source_text: so pray and ask the lord god to send more workers who will gather people together and teach them my message, just like a landowner sends workers into his field to gather the met harvest.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i manèngi ku mi lamatua oka, sèna ka na tabha hari dhèu sab'a, ho lasi puu-g'ètu isi oka se.

source_text: he told us twelve disciples to come to him. then he gave us the power/authority to expel evil spirits that controlled people. he also enabled us to heal all people who had diseases or who were sick.
target_text: èle ka, yesus paroa ana madhutu na, sèna ka mai pakaboko. hèia na hia si koasa ho babège eele nidhu aa puri-pa'èle dhèu nèti papèd'a-tarègu ra.

source_text: here is a list of us twelve disciples whom he called apostles which means ‘messengers': simon, to whom he gave the new name peter; andrew, peter's younger brother; james, the son of zebedee; john, the younger brother of james;
target_text: ana madhutu na dhu na pua sèra, dhèu canguru dua, nuka: partama, ngara na simon dhu dhèu tema paroa ne, ‘petrus', dènge ari na, anderias, yakobis, dènge ari na, yohanis dua ra ana sabadeus,

source_text: philip; bartholomew; thomas; me, matthew, the tax collector; james, the son of alpheus; thaddeus;
target_text: pelipus, bertolomeos, tomas, mateos dhèu roro doi bea, yakobis dhu leo nuka ana alpius, tadius,

source_text: simon, a member of the party that wanted to overthrow the roman government; and judas iscariot or, judas, the man from kerioth town, who later enabled the jewish leaders to seize jesus.
target_text: simon nèti partei politik selot, dènge yudas iskariot dhu èèna na pahie yesus.

source_text: when jesus was about to send us twelve apostles to tell his message to people in various places, he gave us these instructions: do not go where the non-jews live mty or into the towns where the samaritans live, because they hate you. instead, go to the people of israel syn who have gone away from god like sheep that have gotten lost met.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus pua ana madhutu na canguru dua dhèu sèra, aa paredha si, peka na, ja'a pua miu lami asa dhèu èdhi dhèu yahudi sèra, lula ae nèti rèngu dhu madhutu boe j'ara mamuri ama lamatua dènge mola. rèngu cakaraa kahib'i-kalèbho dhu sala j'ara. nèti èèna ka, baku lami asa dhèu yahudi boe, nuka sèmi dhèu samaria.

source_text: when you go to them, proclaim to them that god eup/mty will soon begin to rule over people.
target_text: lami peka dènge dhèu isra'el èdhi sèra, na, ‘ne'e ne, d'ai lod'o kèna, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua. '

source_text: heal sick people, cause dead people to become alive, heal people who have leprosy, and cause demons to leave people who are controlled by them {whom demons control}. do not charge money for helping people, because god did not charge you anything for helping you.
target_text: aa lami puri-pa'èle dhèu pèd'a, pamamuri hari dhèu madhe, pa'èle dhèu kusta, aa babège eele nidhu. ama lamatua hia le miu ae-ae, te ngaa na manèngi hari boe ca ana maa sa. de lami ka ho pala pa'ae-ae mi dhèu leo, te ngaa mage mi manèngi hari ngaa-ngaa kahèi.

source_text: do not take any money with you mty, nor a knapsack. do not take an extra shirt, nor sandals in addition to what you are wearing, nor a walking stick. every worker deserves to get pay from the people for whom he works, so you deserve to receive food and a place to stay from the people to whom you go.
target_text: pakèd'i dènge ai hua. baku mèti doi, gee j'ara, mèdha silu, salapa, do tatea. te dhèu hud'i hia ku dhèu sab'a, ngaa dhu pantas ho ra bisa mamuri.

source_text: in whatever town or village you enter, find out which person is worthy that you should stay in his home. and as you go into that house, ask god to bless the people who live there mty. stay in that home until you leave that town or village.
target_text: ladhe miu maso asa d'ara kota do rae èci, na, miu hud'i tenge ku dhèu dhu neo sèmi rare miu. hèia miu pea ètu èmu èèna, toke miu pakèd'i tèke eele era èèna. ladhe miu maso asa d'ara èmu dhèu, peka la dènge rèngu, ‘saloom! lamatua hia miu mèngi-nale. '

source_text: if the people who live in mty that house are worthy of being blessed {god blessing them}, god will bless them. if the people who live in that house are not worthy of being blessed {of god blessing them}, god will bless you instead of blessing them.
target_text: ladhe dhèu ètu d'ara èmu ne, sèmi rare miu dènge be'a, na, miu manèngi sèna ka lamatua hia si berkat. te ngaa ladhe ra ro'o boe sèmi rare miu, na, lamatua hia boe rèngu berkat.

source_text: if the people who live in any house or town do not welcome you to their home or town, nor listen to your message, leave that house or town. and as you leave, shake off the dust from your feet. by doing that, you will warn them that god will punish them for rejecting your message.
target_text: ladhe dhèu ro'o boe nanene lii padhai miu, mi kalua nèti èmu èèna, do kota èèna, hèia miu caro eele ahu nèti haga miu, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, ladhe ro'o boe nanene, pe rèngu d'ui rare pala ra.

source_text: note this carefully: at the time when god judges all people, he will punish the people who lived in sodom and gomorrah mty, the ancient cities which god destroyed because their people were extremely wicked. but in any town where the people mty refuse to hear your message, god will punish them even more severely.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a, lod'o ama lamatua huku dhèu ètu rai-haha ne'e, tatu na pabia mi dhèu sodom dènge gomora dhu uru èèna bhelu titu kèna. te ngaa sanèd'e! èèna na, nèngu huku bia risi hari mi dhèu dhu ro'o boe sèmi rare miu!

source_text: take note: after i send you out, you will be as defenseless as sheep met in the midst of people who are as dangerous as wolves. so you should wisely stay away from such people, like you stay away from poisonous snakes sim. you should be as harmless as doves are sim.
target_text: sanèd'e paie! te ja'a pua miu ne, èci èèna ka ja'a patabuli kahib'i-kalèbho asa talora aae busa hui. nèti èèna ka, ngangee miu hud'i sèmi mege dhu d'èlu-mèu. aa d'ara mi hud'i mola ku nuka sèmi koro j'aha dhu ne'a boe tenge lii langu.

source_text: also, be on guard against our religious leaders. they will arrest you and take you to the members of the religious councils to put you on trial and punish you because you are my disciples. you will be whipped {the local leaders will whip you} in their meeting places.
target_text: te ngaa baku pamud'e! te bèli-camèd'a dhèu paj'èra miu, sama sèmi busa hui kadhi pamadhe kahib'i-kalèbho. èèna na, rèngu nuni rèti miu asa era parisa lii langu agama. aa dhèu hake paparu miu ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a.

source_text: and because you teach about me, you will be taken {the religious leaders will take you} to governors and kings in order that they may put you on trial and punish you. as a result, you will testify to those rulers and to other non-jews about what i have done.
target_text: pe rèngu ère rèti miu asa madha gubernur dènge dhèu aae, lula miu madhutu ja'a. te ngaa miu hud'i pake lod'o sèra, ho peka-padhai dènge ra lii lolo be'a nèti ja'a. dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua tadèngi kahèi kolongara ja'a ne.

source_text: when the religious leaders arrest you, do not be worried about what you will say to them, because at that very time the holy spirit will tell you the words that you should say.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe rèngu nuni rèti miu sèmi èèna, mage miu madha'u, peka na, ‘èèna na, ja'a peka tasamia? ' do, ‘ja'a neo dhaa peka sèmi ngaa? ' baku j'aj'i mi ngangee, te ladhe d'ai lod'o na, ama mi ètu sorga ka dhu peka dènge miu, nèti j'ara mia ka dhu miu hud'i peka-padhai.

source_text: it is not that you will decide what to say. instead, you will say what the spirit of your heavenly father tells you to say.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ngaa dhu miu padhai, mai boe nèti d'ara miu unu mi, te roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci èèna ka dhu aj'a-nori ètu d'ara miu, sèna ka miu padhai sèmi ngaa sa.

source_text: you will be taken {people who do not believe in me will take you} to the authorities to be killed because you believe in me. for example, people will betray their brothers, and fathers will betray their children. children will rebel against their parents and cause them to be killed.
target_text: sanèd'e, te bèli-camèd'a ètu d'ara èmu cue, ladhe abhu ca dhèu parcaya ja'a, èèna na a'ari nèngu mesa na, ka dhu tenge j'ara ho pamadhe ne. aa ladhe ana ka dhu parcaya, èèna na ama na ka dhu pamadhe ne. ladhe ina-ama ka dhu parcaya, bèli-camèd'a ana-ana ra ka dhu pamadhe si.

source_text: many people will hate you because you believe in me. nevertheless, many people will keep on believing in me until they die. they are the people whom god will take to live with him.
target_text: sanèd'e! te bèli-camèd'a dhèu aa'i-aa'i tèka d'ara dènge miu, lula miu parcaya ja'a ne. te ngaa dhèu dhu taha taruu, èèna na ama lamatua hia ne mamuri.

source_text: when people in one town cause you to suffer, escape to another town and tell the people there about me. note this: i, the one who came down from heaven, will certainly return to earth before you have finished going from one town to another town throughout israel and telling people about me.
target_text: ladhe dhèu paj'èra miu ètu d'ara kota cue, rai lami asa kota leo! lèke kèna! ja'a ne dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. bèli-camèd'a ropa miu palème aa'i mèka kota-kota ètu isra'el, te ngaa ja'a dhu lèpa hari mai le èèna.

source_text: a disciple should not expect to be greater than his teacher, and servants are not superior to their master.
target_text: biasa dhèu pakab'ua ca dhèu mese risi nèti ana sakola na sèra. aa dhèu pakab'ua ca dhèu lamatua risi nèti ènu na sèra.

source_text: you do not expect that people will treat a disciple better than they treat his teacher, or that they will treat a servant better than they treat his master. similarly, because i am your teacher and master, you can expect that people will mistreat you, because they have mistreated me. the most you can expect is that people will treat you like they treat me. i am like the ruler of a household met. but people have insulted me by calling me beelzebub, the ruler of the demons. so they will certainly insult you more, you who are only like members of my household met!
target_text: ladhe ana sakola mèu sama sèmi mese na, nèngu pangee na d'ai le. aa ladhe ènu d'èlu-mèu sama sèmi lamatua na, nèngu ngee na d'ai le. de sanèd'e paie! ladhe dhèu paroa lamatua èmu, peka na, ‘èu ne, baalsebul, dhèu aae nidhu! ' tatu isi èmu na abhu kolongara dhu karehe risi hari.

source_text: do not be afraid of people who insult you and do evil things to you. god wants everything that is unknown now to be revealed {god wants you to reveal everything that is unknown now}. he does not want his truth to remain hidden met and kept secret dou.
target_text: de miu baku madha'u dènge dhèu dhu lab'a miu. te, ngaa dhu dhèu tao pahuni, bèli-camèd'a dhèu aa'i-aa'i ladhe rèdhi.

source_text: so, instead of being afraid, what i say to you secretly as people do at night mty, tell publicly as people do during the daytime mty. what i say to you privately as people do when they whisper to you mty, proclaim publicly mty, dou.
target_text: ngaa dhu ja'a aj'a-nori le miu mesa mi, miu hud'i lami lole ku mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i. aa ngaa dhu ja'a paholo le dènge miu, miu se hud'i lami peka ku palème era.

source_text: do not be afraid of people who are able to kill your body syn but are not able to destroy your soul. instead, fear god because he is able to destroy both a person's body and a person's soul in hell.
target_text: baku madha'u dènge dhèu rai-haha, te rèngu bisa dhoka pamadhe ngi'u aae dhèu di, te ngaa bisa boe pa'ele iie samanga. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i madha'u ku dènge ama lamatua, te dhoka nèngu di dhu dènge koasa ho pamaso ngi'u aae dhèu dènge samanga kateme, asa d'ara dhasi ai dhu heo na loe boe ciki sa.

source_text: think about the sparrows. they have so little value that you can buy cares two of them for only one small coin rhq. but when any sparrow falls to the ground and dies lit, god, your heavenly father, knows it, because he cares about everything.
target_text: de pa'èra d'ara miu. dhèu pahie ana mangungu ètu d'ara pasa dènge kab'ua ciki oo'e di. te ngaa ci'u sa bisa boe madhe, ladhe ama mi ètu sorga no'o mèka.

source_text: he cares about you, too. he even knows how many hairs you have on your head!
target_text: ama miu ètu sorga dhu loe boe ladhe-leru miu, toke j'ara-j'ara dhu ana iiki-iiki. d'ai rèu kètu ètu kab'a kètu miu, na ige nare aa'i hèi.

source_text: god values you much more than he values sparrows lit. so, do not be afraid of people who threaten to kill you
target_text: de baku madha'u! lula ama lamatua pakab'ua miu risi nèti ana mangungu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: if people, without being afraid, are willing to tell others that they are my disciples, i will acknowledge before my father who is in heaven that they are my disciples.
target_text: hèia yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, peka na, dhèu dhu bani mangaku ja'a ètu madha dhèu ae ètu rai-haha ne, pe ja'a kahèi mangaku nèngu ètu katanga madha ama ku ètu sorga, peka na, ‘nèngu ne dhèu ja'a. '

source_text: but if they are afraid to say in front of others that they are my disciples, i will tell my father, who is in heaven, that they are not my disciples.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu pasili ja'a ètu madha dhèu ae, peka na nèngu tadhe boe ja'a, bèli-camèd'a ja'a peka dènge ama ku ètu sorga kahèi, na, ‘ja'a tadhe boe dhèu ne'e. '

source_text: do not think that i came to earth to cause people to live together harmoniously. the result of my coming is that some of those who follow me mty will be killed.
target_text: mage mi pangee na, ja'a ne mai kèti dame asa rai-haha ne. te mamai ja'a ne, sèna ka dhèu rai-haha ne èci lab'a èci.

source_text: because i came to earth, people who do not believe in me will oppose those who do believe in me. for example, some sons will oppose their fathers, some daughters will oppose their mothers, and some daughters-in-law will oppose their mothers-in-law.
target_text: ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne, madhutu ngaa dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua peka tèke èèna, ‘èèna na, ana mone lab'a ama na, ana bhèni lab'a ina na, aa bhèni dhèu èmu ana na, lab'a ina nèti dhèu èmu na,

source_text: this shows that sometimes a person's enemies will be members of his own household.
target_text: te isi èmu mae-manyèla, lula èci lab'a èci. '

source_text: people who love their fathers or mothers more than they love me are not worthy to have a relationship with me. and people who love their sons or daughters more than they love me are not worthy to belong to me.
target_text: de dhèu dhu neo madhutu ja'a tare'a-re'a, nèngu hud'i sue ku ja'a, risi nèti aa'i-aa'i, risi nèti ina-ama na, aa risi nèti ana niki na. ladhe aad'o, na, nèngu nia boe j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a.

source_text: people who are ready to execute a prisoner force him to carry a cross to the place where they will nail him to it met. those who are not willing to allow other people to hurt and disgrace them like that because of being my disciples are not worthy to belong to me.
target_text: te dhèu dhu neo madhutu ja'a, te ngaa d'èi boe pasae j'aj'èra, nèngu nia boe j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a.

source_text: people who deny that they believe in me in order to escape being killed will not live with god eternally met, but people who confess that they believe in me and, as a result are killed, will live with god eternally met.
target_text: dhèu dhu sadia madhe lula na madhutu ja'a, bèli-camèd'a nèngu abhu mamuri taruu dènge ama lamatua. te ngaa dhèu dhu dhoka neo mamuri hia ngi'u nèngu unu na, èèna na, mamuri na ele iia d'ara!

source_text: god considers that everyone who welcomes you, welcomes me sim, and he considers that everyone who welcomes me welcomes him, the one who sent me sim.
target_text: dhèu dhu sèmi nare miu dènge be'a, nèngu sèmi nare ja'a kahèi. aa dhèu dhu sèmi nare ja'a, nèngu kahèi sèmi nare ama lamatua dhu pua ja'a mai.

source_text: those who welcome someone because mty they know that person is a prophet they will receive the same reward that prophets receive from god. likewise, those who welcome a person because mty they know that person is righteous will receive the reward righteous people receive from god.
target_text: dhèu dhu sèmi nare dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, lula na padhue-padhai lii holo-nori ama lamatua, pe lamatua b'ala nèngu sama sèmi na b'ala mi ca dhèu nèti lii padhai nèngu. aa dhèu dhu sèmi nare ca dhèu d'ara mola, lula dhèu èèna madhutu tare'a-re'a dad'èi ama lamatua, pe lamatua b'ala nèngu sama sèmi na b'ala mi ca dhèu d'ara mola.

source_text: note this: suppose people see that you are thirsty mty and give you a drink of cold water because they know that mty you are one of my disciples. god will certainly reward people who do that. they might consider that what they did is insignificant, but god will consider it very significant lit.
target_text: dhèu dhu sèmi nare ca dhèu dhu haha d'ai seli, lula nèngu madhutu ja'a, tatu ama lamatua b'ala ne. masi ka dhèu hia èi hua ca galaa di, tatu ama lamatua bhèlu boe ne.

source_text: when jesus had finished instructing us twelve disciples about what we should do, he sent us to various israelite towns. then he went to teach and preach in other israelite towns in that area.
target_text: ropa yesus hia nare lii moa mi canguru dua ana madhutu na, hèia na la'e kako palème rae-rae ètu rai èèna, sèna ka aj'a dhèu ètu sèra. aa na peka-padhai lii lolo be'a ama lamatua.

source_text: while john the baptizer was in prison, he heard what jesus, the man whom he thought was the messiah, was doing. so he sent some of his disciples to him in order
target_text: lod'o èèna, yohanis ètu d'ara bèdho. ropa na tadèngi j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu yesus tao, hèia na pua ana madhutu na ho lasi karèi yesus, peka na,

source_text: to ask him, are you the messiah who the prophets prophesied would come, or is it someone else that we should expect to come?
target_text: ama lamatua dhu pajaji tèke le karèi nèti uru ka, na, nèngu neo pua kristus mai, sèna ka pala mamuri mi èdhi dhèu yahudi. ama ne, kristus, do? do, èdhi hud'i mate hari ku dhèu leo? ka lasi karèi yesus.

source_text: after they asked jesus that question, he answered them, go back and report to john what you hear me telling people and what you see me doing.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, miu se tadèngi le, aa mèdhi unu mi dènge madha. de lèpa ho lami peka dènge yohanis, aa'i-aa'i dhu j'aj'i, nuka sèmi ngaa dhu dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, yesaya, suri tèke le, peka na:

source_text: i am enabling blind people to see and lame people to walk. i am healing people who have leprosy. i am enabling deaf people to hear and dead people to become alive again. i am telling poor people god's good message.
target_text: dhèu bèdhu, ladhe rèdhi. dhèu karuku, kèd'i kako. dhèu pèd'a kusta, ka'uri ra milu hari. dhèu katele-katipa, bisa tadèngi. dhèu madhe, mamuri hari. dhèu unu aad'o, nanene lii lolo be'a.

source_text: also tell john that god is pleased with people who do not stop believing in me because what i do is not what they expected the messiah to do.
target_text: de sèmi ne'e: lami peka dènge yohanis, bèli-camèd'a nèngu abhu a'oto, ladhe na parcaya ja'a taruu. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a pa'èra-èra!

source_text: when john's disciples had gone away, jesus began to talk to the crowd of people about john. he said to them, think about what sort of person you went to see in the desolate area when you went there to see john. ◄you did not go there to listen to a man who constantly changed his message, like a reed that is blown {blows} back and forth in the wind met! /did you go there to listen to a man whose message changes continually like long grass that is blown {blows} back and forth in the wind changes its direction? ► met, rhq
target_text: ropa ana madhutu yohanis se lèpa, hèia yesus peka dènge dhèu ae se, lula-nèti yohanis ne, aku nèngu na, lod'o miu neo paraga dènge yohanis ètu d'ara pad'a sod'a, miu pangee, na, neo paraga dènge dhèu dhu sèmi ngaa sa? tatu boe, miu paraga dènge dhèu dhu roe aala-aala, nuka sèmi kalai èèu dhu bhabheu madhutu ngèlu di!

source_text: then what kind of person did you go there to see rhq? ◄you did not go there to see a man who was wearing expensive clothes. /did you go there to see a man who was wearing expensive clothes? ► rhq no! you know very well that people who wear beautiful clothes reside in kings' palaces and not in desolate areas.
target_text: aa tatu boe miu mèdhi dhèu dhu pake mèdha-papake dhu kab'ua aae, te dhèu sèmi èèna era pea na dhodhoka ètu d'ara èmu dhèu aae di!

source_text: then what kind of person did you go to see rhq? did you go there rhq to see john because he was ◄a prophet/a person who speaks what god tells him to say►? yes! but i will tell you that john is more important than an ordinary prophet.
target_text: de lami ladhe dhèu sèmi ngaa sa ètu nèi? mi pangee na, miu lami tenge dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua! tare'a! te nèngu ne, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua dhu kapai risi.

source_text: he is the one to whom god was referring when he said to the messiah these words that are written {about whom the prophet malachi wrote} in the scriptures: listen! i am going to send my messenger to go before you syn to prepare the people met for your coming.
target_text: te ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci èèna, dhu suri tèke le lula-nèti yohanis ne, peka na, ‘nanene! ja'a pua dhèu ja'a, sèna ka bhoke j'ara hia èu. '

source_text: note this: of all the people who have ever lived, god does not consider that any of them are greater than john the baptizer. however, god considers that all those people who have let god rule their lives are greater than john, even if they are insignificant people.
target_text: nanene paie! ètu rai-haha ne, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu kapai risi nèti yohanis ne. te ngaa nèti dhèu rai-haha aa'i-aa'i dhu mangaku ama lamatua sama sèmi dhèu aae, dhèu dhu haha d'ai seli èèna ka, nèngu dhu kapai risi nèti yohanis.

source_text: the people who lived in the towns mty in the area where jesus was saw him perform many miracles. but they did not turn away from their sinful behavior. so jesus began to reproach them by saying to them,
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua yesus pasanèd'e dhèu-dhèu dhu pea ètu pèri-pèri rae. na tao le tadha-tadha malaa ae risi ètu nèi, te ngaa ro'o boe ae eele nèti sasala ra, ho madhutu j'ara mamuri ama lamatua dhu mola.

source_text: you people who live in chorazin city mty and you people who live in bethsaida city mty will suffer terribly in hell! i did great miracles in your cities, but you did not turn from your sinful behavior. if the miracles that i performed in your cities had been done in the ancient cities of tyre and sidon, the wicked people who lived there long ago would have sat in ashes, wearing coarse cloth to show that they were sorry for their sins.
target_text: yesus jèke si, peka na, heh! miu dhèu korasin, aa miu dhèu betsaida! mate unu miu! bèli-camèd'a pasae mere mamadhe-mamopo! ja'a tao le rupa-rupa tadha malaa ètu katanga madha miu, te ngaa miu mo'o boe parcaya ama lamatua. masi ka miu dhèu yahudi dhu peka na, miu tadhe lamatua, te ngaa ladhe sèmi tadha malaa dhu ja'a tao se'e ètu kota tirus dènge kota sidon, tatu nèbhu nare sange ne'e, dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra èle le ho'a, aa tèke eele le sasala-sasigo ra ho madhutu ama lamatua. aa tatu ra pake le bèla mèdhi, dènge tao ahu mi kètu ho j'aj'i mi tadha, na, rèngu manyasa nèti sasala ra. masi ka dhèu tirus dènge dhèu sidon sèra dhèu yahudi boe, dhu mangaku na, tadhe lamatua.

source_text: so note this: god will punish the wicked people who lived in the cities of tyre and sidon mty, but he will punish you even more severely on the final day when he judges all people.

source_text: also have something to say to you people who live in capernaum city mty. ◄do not think that you will be honored {that god will honor you} in heaven! /do you think that you will be honored {that god will honor you} in heaven? ► rhq that will not happen! on the contrary, after you die, you will be sent {god will send you} down into the place where sinful people will be punished {he will punish sinful people} forever. god destroyed the ancient city of sodom because the people who lived in that city were extremely wicked. if i had performed in sodom the miracles that i performed in your city, the people there would have turned away from their wicked behavior and their city met would still exist now mty. but you, although i did miracles in your city, you did not turn from your wicked behavior.
target_text: miu dhèu kapernaum! mage-mage, ee! mage mi pangee, na, ama lamatua paca'e miu lami asa sorga. aad'o! èèna na lamatua pèci mi asa d'ara naraka! ladhe sèmi tadha-tadha malaa dhu ja'a tao ètu rae miu dhu j'aj'i uuru le ètu kota sodom, tatu ama lamatua parluu boe labhu pakèpu kota èèna. te ladhe dhèu sodom rèdhi tadha malaa se, tatu ra rai eele le nèti bhabhelu-katub'a ra.

source_text: at that time jesus prayed, father, you rule over everything in heaven and on the earth. i thank you that you have prevented people who think that they are wise iro because they are well-educated, from knowing these things. instead, you have revealed them to people who accept your truth as readily as little children met do.
target_text: ropa padhai lii nare, hèia yesus sabaj'a, peka na, ama! ama dhu j'aj'i lamatua ètu dedha-liru dènge rai-haha. ja'a manèngi makasi ae-ae, lula ama pahuni pamèno-mèno j'ara-j'ara dhu ama hia huku mi dhèu-dhèu dhu pangee na, rèngu d'èlu-mèu, aa dhu padedha iisi ra. te ngaa ama bhoke patalele j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i mi dhèu haha dènge dhu pahaha iisi ra.

source_text: yes, father, you have done that because it seemed good to you to do so.
target_text: tare'a, ama! te sèmi èèna ka, dhu pakarej'e d'ara ama!

source_text: then jesus said to the people there who wanted him to teach them, god, my father, has revealed to me all the things that i need to know in order to do my work. only my father knows who i really am. furthermore, only i and those people to whom i wish to reveal him know what god my father is like.
target_text: ropa sabaj'a nare, hèia yesus peka dènge dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra, na, nanene paie-iie! ama ku ètu sorga pangèd'u le koasa aa'i-aa'i mi ja'a ne. dhu tadhe mèu ja'a, dhoka ama ku di. aa dhu tadhe mèu ama, dhoka ana na, nuka ja'a ne. aa ja'a hag'e kore dhèu leo, sèna ka peka dènge ra, ho rèngu tadhe mèu ne kahèi.

source_text: come to me, all you people who are very weary of trying to obey all the many laws that your religious teachers tell you to obey met. i will enable you to quit trying to obey all those laws.
target_text: miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu roe lula sab'a bia, mai madhutu ja'a! aa miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu pasae bia, mai la asa ja'a!

source_text: let me help you carry those loads, just like two oxen who have a yoke on their necks met, dou help each other pull a heavy load. it will not be difficult for you to do the things that i ask you to do for me dou. because i am gentle and humble dou, accept what i teach about what god wants you to do. and as a result, you will quit worrying about obeying all the religious laws, and your spirits will be at peace.
target_text: ladhe miu sèmi mere a'aj'a ja'a, ho kako palere-lere dènge ja'a, na, èdhi ca ropa dènge sapi dua ngi'u dhu nuni kataka pare rai èci. te ja'a ne, d'ara hua iia, aa lii mako. ladhe miu madhutu ja'a, miu j'aj'i èra hari. lula a'aj'a ja'a, carui boe. aa paredha ja'a, bia boe kahèi.

source_text: during that period of time, on a ◄sabbath/jewish day of rest►, jesus and we disciples were walking through some grain fields. and because we were hungry, we began to pick some of the heads of grain and eat them. the laws of moses permitted people to do that if they were hungry.
target_text: ca lod'o, lèke dènge ae sasab'a dhèu yahudi, yesus dènge ana-ana madhutu na dhu kako re karasa oka dhèu. ana madhutu na manganga, hèia ra g'ètu are-gandum ka ra'a noo-noo.

source_text: some pharisees saw us do what they considered to be work. so they said to jesus, accusing him, look! your disciples are doing work that is not permitted in our laws prs for us to do on our day of rest!
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu pèri-pèri dhèu nèti partei agama parisi dhu madhutu pa'èra ad'a dhèu yahudi ra. ropa ladhe rèdhi ana madhutu yesus se tao sèmi èèna, hèia ra kai ne, peka na, ana madhutu mu, g'ètu gandum lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a-la'a! rèngu baku tao sèmi ne'e! te tatao ne sisu atora èdhi.

source_text: jesus wanted to show them that the record in the scriptures indicated that god permitted people to disobey certain religious laws when they needed food. so he said to them, it is written {someone wrote} in the scriptures rhq what our revered ancestor king david did when he and the men with him were hungry. you have read about that, ◄but you do not think about what it implies! /so why do you not think about what it implies? ► rhq david entered the big tent where they worshipped god and asked for some food. the high priest gave him the bread that had been {they had} presented to god. according to the laws of moses, only priests were permitted to eat that bread, but david and the men who were with him ate it. and god did not consider that what they did was wrong
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, tasamia, ee? miu teko bhèlu lii lolo daud, si? daud dènge ana-ana madhutu na dhu manganga titu kèna. hèia na maso asa d'ara paleo manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua, ka nare roti dhu ama agama hia le mi lamatua, ka rèngu ra'a. te ngaa dhu bisa ra'e roti se dhodhoka ama agama sèra. dhèu leo bisa boe. èle ka daud si ra'a, te ngaa ca dhèu sa pasala boe si. miu nuka sèmi dhèu dhu baca mèdhi boe sasuri lii holo-nori ama lamatua!

source_text: also, think about the laws that moses wrote rhq. he said that even though the priests, by working in the temple on our jewish day of rest, are not obeying the jewish day of rest laws, they are not guilty. you have surely read that, but you do not understand what it means.
target_text: te ètu d'ara sasuri èèna, suri kahèi nèti sasab'a ama agama yahudi sèra, ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a, lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a. te ngaa rèngu sala boe ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: note this: god allows men to work in the temple on our rest day because that work must be done. but in addition, i tell you that i have more authority than the authority of the temple. so, it is more important for you to obey my teachings than to obey your traditions about our rest day.
target_text: nanene! uru èèna, èmu sabaj'a ka dhu kab'ua, te ngaa limuri ne abhu dhu kab'ua risi, nuka ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a.

source_text: you should think about these words of god in the scriptures: ‘i want you to act mercifully toward people, and not just offer sacrifices. ' if you understood what that means, you would not condemn my disciples, who have done no wrong.
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, na peka na, ‘dad'èi ja'a sèmi ne'e: dhèu ja'a sèra hud'i pad'elo ku rasa kasia èci dènge èci. ladhe ra tao boe madhutu j'ara ne, na, badha korban dhu rèngu rèti hia ja'a, dènge boe kab'ua. ' de ladhe miu me'a mèu sasoa nèti lii padhai lamatua ne, tatu miu pasala boe ana madhutu ja'a se. te ra tao boe sala ngaa-ngaa!

source_text: and i want you to know that i, the one who came from heaven, have the authority to determine what is right for my disciples to do on the days of rest.

source_text: after jesus left there that day, he went into a building where we jews worship god.
target_text: èle ka yesus tèke eele era èèna, la'e asa d'ara èmu sabaj'a ra.

source_text: he saw a man with a shriveled hand there. the pharisees thought that jesus would be disobeying the tradition about not working on the day of rest if he healed the man, so one of them asked him, does god permit us to heal people on our day of rest? they asked that question so that they might accuse him if he healed someone ◄on the sabbath/on the jewish rest day►.
target_text: ètu ne'e, abhu mone ca dhèu dhu kacui-aai madhe cabèka. dhèu parisi sèra dhu tenge-tenge j'ara ho pasala yesus, ladhe sèmi na puri-pa'èle dhèu dhu kacui-aai madhe cabèka ne, lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a. hèia ra karèi ne, peka na, madhutu atora agama èdhi, dhèu bisa puri-pa'èle dhèu, lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a-la'a, do aad'o?

source_text: he replied to them, would anyone among you who has only one sheep that falls into a hole ◄on the sabbath/on the jewish rest day► just leave it there rhq? certainly not! you would take hold of it and lift it out right away, and that would be acceptable work on our day of rest, too
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ladhe kahib'i-kalèbho ci'u manahu asa d'ara ro'a, lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a, dhèu unu na mai name nare, sina ma?

source_text: because sheep are valuable, their owners may work on our day of rest in order to rescue them. so, because people are more valuable than sheep, it is certainly right for us to do something good by healing another person any day, including our day of rest!

source_text: he will not quarrel with people, neither will he shout. he will not teach with a loud voice in the main streets.

source_text: as a result, the non-jews will confidently expect that he will do great things for them.

source_text: one day when jesus was at home, some men brought to jesus a man who, because of being controlled by a demon {a demon controlled him}, was blind and unable to speak. jesus healed him by expelling the demon. as a result, the man began to talk and was able to see.
target_text: ca tèka, rèti asa yesus ca dhèu dhu nidhu tao toke bèdhu aa ele lii. hèia yesus pa'èle ne dènge babège eele nidhu nèti dhèu ne'e. ka dhèu ne bisa nèdhi, aa bisa padhai lii.

source_text: because the pharisees and the men who taught the jewish laws heard that the people thought that jesus might be the messiah because he had expelled the demon, they said, it is not god, but beelzebub, the ruler of the demons, who enables this man to expel demons from people!

target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a lii padhai dhèu parisi se. hèia na peka dènge dhèu se'e, aku nèngu na, lii padhai miu ne, lèke boe! ladhe ètu d'ara rai cue, ana kabarai na patao-palaha, tasa mera mia ho rai ne bisa taha! sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe dhèu ètu d'ara kota èci, do d'ara èmu cue, èci patao dènge èci, tatu ra mae-manyèla, toke laho mae-mae, si!

source_text: but because it is god's spirit who enables me to expel demons, that proves that the power of god to rule people's lives has come to you.

target_text: yesus peka hari lii pakasame èci, aku nèngu na, dhèu-dhèu unu ama lamatua, èci èèna ka dènge ragi dhu bhèni èci nare, pab'ali dènge tarigu ca sak. hèia roti ne ca'e toke kapai, lula ragi dhu ciki oo'e deo na.

source_text: jesus told the crowd parables to teach them all these things. when he spoke hyp to them, he habitually used such illustrations.
target_text: yesus aj'a dhèu ae dènge lii lolo rupa-rupa. lii padhai na, aa'i-aa'i se, dhodhoka pake lii pakasame di.

source_text: by doing that, he fulfilled what god told one of the prophets to write long ago: i will speak mty in parables; i will tell parables to teach what i have kept secret since i created the world.
target_text: na aj'a sèmi èèna, sèna ka madhutu sèmi lii nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu suri tèke, peka na, pe ja'a aj'a-nori pake lii pakasame. pe ja'a lole j'ara-j'ara dhu dhèu tadèngi rèdhi mèka, karèi nèti lamatua paj'aj'i rai-haha toke d'ai sange ne'e.

source_text: after jesus dismissed the crowds, he went inside. then we disciples approached him and said, explain to us the parable about the weeds that grew in the wheat field.
target_text: èle ka, yesus lèpa èmu tèke eele dhèu ae sèra. hèia ana madhutu na sèra mai manèngi, na, ama! peka ku dènge ji'i sasoa nèti lii pakasame j'u'u deo sa!

source_text: he answered, the one who sows the good seed represents me, the one who came from heaven.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, na, dhèu dhu ceb'e hini dhu be'a èèna, nuka ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne.

source_text: the field represents this world mty, where people live. the seeds that grew well represent the people who let god rule their lives met. the weeds represent the people who do what the devil, the evil one, tells them to do.
target_text: aa oka èèna, nuka rai-haha ne. hini dhu be'a èèna, nuka dhèu-dhèu dhu j'aj'i le ana-èpu ama lamatua. aa j'u'u sèra, nuka ana pajuu nèti dhèu aae nidhu.

source_text: the enemy who sowed the weed seeds represents the devil. the time when the reapers will harvest the grain represents the time when the world will end. the reapers represent the angels.
target_text: aa dhèu bhelu dhu mai ceb'e lamusi j'u'u, nuka dhèu aae nidhu. aa lod'o puu-g'ètu èèna, nuka d'ai èle rai-haha ne. dhèu sab'a dhu pakaboko isi oka se, nuka ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga.

source_text: the weeds are gathered and burned. {the reapers gather the weeds. then they burn them. } that represents the judging of people, which god will do when the world will end. it will be like this:
target_text: ropa d'ai èle rai-haha ne, ra oru rare j'u'u se ho tunu pakèpu si.

source_text: i, the one who came from heaven, will send my angels, and they will gather from everywhere the people who cause others to quit believing in me met and all those who disobey god's commands.
target_text: te ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, bèli-camèd'a pua ana pajuu nèti sorga mai. rèngu èèna na pakaboko dhèu-dhèu dhu pusi-pahae boe madhutu paredha ama lamatua. aa rèngu oru rare kahèi dhèu-dhèu dhu dadugu-rariu dhèu leo, sèna ka baku madhutu paredha lamatua.

source_text: they will throw those people into the fires of hell. there those people will weep and grind their teeth because of the great pain that they are suffering.
target_text: èèna na ra core dhèu bhelu-katub'a aa'i-aa'i se asa d'ara ai naraka, nuka sèmi j'u'u dhu ai na'e pakèpu si. ètu nèi, dhèu se rasa j'èra titu kèna, aa tangi d'ara ma'ète mae-mae loe boe ciki sa.

source_text: god's brightness will shine on the people who have lived as he wants them to. it will shine on them as brightly as the sun shines. it will shine on them in the place where god, their father, rules over them. if you want to understand this mty, you should think carefully about what i have just said.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu mamuri mola madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua, rèngu pea taruu dènge ama dhèu aae ra ètu sorga. ètu nèi, dhèu se ha'a-ha'a, hèti-hèti, nuka sèmi madha lod'o. de dhèu dhu neo tadhe mèu ja'a, pasa dhilu paie-iie!

source_text: what people do who begin to allow god mty/eup to rule their lives is like what a certain man did to acquire a treasure. a treasure was hidden in a field by someone {someone hid a treasure in a field and never dug it up again}. when another man found it, he hid it by burying it again in order that no one else would find it. being very happy that he had found something very valuable, he went and sold all his possessions to obtain money to buy the field the treasure was in. he then went and bought the field, and so he was able to acquire that treasure.
target_text: yesus tabha hari lii pakasame èci, aku nèngu na, dhèu dhu neo tadhe mèu ama lamatua nèd'u paredha, rèngu nuka sèmi dhèu dhu neo abhu mèdha kab'ua aae, dhu dhèu huni tèke ètu d'ara rai cakasib'i. ka dhèu ne la'e kèi, hèia na abhu mèdha ne, nèti èèna ka na karej'e-karae. èle èèna ka, na dhènu hari mèdha deo na. hèia na lèpa hari lai-lai, la'e pahia aa'i mèdha-panyau na. ka la'e hèli nare rai ne, sèna ka na unu mèdha dhu kab'ua aae deo na.

source_text: also, what people do who begin to allow god mty/eup to rule their lives is like what a merchant did who was looking for good quality pearls to buy.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii pakasame, peka na, dhèu dhu neo tadhe mèu ama lamatua nèd'u paredha, èci èèna kahèi dènge dhèu d'aga ca dhèu dhu d'ara na neo abhu mutiara dhu kab'ua aae titu kèna. èle ka, na patangi-tenge mutiara ho neo hèli.

source_text: when he found one very costly pearl that was for sale, he sold all his possessions to acquire enough money to buy that pearl. then he went and bought it.
target_text: ropa na rage mutiara cue dhu be'a titu kèna, hèia na lèpa lai-lai, sèna ka pahia aa'i mèdha-panyau na. hèia la'e tihe mutiara ne, sèna ka j'aj'i mi unu na.

source_text: what god mty/eup will do to people who falsely say that they are letting him rule their lives is like what certain fishermen did with the fish they caught in a lake, using a large net. they caught all classes of fish, both useful and worthless fish.
target_text: yesus peka hari, na, paredha ama lamatua, nuka sèmi pèku èci dhu dhèu sab'a dhasi lasi lolo ètu d'ara dano. ka pèku ne lèke rupa-rupa i'a.

source_text: when the net was full, the fishermen pulled it up onto the shore. then they sat there and put the useful fish into buckets, and threw the worthless ones away.
target_text: ropa pèku ne pènu dènge i'a, dhèu pèku se ded'e rèti asa dedha nebhe. hèia ra madhèdi kabhili i'a nèti pèku ne. i'a dhu be'a, ra tao asa d'ara kalera. te ngaa i'a dhu karehe, ra core eele.

source_text: what they did in separating the good fish from the bad ones is like what will happen to people when the world ends. the angels will come to where god is judging people, and will separate the wicked people from the righteous ones.
target_text: èci èèna ka, ladhe d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne. èèna na ana pajuu lamatua mai nèti sorga, sèna ka hag'e eele dhèu dhu d'ara mola nèti dhèu bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: they will throw the wicked people into the fire in hell. and those wicked people will weep and gnash their teeth because of the intense pain they are suffering.
target_text: dhèu dhu bhelu-katub'a aa'i-aa'i ra, core si asa d'ara ai naraka. ètu nèi, rèngu heka re'a j'aj'èra, aa loe boe tangi roma iisi.

source_text: then jesus asked us, do you understand all these parables i have told you? we said to him,
target_text: ropa padhai lii nare, hèia yesus karèi ra, aku nèngu na, miu me'a aa'i ngaa dhu ja'a peka-padhai se, do? ra dhaa peka na, nge'a, ama!

source_text: yes, we understand them. then he said to us, because you understand all these parables, you will understand the following parable: you, along with all others, will teach people what you heard me say about god ruling people's lives. you will add that to what you formerly learned. you will be like a manager of a household who takes both new things and old things out of his storage room.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala, peka na, be'a! te mese agama aa'i-aa'i dhu re'a tare'a-re'a lii holo-nori lamatua dhu suri tèke karèi nèti uru èèna, ka ra kèpe pa'èra a'aj'a ja'a, na, rèngu ca ropa dènge lamatua èmu dhu d'èi bhoke gud'a na, ho pad'elo mèdha-panyau na dhu dhui, dènge mèdha-panyau na dhu hiu.

source_text: when jesus had finished telling these parables, he took us and left that area.
target_text: ropa yesus aj'a nare dhèu ae sèra, pake lii pakasame, hèia la'e, tèke eele era èèna,

source_text: we went to nazareth, his hometown. ◄on the sabbath/on the jewish rest day► he began to teach the people in the jewish worship house. the result was that the people there were astonished. but some said, this man is just an ordinary person like us. so how is it that he knows so much and understands so much rhq? and how is it that he is able to do such miracles rhq?
target_text: ho lèpa asa rae na. d'ai nèi, maso la'e asa d'ara èmu sabaj'a, ho aj'a-nori dhèu. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tadèngi lii padhai na malaa-maloha. ka ra papeka, aku rèngu na, ira ii! dhèu ne d'èlu-mèu titu kèna, nga! na sakola ètu mia ne? tasamia ka na bisa tao tadha malaa se'e?

source_text: ◄he is just the son of the carpenter! /isn't he just the son of the carpenter that lived here? ► rhq his mother is mary, and his younger brothers are james, joseph, simon and judas rhq!
target_text: nèngu ne dhoka ana nèti ca dhèu tuka aj'u di. èdhi patadha be'a dènge ina na maria; aa dènge ari na aa'i-aa'i, nuka yakobis, yusuf, yudas dènge simon.

source_text: ◄and his sisters also live here in our town. /do not his sisters live in our town? ► rhq so how is he able to do all these miracles?
target_text: èdhi tadhe ana hèni na kahèi, te èdhi pea ètu d'ara rae cue! de na abhu mamèu na nèti mia? aa na abhu koasa kapai ne nèti cee hari?

source_text: the people were unable to accept that he was the messiah. so jesus said to them, people honor me and other prophets everywhere else we go, but in our hometowns we are not honored, and even our own families do not honor us!
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu se kacèki, toke ra ro'o heka nanene lii padhai na. te ngaa yesus peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, mema tare'a! dhèu d'èi risi pakab'ua dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu mai nèti era leo, te ngaa ra pakab'ua boe dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu mai nèti rae rèngu unu ra.

source_text: jesus did not perform many miracles there because the people did not believe that he was the messiah.
target_text: lula d'ara ra adhu, toke ra parcaya boe yesus, nèti èèna ka na tao tadha malaa ae boe ètu d'ara rae na.

source_text: during that time herod antipas, the ruler, heard reports about jesus performing miracles.
target_text: tèu èèna, dhèu aae herodes nèd'u paredha ètu propensi galilea. nèngu ne dhu tadèngi le kahèi rupa-rupa j'ara lula-nèti yesus.

source_text: he said to his servants: that must be john the baptizer. he must have risen from the dead, and that is why he has power to perform miracles.
target_text: na peka dènge dhèu sab'a na sèra, aku nèngu na, ele boe yesus ne, nuka yohanis tuka sarani, dhu ca hari ni ja'a pua dhèu poro rare kètu na. limuri ne, na mamuri hari le! nèti èèna ka, na abhu koasa, tao tadha-tadha malaa sèra.

source_text: the reason herod thought that was this: herod had married herodias, the wife of his brother philip, while philip was still living. so john had been saying to him, what you did by marrying your brother's wife while your brother is still alive is against god's law! then, to please herodias, herod told his soldiers to arrest john. they bound him with chains and put him in prison.
target_text: dhèu aae herodes peka sèmi èèna, lula uru èèna nèngu dhu tao lii langu dènge yohanis, toke na kèpe yohanis aa pamaso asa d'ara bèdho. j'aj'aj'i lii langu ne, sèmi ne'e ka: dhèu aae herodes leo nare dhèu èmu ari na pelipus, ngara na herodias. aa te ngaa pelipus dènge herodias dhae pa'ia-pa'ela mèka. nèti èèna ka, yohanis kai ne pahari-pahari, peka na, ama dhèu aae, baku paleo èmu dènge dhèu èmu ari mu. te j'ara ne, pamèci boe dènge ad'a èdhi dhèu yahudi!

source_text: herod wanted to have john executed, but he was afraid that the people who had accepted what john taught would riot if he did that, because they believed that john was a prophet.
target_text: te ngaa herodes dale boe lii kai na, hèia leo nare herodias. madhutu iia-iia na, herodes neo pamadhe yohanis tuka sarani. te ngaa na madha'u dènge dhèu ae sèra, lula ra parcaya na, yohanis ne, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, na pua dhèu sab'a na pamaso yohanis asa d'ara bèdho.

source_text: but when herod gave a party to celebrate his birthday, the daughter of herodias danced for his guests. this pleased herod.
target_text: te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, hèia herodes tao pesta hari jadi na. lod'o èèna, ana bhèni nèti bhèni aae herodias la'e roge ètu madha tamu se. na roge be'a titu kèna, toke d'ara herodes karej'e bia.

source_text: so he promised to give her whatever she asked, and he asked god to punish him if he did not do what he had promised.
target_text: na roge nare, hèia herodes paroa ne, ka na peka, èu neo manèngi hadia ngaa nèti ja'a, na peka la! te èèna na ja'a hia èu. ja'a leko boe-monya boe. aa ja'a subha dènge kolongara ama lamatua.

source_text: so herodias' daughter went and asked her mother what to ask for. her mother told her to ask for john the baptizer's head. so her daughter went back and said to herod: cut off the head of john the baptizer and please bring it here on a platter so that my mother can know for sure that he is dead!
target_text: ropa na tadèngi dhèu aae peka sèmi èèna, hèia ina na kakèj'i ne. nèti èèna ka, ana ne la'e peka na, ama! ja'a manèngi kètu nèti yohanis tuka sarani. tèke ne mi d'ara dula, ho rèti mai asa ne'e hia ja'a.

source_text: the king was distressed because he now knew he should not have made that promise to her. but because he had made an oath in front of his guests when he made that promise, and he did not want them to think that he would not do what he had promised, he commanded that the girl be given what she requested.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii manèngi ana bhèni ne, hèia d'ara herodes roe dènge. te ngaa nèngu bisa boe ère nare hari lii subha na, te tamu aa'i-aa'i dhu tadèngi le. nèti èèna ka, na madhutu dhoka dad'èi ana bhèni ne di.

source_text: he sent the executioner to go to the prison and to cut off john's head.
target_text: ka na paredha dhèu lasi poro rare kètu yohanis ètu d'ara bèdho.

source_text: the executioner did that, and put john's head on a platter and gave it to the girl. then the girl took it to her mother.
target_text: ropa ra poro rare, hèia ra tèke mi d'ara dula ho rèti lasi hia mi ana bhèni ne. ropa ana bhèni ne sèmi nare dula, hèia nèti asa ina na.

source_text: john's disciples then went to the prison, took john's body and buried it, and they reported to jesus what had happened.
target_text: lod'o ana madhutu yohanis se tadèngi, ka mai rare ngi'u aae na, ho lasi padhane. èle ka, lasi peka dènge yesus j'ara dhu j'aj'i ne.

source_text: after jesus heard that, he took just us disciples with him and we went by boat on galilee lake to an uninhabited place. after the crowds heard that we had gone to an uninhabited place, they left their towns and followed jesus, walking along the shore.
target_text: lod'o yesus tadèngi ngaa dhu j'aj'i mi yohanis, hèia nèngu dènge ana-ana madhutu na tèke eele era èèna. hèia ra ca'e koha, ho lasi asa era dhu dhèu pea boe, sèna ka ra ae rare ciki. te ngaa dhèu ae ladhe rèdhi koha yesus si dhu oro-oro re sebhe dano. ka dhèu se mai nèti rae-rae, kako karohe-karohe re dedha rai. nèti èèna ka, dhèu se d'ai uuru nèti yesus si.

source_text: when jesus came to the shore, he saw a large crowd of people who had gathered there, waiting for him. he felt sorry for them, and he healed those among them who were sick.
target_text: ropa na puru nèti dedha koha, hèia nèdhi dhèu ae-ae dhu mate le nèngu. ka na rasa kasia mi rèngu. hèia na puri-pa'èle papèd'a-tarègu ra.

source_text: when it was nearly evening, we disciples came to him and said, this is a place where nobody lives, and it is very late. dismiss the crowds so that they can go into the nearby towns. have them do that so that they can buy food for themselves.
target_text: d'ai lod'o nihia, hèia ana madhutu na, peka dènge ne, ama! hua iia ama pua dhèu se, sèna ka lasi hèli nganga'a ètu rae-rae dhu padètu ètu se'e. te lod'o nihia le! ètu ne'e nganga'a aad'o.

source_text: but jesus said to us, they do not need to leave to get food. instead, you yourselves give them something to eat!
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala si, peka na, baku! miu ka dhu panga'a si.

source_text: we said to him, but we have only five loaves of bread and two cooked fish here!
target_text: te ngaa ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ira ee, ama! ji'i se dènge boe ngaa-ngaa, ho panga'a dhèu ae-ae sèmi ne'e ne. ji'i tao tasamia? te abhu dhoka roti lèmi bua di, aa i'a dua ngi'u di!

source_text: he said to us, bring them to me!
target_text: te ngaa yesus lii, peka na, oo! be'a kèna. mèti ku mai!

source_text: he told the people who had gathered there to sit on the grass. then he took the five flat loaves and the two fish. he looked up toward heaven, thanked god for them, and broke them into pieces. then he gave them to us disciples, and we distributed them to the crowd.
target_text: ka na pua dhèu se aa'i-aa'i ra madhèdi kaboko ètu dedha j'u'u. èle èèna ka, yesus nare roti lèmi bua dènge i'a dua ngi'u sèra. hèia na ladhe asa dedha, ho manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. èle ka, na pamae roti se, hèia j'ole asa ana madhutu na, sèna ka ra papala mi dhèu se aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: all the people in the crowd ate until they had enough to eat. then we disciples gathered the pieces that were left over, and we filled twelve baskets with them.
target_text: ka dhèu se ra'a toke bècu. ra'a rara, hèia ana madhutu se pakaboko rare dhu ata, pènu canguru dua soe.

source_text: those who ate were about 5, 000 men. we did not count the women and children!
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ra'a se, dhèu mone pe d'ai lèmi riho sa, iga mèka dhèu bhèni dènge ana iiki.

source_text: right after that happened, jesus told us disciples to get in the boat and to go ahead of him further around the lake while he dismissed the crowds.
target_text: ropa dhèu aa'i-aa'i se ra'a rare, hèia yesus pua ana madhutu na ca'e koha, sèna ka lasi uru asa cabèka dano. te ngaa nèngu ètu èèna era, sena ka pua dhèu se lèpa.

source_text: after he dismissed them, he went up into the hills to pray by himself. when it was evening, he was still there alone.
target_text: ropa rèngu lèpa aa'i mèu-mèu, hèia yesus ca'e la'e asa ledhe èci, ho sabaj'a. toke mèda, nèngu mesa na ètu èèna era.

source_text: by this time we were already many hundred meters from the shore. the boat was being severely tossed around by the waves {the waves were severely tossing the boat} because the wind was blowing against it.
target_text: lod'o èèna, koha ana madhutu na d'ai le talora aae dano. te ngaa rèngu tuku d'ai madhe, lula ngèlu nèti madha, aa naha kapai tatèb'e koha ra.

source_text: then jesus came down from the hills to the lake. some time between three and six o'clock in the morning he walked on the water toward our boat.
target_text: oe d'ai mèu, hèia yesus la'e madhutu si. te ngaa nèngu dhu kako re dedha èi.

source_text: when we disciples saw someone walking on the water, we thought that we must be seeing a ghost. we were terrified, and we screamed out because we were afraid.
target_text: ropa ladhe rèdhi, ana madhutu se cag'ag'a, hèia ra padhai dènge lii madha'u, aku rèngu na, heeh! nidhu kèna!

source_text: immediately jesus said to us, cheer up! it is i. do not be afraid!
target_text: te ngaa yesus lii dènge ra, peka na, miu baku madha'u! te ja'a ne, yesus! mau-mau la!

source_text: peter said to him, lord, if it is you, tell me to walk on the water to you!
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi lii ne'e, hèia petrus peka na, ladhe ama kèna, pua la ja'a kako re dedha èi ne, dhiu asa ama.

source_text: then jesus said, come! so peter got out of the boat and walked on the water toward jesus.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa peka na, mai ka! hèia petrus puru nèti dedha koha, la'e re dedha èi, asa yesus.

source_text: but when peter looked at the tossing waves which the strong wind caused, he became afraid. he began to sink, and cried out, lord, save me!
target_text: te ngaa ropa petrus rasa na ngèlu aae, hèia na madha'u bia. ka na mulai cène, hèia na pa'oo, aku nèngu na, ira oo, ama, ee! soru ku ja'a la!

source_text: immediately jesus stretched out his hand and grabbed him. he said to peter, you only trust a little bit in my power ◄why did you doubt that i could keep you from sinking? /you should not have doubted that i could keep you from sinking! ► rhq
target_text: yesus j'ole dènge ka kacui-aai na, ka kèpe nare petrus. hèia yesus padhai lii, aku nèngu na, petrus, ee! nga tao ka d'ara èu kajari? èu parcaya èra boe mi ja'a, do?

source_text: then jesus and peter got in the boat, and the wind immediately stopped blowing.
target_text: ka dua ra ca'e lasi asa dedha koha, hèia ngèlu mau dènge.

source_text: all of us disciples who were in the boat worshipped jesus and said, truly you are the ◄son of/man two is also► god!
target_text: ropa rèdhi sèmi èèna, ana madhutu na koa-kio padedha-dedha ne, peka na, ira ii! ama ne, mema tare'a-re'a ana ama lamatua!

source_text: when we had gone further around the lake in the boat, we came ashore at gennesaret town.

target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, miu se, dhèu dhu padhai lii leo tao leo! miu d'èlu-mèu lab'a paredha ama lamatua, sèna ka madhutu ad'a tatao nèti bèi-baki miu di.

source_text: god gave these two commands: ‘honor your father and your mother, ' and ‘people who speak evil about their father or mother must be executed. '
target_text: te ama lamatua paredha, peka na, ‘pakab'ua ina-ama miu. ' aa peka hari, na, ‘ladhe ca dhèu padhèd'a aapa ina do ama na, hud'i huku pamadhe ne. '

source_text: then jesus again summoned the crowd to come nearer to him. then he said to them, listen to what i am about to tell you, and try to understand it.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus paroa dhèu leo ètu èèna, ka na aj'a si, peka na, pasa dhilu pabe'a-be'a, sèna ka miu bisa me'a mèu!

source_text: nothing that a person puts into his mouth to eat causes god to consider that person to be unacceptable. instead, it is the words that come out of people's mouths syn that cause god to reject them.
target_text: ngaa dhu maso asa d'ara hèb'a, pakaj'alu boe dhèu. te ngaa dhu mai nèti d'ara hèb'a, èèna ka dhu pakaj'alu dhèu.

source_text: later we disciples went to jesus and said, do you know that the pharisees heard what you said, and as a result they felt offended rhq?
target_text: èle ka, ana madhutu na mai karèi ne, aku rèngu na, ama me'a, do? dhèu parisi se d'ara pèd'a ropa tadèngi lii padhai ama.

source_text: then, to teach us what god would do to the pharisees, jesus told us this parable: my father in heaven will get rid of all those who teach things that are contrary to his truth, just like a farmer gets rid of plants that he did not plant, by pulling them up along with their roots met.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, peka na, ama ku ètu sorga, èèna na core eele dhèu dhu aj'a madhutu boe dad'èi na. èèna nuka sèmi dhèu ko'o eele j'u'u dhu na d'èi boe.

source_text: do not pay any attention to the pharisees. they do not help people who do not know god's truth to understand it, just like blind guides do not help blind people to perceive where they should go met. if a blind person tries to lead another blind person, they will both fall into a big hole met. similarly, both the pharisees and their disciples will end up in hell.
target_text: de baku pusi-pahae dènge dhèu parisi sèi! te rèngu ca ropa dènge dhèu bèdhu dhu pakako dhèu bèdhu. èèna na ra manahu palere-lere asa d'ara ro'a lasi.

source_text: peter said to jesus, explain to us the parable about what a person eats.

source_text: you should know that what comes out of people's mouths, meaning everything that they say syn, comes from their inner beings/hearts. many of the things that they say cause god to consider them to be unacceptable to him.
target_text: te, ngaa dhu mai nèti d'ara hèb'a, èèna ka dhu pakaj'alu dhèu, toke ama lamatua madenge dènge ne, aa d'èi boe pa'èci dènge ne.

source_text: it is people's innermost beings that cause them to think things that are evil, to murder people, to commit adultery, to commit other sexual sins, to steal things, to testify falsely, and to speak evil about others.
target_text: te j'ara-j'ara karehe, ae ka dhu mai nèti d'ara dhèu! nuka sèmi: ngangee dhu bhelu, pamadhe dhèu, bersina, tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu nèngu boe, mana'u, sakasii kapod'e-kabèli, dènge pakarehe kolongara dhèu.

source_text: after jesus took us and left galilee district, we went into the region where the cities of tyre and sidon are located.

source_text: a woman from the group of people called canaanites who live in that region came to the place where jesus was staying. she kept shouting to him, lord, you are the descendant of king david, you are the messiah! have pity on me and my daughter! she is suffering very much because a demon controls her.

source_text: but jesus said to her, i have been sent {god has sent me} to help only the israelite people at this time syn. they are like sheep that have gotten lost met because they do not know the way to heaven.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, ama lamatua pua ja'a mai, ho soru-bara dhèu èdhi dhèu yahudi, lula rèngu kako sala j'ara, nuka sèmi kahib'i-kalèbho dhu re'a heka j'ara. te na pua boe ja'a sèna ka soru-bara dhèu leo.

source_text: but she came closer to jesus and knelt down in front of him to worship him. she pled, lord/sir, help me!
target_text: te ngaa ina ne mai padètu-dètu asa yesus. ka na patitu kètu urutuu dènge lii manèngi, ama! sue ku ja'a la!

source_text: then, to suggest to her that he needed to help the jews first and not the non-jews, whom the jews called dogs, he told her, it is not good for someone to take food that has been prepared for the children and throw it to the little dogs.
target_text: te ngaa yesus core lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, pantas boe tare nganga'a nèti ana-ana, ka hia mi busa. dènge lii dhu pacele, sasoa na, yesus hud'i soru-bara uuru ku dhèu yahudi nèngu unu na, heka bisa ladhe-leru dhèu leo kèna.

source_text: but to show that she believed that non-jews could also receive help from god, the woman said to jesus, lord/sir, what you say is correct, but even the little dogs eat the crumbs that fall to the floor when their masters sit at their tables and eat!
target_text: te ngaa ina ne b'ala, aku nèngu na, tare'a ama! te ngaa busa dhu mate mema ètu ro'a mei. rèngu ra'a kahèi nganga'a dhu bèbhe eele nèti d'ara pega ana sèra. sasoa na, ropa ana-ana ra'a, busa kahèi abhu ra'a. masi ka yesus soru-bara dhèu unu na, te ngaa nèngu hud'i ladhe-leru dhèu yahudi boe kahèi.

source_text: crowds kept coming to him for the next two days and brought lame, crippled, and blind people, those who were unable to talk, and many others who had various sicknesses. they laid them in front of jesus so that he would heal them syn. and he healed them.

source_text: the crowd saw him heal people who could not talk, crippled people, lame people, and blind people, and they were amazed. they said, praise god who rules over us who live in israel!

source_text: you evil people have seen me perform miracles but you do not faithfully worship god met. you want to see me perform a miracle that would prove that god has sent me. but god will enable you to see only one miracle. it will be like what happened met to jonah, the prophet, who was inside a huge fish for three days and then came out of it to live again. then jesus left them and sailed away, along with us disciples.

source_text: we answered, some people say that you are john the baptizer, who has come back to life again. others say that you are the prophet elijah, who has returned from heaven as god promised. still others say that you are the prophet jeremiah or one of the other prophets who lived long ago, who has come back to life again.

source_text: simon peter said to him, you are the messiah! you are the son of the all-powerful god.

source_text: if a fellow believer sins against you, go to him, and when you two are alone, reprove him for sinning against you. if that person listens to you and feels sorry that he has sinned against you, you will have restored your friendship with that person.
