source_text: jesus knew what we were saying. so he said to us, ◄you should not be bothering this woman! /why are you bothering this woman? ► rhq she has done a beautiful thing to me.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a ngangee rèngu, hèia na lii peka na, miu se baku pasusa bhèni ne! hud'i laa! ja'a karej'e, lula na pahae le èi hèu mèngi ne mi ngi'u ja'a.

source_text: keep in mind that you will always have poor people among you, so you can help them whenever you want to. but i will not always be with you, so it is good for her to show now that she appreciates me!
target_text: te dhèu dhu unu boe ngaa-ngaa pa'èci taruu dènge miu. te ngaa ja'a ne mamuri nèbhu heka dènge miu.

source_text: when she poured this perfume on my body, it was as if she knew that i am going to die soon. and it is as if she has anointed my body for being buried.
target_text: aa bhèni dhu pahae èi hèu mèngi mi ngi'u ja'a ne, sèmi ngaa te, nèngu pahèu mèngi mema le ngi'u aae ja'a. te mamuri ja'a nèbhu heka.

source_text: i will tell you this: wherever this good message about me is preached {people preach this good message about me} throughout the world, those who preach it will tell what this woman has done, and as a result people will always remember her.
target_text: ngee paie-iie! sad'i ètu mia èèna ka, ladhe dhèu palolo lii lolo be'a ama lamatua palème rai-haha ne, tatu rèngu papeka kahèi babe'a bhèni ne, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i sanèd'e ne.

source_text: then judas iscariot or, judas, the man from kerioth town, even though he was one of us twelve disciples, went to the chief priests.
target_text: ca dhèu nèti canguru dua ana madhutu yesus se, dhu ngara na yudas iskariot. lod'o èèna kahèi, kalua la'e tenge kètu agama yahudi sèra, sèna ka neo pahie yesus mi rèngu.

source_text: he asked them, if i enable you to seize jesus, how much money are you willing to give me? they agreed to give him 30 silver coins. so they counted out the coins and gave them to him.
target_text: ropa yudas d'ai dhèu se'e, hèia na karèi, peka na, ama-ama! ladhe ja'a bhoke j'ara ho miu bisa kèpe yesus, miu hia ja'a ngaa? hèia dhèu se dhaa, peka na, ladhe èu neo pahie ne dènge ji'i, na ji'i b'ae. ka ra ige rare tèlu nguru doi iia, aa ra j'ole asa yudas.

source_text: from that time judas watched for an opportunity to enable them to seize jesus.
target_text: èle, ka yudas li'u ka la'e, hèia na tenge j'ara ho saraka yesus asa d'ara adhe-aai rèngu.

source_text: on the first day of the week-long festival ◄when we jews ate bread which had no yeast in it/of unleavened bread►, we disciples went to jesus and asked, where do you want us to prepare the meal for the passover celebration so that we can eat it with you?
target_text: d'ara tèu mai-tèu mai, abhu lod'o babe'a dhèu yahudi dhu nanèbhu na pidhu lod'o. ra pangare lod'o babe'a se, na, ‘pesta roti dhu pake boe ragi'. ropa pesta èèna neo mulai, ana madhutu yesus se mai karèi ne, aku rèngu na, ama! mèda ne'e, èdhi bhoke lod'o babe'a èdhi. de ama neo sèna ka ji'i la'a roro kahib'i-kalèbho, aa lalau era pesta paska ètu mia?

source_text: in reply, he gave instructions to two disciples about where they should go. he said to them, go into the city to a man with whom i have previously arranged this. tell him that the teacher says, ‘the time mty that i told you about is near. i am going to celebrate the passover meal with my disciples at your house, and i have sent these two to prepare the meal. '
target_text: ka yesus b'ala si, peka na, lami asa d'ara kota, pe mi paraga dènge ama ca dhèu. miu peka dènge ne sèmi ne'e, ‘ama! ama mese rasa lod'o mamadhe na nèbhu heka. hèia na manèngi era èci ètu d'ara èmu ama, sèna ka na tao kalela paska dènge ana-ana madhutu na. '

source_text: so the two disciples did as jesus told them. they went and prepared the passover meal in that man's house.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi rare, hèia ana-ana madhutu na, tao sèmi dhu na peka. ka ra lalau nganga'a kalela paska ètu era èèna.

source_text: when it was evening, jesus was eating the meal with us twelve disciples.
target_text: ropa d'ai mèda, hèia yesus dènge ana-ana madhutu na, dhèu canguru dua sèra, madhèdi ra'a-rinu.

source_text: while we were eating, he said to us, listen carefully to this: one of you is going to enable my enemies to seize me.
target_text: ropa dhu ra'a era, hèia na lii, peka na, mi nanene! ca dhèu nèti miu se, èèna na pahie ja'a asa adhe-aai dhèu leo kara.

source_text: we were very sad. we began to say to him, one after the other, lord, ◄it is surely not i! /i'm not the one, am i? ► rhq
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi sèmi èèna, d'ara rèngu roe-bhilu. ka rèngu èci-èci karèi yesus, peka na, dhèu dhu ama peka deo na, ja'a aad'o, sina ma?

source_text: he replied, the one who will enable my enemies to seize me is one of you who is dipping bread mty into the sauce in the dish along with me.
target_text: hèia na peka, na, dhèu dhu cèb'u roti na palere-lere dènge ja'a asa d'ara mago ne, nèngu ka dhu pahie ja'a.

source_text: it is certain that i, the one who came from heaven, will die, because that is what has been written {the prophets have written} about me. but there will be terrible punishment for the man who enables my enemies to seize me! it would be better for that man if he had never been born!
target_text: sanèd'e, ee! ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, hud'i madhe ku, nuka sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua. te ngaa mate unu na! dhèu dhu neo pahie ja'a, bèli-camèd'a pasae nare pala na! hua iia risi, ina na baku nara iisi ne!

source_text: then judas, the one who was going to betray him, said, teacher, ◄surely it is not i! /i'm not the one, am i? ► rhq jesus replied, yes, you are the one.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yudas karèi kahèi, peka na, tatu dhèu dhu ama peka deo na, ja'a aad'o, sina ma? hèia yesus b'ala ne, mema tare'a èu unu mu ka dhu peka lii èèna. de cee hari?

source_text: while we were eating, jesus took a small loaf of bread and thanked god for it. he broke it into pieces and gave it to us disciples, and said, take this bread and eat it. it represents my body.
target_text: rèngu dhu ra'a era, hèia yesus ded'e nare roti cue, aa na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. ka na pamae roti ne, hèia j'ole asa ana-ana madhutu na, aa na peka, roti ne'e ne, ngi'u ja'a. mere ho mi'e ka!

source_text: later he took a cup of wine and thanked god for it. then he gave it to us, saying, drink some of the wine in this cup, all of you.
target_text: èle ka, yesus nare galaa dhu pènu dènge èi anggor, ka na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. hèia na j'ole asa ana-ana madhutu na, aa na lii, peka na, miu aa'i-aa'i mi, mere ho minu.

source_text: the wine in this cup represents my blood, which will soon flow from my body. with my blood i will sign the new agreement that god is making to forgive the sins of many people.
target_text: te èi anggor ne'e ne, raa ja'a kèna. èèna na ja'a madhe, te ngaa raa ja'a suti, sèna ka sui kore dhèu ae nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra. raa ne'e j'aj'i mi tadha ho pasanèd'e dhèu, peka na, ngaa dhu ama lamatua pajaji èèna, mema limuri ne j'aj'i le. de mere ho minu ka!

source_text: note this carefully: i will not drink wine in this way any more until the time when i drink it with you with a new meaning. that will happen when my father enables me to begin to rule as king.
target_text: te ngaa nanene paie-iie! mulai nèti mèda ne, ja'a kinu heka èi anggor. pe ja'a dènge ama ku madhèdi ngèd'u paredha sama-sama ètu sorga, heka ja'a kinu hari kèna dènge miu.

source_text: after we sang a hymn, we started out towards olive tree hill.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia rèngu sod'a lii sod'a èci, ho koa-kio ama lamatua. ka mèda èèna kahèi, rèngu lasi dènge ka asa ledhe saitun.

source_text: on the way, jesus told us, this night all of you will desert me because of what will happen to me! this is certain to happen because these words that god said are written in the scriptures: ‘i will cause the shepherd to be killed, and all the sheep will be scattered {scatter}. '
target_text: ropa ètu d'ara kakako rèngu, yesus peka dènge ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, ciki hari ètu d'ara mèda ne'e kahèi, miu aa'i-aa'i mi rai tèke eele ja'a mesa-mesa ku. te dhu suri tèke le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, peka na, ‘èèna na, ama lamatua pamadhe ana madhenga badha, ka kahib'i-kalèbho na rai paj'ala. '

source_text: but after i have died and become alive again, i will go ahead of you to galilee district and meet you there.
target_text: ja'a madhe tare'a, te ngaa ladhe ja'a mamuri hari, laku mate miu ètu propensi galilea.

source_text: peter replied, perhaps all the other disciples will desert you when they see what happens to you, but i certainly will never leave you!
target_text: te ngaa petrus d'èi boe nanene lii na, ka na peka, ama! masi ka dhèu leo rai tèke eele ama, te ngaa ja'a rai boe!

source_text: jesus replied to him, the truth is that this very night, before the rooster crows, you will say three times that you do not know me!
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala aku nèngu na, petrus! sèmi èèna, do? lèka la lii ja'a ne! ètu d'ara mèda ne'e ne kahèi, manu dhae kokotoo mèka, te èu dhu pasili le tèlu hari, peka na, èu tadhe boe ja'a!

source_text: peter said to him, even if they kill me while i am defending you, i will never say that i do not know you! all the rest of us disciples also said the same thing.
target_text: te ngaa petrus no'o boe sèmi. ka na peka, aad'o, ama! ladhe ama madhe, ja'a madhe kahèi. te ja'a rai boe, tèke eele ama! angalai petrus se, peka sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: then jesus went with us to a place that is called {that people call} gethsemane. there he said to most of us, stay here while i go over there and pray.
target_text: ka yesus si kako taruu asa ledhe saitun, d'ai d'ara oka cue, ngara na getsemani. ètu era ne'e yesus peka dènge ana madhutu na, miu madhèdi uuru ku mi ne'e, te ja'a neo laku manèngi-mangaj'i asa nèi.

source_text: he took peter, james, and john with him. he became extremely distressed.
target_text: te ngaa na paroa nare petrus, yakobis dènge yohanis, ho lasi palere-lere dènge ne. mulai nèti èèna ka, d'ara na ma'ète laho mae-mae, aa roe-bhilu.

source_text: then he said to them, i syn am very sorrowful, so much so that i feel as if i were about to die! remain here and stay awake with me!
target_text: rèngu kako kaj'èu mèka, te na peka dènge rèngu, aku nèngu na, d'ara ja'a susa titu kèna! ja'a nuka sèmi oe madhe sa. miu madhèdi, mate ja'a mi ne'e.

source_text: after going a little further, he threw himself face down on the ground. he prayed, my father, if it is possible mty, do not make me have to endure the suffering that is coming now. but do not do as i want. instead, do as you want!
target_text: ka la'e ako kaj'èu ciki, hèia na patitu kètu urutuu ho sabaj'a, aku nèngu na, ama pasue! ladhe ama d'èi na, ja'a baku pasae j'aj'èra ne'e. te ngaa baku madhutu dad'èi ja'a, hud'i laa madhutu dad'èi ama di.

source_text: then he returned to the three disciples and saw that they were sleeping. he woke peter and said to him, ◄i am disappointed that you men fell asleep and were not able to stay awake with me for just a short time! /why were you men not able to stay awake with me for just one hour? ► rhq
target_text: sabaj'a nare, hèia lèpa la'e asa era ana madhutu na dhèu tèlu sèra. te ngaa rèngu dhu bhèj'i luu. ka yesus parèi si, hèia na lii dènge petrus, peka na, hee, petrus! nga tao ka miu se bhèj'i? ja'a ètu nèi nèbhu boe, te ngaa miu lake mere boe beke ciki sa mate ja'a!

source_text: you must keep alert and pray so that you can resist when you are tempted {something tempts you}. you want to do what i tell you, but you syn are not strong enough to actually do it.
target_text: ruri pamako musi madha miu. kèd'i ho beke dènge ja'a. te d'ara miu mema d'èi tao dhu be'a, te ngaa ngi'u miu èra boe. de hua iia miu sabaj'a, sèna ka ladhe lèke dadugu-rariu miu bisa taha.

source_text: he went away a second time. he prayed, my father, if it is necessary for me to suffer lit, may what you want happen!
target_text: ka yesus la'e hari sabaj'a, peka na, ama! ladhe ja'a hud'i pasae ku j'aj'èra ne'e, hud'i laa madhutu dad'èi ama di.

source_text: when he returned to the three disciples, he saw that they were asleep again. they could not keep their eyes open idm.
target_text: sabaj'a nare, hèia na mai hari asa era ana madhutu na dhèu tèlu se. te ngaa dhu ra bhèj'i hari, lula musi madha ra sakaa titu kèna.

source_text: so he left them and went away again. he prayed the third time, saying the same thing that he had prayed before.
target_text: ka na tèke eele si, la'e hari manèngi-mangaj'i catèka. na manèngi-mangaj'i hari mi ama, sèna ka baku soro tèke nèngu pasae j'aj'èra èèna, te ngaa hud'i laa madhutu dhoka dad'èi ama di.

source_text: then he returned to us disciples. he woke us up and said to us, ◄i am disappointed that you are still sleeping and resting! /why are you still sleeping and resting? ► rhq look someone is about to enable sinful men to seize me, the one who came from heaven!
target_text: sabaj'a nare ka, na lèpa hari, la'e parèi ana madhutu na, peka na, miu se bhèj'i taruu, do? kèd'i ka! te dhèu dhu neo pahie ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, dètu le. dhèu se mai ho kèpe ja'a kèna, ho saraka asa adhe-aai dhèu bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: get up! let's go to meet them here comes the one who is enabling them to seize me!
target_text: wee, kèd'i ka! bhoke musi madha miu, ladhe ku asa nèi. te dhèu dhu pahie ja'a, nuka mai nèi.

source_text: while jesus was still speaking, judas arrived. even though he was one of us twelve disciples, he came to enable jesus' enemies to seize him. a large crowd carrying swords and clubs was with him. they had been sent by the chief priests and elders {the chief priests and jewish elders had sent them}.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii era, yudas dhu nare le era èèna dènge dhèu ae-ae. dhèu se mai rèti hela dènge aj'u cèki ho neo kèpe ne. rèngu tao sèmi ne'e, lula madhutu paredha nèti kètu agama yahudi, dènge dhèu heka ad'a sèra.

source_text: judas had previously arranged to give them a signal, saying, the man whom i will kiss is the one you want. seize him!
target_text: yudas dhu peka mema le mi dhèu se'e, na, miu ladhe paie-iie! dhèu dhu ja'a uu, nèngu ka dhu miu kèpe! te nèngu ka dhu miu tenge!

source_text: he immediately went to jesus and said, greetings, teacher! then he kissed jesus on the neck/cheek.
target_text: ropa rèngu d'ai madha yesus, hèia yudas lii dènge ka, saloom, ama mese! hèia yudas uu yesus.

source_text: jesus replied, friend, is it to kiss me that you are here? or, do what you have come for! then the men who came with judas stepped forward and seized jesus.
target_text: èle ka, yesus peka dènge ne, hee, yudas! tao ka laa, madhutu dad'èi èu. ka dhèu ae sèra ara lasi neo kèpe ne.

source_text: suddenly, one of the men who was with jesus pulled his sword out of its sheath. he struck the servant of the high priest to kill him, but only cut off his ear.
target_text: te ngaa dhu re'a boe, na, dhèu unu yesus ca dhèu dhu bete hela na, ka seru pama'ète rèu dhilu dhèu èci. dhèu dhu nu'a ne, nuka ca dhèu ènu nèti kètu kapai risi agama yahudi.

source_text: jesus said to him, put your sword back in its sheath! all those who try to kill others with a sword will themselves be killed with a sword!
target_text: ropa ladhe nèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia yesus lii dènge ne, aku nèngu na, pasaluu hela èu èèna asa d'ara sope na. te dhèu dhu pake rèka ho neo uri pamere lii langu, èèna na nèngu madhe dènge rèka kahèi.

source_text: do you think that rhq if i asked my father, he would not immediately send more than ◄twelve armies of/72, 000► angels to help me?
target_text: èu me'a boe, do? ja'a bisa manèngi ama ku, ho na hia ana pajuu na d'ai nguru riho mai nèti sorga, sèna ka soru-bara ja'a.

source_text: but if i did that, what the prophets have written in the scriptures about what will happen to the messiah would not be fulfilled {happen} rhq.
target_text: te ngaa hud'i laa, ra kèpe ja'a. te aa'i-aa'i dhu suri tèke le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua lula-nèti ja'a ne, hud'i j'aj'i ku.

source_text: at that time jesus said to the crowd that was seizing him, ◄it is ridiculous that you have come here to seize me with swords and clubs, as if i were a bandit! /have you come here to seize me with swords and clubs, as if i were a bandit? ► rhq day after day i sat in the temple courtyard, teaching the people. why did you not arrest me then?
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus peka dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu mai kèpe ne, aku nèngu na, madhutu miu, ja'a ne dhèu bhelu, do? nga tao ka miu mai kèpe ja'a ne, mèti dènge hela dènge aj'u cèki? bèli-bèli ja'a aj'a miu ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua, te ngaa dhèu èci sa tao boe ngaa-ngaa mi ja'a.

source_text: but all this is happening to fulfill what the prophets have written in the scriptures about me. then all of us disciples deserted jesus and ran away.
target_text: te ngaa hud'i laa! mai ka, kèpe ja'a! te j'ara ne'e ne, dhu suri tèke le karèi nèti uru ka, ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua. ropa ana madhutu yesus rèdhi sèmi èèna, ra madha'u titu kèna. hèia ra rai tèke eele ne mesa-mesa.

source_text: the men who had seized jesus took him to the house where caiaphas, the high priest, lived. the men who taught the jewish laws and the jewish elders had already gathered there.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia dhèu dhu kèpe yesus, rèti ne asa èmu kètu kapai risi agama yahudi dhu ngara na, kayafas, lula dhèu kapai sèra dhu pakaboko le ètu era èèna. dhèu se nuka, kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, aa dhèu heka ad'a sèra.

source_text: peter followed jesus at a distance. he came to the high priest's courtyard. he entered the courtyard and sat down with the guards to see what would happen.
target_text: ropa ra rèti yesus, petrus madhutu nèti limuri, toke d'ai èmu kètu kapai risi agama yahudi èèna. petrus la'e kahèi asa madha èmu, ho madhèdi dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu ètu sèra. te neo ne'a, ngaa ka dhu j'aj'i.

source_text: the chief priests and the rest of the jewish council were trying to find people who would tell lies about jesus so that they could convince the roman authorities to execute him.
target_text: ètu d'ara èmu ne, kètu agama yahudi sèra dhu padhue-padhai dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu madhèdi uri lii langu agama. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra tenge j'ara, sèna ka pamanahu yesus, lula ra neo huku pamadhe ne.

source_text: but even though many people spoke lies about him, they did not find anyone who said anything that was useful. finally two men came forward
target_text: masi ka rèngu hia sakasii monya ae kahèi, te ngaa rèngu abhu boe sasala èci sa dhu rèngu bisa pake. nèbhu boe ka, rèngu abhu sakasii dhèu dua.

source_text: and said, this man said, ‘i am able to destroy god's temple and to rebuild it within three days. '
target_text: dhèu dua se, peka na, ji'i tadèngi le kahèi, dhèu ne peka na, ‘bèli-camèd'a ja'a paguri eele èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. te ngaa ètu d'ara tèlu lod'o, ja'a patitu kore hari. '

source_text: then the high priest stood up and said to jesus, are you not going to reply? what do you say about these things that they are saying to accuse you?
target_text: ka kètu kapai risi agama yahudi, kèd'i titu ètu madha dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhèdi ètu era èèna. hèia na karèi yesus, peka na, èu tadèngi le lii galaa dhèu se'e dhu ra galaa èu. nga tao ka èu b'ala boe ca hèb'a sa?

source_text: but jesus remained silent. then the high priest said to him, i command you to tell us the truth, knowing that the all-powerful god is listening to you: are you the messiah, ◄the son of god/the man who is also god►?
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa boe ngaa-ngaa. hèia kètu kapai ne karèi hari, na, ja'a neo karèi! te ngaa èu hud'i dhaa tare'a-re'a ku, nuka sèmi èu dhaa mi ama lamatua dhu mamuri ètu sorga. abhu dhèu dhu peka na, èu ne, kristus, ana ama lamatua dhu na moa tèke karèi nèti uru ka. tare'a sèmi èèna, do?

source_text: jesus replied, yes, it is as you say. but i will also say this to all of you: some day you will see me, the one who came from heaven, sitting beside mty almighty god, and ruling. you will also see me coming on the clouds from heaven!
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala, peka na, tare'a, nuka sèmi lii ama èèna. te ngaa sanèd'e! te bèli-camèd'a miu mèdhi ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. pe ja'a madhèdi ètu baboa g'ana ama lamatua ètu sorga, sèna ka kèd'u paredha sama-sama dènge ne, dhu koasa na kapai risi eele èèna. èle na, ja'a puru mai hari ètu dedha ra'i-liru.

source_text: then the high priest tore his outer garment. that was the custom to show that he was shocked to hear jesus say that he was equal to god. then he said, this man has insulted god! he claims to be equal with god! ◄we certainly do not need anyone else to testify against this man! /why should we seek any more people who will testify against this man? ► rhq you heard what he said!
target_text: ropa na tadèngi nare yesus peka sèmi èèna, hèia kètu kapai ne nasa bia, toke na ciu pamae kodho madhera na. hèia na pa'oo mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhèdi ètu sèra, aku nèngu na, èdhi parluu sakasii tao ngaa hari era! miu unu mi tadèngi le dènge ro'a dhilu miu, lii padhai na. nèngu tao iisi na j'aj'i ana ama lamatua. ne'e ne pahaha ama lamatua! miu aa'i-aa'i mi me'a le, na, madhutu atora agama èdhi, ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tao iisi na nuka sèmi ama lamatua, na, dhèu ne hud'i madhe ku!

source_text: what have you decided? the jewish leaders replied, according to our laws, he is guilty and deserves to be executed!
target_text: de miu neo pama'ète sèmi mia hari? hèia aa'i-aa'i ra parodha, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne mema sala tare'a! de hud'i huku pamadhe ne!

source_text: then some of them spat in his face. others struck him with their fists. others, after they blindfolded him, slapped him
target_text: ka dhèu pèri-pèri lasi sabhuu ilu mi yesus. hèia ra hake-paru, aa tèb'e pa'oke ne.

source_text: and said, since you claim that iro you are the messiah, tell us who hit you!
target_text: èle ka, ra lalangu ne, peka na, wee! èu ne'e ka kristus, si? èu peka sèku! dhèu cee ka dhu j'ubhu èu?

source_text: peter was sitting outside in the courtyard. a servant girl came up to him and looked at him. she said, you also were with jesus, that man from galilee district!
target_text: lod'o èèna, petrus madhèdi era ètu madha èmu. ka ènu bhèni ca dhèu mai lii dènge ne, peka na, deo na, èu kahèi palere-lere dènge yesus, dhèu nasaret èèna, si?

source_text: but while everyone there was listening, he denied it. he said, i do not know what you are talking about!
target_text: te ngaa na pasili ètu madha dhèu ae sèra, peka na, aad'o! nga tao ka èu karèi sèmi èèna! ja'a tadhe boe ne.

source_text: then he went out to the gateway of the courtyard. another servant girl saw him and said to the people who were standing nearby, this man was with jesus, the man from nazareth.
target_text: ka petrus kalua la'e titu ètu hèb'a oka. hèia bhèni leo hari èci ladhe nèdhi ne ètu èèna. ka bhèni ne peka dènge dhèu ètu sèra, aku nèngu na, deo na ja'a kèdhi dhèu ne'e ne palere-lere dènge yesus, dhèu nasaret èèna.

source_text: but peter again denied it. he said, may god punish me if i am lying! i tell you, i do not even know that man!
target_text: hèia petrus jèke ne, peka na, èu ne tao-tao huj'u! ja'a bani subha! ja'a tadhe boe dhèu nèi!

source_text: after a little while, one of the people who were standing there approached peter and said to him, it is certain that you are one of those who were with that man. we can tell from your accent that you are from galilee.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka dhèu leo ètu sèra sa peka dènge ne, hee! èu ne baku kapod'e-kabèli d'ara lii, dhu peka na, èu kako palere boe dènge dhèu ne! te nèti lii padhai èu, èci èèna ka dènge laloe lii dhèu galilea!

source_text: then peter began to proclaim loudly that god should curse him if he was lying. he asked god in heaven to witness that he was telling the truth and said, i do not know that man! immediately a rooster crowed.
target_text: te ngaa na padhèd'a, ka b'ala, aku nèngu na, wee! ja'a subha dènge kolongara ama lamatua! ja'a tadhe boe dhèu ne'e ne! ropa na peka nare sèmi èèna, hèia manu kokotoo dènge.

source_text: then peter remembered the words that jesus had spoken to him, before the rooster crows, you will say three times that you do not know me. and peter went out of the courtyard, crying because he was very sad about what he had done.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi lii kokotoo manu, hèia petrus ngee nèdhi lii yesus, dhu peka na, manu dhae kokotoo mèka, te èu dhu pasili le tèlu hari, peka na, èu tadhe boe ja'a. sanèd'e nare lii ne'e, hèia la'e asa li'u ka tangi d'ara pèd'a.

source_text: very early the next morning all the chief priests and jewish elders decided how to arrange for the romans to execute jesus.
target_text: mad'ae aae era, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu uri lii langu agama sèra, rare lii èci sèna ka neo pamadhe yesus.

source_text: they tied his hands and took him to pilate, the roman governor.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ra èki ne rèti asa madha gubernur pilatus. te rèngu d'èi sèna ka gubernur huku pamadhe ne.

source_text: when judas, the one who had ◄betrayed/enabled jesus' enemies to seize► him, realized that they had decided to have jesus executed, he was very sorry about what he had done. he took the 30 coins back to the chief priests and elders.
target_text: ropa yudas tadèngi na, yesus abhu hahuku madhe, hèia na manyasa, lula nèngu ka dhu pahie yesus. ka la'e hari asa kètu agama yahudi dènge dhèu heka ad'a sèra, ho neo hia hari la'a doi iia tèlu nguru bua sèra.

source_text: he said, i have sinned. i have ◄betrayed/enabled you to seize► a man who ◄is innocent/has not done anything wrong►. they replied, ◄that means nothing to us! /what does that mean to us? ► rhq that is your problem!
target_text: na peka na, ja'a tao le sasala-sasigo, lula ja'a pahie le dhèu dhu dènge boe sasala. te ngaa dhèu se b'ala, aku rèngu na, wee! ji'i se pusi-pahae heka èu ne! èu mesa mu ka dhu d'ui more sasala èèna.

source_text: so judas took the money and threw it inside the temple. then he went away and hanged himself.
target_text: ka yudas ceb'e eele doi sèra asa d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. hèia la'e kadhoe iisi na, toke na madhe aapa.

source_text: later the high priests found the coins. they picked them up and said, this is money that we paid to have a man killed mty, and our law does not allow such money to be put {us to put such money} into the temple treasury.
target_text: hèia kètu agama yahudi sèra kaboko rare doi dhu na ceb'e eele sèra. ra padhue, aku rèngu na, doi se'e mage èdhi tao asa d'ara boaraka doi, lula doi se doi kaj'alu.

source_text: so they decided to use that money to buy the field where clay was dug for making pots {men dug ground for making pots}. they made that field a place where they buried strangers who died in jerusalem.
target_text: de be'a risi èdhi hèli tare rai ca kasib'i nèti dhèu tao èru rai sèi. ladhe dhèu mai nèti rai leo, do, dhèu dhu èdhi tadhe boe madhe, èdhi padhane si ètu era ne'e ne.

source_text: that is why that place is still called {why they still call that place} ‘the field of blood'.
target_text: ka ra hèli rai ne, kab'ua na nèti doi deo sa. nèti èèna ka, rai ne, toke d'ai sange ne'e, dhèu pangare na, ‘rai raa'.

source_text: by buying that field, they fulfilled these words that the prophet jeremiah wrote long ago: they took the 30 silver coins; that was what the leaders of israel decided that he was worth;
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, rèngu madhutu lii nèti ca dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na yermia, dhu suri tèke na, rèngu pake doi iia tèlu nguru bua ho hèli rai. rèngu pake doi se, lula doi se kab'ua nèti hèli dhèu, madhutu sèmi dhu dhèu isra'el pama'ète rare le.

source_text: and with that money they bought the field where clay was dug for potters. they did that as the lord had commanded me.
target_text: rai ne, rèngu hèli nèti dhèu tao èru rai, madhutu lii paredha dhu ama lamatua hia mi ja'a.

source_text: jesus stood in front of pilate, the governor. the governor asked jesus, do you claim to be the king of the jews? jesus replied, it is as you have just said.
target_text: ropa dhèu se rèti yesus d'ai gubernur, hèia na karèi yesus, tasamia? èu ne, tare'a-re'a dhèu aae dhèu yahudi, do? na dhaa, peka na, tare'a. ama peka lèke kèna.

source_text: when he was accused by the chief priests and elders {when the chief priests and elders accused him} about various things, he did not answer.
target_text: te ngaa ropa kètu agama yahudi dènge dhèu heka ad'a sèra galaa ne dènge lii langu ae-ae, na dhaa boe ca hèb'a sa hèi.

source_text: so pilate said to him, you hear how many things they are saying to accuse you; are you not going to reply?
target_text: ka gubernur karèi hari ne, peka na, èu tadèngi boe lii padhai lii rèngu, do? dhèu se hia sasala ae-ae mi dedha èu. te ngaa tasamia ka èu b'ala boe si hèi? !

source_text: but even though he was not guilty, jesus did not say anything. he did not reply to any of the things about which they were accusing him. as a result, the governor was very surprised.
target_text: te ngaa na dhaa boe ca hèb'a sa hèi, toke gubernur malaa.

source_text: it was the governor's custom each year during the passover celebration to release one person who was in prison. he released whichever prisoner the people wanted.
target_text: tèu mai-tèu mai, dhu tema le, ladhe d'ai ka lod'o kalela paska, dhèu yahudi hag'e rare ana bèdho ca dhèu, sèna ka gubernur patabuli ne.

source_text: at that time there was in jerusalem a well-known prisoner whose name was barabbas.
target_text: tèu èèna, dhèu bèdho ca dhèu, ngara na barabas. dhèu aa'i-aa'i tadhe le nèngu ne, lula nèngu ca dhèu bhelu-katub'a titu kèna.

source_text: so when the crowd gathered, pilate asked them, which prisoner would you like me to release for you: barabbas, or jesus, whom some of you claim to be the messiah?
target_text: lod'o èèna kahèi, dhèu ae lasi asa gubernur pilatus ho manèngi, sèna ka patabuli dhèu bèdho èci, sèmi biasa. hèia pilatus karèi si, aku nèngu na, be'a. de ja'a patabuli cee? ètu ne'e barabas, aa abhu kahèi yesus, dhu dhèu paroa ne, kristus. mia ka dhu ja'a patabuli? miu ka dhu pama'ète.

source_text: he asked that question because he realized that the chief priests wanted to have jesus executed. they had brought jesus to him only because they were jealous of jesus. and pilate thought that the crowd would prefer that he release jesus.
target_text: gubernur peka sèmi èèna, te ne'a na kètu agama yahudi rèti yesus asa nèngu, lula rèngu se tèka d'ara dènge yesus.

source_text: while pilate was sitting on the platform where he made judicial decisions, his wife sent him this message: early this morning i had a bad dream because of that man. so do not condemn that righteous man!
target_text: gubernur ètu d'ara uri lii langu ne era, dhèu èmu na moa lii, peka na, ama! mage-mage, oo! te yesus ne dhu dènge boe sasala. lula nèngu ne'e ka, mèda deo na, ja'a nii aapa. toke d'ai sange ne'e, d'ara ja'a dhae tèka mèka.

source_text: but the chief priests and elders persuaded the crowd to ask pilate to release barabbas, and to order that jesus be executed {that his soldiers execute jesus}.
target_text: te ngaa kètu agama yahudi dènge dhèu heka ad'a sèra, dadugu dhèu ae ètu èèna, ho ra manèngi gubernur patabuli barabas, aa huku pamadhe yesus.

source_text: so when the governor asked them, which of the two men do you want me to release for you? they replied, barabbas!
target_text: ka na karèi hari si, aku nèngu na, nèti dhèu dua se, mia ka dhu ja'a patabuli? hèia aa'i-aa'i ra dhaa, peka na, barabas! patabuli barabas di!

source_text: pilate, very astonished, asked, so what shall i do with jesus who some of you say is the messiah? they all answered, command that he be crucified! {command your soldiers ◄to crucify him/to nail him to a cross►}!
target_text: èle ka na karèi si, aku nèngu na, ladhe sèmi èèna, ja'a tao tasa mera mia mi yesus, dhu ra peka na kristus ne? hèia aa'i-aa'i ra pa'oo-parodha peka na, paku pamadhe ne asa aj'u palolo-palèbha!

source_text: pilate replied, why? what crime has he committed? but they shouted even louder, have him crucified {command that your soldiers crucify him}!
target_text: èle èèna ka, gubernur karèi hari, peka na, te sala na, ngaa? ja'a parisa le, te ngaa abhu boe sasala na èci sa! te ngaa ra asa pa'oo-parodha, aku rèngu na, pamadhe ne! paku ne asa aj'u palolo-palèbha!

source_text: pilate realized that he was accomplishing nothing. he saw that instead, the people were starting to riot. so he took a basin of water and washed his hands as the crowd was watching. he said, by washing my hands i am showing you that if this man dies mty, it is your fault, not mine!
target_text: nèbhu boe, na ne'a heka tao tasamia hari, lula dhèu se'e asa ka ra hino neo patao. nèti èèna ka, nare èi ho j'amo ai ètu madha dhèu ae-ae sèra, aa na peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, ja'a tago boe mamadhe dhèu ne'e ne! miu aa'i-aa'i mi ka dhu hud'i pasae mere mamadhe na!

source_text: and all the people answered, the guilt for causing him to die mty will be on us, and it will be on our children, too!
target_text: hèia dhèu se'e dhaa dènge lii pa'oo-parodha peka na, oo, hud'i laa! hud'i laa ji'i dènge ana-èpu ji'i tago ngare raa na!

source_text: then he ordered the soldiers to release barabbas for them. but he ordered that his soldiers flog jesus. and then he turned jesus over to the soldiers for them ◄to nail jesus to a cross/to crucify him►.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, hèia na peka, la'a, sina ma. hèia na patabuli barabas madhutu dad'èi ra. èle èèna ka, na pua dhèu j'aga, lasi kalabhe yesus pake gui. game rare, ka sordad'u rèti yesus, sèna ka neo paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: then the governor's soldiers took jesus into the government headquarters. the whole ◄cohort/group of soldiers► gathered around him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, sordad'u ère rèti yesus asa tana lapa ètu d'ara benteng rèngu. d'ai nèi, rèngu paroa rare angalai ra ca batalion.

source_text: they pulled off his clothes, and pretending he was a king, they put a purple robe on him.
target_text: hèia ra papake ne kodho madhera èci dhu mea aae.

source_text: they took some branches with thorns and wove them to make a crown and put it on his head. they put in his right hand a reed like a staff that a king would hold. then they knelt in front of him and made fun of him, saying, hooray for the king of the jews iro!
target_text: ka rare loro aj'u padhudhu ra ènyu tao sèmi solo. hèia ra ènyi solo ne mi kètu yesus, ho ra sasei ne, tao nuka sèmi rèngu ded'e dhèu aae hiu, dhu pake solo dhèu aae. èle èèna ka, ra j'ole hia ne aj'u ca'èta asa ai g'ana na, nuka sèmi tatea paredha. hèia ra patitu kètu urutuu ra, patangara dènge yesus, aa ra pamakae ne, peka na, pakab'ua dhèu aae dhèu yahudi.

source_text: they kept spitting on him. they took the staff and kept striking him on the head with it.
target_text: hèia ra sabhuu ne ilu, aa rare aj'u ca'èta dhu na kèpe deo na, ka ra d'eu kètu na.

source_text: when they had finished ridiculing him, they pulled off the robe and put his own clothes on him. then they led him away to the place where they would nail him to a cross.
target_text: ropa ra sasei rare ne, hèia ra bhoke eele kodho madhera. èle èèna ka, ra papake hari mèdha-papake na. ka rèti ne asa li'u kota yerusalem, ho neo paku ne mi aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: after jesus carried his cross a short distance, the soldiers saw a man named simon, who was from cyrene city. they forced him to carry the cross for jesus.
target_text: ropa ra ère rèti yesus, d'ai talora j'ara paraga dènge dhèu kota kirene èci dhu neo la'e asa d'ara kota. ngara na, simon. dhèu se laka-seti ne, sèna ka pasae aj'u palolo-palèbha gati yesus.

source_text: they came to a place called golgotha. that name means ‘the place like a skull'.
target_text: ka ra d'ai era èci, ngara na golgota. ètu d'ara lii aram, sasoa na, era rui kètu.

source_text: when they got there, they mixed with wine something that tasted very bitter. they gave it to jesus to drink so that he would not feel so much pain when they nailed him on the cross. but when he tasted it, he refused to drink it. some soldiers took his clothes.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, dhèu se'e hia yesus ninu èi anggor dhu pab'ali rare le dènge èi na'i dhu pèd'u, sèna ka bisa taha rarii. ka yesus camuci, hèia juku eele.

source_text: then they nailed him to the cross. afterwards, they divided his clothes among themselves by gambling with something like dice to decide which piece of clothing each one would get.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu se'e paku yesus asa aj'u palolo-palèbha. hèia sordad'u se ère lot, sèna ka nèti rèngu, cee ka dhu abhu mèdha-papake na.

source_text: then the soldiers sat down there to guard him, to prevent anyone from trying to rescue him.
target_text: ka ra madhèdi madhenge yesus ètu era ne'e.

source_text: they fastened to the cross above jesus' head a sign on which had been {they had} written why they were nailing him to the cross. but all it said was, ‘this is jesus, the king of the jews'.
target_text: ra suri kahèi ètu papa èci, peka na, ne'e ne yesus, dhèu aae dhèu yahudi ka ra paku papa ne re dedha kètu yesus, sèna ka dhèu re'a nga tao ka rèngu huku ne.

source_text: two bandits were also nailed {they also nailed two bandits} on crosses. one was nailed to a cross on the right side of jesus and one to a cross on the left side.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, ra paku pamadhe parapo dhèu dua kahèi. ca dhèu re bèka g'ana yesus, aa èci hari re bèka kariu na.

source_text: the people who were passing by insulted him by shaking their heads as if he were an evil man.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu kako re sèra, laladhe ne. hèia ra pakapengo hèb'a ra, ho lalangu ne.

source_text: they said, you said you would destroy the temple, and then you would build it again within three days! so if you could do that, you should be able to save yourself! if you are the man who is also god or, if you are the son of god, come down from the cross!
target_text: dhèu se'e rodhe ne, peka na, eeh! èu peka na, èu bisa paguri eele èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua, ho èèna na patitu hari ètu d'ara tèlu lod'o, si? ladhe èu tare'a-re'a ana ama lamatua, na, papuru ngi'u mu nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha èèna.

source_text: similarly, the chief priests, the men who taught the jewish laws and the elders made fun of him. various ones of them said things like,
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka ad'a sèra. ra pahahe yesus, aku rèngu na,

source_text: he claims that he saved others iro from their sicknesses, but he cannot help himself! he says that he is iro the king of israel. so he should come down from the cross. then we would believe him!
target_text: nèngu ne pamamuri le dhèu leo, te ngaa na bisa boe patabuli eele ngi'u nèngu unu na. nèngu mesa na peka na, nèngu dhèu aae isra'el! ladhe sèmi èèna, be'a risi na puru ka nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha èèna. ladhe ji'i ngèdhi ka j'aj'i sèmi èèna, ji'i heka parcaya nèngu kèna.

source_text: he says that he trusts in god, and that he is the man who is also god. so if god is pleased with him, god should rescue him now!
target_text: ladhe nèngu ne tare'a-re'a ana ama lamatua, hud'i laa, ‘na maena mi ama lamatua. de ladhe lamatua d'èi ne, hud'i laa lamatua ka dhu pamamuri ne. '

source_text: and the two bandits who had been crucified with him also insulted him, saying similar things.
target_text: dhèu parapo dhèu dua se, pahahe ne sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: at noon it became dark over the whole land. it stayed dark until three o'clock in the afternoon.
target_text: èle èèna ka, maroga kiu-kiu saguru nare era ne'e, karèi nèti lod'o titu mera toke d'ai hake tèlu nihia.

source_text: at about three o'clock jesus shouted loudly, eli, eli, lama sabachthani? that means, ‘my god, my god, why have you deserted me? '
target_text: d'ai hake tèlu, hèia yesus pa'oo pake lii aram, na, eli! eli! lema sabaktani? sasoa na, ama lamatua ja'a! lamatua ja'a! nga tao ka ama soro kabodho ho tèke eele ja'a mesa-mesa ku sèmi ne'e ne?

source_text: when some of the people standing there heard the word ‘eli', misunderstanding it, they said, he is calling for the prophet elijah!
target_text: abhu pèri-pèri dhèu dhu dètu ètu sèra, tadèngi lii na sèmi èèna, hèia ra papeka, mi nanene ku laa. na paroa elia, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu uru sèra!

source_text: immediately one of them ran and got a sponge. he filled it with sour wine. then he put the sponge on the tip of a reed and held it up in order that jesus could suck out the wine that was in it.
target_text: ka ca dhèu rai la'e nare ula, cèb'u asa d'ara èi anggor manyilu. hèia na èki mi suu tatea èci, ka j'ole asa hèb'a yesus sèna ka na camuci.

source_text: but the other people there said, wait! let's see if elijah comes to save him!
target_text: te ngaa cahag'e hari peka na, èdhi ladhe sèku, teko-teko elia mai pamamuri ne, do aad'o?

source_text: then after jesus shouted out loudly again, he died, giving his spirit over to god.
target_text: ka yesus pa'oo hari dènge lii mèdhu, hèia na madhe.

source_text: at that moment the heavy thick curtain that closed off the most holy place in the temple split into two pieces from top to bottom. that signified that ordinary people could now go into the presence of god. the earth shook, and some large rocks split open.
target_text: ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, abhu bèla dhu bhèla aae kadhoe pa'abhe kama luri mola-mèci ama lamatua. lèke dènge yesus ma'ète a'ae èèna, bèla dhu bhèla aae ne mae, cèri mi dua, nèti dedha toke haha. hèia rai opo, toke hadhu aae-hadhu aae mae sèg'i bagi mi dua.

source_text: some tombs opened up, and the bodies of many godly people who had died became alive again.
target_text: ro'a-ro'a dhèu madhe bhoke kahèi. aa dhèu unu ama lamatua dhu madhe le, abhu dhu na pamamuri hari.

source_text: they came out of the tombs, and after jesus became alive again, they went into jerusalem and appeared to many people there.
target_text: ropa yesus mamuri hari le nèti mamadhe na, hèia dhèu madhe sèra bhodho mai nèti d'ara ro'a, ka lasi asa yerusalem. ètu era ne'e dhèu ae rèdhi si.

source_text: the officer who supervised the soldiers who nailed jesus to the cross was standing nearby. his soldiers who had been on guard so that no one would rescue jesus were also there. when they felt the earthquake and saw all the other things that happened, they were terrified. they exclaimed, truly he was both man and god! or, a son of god.
target_text: ètu golgota, abhu komedhaa dènge sordad'u na dhu j'aga ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha yesus èèna. ropa ladhe rèdhi rai opo, dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu j'aj'i se'e, rèngu madha'u titu kèna. ka ra papeka, na, ira ii! dhèu ne'e ne, tare'a-re'a ana lamatua!

source_text: many women were there, watching from a distance. they were women who had accompanied jesus from galilee district in order to provide the things he needed.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, abhu bhèni pèri-pèri dhèu dhu laladhe mamadhe yesus nèti kaj'èu. rèngu se'e ka dhu madhutu ne nèti galilea, te rèngu ka dhu lalau-lalo'o ne karèi nèti uru.

source_text: among these women were mary from magdala town, another mary who was the mother of james and joseph, and the mother of james and john.
target_text: dhèu bhèni se'e, nuka maria nèti rae magdala, maria èci hari nuka ina yakobis dènge yusuf, aa dènge dhèu èmu sabadeus nuka ina nèti yakobis dènge yohanis.

source_text: when it was almost evening, a rich man named joseph came there. he was from arimathea town. he also was a disciple of jesus.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu dhèu kaja èci nèti rae arimatea, ngara na yusuf. nèngu ne dhu nèbhu le madhutu a'aj'a yesus. lod'o mamadhe yesus lèke hari jumat. asa bèli èèna, lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a dhèu yahudi. nèti èèna ka, ropa lod'o oe cèna, hèia yusuf tenge j'ara ho neo papuru ngi'u aae yesus nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: he then went to pilate and asked pilate to allow him to take the body of jesus and bury it. pilate ordered that he be allowed to {his soldiers let joseph} take the body.
target_text: hèia la'e asa gubernur pilatus, sèna ka manèngi papuru ngi'u aae yesus. ka gubernur paredha, sèna ka ngi'u aae yesus saraka mi yusuf.

source_text: so joseph and others took the body and wrapped it in a clean white cloth.
target_text: ka yusuf la'e asa golgota, hèia na papuru ngi'u aae yesus nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha. hèia na hutu pabe'a-be'a ngi'u aae ne dènge bèla hiu dhu kab'ua.

source_text: then they placed it in joseph's own new tomb that had been dug out of the rock cliff. they rolled a huge circular flat stone in front of the entrance to the tomb. then they left.
target_text: tèu èèna, dhèu heka pae rare ro'a èci ètu ledhe hadhu, sèna ka tao tèke ro'a hia yusuf dènge a'ari na, ladhe d'ai lod'o rèngu madhe. de yusuf si nedhe rèti ngi'u aae yesus ne, lasi paj'unu asa ro'a deo na. ka ètu hèb'a ro'a ne, ra saguru dènge hadhu kabela aae cue, ho ra bèdho pabe'a-be'a hèb'a ro'a ne. èle èèna ka yusuf si lèpa.

source_text: mary from magdala and the other mary were sitting there opposite the tomb, watching.
target_text: lod'o èèna, maria nèti magdala, dènge maria dhu leo èci madhutu d'ai era èèna kahèi. ra madhèdi patangara dènge ro'a ne.

source_text: the next day was saturday, the jewish day of rest. the chief priests and some of the pharisees went to pilate.
target_text: asa bèli èèna, lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a dhèu yahudi. hèia kètu agama yahudi dènge dhèu parisi lasi paraga dènge gubernur.

source_text: they said, sir, we remember that while that deceiver was still alive, he said, ‘three days after i die i will become alive again. '
target_text: ra peka, ama. ji'i sanèd'e era, lod'o dhèu kapod'e-kabèli èèna mamuri era, na peka, na, ‘ja'a madhe tare'a, te ngaa èle tèlu lod'o, ja'a mamuri hari. '

source_text: so we ask you to order that the tomb be guarded {that soldiers guard the tomb} for three days. if you do not do that, his disciples may come and steal the body. then they will tell people that he has risen from the dead. if they deceive people by saying that, it will be worse than the way he deceived people before by saying that he was the messiah.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama paredha ku sordad'u sèra, ho ra j'aga paie-iie ro'a èèna d'ai tèlu lod'o. dènge j'ara ne'e, ana madhutu na bani boe mana'u rèti ngi'u aae na, sèna ka ra monya peka na, nèngu mamuri hari. te ladhe rèngu kapod'e-kabèli sèmi èèna, risi eele nèti mamonya rèngu uru sèra, lod'o dhu ra peka na, nèngu ne nuka kristus.

source_text: pilate replied, you can take some soldiers. go to the tomb and make it as secure as you know how.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, hèia gubernur dhaa, aku nèngu na, be'a kahèi! te ngaa miu dènge dhèu madhenga kahèi. be'a risi miu pua si, ho lasi j'aga paie-iie ro'a nèi.

source_text: so they went and made the tomb secure by fastening a cord from the stone that was in front of the entrance to the rock cliff on each side and sealing it. they also left some soldiers there to guard the tomb.
target_text: èle ka lasi asa era èèna, rèti dènge dhèu madhenga ra. d'ai era ne'e, ra segel madhe babèdho ro'a ne. hèia ra pua dhèu sèra madhenga, sèna ka dhèu leo baku mai rare ngi'u aae yesus.

source_text: after ◄the sabbath/the jewish day of rest► ended, on sunday morning at dawn, mary from magdala and the other mary went to look at the tomb.
target_text: ka ètu d'ara hari migu mad'ae aae era, maria nèti magdala, dènge maria dhu leo èci, lasi asa ro'a yesus.

source_text: suddenly there was a strong earthquake. at the same time an angel from god came down from heaven. he went to the tomb and rolled the stone away from the entrance so that everyone could see that the tomb was empty. then he sat on the stone.
target_text: kaca'a la rai opo kapai titu kèna. ana pajuu ama lamatua ca dhèu puru mai nèti sorga, hèia na loli eele hadhu aae dhu saguru ro'a. ka na madhèdi ètu dedha hadhu ne.

source_text: his appearance was as bright sim as lightning, and his clothes were as white as snow.
target_text: rèhu ana pajuu ne kale'e sèmi kaha'a bela, aa mèdha-papake na pudhi mèu.

source_text: the guards shook because they were very afraid. then they became completely motionless, as though they were dead.
target_text: dhèu madhenga se, madha'u bia toke ra karèbha, ka rèngu bisa boe kalau-karèto, nuka sèmi dhèu madhe sa.

source_text: the angel said to the two women, you should not be afraid! i know that you are looking for jesus, who was {whom they} ◄nailed to a cross/crucified►.
target_text: hèia ana pajuu nèti sorga ne, lii dènge dhèu bhèni se'e, aku nèngu na, miu baku madha'u! ja'a ke'a miu se mai tenge yesus, dhèu dhu ra paku pamadhe ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha èèna.

source_text: he is not here! god has ◄caused him to be alive again/raised him from the dead►, just like jesus told you would happen! come and see the place where his body lay!
target_text: te ngaa nèngu aad'o heka ètu era ne'e. te na mamuri hari le, sama sèmi dhu na peka le uru èèna. maso mai, sèna ka mèdhi unu mi era dhu ra paj'unu ngi'u aae na. era ne ngaa-ngaa aad'o heka!

source_text: then go quickly and tell his disciples, ‘he has risen from the dead! he will go ahead of you to galilee district. you will see him there. ' pay attention to what i have told you!
target_text: de pamèri lèpa ka! lami lolo dènge ana madhutu na, peka na, yesus mamuri hari le. la'e uuru le asa galilea. rèngu hud'i lasi paraga uuru ku dènge ne ètu nèi, sèmi dhu uru èèna, na moa mema mi rèngu. parcaya la. lèpa ka, lami lole ngaa dhu ja'a peka ne!

source_text: so the women left the tomb quickly. they were afraid, but they were also very joyful. they ran to tell us disciples what had happened.
target_text: hèia bhèni se rai li'u lasi, tèke eele era ne'e. ra madha'u, te ngaa ra karej'e-karae kahèi. ka ra pamèri-mèri lèpa, lasi peka j'ara se aa'i-aa'i ra mi ana madhutu yesus.

source_text: suddenly, as they were running, jesus appeared to them. he said, greetings! the women came close to him. they knelt down and clasped his feet and worshipped him.
target_text: te ngaa ropa d'ai talora j'ara, kabèdhi la yesus mai paraga dènge ra. ka na lii, aku nèngu na, saloom! ropa ladhe rèdhi, hèia lasi padètu-dètu, liku rare haga na, dènge pahaha iisi ra mi yesus.

source_text: then jesus said to them, do not be afraid! go and tell ◄all my disciples/all those who have been accompanying me► that they should go to galilee. they will see me there.
target_text: hèia na padhai lii, peka na, baku madha'u! lami peka dènge ana madhutu ja'a, sèna ka ra lasi mate ja'a ètu galilea nèi.

source_text: while the women were going, some of the soldiers who had been guarding the tomb went into the city. they reported to the chief priests everything that had happened.
target_text: lod'o dhèu bhèni se ètu talora j'ara era, dhèu madhenga se lèpa le asa kota. rèngu lasi lole ngaa dhu j'aj'i se mi kètu agama yahudi sèra.

source_text: so the chief priests and jewish elders met together. they made a plan to explain why the tomb was empty. they gave the soldiers a lot of money as a bribe.
target_text: hèia kètu agama yahudi rare lii èci dènge dhèu heka ad'a sèra, sèna ka b'ae doi ae-ae mi dhèu j'aga ho ra hutu hèb'a.

source_text: they said, tell people, ‘his disciples came during the night and stole his body while we were sleeping. '
target_text: kètu agama yahudi sèra peka, na, ladhe dhèu karèi miu, dhaa sèmi ne'e: d'ara mèda, ropa ji'i bhèj'i luu, nge'a boe, na, ana madhutu na mai mana'u rèti ngi'u aae na.

source_text: if the governor hears mty about this, we ourselves will make sure that he does not get angry and punish you. so you will not have to worry.
target_text: aa ladhe gubernur tadèngi, mage miu madha'u, te ji'i ka dhu ator dènge ne.

source_text: so the soldiers took the money and did as they were told {as the chief priests and elders told them}. and this story has been told {people have told this story} among the jews to the very day that i am writing this.
target_text: hèia dhèu madhenga se rare doi. aa ra tao madhutu dad'èi kètu agama se'e. nèti èèna ka, toke d'ai sange ne'e dhèu-dhèu yahudi parcaya era lii lolo kapod'e-kabèli ne.

source_text: later we eleven disciples went to galilee district. we went to the mountain where jesus had told us to go.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare lii lolo nèti dhèu bhèni se'e, hèia ana madhutu yesus dhèu canguru èci, lasi paraga dènge yesus asa propensi galilea, ètu ledhe èci, madhutu lii moa na.

source_text: we saw him there and worshipped him. but some of us doubted that it was really jesus, and that he had become alive again.
target_text: ropa ra ladhe rèdhi ne, ka ra pahaha iisi mi nèngu. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa abhu kahèi dhu d'ara ra kajari era.

source_text: then jesus came close to us and said, my father has given me all authority over everything and everyone in heaven and on earth.
target_text: hèia na ara mai padètu-dètu dènge ra, ka na lii, ama lamatua pangèd'u le koasa mi ja'a, sèna ka ja'a paredha aa'i-aa'i ètu sorga, aa dènge aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: so go, and using my authority, teach my message to people of all ethnic groups so that they may become my disciples. baptize them to be under the authority of mty my father, and of me, his son, and of the holy spirit.
target_text: de miu lami asa mia-mia, miu hud'i peka-padhai ku dènge dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i ra, lii lolo be'a ja'a ne. aa miu hud'i aj'a si paie-iie, ho sèna ka rèngu j'aj'i ana madhutu ja'a. aa miu hud'i sarani si ho j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, rèngu dhu pa'èki le dènge ama, dènge ana, aa dènge roh na dhu mola-mèci.

source_text: teach them to obey everything that i have commanded you. and remember that by the spirit i will be with you always, until the end of this age.
target_text: aa nori si sèna ka ra tao madhutu paredha aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a peka tèke le dènge miu. sanèd'e, ee! ja'a bera-bera dènge miu toke èle rai-haha ne.

source_text: ◄this is/i want to tell you► the good message about jesus christ, the son of god or, the man who was also god. what i want to tell you begins just like the prophet isaiah said it would begin, when he wrote these words that god said to jesus: listen! i am sending my messenger ahead of you. he will prepare people for your coming.
target_text: ne'e ne, lii lolo be'a lula-nèti ana ama lamatua. ngara na yesus kristus, dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u karèi nèti uru ka mai. lii lolo na mulai sèmi ne'e: lod'o yesus sab'a mèka sasab'a na, ama lamatua pua uru dhèu èci, ngara na yohanis, la'e tao tèke j'ara hia yesus dhu mai bèli-camèd'a. lula uru èèna, ama lamatua peka le dènge dhèu nèti lii padhai na, ngara na yesaya. na suri tèke, peka na, nanene! ja'a pua le dhèu èci, ho bhoke j'ara hia èu.

source_text: he will call out to people who pass by where he is in the desolate area, as people improve and straighten out pathways before an important official arrives met, make yourselves ready dou in order that you will be prepared when the lord comes.
target_text: dhèu èèna la'e asa d'ara mamoo, ho na rodhe, peka na, ‘miu aa'i-aa'i mi tao pabe'a ku j'ara, sèna ka sèmi mere mamai lamatua! pamera j'ara ho soru mamai na. '

source_text: the messenger that isaiah predicted was john. people called him ‘the baptizer'. in the desolate area near the jordan river he kept telling people, if you want god to forgive you for having sinned, you must turn away from your sinful behavior before you ask me to baptize you. a great number hyp of people who lived in jerusalem city and elsewhere in the judea district were going out to where john was. there, after hearing john's message, they responded by confessing the sinful things that they had done. then they were being baptized by john {john was baptizing them} in the jordan river. john wore rough clothes made of camel's hair. and as the prophet elijah had done, he wore a leather belt around his waist; and what he ate was only grasshoppers and honey that he found in that desolate area.
target_text: ra pangare dhèu ne'e, yohanis, tuka sarani dhèu. era pea nèngu ètu d'ara mamoo. kodho na tao nèti rèu badha onta, dhara hake na, tao nèti ka'uri badha. nganga'a nèngu kabara dènge dhua nasu oni. lod'o èèna, dhèu ae nèti kota yerusalem dènge propensi yudea, mai paraga dènge yohanis ètu era pea na. dhèu se mai neo rèdhi yohanis, aa nanene lii holo-nori na. na peka, hua iia miu ele-ho'a nèti tatao karehe, sèna ka ama lamatua saku eele sasala-sasigo miu. èle èèna miu sarani uuru ku j'aj'i mi tadha, na, miu be'a le dènge lamatua. nèti èèna ka, dhèu se'e bhoka sasala rèngu, ka yohanis sarani si ètu loko yarden.

source_text: he was preaching, very shortly a man will come who is very great. i am nothing compared to him. because he is so superior to me, i am not even worthy to serve him like a slave by stooping down and untying his sandals.
target_text: ka na peka hari, bèli-camèd'a dhèu èci mai, dhu kapai risi nèti ja'a. lula ja'a ne haha d'ai seli, neo j'aj'i ana pua-paleha èèna ka, lèke boe sa hèi.

source_text: i used only water when i baptized you because you said that you wanted to change your lives, but he will put his holy spirit within you to truly change your lives.
target_text: ja'a ne dhodhoka sarani miu dènge èi di, te ngaa nèngu tao risi eele nèti ja'a. te na papènu d'ara miu dènge roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci.

source_text: during that time when john was preaching, jesus came from nazareth town, which is in galilee district. he went to where john was preaching and he was baptized by john {john baptized him} in the jordan river.
target_text: ca lod'o hari, yesus la'e nèti rae nasaret ètu rai galilea, ka na paraga dènge yohanis. èle èèna ka yohanis sarani ne ètu loko yarden.

source_text: immediately after jesus came up out of the water, he saw heaven opened up and he saw the spirit of god descending on himself. he came in the form of a dove.
target_text: ropa yesus bhodho nèti d'ara èi mai, na ladhe, na, liru bhoke eele, ka roh ama lamatua puru mai sama sèmi koro j'aha ci'u, puru mai asa yesus.

source_text: and god mty spoke to him from heaven saying, you are my son, whom i love dearly. i am very pleased with you.
target_text: kaca'a la, ra tadèngi lii ama lamatua nèti dedha-liru, peka na, èu ne, ana pasue ja'a, èu pakarej'e taruu d'ara ja'a.

source_text: ◄then/right away► the spirit of god sent jesus into the desolate area.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, roh ama lamatua jajuku yesus asa d'ara mamoo la'e.

source_text: he was there for 40 days. during that time, he was tempted by satan {satan tempted him}. there were wild animals there also. but angels took care of him.
target_text: na pea dènge badha hui ètu èèna, èpa nguru lod'o. ka dhèu aae nidhu mai dadugu tenge j'ara sèna ka yesus madhutu nèngu, te ngaa tao nare boe. èle èèna ka, ana pajuu nèti ama lamatua puru mai lalau-lalo'o ne.

source_text: later, after john was put in prison {after soldiers put john in prison} because he had rebuked the governor herod antipas for his sins, jesus went to galilee district. there he was preaching the good message that came from god.
target_text: lod'o dhu kèpe rare yohanis tuka sarani pamaso asa d'ara bèdho, nèbhu boe ka yesus pakèd'i la'e propensi galilea. la'e lole lii lolo be'a nèti ama lamatua ètu nèi.

source_text: he was repeatedly saying, now is the time when god will begin to rule people's lives in a new way. so turn away from your sinful behavior! believe the good message in order ◄to belong to him/to become those whose lives he will rule►!
target_text: ka na peka, mi nanene! lod'o ama lamatua d'ai kèna! limuri ne, dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a, na, ama lamatua nèd'u le paredha karèi nèti uru ka. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i tèke eele ka tatao karehe sèra, ho lèpa madhutu ama lamatua. hèia parcaya ka lii holo-nori nèngu kahèi.

source_text: one day, while jesus was walking along by galilee lake, he saw two men, simon and simon's younger brother, andrew. they were casting their fishing net into the lake. they earned money by catching and selling fish.
target_text: ca lod'o hari, yesus kako re sebhe dano galilea, ka nèdhi dhèu dua, ngara ra simon dènge ari na anderias. sasab'a rèngu bèli-bèli èèna, j'ala i'a.

source_text: then jesus said to them, just like you have been gathering fish, come with me and i will teach you how to gather people to become my disciples met.
target_text: ka yesus paroa nare dua ra, peka na, we! mai madhutu ja'a! miu tema tenge i'a, te ngaa ja'a neo aj'a miu, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu tenge samanga.

source_text: immediately they abandoned the work that they were doing with their nets, and they went with him.
target_text: ropa ra nanene rare, hèia ra tèke eele j'ala rèngu, ka lasi dènge madhutu ne.

source_text: after they had gone on a little further, jesus saw two other men, james and james' younger brother, john. they were the sons of a man named zebedee. they were both in a boat mending fishing nets.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus kako hari ciki, ka nèdhi ana-ana sabadeus, a'a ngara na yakobis, aa ari ngara na yohanis. dua ra lalau paie pèku ètu dedha koha.

source_text: as soon as jesus saw them, he told them that they should leave their work and to come with him. so they left their father, who remained in the boat with the hired servants, and they went away with jesus.
target_text: ka yesus paroa dua ra, peka na, mai we! madhutu ja'a! ropa ra tadèngi rare lii yesus, ka dua ra tèke eele ama ra, dènge dhèu sab'a sa ètu dedha koha, lasi dènge ka madhutu yesus.

source_text: later jesus and those disciples arrived at capernaum town. on the next ◄sabbath/jewish rest day►, after jesus had entered ◄the synagogue/the jewish meeting place►, he began teaching the people who had gathered there.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na dhèu èpa sèra lasi d'ai kota kapernaum. lod'o èèna, lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi. ka yesus la'e asa d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i, ka na lole lii holo-nori ama lamatua ètu èèna.

source_text: they were continually amazed at the way he taught. he did not just teach what others had taught, like the men who teach the jewish laws did. they habitually just repeated what other people had taught. instead, he taught with his own authority.
target_text: dhèu ae sèra malaa, nanene lii padhai na, lula nèngu ne'a mèu lii dhu nèngu lole, risi nèti mese-mese agama yahudi.

source_text: suddenly, while he was teaching, a man appeared in their worship place who had an evil spirit in him, and he shouted,
target_text: lod'o èèna, abhu dhèu èci dhu nidhu tao. dhèu ne'e la'e asa d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i kahèi. kaca'a laa na pakèce, peka na,

source_text: jesus, from nazareth town, since we evil spirits have nothing in common with you, ◄do not interfere with us! /what do you want with us evil spirits? ► rhq ◄do not destroy us now! /have you come to destroy us now? ► rhq i know who you are. i know that you are the holy one who has come from god!
