target_text: ka na karèi dhèu ae ètu sèra sa, aku nèngu na, madhutu atora agama èdhi, èdhi bisa tao ngaa lod'o a'oro sasab'a? tao madha j'ara dhu be'a, do karehe? tao pabe'a dhèu, do pamadhe dhèu? te ngaa dhèu sèra èci sa bani boe bhoke hèb'a.

source_text: he looked around at them angrily. he was very distressed that they were stubbornly not wanting to help the man. so he said to the man, reach out your hand! when the man reached out his withered hand, his hand became all right again!
target_text: nèti èèna ka, yesus d'ara pèd'a, lula rèngu madhutu dhoka ad'a di, tao boe madha-dhilu mi dhèu ai roe cabèka ne. yesus nasa, ka na ladhe lème dhèu sèra. hèia na peka mi dhèu ai roe cabèka, aku nèngu na, j'ole kacui-aai èu mai sa ne'e! ka dhèu èèna soro kacui-aai asa yesus la'e. kabèdhi laa, èle dènge papèd'a na.

source_text: then the pharisees decided to get rid of jesus. so after they left the meeting house, they immediately met with some of the jews who supported herod antipas, who ruled galilee district. together they planned how they could kill jesus.
target_text: ropa dhèu parisi ladhe rèdhi yesus pa'èle kacui-aai dhèu èèna lèke lod'o a'oro sasab'a, aa'i-aa'i ra kalua nèti d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i. ka lasi padhue dènge dhèu partei politik herodes, ho tenge j'ara neo pamadhe yesus.

source_text: jesus and his disciples left that town and went to an area further along galilee lake in order to get away from the people. but a great crowd of people followed him. they were people who came from galilee district, from jerusalem city, from other towns of judea district, from idumea district, from the region on the east side of the jordan river, and from the region around tyre and sidon cities. this great crowd of people came to him because they heard about what he was doing.
target_text: ca lod'o, yesus dènge ana madhutu na lasi asa sebhe dano galilea. te ngaa, lula dhèu ae sèra re'a le ngaa dhu nèngu tao, ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i mai nèti rae-rae ho madhutu ne. rèngu mai nèti propensi galilea, propensi yudea, aa propensi idumea. abhu kahèi dhu mai nèti kota yerusalem, kota sidon dènge kota tirus. abhu kahèi cahag'e dhu mai nèti cabèka dhimu loko yarden. aa'i-aa'i sèra neo mai paraga dènge ne.

source_text: because he had healed many people, many other people who had various illnesses pushed forward in order that by touching him they would come well. so he told his disciples that they should get a small boat ready for him to get in and teach from it. he wanted to do this in order that the crowd would not crush him when they pushed forward to touch him.
target_text: taga dhèu dhu mai sèra ae seli, ka yesus pua ana madhutu na lasi tenge koha cue hia nèngu. na neo padhai lii dènge dhèu ae sèra nèti dedha koha, sèna ka rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra bisa ladhe rèdhi rèhu na, aa tadèngi lii padhai lii na hèi. ca hari ni, na puri-pa'èle dhèu pèd'a ae titu kèna. nèti èèna ka, dhèu ae mai paseti èci dènge èci, neo g'ag'e yesus.

source_text: whenever the evil spirits saw jesus, they caused the people whom they controlled to fall down in front of jesus in recognition of jesus' power. then they exclaimed, you are ◄the son of god/the man who is also god►!
target_text: ropa dhèu dhu nidhu tao sa ladhe rèdhi yesus, ka ra bèbha d'ai rai ètu madha yesus. hèia ra taraa, aku rèngu na, èu ne mema tare'a ana ama lamatua!

source_text: he commanded the evil spirits strongly that they should not tell anyone who he was.
target_text: te ngaa yesus kai rèngu, aku nèngu na, miu baku ale dènge dhèu èci sa hèi, ja'a ne cee!

source_text: jesus went with many other people up into the hills. after he picked out from among them the men whom he wanted to accompany him, they came close to him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus kako la'e asa kolo ledhe èci. na paroa pèri-pèri dhèu dhu nèngu d'èi. ka dhèu se mai madhutu ne.

source_text: he appointed twelve men in order that they might be with him and in order that he might send them out to preach. he called them apostles.
target_text: èle èèna ka, na hag'e nare dhèu canguru dua. ka na peka, ja'a pili miu ho madhutu taruu ja'a, j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha ja'a. ja'a neo pua miu, lami lole lii lolo be'a ama lamatua mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: he also gave them power in order that they might expel evil spirits from people.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi ja'a neo hia miu koasa, sèna ka miu bisa babège-lalèta nidhu nèti d'ara dhèu.

source_text: these were the twelve men he appointed: simon, to whom he gave the new name peter; his younger brother andrew; james, the son of zebedee, and john, the younger brother of james, to both of whom he added the new name, ‘men who are like thunder'. because of their fiery zeal; philip; bartholomew; levi, whose other name was matthew; thomas; another james, the son of alphaeus; thaddeus; another simon, who was a member of the party that wanted to overthrow the roman government; and judas iscariot or, judas, the man from kerioth town. he was the one who later ◄betrayed jesus/helped jesus' enemies seize him►.
target_text: ngara dhèu canguru dua sa, nuka: simon dhu yesus pangare na, petrus, yakobis, yohanis, yakobis dènge ari na, yohanis ne, dua ra ana sabadeus. yesus pangare rèngu dua ra, ngara na ‘boanerges', dhu sasoa na ‘sama sèmi d'oro'. anderias, pelipus, bertolomeos, mateos, tomas, yakobis ana alpius, tadius, simon dhu madhutu partei politik selot, dènge yudas iskariot dhu èèna na pahie eele yesus.

source_text: jesus along with his disciples went to the house where he was staying in capernaum. again a crowd gathered where he was. there were many people crowding around him, so that he and his disciples had no time when they could eat or when they could do anything else.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na sèra puru hari nèti kolo ledhe deo na. ka lasi asa d'ara èmu èci. dhèu ae titu kèna mai oke rare ne, ka na bisa boe na'a-ninu.

source_text: after his relatives heard about this, they went to take him home with them because ◄some people/they► were saying that he was insane.
target_text: rèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia ra papeka, aku rèngu na, miu ladhe ku yesus! ne'a heka lalau iisi na. ropa a'ari na tadèngi lii palolo dhèu, ka ra mai neo rare ne.

source_text: around that time some men who taught the jewish laws came down from jerusalem city. they heard that jesus was expelling demons. so they were telling people, beelzebub, who rules the evil spirits, controls him. he is the one who enables this man to expel evil spirits from people!
target_text: lod'o èèna, mese-mese agama nèti yerusalem mai peka dènge dhèu ètu sèra, aku rèngu na, heh! pasa dhilu miu! baku madhutu yesus. te dhèu aae nidhu, dhu ra paroa ngara na baalsebul, maso asa d'ara yesus, ka hia ne koasa, ho bata-magèla nidhu nèti d'ara dhèu.

source_text: jesus summoned those men. then he spoke to them in parables to enable them to realize that satan would not oppose his own evil spirits. he also wanted them to realize that by expelling evil spirits, he was demonstrating that he was much more powerful than satan. so he said, ◄it is ridiculous to suggest that satan would expel his own evil spirits! /why would satan expel his own evil spirits? ► rhq
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi nare lii padhue rèngu èèna, heia na paroa nare rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, ka na peka, lèke boe dènge ngangee dhèu! tasamia ka dhèu aae nidhu bisa babège ngi'u mesa na! ?

source_text: if people who live in the same country are fighting one another, they will cease to be a single group under one ruler.
target_text: ladhe ètu d'ara paredha dhèu aae èci, ana kabarai sèra èci patao-palaha dènge èci, paredha dhèu aae èèna taha nèbhu boe.

source_text: and if people who live in the same house fight each other, they will certainly not remain as one family.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi ètu d'ara èmu, ladhe isi èmu èci patao dènge èci, isi èmu èèna mae-manyèla!

source_text: similarly, if satan and his evil spirits were fighting one another, instead of remaining strong, he would become powerless.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge nidhu. ladhe èci pamusu dènge èci, rèngu mae-manyèla kahèi. sèmi èèna na, heka rèngu laho kao-kao.

source_text: contrary to what you say about me, someone can enter the house of a strong man like satan and carry off his possessions only if he first ties up the strong man. then and only then will he be able to steal the things in that man's house.
target_text: ladhe dhèu parapo neo mai parapo èmu dhèu èra èci, na hud'i èki-karadhe uuru ku lamatua èmu na, heka bau nèti mèdha-panyau kèna.

source_text: jesus also said, consider this carefully! people may sin in many ways and they may speak evilly about god, but if they then are sorry and ask god to forgive them, god will forgive them for doing that.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka mema dènge miu: ama lamatua sadia saku eele sasala dhèu. ladhe dhèu padhai lii karehe mi dedha dhèu leo, ama lamatua bisa saku eele sasala na era.

source_text: but if anyone speaks evil words about what the holy spirit does, god will never forgive that. that person's guilt will remain with him forever.
target_text: te ngaa lii padhai lii karehe mi dedha roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci, ama lamatua saku eele boe sasala nèngu, toke d'ai mia-mia la'e!

source_text: jesus told them that because they refused to admit that the holy spirit was helping him to expel demons. instead, they were saying, an evil spirit is controlling him!
target_text: yesus peka sèmi èèna, lula dhèu sèra peka na, dhèu èèna, nidhu tao.

source_text: jesus' mother and younger siblings arrived. while they stood outside, they sent someone inside in order to call him outside.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ina dènge ari yesus sèra mai tenge ne. d'ai èmu dhu yesus madhèdi ètu d'ara na, rèngu lasi boe asa d'ara, te ngaa ra titu ètu li'u, ka ra hia dhèu lasi paroa yesus.

source_text: a crowd was sitting around jesus. one of them said to him, listen/hey, your mother and your younger brothers and sisters are outside, and they are wanting ◄to see/to talk with► you!
target_text: lasi, na, yesus madhèdi padhai lii dènge dhèu ae. ka dhèu sèra peka dènge ne, ama, ee! ina mu dènge a'ari mu nuka ètu li'u si. ra neo paraga dènge ama.

source_text: jesus replied to them, ◄i will tell you something about my mother and my brothers. /do you know whom i consider to be like my mother and my brothers? ► rhq
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, peka na, cee ka dhu tare'a-re'a j'aj'i ina dènge a'ari ja'a?

source_text: after he looked around at the disciples who were sitting around him in a circle, he said, look here! i love these men as much as i love my mother and my brothers.
target_text: hèia na ladhe palème asa dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu sèra, ka na peka, miu se'e se ka dhu tare'a-re'a j'aj'i ina dènge a'ari ja'a.

source_text: those who habitually do what god wants are as dear to me met as my brother, my sister, or my mother!
target_text: te cee ka dhu madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua, rèngu sèra ka dhu tare'a-re'a j'aj'i ina dènge a'ari ja'a.

source_text: another time jesus began to teach people alongside lake galilee. as he was doing that, a very large crowd gathered around him. because people were jostling him, he got into a boat in the lake so that he could speak to the crowd better. then he sat in it and began to teach the crowd from the boat. at the same time, the crowd was on the shore close to the lake.
target_text: ca lod'o, yesus la'e hari asa dano galilea. d'ai nèi dhèu ae mai oke rare ne. ka yesus ca'e la'e madhèdi asa dedha koha cue dhu panahu. na aj'a dhèu sèra dènge lii pakasame. dhèu dhu titu ètu dedha salae sèra aa'i-aa'i nanene yesus aj'a lii holo-nori ama lamatua.

source_text: then he taught them many parables. while he was teaching them, he told them this:
target_text: na aj'a si lii holo-nori rupa-rupa pake lii pakasame. aku nèngu sèmi ne'e ka:

source_text: consider well the meaning of this illustration: a man/farmer went out to his field to sow some seeds.
target_text: nanene paie-iie! dhèu èci la'e ceb'e hini ètu d'ara oka na.

source_text: as he was scattering them over the soil, some of the seeds fell on the path. then some birds came and ate those seeds.
target_text: ropa na ceb'e hini sèra, cahag'e lèke ètu sebhe j'ara. kabèdhi laa, manu-bhui mai ka ra'a aa'i.

source_text: other seeds fell on ground where there was not much soil on top of rock. very soon the seeds sprouted because the sun warmed the moist soil quickly where it was not deep.
target_text: cahag'e hari lèke ètu era rai dhu pènu dènge hadhu. hini sèra muri, te ngaa rai isi dhoka ciki oo'e di.

source_text: but after the sun shone on those young plants, they became scorched. then they withered because they did not have deep roots.
target_text: ropa lod'o rea mai, ana nganga'a sèra kamale eele hèia madhe aa'i si, lula amo d'ai boe d'ara rai.

source_text: as the farmer sowed, other seeds fell on ground that contained roots of thorny plants. the seeds grew, but the thorny plants also grew up and crowded out the good plants. so the plants produced no grain.
target_text: hini cahag'e lèke ètu dedha rai dhu pènu dènge j'u'u padhudhu. ropa j'u'u sèra muri, hèlu rare ana nganga'a sèra, ka j'aj'i boe hua-hela.

source_text: but as the farmer sowed, other seeds fell on good soil. as a result, they sprouted, they grew well, and then they produced plenty of grain. some plants bore 30 grains. some bore 60 grains. some bore 100 grains.
target_text: te ngaa hini cahag'e lèke ètu dedha rai hèu mèngi. hini sèra muri dènge sega. hua ae titu kèna. cahag'e dhu abhu d'ai tèlu nguru hari, cahag'e èna nguru hari, aa cahag'e d'ai cangasu hari.

source_text: then jesus said, if you want to understand this mty, you should consider carefully what i have just said.
target_text: de ladhe cee dènge ro'a dhilu, na, nanene paie!

source_text: later, when only the twelve disciples and a few other people were with him, they asked him about the parables.
target_text: ca tèka, yesus mesa na. hèia ana madhutu na dhèu canguru dua dènge pèri-pèri dhèu dhu tadèngi le lii holo-nori na, mai paraga dènge ne. ka ra karèi sasoa nèti lii pakasame èèna.

source_text: he said to them, people have not understood before the new message about how god wants to rule people's lives. it is to you that this is being made known {that i am making this known}. but i tell about this only ◄in parables/figuratively► to those who have not yet invited god to rule their lives.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, lula miu tare'a-re'a neo me'a lii holo-nori ama lamatua, ja'a neo peka dènge miu. te ngaa mi dhèu leo, ja'a pake lii pakasame.

source_text: as a result it is true what a prophet has written, although they see what i do, they do not perceive what it means dou. although they hear what i say, they do not understand what it means dou. so they do not ◄repent/turn away from their sinful behavior► in order that they would be forgiven {god would forgive them}.
target_text: tatao dhèu leo sèra sama sèmi dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua suri tèke, peka na, ‘rèngu rèdhi le, te ngaa ro'o boe re'a. rèngu tadèngi le, te ngaa ro'o boe tèke ètu d'ara. ladhe sèmi èèna, hud'i rèngu sène. ra parcaya ia ka lamatua, sèna ka lamatua saku eele ia ka sasala ra. '

source_text: he also said to them, ◄i am disappointed that you do not understand this illustration! /can you not understand this illustration? ► rhq if you do not understand this, ◄you will certainly not understand any of the other illustrations! /how will you understand any of the other illustrations? ► rhq nevertheless, i will explain it to you.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus peka dènge dhèu sèra sasoa lii pakasame hini èèna, aku nèngu na, ladhe miu me'a boe sasoa nèti lii upama deo na, carui risi hari miu me'a sasoa lii pakasame dhu leo.

source_text: in the illustration that i told you, the man who sows seeds represents someone who declares god's message dou.
target_text: de sasoa na sèmi ne'e ka: dhèu dhu ceb'e hini èèna, nuka dhèu dhu lole lii holo-nori ama lamatua.

source_text: some people are like the path on which some of the seeds fell. when they hear the message, satan comes at once and causes them to forget what they have heard.
target_text: hini dhu lèke ètu sebhe j'ara ka manu-bhui mai ra'a aa'i, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu nanene lii holo-nori ama lamatua. te ngaa nèbhu boe, dhèu aae nidhu mai parame rare lii holo-nori nèti d'ara dhèu èèna.

source_text: some people are like the ground where the soil was not very deep over rock. when they hear god's message, they immediately accept it with joy.
target_text: aa hini dhu lèke ètu dedha hadhu, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu nanene, ka na sèmi nare lii holo-nori èèna dènge d'ara karej'e.

source_text: but, because the message does not penetrate deeply met into their hearts/inner beings, they believe it for only a short time. they are like the plants that did not have deep roots. when others treat such people badly or cause them to suffer because they believe, those people who are suffering soon stop believing god's message.
target_text: te ngaa lii holo-nori ne, taha nèbhu boe ètu d'ara dhèu èèna. ropa nèngu paraga j'aj'èra lula na sèmi nare lii ne'e, na tèke eele.

source_text: some people are like the soil that had roots of thorny weeds in it. although those people hear god's message,
target_text: aa hini dhu lèke ètu talora j'u'u dhu padudhu, èci èèna ka dènge lii holo-nori ama lamatua dhu dhèu nanene.

source_text: they desire to be rich, and they desire to own many other things. so they worry only about material things. the result is that they forget god's message and they do not do the things that god wants them to do.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu èèna bhute dhoka dènge rupa-rupa madha j'ara rai-haha dhu pakarej'e ngi'u na. nèti èèna ka, j'ara se'e seti eele lii holo-nori ama lamatua nèti d'ara nèngu, ka j'aj'i heka ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: but some people are like the good soil. they hear god's message and they accept it and they believe it. then they do the things that god wants them to do. they are like the good plants that produced 30, 60 or 100 grains.
target_text: te ngaa hini dhu lèke ètu dedha rai hèu mèngi, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu pasa dhilu ho nanene lii holo-nori ama lamatua dènge karej'e-karae. tatao nèngu madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua dènge d'ara kateme. dhèu ne'e tao j'ara-j'ara dhu pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua, sama sèmi hini dhu nèti hua-hela. abhu kahèi d'ai tèlu nguru hari, cahag'e d'ai èna nguru hari, aa abhu kahèi dhu d'ai cangasu hari.

source_text: he also told them another parable, saying, ◄people certainly do not light an oil lamp and then bring it in the house in order that it may be put {someone may put it} under a container or under a bed. /would anyone light an oil lamp and then bring it in the house in order that it may be put {someone may put it} under a container or under a bed? ► rhq ◄no, they light it in order that it may be put {someone may put it} in a place where it lights the house. /wouldn't they light it in order that it may be put {someone may put it} in a place where it lights the house? ► rhq
target_text: nèti dedha koha, yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na. na peka hari lii upama èci, aku nèngu na, tasamia, ee! miu mèdhi le, do dhae? dhèu suru rare labhu, ka saguru eele hari dènge soe! ka ra tèke asa ro'a koi la'e! aad'o, sina ma? te ladhe sèmi èèna, tèdhi boe saraa nèngu. dhèu hud'i tao labhu ètu era dhu dedha, sèna ka dhèu rèdhi saraa nèngu.

source_text: similarly, there are some parts of god's message that people do not know. but he intends that people will understand all the things that they do not know now.
target_text: ngaa dhu dhèu pahuni deo ne'e, bèli-camèd'a dhèu rèdhi aa'i. te ngaa dhu dhèu re'a boe lod'o deo ne'e, bèli-camèd'a dhèu re'a aa'i.

source_text: if you want to understand this, you should consider carefully what you have just heard.
target_text: de ladhe cee dhu dènge ro'a dhilu, na, nanene paie!

source_text: then he said to them, consider carefully what you hear me say to you, for god will let you understand to the same degree that you consider what i say. he will let you understand even more than that.
target_text: nanene paie-iie! ladhe miu tenge sasala dhèu, na, dhèu leo tenge sasala miu kahèi. sèmi èèna kahèi, ama lamatua tenge sasala miu. te ngaa na tao bia risi hari nèti èèna.

source_text: those who consider what i say and understand it, god will enable them to understand more. but those who do not consider carefully what i say, they will forget even what they already know.
target_text: ladhe dhèu èci neo tenge tare'a-re'a dad'èi lamatua, nèngu asa d'èlu-mèu. te ngaa ladhe dhèu pusi-pahae boe dad'èi lamatua, nèngu j'aj'i asa goa.

source_text: jesus also said, god has the power to change people who let him rule their lives. i will illustrate how that can happen met. a man planted seeds in the ground.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, paredha ama lamatua asa tabha kapai, sama sèmi hini dhu dhèu ceb'e ètu d'ara oka na.

source_text: afterwards he slept each night and rose each day without worrying about the seeds. during that time the seeds sprouted and grew in a way that he did not understand, because by itself the soil caused the plants to grow and produce grain.
target_text: nèngu ceb'e nare, ka la'e bhèj'i. tao heka ai hèb'a mi hini sèra. te ngaa hini sèra muri, ka asa kapai.

source_text: first the stalks appeared. then the heads appeared. then the full kernels in the heads appeared.
target_text: hini se muri unu ra. mulai ti rèu, hela, toke d'ai huri.

source_text: as soon as the grain was ripe he sent people mty to harvest it because it was time to harvest the grain.
target_text: ropa kasere nare nganga'a dhu ètu d'ara oka mami, dhèu unu oka heka la'e puu-g'ètu kèna. sèmi èèna kahèi, paredha ama lamatua. lamatua ka dhu ad'u-ue aa'i-aa'i sèra.

source_text: jesus told them another parable. he said, i will tell you rhq how the number of people whose lives god rules in a new way will continue to grow or, each continue to have more and more influence in this world. i hope rhq that this illustration will show this to you.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus padhai lii hari, ja'a peka hari lii upama èci sèmi ne'e ka: miu ladhe sèku, dhèu dhu j'aj'i unu lamatua sèra. uru èèna ciki di, nèbhu-nèbhu j'aj'i ae.

source_text: you know what happens to mustard seeds when we plant them. though mustard seeds are among the smallest of seeds, here in israel they become large plants.
target_text: èèna sama sèmi lamusi aj'u dhu ana iiki-iiki.

source_text: after they are planted, they grow up and become larger than the other garden plants. they put out big branches so that birds are able to make nests in their shade.
target_text: ladhe èdhi sèla lamusi èèna, na muri mai, j'aj'i aj'u dhu kapai aae. manu-bhui nèti mia-mia mai tèka tenge mamaho, dènge tao rèd'a ètu kolo aj'u èèna.

source_text: jesus used many such illustrations when he talked to the people about god. if they were able to understand some, he kept telling them more.
target_text: j'ara-j'ara a'aj'a yesus madhutu rare'a dhèu.

source_text: he always used parables when he spoke to them. but he explained all the illustrations to his own disciples when he was alone with them.
target_text: ladhe na aj'a dhèu leo, na pake lii pakasame. te ngaa ladhe na aj'a ana madhutu na, nèngu peka aa'i-aa'i sasoa lii pakasame sèra.

source_text: on that same day, when the sun was setting, jesus said to his disciples, let's cross over to the opposite side of lake galilee in the boat.
target_text: d'ai lod'o nihia na, yesus aj'a dhèu nèti dedha koha era. hèia na pua ana madhutu na sèra, peka na, mai èdhi pakèd'i lati asa cabèka dano.

source_text: so they left the crowd, got in the boat where jesus already was, and left. other people went with them in other boats.
target_text: ka ra ca'e koha èci dènge yesus. ra pakèd'i tèke eele dhèu ae sèra ètu èèna. te ngaa dhèu cahag'e ca'e koha leo madhutu yesus si.

source_text: a strong wind came up and the waves started coming into the boat! the boat was soon nearly full of water! jesus was in the back part of the boat. he was sleeping, with his head on a cushion. so they woke him up and said to him, teacher! ◄you ought to be concerned that we are about to die! /are you not concerned that we are about to die? ► rhq
target_text: lod'o èèna, yesus pasaluu kètu na mi nanèlu, ka bhèj'i luu ètu hui koha. nèbhu boe ka, ngèlu aae mai. naha kapai, ka èi tao sabhori oe pènu koha yesus si. nèti èèna ka, ana madhutu yesus sèra madha'u bia. hèia ra parèi ne, ama! kèd'i ku laa! èdhi oe molo kèna! te ngaa ama pusi-pahae boe!

source_text: so jesus got up and rebuked the wind. then he said to the lake, be quiet! be still! dou the wind immediately stopped blowing and then the lake became very calm.
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi lii parèi ra, ka na kèd'i, hèia na kai ngèlu, peka na, mau ka! ka na paredha naha, aku nèngu na, mera ka! hèia ngèlu mau, aa naha mera dènge ka.

source_text: he said to the disciples, ◄i am disappointed that you are afraid like that! /why are you afraid like that? ► rhq do you not yet believe that i can protect you?
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus jèke ana madhutu na, peka na, nga tao ka miu madha'u sèmi èèna? miu parcaya ja'a, do aad'o?

source_text: they were very awestruck. they said to one another, not only do the demons obey this man, but even the wind and the waves obey him! ◄what kind of man is he? /this man is not like ordinary people! ► rhq
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra madha'u dènge malaa, ka èci peka dènge èci, te dhèu ngaa ne? ka bisa ngèlu dènge naha, madhutu lii paredha nèngu?

source_text: jesus and his disciples arrived on the east side of lake galilee. they landed near where the gerasene people lived.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na sèra d'ai cabèka dano galilea. era èèna, ngara na garasa.

source_text: there was a man in that region whom evil spirits controlled. because that man was violent and people were afraid of him, they had tied him up many times. as he grew more violent, no one was able to tie him up any longer, not even with chains, because the chains would be broken by him {he would break the chains} whenever he was bound {they bound him} with them. the iron shackles would also be smashed by him {he would also smash the iron shackles} whenever they were fastened {they fastened them} on his feet. he lived in one of the caves where they bury dead people. during both night and day he would scream among the caves and in the hills. he would also cut himself with sharp stones. that day he came out of the caves. as jesus and his disciples got out of the boat, that man saw jesus from a distance. he immediately ran to jesus, and then he knelt before him.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu dhèu mone èci dhu nidhu tao, ka na huj'u. dhèu huj'u ne pea ètu era padhane dhèu madhe. mèu-mèda na kako ca'e-puru ledhe ètu èèna, dènge pake boe mèdha-papake. na pa'oo-parodha ma'ète boe, aa na nare hadhu ho tuku iisi na toke d'ai nu'a. na èra titu kèna. nèti èèna ka, dhèu èci sa bisa boe èki ne. masi ka ra èki dènge rate bèsi èèna ka, bisa boe kahèi. pèri-pèri hari, dhèu uj'u haga-ai na kahèi, pake rate dènge kanau bèsi, te ngaa na pama'ète aa'i si. dhèu ne èra bia, nèti èèna ka, èci sa taha boe ne. ropa yesus dènge ana madhutu na puru nèti dedha koha, dhèu huj'u èèna ladhe nèdhi rèngu nèti kaj'èu. hèia na kalua nèti era padhane dhèu madhe, ka na mai patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha yesus.

source_text: jesus said to the evil spirit, you evil spirit, come out of this man! but the demon did not leave quickly. it shouted very loudly, jesus, i know that you are the ◄son of/man who is also► god, so ◄we have nothing in common. /what do we have in common? ► idm, rhq so leave me alone i ask you to promise, knowing god is listening, that you will not torture me now!
target_text: ropa ladhe nèdhi rèhu dhèu ne'e, hèia yesus peka, na, hee, nidhu bhelu! kalua pakaj'èu nèti dhèu ne'e. èle èèna ka, dhèu èèna pajèka, aku nèngu na, weh! èu neo tao ngaa mi ja'a? ja'a ke'a èu ne yesus, ana nèti ama lamatua dhu koasa risi eele. ja'a manèngi èu baku paj'èra ja'a!

source_text: so, in order to expel the demon more easily, jesus asked him, what is your name? he replied, my name is crowd/mob because there are many of us evil spirits in this man.
target_text: hèia yesus karèi ne, ngara èu cee? na dhaa, aku nèngu na, ngara ja'a legion, lula ji'i ae titu kèna, sama sèmi ca kaboko sordad'u!

source_text: then the evil spirits fervently kept begging jesus that he not send them out of the region.
target_text: èle èèna ka, nidhu sèra peka re dhèu huj'u èèna, ho manèngi yesus, sèna ka baku pua rèngu kalua nèti d'ara rae ne.

source_text: at the same time, a large herd of pigs was ◄grazing/rooting for food► nearby on the hillside.
target_text: kaj'èu boe nèti èèna, abhu hahi ca oka dhu dhèu madhenge. ele boe hahi sèra dua riho ngi'u. dhu tenge nganga'a ètu sebhe ledhe.

source_text: so the evil spirits pleaded with jesus, allow us to go to the pigs in order that we might enter them!
target_text: ka nidhu sèra manèngi yesus, aku rèngu na, hia ji'i maso asa d'ara hahi sèra.

source_text: he permitted them to do that. so the evil spirits left the man and entered the pigs. the herd, which numbered about 2, 000, rushed down the cliff into the lake, and drowned in the lake.
target_text: tadèngi nare sèmi èèna, hèia yesus d'èi kahèi. ka nidhu sèra kalua nèti d'ara dhèu èèna, ka lasi asa d'ara hahi sèra. hèia hahi sèra rai paj'ala, ka lasi asa sebhe tèbhi, ka ra manahu asa d'ara dano, hèia madhe aa'i si.

source_text: the men who had been tending the pigs ran and reported in the town and the countryside what had happened. many people went to see what had happened.
target_text: ropa dhèu j'aga hahi sèra ladhe rèdhi madha j'ara dhu j'aj'i èèna, ra madha'u titu kèna. ka rai lasi peka palème dènge dhèu ètu d'ara rae-rae dhu dètu ètu era èèna. nèbhu boe dhèu canau-kateme mai neo re'a.

source_text: they came to the place where jesus was. then they saw the man whom evil spirits had previously controlled. he was sitting there with clothes on and mentally sound. as a result, they became afraid because they thought that jesus might destroy more of their property. or, they realized that jesus must be very powerful.
target_text: dhèu sèra mai paraga dènge yesus, ka ra ladhe la'a, na, dhèu dhu nidhu tao èèna, madhèdi ètu èèna kahèi. dhèu èèna pake le mèdha-papake. kahadhu na mase'a le. rèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia dhèu sèra madha'u. lula rèngu re'a le, ladhe dhèu cee dhu bisa babège eele nidhu nèti d'ara dhèu huj'u èèna, nèngu tare'a-re'a dhèu èra risi.

source_text: the people who had seen what had happened described what had happened to the man whom the evil spirits previously controlled. they also described what had happened to the pigs.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra lasi peka palème ètu mia-mia, aku rèngu na, ji'i ngèdhi le dènge madha, dhèu huj'u ne èle le. sèmi èèna kahèi hahi dhu madhe ètu d'ara dano.

source_text: then the people pleaded with jesus to leave their region.
target_text: ka dhèu kabarai èèna mai manèngi ho yesus tèke eele ka rai rèngu.

source_text: as jesus got in the boat in order to leave, the man whom the evil spirits previously controlled begged jesus, please let me go with you!
target_text: ropa yesus neo ca'e hari asa dedha koha, ka dhèu dhu èle nèti huj'u dhu nidhu tao èèna manèngi yesus, sèna ka nèngu madhutu ne kahèi.

source_text: but jesus did not let him go with him. on the contrary, he said to him, go home to your family and tell them how much the lord god has done for you, and tell them how god was kind to you.
target_text: te ngaa yesus kai. ka na peka dènge dhèu èèna, aku nèngu na, be'a risi èu lèpa ka asa èmu, ho peka dènge a'ari èu, ngaa dhu ama lamatua tao le mi dedha èu. peka dènge si, mema ama lamatua sue èu titu kèna.

source_text: so the man left and traveled around the ten towns district. he told people how much jesus had done for him. all the people who heard what the man said were amazed.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia dhèu èèna pakèd'i la'e palème rae-rae nèti canguru kota, dhu ngara na ‘dekapolis'. na lole ngaa dhu yesus tao le mi dedha nèngu. dhèu-dhèu dhu tadèngi lii lolo na, malaa aa'i mèu-mèu, aku rèngu na, mema lèke tare'a!

source_text: jesus and his disciples went in a boat back around lake galilee to where they were before. when they arrived at the shore of the lake, a large crowd gathered around jesus.
target_text: èle ka, yesus si pakèd'i hari dènge koha asa cabèka dano. ropa ra puru nèti dedha koha, dhèu ae mai lingu rare yesus.

source_text: one of the men who presided over a ◄synagogue/jewish meeting place►, whose name was jairus, came there. when he saw jesus, he prostrated himself at his feet.
target_text: dhèu èci mai, ngara na yairus. nèngu ne, kètu èmu manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi ètu kota èèna. ropa nèngu nèdhi yesus, ka mai patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha yesus.

source_text: then he pleaded with jesus earnestly, my twelve-year old daughter is sick and nearly dead! please come to my house and place your hands on her in order that she will be healed {to heal her}, so that she will not die!
target_text: ka na pamako, peka na, ama, ee! ana bhèni ja'a, heka canguru dua tèu, pèd'a oe madhe. mai lati ku asa èmu ja'a, sèna ka puri-pa'èle ne nèti papèd'a na.

source_text: so jesus and the disciples went with him. a large crowd followed jesus and many pushed close to him.
target_text: hèia yesus la'e dènge ka, madhutu yairus asa èmu na. te ngaa ètu d'ara kakako rèngu, dhèu ae titu kèna, ka ra seti ne nèti haa, nèti dhimu.

source_text: there was a woman in the crowd who had vaginal bleeding eup every day for twelve years.
target_text: ètu talora dhèu ae sèra, abhu dhèu bhèni èci dhu pèd'a dhèu bhèni. papèd'a ne loe boe canguru dua tèu kèna.

source_text: she had suffered much while many doctors treated her. but although she had spent all her money to pay the doctors, she had not been helped {they had not helped her}. instead, she had become worse eup.
target_text: mèdha-panyau dènge doi-dhari dhèu bhèni ne'e, èle aa'i mèu-mèu ho b'ae dote. te ngaa papèd'a na èle boe, asa na hoe.

source_text: after she heard that jesus healed people, she came to where he was and pushed in the crowd close behind jesus. she did that because she was thinking, if i touch him or even if i touch his clothes, i will be healed {his power will heal me}. so she touched jesus' clothes. at once her bleeding stopped. at the same time, she sensed that she had been cured of {that he had cured} her illness.
target_text: bhèni ne tadèngi ae le dhèu palolo ngaa dhu yesus tao. nèti èèna ka, na mai pasuki asa talora dhèu ae sèra, ho na padètu dènge yesus. na pangee, na, sad'i ja'a gai lèke sebhe kodho na di, tatu papèd'a ja'a èle. ropa na gai lèke sebhe kodho yesus, kabèdhi laa raa bhèni ne tèja eele dènge. hèia na rasa, na be'a le.

source_text: jesus also immediately sensed that his power had healed someone. so he turned around in the crowd and asked, who touched my clothes?
target_text: lod'o èèna kahèi, yesus rasa a'èra kalua nèti d'ara ngi'u na. ka na kabib'a asa kabodho, ho ladhe asa dhèu ae sèra, ka na karèi, peka na, nèti miu se, cee ka dhu gai lèke kodho ja'a?

source_text: one of his disciples replied, you can see that many people are crowding close to you! probably many people touched you! so ◄why do you ask ‘who touched me? '/we are surprised that you ask ‘who touched me? ' rhq►
target_text: ka ana madhutu na dhaa, aku rèngu na, ama, ladhe ku laa. dhèu ae paseti sèmi ne'e. nga tao ka ama karèi, peka na, ‘cee ka dhu gai kodho ja'a? '

source_text: but jesus kept looking around in order to see the one who had done it.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ladhe pala-lème, neo ne'a cee ka dhu gai lèke sebhe kodho na.

source_text: the woman was very afraid and trembling. she thought that jesus might be angry because she had violated the law that women who had such a sickness should not touch other people. but she knew that jesus had healed her. so she prostrated herself before him. then she told him truthfully about what she had done.
target_text: ropa yesus karèi sèmi èèna, hèia bhèni èèna madha'u bia. èle èèna ka, na mai patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha yesus, ka na mangaku, ama! ja'a ka dhu gai lèke sebhe kodho ama ku deo na.

source_text: he said to her, ◄ma'am/young lady►, because you have believed that i could heal you, i have healed you. you may go home with peace in your heart/inner being, because i promise that you will not be sick this way any more.
target_text: hèia yesus peka mi bhèni ne, aku nèngu na, lula èu parcaya ja'a dènge d'ara kateme, nèti èèna ka, èu èle le. lamu ka èmu, dènge d'ara karej'e-karae.

source_text: while jesus was still speaking to that woman, some people arrived who had come from jairus' house. they said to jairus, your daughter has now died. so ◄it is useless that you bother the teacher any longer by urging him to go to your house! /why do you bother the teacher any longer by urging him to go to your house? ► rhq
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii era, hèia dhèu èci mai nèti èmu yairus, aku nèngu na, ira ii! ana mu madhe le. de baku paj'èra ia ka ama mese. nèngu la'e ia ka sa nèi.

source_text: but when jesus heard what these men said, he said to jairus, do not think that the situation is hopeless! just keep believing that she will live!
target_text: te ngaa yesus pusi boe dènge lii padhai lii dhèu ne'e. ka na peka dènge yairus, èu baku madha'u, ee! parcaya mi ama lamatua di.

source_text: then he allowed only his three closest disciples, peter, james, and john, to go with him to jairus' house. he did not allow any other people to go with him. after they arrived near the house, jesus saw that the people there were in turmoil. they were weeping and wailing dou loudly.
target_text: hèia yesus la'e dènge ka, tèke eele ana madhutu na cahag'e. nèti dhoka petrus, yakobis dènge yohanis. ropa d'ai èmu yairus, rèngu rèdhi dhèu jau oob'a-jau oob'a, aa tadèngi cahag'e tangi d'ara pèd'a.

source_text: he entered the house and then he said to them, knowing that he was going to cause her to live again, ◄do not make such a disturbance! /why are you making such a disturbance? ► rhq stop crying, for the child is not dead! on the contrary, she is only sleeping hyp, eup!
target_text: yesus maso asa d'ara, ka na karèi si, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka miu maruru dènge tangi sèmi ne'e? ana ne'e madhe boe! nèngu dhoka bhèj'i di.

source_text: the people laughed at him, because they knew that she was dead. but he sent all the other people outside the house. then he took the child's father and mother and the three disciples who were with him. he went into the room where the child was lying.
target_text: dhèu ètu sèra tadèngi yesus peka sèmi èèna, ka ra mari pakapengo hèb'a dènge ne. hèia na pua dhèu sèra kalua aa'i nèti d'ara kama ana dhu madhe èèna. ka na paroa ina-ama ana bhèni ne, dènge ana madhutu na dhèu tèlu sèra, maso asa d'ara.

source_text: he took hold of the child's hand and said to her in her own language, talitha, koum! that means, little girl, get up!
target_text: hèia yesus kèpe kacui-aai ana dhu madhe ne, ka na padhai lii pake lii rèngu, lii aram, aku nèngu na, talita kum! sasoa na, ana bhèni! kèd'i ka!

source_text: at once the girl got up and walked around. it was not surprising that she could walk, because she was twelve years old. when this happened, all who were present were very astonished. jesus ordered them strictly, do not tell anyone about what i have done! afterwards he told them that something to eat should be brought to the girl {that they should bring the girl something to eat}.
target_text: kabèdhi laa, ana dhu madhe èèna mamuri hari. hèia na kèd'i titu, ka na kako. hèia yesus peka dènge ina na, aku nèngu na, hia ana ne'e na'a-ninu! dhèu ae ètu sèra dhu rèdhi j'ara dhu j'aj'i ne, ra malaa titu kèna. hèia yesus kai si, peka na, mage mi peka dènge dhèu èci sa, ja'a ka dhu pamamuri hari ana ne.

source_text: jesus left capernaum city and went to his hometown, nazareth. his disciples went with him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na sèra aa'i-aa'i ra, lèpa hari asa rae na, nasaret.

source_text: ◄on the sabbath/on the jewish rest day►, he entered the jewish worship house and taught the people. many who were listening to him were astonished. but some were saying, this man is just an ordinary person like we are! so ◄we cannot believe that this man is able to teach us about these things and that he has been made very wise {that god has made him very wise} and that he is performing such miracles! /how is it that rhq this man is able to teach us about these things and that he has been made very wise {that god has made him very wise} and that he is performing such miracles? ► rhq
target_text: lod'o èèna lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a dhèu yahudi. hèia yesus la'e asa d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ho na aj'a lii holo-nori ama lamatua ètu èèna. lod'o èèna, dhèu ae lasi manèngi-mangaj'i. ropa ra tadèngi yesus aj'a lii holo-nori ama lamatua, hèia dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra malaa, aku rèngu na, dhèu ne mèu samia ne! na dènge koasa kahèi! tasamia ka na sèmi èèna, ee?

source_text: ◄we know that he is just an ordinary carpenter! /isn't he just an ordinary carpenter rhq? ► we know him and his family! we know mary his mother! ◄we know his younger brothers james, joses, judas and simon! /are not his younger brothers james, joses, judas and simon? ► rhq and ◄his younger sisters also live here in this town! /do not his younger sisters also live here in this town? ► rhq so they despised him.
target_text: nèngu ne'e dhoka tuka aj'u di. èdhi tadhe ina na, maria. sèmi èèna kahèi ari na, yakobis, yoses, yudas dènge simon, dènge ari na dhèu bhèni sèra. rèngu dènge èdhi pea ca rae. dhèu se'e ngee ètu d'ara rèngu na, rèngu mèu risi nèti yesus. nèti èèna ka, ra d'èi heka nanene ne.

source_text: jesus knew that they refused to believe in him. so he said to them, it is certainly true that people honor me and other prophets in other places, but not in our hometowns! even our relatives and the people who live in our own houses do not honor us!
target_text: ka yesus peka, mema tare'a! dhèu pakab'ua risi dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua nèti rae leo. te ngaa ra pakab'ua boe dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu nèti rae nèngu.

source_text: so, although he healed a few sick people there by touching them, he decided not to perform many other miracles in nazareth because the people there did not believe that he was the messiah.
target_text: d'ara dhèu sèra adhu sèmi hadhu, ka ra parcaya boe lii padhai lii yesus. nèti èèna ka, na malaa, hèia na pake boe koasa na. ka na puri-pa'èle dhoka dhèu pèri di, ètu èèna.

source_text: he was amazed that they did not believe in him. jesus and his disciples went from town to town in that region teaching the people.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus kako palème asa rae-rae dhu padètu ètu sèra, ho aj'a dhèu j'ara mamuri ama lamatua.

source_text: one day he summoned the twelve disciples, and then he told them that he was going to send them out two-by-two to teach people in various towns. he gave them power to expel evil spirits from people.
target_text: na paroa nare ana madhutu na dhèu canguru dua sèra, ka na pua rèngu lasi dua-dua ho lole lii lolo be'a nèti ama lamatua. na hia si koasa kahèi, ho babège eele nidhu nèti d'ara dhèu.

source_text: he also instructed them to wear sandals and to take along a walking stick when they were traveling. he told them not to take food, nor a bag in which travelers carry supplies, nor any money for their journey. he also did not allow them to take extra clothing. he wanted the people who heard their message to give them what they needed.
target_text: na peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, miu baku mèti mèdha ae ètu d'ara kakako miu. baku mèti nganga'a, doi, dènge tas. mèti dhoka tatea, salapa ètu haga, dènge kodho ètu ua di.

source_text: he also instructed them, after you enter a town, if someone invites you to stay in his house, go into his house. eat and sleep in that same home until you leave that town.
target_text: ladhe cee dhu sèmi rare miu ètu èmu ra, miu pea dhoka ètu èèna di, toke d'ai pakèd'i hari.

source_text: wherever the people do not welcome you and wherever the people do not listen to you, shake off the dust from your feet as you leave that place. by doing that, you will warn them that god will punish them for rejecting your message.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu lami asa era èci, hèia dhèu ètu sèra sèmi rare boe miu, aa ra d'èi boe nanene lii padhai lii miu, tèke eele era èèna. aa peka mi dhèu sèra, na, ‘miu mo'o boe nanene, si! de bèli-camèd'a sèmi mere pala mi! '

source_text: so after the disciples went out to various towns, they were preaching that people should stop their sinful behavior.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra lasi lole lii lolo be'a. ra peka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i hud'i ele ho'a nèti sasala-sasigo ra, ka lèpa ho mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: they were also expelling many evil spirits from people, and they were anointing many sick people with olive oil and healing them.
target_text: ka ra babège eele nidhu nèti d'ara dhèu. ra pasuti èi lèngi mi kètu dhèu pèd'a, aa sabaj'a ho pa'èle si nèti papèd'a. ka ra èle dènge.

source_text: king herod antipas heard about what jesus was doing, because many people were talking about it. some people were saying about jesus, he must be john the baptizer! he has come back to life! that is why he has god's power to perform these miracles!
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ètu mia-mia tadhe aa'i le yesus. dhèu aae herodes tadèngi le lii lolo lula-nèti koasa yesus kahèi. dhèu palolo ètu mia-mia, aku rèngu na, yohanis tuka sarani èèna, mamuri hari le ètu d'ara ngi'u yesus! nèti èèna ka, na bisa tao tadha malaa sèra.

source_text: others were saying about jesus, he is the former prophet elijah, whom god promised to send back again. others were saying about jesus, no, he is a different prophet, like one of the other prophets who lived long ago.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu cahag'e hari peka, aku rèngu na, aad'o! ne'e ne, elia dhu mamuri hari d'ara ngi'u yesus. aa dhèu cahag'e hari, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu leo hari nèti uru sèra.

source_text: having heard what the people were saying, king herod antipas himself repeatedly said, the man performing those miracles must be john! i commanded my soldiers to cut off his head, but he has come back to life again to get revenge for my killing him!
target_text: ropa dhèu aae herodes tadèngi nare lii lolo dhèu se'e lula-nèti yesus, ka na dhaa, peka na, èèna yohanis tuka sarani, dhu ca hari ni ja'a hia dhèu pare pamadhe le, te ngaa na mamuri hari!

source_text: the reason king herod concluded that john wanted revenge is as follows: some time before this, herod married herodias, while she was still the wife of his younger brother, philip. john kept telling herod, god's law does not permit you to marry the wife of your brother while he is still alive. then, because herodias urged him to put john in prison, herod himself sent soldiers to john. they seized john and put him in prison.
target_text: dhèu aae herodes pua sèmi èèna, lula nèngu lii langu dènge yohanis. lii lolo na sèmi ne'e ka: dhèu aae herodes leo nare dhèu èmu ari na, pelipus, ngara na herodias. aa te ngaa pelipus dènge herodias dhae pa'ia mèka. nèti èèna ka, yohanis kai pahari-pahari, peka na, ama dhèu aae baku leo dènge dhèu èmu ari mu. te èèna sisu ad'a èdhi dhèu yahudi. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa herodes leo nare bhèni ne'e kahèi. hèia na pua dhèu lasi kèpe rare yohanis, ho pamaso ne asa d'ara bèdho.

source_text: but because herodias wanted to get further revenge on john, she wanted someone to execute him. but she could not do that because while john was in prison, herod kept john safe from her.
target_text: lula yohanis kai pèri hari le, hèia bhèni ne tèka d'ara dènge ne, ka na neo pamadhe ne. te ngaa lake nare mèka, te herodes dhu pamaso le yohanis asa d'ara bèdho la'e.

source_text: herod did this because he respected/feared john, because he knew that he was a righteous and holy man. the king did not know what he should do, but he liked to listen to him.
target_text: ka na pua sordad'u sèra madhenge paie ne ètu d'ara bèdho. herodes madha'u dènge yohanis. na ne'a tare'a, yohanis ne dhèu dhu ama lamatua pua mai. aa yohanis ne dhèu d'ara mola. herodes d'èi nanene lii padhai lii yohanis kahèi. te ngaa stèka-stèka, d'ara na pèd'a nanene lii padhai lii yohanis.

source_text: but herodias was able to have someone execute john when they honored/celebrated the day when herod was born. on that day, he invited the most important government officials, the most important army leaders, and the most important men in galilee district in order that they might eat and celebrate with him.
target_text: ka ca tèka, herodias abhu lod'o dhu be'a, sèna ka na b'ala d'ara pèd'a na. lod'o èèna, lèke dènge hari jadi herodes. ka ra nèru dhèu aae-dhèu kapai mai ra'a-sisi hari jad'i. dhèu dhu mai sèra, ama-ama dhu paredha, ama-ama sordad'u, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a ètu galilea.

source_text: while they were eating, herodias' daughter came into the room and danced, and that pleased king herod and his guests. so the king said to her, ask me for whatever you desire and i will give it to you!
target_text: ètu d'ara talora tatao èèna, ana bhèni herodias la'e roge. na roge be'a risi eele, ka d'ara herodes dènge dhèu dhu nèru sèra karej'e bia. nèti èèna ka, herodes paroa ne mai asa madha, ka na karèi, aku nèngu na, èu neo manèngi ngaa? èu peka ho ja'a hia.

source_text: he said to her, whatever you ask, i will give it to you! i will give you up to half of what i own and rule, if you ask for it. may god punish me if i do not do what i have promised!
target_text: èu manèngi era paredha ja'a ne bagi dua, hia èu cabèka èèna ka, ja'a ko'o kahèi. ja'a subha dènge ngara ama lamatua!

source_text: the girl immediately left the room and went to her mother. she told her what the king had said, and asked her, what shall i ask for? her mother replied, ask the king to give you the head of john the baptizer!
target_text: ka ana bhèni èèna la'e karèi ina na, aku nèngu na, ina, ee! madhutu ngangee ina ku, na, ja'a manèngi ngaa dhu be'a risi nèti ama ku? ka ina na dhaa, aku nèngu na, lamu asa madha ama mu ho peka dènge ne, ja'a manèngi dhoka kètu yohanis di.

source_text: the girl quickly entered the room again. she went to the king and she requested, i want you to command someone to cut off the head of john the baptizer and give it to me at once on a platter, so that my mother can know he is dead!
target_text: ka ana bhèni ne la'e asa madha herodes, ka na peka, aku nèngu na, ama! ja'a manèngi kètu yohanis, tao ètu d'ara dula èci hia ja'a. deo ne'e ne, kahèi!

source_text: the king became very distressed when he heard what she asked for, because he knew john was a very righteous man or, because he now knew that he should not have made that promise to her. but he could not refuse what she requested because he had promised that he would give her anything she asked for, and because his guests had heard him promise that.
target_text: ropa herodes tadèngi nare lii manèngi ana bhèni na, ka d'ara na cag'ag'a. te ngaa nèngu bisa heka ère hari lii subha nèngu deo na, lula dhèu ètu sèra tadèngi aa'i le.

source_text: so the king at once ordered the man who executes prisoners to go and cut off john's head and bring it to the girl. that man went to the prison and cut off john's head.
target_text: èle èèna ka, herodes paredha komedhaa sordad'u lasi poro rare kètu yohanis nèti d'ara bèdho.

source_text: he put it on a platter, brought it back, and gave it to the girl. the girl took it to her mother.
target_text: ropa ra poro rare, ra tao asa d'ara dula èci, ka rèti la'a asa ana bhèni èèna. na sèmi nare, hèia nèti asa ina na la'e.

source_text: after john's disciples heard what happened, they went to the prison and took john's body and then they buried it in a burial cave.
target_text: ropa ana madhutu yohanis sèra tadèngi ra poro rèti le kètu yohanis, rèngu mai nedhe rèti ngi'u nèngu lasi padhane. d'ai sange ne'e ka, lii lolo mamadhe yohanis.

source_text: the twelve apostles returned to jesus from the places to which they had gone. they reported to him what they had done and what they had taught to people.
target_text: ca lod'o hari, ana madhutu yesus dhu na pua lasi asa rae-rae ho aj'a dhèu j'ara mamuri ama lamatua sèra, lèpa hari mai, ka ra pakaboko hari dènge ne. ra lolo dènge yesus ngaa dhu rèngu tao dènge aj'a mi dhèu.

source_text: he said to them, come with me to a place where no people are living, in order that we can be alone and rest a little while! he said this because many people were continually coming to them and going away again, with the result that jesus and his disciples did not have time to eat or do anything else.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ae mai patangi-tenge yesus. lula dhèu ae seli eele, ka yesus dènge ana madhutu na abhu boe tebho ra'a-rinu hèi. nèti èèna ka, yesus ale dènge ana madhutu sèra, peka na, be'a risi èdhi pakèd'i nèti era ne'e lati tenge era èci dhu mau, sèna ka èdhi ae tara ciki.

source_text: so they went away by themselves in a boat to a place where no people were living.
target_text: ka ra ca'e koha cue lasi asa era dhu mau, kaj'èu nèti d'ara rae.

source_text: but many people saw them leaving. they also recognized that they were jesus and the disciples, and they saw where they were going. so they ran ahead on land from all the nearby towns to the place where jesus and his disciples were going. they actually arrived there before jesus and the disciples.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu ae ètu sèra sa, ladhe rèdhi koha rèngu kako re sebhe dano. hèia ra kalua nèti rae ka kako pamèri madhutu re dedha rai. nèti èèna ka, rèngu d'ai uuru yesus si.

source_text: as jesus and his disciples got out of the boat, jesus saw this large crowd. he felt sorry for them because they were confused, like sheep that do not have a shepherd. so he taught them many things.
target_text: ropa yesus puru nèti dedha koha, ladhe laa, na, dhèu ae dhu mate ne. dhèu se'e re'a heka tao iisi ra tasamia. nèti èèna ka, d'ara yesus sue si, te rèngu sama sèmi kahib'i-kalèbho dhu dènge boe ana madhenga. èle èèna ka, na aj'a si j'ara mamuri ama lamatua.

source_text: late in the afternoon, the disciples came to him and said, this is a place where no people live and it is very late. so send the people away in order that they may go to the surrounding farms and villages in order that they can buy for themselves something to eat!
target_text: na aj'a nèti loo nètu, toke d'ai nihia la'e. hèia ana madhutu na sèra mai padhue dènge ne, aku rèngu na, ama! hua iia ama ku pua si lasi hèli nganga'a ètu rae dhu dètu ètu era se'e. te oe mèda kèna, aa ètu era ne'e nganga'a aad'o.

source_text: but he replied, no, you yourselves give them something to eat! they replied, ◄we could not buy enough bread to feed this crowd, even if we had as much money as a man earns by working 200 days! /how could we buy enough bread to feed this mob, even if we had as much money as a man earns by working 200 days? ► rhq
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala lii rèngu, aku nèngu na, baku tao sèmi èèna! hud'i laa, pe miu panga'a si. hèia ra karèi hari ne, ira, ee! ladhe èdhi panga'a dhèu ae sèmi ne'e, èdhi kalua doi ae bia, nga. sama sèmi gaji tuka ca tèu kateme, nga! aa èdhi tare doi sèra, nèti mia hua kèna!

source_text: but he replied to them, how many loaves of bread do you have? go and find out! they went and found out and then they told him, we have only five flat loaves and two cooked fish!
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, miu lami karèi sèku dhèu sèra, teko cee dhu nèti nganga'a mèra. hèia ra lasi karèi, ka mai peka dènge ne, abhu dhoka roti lèmi bua, dènge i'a dua ngi'u di.

source_text: he instructed the disciples to tell all the people to sit down on the green grass.
target_text: hèia yesus pua dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra ho madhèdi cakaboko-cakaboko ètu dedha j'u'u.

source_text: so the people sat in groups. there were 50 people in some groups and 100 people in other groups.
target_text: dhèu se'e madhèdi sèmi dhu yesus pua. abhu kaboko dhu dhèu cangasu-cangasu, aa abhu kaboko dhu dhèu lèmi nguru-lèmi nguru.

source_text: jesus took the five flat loaves and the two fish. he looked up towards heaven and thanked god for them. then he broke the loaves and fish into pieces and kept giving them to the disciples in order that they would distribute them to the people.
target_text: hèia yesus nare roti lèmi bua dènge i'a dua ngi'u sèra, ka na ladhe asa dedha. na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. èle èèna ka, nare roti lèmi bua, ka na ku'u pamae ca'èta-'èta. hèia na hia mi ana madhutu na, ho lasi papala hia dhèu dhu madhèdi sèra. na pala-bagi i'a dua ngi'u sèra kahèi.

source_text: everyone ate this food until they all had enough to eat!
target_text: ka dhèu sèra ra'a toke bècu.

source_text: the disciples then collected twelve baskets full of pieces of bread and of the fish that were left over.
target_text: ra'a èle, hèia ana madhutu na sèra lasi pakaboko nganga'a dhu risi eele sèra, pènu canguru dua soe.

source_text: there were approximately 5, 000 men who ate the bread and fish. they did not even count the women and children.
target_text: dhèu dhu ra'a sèra, dhèu mone di, lèmi riho dhèu, ige mèka bhèni dènge ana iiki.

source_text: right away jesus told his disciples to get into the boat and then go ahead of him to bethsaida town, which was further around lake galilee. he stayed and dismissed the many people who were there.
target_text: èle ka, yesus pua ana madhutu sèra pakèd'i uuru dènge koha asa rae betsaida ètu cabèka dano. te nèngu dhae la'e mèka, ho na pua dhèu ae sèra lèpa.

source_text: after he said goodbye to the people, he went up into the hills in order to pray.
target_text: ropa dhèu sèra lèpa, na la'e asa ledhe èci ètu èèna, ho na manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: when it was evening, the disciples' boat was in the middle of the lake and jesus was by himself on the land. he saw that the wind was blowing against them as they rowed. as a result, they were having great difficulty. he approached them early in the morning, when it was still dark, by walking on the water. he intended to walk by them. they saw him walking on the water, but they thought that he was a ghost. they screamed because they all were terrified when they saw him. but he talked to them. he said to them, be calm! do not be afraid, because it is i!
target_text: lod'o mèda le, ka yesus puru mai. na ladhe nèdhi ana madhutu na sèra dènge koha lasi d'ai talora dano le. lula ngèlu madha mèdhu ae, ka ra tuku koha d'ai madhe. d'ara oe mèu sa, yesus heka la'e madhutu si kèna. te ngaa na kako re dedha èi. ropa na kako oe seli koha ra, ana madhutu sèra ladhe rèdhi ne, ka ra madha'u titu kèna. hèia èci karèi èci, aku rèngu na, irii! ngaa nèi? nidhu, do? hèia yesus lii dènge si, aku nèngu na, we! miu baku madha'u! te ja'a ne!

source_text: he got into the boat and sat down with them and the wind immediately stopped blowing. they were completely amazed about what he had done.
target_text: ropa yesus ca'e la'e asa dedha koha, kabèdhi laa, ngèlu mau dènge. ana madhutu na sèra malaa bia.

source_text: although they had seen jesus multiply the bread and the fish, they did not understand from that how powerful he was, as they should have. they did not think clearly about it.
target_text: rèngu heka rèdhi kèna, yesus pake koasa na, lod'o panga'a lèmi riho dhèu èèna. te ngaa rèngu re'a iia boe koasa yesus, lula d'ara rèngu adhu sèmi hadhu.

source_text: after they went further around lake galilee in a boat, they came to the shore at gennesaret town. then they tied up the boat there.
target_text: ropa rèngu d'ai cabèka dano, ra panahu koha ètu dae genesaret.

source_text: as soon as they got out of the boat, the people there recognized jesus.
target_text: ropa ra puru nèti dedha koha, dhèu ae ladhe rèdhi si. ka ra rodhe lème, aku rèngu na, ee! yesus mai le!

source_text: so they ran throughout the whole district in order to tell others that jesus was there. then the people placed those who were sick on stretchers and carried them to any place where they heard people say that jesus was. in whatever village, town or other place where he entered, they would bring to the marketplaces those who were sick. then the sick people would beg jesus to let them touch him or even the edge of his clothes in order that jesus might heal them. all those who touched him or his robe were healed.
target_text: dhèu sèra aa'i-aa'i ra lasi peka palème rae, nèti èèna ka, dhèu mai nèti mia-mia, jèru rèti a'ari rèngu dhu pèd'a asa yesus. sad'i ra tadèngi yesus ètu era èci, na, rame-rame nedhe rèti dhèu pèd'a mai. ra paj'unu si ètu d'ara tana lapa ètu èèna. te ra pangee, na, sad'i dhèu pèd'a sèra goi lèke sebhe kodho yesus di, èle dènge nèti papèd'a ra. ka dhèu goi lèke kodho na, hèia èle nèti papèd'a ra.

source_text: one day some pharisees and some men who teach the jewish laws gathered around jesus. they had come from jerusalem to investigate him.
target_text: ca lod'o, dhèu partei agama parisi canau dènge mese-mese agama mai nèti kota yerusalem neo paraga dènge yesus.

source_text: the pharisees and all of the other jews strictly observe the traditions that their ancestors taught. for example, they refuse to eat until they first wash their hands with a special ritual, especially after they return from buying things in the marketplace. they think that god will be angry with them if they do not do that, because some person or thing unacceptable to god might have touched ◄them/the things they bought►. there are many other such traditions that they accept and try to obey. specifically, they wash in a special way their cups, pots, kettles, containers, and beds in order that using these things will not make god reject them. that day, those pharisees and men who taught the jewish laws saw that some of his disciples were eating food with hands that they had not washed using the special ritual. so they questioned jesus, saying, your disciples disobey the traditions of our ancestors! ◄you should not let them eat food if they have not washed their hands using our special ritual! /why do you let them eat food if they have not washed their hands using our special ritual? ► rhq
target_text: dhèu parisi kèpe pa'èra ad'a yahudi. nuka sèmi, dhèu neo ra'a-rinu hud'i j'amo uuru ku kacui-aai madhutu atora ad'a. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe lèpa nèti d'ara pasa, hud'i diu uuru ku èi. toke mèdha dapu rèngu sèmi èru-pangala, pega, curu, galaa, cere, hud'i rase uuru ku madhutu atora ad'a, heka bisa pake ra'a-rinu kèna. ladhe dhèu yahudi cahag'e madhutu boe ad'a rèngu sèmi èèna, dhèu parisi nasa. nèti èèna ka, ra nasa ropa rèdhi ana madhutu yesus sèra ra'a-rinu j'amo boe kacui-aai madhutu atora ad'a rèngu. ka rèngu mai pasala yesus, peka na, nga tao ka ana madhutu èu se ra'a-rinu j'amo uuru boe kacui-aai? sèra sa, pasala dènge ad'a nèti bèi-baki èdhi!

source_text: jesus said to them, isaiah rebuked your ancestors, and his words describe very well you people who only pretend to be good! he wrote these words that god said: these people speak as if they honor me, but they syn really do not think about honoring me at all. it is useless for them to worship me, because they teach only what people have commanded as if i myself had commanded them.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, miu se mema padhai lii leo, tao leo! nèti uru nèka mai yesaya suri tèke le, lii padhai lii ama lamatua sèmi ne'e, ‘abhu dhèu dhu koa-kio kolongara ja'a, dhoka dènge hèb'a di, te ngaa nèti boe d'ara. tatao rèngu sèmi èèna na, lèke boe. rèngu pusi-pahae boe dad'èi ja'a, te ngaa rèngu madhutu dhoka atora dhèu rai-haha di. ' miu èci èèna kahèi.

source_text: you, like your ancestors, refuse to do what god has commanded. instead, you follow only the traditions that ◄others/your ancestors► have taught. jesus also said to them, you think iro that you are clever in refusing to do what god commanded just so that you can obey your own traditions!
target_text: miu tèke eele le paredha ama lamatua, ho madhutu atora dhèu rai-haha. tatao miu ne, d'èlu-mèu bia!

source_text: for example, our ancestor moses wrote god's command, ‘honor your fathers and your mothers'. he also wrote, ‘the authorities must execute a person who speaks evil about his father or mother. '
target_text: karèi nèti uuru èèna, musa peka le lii paredha ama lamatua sèmi ne'e ka, ‘pakab'ua ina-ama miu. ' aa tabha hari, peka na, ‘ladhe ana èci padhèda ama na, do ina na, hud'i ra huku pamadhe ne. '

source_text: but you teach people that it is all right that people no longer must help their parents. you teach people that it is all right if people give their things to god instead of giving them to their parents. you allow them to say to their parents, ‘what i was going to give to you to provide for you, i have now promised to give to god. so i cannot any longer help you! ' as a result, you are actually telling people that they no longer have to help their parents!
target_text: ama lamatua aj'a sèmi èèna, te ngaa miu aj'a leo. miu peka na, ‘ladhe dhèu èci pamoa le neo hia ngaa èci mi ama lamatua, masi ka ina dènge ama na j'èra oe madhe èèna ka, te ngaa pake boe mèdha èèna ho soru-bara si, lula nèngu moa le neo hia mi lamatua. '

source_text: and, by doing that, you disregard what god commanded! you teach your own traditions to others and tell them strongly that they should obey them and you do many other things like that.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, deo na ja'a peka le, miu pake heka dad'èi ama lamatua, te ngaa miu gati eele dènge atora miu dhu hiu. atora ae le dhu miu gati eele sèmi èèna.

source_text: then jesus again summoned the crowd to come closer. then he said to them figuratively, all of you people listen to me! try to understand dou what i am about to tell you.
target_text: hèia yesus paroa hari dhèu leo ètu sèra, ka na peka na, pasa dhilu ho nanene paie, sèna ka miu me'a.

source_text: nothing that people eat causes god to consider them to be unacceptable. on the contrary, it is that which comes from people's ◄inner beings/hearts► that causes god to reject them.
target_text: ngaa dhu maso asa d'ara d'èlu, pakaj'alu boe. te ngaa dhu kalua mai nèti d'ara, èèna ka dhu pakaj'alu dhèu. cee dènge ro'a dhilu, na, nanene.

source_text: after jesus had left the crowd and then entered a house with the disciples, they asked him about the parable that he had just spoken.
