target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu mone tèke eele ina-ama na, ho mamuri d'ara èci dènge dhèu èmu na,

source_text: instead, the two of them shall live together, and they shall become so closely united met that they are like one person. ' therefore, although the people who marry were two separate persons before, god regards them as one person now, so he wants them to remain married.
target_text: sèna ka dua ra j'aj'i mi èci. '

source_text: because that is true, a man must not separate from his wife whom god has joined to him, because god's plan is for them to remain together!
target_text: ladhe lamatua pa'èci le rèngu dua ra, dhèu rai-haha baku pacèri eele si!

source_text: when jesus and his disciples were alone in a house, they asked him again about this.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na lasi mesa ra asa d'ara èmu cue. ètu èèna, rèngu karèi ne lii aj'a deo sa.

source_text: he said to them, god considers that a marriage lasts until either the husband or the wife dies, so he considers that any man who divorces his wife and marries another woman is committing adultery, even if he divorces his first wife.
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, dhèu mone cee dhu ia eele dhèu èmu na, ho na madhèdi hari dènge dhèu bhèni leo, nèngu bersina.

source_text: god also considers a woman who divorces her first husband to be committing adultery if she marries another man.
target_text: èci èèna ka, dènge dhèu bhèni. ladhe nèngu ia eele dhèu èmu na, ho na leo hari dènge mone leo, nèngu bersina kahèi.

source_text: one day, some people were bringing children to jesus in order that he would touch and bless them. but the disciples scolded those people because they thought that jesus ◄did not want to be bothered spending time with/was not concerned about► children.
target_text: ca tèka, dhèu rèti ana-ana rèngu asa yesus. ra manèngi sèna ka yesus sabaj'a hia si, ho hia lii mèngi-nale. te ngaa ana madhutu yesus kai dhèu sèra.

source_text: when jesus saw that, he became angry. he said to the disciples, allow the children to come to me! do not forbid them dou! it is people who are humble and trust as they do who can experience ◄god's rule in their lives/god taking care of them► met.
target_text: yesus ladhe nèdhi sèmi èèna, ka na nasa dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, hud'i laa ana iiki sèra mai asa ja'a. baku magee si. te dhèu sèmi sèra ka dhu j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua.

source_text: note this: those who do not trustingly allow god to direct their lives, as children do, will not enter the place where god rules.
target_text: miu sanèd'e paie! dhèu cee dhu neo mai asa katanga-madha lamatua, d'ara na kateme hud'i d'èi paraga dènge ne, èci èèna ka ana iiki dhu d'ara d'èi paraga dènge ina-ama ra. ladhe sèmi boe èèna, rèngu bisa boe j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua.

source_text: then he embraced the children. he also put his hands on them and asked god to bless them.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus liku nare ana iiki se, ka na tao kacui-aai na mi dedha kètu ana iiki se èci-èci, ho na hia si lii mamèngi.

source_text: as jesus was starting to travel again with his disciples, a young man ran up to him. he knelt before jesus and then he asked him, good teacher, what must i do to have eternal life/in order to live with god eternally?
target_text: ropa yesus si neo pakèd'i, dhèu kaja èci rai mai neo paraga dènge ne. hèia na pacud'u ètu madha yesus, ka na karèi ne, aku nèngu na, ama mese dhu hua iia! ja'a neo karèi ciki. ja'a tao tasamia, sèna ka ja'a ke'a tare'a-re'a, na, ja'a ne maso sorga ho mamuri taruu pa'èci dènge ama lamatua?

source_text: jesus said to him, ◄you should consider carefully what you are implying or, that you are implying that i am god by calling me good, because only god is good! /do you realize what you are implying or, that you are implying that i am god by calling me good, because only god is good? ► rhq no other person is good
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, nga tao ka èu ne peka na, ja'a ne ‘hua iia'? dhèu rai-haha ne èci sa dhu hua iia boe. dhoka ama lamatua di dhu hua iia.

source_text: but to answer your question, you know the commandments of moses, which will cause you to live eternally if you obey them perfectly. he commanded things such as ‘do not murder anyone, do not commit adultery, do not steal, do not ◄testify falsely/lie►, do not cheat anyone, and honor your father and mother'.
target_text: èu me'a le, lii paredha ama lamatua sèra nèti uru ka, dhu peka na: ‘baku pamadhe dhèu; baku tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu-kamali boe èu; baku mana'u; baku j'aj'i sakasii kapod'e-kabèli; baku monya ho parame more mèdha-panyau dhèu; aa pakab'ua ina-ama èu. '

source_text: the man said to him, teacher, i have obeyed all those commandments ever since i was young. so is ◄that enough/there something else that i have not done►?
target_text: dhèu èèna dhaa, peka na, tare'a, ama mese! nèti ana ngèru ka mai, ja'a madhutu le lii paredha sèra aa'i-aa'i si.

source_text: jesus looked at him and loved him. he said to him, there is one thing that you have not yet done. you must go home, sell all that you possess, and then give the money to poor people. as a result, you will be spiritually rich in heaven. after you have done what i have told you, come with me and be my disciple!
target_text: yesus rasa kasia dènge dhèu ne'e, hèia na peka, tare'a! te ngaa j'ara èci era. lèpa ka asa èmu èu, lamu pahia aa'i su'i-kakaja èu. kab'ua na lamu pala-bagi mi dhèu dhu unu boe ngaa-ngaa. èle èèna, heka mai kèna, ho madhutu ja'a. pe bèli-camèd'a lamatua pala-bagi hia èu hari kakaja-sasu'i dhu leo ètu sorga.

source_text: the man became disappointed when he heard that. he went away sad, because he was very rich and he did not want to give away everything.
target_text: ropa dhèu ne tadèngi nare lii padhai lii yesus èèna, d'ara na laho mae-mae. la'e ka èmu dènge d'ara dhu pèd'a bia, lula nèngu dhèu kaja tare'a.

source_text: jesus looked around at the people. then he exclaimed to his disciples, it is very difficult for people who are wealthy to decide to let god rule their lives!
target_text: hèia yesus ladhe la'e-mai, aa peka dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, mi nanene! dhèu kaja carui titu kèna maso sorga!

source_text: the disciples were surprised at what he said. they thought that god favored the rich people, so if god did not save them, he would not save anyone. so jesus replied again to them, my dear friends, it is very difficult for anyone to decide to let god rule his life.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare lii padhai lii yesus èèna, ana madhutu na bingu. ka yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, mi nanene paie! mema carui ladhe dhèu neo j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua. baku ngee èèna mud'a!

source_text: it is impossible for a camel to go through the eye of a needle. it is almost as difficult hyp for rich people to decide to let god rule their lives.
target_text: dhèu kaja maso sorga ho j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua, sama carui dènge badha onta ci'u dhu kapai maso asa oka na re ro'a j'aj'au.

source_text: the disciples were very astonished. so they said to each other, if that is so, ◄it will be unlikely that anyone will be saved {that god will save anyone}! /will god save anyone? ► rhq
target_text: lii padhai lii yesus ne asa pamalaa dhèu se'e aa'i-aa'i si. ka ra pakarèi, peka na, ladhe tare'a sèmi èèna, cee ka dhu bisa abhu mamuri dènge ama lamatua?

source_text: jesus looked at them and then he said, yes, it is impossible for people to save themselves! but god certainly can save them, because god can do anything!
target_text: ka yesus ladhe si èci-èci, hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, madhutu dhèu rai-haha, na, carui. te ngaa baku bhèlu, madhutu ama lamatua, aa'i-aa'i bisa j'aj'i.

source_text: peter exclaimed, you know that we have left behind everything and we have become your disciples. so, ◄what about us/will god <accept us/reward us>►?
target_text: èle èèna ka, petrus padhai lii, peka na, ama, ji'i tèke eele le ngaa-ngaa dhu j'aj'i unu ji'i, ho madhutu èu. de ji'i abhu bab'ala na ngaa?

source_text: jesus replied, i want you to know this: those who have left their houses, their brothers, their sisters, their father, their mother, their children, or their plots of ground, to be my disciples and to proclaim the good news, will receive in this life 100 times as much as they left behind. that will include houses and people as dear as brothers and sisters and mothers and children, and plots of ground. furthermore, although people will persecute them here on earth because they believe in me, in the future age they will ◄have eternal life/live with god eternally►.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, ja'a neo peka dènge miu sèmi ne'e: dhèu dhu madhutu ja'a, aa tèke eele ina-ama na, a'ari na, ana-èpu na, oka-tedhe na, sasab'a-la'a na, dènge isi èmu aa'i-aa'i, ho la'e peka-padhai lii lolo be'a ama lamatua mi dhèu ètu mia-mia, lèpa loo limuri, nèngu abhu hari ngaa-ngaa sèra, d'ai cangasu hari. aa'i-aa'i dhu nèngu tèke eele sèra, èèna na nèngu abhu risi hari. aa nèngu abhu j'aj'èra kahèi, lula madhutu ja'a. te ngaa ladhe d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne, nèngu mamuri taruu pa'èci dènge ama lamatua. bab'ala nèngu, sèmi èèna ka.

source_text: but i warn you all: many of you who now consider yourselves to be very important will be unimportant at that future time, and many of you who now consider yourselves to be unimportant will be very important at that future time!
target_text: sanèd'e paie! dhèu dhu padedha iisi, madhutu ngangee ama lamatua, limuri mai nèngu j'aj'i dhèu haha d'ai seli. te ngaa dhèu dhu ngee, na, nèngu dhèu haha di, madhutu ngangee ama lamatua, limuri mai nèngu j'aj'i dhèu kapai.

source_text: some days later as they continued to travel, jesus and his disciples were walking on the road that leads up to jerusalem city. jesus was walking ahead of them. the disciples/apostles were astonished that he was going to where there were many people who opposed him, and the other people who were with them were afraid about what would happen to him in jerusalem. along the way he took the twelve disciples to a place by themselves. then he began to tell them again about what was going to happen to him, saying,
target_text: lod'o èèna, yesus dènge ana madhutu na lasi asa kota yerusalem. yesus kako uuru. ana madhutu na dhèu canguru dua dènge dhèu leo dhu kako pa'èci madhutu ne re limuri. rèngu sanèd'e lii padhai dhu yesus peka dènge rèngu uru èèna, peka na, dhèu neo pamadhe ne ètu yerusalem. nèti èèna ka, rèngu bingu dènge madha'u. hèia yesus paroa nare ana madhutu na sèra mesa ra, ho na peka hari dènge rèngu dhèu neo tao ngaa mi dedha nèngu ètu yerusalem.

source_text: listen carefully! we are going up to jerusalem. there the chief priests and the men who teach the jewish laws will be enabled {someone will help the chief priests and those who teach our jewish laws} to seize me. then they will declare that i must die, even though i am the one who came from heaven. then they will take me to the roman authorities.
target_text: yesus peka dènge si, mi nanene! èdhi neo lati asa yerusalem. ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ètu nèi, dhèu neo pahie eele ja'a asa kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra. èle èèna, ra uku-ked'i pamadhe ja'a. ra tule eele ja'a asa dhèu leo dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua.

source_text: those men will ridicule me. they will spit on me. they will ◄scourge me/whip me with a leaded whip. ► then they will kill me. but on the third day after that, i will become alive again!
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra padhai lii pamakae ja'a. ra paru'e ilu mi ja'a. aa ra dhedhe pamae iisi ja'a. èle èèna, heka ra pamadhe ja'a kèna. mema ja'a madhe tare'a. te ngaa d'ai camèda, ja'a mamuri hari.

source_text: along the way, james and john, who were the two sons of zebedee, approached jesus and they said to him, teacher, please do for us what we will ask you to do!
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana sabadeus, nuka yakobis dènge yohanis, mai asa yesus. ka ra manèngi, peka na, ama mese! ji'i neo padhai lii dènge ama ciki.

source_text: he said to them, what do you want me to do for you?
target_text: ka yesus karèi si, miu neo ngaa?

source_text: they said to him, when you rule gloriously, let us rule with you. let one of us sit at your right side and one sit at your left side.
target_text: ra dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e, ama! bèli-camèd'a, ladhe ama mèd'u paredha, ji'i manèngi ama pamadhèdi ji'i dua mi, èci re sebhe g'ana, èci hari re kariu, sèna ka ji'i paredha hèi.

source_text: but jesus said to them, you do not understand what you are asking for. then he asked them, can you endure suffering mty like i am about to suffer? can you endure being killed mty as i will be killed {people killing you as they will kill me}?
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, miu dua mi se me'a boe lii manèngi miu èèna. èèna na, ja'a abhu j'aj'èra ae. de tasamia? miu ngee, na, miu se bisa pasae j'aj'èra dènge ja'a toke madhe, do?

source_text: they said to him, yes, we are able to do that! then jesus said to them, it is true that you will endure suffering mty like i will suffer, and you will endure being killed as i will be killed {people killing you as they will kill me}.
target_text: ka ra dhaa, peka na, ji'i bisa, ama! ka yesus b'ala, peka na, mema, èèna na, miu pasae j'aj'èra kahèi, sama sèmi ja'a.

source_text: but i am not the one who chooses the ones who will sit next to me and rule with me. god will give those places to the ones he appoints.
target_text: te ngaa cee dhu madhèdi re sebhe g'ana, do sebhe kariu ja'a, èèna hak ja'a aad'o. te dhu hak ka ama lamatua dhu pama'ète mema le, na, cee-cee ka dhu madhèdi ètu era sèra.

source_text: the other ten disciples later heard about what james and john had requested. as a result, they were angry with them because they also wanted to rule with jesus in the highest positions.
target_text: ropa ana madhutu dhu leo sèra tadèngi lii manèngi yakobis dènge yohanis sèmi èèna, ka ra nasa bia.

source_text: then, after jesus called them all together, he said to them, you know that those who rule the non-jews enjoy showing that they are powerful. you also know that officials enjoy commanding others.
target_text: hèia yesus paroa aa'i-aa'i si, ka na peka, aku nèngu na, miu me'a le, sina ma? dhèu-dhèu kapai dhu rèd'u paredha j'eli ana kabarai sèna ka rèngu bisa boe kalau-karèto. dhèu kapai kabarai dhu tadhe boe lamatua hia paredha risi eele, ka ana kabarai bisa heka doa kètu.

source_text: but do not be like them! on the contrary, all those among you who want god to consider them great must become like servants to the rest of you.
target_text: te ngaa miu baku tao sèmi èèna! nèti talora miu, cee dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu kapai, nèngu hud'i j'aj'i ku ana pua-paleha ho lalau dhèu leo.

source_text: furthermore, if anyone among you wants god to consider him to be the most important, he must act like a servant for the rest of you.
target_text: cee dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu kapai, nèngu hud'i tao ngi'u na sama sèmi ènu.

source_text: you should imitate me. even though i am the one who has come from heaven, i did not come to be served {for others to serve me}. on the contrary, i came in order to serve others and to allow others to kill me, in order that my dying for people would be like a payment to rescue many people from being punished {god punishing them} for their sins.
target_text: ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ja'a mai hia boe dhèu lalau-lalo'o ja'a. te ngaa ja'a mai ho lalau-lalo'o dhèu ae, dènge hia mamuri ja'a ho sui kore dhèu ae nèti koasa sasala-sasigo rèngu.

source_text: on the way to jerusalem, jesus and the disciples came to jericho town. afterwards, while they were leaving jericho along with a great crowd, a blind man who habitually begged for money was sitting beside the road. his name was bartimaeus and his father's name was timaeus.
target_text: yesus dènge ana madhutu na, dènge dhèu ae titu kèna kako lasi kota jeriko. ropa rèngu neo kako taruu, dhèu bèdhu èci madhèdi ètu sebhe j'ara, na kanata ai ho manèngi ngaa-ngaa nèti dhèu dhu kako re èèna. ngara na bartimeos, ana nèti timeos.

source_text: when he heard people say that jesus from nazareth was passing by, he shouted, jesus! you who are the messiah descended from king david, ◄be merciful to/help► me!
target_text: ropa na tadèngi dhèu dhu kako mai sèra, yesus nèti rae nasaret na kahèi, ka na rodhe, peka na, yesus! ana-èpu daud, ee! ji'i mate èu nèbhu ae le! sue ku ja'a laa!

source_text: many people rebuked him and told him that he should be quiet. but he shouted even more, you who are the messiah descended from king david, ◄be merciful to/help► me!
target_text: ropa ra nanene lii rodhe na, hèia dhèu sèra jèke ne, aku rèngu na, èu mau-mau ku laa! te ngaa na rodhe asa aae, peka na, yesus! ana-èpu daud, ee! sue ku ja'a laa!

source_text: jesus stopped and said, call him to come over here! they summoned the blind man, saying, jesus is calling you! so cheer up and get up and come!
target_text: hèia yesus titu taha, ka na peka, mèti ku na mai sa ne'e! ka ra lasi peka dènge dhèu bèdhu èèna, peka na, èu mau-mau ka laa! te ama mese paroa èu nèi. de mai lati ka!

source_text: he threw aside his cloak as he jumped up, and he came to jesus.
target_text: ropa nanene nare, ka bartimeos pèci eele sig'i kalolo na, hèia na kèd'i titu la'e paraga dènge yesus.

source_text: jesus asked him, what do you want me to do for you? the blind man said to him, sir, i want to be able to see again!
target_text: ka yesus karèi ne, peka na, èu parluu ngaa? dhèu bèdhu ne dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama, ee! ja'a manèngi ho ja'a bisa kèdhi.

source_text: jesus said to him, i am healing you because you believed in me. so you may go home! he could see immediately. and he went with jesus along the road.
target_text: yesus peka hari dènge ne, lula èu parcaya, ja'a bisa tao paie musi madha èu. ne'e ne kahèi musi madha èu èle dènge! de lamu ka! ka musi madha bartimeos èle dènge. èle ka la'e madhutu yesus.

source_text: when they came near to jerusalem, they came to bethphage and bethany villages near olive tree hill. then jesus summoned two of his disciples.
target_text: ropa ra dètu dènge kota yerusalem, ka ra dhuli uuru dua rae, ngara na betfage dènge betania, ètu sebhe ledhe saitun. ètu èèna, yesus si mate ciki oo'e di. ka na pua ana madhutu na dhèu dua lasi uuru.

source_text: he said to them, go to that village just ahead of you. as soon as you enter it, you will see a donkey that no one has ever ridden, that has been tied {people have tied} up. untie it, and then bring it to me.
target_text: na pua si, peka na, miu dua mi lami uuru asa d'ara rae nèi. ropa miu maso lami, miu mèdhi ana badha keled'ei ci'u, dhu ra èki ètu èèna, dhu dhèu dhae manya'e mèka. lami ho lècu eele dhari a'èki na, ho ère mèti mai asa ne'e.

source_text: if anyone says to you, ‘why are you doing that? ', say, ‘jesus, our lord, needs to use it. he will send it back here with someone as soon as he no longer needs it. '
target_text: te ngaa ladhe dhèu karèi miu, ‘nga tao ka miu ère mèti ana keled'ei ne? ' mi peka dènge si, ‘lamatua ji'i neo pake ne. ladhe pake nare, na, na hia hari mai. '

source_text: so the two disciples went and they found the young donkey. it was tied close to the door of a house, which was beside the street. then they untied it.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana madhutu na dhèu dua sèra lasi, ka rèdhi ana keled'ei ci'u dhu èki tèke ètu madha èmu cue ètu sebhe j'ara. ra lècu eele dhari èki na, ka ra ère rèti mai.

source_text: some of the people who were there said to them, why are you untying the donkey?
target_text: ka dhèu-dhèu dhu titu ètu èèna, peka na, we! nga tao ka miu pakako mèti keled'ei dhèu?

source_text: they told them what jesus had said. so the people permitted them to take the donkey.
target_text: ka ra dhaa, peka na, lamatua ji'i neo pake ne. ho ladhe na pake nare, na, ji'i ngèti hari mai. ka dhèu sèra soro tèke si lasi pakako rèti ana keled'ei èèna.

source_text: they brought the donkey to jesus. the disciples put some of their clothes on it in order to make something for him to sit on.
target_text: hèia ra rèti ana keled'ei èèna asa yesus. ka ra hèle sig'i-kalolo rèngu mi dedha keled'ei, ka yesus manya'e.

source_text: many people spread their cloaks on the road to honor him as a king. others, in order to honor him, spread along the road branches that they cut from palm trees in the fields beside the road.
target_text: ropa oe maso d'ara kota, ka dhèu ae rare sig'i-kalolo, ka ra hèle mi dedha j'ara oka-hoo. dhèu cahag'e lasi para rèu palam ètu sebhe j'ara, ho ra tao mi talora j'ara oka-hoo. tatao sèmi èèna na, sama sèmi tadha èci dhu peka na, rèngu pakab'ua yesus.

source_text: the people who were going in front of him and behind him were all shouting things like, praise god! may god bless this one who comes ◄with his authority/as his representative► mty.
target_text: dhèu cahag'e kako uru ètu madha yesus; aa cahag'e kako limuri. ka ra pa'oo, peka na, hosana! mai ti koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua! lamatua hia berkat mi dhèu dhu mai pake kolongara na, lula ama lamatua hia ne mai!

source_text: may you be blessed {may god bless you} when you rule like our ancestor king david ruled! praise god who is in the highest heaven!
target_text: hosana! mai ti koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua! lula lamatua neo pakèd'i hari paredha dhèu aae daud! hosana! mai ti koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua! lula lamatua madhèdi nèd'u paredha ètu era dedha risi eele!

source_text: he entered jerusalem with them, and then he went into the temple courtyard. after he looked around at everything there, he left the city because it was already late in the afternoon. he returned to bethany with the twelve disciples and slept there.
target_text: ropa ra d'ai d'ara kota, ka yesus si maso asa madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ka yesus ladhe palème era èmu èèna. te ngaa, lula lod'o nihia ae le, ka ra lèpa hari asa rae betania.

source_text: the next day, as jesus and his disciples were leaving bethany, jesus was hungry.
target_text: asa bèli mad'ae aae èèna, ka rèngu kalua nèti betania lasi asa yerusalem. d'ai talora j'ara ka yesus manganga.

source_text: he saw from a distance a fig tree with all its leaves, so he went to it to see if he could find any figs on it. but when he came to it, he found only leaves on it. this was because it was not yet time when normal fig trees have ripe figs.
target_text: ka na ladhe nèdhi ana aaj'u èci ètu sebhe j'ara. hua aj'u na, dhu dhèu ra'a. yesus la'e padètu ho neo ne'a aj'u na, hua do aad'o. na ladhe aj'u èèna hua boe cue sa. te mema d'ai mèka hèru hua. rèu heka mare kèna.

source_text: but to illustrate how god would punish the nation of israel, he said to the tree, no one shall ever eat from you again because you will no longer bear figs. the disciples heard what he said.
target_text: ka yesus peka mi aj'u èèna, lula èu hia boe ja'a hua, mulai ti deo ne'e, èu bisa heka hia hua èu asa dhèu leo! ana madhutu yesus sèra tadèngi na padhai lii dènge nasa sèmi èèna.

source_text: jesus and his disciples went back to jerusalem. he entered the temple courtyard. he saw people who were selling and buying animals for sacrifices. they were spoiling the place of worship. he chased those people from the temple courtyard. he also overturned the tables of those who were giving temple tax money in exchange for roman coins. he overturned the seats of the men who were selling doves for sacrifices,
target_text: yesus si kako taruu asa yerusalem, d'ai nèi ka yesus maso asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ètu madha èmu èèna, dhèu tao pasa ho ra pahia koro j'aha dhu biasa dhèu pake tao korban ho ra sabaj'a. ropa yesus nèdhi sèmi èèna, ka na lalèta si asa li'u. na tule eele mei dhu ra pake ho pasilu doi sèra, aa na tule paguri eele bagu dhu ra pake pahia manu-bhui sa.

source_text: and he would not allow anyone who was carrying anything to sell to go through the temple area.
target_text: ka yesus kai si aa'i-aa'i ra, sèna ka ra rèti ia ka mèdha rèngu re d'ara madha èmu èèna.

source_text: then as he taught those people, he said to them, it is written {one of the prophets wrote} in the scriptures that god said, ‘i want my house to be called {people to call my house} a house where people from all nations may pray', but you bandits have made it like a cave where you can hide! ◄you know that! /do you not know that? ► rhq
target_text: ka na aj'a si, peka na, miu me'a le lii dhu dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua suri tèke le, peka na: ‘ja'a tao èmu ne'e, sèna ka suku aa'i-aa'i mai sabaj'a ètu ne'e. ' te ngaa miu tao èmu ne j'aj'i era pakaboko dhèu parapo.

source_text: the chief priests and the men who taught the jewish laws later heard about what he had done. so they planned how they might kill him, but they knew that it would be difficult, because they realized that the crowd was amazed at what he was teaching and they feared that the people would soon decide that jesus had more authority over the temple than they did or, feared what the people would do if they tried to arrest jesus.
target_text: ropa kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra re'a rare tatao yesus sèmi èèna, ka ra nasa dènge ne. ka ra tenge j'ara ho neo pamadhe ne. te ngaa ra madha'u, lula dhèu ae dhu d'èi lii holo-nori yesus.

source_text: that evening, jesus and his disciples left the city and again slept in bethany.
target_text: d'ara lod'o cèna sa, yesus si kalua hari nèti kota yerusalem lèpa lasi j'unu asa rae betania.

source_text: the next morning, while they were going along the road toward jerusalem, they saw that the fig tree that jesus had cursed had withered completely. peter remembered what jesus had said to the fig tree and he exclaimed to jesus, teacher, look! the fig tree that you cursed has withered!
target_text: bèli mad'ae èèna, yesus si lasi hari asa yerusalem. d'ai talora j'ara, ka ra rèdhi aj'u dhu yesus padhai lii med'a na. ka ana madhutu yesus sèra malaa, lula rèngu rèdhi aj'u èèna mango le d'ai amo. hèia petrus sanèd'e lii padhai lii yesus med'a na. ka na peka na, ama! ladhe ku! aj'u dhu ama dhoo med'a na, madhe le!

source_text: jesus replied, you should not be surprised that god did what i asked! you must trust that god will do whatever you ask him to do!
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, tare'a, we! sad'i miu parcaya ama lamatua sèmi èèna, na, j'aj'i kahèi.

source_text: also note this: if anyone says to this hill, ‘be raised up {rise up} and then be thrown {throw yourself} into the lake! ' and if he does not doubt that what he asks for will happen, that is, if he believes that what he asks for will happen, god will do it for him.
target_text: ladhe miu parcaya dènge d'ara kateme, miu bisa pua ledhe hia na pidha asa d'ara dhasi. pe lamatua pidha eele ledhe èèna, sad'i miu baku parcaya dènge d'ara cabèka. miu parcaya mi ama lamatua, hud'i dènge d'ara kateme ku.

source_text: so i tell you, whenever you ask god for something when you pray, believe that you will receive it, and, if you do, god will do it for you.
target_text: baku bhèlu! sad'i miu parcaya dènge d'ara kateme, ngaa dhu miu manèngi, tatu ama lamatua bisa hia miu.

source_text: now, i tell you this also: whenever you are praying, if you have a grudge against people because they have harmed you, forgive them, in order that your father in heaven will likewise forgive your sins.
target_text: ladhe dhèu èci sabaj'a, aa te ngaa na tèka d'ara era dènge dhèu leo, nèngu hud'i la'e pabe'a uuru ku dènge dhèu èèna. ladhe miu tao sèmi èèna, ama miu ètu sorga heka saku eele sasala miu kèna. ladhe abhu nèti miu dhu tèka d'ara dènge dhèu, ho mo'o boe hia abho, na, tatu ama miu ètu sorga no'o boe pabhèlu eele sasala miu kahèi.

source_text: jesus and his disciples arrived in the temple courtyard in jerusalem again. while jesus was walking there, a group consisting of chief priests, some men who taught the jewish laws, and elders came to him and they said to him,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si lasi taruu. ropa d'ai yerusalem, ka ra maso hari asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ropa maso asa madha èmu èèna, kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka yahudi sèra mai,

source_text: by what authority are you doing these things? who authorized you to do things like those you did here yesterday?
target_text: ka ra karèi yesus, peka na, cee ka dhu pua èu mai tao maruru ètu ne'e med'a na? cee ka hia èu hak!

source_text: jesus said to them, i will ask you one question. if you answer me, i will tell you who authorized me to do those things.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a, na, rèngu neo tenge j'ara ho pamanahu ne. ka na b'ala si, peka na, ja'a neo karèi miu kahèi. miu dhaa uuru ku ja'a, heka ja'a dhaa miu kèna.

source_text: did god mty or people authorize john to baptize those who came to him?
target_text: ja'a neo karèi miu sèmi ne'e: miu aa'i-aa'i mi tadhe yohanis, tuka sarani èèna, sina ma? cee ka dhu pua nèngu la'e sarani dhèu? lamatua do, dhèu rai-haha?

source_text: they debated among themselves as to what they should answer. they said to each other, if we say that it was god who authorized him, he will say to us, ‘therefore, ◄you should have believed what john said! /why did you not believe what john said? ► rhq'
target_text: ra pajiko la'e-mai, ka ra padhue, peka na, eea! nara èdhi le! ladhe èdhi dhaa, peka na, ‘ama lamatua ka dhu pua yohanis, ' na b'ala hari, peka na, ‘nga tao ka miu parcaya boe yohanis! '

source_text: on the other hand, if we say that it was people who authorized john, then what will happen to us? they were afraid to say that about where john got his authority, because they knew that the people would be very angry with them. they knew that all the people truly believed that john was a prophet whom god had sent.
target_text: te ngaa èdhi bisa boe peka kahèi, na, ‘dhèu rai-haha dhu pua ne. ' te aad'o na, dhèu ae tao dènge èdhi. lula dhèu ae parcaya, yohanis èèna, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua.

source_text: so they answered jesus, we do not know where john got his authority. then jesus said to them, because you did not answer my question, i will not tell you who authorized me to do those things here yesterday.
target_text: ka ra dhaa, peka na, ji'i nge'a boe! ka yesus dhaa hari si, peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, ja'a ko'o boe peka kahèi, cee ka dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: then jesus told those jewish leaders a parable. he wanted to show what god would do to those who rejected the former prophets and himself. he said, a certain man planted a vineyard. he built a fence around it in order to protect it. he made a stone tank to collect the juice that they would press out of the grapes. he also built a tower for someone to sit in to guard his vineyard. then he leased the vineyard to some men to care for it and to give him some of the grapes in return. then he went away to another country.
target_text: èle ka, yesus padhai lii hari dènge kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a yahudi sèra. ka na lole pake lii upama èci, peka na, dhèu èci la'e tao oka ho neo sèla anggor ètu dedha rai na. ka na tao tedhe reo nare oka èèna, aa tao bak cue ho kanate èi anggor asa d'ara la'e kahèi. hèia na patitu èmu madhenga oka cue dhu dedha. èle èèna ka, na hia dhèu leo seb'a oka èèna, ho ra pabagi èi anggor. hèia na pakèd'i asa rai leo la'e.

source_text: when the time came to harvest the grapes, he sent a servant to the men who were taking care of the vineyard in order to receive from them his share of the grapes that the vineyard had produced.
target_text: lod'o d'ai hèru puu-g'ètu hua anggor, ka lamatua oka pua ana paleha na èci la'e asa dhèu sab'a oka sèra, ho na manèngi pala na.

source_text: but after the servant arrived, they grabbed him and beat him, and they did not give him any fruit. then they sent him away.
target_text: ropa d'ai nèi, ka dhèu seb'a sèra kèpe rare, ka game ne. hèia ra pua ne lèpa dènge ai hua da'u-da'u.

source_text: later the one who owned the vineyard sent another servant to them. but they beat that one on his head, and they insulted him.
target_text: ka lamatua oka pua hari ana paleha leo èci. te ngaa dhèu seb'a sèra dhedhe panu'a kètu na. ka ra pamakae ne, dènge magèle eele ne.

source_text: later he sent another servant. that man they killed. they mistreated many other servants whom he sent. some they beat and some they killed.
target_text: hèia lamatua oka èèna pua hari ana paleha leo èci la'e. te ngaa dhèu seb'a sèra hake pamadhe ne. ra tao samia èèna ka, lamatua oka pua taruu ana paleha na la'e. te ngaa dhèu seb'a sèra game cahag'e, aa pamadhe cahag'e.

source_text: the man still had one other person with him. it was his son. he loved him very much. so, finally he sent his son to them because he thought that they would respect him and give him some of the grapes.
target_text: ate eele dhodhoka ana mone mesa dhu pasue nèti lamatua oka. lula na abhu heka j'ara dhu leo, ka lamatua oka na pua ana d'èlu na la'e. na pajiko, peka na, ‘sèmi ja'a pua ana d'èlu ja'a la'e, na, rèngu sèmi rare dènge be'a, aa ra nanene ne. '

source_text: but when they saw his son coming, those men who were looking after the vineyard said to each other, ‘look! here comes the man who will some day inherit the vineyard! so let's kill him in order that this vineyard will be ours! '
target_text: hèia na pua ana na la'e. ropa dhèu seb'a sèra rèdhi ana na mai, ka ra papeka isi-aanga ra, peka na, ‘we! mi ladhe ku laa! mone heka nèi pua ana d'èlu na mai! ladhe ama na madhe, nèngu ne'e ka dhu sèmi nare aa'i-aa'i mèdha pusaka ama na. de mai ti pamadhe ne, sèna ka èdhi tare pusaka na! '

source_text: they seized him and killed him. then they threw his body outside the vineyard.
target_text: ka aa'i-aa'i ra kèpe, ka ra pamadhe ne, hèia ra core eele ngi'u aae na asa li'u tedhe la'e. lii pakasame ne, d'ai sange ne'e ka.

source_text: so ◄do you know what the man who owns the vineyard will do? /i will tell you what the man who owns the vineyard will do rhq►. he will come, and he will kill those evil men who were taking care of his vineyard. then he will arrange for other people to take care of it.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus karèi dhèu kapai sèra, peka na, madhutu ngangee miu, na, lamatua oka èèna tao dhèu seb'a sèra tasa mera mia? madhutu ngangee ja'a, tatu nèngu mai ho pamadhe aa'i dhèu seb'a sèra, sèna ka na hia dhèu leo hari seb'a oka anggor na.

source_text: now think carefully about these words, which you have read in the scriptures: the men who were building the building rejected one stone. but others put that same stone in its proper place, and it has become the most important stone in the building met!
target_text: èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti baca le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, peka na, ‘abhu hadhu cue dhu tuka hadhu sèra core eele le, te ngaa limuri ne, j'aj'i le hadhu padhèdi.

source_text: the lord has done this, and we marvel as we look at it.
target_text: ama lamatua mesa na dhu pili nare, ka na pamadhèdi hadhu ne. nèti èèna ka, èdhi ladhe, na, be'a titu kèna! '

source_text: then the jewish leaders realized that he was accusing them when he told this story about what those wicked people did. so they wanted to seize him. but they were afraid of what the crowds would do if they did that. so they left him and went away.
target_text: dhèu kapai sèra re'a dènge, na, yesus padhai lii paraga, pake lii pakasame èèna. rèngu sèra sama sèmi dhèu seb'a oka anggor èèna. hèia ra tenge j'ara ho neo kèpe yesus. te ngaa ra madha'u dènge dhèu ae dhu d'èi lii holo-nori yesus. ka ra kako eele ne.

source_text: the jewish leaders sent to jesus some pharisees who thought that the jews should pay only the tax that their own jewish authorities required people to pay. they also sent some members of the party that supported herod antipas and the roman government. they wanted to make jesus say something wrong that would make one of those groups very angry with him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu kapai yahudi se pua pèri-pèri dhèu parisi dènge dhèu nèti partei herodes, lasi pakarèi dènge yesus, ho ra neo sahèdhe ne.

source_text: after they arrived, they said to him deceivingly, teacher, we know that you teach the truth. we also know that you are not concerned about what people say about you, even if an important person does not like what you say. instead, you teach truthfully what god wants us to do. so tell us what you think about this matter: is it right that we pay taxes to the roman government, or not mty? should we pay the taxes, or should we not pay them?
target_text: ka ra karèi ne, peka na, ama mese! ji'i nge'a, na, d'ara ama ku mola, aa d'èi boe kapod'e-kabèli. ama me'a d'ara dhèu. ama peka dad'èi lamatua dènge mola-mola, lula ama pili boe rèhu dhèu. de, ji'i neo karèi ama ku ca j'ara. madhutu atora agama yahudi, èdhi bisa b'ae bea asa dhèu aae kapai dhu paredha roma, do aad'o?

source_text: jesus knew that they did not really want to know what god wanted them to do. so he said to them, ◄i know that you are just trying to make me say something wrong for which you can arrest me. /why are you just trying to make me say something wrong for which you can arrest me? ► rhq but i will answer your question anyway. bring me a coin so that i might ask you something after i look at it.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a le, na, rèngu neo sahèdhe ne, sèna ka na padhai lii lab'a paredha roma. ka yesus b'ala si, peka na, nga tao ka miu neo sahèdhe ja'a dènge lii karèi sèmi èèna! cob'a pad'elo ku mi ja'a doi pudhi cue!

source_text: after they brought him a coin, he asked them, whose picture is on this coin? and whose name is on it? they replied, it is a picture and the name of caesar, the man who rules the roman government.
target_text: ka ra j'ole doi pudhi cue hia ne. hèia yesus nare, ka laladhe. ka na karèi si, peka na, rèhu dènge ngara cee ètu doi pudhi ne? ka ra dhaa, peka na, èèna dhèu aae kapai paredha roma!

source_text: then jesus said to them, that is correct, so give to the government mty what they require, and give to god what he requires. they were frustrated at his answer but amazed at what he said, because they were not able to accuse him of anything because of what he said.
target_text: ka yesus peka, naa, ladhe sèmi èèna, ngaa dhu unu dhèu paredha, hia asa dhèu paredha la'e. te ngaa dhu unu ama lamatua, hia asa ama lamatua la'e. ropa tadèngi rare, lii b'ala na, ka ra malaa, lula yesus peka dhu lèke. nèti èèna ka, dhèu sèra bisa heka sahèdhe ne.

source_text: men who belong to the sadducee sect deny that people become alive again after they die. in order to discredit jesus by ridiculing the idea that people will live again, some of them came to him and asked him,
target_text: abhu partei agama dhu leo èci, ngara na partei saduki. rèngu aj'a, peka na, dhèu madhe bisa heka mamuri. ca tèka, abhu dhèu saduki pèri-pèri mai neo sahèdhe yesus.

source_text: teacher, moses wrote for us jews that if a man who has no children dies, his brother should marry the dead man's widow. then if those two bear children, everyone will consider that those children are the children of the man who died, and in that way the dead man will continue to have descendants.
target_text: ka ra padhai lii dènge yesus, peka na, ama mese! musa suri tèke le hia èdhi atora, peka na: ladhe dhèu mone èci madhe tèke eele dhèu èmu na, te ngaa rèngu dènge boe kolo, na, ari dhèu mone na bisa leo nare hari bhèni balu èèna, sèna ka abhu kolo ho baku pa'ele kolongara a'a na dhu madhe èèna.

source_text: so here is an example. there were seven boys in one family. the oldest one married a woman, but he and his wife did not bear any children. then he later died.
target_text: mema musa aj'a sèmi èèna. te ngaa ji'i neo karèi ama sèmi ne'e: abhu dhèu pidhu dhu pa'a'ari. mone uru leo uuru èmu, te ngaa madhe, abhu mèka kolo.

source_text: the second brother followed this law and married that woman and he, too, did not bear any children. then he later died. the third brother did like his other brothers did. but he also did not bear any children, and later died.
target_text: ka ari na leo nare bhèni balu èèna. nèbhu boe ka ari na madhe, te ngaa abhu boe kolo kahèi. ari na ka tèlu, sèmi èèna kahèi; na leo nare bhèni balu èèna, te ngaa abhu mèka kolo, nèngu madhe.

source_text: eventually all seven brothers married that woman, one by one, but they had no children, and one by one they died. afterwards the woman died, too.
target_text: taruu-taruu sèmi èèna ka, d'ai ana limuri tèka madhe kahèi. nèbhu boe, hèia bhèni balu èèna madhe.

source_text: therefore, if it were true what some people say, that people will become alive again after they die, whose wife do you think that woman will be when people become alive again? ◄keep in mind that she was married to all seven brothers! /she was married to all seven brothers, so how can anyone decide rhq? ►
target_text: naa! ji'i neo karèi ama sèmi ne'e: dhèu bhèni èèna, leo le dènge mone dhèu pidhu! d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne, ho lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu madhe, bhèni ne j'aj'i dhèu èmu cee, nèti dhèu pidhu sèra?

source_text: jesus replied to them, you are certainly wrong rhq. you do not know what they have written in the scriptures about this. you also do not understand god's power to make people alive again.
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, lii karèi miu sèra, tadha, na, miu me'a iia mèka isi sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua! miu me'a boe koasa lamatua kahèi. de miu sala titu kèna!

source_text: that woman will not be the wife of any of them, because when people have become alive again, instead of men having wives and women having husbands, they will be like the angels in heaven, who do not marry.
target_text: mi nanene! sèmi ne'e: ètu sorga dhèu paleo boe èmu. dhèu madhe aa'i-aa'i dhu lamatua pamamuri hari, ra paleo heka èmu. sèmi èèna kahèi, ana pajuu ama lamatua ètu sorga.

source_text: but as to people becoming alive again after they die, in the book that moses wrote, he said something about people who have died that i am sure that you have read rhq. when moses was looking at the bush that was burning, god said to him, ‘i am the god whom abraham worships and the god whom isaac worships and the god whom jacob worships. '
target_text: aa ja'a peka mi miu lula-nèti dhèu madhe mamuri hari, do aad'o. musa suri tèke lula-nèti ana aaj'u dhu ai na'e, te ngaa kèpu boe. miu sanèd'e lii lolo èèna, do aad'o? ropa ai na'e ana aaj'u èèna, ama lamatua peka dènge musa, na, ‘ja'a ne, ama lamatua nèti bèi-baki èu, nuka abraham, isak, dènge yakob. toke d'ai sange ne'e, rèngu aa'i-aa'i manèngi-mangaj'i mi ja'a era. '

source_text: it is not dead people who worship god. it is living people who worship him. abraham, isaac and jacob died long before moses lived, but god said that they were still worshipping him, so we know their spirits were still alive! so your claim that dead people do not become alive again is very wrong.
target_text: èdhi te'a, na, bèi-baki èdhi sèra madhe nèbhu le. te ngaa, lula ama lamatua peka nare le, na, nèngu j'aj'i lamatua rèngu era. nèti èèna ka, èdhi te'a, na, rèngu mamuri hari le. de masi ka dhèu madhe le, te ngaa ra mamuri hari. de dhèu mamuri dhu manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua, te ngaa dhèu madhe aad'o, sina ma? nèti èèna ka, ladhe miu kèpe taruu a'aj'a dhu peka na, dhèu madhe mamuri heka, èèna miu sala ae!

source_text: a man who taught the jewish laws heard their discussion. he knew that jesus answered the question well. so he stepped forward and asked jesus, which commandment is the most important?
target_text: ètu lod'o èèna, abhu mese agama èci dhu nanene yesus padhai lii dènge dhèu nèti partei saduki sèra. madhutu a'abhu mese agama èèna, na, yesus dhaa lèke le lii karèi rèngu. hèia na karèi yesus, peka na, ama! ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: atora ad'a dènge lii paredha agama èdhi ae titu kèna. madhutu a'abhu ama, nèti lii paredha dhu mai nèti musa, mia ka dhu hua iia risi?

source_text: jesus answered, the most important commandment is this: ‘listen, you people of israel! you must worship the lord, our god, our only lord.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, lii paredha dhu hua iia risi, peka sèmi ne'e ka: ‘miu dhèu isra'el aa'i-aa'i mi! mi nanene paie! ama lamatua èèna, mema lamatua èdhi, aa kètu èdhi kahèi. nèngu dhoka mesa na di, lamatua leo aad'o.

source_text: you must show that you love him in all the ways that you live show it in all that you want and feel, in all that you think, and in all that you do! '
