source_text: these words that i am saying to you disciples i am saying to everyone who believes in me: always be ready! that is what jesus warned his disciples.
target_text: de, ngaa dhu ja'a peka dènge miu ne'e, ja'a peka lème dènge dhèu leo kahèi, ‘miu hud'i pajiko paie, ho mi soru mamai ja'a. ' d'ai sange ne'e ka, lamatua yesus padhai lii lula-nèti lod'o-lod'o j'aj'èra dhèu rai-haha, dènge ana madhutu na sèra ètu ledhe saitun.

source_text: it was only two days before the people ◄celebrated/started to celebrate► for one week the festival which they called passover. during those days they also celebrated the festival of ◄unleavened bread/eating bread that had no yeast in it►. the chief priests and the men who taught the jewish laws were planning how they could seize jesus secretly. they wanted to accuse him in front of the roman authorities so that they would execute him. but they were saying to one another, we must not do it during the celebration, because, if we do it then, the people will be very angry with us and riot!
target_text: èle èèna ka, kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra tenge j'ara neo kèpe yesus dènge mau-mau. te rèngu neo pamadhe ne. te ngaa ètu d'ara padhue èèna, ra peka na, taha ku! baku parai kèpe ne, lula lod'o kalela dètu le. mage dhoka dhèu ae sèra patao dènge èdhi. rèngu padhai lii sèmi èèna, lula dii dua lod'o ka, d'ai lod'o kalela dhèu yahudi, dhu biasa ra peka na, ‘paska' dènge ‘pesta roti dhu pake boe ragi'. kalela se pasanèd'e rèngu lod'o bèi-baki ra kalua nèti rai masir.

source_text: jesus was at bethany town in the house of simon, whom jesus had healed from leprosy. while they were eating, a woman came to him. she was carrying a stone jar that contained expensive fragrant perfume called nard. she opened the jar and then she poured the perfume on jesus' head.
target_text: ètu rae betania, abhu ca dhèu ngara na simon. uru èèna, dhèu madenge dènge ne, lula nèngu pèd'a kusta. te ngaa limuri ne, èle le nèti papèd'a na. hèia lod'o kalela dhae d'ai mèka, na, yesus dènge ana madhutu na sèra lasi ra'a-rinu ètu èmu simon. ètu talora ra'a-rinu era, dhèu bhèni èci mai paraga yesus. nèd'u dènge boto èci dhu ra tao nèti hadhu. isi boto ne, èi hèu mèngi asli dhu kab'ua titu kèna, dhu ra tao nèti amo aaj'u hèu mèngi. hèia bhèni ne pamae hèb'a boto èèna, ka na pasuti èi hèu mèngi mi kètu yesus, ho j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, nèngu pakab'ua yesus.

source_text: one of the people who were present became angry and said to the others, ◄it is terrible that she wasted that perfume! /why did she waste that perfume? ► rhq
target_text: te ngaa ètu èèna, abhu dhèu leo dhu ra'a-rinu pa'èci kahèi. ropa dhèu se rèdhi dhèu bhèni ne tao sèmi èèna, hèia ra nasa. ka ra padhai lii padedha iisi, peka na, ngaa ka unu bhèni nèi? na bhori eele èi hèu mèngi kab'ua aae èèna!

source_text: it could have been sold {we could have sold it} for ◄a huge amount of money/an amount of money for which a person works for a year►, and then the money could have been given {we could have given the money} to poor people! so he rebuked her.
target_text: be'a risi nèngu pahie èi hèu mèngi èèna, ho la'e papala doi ae sèra, mi dhèu dhu dènge boe unu. te kab'ua èi hèu mèngi ne, èci èèna ka dènge gaji tuka d'ara ca tèu. hèia ra jèke bhèni ne.

source_text: but jesus said, stop scolding her! she has done to me what i consider to be very appropriate/delightful. so ◄you should not bother her! /why do you bother her? ► rhq
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala lii rèngu, aku nèngu na, miu baku pasusa bhèni ne! hud'i laa! ja'a karej'e lula nèngu pasuti le ngi'u ja'a dènge èi hèu mèngi ne'e!

source_text: you will always have poor people among you. so you can help them whenever you want to. but i will not be here among you much longer. so it is good for her to show now that she appreciates me.
target_text: dhèu kasia sèra, bèli-bèli ètu talora miu. de lod'o mia èèna ka dhu miu lake mere, na, miu bisa soru-bara si. te ngaa nèbhu heka, ja'a pa'èci heka dènge miu.

source_text: it is appropriate that she has done what she was able to do. it is as if she knew that i was going to die soon and has anointed my body for their burying it.
target_text: mamuri ja'a nèbhu heka ètu rai-haha ne. dènge tatao bhèni ne, nèngu lalau ngi'u ja'a, sama sèmi nèngu pahèu mèngi mema ngi'u aae ja'a, ho padhane.

source_text: i will tell you this: wherever the good message about me is preached {people preach the good message} throughout the world, what she has done will be told {people will tell others what she has done to me}, and as a result people will remember her.
target_text: miu patadhe, ee! èèna na, ladhe dhèu lole lii lolo be'a ama lamatua ètu mia-mia, na, ra palolo kahèi tatao be'a bhèni ne'e. sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i sanèd'e nèngu.

source_text: then judas iscariot or, judas, the man from kerioth town went to the chief priests in order to talk to them about helping them to seize jesus. he did that even though he was one of the twelve disciples
target_text: èle èèna ka, abhu ca dhèu nèti ana madhutu yesus dhèu canguru dua sèra, ngara na yudas iskariot. nèngu kalua la'e tenge kètu agama yahudi sèra ho neo pahie yesus mi rèngu. ropa na paraga dènge rèngu, ka na peka naneo na.

source_text: when they heard what he was willing to do for them, they were very happy. they promised that they would give him a large amount of money for doing that. judas agreed, so they gave him the money. as a result, he began watching for an opportunity ◄to betray jesus/to enable jesus' enemies to seize him►.
target_text: lod'o kètu agama sèra tadèngi naneo yudas, ka ra karej'e titu kèna. hèia ra jaji, peka na, ladhe èu neo pahie yesus dènge ji'i, tatu ji'i b'ae. hèia yudas kalua, ka na mulai tenge j'ara ho pahie yesus.

source_text: two days later, when they killed the lambs for the festival at the beginning of the week when people ate bread that had no yeast in it, jesus' disciples said to him, where do you want us to go and prepare the meal for the passover celebration in order that you can eat it with us?
target_text: lod'o èèna, lèke dènge lod'o partama nèti lod'o kalela dhèu yahudi. de d'ara lod'o èèna, rèngu tema tunu roti dhu dènge boe ragi, aa roro kahib'i-kalèbho kahèi. hèia ana madhutu yesus sèra mai karèi ne, aku rèngu na, ama! doe ne'e ne, lod'o kalela paska èdhi kèna. de ama neo ji'i lalau era kalela paska ètu mia?

source_text: so he chose two of his disciples to prepare everything. he said to them, go into jerusalem city. a man will meet you, who will be carrying a large jar full of water. follow him.
target_text: hèia yesus pua ana madhutu na dhèu dua, aku nèngu na, miu lami uuru ku asa d'ara kota. ètu nèi, miu paraga dènge dhèu mone èci, dhu pasae èi d'ara g'ala iiki cue. lami madhutu ne nèti limuri.

source_text: when he enters a house, say to the man who owns the house, ‘our teacher wants us to prepare the meal of the passover celebration so that he can eat it with us his disciples. ◄please show us the room that he arranged with you about. /where is the room that he arranged with you about? ► rhq'
target_text: ladhe na maso asa èmu mia èèna ka, na, miu madhutu ne asa d'ara. hèia miu peka mi lamatua èmu èèna, sèmi ne'e, ‘ama mese ji'i manèngi kama èci, ho na neo tao kalela paska dènge ana madhutu nèngu. '

source_text: he will show you a large room that is on the upper floor of the house. it will be furnished and ready for us to eat a meal in it. then prepare the meal there for us.
target_text: pe dhèu èèna paj'uj'u kama aae èci ètu èmu dedha na, dhu na sadia nare le. de miu dua mi dhoka lami lalau nganga'a di.

source_text: so the two disciples left. they went into the city and found everything to be just like he had told them. they prepared the meal for the passover celebration, and then returned to jesus and the other disciples.
target_text: hèia dua ra lasi ka asa d'ara kota. d'ai nèi, rèngu rèdhi tare'a, sama sèmi ngaa dhu yesus moa deo na. ka ra sadia aa'i-aa'i, ho yesus si ra'a kalela paska ètu era èèna. èle èèna ka, dua ra lasi paroa yesus si.

source_text: when it was evening, jesus arrived at that house with the twelve disciples.
target_text: ropa lod'o oe cèna, hèia yesus dènge ana madhutu dhèu canguru dua sèra d'ai era èèna.

source_text: as they were all sitting there and eating, jesus said, listen carefully to this: one of you will enable my enemies to seize me. specifically, it is one of you who will do this in spite of the fact that he is eating with me right now!
target_text: ka ra madhèdi ra'a sama-sama. ètu talora ra'a era, yesus padhai lii dènge si, aku nèngu na, miu nanene ku! èèna na dhèu èci nèti miu se pahie eele ja'a mi dhèu leo.

source_text: the disciples became very sad and they said to him one by one, surely ◄it is not i! /i am not the one, am i? ► rhq
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii èèna, ana madhutu yesus sèra cag'ag'a dènge manyasa. ka rèngu èci-èci mulai karèi yesus, peka na, dhèu dhu ama peka èèna, ja'a aad'o, sina ma?

source_text: then he said to them, it is one of you twelve disciples, the one who is dipping bread into the sauce in the dish along with me.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, dhèu dhu cèb'u roti palere-lere dènge ja'a asa d'ara mago ne, nèngu ka dhu pahia ja'a.

source_text: it is certain that i, the one who came from heaven, will die, because that is what has been {what the prophets have} written about me. but there will be terrible punishment for the man by whom i will be betrayed {who will ◄betray me/help my enemies to seize me►}! in fact, it would be better for that man if he had never been born!
target_text: mi sanèd'e! ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ja'a hud'i madhe ku, sama sèmi dhu suri tèke le, ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua. te ngaa kasia, dhèu dhu neo pahia ja'a èèna, bèli-camèd'a nèngu dui nare pala na! hua iia risi, ina na baku nara iisi ne!

source_text: while they were eating, he took a flat loaf of bread and thanked god for it. then he broke it into pieces and gave it to them and said to them, this bread represents met my body. take it and eat it.
target_text: ropa rèngu ètu talora ra'a era, yesus nare roti cue, hèia na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. ka na pamae roti ne, hèia na j'ole asa ana madhutu na sèra. ka na peka na, roti ne'e ne, ngi'u ja'a kèna. mere ho mi'a.

source_text: afterwards, he took a cup that contained wine and thanked god for it. then he gave it to them, and then, as they all drank from it,
target_text: èle èèna ka, na nare galaa dhu isi dènge èi hua anggor. na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua kahèi. ka na j'ole galaa èèna asa ana madhutu na, sèna ka rinu.

source_text: he said to them, this wine represents met my blood, which is about to be shed {which is about to flow from my body} when my enemies kill me. with this blood i will sign the agreement that god has made to forgive the sins of many people.
target_text: hèia na peka, èi anggor ne'e ne, raa ja'a kèna, dhu suti sèna ka hia mamuri mi dhèu ae. raa ne, j'aj'i mi tadha ho pasanèd'e, peka na, ngaa dhu ama lamatua moa le èèna, limuri ne j'aj'i le tare'a. mere ho minu ka!

source_text: i want you to know this: i will not drink any more wine in this way until the time when i drink it with a new meaning when i begin to rule as a king.
target_text: mi sanèd'e paie! nèti mèda ne'e ne, ja'a kinu heka èi anggor. toke d'ai ja'a dènge ama ku ngèd'u paredha sama-sama ètu sorga, heka kinu hari kèna.

source_text: after they sang a hymn, they went out toward olive tree hill.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra sod'a lii sod'a èci, ho ra koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua. ka mèda èèna kahèi, lasi dènge asa ledhe saitun.

source_text: while they were on their way, jesus said to them, it has been {the prophets have} written in the scriptures that god said about me, ‘i will kill the shepherd and his sheep will scatter. ' those words will come true. when they are about to capture me, all of you will leave me and run away.
target_text: ètu d'ara kakako rèngu èèna, yesus padhai lii, peka na, d'ara mèda ne'e ne, miu aa'i-aa'i mi rai tèke eele ja'a mesa ku. sama sèmi dhu ra suri le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, peka na, ‘èèna na ama lamatua pamadhe ana madhenga badha, ka kahib'i-kalèbho na rai paj'ala asa haa, asa dhimu. '

source_text: but after i have been made {god has made me} alive again, i will go ahead of you to galilee district and meet you there.
target_text: èèna na ja'a madhe tare'a. te ngaa lod'o ja'a mamuri hari, ja'a laku uru nèti miu asa propensi galilea!

source_text: then peter said to him, perhaps all the other disciples will leave you, but not i! i will not leave you!
target_text: ka petrus b'ala, peka na, ama! masi ka dhèu leo rai eele ama, te ngaa ja'a rai boe!

source_text: then jesus said to him, the truth is that this very night, before the rooster crows a second time, you yourself will deny three times that you know me!
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, petrus! mu patadhe! mèda ne'e kahèi, manu kokotoo d'ai mèka dua hari, te ngaa èu pasili le ja'a tèlu hari, peka na, èu tadhe boe ja'a!

source_text: but peter replied strongly, even if they kill me as i defend you, i will never deny that i know you! and all the other disciples said the same thing.
target_text: ka petrus pajèka dènge ne, peka na, aad'o sèmi èèna, ama! ladhe ama madhe, ja'a madhe dènge ama kahèi. te ngaa ja'a pasili boe ama, aa rai eele boe! angalai petrus sèra lii èci èèna kahèi.

source_text: on the way, jesus and the disciples came to the place that people call gethsemane. then he said to some/eight of his disciples, stay here while i pray!
target_text: hèia yesus si lasi d'ai d'ara oka cue ètu ledhe saitun, ngara na ‘getsemani'. d'ai èèna, hèia yesus peka dènge ra, miu madhèdi mate ja'a mi ne'e. ja'a neo laku manèngi-mangaj'i asa nèi.

source_text: then he took peter, james, and john with him. he became extremely distressed, and he said to them,
target_text: ka yesus gale nèti petrus, yakobis, dènge yohanis lasi dènge ne. mulai nèti èèna ka, na rasa d'ara nèngu ma'ète laho mae-mae.

source_text: i syn am very sorrowful. it is as if i were about to die. you men remain here and stay awake!
target_text: hèia na peka dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, d'ara ja'a pèd'a titu kèna! ja'a rasa sèmi oe madhe sa. miu madhèdi mate mi ne'e.

source_text: he went a bit further and threw himself on the ground. then he prayed that if it were possible, he would not have to suffer mty. he said, o my father, because you are able to do everything, rescue me so that i do not have to suffer now mty! but do not do what i want. instead, do what you want!
target_text: hèia la'e ako kaj'èu ciki nèti era èèna, ka na patitu kètu urutuu na ètu rai, ka na sabaj'a, peka na, ama pasue! ladhe sèmi ama d'èi, na, ja'a baku pasae j'aj'èra ne'e d'ai madhe. ja'a ke'a le, ètu madha ama, abhu boe ngaa èci sa dhu ama bisa boe tao. de ladhe bisa, na, ama pakaj'èu eele babia ne'e nèti kabela-kao ja'a. masi ka sèmi èèna, baku madhutu dad'èi ja'a; te ngaa hud'i madhutu dad'èi ama ku ka laa.

source_text: then he returned and found his disciples sleeping. he woke them up and said, simon! ◄i am disappointed that you fell asleep and that you were not able to stay awake for just a short time! /why is it that you fell asleep and that you were not able to stay awake for just one hour? ► rhq
target_text: èle èèna ka, na lèpa asa ana madhutu na, dhèu tèlu sèra, te ngaa ra bhèj'i luu. hèia na parèi si, ka na padhai lii dènge petrus, peka na, petrus! èu bhèj'i, do? ja'a nèbhu boe ètu nèi, te ngaa miu bisa boe beke mate ja'a ciki sa!

source_text: and he said to them, you want to do what i say, but you are not strong enough mty to actually do it. so keep awake and pray in order that you can resist when something like this tempts you!
target_text: kèd'i ho pamako musi madha èu. kèd'i ka, ho beke dènge ja'a! d'ara miu neo tao be'a kahèi, te ngaa ngi'u miu roe. de be'a risi miu sabaj'a, sèna ka ladhe miu lèke dadugu-rariu, miu baku manahu.

source_text: then he went away again and prayed again what he prayed before.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus la'e manèngi-mangaj'i ca tèka hari. nèngu manèngi hari mi ama lamatua, aku nèngu na, ama! ladhe bisa, na, ama pakaj'èu eele babia ne nèti ja'a. te ngaa hud'i madhutu dad'èi ama ku ka laa.

source_text: when he returned, he found that they were sleeping again because they were so sleepy that they could not keep their eyes open. because they were ashamed, they did not know what to say to him when he awakened them.
target_text: ka na lèpa hari asa era ana madhutu na dhèu tèlu sèra. te ngaa rèngu bhèj'i hari le, lula musi madha ra sakaa titu kèna. hèia na parèi hari si, te ngaa rèngu re'a boe dhaa sèmi ngaa mi nèngu.

source_text: then he went and prayed again. he returned a third time; and he found them sleeping again. he woke all of them and said to them, ◄i am disappointed that you are sleeping again! /why are you sleeping again? ► rhq you have slept enough. the time for me to suffer is about to begin. look! someone is about to enable sinful men to seize me, the one who came from heaven.
target_text: hèia yesus tèke eele si, ka la'e manèngi-mangaj'i d'ai tèlu hari kèna. èle èèna ka, na lèpa la'e parèi ana madhutu na sèra. na peka, miu bhèj'i taruu era? sange èèna ka laa! kèd'i ka! te dhèu dhu neo pahie ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, nuka mai dènge angalai nèngu sèra. rèngu mai kèpe ja'a, ho saraka mi dhèu bhelu-katub'a si.

source_text: so get up! let's go toward him look! here comes the one who is enabling them to seize me!
target_text: kèd'i ka! pamako musi madha miu, ho ladhe ku asa nèi! dhèu dhu neo pahie ja'a ne, nuka mai nèi. mai ho lati paraga dènge si!

source_text: while he was still speaking, judas arrived. even though he was one of jesus' twelve disciples, he came to enable jesus' enemies to seize him. a crowd who carried swords and clubs was with him. the leaders of the jewish council had sent them.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii era, hèia yudas d'ai madha yesus dènge dhèu ae titu kèna. rèngu mai rèti dènge hela dènge cèki, ho kèpe yesus. dhèu se tao sèmi èèna, lula ra madhutu lii paredha nèti kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a sèra.

source_text: judas, who was ◄betraying jesus/helping jesus' enemies to seize him►, had previously told this crowd, the man whom i kiss is the one whom you want. when i kiss him, seize him and lead him away while you guard him carefully.
target_text: yudas hia mema tadha mi dhèu ae se, peka na, ladhe d'ai nèi, ja'a uu cee, na, nèngu kèna. de mi kèpe ne.

source_text: so, when judas arrived, he immediately went to jesus and said, my teacher! then he kissed jesus on his neck/cheek.
target_text: ropa yudas si d'ai era èèna, na la'e asa madha yesus. ka na lii, aku nèngu na, ama mese! hèia na liku nare yesus, ka na uu ne.

source_text: then the crowd seized jesus.
target_text: hèia dhèu ae sèra ara asa madha yesus, ka ra kèpe ne.

source_text: but one of the disciples who was standing nearby drew his short sword. he struck the servant of the high priest with it to kill him, but he only cut off his ear.
target_text: te ngaa ana madhutu yesus èci bete hela na, ka na pare pama'ète rèu dhilu dhèu èci. dhèu dhu nu'a ne, ènu nèti kètu kapai risi agama yahudi.

source_text: jesus said to them, ◄it is ridiculous that you come here to seize me with swords and clubs, as if i were a bandit! /have you come here to seize me with swords and clubs, as if i were a bandit rhq? ► day after day i was with you in the temple courtyard teaching the people why did you not seize me then? but this is happening in order that what the prophets have written in the scriptures about me may be fulfilled {may happen}.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge dhèu ae dhu mai kèpe nèngu sèra, aku nèngu na, tasamia? miu ngee, na, ja'a ne dhèu bhelu, do? ka miu mai kèpe ja'a mèti hela dènge cèki? bèli-bèli ja'a aj'a miu ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, te ngaa miu èci sa kèpe boe ja'a. mai ka, kèpe ja'a! te j'ara ne j'aj'i sèmi dhu suri tèke le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua.

source_text: all the disciples at once left him and ran away.
target_text: ana madhutu yesus sèra madha'u titu kèna. hèia ra rai tèke eele yesus mesa na ètu èèna.

source_text: at that time, ◄a young man/i► was following jesus. he/i was wearing only a linen cloth around his/my body. the crowd seized him/me. but, as he/i pulled away from them, he/i left behind the linen cloth in their hands, and then he/i ran away naked.
target_text: ètu era èèna, abhu ana mone ngèru èci kahèi dhu madhutu yesus re limuri. ana ne pahutu isi na dènge sig'i ca bèla. dhèu sèra neo kèpe ne kahèi, ka na rai tèke eele sig'i na ètu kacui-aai dhèu sèra, lula na madha'u. hèia na rai dènge boe mèdha-papake ètu ua na.

source_text: the men who had seized jesus led him away to the house where the supreme priest lived. all of the jewish council were gathering there.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra rèti yesus asa èmu kètu kapai risi agama yahudi. ètu èèna, dhèu kapai sèra pakaboko le. rèngu sèra, nuka: kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a sèra.

source_text: peter followed jesus at a distance. he went into the courtyard of the house where the supreme priest lived, and sat there with the men who guarded the house of the supreme priest. he was warming himself beside a fire.
target_text: ropa ra kèpe rèti yesus, petrus madhutu mau-mau nèti limuri. hèia na maso kahèi d'ai madha èmu kètu kapai risi agama yahudi, ka na madhèdi manyiru ai sama-sama dènge dhèu j'aga ètu sèra.

source_text: the chief priests and all the rest of the jewish council had already tried to find people who would tell lies about jesus in order that they could convince the roman authorities to execute him. but they did not succeed,
target_text: ètu d'ara èmu èèna, kètu agama yahudi sèra padhue dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu madhèdi j'ue lii langu agama. ra patangi-tenge bukti ho pamanahu yesus, lula ra neo pamadhe ne. te ngaa rèngu abhu boe bukti èci sa.

source_text: because, although many people spoke lies about him, they contradicted each other.
target_text: ka ra paroa dhèu ae asa madha ho j'aj'i sakasii, sèna ka neo pabèbhe yesus. te ngaa lii sakasii rèngu sèra, èci dènge èci pamèci boe.

source_text: finally, some stood up and accused him falsely by saying,
target_text: abhu pèri-pèri dhèu sakasii leo dhu kèd'i titu, ka ra pakapod'e lii, peka na,

source_text: we heard him when he said, ‘i will destroy this temple that was built by men, and then within three days i will build another temple ◄without help from anyone else/that human hands will not build►. '
target_text: ji'i tadèngi dhèu ne'e peka na, ‘èèna na ja'a paguri eele èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i dhu dhèu rai-haha tao dènge kacui-aai ra. te ngaa èle tèlu lod'o ka, ja'a patitu kore hari le èmu èèna, dènge boe pake kacui-aai dhèu. '

source_text: but, what some of these men said also did not agree with what others of them said.
target_text: te ngaa lii lolo rèngu sèra èci dènge èci baka-leo hua.

source_text: then the supreme priest himself stood up in front of them and said to jesus, are you not going to reply? what do you say about all the things that they are saying in order to accuse you?
target_text: hèia kètu kapai risi agama yahudi èèna, kèd'i titu ètu talora dhèu ae dhu madhèdi ètu sèra. ka na karèi yesus, aku nèngu na, dhèu ae mai le galaa èu. nga tao ka èu mau-mau, mo'o boe dhaa lii galaa sèra?

source_text: but jesus was silent and did not reply dou. then the supreme priest tried again. he asked him, are you the messiah? do you say that you are ◄the son of god/the man who is also god►?
target_text: te ngaa yesus mau-mau, lii boe ca hèb'a sa. èle èèna ka, kètu kapai risi agama yahudi ne, karèi hari ne ca tèka, èu peka ku laa! tare'a-re'a èu ne kristus, ana ama lamatua dhu na moa nèti uuru èèna, do?

source_text: jesus said, i am. furthermore, you will see me, the one who came from heaven, ruling beside god, who is completely powerful. you will also see me coming down through the clouds in the sky!
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, mema tare'a sèmi èèna! nèngu èèna ka, ja'a ne! bèli-camèd'a miu ladhe mèdhi ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, madhèdi re bab'oa g'ana ama lamatua ètu sorga. koasa nèngu kapai risi eele! ladhe èèna na, ja'a dènge nèngu, ngèd'u paredha sama-sama. èle èèna na, ja'a puru mai nèti sorga dènge ra'i-liru.

source_text: in response to jesus' words, the supreme priest tore his outer garment. that was their custom to show that he was shocked that jesus had said that he was equal to god. then he said, we certainly do not rhq need any more people who will testify against this man,
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare lii padhai yesus, kètu kapai risi agama yahudi ne nasa titu kèna, hèia na ciu pamae kodho madhera ètu ua na. ka na pajèka peka dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu sèra, aku nèngu na, èdhi parluu heka sakasii!

source_text: because you have heard what he said against god! he claimed to be equal with god therefore, what have you decided? they all said that jesus was guilty and deserved ◄to be executed/that they should kill him►.
target_text: miu tadèngi le dènge ro'a dhilu miu, si? nèngu unu na ka dhu peka sèmi èèna! nèngu padedha iisi na, j'aj'i ana ama lamatua. lii ne'e ne, lii dhu pa'ele iie kolongara ama lamatua! madhutu atora agama èdhi, dhèu dhu tao iisi na sama sèmi ama lamatua, dhèu èèna hud'i lèke huku madhe ku! de mi pama'ète tasamia? hèia rèngu aa'i-aa'i pama'ète, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne, tare'a-re'a sala! de nèngu ne hud'i lèke huku pamadhe!

source_text: then some of them began spitting on jesus. they put a blindfold on him, and then they began striking him and saying to him, if you are a prophet, tell us who hit you! and those who were guarding jesus struck him with their hands.
target_text: hèia pèri-pèri dhèu kèd'i lasi sabhuu ilu mi rèhu yesus. ra hutu musi madha na, ka ra game ne. hèia ra karèi ne, aku rèngu na, ladhe èu j'aj'i dhèu mèti lii padhai ama lamatua, na, èu peka sèku! cee ka dhu j'ubhu èu? èle èèna ka, ra pua dhèu dhu madhenge èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ho mai pakako rèti yesus. ropa ra kako, ra tèb'e pa'oke ne nèti haa, nèti dhimu.

source_text: while peter was outside in the courtyard of the supreme priest's house, one of the girls who worked for the supreme priest came near him. when she saw peter warming himself beside the fire, she looked at him closely. then she said, you also were with jesus, that man from nazareth town!
target_text: mèda èèna, petrus madhèdi era ètu madha èmu èèna. hèia ènu dhèu bhèni èci nèti kètu kapai risi agama yahudi, mai ka nèdhi petrus madhèdi manyiru ai. na ladhe kaloo ka rèhu petrus, ka karèi, aku nèngu na, deo na èu sama-sama dènge yesus, dhèu nasaret èèna, si?

source_text: but he denied it by saying, i do not know or understand dou what you are talking about! then he went away from there to the gate of the courtyard.
target_text: te ngaa petrus dhaa, peka na, aad'o! nga tao ka èu karèi sèmi èèna! ja'a tadhe boe dhèu èèna. hèia petrus kalua, ka la'e titu ètu hèb'a tedhe. kabèdhi laa, manu kokotoo.

source_text: the servant girl saw him there and said to the people who were standing nearby, this man is one of those who have been with that man they arrested.
target_text: hèia dhèu bhèni èèna ladhe nèdhi hari petrus. ka na peka dènge dhèu ètu sèra, aku nèngu na, nèngu ne ca dhèu nèti rèngu kahèi!

source_text: but he denied it again. after a little while, one of those who were standing there said to peter again, the way you speak shows that you also are from galilee district. so it is certain that you are one of those who accompanied jesus!
target_text: te ngaa petrus pasili hari, ka na peka, tao-tao èu huj'u! ja'a tadhe boe dhèu ne'e! nèbhu boe ka, dhèu èci ètu èèna kahèi, peka hari mi petrus, aku nèngu na, èu ne baku pasili, peka na, èu dènge boe dhèu se'e se! we! miu se aa'i-aa'i mi, dhèu galilea, si?

source_text: but he began to exclaim, i do not know the man that you are talking about! because god knows that i am speaking truthfully, may he punish me if i am lying!
target_text: ka petrus pab'ala hari, aku nèngu na, ja'a bani subha! ja'a tadhe boe dhèu nèi!

source_text: immediately the rooster crowed a second time. then peter remembered what jesus had said to him before, before the rooster crows a second time, you will deny three times that you know me. when he realized that he had denied it three times, he started crying.
target_text: petrus dhu padhai lii nare mèka, kabèdhi laa, manu kokotoo ka dua hari kèna. hèia petrus sanèd'e lii dhu yesus peka dènge nèngu, ladhe manu kokotoo d'ai mèka dua hari, te èu pasili le ja'a tèlu hari peka na èu tadhe boe ja'a! ropa ngee nèdhi, hèia petrus tangi d'ara pèd'a.

source_text: very early in the morning the chief priests met together with the rest of the jewish council, in order to decide how to accuse jesus before the roman governor. their guards tied jesus' hands again. they took him to the house of pilate, the governor, and they started to accuse him, saying jesus is claiming that he is a king!
target_text: mad'ae aae era, dhèu-dhèu j'ue lii langu agama yahudi sèra pare'a lii ho pamadhe yesus. ka ra èki rèti ne, lasi asa madha gubernur pilatus.

source_text: pilate asked jesus, do you claim to be the king of the jews? jesus answered him, you yourself have said so.
target_text: ropa d'ai madha gubernur, ka na karèi yesus, aku nèngu na, tasamia? èu ne tare'a dhèu aae yahudi, do? yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, tare'a. ama gubernur peka lèke kèna.

source_text: then the chief priests claimed that jesus had done many bad things.
target_text: hèia kètu agama yahudi sèra peka dènge gubernur, aku rèngu na, dhèu ne'e tao sala ae titu kèna! hèia ra lolo ka sasala na èci-èci.

source_text: so pilate asked him again, don't you have anything to say? listen to how many bad things they are saying that you have done!
target_text: ka gubernur karèi hari yesus, èu tadèngi boe lii padhai dhèu se'e, do? dhèu se'e, pasala le èu ae-ae. èu b'ala ku laa!

source_text: but even though jesus was not guilty, he did not say anything more. the result was that pilate was very much surprised.
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala boe ca hèb'a sa, ka gubernur malaa.

source_text: it was the governor's custom each year during the passover celebration to release one person who was in prison. he customarily released whichever prisoner the people requested.
target_text: tèu mai-tèu mai, dhu tema le, ladhe d'ai lod'o kalela paska dhèu yahudi, dhèu ae sèra paj'uj'u ana bèdho èci, ho gubernur patalale ne.

source_text: at that time there was a man called barabbas who had been {whom the soldiers had} put in prison with some other men. those men had murdered some soldiers when they rebelled against the roman government.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ana bèdho èci, ngara na barabas. uru èèna, ra kèpe ne, taga na palab'a dènge dhèu paredha roma, aa na pamadhe dhèu kahèi.

source_text: a crowd approached pilate and asked him to release someone, just like he customarily did for them during the passover celebration.
target_text: lula lod'o tatao paska èèna oe dètu le, dhèu ae lasi manèngi gubernur pilatus, ka ra pa'oo-parodha, peka na, ama gubernur! lod'o tatao paska dètu le! lod'o sèmi ne'e, ama gubernur patabuli ku ana bèdho èci, sama sèmi tèu-tèu uru sèra.

source_text: pilate answered them, would you like me to release for you the man whom you jewish people say is your king?
target_text: hèia gubernur b'ala lii rèngu, ladhe sèmi èèna, ja'a patabuli cee? tasamia, ladhe ja'a patabuli dhèu aae yahudi miu, do? miu mo'o, do aad'o?

source_text: he asked this because he realized what the chief priests were wanting to do. they were accusing jesus because they were jealous of him because many people were becoming his disciples.
target_text: gubernur peka sèmi èèna, lula nèngu ne'a le, kètu agama yahudi ka rèti yesus mai asa nèngu, taga ra kacèki dènge yesus.

source_text: but the chief priests urged the crowd to request that pilate release barabbas for them instead of jesus.
target_text: hèia kètu agama yahudi se dadugu dhèu ae sèra, ho manèngi gubernur, peka na, ji'i ngo'o boe nèngu! ji'i d'èi dhoka patabuli barabas di!

source_text: pilate said to them again, if i release barabbas, what do you want me to do with the man whom some of you jews say is your king?
target_text: ka gubernur karèi hari dhèu ae sèra, ladhe sèmi èèna, yesus, dhu ra pangare na ‘dhèu aae yahudi' èèna, ja'a tao ne, tasamia?

source_text: then they shouted again, command that your soldiers crucify him!
target_text: ka aa'i-aa'i ra pa'oo, peka na, pamadhe ne! paku ne mi aj'u palolo-palèbha!

source_text: then pilate said to them, why? what crime has he committed? but they shouted even louder, command your soldiers to crucify him!
target_text: hèia gubernur karèi si, aku nèngu na, sasala na ngaa? ja'a parisa kore le. te ngaa abhu boe sasala na èci sa, dhu nèngu tao! te ngaa dhèu se asa ka hino pa'oo-parodha, aku rèngu na, pamadhe ne! paku ne mi aj'u palolo-palèbha!

source_text: so, because pilate wanted to please the crowd, he released barabbas for them. then, after his soldiers had whipped jesus with leather straps into which they had fastened metal pieces, pilate told the soldiers to take him away in order that he would be crucified {they would crucify him}.
target_text: lula gubernur neo pakarej'e d'ara dhèu ae sèra, ka na patabuli barabas madhutu dad'èi rèngu. ka na paredha dhèu j'aga sèra lasi kalabhe yesus pake gui. game rare ne, hèia sordad'u sèra rèti ka yesus lasi neo paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: the soldiers took jesus into the courtyard of the palace where pilate lived. that place was the government headquarters. then they summoned the whole ◄cohort/group of soldiers► who were on duty there.
target_text: èle èèna ka, sordad'u sèra ère rèti yesus asa era dhu taleo èci ètu madha èmu gubernur. ka ra paroa anga sordad'u dhu leo sèra ca batalion, ho pakaboko.

source_text: after the soldiers gathered together, they put a purple robe on jesus. then they placed on his head a crown that they made from branches of thornbushes. they did those things in order to ridicule him by pretending that he was a king.
target_text: ra papake yesus kodho madhera aae èci, dhu mea oe sèmi mangèru sa, sama sèmi mèdha-papake dhèu aae-dhèu aae. ka rare loro aj'u dhu padhudhu, ho ènyu solo. hèia ra ènyi solo padhudhu èèna mi kètu yesus. ka ra tao ne, sèmi dhèu aae dhu ded'e hiu, dhu pake solo dhèu aae.

source_text: then they greeted him like they would greet a king, in order to ridicule him, saying, hooray for the king who rules the jews!
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra sangaja pakab'ua yesus. ra peka, aku rèngu na, ama dhèu aae yahudi dhu hua iia!

source_text: they repeatedly struck his head with a reed and spat on him. by kneeling down, they pretended to honor him.
target_text: aa ra sangaja pacud'u kètu ho pakab'ua yesus. ka ra sabhuu ilu pèri-pèri hari mi rèhu yesus. sèmi èèna kahèi, ra d'eu kètu yesus dènge gui pahari-pahari.

source_text: when they had finished ridiculing him, they pulled off the purple robe. they put his own clothes on him, and then they led him outside of the city in order to nail him to a cross.
target_text: ropa ra tao rare sèmi èèna, ka ra bhoke eele kodho madhera nèti ua na. ka ra papake hari mèdha-papake na. èle ka, rèti yesus asa li'u yerusalem, ho neo paku ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha d'ai madhe.

source_text: after jesus carried his cross a short distance, a man named simon from cyrene city came along. he was the father of alexander and rufus. he was passing by while he was returning home from outside the city. the soldiers compelled simon to carry the cross for jesus.
target_text: ropa rèngu kalua nèti yerusalem, d'ai talora j'ara paraga dènge dhèu kota kirene èci. ngara na simon, ama nèti aleksander dènge rufus. ropa na neo maso asa yerusalem, sordad'u sèra pakaseti ne pasae aj'u palolo-palèbha yesus.

source_text: they brought them both to a place that they call golgotha. that name means, ‘a place like a skull'.
target_text: ère rèti yesus asa era èci, ngara na golgota. sasoa na, ‘era rui kètu'.

source_text: then they tried to give jesus wine that was {that they} mixed with medicine called myrrh. they wanted him to drink it so that he would not feel so much pain when they crucified him. but he did not drink it.
target_text: d'ai era èèna, ra neo hia yesus ninu èi hua anggor manyilu dhu pab'ali dènge èi na'i, sèna ka na taha rarii nèti nu'a-nu'a ètu ngi'u na sèra. te ngaa yesus no'o boe ninu.

source_text: some of the soldiers took his clothes. then they nailed him to a cross. afterwards, they divided his clothes among themselves by gambling with something like dice. they did this in order to determine which piece of clothing each one would get. it was nine o'clock in the morning when they crucified him.
target_text: hèia ra paku kacui-aai dènge haga yesus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. paku rare ka, ra patitu aj'u palolo-palèbha èèna, ele boe d'ara hake ceo mad'ae sa. èle èèna ka, sordad'u sèra ère lot, ho re'a cee ka dhu abhu mèdha-papake yesus.

source_text: they attached to the cross above jesus' head a sign on which it had been written {someone had written} the reason why they were nailing him to the cross. but all that it said was, the king of the jews.
target_text: ka ra suri ètu papa èci dhu ra paku re dedha kètu yesus, peka na, ne'e ne, dhèu aae yahudi rèngu pake alasan èèna ka, ho huku pamadhe yesus.

source_text: they also nailed to crosses two men who were bandits. they nailed one to a cross at the right side of jesus and one to a cross at the left side of jesus.
target_text: ètu èèna, ra paku parapo dhèu dua kahèi pa'èci dènge yesus. èci re cabèka g'ana, aa èci hari re cabèka kariu yesus. dènge j'ara ne, rèngu madhutu sama sèmi dhu ra suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua, peka na, ra tao ne sama sèmi dhèu bhelu.

source_text: the people who were passing by insulted him by shaking their heads as if here were an evil man. they said, aha! you said that you would destroy the temple and then you would build it again within three days.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu kako re èèna, ladhe rèdhi yesus dhu ra paku ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. ka ra pakareko kètu, aa ra padhai lii pamakae yesus, aku rèngu na, heh! èu ne peka na, èu bisa paguri eele èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ho d'ara tèlu lod'o, èu pakèd'i hari, si?

source_text: if you could do that, then rescue yourself by coming down from the cross!
target_text: èu puru sèku nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha èèna, ho patabuli ngi'u èu! ladhe sèmi èèna, heka ji'i parcaya, na, èu ne, ana ama lamatua.

source_text: the chief priests, along with the men who taught the jewish laws, also wanted to make fun of jesus. so they said to each other, he claims to have saved others from their sicknesses iro but he cannot save himself!
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, kètu agama yahudi sèra, padhai lii pamakae yesus, aku rèngu na, nèngu ne, patabuli le dhèu leo nèti rupa-rupa j'aj'èra, te ngaa nèngu bisa boe patabuli ngi'u nèngu unu na nèti j'aj'èra ne'e.

source_text: he said, ‘i am the messiah, i am the king who rules the people of israel. ' if his words are true, he should come down now from the cross! then we will believe him! the two men who were crucified beside him also insulted him.
target_text: nèngu peka unu na, nèngu ne ‘kristus', dhu uru èèna ama lamatua moa tèke le. dhèu leo peka na, nèngu ne dhèu aae isra'el. ladhe tare'a sèmi èèna, hud'i laa na puru nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha ne, sèna ka ji'i ngèdhi ne. heka ji'i parcaya ne kèna. dhèu dua dhu ra paku sama-sama dènge yesus sèra, padhai lii pamakae yesus kahèi.

source_text: at noon the whole land became dark, and it stayed dark until three o'clock in the afternoon.
target_text: d'ara lod'o titu mera sa, era èèna maroga, toke d'ai hake tèlu loo nihia.

source_text: at three o'clock jesus shouted loudly, eloi, eloi, lama sabachthani? that means, my god, my god, why have you deserted me?
target_text: d'ai hake tèlu nihia, hèia yesus pa'oo pake lii aram, peka na, eloi! eloi! lema sabaktani? dhu sasoa, peka na, lamatua ja'a! lamatua ja'a! nga tao ka, ama ku tèke eele ja'a sèmi ne'e?

source_text: when some of the people who were standing there heard the word ‘eloi', misunderstanding it, they said, listen! he is calling for the prophet elijah!
target_text: abhu pèri-pèri dhèu ètu èèna, tadèngi lii pa'oo yesus. ka ra peka, miu nanene ku laa! te na paroa elia, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua uru èèna.

source_text: one of them ran and filled a sponge with sour wine. he placed it on the tip of a reed, and then he held it up for jesus to suck out the wine that was in it. while he was doing that, someone said, wait! let's see whether elijah will come to take him down from the cross!
target_text: ka dhèu èci rai la'e nare ula dhasi, ka na cèb'u asa d'ara èi hua anggor manyilu. hèia nare ula èèna, èki ètu suu tatea èci, ka na soro asa panyoro yesus ho na camuci. dhèu èèna peka, èdhi tatae sèku. cee ne'a, tao-tao elia mai, ho papuru ne nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha èèna.

source_text: and then, after jesus shouted loudly, he stopped breathing and died.
target_text: hèia yesus pa'oo hari ca tèka, heka na madhe kèna.

source_text: at that moment the heavy thick curtain that closed off the most holy place in the temple split into two pieces from top to bottom. that showed that ordinary people could now go into the presence of god.
target_text: ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i abhu bèla dhu bhèla aae, ra kadhoe pa'abhe kama luri mola-mèci. ropa yesus ma'ète a'ae, bèla ne mae cèri bagi mi dua, nèti dedha toke d'ai haha.

source_text: the officer who supervised the soldiers who nailed jesus to the cross was standing in front of jesus. when he saw how jesus died, he exclaimed, truly, this man was the man who was also god!
target_text: ètu golgota abhu komedhaa sordad'u j'aga dhu titu dètu aj'u palolo-palèbha yesus. ropa ladhe nèdhi mamadhe yesus, na cag'ag'a. hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, ira ii! mema tare'a! dhèu ne'e ne, ana ama lamatua.

source_text: there were also some women there, watching these events from a distance. they had accompanied jesus when he was in galilee district, and they had provided what he needed. they had come with him to jerusalem. among those women was mary from magdala town. there was another mary, who was the mother of the younger james and of joses. there was also salome.
target_text: abhu pèri-pèri dhèu bhèni dhu madhutu lasi asa era èèna kahèi. ra titu nèti kaj'èu, ladhe rèdhi mamadhe yesus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha èèna. rèngu se ka dhu uru èèna lalau-lalo'o yesus ètu galilea. rèngu sèra, nuka: salome, maria nèti rae magdala, dènge maria èci hari nuka ina yakobis dènge yoses, dènge dhèu bhèni leo hari dhu mai asa yerusalem, sama-sama dènge yesus.

source_text: when evening was near, a man named joseph from arimathea town came there. he was a member of the jewish council, one whom everyone respected. he was also one of those who had been waiting expectantly for the time when god would send his king to begin to rule. he knew that, according to jewish law, people's bodies had to be buried {someone had to bury people's bodies} on the day they died. he also realized that it was the day when people prepared things for ◄the jewish day of rest/the sabbath►, and that the sabbath would start when the sun set. so he became courageous and went to pilate and asked pilate to permit him to take the body of jesus down from the cross and bury it immediately.
target_text: ropa lod'o oe cèna, hèia dhèu èci tenge j'ara ho papuru ngi'u aae yesus nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha. dhèu èèna, ngara na yusuf, nèti kota arimatea. nèngu ne'e kahèi, ca dhèu dhu j'ue lii langu agama yahudi. nèngu dhèu d'ara be'a kahèi. aa nèngu mate nèbhu le paredha ama lamatua mai. lod'o yesus madhe èèna, lèke hari jumat. bèli na, lèke lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi. nèti èèna ka, yusuf neo papuru eele ngi'u aae yesus ètu d'ara lod'o hari jumat èèna. ka na pabani iisi na, la'e paraga dènge gubernur pilatus, manèngi ho papuru ngi'u aae yesus.

source_text: pilate was surprised when he heard that jesus was already dead. so he summoned the officer who was in charge of the soldiers who crucified jesus, and he asked him if jesus had already died.
target_text: ropa gubernur tadèngi lii manèngi yusuf ne, na malaa. hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, eea! nga tao ka, dhèu ne madhe malai sa mia ne! ja'a ngee, na, dhae madhe mèka! hèia na pua dhèu lasi paroa komedhaa, ka na karèi ne, aku nèngu na, sa mia? yesus madhe le, do dhae?

source_text: when the officer told pilate that jesus was dead, pilate allowed joseph to take away the body.
target_text: komedhaa èèna b'ala, peka na, tare'a, ama! na madhe le karèi deo na. ropa gubernur tadèngi nare lii dhaa èèna, hèia na hia yusuf la'e nare ngi'u aae yesus.

source_text: after joseph bought a linen cloth, he and others took jesus' body down from the cross. they wrapped it in the linen cloth and laid it in a tomb that previously had been dug out of the rock cliff. then they rolled a huge flat stone in front of the entrance to the tomb.
target_text: hèia yusuf la'e hèli bèla madhera dhu kab'ua èci, ka na la'e asa golgota. d'ai nèi, ka na papuru ngi'u aae yesus nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha. na pahutu ngi'u aae yesus dènge bèla hiu. tèu èèna, ra heka pae rare ro'a èci ètu d'ara hadhu aae. hèia ra nedhe rèti ngi'u aae yesus asa d'ara ro'a èèna. ka ra loli rare hadhu kabela dhu kapai èci, ho ra bèdho paie hèb'a ro'a èèna. èle èèna ka, yusuf si lèpa.

source_text: mary from magdala and mary the mother of joses were watching where jesus' body was placed {where they placed jesus' body}.
target_text: lod'o èèna, maria nèti rae magdala, dènge maria èci hari, ina yoses, madhutu d'ai era èèna kahèi. dua ra rèdhi era dhu ra padhane yesus, ka ra patadhe paie era èèna.

source_text: on saturday evening when ◄the sabbath/the jewish day of rest► had ended, mary from magdala, mary the mother of the younger james, and salome bought fragrant ointment. the jews had a custom of anointing bodies before they buried them, and the women wanted to follow this custom.
target_text: bèli èèna, lèke hari sabtu, nuka lod'o sabaj'a dhèu yahudi. ropa lod'o cèna la'e, maria nèti rae magdala, maria dhu leo hari ina yakobis, dènge salome, lasi hèli èi hèu mèngi, sèna ka bèli rèngu bisa lasi pasuti mi ngi'u aae yesus madhutu ad'a dhèu yahudi.

source_text: so very early on sunday, just after the sun rose, they took the fragrant ointment and started toward the tomb.
target_text: ropa hari migu mad'ae aae èèna, tèlu ra lasi asa ro'a yesus.

source_text: while they were going there, they were saying to each other, who will roll away for us the stone that blocks the entrance of the tomb? after they arrived, they looked up and saw that the stone had already been rolled away {that someone had already rolled away the stone}. they were surprised because it would have been difficult to move such a huge stone.
target_text: ètu talora j'ara, tèlu ra padhue, aku rèngu na, waa! d'ai nèi, na, cee ka dhu bisa loli eele hadhu aae èèna nèti hèb'a ro'a? èdhi tèlu ti bisa boe, lula hadhu èèna kapai bia! te ngaa ropa rèngu d'ai ro'a èèna, rèdhi hadhu èèna dhu hari eele le nèti hèb'a ro'a.

source_text: they entered the tomb and saw an angel who looked like a young man. he was sitting at the right side of the cave. he was wearing a shining white robe. as a result, they were astonished.
target_text: hèia bhèni se maso asa d'ara. rèngu cag'ag'a titu kèna, lula ètu d'ara ro'a èèna, rèdhi ana mone ngèru èci madhèdi ètu sebhe g'ana rèngu, dhu pake mèdha pudhi lao-lao.

source_text: the young man said to them, do not be astonished! i know that you are looking for jesus, the man from nazareth, who was nailed to a cross {whom they nailed to a cross}. but he has become alive again! he is not here! look! here is the place where they placed his body.
target_text: hèia mone ngèru èèna, peka dènge rèngu, baku madha'u! ja'a ke'a, na, miu mai tenge yesus dhèu nasaret, dhu ra paku pamadhe ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. na aad'o heka ètu ne'e, lula na mamuri hari le! mai ho ladhe unu mi, te ngi'u yesus aad'o heka ètu era dhu ra paj'unu na.

source_text: but, instead of remaining here, go and tell his disciples. particularly be sure that you tell peter. tell them, ‘jesus is going ahead of you to galilee district, and you will see him there, just like he told you previously'!
target_text: de lami ka lai-lai, ho lole dènge petrus si, peka na, yesus mamuri hari le! na la'e uuru le asa galilea. èèna na rèngu paraga dènge yesus ètu nèi, sèmi dhu uru èèna na peka mema le dènge rèngu. de lami ka!

source_text: the women went outside and ran from the tomb. they were trembling because they were afraid, and they were astonished. but they did not say anything to anyone about this while they were going, because they were afraid.
target_text: ropa bhèni se rèdhi heka ngi'u yesus ètu era dhu ra paj'unu na, rèngu cag'ag'a. ka rai asa li'u lasi. hèia rèngu lèpa dènge ka, ra peka boe dènge dhèu èci sa ètu j'ara, lula rèngu madha'u titu kèna.

source_text: when jesus became alive again early on sunday morning, he appeared first to mary from magdala town. she was the woman from whom he had previously expelled seven evil spirits.
target_text: hari migu mad'ae aae era, yesus pad'elo uuru ngi'u na mi maria nèti magdala, dhu uru èèna, yesus babège eele nidhu pidhu nèti nèngu.

source_text: she went to those who had been with jesus, while they were mourning and crying. she told them what she had seen.
target_text: ropa na nèdhi nare yesus, hèia la'e dènge ka, peka dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu uru èèna madhutu yesus. dhèu sèra pakaboko taruu ètu era èci. rèngu ètu d'ara susa era, taga ra ngee mamadhe yesus.

source_text: but when she told them that jesus was alive again and that she had seen him, they refused to believe it.
target_text: ka maria peka dènge rèngu, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka miu susa era? susa ia ka, te yesus mamuri hari le! deo na, ja'a heka paraga dènge ne kèna! te ngaa rèngu aa'i-aa'i dhaa, aku rèngu na, èu ne, monya! ji'i lèka boe.

source_text: later that day, jesus appeared to two of his disciples while they were walking from jerusalem to their homes in the surrounding area. but they did not recognize him quickly because he looked very different.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu madhutu yesus dhèu dua lasi asa rae èci. ropa d'ai talora j'ara, yesus pad'elo ngi'u dènge si. te ngaa nèngu ub'a le. nèbhu boe, heka ra tadhe ne.

source_text: after they recognized him, those two went back to jerusalem. they told his other followers what had happened, but they did not believe it.
target_text: hèia dua ra lèpa hari, lasi peka dènge angalai ra sèra, aku rèngu na, wee! miu nanene ku laa! lai-lai deo na, ji'i paraga le dènge yesus ètu j'ara! te ngaa angalai ra aa'i-aa'i dhaa, aku rèngu na, eeh! miu baku monya sèmi èèna!

source_text: later he appeared to the eleven apostles while they were eating. he rebuked them because they had stubbornly refused to believe the reports of those who saw him after he had become alive again.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus paraga dènge ana madhutu na sèra, dhèu canguru èci, ropa ra madhèdi ra'a-rinu. ka na jèke si, aku nèngu na, wee! miu kètu hadhu pa'ae sa mia ne! dhèu peka le dènge miu, rèngu rèdhi le ja'a dènge musi madha rèngu, te ngaa miu parcaya boe! aku miu na, dhèu sèra monya! de ne'e ne, ja'a unu ku mai. mema tare'a ja'a madhe, te ngaa ja'a mamuri hari le! de mèdhi le, sina ma!

source_text: later he said to them, go into the whole world and preach the good message to everyone!
target_text: de lami ka asa mia-mia palème rai-haha ne. peka dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra lii lolo be'a ja'a ne.

source_text: everyone who believes your message and who is baptized will be saved {god will save}. but everyone who does not believe it will be condemned {god will condemn}.
target_text: dhèu cee dhu parcaya ja'a aa abhu sarani, èèna na ama lamatua hia ne mamuri sèna ka na bisa pea taruu dènge ne ètu sorga. te ngaa cee dhu parcaya boe ja'a, èèna na nèngu abhu huku nèti lamatua, ka lamatua core eele ne asa li'u la'e, ho na pea taruu ètu nèi.

source_text: those who believe my good message will perform miracles. specifically, by my power they will expel evil spirits. they will speak in languages that they have not learned.
target_text: aa dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a sèra, rèngu tao rupa-rupa tadha malaa, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra re'a, peka na, koasa ra mema mai nèti ama lamatua! conto sèmi, èèna na rèngu bisa babège eele nidhu pake kolongara ja'a. ladhe èèna na, ama lamatua hia si padhai lii pake lii leo dhu rèngu mesa ra dhane rare boe.

source_text: if they pick up snakes accidentally or if they drink any poisonous liquid accidentally, they will not be hurt. whenever they put their hands on sick people in order that god will heal them, those sick people will become well.
target_text: ladhe rèngu kèpe mege dhu dènge raco, do, rinu lèke raco, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. ladhe ra tao kacui-aai asa dhèu pèd'a, dhèu èèna èle nèti papèd'a-tarègu na.

source_text: after the lord jesus had said this to the disciples, he was taken {god took him} up into heaven. then he sat down on his throne beside god to rule with him.
target_text: ropa padhai lii èle dènge ana madhutu na sèra, hèia ama lamatua paca'e yesus asa sorga. ètu nèi, nèngu j'aj'i ai g'ana ama na, ka rèd'u paredha sama-sama.

source_text: as for the disciples, they went out from jerusalem, and then they preached everywhere. wherever they went, the lord enabled them to perform miracles. by doing that, he showed people that god's message is true.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia ana madhutu na sèra madhutu paredha na. rèngu lasi asa mia-mia, ho lole mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i lii lolo be'a yesus. hèia ama lamatua hia si koasa ho ra tao tadha-tadha malaa dhu yesus peka le dènge rèngu. nèti èèna ka, dhèu ae parcaya yesus, taga rèngu re'a le lii lolo be'a èèna, lèke tare'a-re'a.

source_text: my noble friend theophilus, many people saw the things that jesus did while he was with us, from the time when he started mty his ministry. they served god by teaching people the message about the lord jesus. many of those who heard what they taught wrote down for us accounts of the things that jesus did from the time when he began his ministry. i myself have studied these accounts carefully. so i decided that it would be good for me also to write for you sg an accurate account of these matters.
target_text: ama teofilus dhu ja'a pakab'ua. lii maho'o nèti ja'a. dhèu ae dhu suri sèku le lii lolo nèti mamuri dènge sasab'a-la'a yesus dhu j'aj'i ètu talora aae ji'i. rèngu suri lii lolo sèra pake lii lolo dhu parai reo nèti ji'i asa ji'i karèi nèti uru ka, dhu ji'i nge'a nèti dhèu-dhèu dhu dètu dènge lamatua yesus, aa nèti dhèu leo dhu ladhe rèdhi dènge musi madha ra. lii lolo se'e, lèke mola-mola dènge mamoa ama lamatua karèi nèti uru kèna. de ja'a parisa kore le toke lutu dènge be'a, j'ara sèra aa'i-aa'i ra, mulai nèti j'aj'aj'i ra. hèia ja'a pama'ète ho sèna ka suri si paie-iie ètu d'ara sasuri ne'e karèi nèti j'aj'aj'i ra. dènge j'ara ne, ama bisa me'a mèu ngaa dhu j'aj'i le.

source_text: i want you to know the truth about what you have been taught {what others have taught you}.
target_text: aa ama bisa parcaya ngaa dhu dhèu lole sèra, lii dhu monya boe. aa'i-aa'i se j'aj'i tare'a!

source_text: when king herod the great ruled judea district, there was a jewish priest named zechariah. he belonged to the group of priests called the abijah group. he and his wife elizabeth were both descended from the first priest of israel, aaron.
target_text: j'aj'aj'i lii lolo ne sèmi ne'e: lod'o dhèu aae herodes nèd'u paredha ètu propensi yudea, abhu ca dhèu, dhu ngara na sakaria. nèngu ne, ca dhèu ama agama yahudi. aa nèngu kahèi, ca dhèu nèti kaboko ama agama abia. dhèu èmu sakaria, ngara na elisabet, ca dhèu ana-èpu nèti ama agama kahèi. te elisabet ne, ana-èpu nèti harun, a'a musa.

source_text: god considered that both of them were righteous, because they constantly completely obeyed everything that god had commanded.
target_text: dua ra mamuri mola madhutu paredha dènge atora aa'i-aa'i nèti ama lamatua. aa dhèu pakab'ua si kahèi.

source_text: but they had no children, because elizabeth had been unable to bear children. furthermore, she and her husband were very old.
target_text: dua ra dhu heka le, te ngaa dhu abhu boe kolo, te era ana nèti elisabet dhu bèdho mèno.

source_text: one day zechariah's group was doing their work in the temple in jerusalem, and he was serving as a priest in god's presence.
target_text: ca tèka, sakaria dènge dhèu d'ara kaboko abia lèke lod'o rèngu sab'a ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ètu kota yerusalem.

source_text: following their custom, the other priests chose him by lot to enter the lord's temple and burn incense.
target_text: madhutu atora ama agama, hud'i ère lot, ho re'a cee ka dhu maso asa kama mola-mèci dhu ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ètu era èèna, dhèu ne hud'i pasèbu ai pake aj'u hèu mèngi ètu madha ama lamatua. lod'o èèna, sakaria lèke lot.

source_text: while he was burning the incense, many people were outside in the courtyard, praying.
target_text: hèia la'e dènge ka asa d'ara. nèngu dhu talora pasèbu ai ètu d'ara kama èèna, dhèu ae-ae dhu sabaj'a ètu madha èmu.

source_text: then an angel whom god had sent appeared to him. the angel was standing at the right side of the place where the priests burned incense.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, ana pajuu ama lamatua ca dhèu nèti sorga titu re bèka g'ana era tunu aj'u hèu mèngi ne.

source_text: when zechariah saw the angel, he was startled and became very afraid.
target_text: ropa ladhe nèdhi, sakaria madha'u titu kèna, ka ne'a heka tao sèmi ngaa.

source_text: but the angel said to him, zechariah, do not be afraid! when you sg prayed asking god for a son or, that god would send the messiah, god heard what you prayed. so your wife elizabeth shall bear a son. you must name him john.
target_text: te ngaa ana pajuu ne lii, aku nèngu na, sakaria! baku madha'u! te ama lamatua tadèngi le lii manèngi-mangaj'i èu. de bèli-camèd'a, dhèu èmu èu nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. èu hud'i pangare ne, yohanis.

source_text: he will cause you to be very happy, and many other people will also be happy because he is born.
target_text: èèna na dhèu ae karej'e kahèi sama-sama dènge miu, lula miu abhu ana. bèli-camèd'a, ana ne pakarej'e d'ara èu.

source_text: god will consider him to be very important. he must never drink wine or any other alcoholic drink, in order that he will be completely dedicated to god. he will be controlled by the holy spirit {the holy spirit will control him} from before he is born.
target_text: koasa nèti roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci, bera-bera dènge ne, karèi nèti ina na kad'o nèngu era. nèngu ne hud'i luri ninu dhua ara-dhua pèd'u. ropa na kapai, ama lamatua pake ne j'aj'i dhèu dhu dènge kolongara.

source_text: he will persuade many people in israel to turn away from their sins and please the lord their god.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a èèna pamako nare dhèu isra'el ae-ae, ho ra lèpa hari asa ama lamatua rèngu.

source_text: as god's spirit enables him to preach powerfully as the prophet elijah did, he will precede the messiah. he will cause parents syn to act peacefully toward their children again. he will cause many people who do not obey god to hear and obey the wise things that righteous people tell them. he will do this in order to help many people to be ready when the lord comes.
target_text: tatao dènge koasa na nuka sèmi elia, ca dhèu dhu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua karèi uru. nèngu ne mai uuru nèti lamatua èdhi. nèngu ne bisa kabèli d'ara ina-ama, ho sue hari ana-ana ra. aa dhèu dhu rai nèti madha lamatua, na ad'u si ho ra lèpa hari madhutu dad'èi lamatua. nèti sèmi èèna, nèngu tao dhèu sèna ka sadia d'ara ra sèmi mamai lamatua.

source_text: then zechariah said to the angel, i am very old, and my wife is also so old that she cannot bear a child. so ◄i cannot believe that what you sg said will happen! /how can i believe that what you sg said will happen? ► rhq
target_text: te ngaa sakaria karèi ana pajuu ne, aku nèngu na, bisa boe, sina ma? ! ja'a dènge dhèu èmu ja'a, d'ara heka sèmi ne'e ne! tasamia ja'a bisa ke'a, na, j'ara se bisa j'aj'i?

source_text: then the angel said to him, i am god's chief angel, gabriel! i do what god tells me, because i constantly am in god's presence! i was sent {he sent me} to tell you sg something good that is going to happen to you.
target_text: ka ana pajuu ne dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e! ja'a ne gabriel, dhèu pajuu ama lamatua. nèngu ka paleha ja'a mai, sèna ka peka dènge èu lii lolo dhu be'a ne.

source_text: what i have told you will certainly happen at the time god decides, but you did not believe what i told you. so now god will make you will be unable to talk until the day your son is born!
target_text: te ngaa èu mo'o boe lèka lii padhai ja'a ne. de tadha dhu èu manèngi, sèmi ne'e! he'o èu èèna na sakaa, ho èu bisa heka padhai lii, nèti deo ne'e ne, toke miu abhu ana. pe èu mèdhi unu mu. te ngaa dhu ja'a peka ne, bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i, lèke dènge lod'o na.

source_text: while zechariah and the angel were talking, the people in the courtyard were waiting for zechariah to come out. they wondered, why is he staying in the temple for such a long time?
target_text: dhèu-dhèu dhu sabaj'a ètu li'u sèra, bingu titu kèna, lula sakaria tao bhodho boe.

source_text: when zechariah came out, he was not able to speak to the people. because he could not talk, he made motions with his hands to try to convey what had happened. then they realized that he had seen ◄a vision from god/something that god showed him► while he was in the temple.
target_text: ropa na kalua mai, nèngu bisa heka padhai lii. ka na hia tadha re kacui-aai na, heka dhèu se'e re'a, na, lamatua hia tanila ropa nèngu ètu d'ara kama mola-mèci èèna.

source_text: when zechariah's time to work as a priest in the temple was finished, he left jerusalem and returned to his home.
target_text: ropa èle sasab'a ra, hèia sakaria lèpa asa èmu na.

source_text: some time later his wife elizabeth became pregnant eup. she did not leave their house for five months, because she knew that people would laugh at her if she told them that she was pregnant. but she thought, god has enabled me to become pregnant. he has pitied me and i will no longer be ashamed because i have no children!
target_text: nèbhu boe ka elisabet dènge babia. ka na pea dhoka ètu d'ara èmu toke lèmi hèru. na peka, aku nèngu na, koa-kio lamatua! lod'o d'ai kèna, lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a. ladhe ja'a ne dènge ka kolo, dhèu pamakae heka ja'a.

source_text: when elizabeth had been pregnant eup for almost six months, the angel gabriel was sent by god {god sent the angel gabriel} again.
target_text: ropa elisabet dènge babia d'ai èna hèru, hèia ama lamatua pua ana pajuu na nèti sorga, la'e asa rae cue ètu propensi galilea, ngara na nasaret. ngara ana pajuu ne, gabriel.

source_text: this time he went to nazareth town in galilee district, to a virgin whose name was mary. it had been {her parents had} promised that she would marry a man named joseph, who was descended from king david.

source_text: but i say this to each of you disciples who are listening to what i say: love your enemies as well as your friends. do good things for those who hate you!

source_text: if you lend things or money only to those who you expect will give something back to you, do not expect that god will reward you rhq for doing that. even sinners lend to other sinners, because they expect them to pay everything back.

source_text: instead, love your enemies! do good things for them! lend to them, and do not expect them to pay anything back! if you do that, god will give you a big reward. and you will be acting like his children should. remember that god is kind to people who are not grateful and to people who are wicked, and he expects you to be like that too.

source_text: act mercifully toward others, just like your father in heaven acts mercifully toward you.

source_text: just like you can tell if a tree is good or bad by looking at its fruit, you can tell which people are good and which are bad by looking at the way they conduct their lives. for example, because thornbushes cannot produce figs, no one can pick figs from thornbushes. and since bramble bushes cannot produce grapes, no one can pick grapes from bramble bushes.

source_text: the disciples of john the baptizer went to the prison where john was and told him about those things. so one day john summoned two of his disciples and told them to go to the lord and ask him: are you the messiah who the prophets prophesied would come, or is it someone else that we should expect to come? when those two men came to jesus, they said, john the baptizer sent us to ask you sg this: are you the messiah that we are expecting god to send, or shall we exc expect someone else?

source_text: at that very time jesus was healing many people of their diseases and other sicknesses, he was casting out evil spirits, and he was causing many blind people to be able to see.
