source_text: jesus had said previously that people did not honor prophets like himself when they tried to teach people in their own home area. so, two days later, jesus and we disciples left that area and went to his own area in galilee district, because he knew that people there would not think very highly of him, and as a result the jewish leaders would not be jealous.
target_text: hèia yesus si tèke eele era èèna, pakèd'i lasi asa propensi galilea. ca tèka yesus dhu peka nèdhi, na, dhèu d'èi boe pakab'ua dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua nèti rae èta-èsu na.

source_text: however, when we arrived in galilee district, many of the people there welcomed him, because they had been in jerusalem during the passover celebration and had seen all the things he did there.
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o dhèu dhae tao mèka kalela paska, dhèu galilea ae ka dhu lasi asa yerusalem, sèna ka tao lod'o hua iia ètu nèi. ka rèdhi aa'i-aa'i kahèi dhu yesus tao ètu yerusalem. nèti èèna ka, lod'o na lèpa asa galilea, dhèu sèmi ne dènge be'a.

source_text: jesus went again to cana in galilee district. that was where he previously turned water into wine. there was one of the king's officials who lived in capernaum, whose son was very sick.
target_text: ka yesus si lasi hari asa rae kana ètu propensi galilea. ètu era ne'e ka dhu yesus tao nèdhi èi j'aj'i anggor. lod'o èèna, abhu pegawi ca dhèu dhu pea ètu kota kapernaum. ana mone na dhu pèd'a.

source_text: when that man heard others say that jesus had returned to galilee district from judea district, he went to jesus in cana and pleaded with him, please come down to capernaum and heal my son, who is about to die!
target_text: ropa pegawi ne tadèngi, yesus lèpa le asa galilea nèti propensi yudea, hèia ca'e la'e asa rae kana ho tenge yesus. ropa paraga dènge ne, ka na pamako, sèna ka yesus puru la'e ho puri-pa'èle ana na nèti papèd'a-tarègu. te ana ne dhu pèd'a oe madhe.

source_text: jesus said to him, you people will believe my message only if you see me perform more miracles!
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge pegawi ne, ladhe miu mèdhi boe tadha-tadha malaa dhu ja'a tao, na, miu mo'o boe lèka ja'a!

source_text: but the official said to him, sir, ◄i believe in you/i believe that you came from god►. so please come down to my home before my son dies!
target_text: te ngaa pegawi ne dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama, lati ku laa. te aad'o, na, ana ja'a madhe.

source_text: jesus said to him, then you may go home. your son ◄will live/not die►! the man believed what jesus said, and left.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge ne, lèpa ka. te ana mu mamuri. ka na lèpa dènge ka, lula nèngu parcaya lii padhai yesus.

source_text: the next day while he was on the way home, his servants met him. they told him, your child is going to live!
target_text: ropa pegawi ne ètu talora j'ara era, dhèu-dhèu sab'a na mai paraga dènge ne, ka ra peka na, ama susa ia ka, te ana ama èle le nèti papèd'a.

source_text: he asked them, at what time did my son start to become well? they said to him, his fever ceased yesterday afternoon at one o'clock.
target_text: ka na karèi si, na èle, d'ara hake pèri sa? ka dhèu se dhaa, peka na, karèi med'a, lod'o titu mera d'ara hake èci sa, maringi-sagoro na èle dènge ka.

source_text: then the boy's father realized that this was the time jesus told him, your son will ◄live/not die►. so he and all the people in his house believed that jesus was the messiah.
target_text: hèia pegawi ne ngee nèdhi dènge, na, ana na be'a le, ropa yesus peka na, ana ama èle le nèti papèd'a. ka pegawi ne, dènge isi èmu na aa'i-aa'i parcaya yesus.

source_text: that was the second miracle that jesus performed in galilee district, after he had returned from judea district.
target_text: de ne'e ne, tadha malaa ka dua dhu yesus tao, lod'o na kalua nèti yudea la'e asa galilea.

source_text: some time later, jesus went up to jerusalem when the jews were having another celebration.
target_text: nèbhu boe nèti èèna, abhu lod'o hua iia agama yahudi. ka yesus si lasi asa kota yerusalem.

source_text: at one of the gates into the city called the sheep gate, there is a pool. in our language we call it bethzatha. around the pool were five open areas with roofs over them.
target_text: ètu nèi, abhu kolam cue dhu dènge lèmi teras dhu padètu dènge hèb'a babèdho èci, dhu dhèu peka na, babèdho kahib'i-kalèbho. dènge lii aram kolam ne, ngara na ‘batesda'.

source_text: many people were lying there. they were people who were blind, lame, or paralyzed.
target_text: dhèu pèd'a ae-ae dhu tema mate ètu teras se'e. dhèu pèd'a se nuka sèmi: dhèu bèdhu, dhèu karuku, dènge dhèu bisa boe eso. rèngu se mate, ladhe pèri lod'o èi ne mulai dènge gagèb'o. te ca tèka-tèka, ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga maso uru asa d'ara èi ne, ho na gagèb'o èi ne. ho ladhe cee dhu maso uru asa d'ara èi ne, papèd'a nèngu èle dènge.

source_text: one of those who was there had been paralyzed for 38 years.
target_text: ètu era ne'e abhu ca dhèu dhu pèd'a tèlu nguru aru tèu le.

source_text: jesus saw him lying there and found out that the man had been like that for a long time. he said to the man, do you want to become well?
target_text: hèia yesus ladhe nèdhi dhèu ne j'unu ètu èèna. nèngu ne'a dhèu ne dhu pèd'a nèbhu le, ka na karèi ne, aku nèngu na, èu neo èle nèti papèd'a, do?

source_text: the paralyzed man replied to him, yes, sir, i want to get well, but there is no one to help me get down into the pool when the water is stirred {stirs}. while i am trying to get to the pool, someone else always gets there before me.
target_text: hèia dhèu ne dhaa, na, ko'o, ama. te ngaa ako carui ka, ladhe èi ne mulai gagèb'o, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu ded'e ja'a ho pamaso asa d'ara èi ne. ladhe ja'a sèku maso, na, abhu le dhèu leo dhu maso uuru nèti ja'a.

source_text: jesus said to him, get up! then pick up your mat and walk!
target_text: ka yesus pua ne, aku nèngu na, titu ka! lulu dhèpi èu, ho lèpa ka.

source_text: the man immediately was healed. he picked up his mat and started walking! the day on which this happened was a jewish day of rest.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii nare, hèia dhèu ne èle dènge ka nèti karuku na. ka na kèd'i, ded'e nèti dhèpi na, hèia la'e dènge ka. j'ara ne j'aj'i, lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a dhèu yahudi.

source_text: so the jewish leaders said to the man who had been healed, today is ◄the sabbath/our rest day►, and in our jewish laws it is written that people should not work on our ◄sabbath/rest day►, so you should not be carrying your mat!
target_text: ka ama-ama dhèu yahudi jèke dhèu dhu heka èle nèti papèd'a ne, aku rèngu na, weh! èu me'a, do aad'o? doe ne'e ne, lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a. madhutu atora agama èdhi, dhèu bisa boe nedhe dhèpi na, te èèna ngara na, sasab'a!

source_text: the man replied to them, the man who healed me, he himself said to me, ‘pick up your mat and walk! '
target_text: ka na dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama-ama! baku nasa dènge ja'a. te dhèu dhu puri-pa'èle ja'a, dhu paredha ja'a peka na, ‘lulu dhèpi èu, ho lèpa ka. '

source_text: they asked him, who is the man who said to you, ‘pick it up and walk! '?
target_text: hèia dhèu se karèi ne, cee ka dhu pua èu nedhe dhèpi èèna?

source_text: but since jesus had disappeared in the crowd without telling the man his name, the man did not know who it was who had healed him.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu èle nèti pèd'a ne, tadhe boe, na, yesus ne, cee. te yesus dhu kalua le mau-mau, lula dhèu ae ètu èèna.

source_text: later, jesus found the man in the temple courtyard. he told the man his name, and said to him, listen! you are healed! so stop sinning! if you do not stop sinning, something will happen to you that will be worse than the illness you had before!
target_text: nèbhu boe, ka yesus paraga dènge dhèu ne ètu madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ka yesus peka dènge ne, aku nèngu na, nanene! èu èle le nèti papèd'a èu. baku ad'u-ue hari sasala, sèna ka èu baku abhu hari j'aj'èra dhu bia risi.

source_text: the man went away and told the jewish leaders syn that it was jesus who had healed him.
target_text: hèia dhèu ne la'e asa ama-ama dhèu yahudi se, ka na lolo, peka na, dhu puri-pa'èle ja'a nèti papèd'a èèna, ngara na yesus.

source_text: so the jewish leaders syn started to harass jesus, because jesus was doing these things ◄on the sabbath/on the jewish rest day►.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ra mulai paj'èra yesus, lula nèngu pa'èle dhèu pèd'a lèke dènge lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: then jesus replied to them, my father has always been working every day, including ◄the sabbath/the day of rest►, up until now. i am doing the same thing!
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka dènge ra, sèmi ne'e. ama ku ae boe nèti sasab'a-la'a na. de ja'a sab'a taruu kahèi.

source_text: the jewish leaders syn considered that he was disobeying their rules about ◄the sabbath/the day of rest►, and that by saying that god was his father, he was making himself equal with god. and they considered that both these things were grounds for killing him. so they tried even harder to find a way to kill him.
target_text: lula ama-ama dhèu yahudi se cap le, peka na, yesus sisu atora lod'o ae sasab'a rèngu, nèti èèna ka ra tenge-tenge j'ara tasamia, ho pamadhe ne. risi-risi hari, na peka na, ama lamatua èèna, ama nèngu. dènge lii padhai sèmi ne'e, nèngu tao iisi na sama sèmi ama lamatua.

source_text: jesus replied to them by saying, you need to know this: i can do nothing by my own authority. i do only the kind of things that i see my father doing. whatever kinds of things my father is doing, those are the things i am doing.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, tare'a! ja'a peka mema, na, ja'a bisa boe tao ngaa-ngaa madhutu d'ara ja'a unu ku. te ja'a ne, ana ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka ja'a bisa sab'a dhodhoka madhutu ngaa dhu ja'a kèdhi ama ku sab'a. ja'a kèdhi ama ku tao ngaa, na, ja'a tao madhutu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: my father loves me, and he shows me everything that he is doing. he will show me the miracles that he wants me to do that will be greater than the ones that you have already seen me do, so that you may be amazed.
target_text: ama ku ètu sorga sue ja'a, nuka ana na. na pad'elo dènge ja'a kahèi aa'i-aa'i dhu nèngu tao. na neo pad'elo dènge ja'a j'ara-j'ara dhu kapai risi hari, sèna ka miu mèdhi aa asa tabha malaa!

source_text: for example, just like my father causes people who have died to become alive again, i will give eternal life to everyone that i want to.
target_text: ama ku pamamuri hari dhèu madhe. sèmi èèna kahèi, bèli-camèd'a ja'a hia mamuri dhu lèke mi cee èèna ka dhu madhutu dad'èi ja'a.

source_text: furthermore, my father is not the one who judges people concerning their sins. instead, he has given to me the work of judging people,
target_text: dhu mola-mola, sèmi ne'e ka: ama ku mesa na pama'ète boe hahuku mi dhèu. te ngaa na pangèd'u aa'i hak èèna mi ja'a, te ja'a ne, ana na. hèia ja'a ka dhu pama'ète, na, tatao dhèu lèke, do aad'o.

source_text: in order that all people may honor me, just like they honor my father. my father considers that anyone who does not honor me is not honoring him, the one who sent me.
target_text: ama ku d'èi sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i pakab'ua ja'a, sama sèmi rèngu pakab'ua nèngu kahèi. te dhèu dhu pakab'ua boe ja'a, ana nèngu ne, èci èèna ka rèngu pakab'ua boe ama ku dhu pua ja'a mai.

source_text: listen to this carefully: those who hear my message and believe that god is the one who sent me have eternal life. god will not ◄condemn them/say that he will punish them►. they are no longer separated from god. instead, they have eternal life.
target_text: tare'a! ja'a peka mema. dhèu dhu tare'a-re'a nanene lii padhai ja'a, aa parcaya ama lamatua dhu pua ja'a mai, na, nèngu abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. lamatua huku heka nèngu. te dhèu èèna abhu heka hahuku madhe, te ngaa nèngu j'aj'i le dhèu dhu mamuri taruu dènge lamatua.

source_text: listen to this carefully: there will be a time when those who are ◄spiritually dead/separated from god► will hear the voice of me, ◄the son of god/the man who is also god►. in fact, it is that time already. those who hear and pay attention to my message will have eternal life.
target_text: tare'a! ja'a peka mema dènge miu kèna. lod'o na dètu le, limuri ne dhu j'aj'i le, nuka dhèu-dhèu madhe nanene lii ja'a, ana ama lamatua. te dhèu dhu nanene dènge sèmi nare lii padhai ja'a, nèngu abhu mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: my father has power to make things live. similarly, he has given me the power to enable people to live eternally.
target_text: mamuri aa'i-aa'i kapua na nèti ama ku. nèngu hia ja'a mamuri dhu lèke kahèi. te ja'a ne, ana na.

source_text: because i am the one who came from heaven, he has given me the authority to judge people concerning their sins.
target_text: ama ku pangèd'u koasa dènge hak mi ja'a kahèi, sèna ka pama'ète hahuku mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, lula ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a.

source_text: do not be surprised about that, because there will be a time when all people who have died will hear my voice,
target_text: miu baku malaa, te ciki oo'e hari dhèu madhe aa'i-aa'i ra tadèngi lii padhai ja'a.

source_text: and they will become alive again. those who have lived good lives will rise from their graves and live forever. but those who have lived evil lives will rise, and i will ◄condemn them/declare that i will punish them for their sins►.
target_text: hèia ra mamuri hari. ka rèngu kalua nèti d'ara ro'a ra. dhèu dhu uru sèra tao be'a, abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. te ngaa dhèu dhu uru sèra ad'u-ue bhabhelu-katub'a, pasae hahuku taruu.

source_text: i do not do anything like that by my own authority. i judge people only according to what i hear my father tell me. i will judge people fairly, because i do not want to please only myself. instead, i want to please my father, who sent me.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, ja'a bisa boe tao ngaa-ngaa ladhe dhae tadèngi mèka nèti ama ku. ladhe ja'a tadèngi kore ku, heka ja'a pama'ète lii langu dhèu kèna. nèti èèna ka, ngaa dhu ja'a pama'ète sèra, lèke mola-mola. te ja'a ko'o boe madhutu dad'èi ja'a mesa ku, te ngaa ja'a madhutu dad'èi ama ku. lula nèngu ka dhu pua ja'a mai!

source_text: if i were the only one to tell people about myself, people could rightly say that what i say is not true.
target_text: lèke iia boe, ladhe ja'a mesa ku dhu padhue-padhai lula-nèti ngi'u ja'a.

source_text: but there is someone else who tells people about me. and i know that what he tells people about me is true.
target_text: te ngaa abhu dhèu leo kahèi dhu j'aj'i sakasii lula-nèti ja'a. aa ja'a ke'a lii padhai nèngu lula-nèti ja'a, lèke tare'a-re'a.

source_text: as for you, when you sent messengers to john the baptizer to ask about me, he told the truth about me.
target_text: miu dhu pua mèdhi dhèu lasi pakarèi dènge yohanis tuka sarani. ka na peka lèke lula-nèti ja'a ne.

source_text: i do not need that people tell others about me. but instead, i am reminding you about what john told people about me, in order that you will believe it and be saved {god will save you}.
target_text: aa te ngaa ja'a parluu boe lii sakasii nèti dhèu rai-haha. te ngaa ja'a pasanèd'e lii se'e, sèna ka miu bisa pakaj'èu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo miu.

source_text: john's message about me or, john met was like a lamp that shines brightly. for a short while you were willing to be made happy by that message {to let that message make you happy}.
target_text: lii padhai yohanis ne, nuka sèmi labhu èci dhu heo pasaraa miu. ropa heo na d'elo miu era, d'ara miu karej'e-karae.

source_text: but there is something else that tells you about me. it should prove who i am more than what john said about me. the miracles prs that my father told me to do, the miracles that i am performing, show or, prove to people that my father sent me.
target_text: aa te ngaa ja'a abhu dhèu èci dhu kapai risi eele nèti yohanis dhu peka mola-mola lula-nèti ja'a ne. nèngu, nuka ama ku ètu sorga, dhu pangèd'u mi ja'a sasab'a ae-ae, sèna ka sab'a toke pa'èle. sasab'a ae se'e ka dhu j'aj'i mi tadha, na, ama ka dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: furthermore, my father, who sent me, tells people about me. you have never heard his voice or seen him.
target_text: lula nèngu ka dhu pua-paleha ja'a, nèngu ka dhu peka mola-mola lula-nèti ja'a kahèi. miu mesa mi tadèngi mèdhi mèka lii nèngu, do, patoo madha dènge madha, aa ladhe mèdhi mèka rèhu na.

source_text: furthermore, you have not believed in me, the one he sent. so you have not believed his message in your inner beings.
target_text: lii holo-nori lamatua mamuri boe ètu d'ara miu, lula miu parcaya boe ja'a dhu nèngu pua mai.

source_text: you carefully study or, study the scriptures, because you think that by studying them you will find the way to have eternal life. and those scriptures tell people about me!
target_text: miu d'èi parisa toke lutu sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, lula miu pangee, na, bèli-camèd'a miu abhu j'ara ho abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. aa te ngaa sasuri sèra ka dhu lole lula-nèti ja'a ne.

source_text: but you refuse ◄to come to me/to believe my message► in order that you may have eternal life.
target_text: te ngaa miu mo'o boe ara mai asa ja'a, ho j'aj'i dhèu ja'a, sèna ka abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe.

source_text: it does not matter to me whether people praise me.
target_text: ja'a parluu boe dhèu ded'e kolongara ja'a padedha-dedha.

source_text: but you want people to praise you. i know that within yourselves you do not love god.
target_text: lula ja'a ke'a mèu d'ara iiki miu. nèti èèna ka ja'a ke'a, na, miu sue boe ama lamatua.

source_text: although i have come to earth with my father's authority mty, you do not accept me. but if someone else comes with his own authority mty, you accept him!
target_text: ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne, lula ama ku dhu nèd'u koasa ka pua ja'a mai. te ngaa miu mo'o boe sèmi mere ja'a. aa te ngaa ladhe dhèu leo dhu mai pake koasa nèngu, miu sèmi mere ne dènge be'a.

source_text: you accept your praising each other, but you do not try to do things that will result in god himself praising you. so ◄there is no way you can believe in me! /how can you believe my message? ► rhq
target_text: miu èci dènge èci d'èi sèna ka abhu koa-kad'iri. te ngaa miu pusi-pahae boe, ladhe ama lamatua koa miu, do aad'o. aa te ngaa nèngu èèna, ama lamatua! abhu boe dhu leo. de ladhe miu pahae boe ne, na, tasamia miu bisa parcaya nèngu?

source_text: but do not think that i am the one who will accuse you while my father is listening! no, it is moses who will accuse you! you thought that he would defend you.
target_text: baku pangee, na, ja'a pèci sasala mi dedha miu ètu katanga madha ama ku. aad'o. dhu pèci sasala sa dedha miu nuka musa. aa te ngaa, era maena miu ka nèngu, lula nèngu ka dhu hia miu atora ama lamatua.

source_text: moses wrote about me, so if you had believed what he wrote, you would have believed what i said
target_text: de ladhe miu lèka musa, tatu miu parcaya ja'a tare'a-re'a. te nèngu ka dhu suri lula-nèti ja'a ne.

source_text: but because you did not believe what he wrote about me, ◄you will certainly not believe what i say! /how will you believe what i say? ► rhq
target_text: te ngaa lula miu parcaya èra boe mi ngaa dhu na suri, tasamia ka miu bisa lèka ngaa dhu ja'a peka-padhai? aad'o, sina ma?

source_text: some time later, when jesus was in galilee district, near the time of the jewish passover celebration, jesus went with us disciples by boat and crossed to another place along galilee lake. this lake is also called tiberias lake. a large crowd of people kept following jesus on land because they had been seeing the miracles he performed by healing sick people. jesus went up on the hillside and sat down with us disciples to teach us. then he looked up and saw a great crowd of people coming toward him.
target_text: lod'o kalela paska dhèu yahudi oe dètu. hèia yesus si lasi asa cabèka dano galilea. ngara leo dano ne, ‘dano tiberias'. dhèu ae dhu madhutu ne, lula rèdhi tadha-tadha malaa dhu na tao, lod'o puri-pa'èle dhèu-dhèu pèd'a. d'ai cabèka dano, yesus dènge ana-ana madhutu na ca'e asa ledhe iiki èci. hèia ra madhèdi ètu era èèna.

source_text: he said to philip, where will we buy food for all these people to eat?
target_text: ropa yesus ladhe nèdhi dhèu ae mai pakaboko, hèia na karèi ana madhutu na ca dhèu, ngara na pelipus, aku nèngu na, ètu era mia èdhi bisa hèli nganga'a, ho hia dhèu se ra'a?

source_text: he asked this only to find out if philip believed what jesus could do, because jesus already knew what he himself was going to do.
target_text: yesus ne'a le ngaa dhu nèngu neo tao. te ngaa na peka sèmi èèna, sèna ka neo sèku pelipus.

source_text: philip replied to him, even if we had the amount of money a man earns in eight months, that would not be enough to buy bread so that each person could have a little bit!
target_text: ka pelipus dhaa, na, waa! masi ka gaji tuka ca dhèu dua ngasu lod'o èèna ka, d'ai mèka hèli roti ho panga'a dhèu udhu sobhu-sobhu se! masi ka ca dhèu abhu roti ciki oo'e èèna ka, pad'ai boe hèi!

source_text: another one of us disciples, andrew, who was simon peter's younger brother, said to jesus,

source_text: the jewish leaders syn gathered around him and said, how long will you keep us from knowing for sure if you are the messiah? if you are the messiah, tell us clearly!
target_text: hèia ama-ama dhèu yahudi mai lingu rare ne, ka ra peka, eeh! ji'i se mate toke d'ai pèri lod'o hari, ho nge'a? ladhe èu ne, nuka kristus, na, peka mola-mola.

source_text: jesus answered them, i have told you that i am the messiah, but you do not believe me! you should know who i am because of the miracles i do with my father's authority mty.
target_text: yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, ja'a dhu peka mema le, te ngaa miu mo'o boe lèka. aa te ngaa j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a tao, aa'i-aa'i madhutu paredha ama ku di. j'ara se'e se ka dhu pad'elo, na, ja'a ne, cee.

source_text: but instead, you do not believe in me because you do not belong to me. you are like met sheep who belong to a different shepherd.
target_text: te ngaa miu mo'o boe lèka ja'a, lula miu se kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a boe.

source_text: just like sheep heed the voice of their true shepherd met, my people pay attention to what i say. i know them, and they have become my disciples.
target_text: te kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a dhu tare'a sèra, tadhe lii ja'a. rèngu madhutu ja'a, aa ja'a tadhe rèngu kahèi.

source_text: i will give them eternal life. no one will separate them from me, not ever. no one shall ever pull them away from belonging to me.
target_text: ja'a hia si mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe, aa rèngu cèri eele boe nèti ama lamatua kahèi. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa parame rare si nèti ja'a.

source_text: those that my father has given to me are more precious than anything else or, my father, who has given them to me, is greater than anything that opposes them. so no one can pull them away from belonging to him mty.
target_text: ama ku ètu sorga ka dhu pangèd'u rèngu mi ja'a. nèngu èra risi aa'i mèu-mèu. nèti èèna ka, abhu boe ca dhèu sa hèi, dhu bisa parame rare si nèti nèngu.

source_text: my father and i are equal.
target_text: te ama ku dènge ja'a ne, èci.

source_text: the jewish leaders syn again picked up stones to throw at jesus and kill him because they were angry at his saying that he was equal with god.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare, hèia ama-ama dhèu yahudi se rare hari hadhu, neo pèci pamadhe yesus.

source_text: but jesus said to them, you have seen me perform many miracles that my father told me to do. you should realize from seeing them that i am equal with god. so, because of which of these miracles iro are you wanting to kill me by throwing stones at me?
target_text: ka yesus padhai lii, aku nèngu na, ja'a pad'elo le j'ara dhu be'a ae-ae nèti ama ku. miu pake j'ara be'a mia, ho neo pèci pamadhe ja'a?

source_text: the jewish leaders syn replied, we are wanting to throw stones at you not because you performed a great miracle. instead, we are wanting to do it because you are dishonoring god. you are just a man, but you are saying that you are god!
target_text: hèia dhèu se dhaa, peka na, ji'i pèci boe èu lula èu tao j'ara be'a. te ngaa ji'i huku èu dènge j'ara pèci pake hadhu, lula èu pahahe ama lamatua. te èu dhoka dhèu rai-haha di, te ngaa tao iisi mu nuka sèmi ama lamatua! seli-kolane, nga!

source_text: jesus replied to them, in the scriptures it is written {◄someone/the psalmist► has written} rhq what god said to the rulers whom he had appointed, ‘i have said that you are like gods. '
target_text: ka yesus b'ala, peka na, tasamia? ètu d'ara atora agama dhu miu mèd'u, dhu suri na, ‘ja'a peka mema, na, miu ama-ama se, dewa'.

source_text: god said that to those leaders when he appointed them. no one objected to that. and nothing that is in scripture can be set aside {no one can set aside anything that is in scripture}.
target_text: èdhi te'a le, na, aa'i-aa'i dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, lèke, aa bisa boe core eele. ama lamatua mesa na dhu peka le dhèu sèra, na, rèngu se, ‘dewa'.

source_text: but i am the one my father set apart to completely belong to him. he sent me here into this world. so ◄why are you angry with me for saying that i am equal with god when i say that i am the man who is also god? /you should not be angry with me for saying that i am equal with god when i say that i am the person who is both god and man! ► rhq
target_text: de tasamia ka miu bisa peka, na, ja'a ne pahahe ama lamatua lula ja'a peka, na, ja'a ne ana ama lamatua? maso boe asa d'ara kahadhu, si! te ama ètu sorga ka dhu paj'uj'u ja'a aa pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: if i were not doing the miracles that my father told me to do, i would not expect you to believe in me.
target_text: sèmi ne'e. ladhe ja'a pakako boe sasab'a-la'a ama ku, na, miu baku parcaya ja'a.

source_text: but because i perform these miracles, believe what these miracles show about me, even though you do not believe what i say. if you do that, then you will know and understand that my father has a close relationship with me, and i have a close relationship with my father.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a pakako taruu sasab'a ama ku. de masi ka miu lèka boe ja'a, te ngaa miu hud'i sèmi mere ku tadha malaa dhu ja'a tao. dènge sèmi èèna, miu bisa me'a kahèi, na, ama ku dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a. aa ja'a pa'èki dènge nèngu kahèi.

source_text: after they heard that, they tried to seize him again, but he got away from them.
target_text: ka dhèu se sèku kèpe ne hari, te ngaa na tabhèli eele nèti kacui-aai rèngu.

source_text: then jesus went, along with us, back across to the east side of the jordan river. we went to the place where john was previously baptizing people. he/we stayed there for a few weeks.
target_text: hèia yesus la'e hari asa cabèka loko yarden, ètu era dhu uru èèna yohanis sarani dhèu. ka na pea taha ètu nèi.

source_text: many people came to jesus. they were saying, john never performed a miracle, but this man has performed many miracles! everything that john said about this man is true!
target_text: dhèu ae mai tenge ne. hèia ra peka, aku rèngu na, yohanis tao nèdhi boe tadha malaa. te ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu nèngu lole lula-nèti yesus ne, lèke tare'a-re'a!

source_text: many people who came there believed ◄that jesus was the messiah/that jesus truly had come from god►.
target_text: ka dhèu ae ètu nèi parcaya yesus.

source_text: one time there was a man whose name was lazarus who was very sick. he lived in bethany village, where his older sisters mary and martha also lived. mary was the woman who later poured perfume on the feet of the lord jesus, and then wiped his feet with her hair.
target_text: abhu dhèu èci, ngara na lasarus. nèngu pea ètu rae betania, sama-sama dènge a'a na bhèni dhèu dua, maria dènge marta. maria ne'e, ka dhu pakose haga lamatua yesus dènge èi hèu mèngi, ka pamèu pake rèu kètu na. ca lod'o, ka lasarus pèd'a aae.

source_text: so the two sisters sent someone to tell jesus about lazarus, saying, lord, the one you love very much is very sick.
target_text: ka ana hèni na dhèu dua se pa'adhu lii moa hia yesus, aku rèngu na, lasarus, angalai ama èèna, pèd'a aae.

source_text: they hoped that jesus would come, but when jesus heard the message, he said, his being sick will not end in his dying. instead, it will result in people realizing how great god is, and that i, god's son, may be honored {that people may honor me, god's son}, because of what i will do.
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi lii moa ne, hèia na lii, aku nèngu na, èi papèd'a ne nèti boe mamadhe. ama lamatua neo pake j'ara ne'e ho pad'elo dadedha na. sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ded'e padedha-dedha ja'a, nuka ana ama lamatua ne.

source_text: jesus loved martha and her younger sister mary and lazarus.
target_text: yesus sue marta, maria, dènge ari ra lasarus.

source_text: but when jesus heard that lazarus was sick, he stayed where he was for two more days.
target_text: lod'o na tadèngi, na, lasarus dhu pèd'a, yesus pea dua lod'o era ètu cabèka loko yarden.

source_text: but jesus wanted to see lazarus. so he said to us disciples, let's go back to judea.
target_text: ka na peka dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, mai lati hari asa era pea lasarus ètu propensi yudea.

source_text: we said, teacher, just a short while ago the jewish leaders syn wanted to kill you by throwing stones at you. so ◄we think that you should not go back there again! /are you sure that you want to go back there again? ► rhq
target_text: te ngaa ana madhutu na pab'ala, peka na, ama mese. lai-lai ne, ama-ama dhèu yahudi sèra neo pèci pamadhe ama ètu nèi. te ngaa ama neo lamu hari asa nèi?

source_text: to show us that nothing bad could happen to him until the time that god had chosen met, jesus replied, there are rhq twelve hours in the daytime, which is enough time to do what god wants us to do. people who walk in the daytime will not stumble over things they cannot see, because they see things by the light from the sun.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, na, baku madha'u! bèli-bèli, nèti lod'o rea toke lod'o cèna, canguru dua jam, si? ladhe kako ètu d'ara saraa, dhèu kadhunu boe. te saraa pasaraa rai-haha ho dhèu bisa ladhe rèdhi dènge be'a.

source_text: it is when people walk in the nighttime that they stumble over things, because they have no light.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe dhèu kako ètu d'ara maroga, na kadhunu pahari-pahari, te dènge boe saraa.

source_text: after he said that, he told us, our friend lazarus has gone to sleep. but i will go there so that i can wake him up.
target_text: yesus padhai lii èle, ka na peka, angalai èdhi lasarus bhèj'i le. te ngaa pe ja'a laku parèi ne.

source_text: so we said to him, lord, if he is sleeping, he will get well. so you do not need to risk your life by going there.
target_text: hèia ana madhutu na peka, na, ama, ladhe nèngu bhèj'i di, sasoa na, èèna na nèngu èle nèti papèd'a, si?

source_text: jesus was speaking figuratively about lazarus' death, but we thought that he was talking about really being asleep.
target_text: ra peka sèmi èèna, lula rèngu ngee, na, yesus padhai lii lula-nèti bhèj'i dhu biasa di. aa te ngaa, yesus lole lula-nèti mamadhe lasarus.

source_text: so then he told us plainly, lazarus is dead.
target_text: hèia yesus peka mola-mola dènge ra, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e. lasarus madhe le.

source_text: but for your sake i am glad that i was not there when he died, because i want you to believe more firmly that i ◄am the messiah/came from god►. so now, instead of staying here, let's go to him.
target_text: aa te ngaa ja'a karej'e lula ja'a aad'o ètu nèi lod'o dhu na madhe mèka, sèna ka miu baku susa. te, ngaa dhu j'aj'i ne'e, èèna ka dhu tao miu bisa parcaya ja'a. mai lati ka!

source_text: then thomas, who was {whom they} called ‘the twin', said to the rest of us disciples, let's all go, so that we may die with jesus when his enemies kill him.
target_text: hèia tomas, dhu dhèu paroa, na, ana kembar, peka dènge ana madhutu dhu leo sèra, aku nèngu na, mai ka! be'a risi aa'i-aa'i ti lati, sèna ka madhe palere-lere dènge ne.

source_text: when we arrived close to bethany, someone told jesus that lazarus had died and had been buried and his body had been in the tomb for four days. bethany is less than ◄two miles/three kilometers► from jerusalem. many jews had come from jerusalem to console martha and mary over the death of their younger brother.
target_text: ka yesus si lasi asa rae betania. rae ne, kaj'èu nèti yerusalem tèlu kilometer di. ka dhèu yahudi nèti nèi, ae ka dhu mai beke, sèna ka pa'èra d'ara marta dènge maria. ropa yesus si d'ai nèi, heka re'a, na, dhèu padhane le lasarus èpa lod'o kèna.

source_text: when martha heard someone say that jesus was coming, she went along the road to meet him. but mary stayed in the house.
target_text: ka lod'o marta tadèngi, na, yesus mai le, hèia la'e paraga dènge yesus. te ngaa maria mate ètu èmu.

source_text: when martha got to where jesus was, she said to him, lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died because you would have healed him!
target_text: hèia marta lii dènge yesus, peka na, ama, ee! ladhe ama ètu ne'e, tatu ari ja'a madhe boe.

source_text: but i know that even now god will do for you whatever you ask concerning my brother.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a parcaya kahèi, sad'i ama manèngi ngaa èèna ka nèti ama lamatua, tatu abhu.

source_text: jesus said to her, your brother will become alive again!
target_text: ka yesus lii dènge ne, peka na, marta! èèna na, ari mu mamuri hari.

source_text: martha said to him, i know that he will become alive again when all people become alive again on the judgment day.
target_text: marta padhai lii, peka na, ja'a ke'a, pe d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne, ladhe ama lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu madhe aa'i-aa'i, nèngu pamamuri hari kahèi ari ja'a.

source_text: jesus said to her, i am the one who enables people to become alive again and who causes people to live eternally. those who believe in me, even if they die, will live again.
target_text: hèia yesus peka na, ja'a ka dhu hia dhèu madhe mamuri hari. ja'a ka dhu hia dhèu, mamuri dhu lèke kahèi. de dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a, abhu mamuri èèna, masi ka nèngu madhe.

source_text: furthermore, all those who believe in me while they are alive, their souls will not die forever. do you believe that?
target_text: ka dhèu dhu unu mamuri dhu lèke èèna, aa parcaya ja'a, bèli-camèd'a madhe boe, te ngaa mamuri taruu. marta, èu parcaya lii padhai ja'a ne, do?

source_text: she said to him, yes, lord! i believe that you are the messiah, ◄the son of god/the man who is also god►. you are the one god promised to send into the world!
target_text: hèia marta dhaa, na, oo, ama! ja'a parcaya, na, èu ne, nuka kristus, dhèu dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u mema karèi nèti uru ka. aa èu ne, ana ama lamatua dhu na padhadha tèke hia mai asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: after she said that, she returned to the house and took her younger sister, mary, aside and said to her, the teacher is close to our village, and he wants to talk to you.
target_text: ropa marta padhai lii nare, hèia na lèpa asa èmu na. ka na paroa ari na maria, sèna ka dua ra mesa-mesa ra. ka na peka, na, ama mese mai le. nèngu neo paraga dènge èu.

source_text: when mary heard that, she got up quickly and went to him. jesus had not yet entered the village; he was still at the place where martha met him. the jews who were in the house with mary, consoling her, saw mary get up quickly and go outside. so they followed her, thinking that she was going to the tomb where they had buried lazarus, in order to cry there.
target_text: ropa tadèngi sèmi èèna, hèia maria la'e dènge ka tenge yesus. ropa dhèu yahudi dhu beke dènge maria ètu d'ara èmu, rèdhi nèngu kèd'i sahèka, ka rai li'u la'e, hèia lasi madhutu ne re limuri. te rèngu pangee, na, maria la'e tangi asa ro'a lasarus. lod'o èèna, yesus si d'ai mèka d'ara rae. nèngu ètu era dhu marta paraga dènge ne.

source_text: when mary got to where jesus was and saw him, she prostrated herself at his feet and said, lord, if you had been here, my younger brother would not have died!
target_text: ropa maria la'e d'ai era èèna, ka ladhe nèdhi yesus. hèia na patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha yesus. ka na lii, aku nèngu na, ama! sèmi ama ètu ne'e, tatu ari ja'a madhe boe.

source_text: when jesus saw her crying, and saw that the jews who had come with her were also crying, he was very angry that satan had caused lazarus to die or, very troubled and disturbed in his spirit.
target_text: ropa yesus nèdhi maria tangi, aa dhèu yahudi dhu madhutu ne tangi kahèi, ka yesus nasa aa d'ara na susa.

source_text: he said, where have you buried ◄him/his body►? they said to him, lord, come and see.
target_text: hèia na karèi, aku nèngu na, miu padhane ne ètu mia? ra dhaa, peka na, mai, ama! sèna ka mèdhi unu mu.

source_text: jesus began to cry.
target_text: hèia yesus tangi.

source_text: then some of the jews said, look how much he loved lazarus!
target_text: ka dhèu yahudi se papeka, aku rèngu na, ladhe ku laa. na sue lasarus titu kèna!

source_text: but some others said, he enabled a blind man to see. so ◄he should have been able to heal this man so that he did not die! /why did he not heal this man so that he did not die? ► rhq
target_text: te ngaa abhu cahag'e dhu papeka na, dhèu ne'e ne ka dhu hia dhèu bèdhu bisa nèdhi. nga tao ka nèngu bisa boe tenge j'ara, sèna ka lasarus baku madhe?

source_text: within himself jesus was again very angry about lazarus dying or, very troubled. he came to the tomb. it was a cave. the entrance had been covered with a large stone.
target_text: ka d'ara yesus susa. hèia la'e padètu-dètu asa ro'a dhu ra padhane lasarus. ro'a ne dhu ra katange le dènge hadhu aae cue.

source_text: jesus said, take away the stone! martha, who, as i mentioned before, was an older sister of the man who had died, said, lord, his body has been in the tomb for four days, so now there will be a bad smell!
target_text: hèia yesus pua dhèu ètu sèra, peka na, loli eele ku hadhu nèti hèb'a ro'a ne! te ngaa marta, ana hèni dhèu madhe ne, peka, aku nèngu na, irii, ama! na madhe èpa lod'o kèna! tatu hèu le.

source_text: jesus said to her, i told rhq you that if you believed in ◄me/what i can do►, you would see how great god is! have you forgotten that?
target_text: ka yesus pasanèd'e ne, aku nèngu na, sanèd'e lii ja'a deo na, si? ja'a dhu peka mema le, na, ladhe èu tare'a-re'a parcaya ja'a, pe mèdhi dadedha ama lamatua.

source_text: so they took away the stone. then jesus looked up toward heaven and said, my father, i thank you that you heard me when i prayed about this earlier.
target_text: hèia pèri-pèri dhèu loli eele hadhu nèti hèb'a ro'a ne. ka yesus ladhe asa dedha-liru, hèia na peka, ama! ja'a manèngi makasi, lula ama nanene ja'a.

source_text: i know that you always hear me when i pray. but instead of just praying silently, i said that for the sake of the people who are standing here. i want them to believe that you sent me.
target_text: ja'a ke'a karèi nèti uru ka, na, ama nanene taruu ja'a. te ngaa doe ne ja'a peka sèmi ne'e, sèna ka dhèu-dhèu dhu titu ètu ne'e, bisa re'a, na, ama ka dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: after he said that, he shouted, lazarus, come out!
target_text: ropa peka nare, hèia na paroa dènge lii mèdhu, peka na, lasarus! kalua ka!

source_text: the man who had been dead came out! the strips of cloth were still wrapped around his hands and feet, and a cloth was still around his face, but he came out! jesus said to them, take off the cloths so that he can walk easily! so they did that.
target_text: ka dhèu madhe ne kalua nèti d'ara ro'a. kacui-aai dènge haga na pa'èki era dènge bèla hutu dhèu madhe. aa abhu bèla dhu pahutu rèhu na kahèi. yesus pua dhèu ètu sèra, peka na, bhoke eele bèla hutu se, sèna ka na kako!

source_text: as a result, many of the jews who had come to see mary and who had seen what jesus did, believed that he ◄was the messiah/had come from god►.
target_text: ropa laladhe rèdhi tatao yesus ne, dhèu yahudi dhu beke dènge maria, ae ka dhu parcaya yesus.

source_text: but some of the others went to the pharisees and told them what jesus had done.
target_text: te ngaa abhu cahag'e kahèi dhu lasi paraga dènge dhèu nèti partei parisi, sèna ka peka tatao yesus ne dènge rèngu.

source_text: so the chief priests and the pharisees gathered all the members of the jewish council together. they started saying to each other, what are we going to do about jesus? he is performing many miracles!
target_text: èle èèna, hèia kètu agama yahudi sèra, dènge dhèu parisi pakaboko ho padhue. ra pakarèi, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne, tao tadha malaa rupa-rupa! de èdhi tao ne tasamia hari?

source_text: if we allow him to keep doing this, everyone will believe ◄in him/that he is the messiah►, and they will make him their king. then the roman army will come and destroy our temple and our whole nation of israel!
target_text: te ladhe èdhi soro tèke ne, bèli-camèd'a dhèu aa'i-aa'i sanao-maena nèngu j'aj'i dhèu aae rèngu. dènge j'ara ne'e, èèna na sordad'u roma sèra mai paguri eele èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i èdhi dènge palaho isi kabarai èdhi.

source_text: one of the jewish council members was caiaphas. he was the jewish high priest that year. hinting that they should get rid of jesus, he said to them, you talk as though you do not know anything hyp!
target_text: tèu èèna, kayafas dhu j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama yahudi. na peka, na, goa, ee! miu me'a boe ngaa-ngaa!

source_text: you do not realize that it would be much better for us if one man died for the sake of the people rather than that the romans kill all the people of our jewish nation.
target_text: te ladhe dhèu èci madhe pala dhèu aa'i-aa'i, èèna be'a risi hia miu. te ladhe aad'o, na, sordad'u roma mai, pamadhe aa'i mèu-mèu isi kabarai èdhi dhèu yahudi ne!

source_text: he said that, not because he thought of it himself. instead, since he was the high priest that year, he was prophesying that jesus would die for the whole jewish nation.
target_text: lii kayafas ne mai boe nèti d'ara nèngu unu na. te ama lamatua pake hèb'a na, lula nèngu ka kètu kapai risi agama d'ara tèu èèna. nèti èèna ka, kayafas peka tèke, na, bèli-camèd'a yesus madhe pala dhèu yahudi aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: but he was also prophesying that jesus would die, not just for the jews, but for all the people living in other lands who would belong to god, in order that he would unite all of them into one group.
target_text: aa te ngaa, dhu lèke ka, yesus madhe boe hia dhèu yahudi mesa ra di, te ngaa pala dhèu unu ama lamatua aa'i-aa'i dhu pale-lème ètu rai-haha ne. nèngu èèna na oru nare si j'aj'i mi suku ca nau-ca nadha.

source_text: so from that day the jewish leaders started to make plans how they could kill jesus.

source_text: i have told you all these things while i am still with you.

source_text: but my father will send the holy spirit. he is the one who will ◄encourage/be like a legal counsel for► you. he will come with my authority mty. he will teach you all of god's truth that you need to know. he will also cause you to remember all the things that i have told you.
target_text: te ngaa èèna na, ama ku pua mai ca dhèu era sarai-maena, nuka roh mola-mèci na. roh ne'e ka dhu gati ja'a ètu rai-haha ne. sasab'a na, nuka: aj'a-nori miu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra, dènge pasanèd'e miu j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a padhue-padhai le dènge miu.

source_text: as i leave you, i am causing you to have inner peace. this inner peace comes from me. i am not causing you to have something that those who do not belong to god mty can give you. so stop being anxious/worried, and do not be afraid.
target_text: pe, ladhe d'ai lod'o ja'a laku, ja'a tao d'ara miu ho mamuri padame dènge mera-milu. dhoka ja'a mesa ku dhu bisa tao d'ara mera-milu sèmi èèna. aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu rai-haha ne bisa boe tao rare d'ara miu mera-milu sèmi èèna. de miu baku susa, aa baku madha'u.

source_text: you heard me say to you, ‘i am going away, but later i will come back to you. ' if you loved me, you would be glad that i am going back to my father, because my father is greater than i am, and there he will honor me and will send the spirit to you.
target_text: miu tadèngi mèdhi le, dhu ja'a peka dènge miu, na, ‘ja'a tèke eele miu, te ngaa èèna na mai hari. ' d'ara miu baku susa. te ladhe miu sue ja'a, na, d'ara miu karej'e-karae, lula ja'a laku asa ama ku. ama ku kapai risi nèti ja'a ne.

source_text: i have told you these things now before they happen, so that when they happen you will believe that what i said is true.
target_text: sanèd'e, te ja'a dhu peka mema le dènge miu. dènge j'ara ne'e, ladhe j'ara se j'aj'i ku, na, miu bisa parcaya ja'a.

source_text: i will not be able to talk to you much longer, because what happens to me will be as though satan, the ruler of this world, is coming to attack me. but he has no control over what happens to me.
target_text: nèbhu heka, ja'a padhai lii heka dènge miu. te dhèu aae nidhu dhu mai le. nèngu nèd'u paredha ètu rai-haha ne, te ngaa koasa na lèke boe ja'a.

source_text: instead, the people who do not belong to god mty must learn from what happens to me that i love my father, and i am doing the things that he has commanded me to do. now, let's get up and leave here.
target_text: masi ka nidhu ne mai, te ngaa ja'a sab'a taruu madhutu paredha ama ku. ne'e ne ka dhu pad'elo dènge dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, na, ja'a sue ama ku titu kèna. de mai lati ka!

source_text: jesus talked to us as we were walking along. speaking figuratively of the need for us to live in a way that god wants us to, he said, i am like met a genuine vine, not like those jewish leaders who do not teach the truth. my father is like met a gardener who works to take care of a vineyard.
target_text: yesus padhai lii, peka na, nanene! miu dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a. ja'a ne sama sèmi aj'u anggor ca kapua. te ngaa ja'a ne, aj'u anggor dhu lèke! aa ama ku nuka sèmi dhèu sab'a oka.

source_text: just like a gardener cuts off the branches that bear no grapes met, god gets rid of those who do not please him even though they say that they belong to him. those branches that bear fruit, the gardener trims so that they may bear more grapes. similarly, my father disciplines/corrects those who live as he wants them to live.
target_text: de ladhe dhèu peka na, nèngu dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a, te ngaa sab'a boe ngaa-ngaa, ama ku core eele ne, sama sèmi dhèu sab'a oka dhu pare eele aa'i dadana dhu hua boe. te ngaa dhèu dhu pa'èki pa'èra dènge ja'a, ama ku pamèu kaj'alu ètu d'ara dhèu èèna, nuka sèmi dhèu sab'a oka poro pabab'a dadana, sèna ka hua na asa ae.

source_text: you are already like the branches that a gardener trims because you have believed the message that i have told you.
target_text: lii holo-nori ja'a se'e, bisa le pamèu d'ara miu, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu sab'a oka dhu pamèu dadana anggor.

source_text: remain having a close relationship with me. if you do that, i will remain having a close relationship with you. a branch of a vine cannot bear fruit if it is cut off and left by itself. to bear fruit, it must remain attached to the vine. similarly, you cannot live the way that god wants you to if you do not remain united to me met.
target_text: miu hud'i pa'èki taruu ku dènge ja'a, sama sèmi ja'a pa'èki dènge miu. te dadana dhu pare eele le nèti laa na, bisa boe hua. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge miu. miu bisa boe tao ngaa èci sa dhu be'a, ladhe miu pa'èki taruu boe dènge ja'a.

source_text: i am like met a vine. you are like met the branches. all those who have a close relationship with me and with whom i have a close relationship will do much that pleases god, like met a vine that bears much fruit. remember that you can do nothing hyp that truly pleases god without my help.
target_text: ja'a sama sèmi aj'u anggor ca kapua. miu nuka sèmi dadana nèngu. de dhèu dhu pa'èki taruu dènge ja'a, aa ja'a pa'èki dènge nèngu kahèi, na, nèngu èci èèna ka dènge dadana dhu hua ae-ae. te, ladhe miu pa'èki taruu boe dènge ja'a, miu bisa boe tao ngaa-ngaa dhu be'a.

source_text: a gardener cuts off and throws away useless branches. then, after they dry up, he picks them up and throws them into a fire and burns them sim. similarly, everyone who does not remain having a close relationship with me, god will get rid of.
target_text: dhèu dhu pa'èki boe taruu dènge ja'a, nèngu cakaraa dadana èci dhu guna heka. dadana sèmi èèna, dhèu poro eele, sèna ka pamango eele ne. hèia pakaboko ho core asa d'ara ai, tunu pakèpu si.

source_text: if you remain having a close relationship with me and you keep living in accordance with my message, you can ask god to do anything for you, and he will do it.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu pa'èki pa'èra-èra dènge ja'a taruu, aa lii holo-nori ja'a pea taruu ètu d'ara miu, na, ngaa dhu miu manèngi mi ama lamatua, na tao hia miu.

source_text: the way my father is honored is by your {the way you honor my father is by} doing much that pleases him met, and by doing that, you will show that you are my disciples.
target_text: ladhe miu tao j'ara dhu be'a ae-ae, sama sèmi dadana èci dhu hua ae-ae, èèna ka dhu ded'e padedha-dedha ama lamatua. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu pad'elo kahèi, na, miu ana madhutu ja'a.

source_text: i have loved you just as my father has loved me. now keep living in a way that is appropriate for those whom i love.
target_text: sèmi mia ama sue ja'a, sèmi èèna kahèi ja'a sue miu. miu hud'i pa'èki ku pa'èra-èra dènge ja'a, sèna ka ja'a bisa pad'elo dènge miu sasue ja'a.

source_text: if you obey what i have commanded you, you will be acting in a way that is appropriate for those whom i love, just like i have obeyed what my father has commanded me and i act in a way that is appropriate for someone whom he loves.
target_text: ladhe miu tao madhutu lii paredha ja'a sèra, na, miu pa'èki taruu dènge ja'a, hèia ja'a bisa pad'elo sasue ja'a mi dedha miu. èèna nuka sèmi ja'a tao madhutu lii paredha ama ku, hèia na pad'elo sasue na taruu mi dedha ja'a.

source_text: i have told you these things so that you may be joyful as i am joyful, and that you may be completely joyful.
target_text: karèi nèti uru ka, ja'a peka dènge miu j'ara se aa'i-aa'i ra, sèna ka d'ara miu karej'e-karae, sama sèmi d'ara ja'a. te madhutu dad'èi ja'a, d'ara miu hud'i karej'e dhu dènge boe too-lane!

source_text: what i am commanding you is this: love each other just like i have loved you.
target_text: lii paredha ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: miu hud'i pasue ku èci dènge èci, sama sèmi ja'a sue miu.

source_text: the best way that people can show that they love someone is to die for that person. there is no way that you can love someone in a greater way than that.
target_text: ladhe dhèu èci sadia madhe sèna ka angalai na bisa mamuri, nèngu tatu sue tare'a-re'a angalai na. abhu boe sasue dhu risi eele hari sèmi èèna.

source_text: you show that you are my friends if you keep doing what i have commanded you.
target_text: ladhe miu madhutu paredha ja'a taruu, miu j'aj'i angalai ja'a.

source_text: i will no longer call you my servants, because servants do not know why their masters want them to do things. instead, i have said that you are my friends, because i, acting like a friend, have revealed to you everything that my father told me.
target_text: ja'a paroa heka miu, na, ‘ana pua-paleha' ja'a. te ana pua-paleha èci, ne'a iia boe dad'èi lamatua na. te ngaa ja'a paroa miu, na, ‘angalai' ja'a, lula ja'a bhoke patalele le aa'i-aa'i dhu ama ku peka le dènge ja'a.

source_text: you did not decide to become my disciples. instead, i chose you, so that you would do many things that please him met. the results of what you do will last forever. i also chose you so that my father will do for you whatever you, using my authority, ask him to do mty.
target_text: miu pili boe ja'a. te ngaa ja'a ka dhu pili kore aa ded'e miu ho pakako sasab'a ne. de miu hud'i lami tao j'ara be'a ae-ae dhu taha nare nèbhu. èèna nuka sèmi aj'u anggor ca kapua dhu hua na be'a taruu. ladhe miu tao ka sèmi èèna, na, ngaa dhu miu manèngi mi ama ku, tatu na tao hia miu.

source_text: i repeat what i have commanded you: love each other.
target_text: de dhu ja'a paredha miu sèmi ne'e ka: miu hud'i pasue ku èci dènge èci.

source_text: the people who are opposed to god will hate you. when that happens, remember that they hated me first.
target_text: yesus lii tabha hari, na, ladhe dhèu ètu rai-haha ne d'èi boe miu, na, sanèd'e, te karèi nèti uru ka rèngu d'èi boe ja'a.

source_text: if you belonged to those who are opposed to god mty, they would love you like they love those who belong to them. but you do not belong to those who are opposed to god mty. instead, i chose you so that you would separate yourselves from mty them. that is why those who are opposed to god mty hate you.
target_text: ladhe miu sama sèmi dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne, tatu ra sue miu. te ngaa miu sama boe dènge rèngu. te ja'a dhu hag'e kore le miu, sèna ka cèri eele miu nèti rèngu. nèti èèna ka rèngu d'èi boe miu.

source_text: remember these words that i told you: ‘no servant is greater than his master. ' that means that you, who are like my servants, cannot expect people to treat you better than they treat me. so, since they have ◄persecuted me/caused me to suffer►, they will ◄persecute you/cause you to suffer► also. if they had paid attention to the things i taught them, they would pay attention to what you teach them.
target_text: baku bhèlu dhu ja'a peka kore le dènge miu, na, ‘ca dhèu ana pua-paleha risi boe nèti lamatua na. ' de ladhe rèngu paj'èra ja'a, tatu ra paj'èra miu kahèi. ladhe rèngu nanene ka lii holo-nori ja'a, na, rèngu nanene miu kahèi.

source_text: they will treat you like that because you belong to me mty, and because they do not know the one who sent me.
target_text: èèna na ra paj'èra miu, lula miu dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a. te rèngu tadhe boe nèngu dhu pua ja'a kahèi.

source_text: if i had not come and spoken god's message to them, they would not be guilty of rejecting me and my message. but now i have come and told them god's message, so they will have no excuse when god judges them for their sin.
target_text: ladhe ja'a dhae padhai lii kèdhi mèka dènge rèngu, aa pad'elo j'ara mamuri dhu lèke mi rèngu, na, ra pangee taruu, na, rèngu dènge boe sala ngaa-ngaa. te ngaa ja'a mai le, aa padhai dènge rèngu sèmi èèna. de ladhe rèngu tao sala, na, rèngu abhu boe j'ara ho peka na, ‘wee! ji'i se nge'a boe, na, dhu ji'i tao sèra, sala. '

source_text: all those who hate me, it is as though they hate my father as well.
target_text: dhèu dhu d'èi boe ja'a, nèngu d'èi boe ama ku kahèi.

source_text: if i had not done among them the miracles that no one else ever did, they would not be guilty of the sin of rejecting me. but now, although they have seen those miracles, they have hated both me and my father.
target_text: ja'a tao kèdhi le tadha malaa rupa-rupa ètu katanga madha ra, dhu dhèu leo tao rèdhi mèka. ladhe ja'a tao boe j'ara sèra sa, rèngu sala boe kahèi ladhe ro'o boe sèmi rare ja'a. aa te ngaa rèngu dhu rèdhi le tadha malaa dhu ja'a tao sèra. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa rèngu d'èi boe ja'a, aa d'èi boe ama ku ètu sorga kahèi.

source_text: but this has happened in order that these words that have been written in their scriptures might be fulfilled {to fulfill this that ◄someone/the psalmist► wrote in their scriptures}: ‘they hated me for no reason. '
target_text: te ngaa j'ara se'e se dhu j'aj'i le, sèna ka madhutu ngaa dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara atora ama lamatua, dhu peka na, ‘rèngu d'èi boe ja'a. aa te ngaa nanasa rèngu se'e dènge boe kolo-kapua. '

source_text: later i will send to you from my father the one who will ◄encourage/be like a legal counsel for► you. he is the spirit who will teach you god's truth. he will come from my father. he will tell people about me.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu era sarai-maena èèna neo mai. nèngu èèna, nuka roh dhu tao miu me'a mèu ngaa dhu lèke. na mai nèti ama ku. ladhe ja'a laku le asa ama ku, pe ja'a hia roh na mai asa miu. na lole dènge miu lula-nèti ja'a.

source_text: but you disciples must also tell people about me, because you have been with me from the time when i started my ministry mty.
target_text: èèna na miu peka dènge dhèu lula-nèti ja'a kahèi, lula miu bera-bera dènge ja'a karèi nèti uru j'ara ka.

target_text: ja'a peka le j'ara se'e dènge miu, sèna ka miu baku pakaj'èu nèti ja'a.

source_text: they will not allow you to worship in ◄synagogues/their meeting places►. in fact, there will be a time when anyone who kills you will think that he is serving god by doing that.

source_text: they will do such things because they have never known who i really am, nor who my father is.
target_text: rèngu tao miu sèmi èèna, lula rèngu tadhe iia boe ja'a. aa rèngu tadhe boe ama ku kahèi.

source_text: i have told you these things in order that when they start ◄to cause you to suffer/to persecute you► mty, you will remember that i warned you. i did not tell you these things when you first started to accompany me mty because i was with you, and they were causing trouble for me, not for you.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka le j'ara se'e dènge miu, sèna ka lèpa lod'o limuri ladhe j'aj'i, miu bisa sanèd'e, na, ja'a dhu peka mema le. te ngaa ja'a peka uuru mèka dènge miu, lula ja'a bera-bera dènge miu era.

source_text: now i am about to return to the one who sent me. but i am disappointed that none of you is asking me, ‘where are you going? '

source_text: instead, because i have told you these things, you are very sad.
target_text: lula ja'a dhu peka le dènge miu, nèti èèna ka d'ara miu susa.

source_text: but the truth is that it is good for you that i am going away, because if i do not go away, the holy spirit, who will ◄encourage/be like a legal counsel for► you will not come to you. but when i go, i will send him to you.
target_text: te ngaa, ngaa dhu ja'a peka dènge miu ne, lèke tare'a. ladhe ja'a laku, na, miu abhu babe'a na. te ladhe ja'a laku boe, dhèu era sarai-maena èèna mai boe pad'elo j'ara hia miu. te ngaa ladhe ja'a laku, na, ja'a hia ne mai dènge miu.

source_text: when he comes, he will prove that those who do not belong to god mty are wrong about what is sinful and about who is really righteous and about whom god will judge and condemn for their sin.
target_text: pe ladhe na mai, na bhoke ngangee dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, ka re'a, na, d'ara dènge tatao ra, sala. na pamako si, sèna ka rèngu madhutu j'ara mamuri dhu lèke. aa na pasanèd'e rèngu, na, ladhe lamatua pama'ète lii langu ra, peka na, rèngu se sala, do sala boe.

source_text: he will tell people that their greatest sin is that they do not believe in me.
target_text: dhèu era sarai-maena èèna pad'elo sasala ra, lula rèngu lèka boe ja'a.

source_text: he will tell people that because i am going back to my father, and you will no longer see me, you will know that i am the one who was truly righteous.
target_text: nèngu pad'elo j'ara mamuri dhu lèke kahèi. lula ja'a lèpa asa ama ku, èèna na miu mèdhi heka ja'a. nèti èèna ka, dhèu era sarai-maena ne mai gati ja'a.

source_text: he will tell people that the fact that god has already determined that he will punish satan, the one who rules this world, shows that some day god will also punish those who do not belong to him.
target_text: nèngu peka kahèi, na, ama lamatua pama'ète lii langu dhèu dènge mola, lula lamatua dhu pama'ète nare le lii langu dhèu aae nidhu, dhu paredha rai-haha ne.

source_text: i have many more things that i would like to tell you, but you are not able to accept them now.
target_text: abhu j'ara ae era dhu ja'a neo peka dènge miu, te ngaa ne'e ne miu dhae bisa mèka me'a.

source_text: but god's spirit is the one who will teach you god's truth. when he comes, he will guide you so that you understand all spiritual truth. he will not speak from his own authority. instead, it is the things that he hears my father say that he will tell you. he will also tell you about things that will happen later.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe roh dhu pad'elo j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke èèna mai ka, nèngu pad'elo j'ara sèna ka miu bisa me'a j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu lèke. nèngu padhai lii boe nèti d'ara na mesa, te ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu na tadèngi sèra mai nèti ama ku. nèngu neo peka dènge miu kahèi, ngaa dhu bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i.

source_text: he will honor me by revealing my truth to you.
target_text: nèngu neo ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha, lula na neo bhoke patalele aa'i hia miu, j'ara dhu lèke lula-nèti ja'a.

source_text: everything that my father has is mine. that is why i said that the spirit is able to reveal my truth to you.
target_text: aa'i-aa'i dhu unu ama ku, unu ja'a kahèi. nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka deo na, roh lamatua èèna na bhoke patalele aa'i mèu-mèu j'ara dhu lèke lula-nèti ja'a, aa pad'elo dènge miu.

source_text: after a short time i will leave you, and you will not see me. then a short time after that you will see me again.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii padhai, peka na, nèbhu heka, miu mèdhi heka ja'a. te ngaa nèbhu boe kahèi, miu mèdhi hari ja'a.

source_text: so some of us said to each other, what does he mean by saying ‘after a short time you will not see me, ' and ‘a short time after that you will see me again'? and what does he mean by ‘because i am going back to my father'?
target_text: ka ana madhutu na cahag'e papeka èci dènge èci, aku rèngu na, a'abhu ama èèna, ngaa kèna? ka peka na, ‘nèbhu heka, miu mèdhi heka ja'a. te ngaa nèbhu boe kahèi, miu mèdhi hari ja'a. ' aa, nga tao ka na padhai lii, na, ‘lula ja'a neo laku asa ama ku'?

source_text: we kept asking each other, what does he mean by saying ‘after a little while'? we do not understand what he is saying.
target_text: hèia ra pakarèi, peka na, a'abhu na ngaa, dhu peka na, ‘nèbhu heka'? èdhi te'a boe sasoa na.

source_text: jesus realized that we wanted to ask him about that. so he said to us, you are asking rhq each other what i meant when i said, ‘after a short time you will not see me, and then a short time after that you will see me again. '
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhu ne'a rèngu neo karèi ne ca j'ara. hèia na karèi, aku nèngu na, deo na ja'a peka na, ‘nèbhu heka, miu mèdhi heka ja'a. te ngaa nèbhu boe, miu mèdhi hari ja'a kahèi. ' miu pakarèi sèmi èèna, si?

source_text: listen to this carefully: after i ◄leave you/die►, those who oppose god mty will be happy, but you will be sad. but later you will stop being sad and you will become joyful.
