source_text: a woman who is about to bear a child feels pain, because that is what happens mty at that time. but after her baby is born, she forgets that pain, because she is very joyful that her child has been born.
target_text: j'ara ne sama sèmi bhèni ca dhèu kabake pèd'a d'ai lod'o neo nara iisi. d'ara na rasa bia, lula d'ai lod'o j'aj'èra na kèna. te ngaa ladhe nara iisi nare, na, j'aj'èra na ele. te d'ara na karej'e, lula abhu dhèu hiu èci dhu mai asa rai-haha.

source_text: it will be the same with you. i will soon die and you will be sad. but after that, i will see you again. then you will be joyful, and no one will be able to stop you from being joyful.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge miu. ne'e ne miu tangi dènge d'ara susa. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu ja'a mai paraga hari dènge miu, ka d'ara miu j'aj'i hari karej'e-karae. aa ladhe j'ara ne j'aj'i, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa bhabhae rare d'ara karae miu.

source_text: when that happens, you will not ask me any questions about anything. listen to this carefully: after that happens, my father will do for you anything you ask, because of his relationship with me mty.
target_text: aa ladhe j'ara sèmi sèra j'aj'i, miu pakarèi heka ngaa-ngaa dènge ja'a. tare'a! ja'a peka hari dènge miu kèna, na, sad'i miu manèngi ngaa èèna ka nèti ama ku, pake kolongara ja'a, èèna na nèngu tao sèmi èèna hia miu.

source_text: up to the present time, using my authority you have not asked god to do anything for you mty. now keep asking him for things that you need. if you do that, you will receive them, and then you will be completely joyful.
target_text: toke d'ai sange ne'e, miu dhae manèngi mèka ngaa-ngaa pake kolongara ja'a. de manèngi la, sèna ka miu abhu. dènge j'ara ne, d'ara miu bisa karej'e tare'a-re'a.

source_text: although i have been speaking these things using figurative language, there will soon be a time when i will no longer use that kind of language. instead, i will tell you plainly ◄about my father/what my father wants►.
target_text: yesus padhai lii tabha hari, peka na, toke d'ai sange ne'e, ja'a tema aj'a-nori miu pake lii pakasame. te ngaa bèli-camèd'a d'ai lod'o na, ja'a aj'a miu pake heka lii pakasame. te ja'a neo peka mola-mola lula-nèti ama ku.

source_text: at that time, you will ask him for things ◄because you belong to me/with my authority► mty. i will not need to ask my father to do what you ask.
target_text: ladhe lod'o èèna d'ai, na, miu mesa mi dhu sabaj'a ho manèngi mi ama ku pake kolongara ja'a. baku dhoka ja'a mesa ku di dhu sabaj'a hia miu.

source_text: my father himself loves you because you have loved me and because you have believed that i came from god my father, so he wants you to ask him or, so he does not need anyone to persuade him to help you
target_text: te ama ku sue miu, lula miu sue ja'a. aa miu me'a mèu, na, ama lamatua ka dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: i came from my father into this world. very soon i will be leaving this world and going back to my father.
target_text: uru èèna, ja'a tèke eele ama ku, ho mai pea taha ètu rai-haha ne. te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a neo tèke eele rai-haha ne, ho laku pea pa'èci hari dènge ne.

source_text: then we, his disciples, said, now you are speaking plainly, without using figurative language.
target_text: tadèngi rare sèmi ne'e, hèia ana madhutu yesus se lii, aku rèngu na, de ne'e ne, ama padhai lii mola-mola kèna, aa aj'a-nori pake heka lii pakasame.

source_text: now we understand that you know everything. you do not need anyone to ask you questions about anything, because you know what we want to ask before we ask you. that also leads us to believe that you came from god.
target_text: ji'i nge'a, na, ama dhu me'a aa'i mèu j'ara-j'ara. dhèu parluu heka sèku ama dènge karèi ngaa-ngaa, lula ama dhu me'a uru le ngaa dhu ra neo karèi, aa lii dhaa na tasa mera mia. j'ara ne peka dènge ji'i, na, ama mai nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: jesus replied, now you rhq say that you believe that i came from god.
target_text: hèia yesus karèi, aku nèngu na, tare'a, do? limuri ne, miu lèka ja'a, do?

source_text: but listen! there will soon be a time, and that time is already here, when you will all run away! each of you will run away to your own home. you will leave me, and i will be alone. but i will not really be alone at that time, because my father is always with me.
target_text: sèmi ne'e. nèbhu boe, mulai ciki-diki ne, miu aa'i-aa'i mi rai paceb'a. ca dhèu-dhèu ka rai tèke eele ja'a mesa-mesa ku, ho la'e lu'u. masi ka sèmi èèna, ja'a mesa ku boe, lula ama ku bera-bera dènge ja'a.

source_text: i have told you these things in order that you may have inner peace because of your relationship with me. in this world you will have trouble. but be courageous! i have defeated those who are opposed to me mty, and you can defeat them, too!
target_text: ja'a peka tèke le j'ara se dènge miu, sèna ka d'ara miu mera-milu, lula miu dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a. te bèli-camèd'a dhèu ètu rai-haha ne pasusa dènge paj'èra miu. te ngaa pa'èra d'ara miu, lula ja'a segi aa'i le koasa aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne!

source_text: after jesus said those things, he looked up toward heaven. then he prayed, my father, it is now the time mty for me to suffer and die. honor me as i do that, in order that i may honor you. you gave me authority over all people, in order that i might enable all those whom you chose to come to me to live eternally.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii nare, hèia na ladhe asa dedha-liru, ka sabaj'a, peka na: ama pasue. lod'o d'ai kèna ho ama ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha. ja'a ne, ana ama. ama dhu pangèd'u ja'a hak, sèna ka lalau-lalo'o dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. ama hia hak ne, sèna ka ja'a hia mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ama pangèd'u mai ho j'aj'i dhèu ja'a. de ne'e ne, ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha ho pad'elo dadedha ama.

source_text: the way for people to live eternally is for them to know that you are the only true god, and to know that i, jesus, am the messiah, the one you have sent.
target_text: j'ara abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe, sèmi ne'e: dhèu hud'i tadhe ama ku, nuka ama lamatua dhu lèke. dhu leo aad'o. aa rèngu hud'i tadhe ku ja'a kahèi, nuka yesus kristus, dhu ama pua mai asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: i have honored you here on this earth by completing all the work that you gave me to do.
target_text: ja'a pad'elo le dadedha ama ètu rai-haha ne. ja'a pa'èle le sasab'a dhu ama pangèd'u mi ja'a.

source_text: my father, now honor me when i am with you again, by causing me to have the greatness i had when i was with you before the world began.
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o èdhi paj'aj'i mèka rai-haha ne, ja'a bera-bera le dènge ama. lod'o èèna, dadedha ja'a èci èèna ka dènge dadedha ama. ne'e ne ja'a neo lèpa hari asa ama. de ja'a manèngi ho ama ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha, sèna ka dadedha ja'a sama sèmi uru èèna.

source_text: i have revealed what you are like to the people whom you brought to me from among those who do not belong to you mty. those who came to me belonged to you, and you brought them to me. now they have obeyed your message.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii sabaj'a, peka na, ama hia le dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, j'aj'i dhèu ja'a. ja'a aj'a-nori si, ho rèngu tadhe ama. rèngu j'aj'i dhèu ama, hèia ama pangèd'u si j'aj'i unu ja'a kahèi. ka ra tao madhutu lii holo-nori ama.

source_text: now they know that everything you have given me, your message and your work, comes from you.
target_text: limuri ne re'a le, na, j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu ama pangèd'u mi ja'a sèra, kapua ra nèti ama.

source_text: i gave them the message that you gave me, and they have accepted it. they now know for certain that i came from you. they now believe that you sent me.
target_text: te ja'a aj'a kore le rèngu lii holo-nori dhu ama hia mi ja'a. rèngu sèmi rare kahèi lii holo-nori se'e. re'a kahèi, na, ja'a mai nèti ama. ka ra parcaya, na, ama ka dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: i am praying for them. i am not praying for those who do not belong to you mty. instead, i am praying for those whom you have brought to me, because they belong to you.
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a hia rèngu. ne'e ne, ja'a sabaj'a boe hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. te ngaa ja'a sabaj'a hia dhèu-dhèu dhu ama pangèd'u mi ja'a, te rèngu se unu ama.

source_text: all the disciples that i have belong to you, and all those who belong to you also belong to me. they have shown how great i am.
target_text: te aa'i-aa'i unu ja'a, sèra sa unu ama kahèi. aa aa'i-aa'i unu ama, sèra sa unu ja'a kahèi. ka dhèu unu ja'a se, dhu ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha.

source_text: i will not be staying in the world any longer. i will be coming back to you. they, however, will be here in the world among those who are opposed to you. my holy father, protect them from spiritual harm by your power mty, the power that you gave me, in order that they may be united as we are united.
target_text: ja'a pea boe taruu ètu rai-haha ne, lula nèbhu heka ja'a lèpa hari asa ama ku. te ngaa dhèu se hud'i pea taruu ètu rai-haha ne. ama dhu mola-mèci. ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama ladhe-leru si pake koasa dhu ama pangèd'u le mi ja'a. ja'a manèngi kahèi ho rèngu pa'èki j'aj'i mi èci, nuka sèmi ja'a pa'èki j'aj'i mi èci dènge ama.

source_text: while i have been with them, i have completely protected them by the power mty that you gave me. as a result, only one of them will be eternally separated from you. he is the one who was doomed to be eternally separated from you. that has happened to fulfill what a prophet wrote in the scriptures would happen.
target_text: karèi nèti ja'a ètu rai-haha ne bera-bera dènge rèngu, ja'a leru si, lula rèngu j'aj'i le dhèu ama. ja'a j'aga aa sanoro si, sèna ka rèngu pa'èki taruu dènge ama. abhu boe dhu ele. dhodhoka yudas di dhu cèri eele, madhutu ngaa dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua karèi nèti uru èèna.

source_text: father, now i am about to return to you. i have said these things while i am still here in the world in order that my disciples may fully experience being joyful, as i have been joyful.
target_text: limuri ne, ja'a neo lèpa hari asa ama. ja'a peka le j'ara se'e lod'o ja'a ètu rai-haha ne era. dènge sèmi ne'e, dhèu unu ja'a se d'ara rèngu bisa karej'e-karae taruu, sama sèmi d'ara ja'a.

source_text: i have given them your message. as a result, those who are opposed to you mty have hated them, because my disciples do not belong to those who oppose you mty, just like i do not belong to those who oppose you mty.
target_text: ja'a dhu peka-padhai le dènge rèngu lii holo-nori ama. dhèu leo ètu rai-haha tèka d'ara dènge dhèu unu ja'a, lula mamuri dhèu ja'a, sama boe dènge mamuri rèngu. ja'a sèmi èèna kahèi, te ja'a sama boe sèmi dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: i am asking you, not that you take them out of this world, but instead that you protect them from satan, the evil one.
target_text: ladhe ja'a sabaj'a, ja'a manèngi boe ho ama more si nèti rai-haha ne. aad'o! te ngaa ja'a manèngi, ho ama j'aga si, sèna ka ra pakaj'èu nèti bhabhelu.

source_text: they do not belong to those who are opposed to you mty, just like i also do not belong to them.
target_text: rèngu sama boe dènge dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne, èci èèna ka dènge ja'a dhu sama boe kahèi dènge dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: set my disciples apart so that they may ◄completely belong to/serve► you, by enabling them to live in accordance with what is true. your message is true.
target_text: pake ngaa dhu lèke, sèna ka pamèu d'ara ra. te dhu lèke ka, lii holo-nori ama.

source_text: just like you sent me here into this world, now i surely will be sending them to other places in mty the world.
target_text: ama ka dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne. ka ja'a pua-paleha rèngu kahèi sèmi èèna, sèna ka rèngu mamuri pale-lème ètu talora aae dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: i dedicate myself to completely belong to you, in order that they also may truly be dedicated {dedicate themselves} completely to you.
target_text: ja'a j'aga ngi'u ja'a ho mola-mèci taruu hia mi ama. dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu unu ja'a j'aga mamuri ra kahèi sèna ka mola-mèci hia mi ama. te lii holo-nori ama dhu lèke, dhu tao si ho ra saraka mamuri rèngu kateme mi ama.

source_text: i am praying not only for these eleven disciples. i am praying also for those who will believe in me as a result of hearing their message.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii manèngi-mangaj'i na, aku nèngu na, ja'a sabaj'a, mesa boe hia mi dhèu limuri ne'e di, te ngaa hia rèngu dhu lod'o limuri dhu parcaya ja'a kahèi, lula lii padhai dhèu se'e.

source_text: my father, i want all of them to be united, just like i am united with you because of my relationship with you, and as you are united with me because of your relationship with me. i also want them to be united with us. i want that to happen so that those who do not know you mty may know that you sent me.
target_text: ama, ja'a manèngi sèna ka rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra bisa pa'èki j'aj'i mi èci, sama sèmi èdhi pa'èki j'aj'i èci. ja'a manèngi sèna ka rèngu j'aj'i èci dènge èdhi, ho hud'i laa dhèu rai-haha ne bisa parcaya, na, ama ka dhu pua-paleha ja'a.

source_text: i have honored my disciples just like you honored me, in order that they may be united, as we are united.
target_text: ama pad'elo le dadedha ja'a mi dhèu sèra. ka ja'a ded'e le rèngu padedha-dedha sama sèmi ja'a. dènge jara ne'e, rèngu pa'èki j'aj'i èci, sama sèmi èdhi kahèi j'aj'i èci.

source_text: i want them to be united just like they are united with me and as you are united with me. may they be completely united, in order that those who do not belong to you mty may know that you sent me and that you have loved them just like you have loved me.
target_text: ja'a pa'èki dènge rèngu. ama kahèi pa'èki dènge ja'a. rèngu hud'i pa'èki j'aj'i èci sèmi èèna ku, toke ra mamuri d'ara èci dènge be'a. te ladhe rèngu mamuri d'ara èci sèmi èèna, dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne re'a, na, ama dhu sue si, nuka sèmi ama sue ja'a. dènge j'ara ne, rèngu re'a kahèi, na, ama ku dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: my father, i want the disciples you have brought to me to some day be with me in heaven, where i will be. i want them to see my greatness. i want them to see the greatness you gave me because you loved me. you gave me that greatness before you created the world.
target_text: ama, ja'a d'èi sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ama pangèd'u le mi ja'a, bera-bera dènge ja'a. te ja'a neo, sèna ka rèngu bisa ladhe rèdhi ama ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha. te ama sue ja'a mema-mema le, lod'o èdhi dhae paj'aj'i mèka rai-haha ne.

source_text: my righteous father, although the people who do not belong to you mty do not know what you are like, i know what you are like, and my disciples know that you sent me.
target_text: ama pasue dhu d'ara mola. te ngaa dhèu ètu rai-haha ne tadhe boe ama. ja'a tadhe ama. aa dhèu unu ja'a re'a kahèi, na, ama ka dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: i have revealed to them what you are like, and i will continue to reveal to them what you are like. i will do that in order that they may love others just like you love me, and in order that i may be in them by my spirit.
target_text: ja'a dhu peka le dènge rèngu, ama ne, cee. aa èèna na ja'a loe boe peka dènge rèngu sèmi èèna, lula ja'a d'èi ho rèngu re'a mèu sasue ama. te sasue dhu rèngu re'a rèdhi ne'e ne, èci èèna ka dènge sasue ama mi dedha ja'a, sèna ka hud'i laa ja'a pa'èki taruu dènge rèngu.

source_text: after jesus finished praying, he went across the kidron brook, along with us disciples, to a grove of olive trees.
target_text: ropa yesus manèngi-mangaj'i nare, hèia la'e palere-lere dènge ana madhutu na. lasi asa d'ara oka cue ètu sebhe loko kidron.

source_text: judas, who was about to enable jesus' enemies to seize him, knew that he would probably be there. he knew that because jesus often gathered there with us. so judas came to that grove. he was leading a troop of roman soldiers and some temple guards who had been sent by the pharisees and chief priests. they were carrying torches and lamps and weapons.
target_text: lod'o èèna, kètu agama yahudi sèra dènge dhèu-dhèu nèti partei agama parisi saraka mi yudas, sordad'u dènge dhèu j'aga pèri-pèri. te nèngu neo pahie eele yesus. yudas ne'a oka ne kahèi, lula yesus pakaboko dènge ana madhutu na ètu era ne'e pèri-pèri hari le. ka yudas si lasi asa oka ne rèti dènge ob'o, labhu lantera dènge rèka.

source_text: jesus knew everything that was about to happen to him. so as they approached, he stepped forward and asked them, who are you looking for?
target_text: aa te ngaa yesus dhu ne'a uru le aa'i-aa'i dhu èèna na j'aj'i. hèia ara la'e asa madha rèngu, ka na lii, peka na, miu tenge cee?

source_text: they replied to him, jesus, the man from nazareth. he replied, that is who i am. judas, the one who was enabling his enemies to seize him, was with them.
target_text: ka ra b'ala, na, ji'i tenge dhèu èci, ngara na yesus, nèti rae nasaret. ka yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a ka ne'e. lod'o èèna, yudas dhu titu dènge dhèu se'e. nèngu ne'e ka dhu pahie yesus.

source_text: when jesus told them, that is who i am, they lurched backward and fell down on the ground because of his power.
target_text: ropa yesus peka na, ja'a ka ne'e, hèia dhèu se hari kabodho, ka ra bèbha.

source_text: he asked them again, who are you looking for? they said, jesus, the man from nazareth.
target_text: ka yesus karèi hari, na, miu tenge cee? hèia dhèu se dhaa, aku rèngu na, yesus, dhèu nasaret.

source_text: jesus replied, i told you that i am jesus. so since i am the one you are looking for, allow these disciples of mine to go.
target_text: hèia na peka dènge ra, deo na ja'a peka kore le, na, nèngu ka ja'a ne. de ladhe miu tenge ja'a, na, baku kèpe dhèu leo. hud'i si lasi.

source_text: this happened in order that when they did what he asked them to do, the words would be fulfilled that he had prayed, i will never lose any of those whom god has brought to me.
target_text: nèngu padhai lii sèmi èèna, sèna ka pamèci dènge ngaa dhu nèngu peka nèdhi le, na, ama. aa'i-aa'i dhu ama pangèd'u le mi ja'a, abhu boe èci sa dhu ele.

source_text: simon peter had a long dagger. so he drew it and tried to kill the high priest's servant, but he only cut off the man's right ear. the servant's name was malchus.
target_text: lod'o èèna, simon petrus nèti dènge samala iiki èci. ka na bete ho neo pare dhèu. kabèdhi laa, na pare pama'ète rèu dhilu g'ana nèti dhèu èci. dhèu ne ngara na malkus. nèngu ne, ana pua-paleha nèti kètu kapai risi agama yahudi.

source_text: jesus said to peter, put your sword back into its sheath! ◄i must endure what my father wants me to suffer. /do you not think that i must endure what my father wants me to suffer? ► met, rhq
target_text: ka yesus pua petrus, aku nèngu na, we, petrus! pasaluu hari samala èu èèna asa d'ara sope la'e. te ama ku dhu peka le, na, ja'a hud'i paraga ku dènge j'aj'èra sèmi ne'e ne. de hud'i laa! èèna nuka sèmi nèngu hia ja'a galaa èci dhu isi na pèd'u-èd'u. hud'i laa ja'a kinu toke èle.

source_text: then the troop of soldiers, along with their commander and the jewish temple guards, seized jesus. they tied his hands behind his back.
target_text: hèia komedhaa, sordad'u dènge dhèu j'aga aa'i-aa'i ra kèpe yesus, ka ra èki ne.

source_text: then they took him first to annas, who was previously the high priest. he was the father-in-law of caiaphas. caiaphas was the high priest that year.
target_text: ka lere rèti uuru ne asa anas. anas ne, ama dhèu èmu kayafas. tèu èèna, kayafas dhu j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama yahudi.

source_text: caiaphas was the one who previously advised the jewish council that it would be better if one man died for the sake of the people than for all the people of the jewish nation to die.
target_text: kayafas ne'e ka dhu peka nèdhi le dènge ama-ama dhèu yahudi, aku nèngu na, be'a risi hia miu, ladhe dhèu èci madhe pala dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: simon peter and i were following jesus. because the high priest knew me, his doorkeeper permitted me to enter the courtyard.
target_text: simon petrus dhu madhutu yesus re limuri palere-lere dènge ana madhutu yesus èci, nuka ja'a, yohanis ne. lula kètu kapai risi agama yahudi tadhe ja'a, nèti èèna ka ja'a bisa maso kahèi palere-lere dènge yesus asa madha èmu na.

source_text: but peter had to wait outside near the doorway. however, since i knew the high priest, i went back to the doorway and spoke to the girl who was guarding the entrance. then she allowed peter to come in.
target_text: te ngaa petrus titu ètu li'u, padètu dènge hèb'a tedhe. hèia ja'a laku asa li'u, ho peka dènge dhèu bhèni èci dhu j'aga hèb'a tedhe ne, sèna ka kèti petrus asa d'ara.

source_text: the servant girl who was guarding the doorway said to peter, surely you are not another disciple of that man they have arrested, are you? he said, i am not.
target_text: hèia bhèni ne karèi petrus, aku nèngu na, wee! èu ne, ca dhèu ana madhutu dhèu nèi, si? te ngaa petrus dhaa, aku nèngu na, aad'o!

source_text: it was cold, so the high priest's slaves and temple guards made a charcoal fire and were standing around it to keep warm. peter was also standing near it, warming himself.
target_text: lod'o èèna lèke dènge hèru pacuhi. nèti èèna ka, dhèu madhenga dènge ana pua-paleha sèra dhu titu manyiru ai. ka petrus la'e manyiru ai sama-sama dènge rèngu kahèi.

source_text: while peter was doing that, the high priest asked jesus about his disciples and about what he was teaching people.
target_text: lod'o èèna, kètu kapai risi dhui nèti agama yahudi parisa yesus lula-nèti a'aj'a na, aa lula-nèti ana madhutu na.

source_text: jesus replied, i have always spoken where many people mty, hyp could hear me. i have taught them in ◄the synagogues/their meeting places► and in the temple courtyard, in places where many hyp jews come together. i have spoken nothing secretly.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge nèngu, aku nèngu na, ja'a peka paled'a, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa tadèngi. ja'a tema aj'a ètu era dhu biasa dhèu yahudi èdhi pakaboko, nuka ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a èdhi, dènge ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ja'a padhai lii pahuni kèdhi boe.

source_text: so ◄why are you asking me questions like this illegally? /you should not be asking me questions like this illegally! ► rhq ask the people who heard what i taught! they certainly know what i said!
target_text: nga tao ka èu karèi ja'a? karèi la dhèu-dhèu dhu nanene lii padhai ja'a. te, tatu re'a ngaa dhu ja'a peka-padhai.

source_text: after jesus said that, one of the temple guards standing near him slapped him on his face. he said, ◄that is not the way you should answer the high priest! /is that the way you should answer the high priest? ► rhq
target_text: ropa na padhai lii sèmi èèna, dhèu j'aga èci dhu titu ètu èèna, tèb'e yesus, ka na peka na, èu baku padhai lii sèmi èèna dènge kètu kapai risi.

source_text: jesus replied to him, if i said something that was contrary to your laws, you could tell me that what i said that was wrong. but because i said only what was right, ◄you should not be striking me! /why are you striking me? ► rhq
target_text: ka yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, ladhe ja'a padhai lii sale, na, pad'elo mia dhu sale nèti lii padhai deo na. te ngaa ladhe ja'a peka lèke, nga tao ka èu tèb'e ja'a?

source_text: then after jesus' hands were tied {after they tied jesus hands} again, annas sent him to caiaphas, the high priest.
target_text: èle ka, anas pua dhèu lere ne asa kayafas dhu j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama yahudi. lod'o lere rèti ne, yesus dhu ra èki era.

source_text: as simon peter was standing warming himself at the fire, someone else said to him, you are not one of that man's disciples, are you? he denied that he was, and said, i am not.
target_text: lod'o èèna, simon petrus titu manyiru ai era. ka dhèu leo dhu ètu èèna, karèi ne, aku nèngu na, èu ne, ca dhèu nèti ana madhutu dhèu nèi, si? te ngaa petrus pasili, peka na, aad'o!

source_text: later one of the high priest's servants, a man who was a relative of the man whose ear peter had cut off before, said to him, i saw you with that man in the grove of olive trees, did i not?
target_text: ètu era ne'e, abhu kahèi dhèu sab'a èci nèti kètu kapai risi agama yahudi. nèngu ne, pa'a'ari kahèi dènge dhèu dhu petrus pare pama'ète rèu dhilu na. hèia dhèu ne karèi petrus, peka na, waa! deo na, èu ne ètu d'ara oka nèi, si? te ja'a kèdhi èu ètu nèi!

source_text: peter again denied it. immediately a rooster crowed, as jesus had said would happen.
target_text: te ngaa petrus pasili hari, hèia manu kokotoo dènge.

source_text: then the jewish leaders syn led jesus from the home of caiaphas to the headquarters of pilate, the roman governor. it was before dawn. pilate was a non-jew, and they thought that if they entered his headquarters, they would become unacceptable to god {god would reject them}, and as a result they would not be able to eat the food during the passover celebration. because of that, they did not want to enter pilate's headquarters.
target_text: d'ara mad'ae aae era, lere rèti yesus nèti kayafas asa èmu jabatan gubernur ètu benteng sordad'u roma. dhèu yahudi se maso boe asa èmu dhèu roma, te èèna pakaj'alu rèngu. te ladhe ra maso, na, rèngu bisa boe ra'a pesta paska.

source_text: so pilate came out to talk to them. he said, what law do you say that this man has disobeyed?
target_text: hèia gubernur pilatus la'e asa li'u paraga dènge dhèu yahudi se. ka na karèi, aku nèngu na, miu pèci sasala ngaa mi dedha dhèu ne'e?

source_text: they knew that jesus had not disobeyed any roman law, so they did not want to answer him. instead, they said, if this man were not a criminal, we would not have brought him to you!
target_text: hèia ra b'ala, peka na, sèmi ne'e, ama. ladhe nèngu ne dhèu bhelu-katub'a boe, na, tatu ji'i mai boe asa madha ama. ngaa hari ji'i mai saraka ne asa kacui-aai ama.

source_text: then pilate said to them, take him yourselves, and judge him according to your own laws! then the jewish leaders syn said, no! we want him executed, but we want you romans to execute him, because we jews have no right to execute anyone!
target_text: ka gubernur peka dènge dhèu se, na, sèmi ne'e. hud'i laa miu ka dhu uri lii langu na, madhutu atora miu dhèu yahudi. hèia ama-ama dhèu yahudi se, peka na, bisa boe ama. ji'i dhèu yahudi dènge heka hak ho pama'ète hahuku madhe. dhoka miu dhèu paredha roma di dhu dènge hak èèna.

source_text: the romans executed people by nailing them to a cross. so, as a result of what the jewish leaders said, it was fulfilled {the romans would fulfill} what jesus had said previously about the way he was going to die.
target_text: lii padhai lii rèngu èèna, palèke dènge lii padhai dhu uru èèna yesus peka nèdhi le. te nèngu dhu peka le dènge dhèu unu na sèra, na, nèngu madhe madhutu j'ara paredha roma, nuka ra paku ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: pilate then went back inside his headquarters. he summoned jesus. because the jewish leaders had said that jesus claimed to be a king, pilate said to jesus scornfully, are you the king of the jews?
target_text: hèia gubernur maso hari asa d'ara benteng sordad'u. ka na paroa yesus, hèia na karèi, peka na, èu ne, dhèu aae dhèu yahudi, do?

source_text: jesus replied, are you asking that because you yourself want to know if i claim to be a king, or because ◄someone else/caiaphas► said that i claim to be their king?
target_text: te ngaa yesus karèi ne, aku nèngu na, ama ka peka sèmi èèna, do abhu dhèu leo ka dhu peka dènge ama lula-nèti ja'a?

source_text: pilate replied, i am not a jew, so ◄i cannot understand these matters! /how can i understand these matters? ► rhq it was your fellow jews and your chief priests who brought you to me! what have you done to make them want to execute you?
target_text: hèia gubernur dhaa, na, eee! ja'a ne dhèu yahudi boe. ana kabarai èu mesa mu ka dhu saraka èu. ngaa hari kètu agama yahudi sèra. èu ne, tao sala ngaa? èu peka sèku!

source_text: jesus replied, it is not people in mty this world who are making me king. if it was people in this world who were making me a king, my disciples would have fought in order that the jewish leaders syn would be prevented {to prevent the jewish leaders syn} from seizing me. but it is not someone here in this world who is making me a king.
target_text: ka yesus peka na, ja'a ne, dhèu aae boe nèti rai-haha ne. te ladhe ja'a j'aj'i dhèu aae sama sèmi èèna, tatu dhèu-dhèu ja'a palab'a le, ka dhèu yahudi kèpe boe ja'a. tare'a, ja'a ne dhèu aae. te ngaa ca dhèu sa ètu rai-haha ne ded'e boe ja'a.

source_text: then pilate said to him, so are you saying that you are a king? jesus replied, yes, what you have said about my being a king is correct. i was born to become a king, and i came into this world to tell people the truth about god. everyone who believes the truth pays attention to what i say.
target_text: hèia gubernur karèi hari, peka na, de èu ne, dhèu aae, do? ka yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama unu mu ka dhu peka, na, ja'a ne dhèu aae. dhu lèke ka, rara iisi ja'a ne, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu aae. ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne ho j'aj'i dhèu aae, sèna ka ja'a peka-padhai j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu kèpe pa'èra j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke, rèngu sèra ka dhu nanene ja'a.

source_text: pilate said to him, how can anyone know what the truth is? after he said that, he went outside and talked to the jewish leaders syn again. he said to them, i do not find that he has done anything at all for which i should punish him.
target_text: ka gubernur karèi, peka na, dhu lèke èèna, sèmi ngaa sa? ropa gubernur pilatus padhai lii nare, hèia kalua hari la'e asa dhèu yahudi sèra. ka na peka, ja'a parisa le nèngu, te ngaa abhu boe sasala na èci sa.

source_text: but you jews customarily, every year during the passover celebration, ask me to release for you someone who is in prison. so would you like for me to release for you the man who you jews say is your king?
target_text: te ngaa miu dhu tema le, tèu mai-tèu mai lod'o d'ai pesta paska sèmi ne'e, ja'a patabuli ana bèdho ca dhèu hia miu. de tèu ne'e mo'o sèna ka ja'a patabuli dhèu aae yahudi miu, do tasamia?

source_text: they shouted again, no, do not release this man! instead, release barrabas! but barrabas was in prison because he was a revolutionist!
target_text: ka aa'i-aa'i ra pa'oo-parodha, peka na, baku patabuli dhèu èèna! patabuli barabas di! barabas ne, ca dhèu dhu bhelu titu kèna.

source_text: then pilate took jesus inside and had soldiers ◄scourge jesus/strike jesus with a whip that had pieces of metal or bone fastened to it►.
target_text: èle èèna ka, gubernur pilatus pua sordad'u na lasi kalabhe yesus pake gui.

source_text: the soldiers also took some branches with thorns and wove them to make something like a crown. then they put it on his head. they also put a purple robe on him. they did these things to ridicule him by pretending that he was a king. then they kept coming to him and saying, hooray for the king of the jews iro! and slapping him on his face.
target_text: aa sordad'u se'e rare kalai aj'u padhudhu kahèi, ho ènyu tao solo. ka ra lalilu solo ne mi kètu yesus, nuka sèmi rèngu neo ded'e dhèu aae hiu dhu pake solo dhèu aae. aa te ngaa sasoa na, ra neo pahahe ne di. hèia ra papake yesus kodho madhera èci dhu mea sanama mangèru, nuka sèmi dhèu aae biasa pake. aa ra sasei ne, peka na, tabea, dhèu aae yahudi! sordad'u se tèb'e ne g'ana-kariu kahèi.

source_text: once more pilate came outside and said to the crowd, look! i am bringing him out to you so that you may know that i do not find that he has done anything for which we should punish him any more.
target_text: ka gubernur la'e hari catèka peka dènge dhèu ae sèra, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e! ja'a kèti ne asa li'u hia miu. te ngaa miu hud'i me'a ku, na, ja'a parisa kore le, te ngaa abhu boe sasala na èci sa.

source_text: when jesus came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe, pilate said to them, look at this wretched man!
target_text: ropa rèti yesus asa li'u, nèngu dhu pake era solo padhudhu dènge kodho madhera dhu mea sanama mangèru. hèia gubernur lii dènge dhèu ae se, peka na, ladhe ku, dhèu ne.

source_text: when the chief priests and temple guards saw him, they shouted, command your soldiers to kill him by nailing him to a cross! crucify him! pilate, knowing that they could not legally do it themselves, said to them, you yourselves take him and nail him to a cross! as for me, i do not find that he has done anything for which we should punish him.
target_text: ropa kètu agama dènge dhèu madhenga èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i sèra ladhe rèdhi yesus, hèia ra pa'oo-parodha palere-lere, peka na, pamadhe ne! paku ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha! te ngaa gubernur peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, hud'i laa miu ka dhu mèti ne, lami pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. te ja'a abhu boe sasala na èci sa, dhu palèke dènge hahuku madhe.

source_text: the jewish leaders syn replied, our ancestor moses gave us the law that says we must kill anyone who claims to be god. this man claims that he is ◄the son of/the man who is also► god, so you must have him killed {command your soldiers to kill him}.
target_text: dhèu yahudi dhaa, aku rèngu na, ji'i dènge atora nèti ama lamatua. madhutu atora ne, dhèu ne hud'i madhe ku, lula na ded'e iisi na j'aj'i ana ama lamatua.

source_text: when pilate heard that, he was more afraid of what would happen to himself if he commanded the soldiers to kill jesus.
target_text: ropa gubernur tadèngi lii padhai ra, hèia asa na madha'u.

source_text: so he took jesus back inside the headquarters. he said to jesus, where do you really come from? but jesus did not answer him.
target_text: ka la'e hari asa d'ara benteng, hèia na karèi yesus, peka na, èu ne, dhèu mia? te ngaa yesus bhoka boe hèb'a.

source_text: so pilate said to him, are you refusing to answer me? do you not know that i have authority to release you, and i also have authority to have you crucified {command my soldiers to crucify you}?
target_text: ka gubernur jèke yesus, peka na, eeh! nga tao ka èu b'ala boe ja'a? èu dhu me'a, si? ja'a ne, dènge koasa pamadhe èu, do, patabuli èu.

source_text: jesus replied, the only authority you have is what has been given to you by god mty {what god mty has given you}. the high priest put me into your hands. he has done to me what he wanted to do, and you do not really want to do it. so he is guilty of committing a greater sin than you are.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala, peka na, sèmi ne'e, ama. ladhe ama dhu dènge koasa sèmi èèna, na, lula ama abhu koasa nèti ama lamatua ètu sorga. te dhodhoka nèngu di dhu hia ama koasa èèna, sèna ka tao ngaa èci sa hia mi ja'a ne. te ngaa dhèu dhu saraka ja'a asa ama, rèngu sèra ka dhu pasae sasala bia risi.

source_text: because of that, pilate kept trying to release jesus. but the jewish leaders syn, threatening to report to the emperor that pilate was not going to punish a man who claimed he was a king, continued to shout, anyone who claims that he is a king is opposing the emperor! so if you release this man, we will make sure that the emperor learns about it, and then he will not consider you as his friend!
target_text: karèi nèti èèna ka, gubernur tenge j'ara ho patabuli yesus. te ngaa dhèu yahudi se pa'oo palere-lere, aku rèngu na, ladhe ama patabuli dhèu ne, tatu ama dhu pa'angalai boe dènge dhèu aae kapai, keser. te dhèu dhu ded'e ngi'u na j'aj'i dhèu aae, nèngu èèna lab'a keser.

source_text: when pilate heard that, he brought jesus out again. he sat down at the place where he made decisions about punishing people. the place was called {people called it} the stone pavement. in the aramaic language its name was gabbatha.
target_text: ka ropa gubernur tadèngi lii padhai dhèu se, hèia na pua rèti yesus asa li'u. ka gubernur madhèdi ètu kadera pama'ète lii, ètu era èci dhu ra pangare na, tana lapang nèti hadhu kabela. madhutu lii aram, ngara na gabata.

source_text: it was almost noontime, on the day that they prepared things for the passover celebration or, the day before the sabbath during the passover celebration. pilate said to the jewish leaders syn, ridiculing them, look at your king!
target_text: lod'o èèna, lèke dènge lod'o sadia kalela paska. pe d'ara lod'o titu mera sa, gubernur peka dènge dhèu yahudi sèra, aku nèngu na, ladhe ku laa! nèngu ne, dhèu aae miu!

source_text: they shouted, take him away! take him away! have him crucified {command your soldiers to nail him to a cross}! pilate said to them, he is your king! do you really want me to tell my soldiers to nail him to a cross? the chief priests replied, the emperor is our king! we do not have any other king!
target_text: te ngaa rèngu asa hoe pa'oo-parodha peka na, mèti ne, asa li'u mai! pamadhe ne! paku ne asa aj'u palolo-palèbha! hèia gubernur papane si, peka na, de tasamia? miu d'èi, ladhe ja'a pamadhe dhèu aae miu ne, do? ka kètu agama yahudi se b'ala, peka na, dhèu aae ji'i dhodhoka ca dhèu di, nuka keser! dhèu leo aad'o!

source_text: then at last pilate agreed to do what they wanted, and he told the soldiers to crucify jesus. then the soldiers took jesus away.
target_text: hèia gubernur hia yesus asa sordad'u sèra, sèna ka ra paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. hèia sordad'u se sèmi rare yesus.

source_text: as they left, he himself was carrying the cross on which they were going to nail him. they went to a place called the place of a skull. in the aramaic language it is called {they call it} golgotha.
target_text: ka yesus pasae aj'u palolo-palèbha na la'e asa li'u kota. lasi asa era èci dhu ngara na, era rui kètu. madhutu lii aram, era ne ngara na, golgota.

source_text: there, after removing most of his clothes, the soldiers nailed him to the cross. they also nailed two other criminals to crosses. there was one on each side, and jesus was in the middle.
target_text: d'ai era èèna, ra paku yesus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha èci. dhèu se paku kahèi dhèu leo dhèu dua. èci re sebhe g'ana, aa ca dhèu hari re sebhe kariu yesus. ka yesus ètu talora rèngu dua ra.

source_text: pilate also had them write on a board a notice that stated why they were executing him, and fasten it to the cross. but all they wrote was ‘jesus from nazareth, the king of the jews'.
target_text: ka gubernur paredha sordad'u na sèra, suri ètu papa èci, ho paku re dedha kètu yesus. ètu papa ne ra suri, peka na, yesus, dhèu nasaret. nèngu ne, dhèu aae dhèu yahudi

source_text: many jews were able to read this sign, because the place where jesus was nailed {where they nailed jesus} to the cross was very close to jerusalem, where many people had come for the celebration, and because it was written {they wrote it} in three languages: hebrew, latin, and greek.
target_text: rèngu suri ètu papa ne pake tèlu lii, nuka: lii aram, lii yunani, dènge lii latin. dhèu yahudi ae ka dhu baca sasuri ne, lula era mamadhe yesus ne, padètu dènge kota yerusalem.

source_text: so the jewish priests went back to pilate and protested, saying to him, change what they have written from ‘the king of the jews' to ‘this man said that he is the king of the jews'!
target_text: te ngaa kètu agama yahudi sèra ro'o boe. ka lasi peka dènge gubernur, aku rèngu na, ama! baku suri ‘dhèu aae nèti dhèu yahudi'! be'a risi suri laa peka na, ‘dhèu ne peka na, nèngu dhèu aae nèti dhèu yahudi. '

source_text: pilate replied, what i told them to write is what they have written, and i will not change it.
target_text: te ngaa gubernur dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a ka dhu pua si suri sèmi èèna. de hud'i ka laa!

source_text: after the soldiers nailed jesus to the cross, they took his clothes and divided them into four parts, one part for each soldier. but they kept his cloak separate. this cloak was without seam, woven from top to bottom, one piece of cloth.
target_text: ropa sordad'u paku rare yesus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, hèia ra pabagi mèdha-papake na mi èpa pala. ca dhèu sordad'u abhu ca pala. hèia rare kodho li'u na, dhu j'au boe, dhu manènu kateme nèti dedha.

source_text: so they said to each other, let's not tear it. instead, let's decide ◄by throwing lots/by gambling► who will get it. so that is what the soldiers did. as a result, these words were fulfilled {they fulfilled these words} that the psalmist had written in scripture, they divided most of my clothes among themselves. they cast lots for one piece of my clothing.
target_text: ka ra papeka, aku rèngu na, èdhi baku ciu eele kodho na. be'a risi ère lot, sèna ka te'a, na, cee ka dhu abhu. èèna j'aj'i madhutu sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua, dhu peka na, rèngu pabagi mèdha-papake ja'a, ka ra ère lot ho abhu kodho ja'a. hèia sordad'u se tao madhutu sèmi èèna ka.

source_text: near the cross where they had nailed jesus stood his mother, his mother's sister, mary the wife of clopas, and another mary, the woman from magdala village.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, abhu kahèi dhèu bhèni pèri-pèri dhu titu. rèngu se, nuka: ina yesus, ina iiki yesus, maria dhèu èmu klopas, dènge maria nèti rae magdala.

source_text: jesus saw his mother standing there. he also saw me standing nearby. then he said to his mother, this man will now be like your son.
target_text: yesus ladhe nèdhi ina na dhu titu ètu èèna, sama-sama dènge ja'a, yohanis, nuka ana madhutu dhu nèngu sue. ka yesus lii dènge ina na, aku nèngu na, ina. nèngu ne, ana mu.

source_text: and he said to me, treat this woman as met your mother. so from that time i took her to my home and took care of her.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge ja'a, peka na, yohanis. nèti deo ne'e, tao laa nèngu sèmi ina èu! ka karèi nèti lod'o èèna, ina yesus pea dènge ja'a.

source_text: later, jesus knew that everything that god sent him to do had now been completed {that he had now completed everything that god sent him to do}, but he knew that something else that was written in the scriptures had to be fulfilled {that he had to fulfill something else that they had written in the scriptures}. so he said, i am thirsty!
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus ne'a le, na, nèngu sab'a nare aa'i le sasab'a-la'a na. se'e se pamèci dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua karèi nèti uru ka. hèia yesus peka, na, ja'a koko-kamango.

source_text: there was a jar of sour wine there. so someone took a stalk of a plant called hyssop and fastened a sponge to it. then he dipped the sponge into the wine and lifted it up to jesus' lips.
target_text: ètu era ne'e abhu èi anggor manyilu ètu d'ara g'ala iiki cue. ka sordad'u sèra rare ula ho cèb'u asa èi anggor, hèia èki mi suu aj'u ca laa, ka j'ole asa hèb'a na.

source_text: when jesus tasted the sour wine, he shouted, i have finished all that i came to do! then he bowed his head and ◄died/handed over his spirit to god►.
target_text: ropa yesus camuci nare, hèia na lii, aku nèngu na, èle kèna. hèia kètu na loe, ka ma'ète a'ae.

source_text: that was the day that they prepared everything for their ◄sabbath/day of rest►. the next day was a special day of rest, because it was the day of rest during the passover celebration. the jewish leaders syn did not want the bodies of the three men to remain on the cross during their ◄sabbath/day of rest► because leaving bodies hanging overnight would be contrary to their jewish laws. so they went to pilate and asked him to command that the legs of the three men on the crosses be broken {the soldiers to break the legs of the three men on the crosses}, so that they would die quickly. then their bodies could be taken down and buried {someone could take down their bodies and bury them}.
target_text: lod'o èèna lèke hari jumat. madhutu atora agama, dhèu yahudi hud'i sadia mema d'ara lod'o èèna, sèna ka bèli èèna rèngu soru lod'o sabaj'a ra. nèti èèna ka, ro'o boe tèke eele ngi'u aae dhèu madhe, kadhoe tèke ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a. te lod'o sabaj'a èèna, lod'o be'a. de ama-ama dhèu yahudi manèngi gubernur, sèna ka pua dhèu lasi hake papadhe haga dhèu ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, rèngu madhe malai, ho dhèu bisa papuru ngi'u aae ra nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha ako lod'o aae era.

source_text: so, after pilate agreed, the soldiers went and broke the legs of the first man whom they had nailed on a cross near jesus. then they broke the legs of the second man.
target_text: hèia sordad'u se lasi asa era èèna. ka ra hake papadhe uru haga dhèu dua sèra, dhu paku sama-sama dènge yesus.

source_text: but when they came to jesus, they saw that he was dead already. so they did not break his legs.
target_text: te ngaa ropa ra d'ai yesus, rèdhi, na, yesus dhu madhe le. nèti èèna ka, rèngu hake papadhe boe haga na.

source_text: instead, one of the soldiers pierced jesus' side with a spear to make sure that jesus was dead. immediately blood clots and other liquid flowed out, which showed that jesus was really dead.
target_text: te ngaa sordad'u ca dhèu nare kapoke na, hèia kèj'i d'ara karasa yesus. ka raa kalua, aa èi kalua kahèi.

source_text: i, john, saw this myself, and what i am writing is true. i know that i am telling the truth, and i am saying this in order that you may believe in or, my testimony about jesus.
target_text: ja'a ne'e ka dhu ladhe kèdhi dènge musi madha ku. ja'a kèdhi aa'i, aa dhu ja'a suri ne lèke tare'a-re'a. te ja'a ke'a mèu ngaa dhu ja'a lolo ne lèke mola-mola, sèna ka miu bisa parcaya lii padhai ja'a.

source_text: these things happened in order that these words would be fulfilled {to fulfill these words} that are written in scripture: not one of his bones will be broken {no one will break any of his bones}.
target_text: j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i, lula sasuri ama lamatua dhu suri, na, rui na ca laa sa, padhe boe.

source_text: and they fulfilled another scripture passage that has these words: ‘they will look on the one whom they have pierced'.
target_text: ètu era leo d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ne, suri kahèi, peka na, èèna rèngu ladhe rèdhi dhèu dhu ra kèj'i ne.

source_text: later, joseph, from arimathea town, went to pilate and asked pilate to allow him to take jesus' body down from the cross. joseph was a disciple of jesus, but he did not tell anyone that, because he was afraid of the other jewish leaders syn. pilate permitted him to take jesus' body, so he went, along with others, and they took jesus' body down from the cross.
target_text: abhu dhèu èci ngara na yusuf, nèti rae arimatea. nèngu ana madhutu yesus kahèi. te ngaa na madhutu pahuni-pahuni, lula madha'u dènge ama-ama dhèu yahudi. yusuf la'e asa gubernur pilatus, manèngi ijin sèna ka bisa nèti ngi'u aae yesus. gubernur d'èi kahèi. ka yusuf la'e papuru ngi'u aae yesus, hèia ded'e nèti.

source_text: nicodemus was one of them. he was the man who previously went to visit jesus at night. nicodemus bought an expensive mixture of myrrh and aloe spices to put on the body. it weighed about ◄75 pounds/35 kilograms►.
target_text: nikodemus la'e sama-sama dènge yusuf kahèi. nikodemus ne'e ka dhu uru èèna la'e paraga dènge yesus re mèda. na hèli rampe ae titu kèna, pe d'ai tèlu nguru tèlu kilo sa, sèna ka tao mi ngi'u aae yesus.

source_text: they took the body of jesus and wrapped strips of linen cloth around it, putting the spices in with the strips of cloth. they did this according to the jewish customs about burying bodies in tombs.
target_text: hèia ra hèlu ngi'u aae yesus dènge bèla halus. ladhe hèlu ca tèka, ra tao rampe la'a. rèngu tao sèmi ne'e, madhutu ad'a dhèu yahudi ladhe padhane dhèu madhe.

source_text: close to the place where jesus was crucified {where they nailed jesus to the cross} there was a grove of trees, and at the edge of that grove was a new burial cave. nobody had ever been put in that cave previously.
target_text: kaj'èu boe nèti era yesus madhe ne, abhu oka bunga cue. ètu d'ara oka ne, dhèu heka pae rare ro'a dhèu madhe kèna. ra padhane rèdhi mèka dhèu èci sa ètu d'ara ro'a èèna.

source_text: the jewish day of rest would start at sunset, and they had to finish burying his body before then. so, since that cave was nearby, they laid jesus' body there and rolled a huge stone in front of the entrance.
target_text: lod'o èèna, lod'o sadia dhèu yahudi ho soru lod'o sabaj'a ra, oe èle kèna. nèti èèna ka, dhèu se tèke ngi'u aae yesus ètu d'ara ro'a èèna, te era èèna kaj'èu boe.

source_text: early on sunday morning, while it was still dark, mary, the woman from magdala village, went to the burial cave with some other women. they saw that the stone had been removed {that someone had removed the stone} from the entrance to the cave.
target_text: hari migu, nuka lod'o partama ètu d'ara migu èèna. mad'ae aae era, maria nèti rae magdala la'e asa ro'a yesus. d'ai era èèna, ladhe nèdhi hadhu aae dhu pake katange ro'a, hari eele nèti era na.

source_text: so mary ran to where simon peter and i were staying in jerusalem. she said to us, they have taken the lord's body out of the burial cave, and we do not know where they have put it!
target_text: hèia na rai lèpa hari la'e paraga dènge simon petrus aa dènge ja'a, nuka ana madhutu dhu yesus sue, ka na peka, dhèu mana'u rèti le lamatua èdhi nèti ro'a na! te'a boe rèngu tèke ne ètu mia!

source_text: so peter and i started going to the cave.
target_text: ka ja'a dènge petrus rai la'a asa era ro'a èèna.

source_text: we were both running, but i ran faster than peter and got there first.
target_text: ji'i rai palere-lere, te ngaa ja'a malai risi, ka d'ai uuru ro'a èèna.

source_text: i stooped down at the entrance and looked inside. i saw the strips of linen cloth lying there where his body had been laid, but i did not go inside.
target_text: te ngaa laku boe asa d'ara ro'a, dhoka patigi nèti li'u di. ètu d'ara ro'a, ja'a ladhe kèdhi bèla halus dhu ra pake hèlu mi ngi'u aae yesus.

source_text: then simon peter, who was running behind me, arrived. he went inside the cave. he, too, saw the strips of linen cloth lying there.
target_text: te ngaa ropa petrus d'ai, la'e dènge asa d'ara. nèdhi bèla halus dhu ètu èèna kahèi.

source_text: he also saw the cloth that they had wrapped around jesus' head. it had been folded and put {someone had folded it and put it} aside, separate from the linen strips.
target_text: nèdhi kahèi lesu dhu ra pahutu kètu yesus. te ngaa lesu ne dhu lèpe ètu era leo nèti bèla halus ne.

source_text: then i also went inside. i saw those things and i believed that jesus had truly become alive again.
target_text: hèia ja'a, dhu d'ai uuru ro'a, maso madhutu kahèi asa d'ara. ropa ladhe kèdhi aa'i-aa'i se, ka ja'a parcaya lii padhadha dhu uru èèna yesus peka mema, na, bèli-camèd'a nèngu mamuri hari nèti mamadhe na.

source_text: before this happened, we did not understand from what the prophets had written in the scriptures, that he had to become alive again after he died.
target_text: te lod'o èèna, ji'i dhu j'aj'i ana madhutu na, dhae nge'a mèka sasoa nèti isi sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, dhu suri mema, peka na, kristus hud'i mamuri hari ku nèti mamadhe na.

source_text: then we two disciples went back to where we were staying. in the meantime, mary returned to the cave.
target_text: èle ka, ji'i dua mi lèpa.

source_text: as she stood outside the cave crying, she stooped down to look inside the cave.
target_text: te ngaa maria titu era ètu li'u ro'a èèna. nèngu tangi taruu. ka na patigi asa d'ara ro'a ne, aa na tangi era.

source_text: she saw two angels in very white clothing, sitting at the place where jesus' body had been laid. one was where his head had been, and the other was where his feet had been.
target_text: ladhe nèdhi ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga dhèu dua. ana pajuu se, pake mèdha-papake pudhi. dua ra madhèdi ètu era dhu ca lod'o ni dhèu paj'unu ngi'u aae yesus. ca dhèu madhèdi re era kètu, aa èci hari dhu madhèdi re era haga.

source_text: they said to her, woman, why are you crying? she said to them, they have taken away the body of my lord, and i do not know where they have put it!
target_text: ana pajuu se karèi maria, aku rèngu na, nga tao ka èu tangi? hèia maria dhaa, peka na, ja'a tangi, lula dhèu ded'e rèti ngi'u aae lamatua ja'a. te ngaa ke'a boe ra tèke ne ètu mia.

source_text: after she said that, she turned around and saw jesus standing there, but she did not know that it was jesus.
target_text: ropa na padhai lii nare, nèngu kabib'a asa li'u. ka ladhe nèdhi ca dhèu dhu titu ètu èèna, te ngaa ne'a boe, na, dhèu ne, nuka yesus.

source_text: he said to her, woman, why are you crying? who are you looking for? thinking that he was the gardener, she said to him, sir, if you have taken his body away, tell me where you have put it. then i will get it and bury it properly.
target_text: hèia yesus karèi ne, peka na, nga tao ka èu tangi? te èu tenge cee? maria pangee, na, nèngu ne dhèu madhenga oka. ka maria pamako dhèu ne, aku nèngu na, ama. ladhe ama ka ded'e mèti ngi'u aae na, peka ku laa, ama tèke ne ètu mia. hud'i laa laku ded'e kèti ne asa era leo, sèna ka padhane ne pabe'a-be'a. sue laa, ama!

source_text: jesus said to her, mary! she turned toward him again and recognized him. then she exclaimed in aramaic, rabboni! which means ‘teacher'.
target_text: ka yesus paroa ne, peka na, maria. hèia na kabèli ladhe asa yesus, ka na lii, aku nèngu na, raboni! lii aram, sasoa na, mese ja'a!

source_text: jesus said to her, stop clinging to me, because i have not yet returned to my father. go to my disciples and tell them, ‘i am about to return to my father and your father, to the one who is my god and your god'.
target_text: yesus peka dènge ne, baku g'ag'e ku ja'a, te ja'a dhae ca'e mèka laku asa ama ku ètu sorga. te ngaa lamu uuru ku peka dènge angalai ja'a sèra, na, ‘ja'a neo ca'e laku asa ama ku. nèngu èèna, ama miu kahèi. nèngu èèna, ama lamatua ja'a. de nèngu, ama lamatua miu kahèi. '

source_text: so mary went to where we disciples were and told us that she had seen the lord alive again. she also told us what jesus said that she should tell us.
target_text: èle ka, maria, dhèu magdala èèna, la'e lolo dènge ana madhutu yesus sèra, peka na, ja'a paraga le dènge lamatua èdhi, yesus! ka na peka dènge rèngu lii moa yesus.

source_text: on that sunday evening we disciples gathered together. the doors were locked {we locked the doors} because we were afraid that the jewish leaders syn might arrest us. suddenly jesus appeared miraculously and stood among us! he said to us, may god give you inner peace!
target_text: lod'o èèna, lèke dènge hari migu, nuka lod'o partama ètu d'ara migu èèna. lod'o heka cèna kèna, ka ana madhutu yesus pakaboko. rèngu patèke babèdho èmu ne pa'èra-èra, lula rèngu madha'u dènge ama-ama dhèu yahudi. re'a rare boe, na, yesus titu ètu talora aae rèngu, ka na lii, aku nèngu na, saloom!

source_text: after he said that, he showed us the wounds in his hands and his side. we were very happy when we saw the lord!
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii nare dènge rèngu sèmi èèna, hèia na pad'elo nu'a dhu ètu kacui-aai dènge karasa na. ana madhutu na karej'e titu kèna, ropa ladhe rèdhi lamatua rèngu.

source_text: jesus said to us again, may god give you peace! just like my father sent me, now i am sending you to proclaim my message.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge rèngu, na, hud'i laa miu mamuri dame dènge mera-milu. sanèd'e, te ama ku pua-paleha ja'a tasamia, na, ja'a pua-paleha miu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: after saying that, he breathed on us and said, receive the holy spirit!
target_text: padhai lii nare sèmi èèna, ka na ara padètu la'e asa rèngu, hèia na tiu a'ae na mi rèngu èci-èci. hèia na padhai lii, peka na, ja'a pangèd'u miu roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci. sèmi mere ne.

source_text: if you forgive people for their having sinned, god will already have forgiven them. if you do not forgive them, god has not forgiven them.
target_text: de, ladhe miu pabhèlu eele sasala dhèu, na, sasala ne ele le, te ama lamatua saku eele sasala èèna kahèi. te ngaa ladhe miu mo'o boe pabhèlu eele sasala dhèu, na, lamatua saku eele boe sasala sèra kahèi.

source_text: one of us disciples, thomas, the one whom we called the twin, was not with us when jesus appeared to us.
target_text: ca dhèu nèti ana madhutu yesus canguru dua sèra, ngara na tomas. ra pangare na, ‘ana kembar' kahèi. ropa yesus pad'elo iisi na dènge ana madhutu dhu leo sèra, tomas aad'o.

source_text: when the rest of us told him that we had seen the lord, he said to us, if i do not see the marks of the nails in his hands and put my fingers in the place where the nails were, and put my hands into the place in his side where the soldier thrust the spear, i will certainly not believe that he was the one you saw!
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ropa angalai na sèra peka dènge ne, ji'i paraga le dènge lamatua èdhi, hèia tomas dhaa, na, sèmi ne'e. ja'a hud'i ladhe kèdhi ku nu'a era paku sèra ètu kacui-aai na, aa pamaso ai ja'a asa nu'a ètu d'ara karasa na. ladhe ja'a tao mèka sèmi èèna, ja'a bisa mèka parcaya, na, nèngu mamuri hari le.

source_text: a week later we were in the house again. this time thomas was with us. although the doors had been locked {we had locked the doors}, jesus again appeared miraculously and stood among us. he said, may god give peace to you!
target_text: ca migu hari, ka ana madhutu yesus sama-sama dènge tomas ètu d'ara èmu cue. masi ka babèdho dhu patèke, te ngaa yesus maso asa d'ara, titu ètu talora aae rèngu. ka na hia lii maho'o dènge ra, peka na, saloom!

source_text: then he showed thomas his hands and said to him, put your finger here! look at the wounds in my hands! reach out your hand and put it in the wound in my side! stop doubting lit/dou! instead, believe that i am alive again!
target_text: hèia na padhai lii dènge tomas, aku nèngu na, j'ole kacui-aai èu mai, ho g'ag'e kacui-aai ja'a ne. aa mai g'ag'e nu'a ètu d'ara karasa ja'a ne. parcaya ka, na, ja'a ne mamuri hari le! core eele ka d'ara parcaya boe èu èèna.

source_text: thomas answered him, you are truly my lord and my god!
target_text: tomas dhaa, peka na, ira ii, ama, ee! ja'a heka lèka tare'a-re'a kèna! ama ne, kètu ja'a, aa ama lamatua ja'a kahèi!

source_text: jesus said to him, because you have seen me, you have believed that about me. but god is truly pleased with those who have believed that about me, even though they have not seen me!
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge ne, tomas! èu parcaya, na, ja'a mamuri hari le, lula èu mèdhi le ja'a dènge musi madha èu unu mu. te ngaa dhu oto risi ka, nuka dhèu dhu rèdhi boe ja'a, te ngaa ra parcaya.

source_text: we disciples saw jesus perform many other miracles, but i have not written about them in this book.
target_text: yesus tao tadha malaa dhu leo ae-ae kahèi, dhu ja'a suri boe ètu d'ara sasuri ne. ana madhutu na ladhe rèdhi tadha malaa se'e dènge musi madha rèngu unu ra.

source_text: but these that i have written about, i have written about them in order that you may believe that jesus is the messiah, ◄the son of god/the man who is also god►, and in order that you may have eternal life by trusting ◄in him/in what he has done for you► mty.
target_text: te ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a suri ètu d'ara sasuri ne, sèna ka miu parcaya, na, yesus ne, kristus dhu ama lamatua padhadha tèke hia mai. yesus ne, ana ama lamatua kahèi. aa ropa miu parcaya ne, miu abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe, lula miu j'aj'i dhèu unu nèngu.

source_text: after that, jesus showed himself to us disciples when we were at tiberias lake, which is another name for galilee lake. this is what happened:
target_text: èle pèri-pèri lod'o, ka yesus pad'elo hari iisi na ètu sebhe dano tiberias. lii lolo na, sèmi ne'e ka:

source_text: simon peter, thomas who was called {whom we called} the twin, nathaniel from cana town in galilee, my older brother and i, and two other disciples were together.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ana madhutu yesus, dhèu pidhu dhu pakaboko. rèngu se, nuka: simon petrus, tomas, dhu ra pangare ne, ‘ana kembar', natanel, nèti rae kana ètu propensi galilea, ana dhèu dua nèti sabadeus, dènge ana madhutu yesus dhu leo dhèu dua.

source_text: simon peter said to us, i am going to try to catch some fish. we said, we will go with you. so we went down to the lake and got into the boat. but that night we caught nothing.
target_text: simon petrus peka dènge angalai na se'e, ja'a neo laku pèku i'a. hèia angalai na se'e dhaa, aku rèngu na, oo! ji'i la'a kahèi. ka lasi asa sebhe dano. hèia ca'e koha lasi tenge i'a. te ngaa mèda èèna rèngu rara boe ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: early the next morning, jesus stood on the shore, but we did not know that it was jesus.
target_text: asa bèli mad'ae aae èèna, yesus titu ètu sebhe dano ne. te ngaa ana madhutu na sèra re'a boe, na, nèngu ne, yesus.

source_text: he called out to us, my friends, you have not caught any fish, have you? we answered, you are correct, we have not caught any.
target_text: ka na pa'oo, peka na, mera i'a, do? hèia ra dhaa, peka na, mola-mèu lao! ci'u sa, aad'o hèi.

source_text: he said to us, throw your net out from the right-hand side of the boat! then you will find some! we did that, and we caught so many fish in the net that we were unable to pull the net into the boat!
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, lolo sèku pèku miu asa cabèka koha èèna. pe miu abhu. ka rèngu tao madhutu kahèi. ka ra abhu i'a ae titu kèna, toke rèngu bisa boe ère rare pèku ne asa dedha koha.

source_text: but i knew that it was jesus, so i said to peter, it is the lord! peter had taken off his cloak while he was working, but as soon as he heard me say it is the lord! he wrapped his cloak around himself and jumped into the water and swam to shore.
target_text: aa ja'a ètu èèna kahèi. ja'a ne, ana madhutu dhu yesus sue. ka ja'a peka dènge petrus, na, ira ii! nèngu nèi, lamatua èdhi! ropa tadèngi nare lii ja'a deo na, hèia simon petrus pake hari kodho na, ka ridhu asa d'ara dano, sèna ka nangi asa dae.

source_text: the rest of us came to the shore in the boat, pulling the net full of fish. we were not far from shore, only about 100 yards/meters.
target_text: te koha ne kaj'èu nèti dae pe d'ai cangasu meter sa. hèia angalai na kao koha asa dae, todhe dènge pèku dhu pènu dènge i'a deo sa.

source_text: when we got to the shore, we saw that there was a fire of burning coals there, with a large fish on the fire, and some buns.
target_text: ropa rèngu d'ai dae, hèia rèdhi ai karoo, dènge i'a dhu ra paga. aa abhu roti kahèi.

source_text: jesus said to us, bring some of the fish that you have just caught!
target_text: yesus lii dènge ra, mèti ku i'a osa miu d'ai ciki sa, dhu miu heka pèku mere deo na.

source_text: simon peter got in the boat and dragged the net to the shore. it was full of large fish. there were 153 of them! but in spite of there being so many fish, the net was not torn.
target_text: ka simon petrus ca'e hari asa dedha koha, ho ère pa'eta pèku ne asa dae. pèku ne dhu pènu dènge i'a aae, cangasu lèmi nguru tèlu ngi'u. masi ka i'a ae sèmi èèna, te ngaa pèku ne mae boe ciki sa hèi.

source_text: jesus said to us, come and eat some breakfast! none of us dared to ask him, who are you? because we knew that it was the lord.
target_text: ka yesus paroa si, aku nèngu na, mai mi'a ka! rèngu dhu re'a le, na, nèngu ne lamatua rèngu, ka ra bani boe karèi ne, na, ama ne, cee?

source_text: jesus took the buns and gave them to us. he did the same with the fish.
target_text: hèia yesus nare roti dènge i'a, nèti hia si.

source_text: that was the third time that jesus appeared to us disciples after god caused him to become alive again after he died.
target_text: ne'e ne, ka tèlu hari kèna yesus pad'elo iisi na mi ana madhutu na sèra, ropa na mamuri hari nèti mamadhe na.

source_text: so ananias went, and after he found the house where saul was, he entered it. then, as soon as he met saul, he put his hands on him, and he said, brother saul, the lord jesus himself commanded me to come to you. he is the same one who appeared to you sg while you were traveling along the road. he sent me to you in order that you might see again and that you might be completely controlled by the holy spirit {that the holy spirit might completely control you}.
target_text: tadèngi nare lii padhai lii lamatua, hèia ananias la'e ka maso asa èmu èèna. ka na bane ai na mi saulus, peka na, angalai saulus! lamatua yesus dhu pad'elo iisi mi èu ètu talora j'ara lod'o èu mai asa ne'e, nèngu èèna ka dhu pua ja'a mai paraga dènge èu ètu ne'e. na pua ja'a kahèi ho sabaj'a dènge tao kacui-aai mi dedha èu, sèna ka èu bisa mèdhi hari. aa na d'èi ho èu sèmi more roh na dhu mola-mèci.

source_text: but barnabas took him and brought him to the apostles. he explained to the apostles how, while saul was traveling along the road to damascus, he had seen the lord jesus and how the lord had spoken to him there. he also told them how saul had preached boldly about jesus mty to people in damascus. the apostles believed barnabas and told the other believers about that.

source_text: while peter was traveling throughout those regions, once he went to the coastal plain to visit the believers who lived in lydda town.

source_text: in joppa town there was a believer whose name was tabitha. her name in the greek language was dorcas. both of these names mean gazelle/deer/antelope. that woman was continually doing good deeds for others. specifically, she was helping poor people by giving them things that they needed.

source_text: during the time that peter was in lydda, she became sick and died. some women there washed her body according to the jewish custom so that the people could bury it. then they covered her body with cloth and placed it in an upstairs room in her house.
target_text: lod'o èèna, tabita ne pèd'a aae, ka madhe. ka dhèu padiu ne èi. èle èèna ka, ra papake ne mèdha-papake, ka ra paj'unu ne ètu kama dedha.

source_text: he grasped one of her hands and helped her to stand up. after he had summoned the believers and especially the widows among them to come back in, he showed them that tabitha was alive again.

source_text: he always tried to do what would please god; he and his entire household mty were non-jews who habitually worshipped god. he sometimes gave money to help poor jewish people, and he prayed to god regularly.
target_text: nèngu dènge isi èmu na d'èi padètu dènge ama lamatua. te ngaa ae ka dhèu roma leo sèmi boe èèna. nèngu biasa soru-bara dhèu j'èra, aa na maj'èni sabaj'a mi ama lamatua.

source_text: one day at about three o'clock in the afternoon cornelius saw a vision. he clearly saw an angel whom god had sent. the angel came into his room and said to him, cornelius!
target_text: ca lod'o hari, pe d'ara hake tèlu nihia sa, na abhu tanila. na ladhe nèdhi iia-iia ana pajuu ama lamatua èci puru mai nèti sorga, ka na paroa ne, peka na, kornelis!

source_text: cornelius stared at the angel and became terrified. then he asked fearfully, sir, what do you sg want? the angel answered him, you sg have pleased god because you have been praying regularly to him and you often give money to help poor people. those things have been like a sacrifice to god.
target_text: ropa kornelis ladhe nèdhi ana pajuu nèti sorga, ka na madha'u titu kèna. hèia na karèi, aku nèngu na, tasamia, ama? ka ana pajuu ne dhaa, na, lamatua tadèngi le lii manèngi-mangaj'i èu, aa na ne'a le d'ara hua iia èu mi dedha dhèu leo. ka na sanèd'e èu.

source_text: so, now command some men to go to joppa and tell them to bring back a man named simon whose other name is peter.

source_text: he explained to them everything that the angel had said. then he told them to go to joppa to ask peter to come to caesarea.
