target_text: ja'a neo peka j'ara èci dènge miu dhèu yahudi boe, sèmi ne'e: lamatua pua ja'a sèna ka, laku peka-padhai dènge miu, lula-nèti lii lolo be'a na. nèti èèna ka, ja'a pa'èra ngi'u, sèna ka pakako sasab'a dhu be'a aae ne.

source_text: but i also hope that by my labors i will make my fellow jews ◄jealous/want what you non-jews have►, with the result that some of them will believe and be saved.
target_text: te ladhe ja'a pakako sasab'a ne dènge be'a, ja'a sanao sèna ka dhèu yahudi unu ku tèka d'ara. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, ja'a bisa bara rèngu cahag'e sèna ka abhu mamuri.

source_text: god has rejected most of my fellow jews because they refused to believe, with the result that he reconciled many other people in the world mty to himself. but he will accept my fellow jews again when they trust in christ! and ◄this is what the result will be. /do you know what the result will be? ► rhq it will be as though god is making them alive again after they have been dead!
target_text: ropa lamatua tule eele dhèu unu na, lod'o èèna kahèi lamatua bhoke j'ara, sèna ka dhèu leo abhu j'ara ho maso j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua. te ngaa èle èèna, ladhe sèmi rèngu padame hari dènge lamatua, èèna be'a risi. te èèna sama sèmi rèngu mamuri hari nèti mamadhe ra!

source_text: just like the whole lump of dough will belong to god if people offer to god met the bread baked from the first part of it met, so the jews will belong to god because their ancestors belonged to god. and just like the branches of a tree will be good if the roots are good met, so the descendants of our great jewish ancestors who belonged to god will also some day belong to god.
target_text: nuka sèmi dhèu neo tao roti. ladhe nare tarigu ciki saraka mi lamatua, èèna na roti se j'aj'i mola-mèci unu lamatua. aa ladhe dhèu hia amo aj'u èci, ho j'aj'i bua sulung mi lamatua, èèna na aj'u ca kapua ne j'aj'i mola-mèci unu lamatua kahèi.

source_text: god has rejected many of the jews met, like branches of a tree are broken off {like people break off dead branches of a tree}. and each of you non-jews whom god has accepted is like met a branch of a wild/uncultivated olive tree that was {that someone} grafted among the branches or, onto one of the branches that were left on a cultivated olive tree. god has caused you to benefit from how he blessed ourexc first jewish ancestors, as branches benefit from the nutritious sap from the roots of a cultivated olive tree met.
target_text: ja'a neo pakasame dhèu yahudi dènge aj'u saitun ca kapua dhu ra piara ètu d'ara oka. ama lamatua dhu tutu eele le dadana cahag'e nèti aj'u ne. te ngaa miu dhu yahudi boe, nuka sèmi saitun j'ami. hèia, nèti dadana miu cahag'e, lamatua pare nare ka la'e patapa mi aj'u dhu ètu d'ara oka deo na. dènge j'ara ne, dadana nèti aj'u dhu ètu li'u oka, sakid'o nare mamuri nèti aj'u ètu d'ara oka deo na. ne'e ne, èci èèna ka dènge miu dhu yahudi boe, dhu sèmi mere d'ara hua iia lamatua kahèi, dhu na neo hia mi dhèu unu na, dhèu yahudi sèra.

source_text: however, you non-jews must not despise the jews whom god rejected met, who are like the branches that were broken off from the tree if any of you wants to boast about having received blessings from god, remember this: branches do not nourish the roots. instead the roots nourish the branches met. similarly, you are blessed by god because of what you have received from the jews! it is not what the jews have received from you that blesses them met!
target_text: te ngaa baku pamud'e! de mage mi padedha iisi, ho pangee na, miu dhu nèti li'u, be'a risi nèti dadana dhu lamatua tutu eele sèra! ladhe èu neo padedha iisi, mage èu bhèlu, te, èu ne dhoka ca dadana di! èu boe ka dhu pa'èra kapua aj'u ne. te amo ka dhu pa'èra aj'u ne!

source_text: if one of you then says, god rejected the jews met like branches met that are broken {that people broke} off a tree and rejected, in order that he might accept us non-jews, as branches met of a tree are grafted in {as people graft in branches of a tree},
target_text: ele boe èu neo peka, na, lamatua pare eele dadana èci nèti aj'u dhu muri ètu d'ara oka na, sèna ka na pakaj'èpe ja'a mi era deo na, ho gati dadana deo na.

source_text: i would reply that this is true. however, it is because the jews did not believe in christ that they were rejected met {that god rejected met them}. as for you, it is only because you believe in christ that god has accepted you! so do not any of you become proud, but instead beware of what could happen to you
target_text: mema lèke. te ngaa baku bhèlu, na, lamatua tutu eele dadana sèra, lula rèngu parcaya boe ne. aa èu gati si, lula èu parcaya nèngu. de baku padedha iisi! be'a risi loe aa baku lela dedha!

source_text: since god did not spare the unbelieving jews met who were like a tree's natural branches, he will not spare any of you if you do not keep trusting in him!
target_text: te dhèu yahudi sèra nuka sèmi dadana dhu muri mema, dhu cèu uru tèka. te ngaa lamatua tèke eele boe si toke panèbhu ètu èèna. de ladhe èu parcaya boe taruu mi lamatua, mage èu maena ho na soro tèke èu taruu ètu èèna!

source_text: note then, that god acts kindly, but he also acts severely. he has acted severely toward the jews who have stopped trusting in him. on the other hand, he acts kindly toward each of you non-jews only if you continue to appreciate his acting kindly toward you. however, you will be rejected {he will reject you} if you do not keep trusting in him.
target_text: de miu hud'i pangee pabe'a-be'a ku. ama lamatua mema d'ara hua iia. te ngaa ne'a hia huku dhu bia kahèi. pe nèngu huku dhèu dhu manahu le, dhu pabe'a heka dènge ne. te ngaa mi miu dhèu yahudi boe, lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na, sad'i miu pa'èki taruu dènge ne, aa miu sèmi mere babe'a na. te ngaa ladhe miu sèmi mere boe j'ara sèmi èèna, lamatua pare eele kahèi miu nèti aj'u na.

source_text: and if the jews believe in christ lit, god also will reunite them to himself as branches are grafted {as people graft branches} into a tree again, because god is able to do that.
target_text: sama sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu yahudi sèra. ladhe ra ele-ho'a ka, ho mulai parcaya kristus, pe lamatua tape hari rèngu mi aj'u uru èèna. te nèngu dènge koasa ho bisa tao j'ara sèmi èèna!

source_text: each of you non-jews who were previously separated from god has benefited from the ways in which god blessed the jews met. that is like taking branches that have been cut {that someone has cut} from a wild olive tree that just grew without being planted {someone planting it} and, contrary to what people usually do, grafting them into a cultivated olive tree. so god will much more readily receive back the jews because they belonged to him before met! that will be like the original branches that had been cut off being grafted {like grafting the original branches that someone cut off, } back into the olive tree to which they originally belonged!
target_text: te miu dhu dhèu yahudi boe, nuka sèmi dadana nèti aj'u saitun hui, dhu muri tab'a ètu li'u oka. te ngaa lamatua hag'e nare miu, ka pakaj'èpe laa mi aj'u saitun dhu hua iia, dhu na sèle ètu d'ara oka na, sèna ka hud'i laa aj'u hui èèna leko-leo, aa aj'u ètu d'ara oka leko-leo. te ladhe dhèu yahudi boe, bisa j'aj'i sèmi sèra, ngaa hari dhèu yahudi. rèngu bisa risi eele hari, ladhe lamatua pakaj'èpe hari si mi laa aj'u rèngu unu ra.

source_text: my non-jewish fellow believers, i certainly want you to understand lit this truth that god has now revealed about my fellow jews who are refusing to believe. you should not proudly think that god now favors you more than the jews or, that you understand god's further plans for the jews. many people of israel will continue to be stubborn until all the non-jews whom god has chosen have believed in jesus.
target_text: a'ari ètu roma! miu hud'i me'a ku ngaa dhu uru èèna j'aj'i mi rahasia. te ladhe miu me'a, miu mage pakapai iisi, dhu peka na, miu d'èlu-mèu risi. te j'ara na sèmi ne'e: limuri ne d'ara dhèu yahudi, adhu sèmi hadhu, aa ro'o boe parcaya kristus. te ngaa rèngu bisa boe sèmi èèna taruu. te ladhe dhèu yahudi boe aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua pili nare si, parcaya le kristus, bèli-camèd'a dhèu yahudi sèra parcaya ne kahèi.

source_text: and then all hyp the people of israel will be saved {god will save all hyp the people of israel}. then these words that are written {that a prophet wrote} in the scriptures will ◄become true/be fulfilled►: the one who sets his people free will originate from the place where god dwells or, from the jews mty. then he will remove the guilt of the israelite people or, descendants of jacob mty.
target_text: de ladhe d'ai ka lod'o na, pe lamatua patalale dhèu yahudi aa'i-aa'i nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra. j'ara ne'e j'aj'i, nuka sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, dhu peka na, bèli-camèd'a dhèu èci mai, dhu patabuli èdhi nèti mamadhe-mamopo. nèngu mai nèti ledhe sion, nuka kota yerusalem. èèna na, nèngu ka dhu tao ho ana-èpu yakob ele-ho'a. te rèngu mamuri pusi-pahae boe ja'a, aa ra soro kabodho mi j'ara mamuri ja'a dhu mola.

source_text: and as god says, the contract that i will make with them is that i will forgive their sins.
target_text: ja'a neo saku eele sasala-sasigo ra. te ja'a pa'èki le lii padhadha dènge rèngu sèmi èèna ka.

source_text: with regard to the jews rejecting the good message about christ, god treats them as enemies, which has benefited you non-jews. but in regard to their being the people whom god chose, god still loves them because of what he promised their ancestors.
target_text: lod'o-lod'o dhèu yahudi tadèngi lii lolo be'a lamatua, ra tao iisi ra nuka sèmi musu dhu palab'a dènge ne. dènge sèmi ne'e ka, rèngu hia j'ara mi miu dhu yahudi boe! masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa lamatua sue si era, lula na sue bèi-baki ra, aa na hag'e nare si j'aj'i dhèu unu na.

source_text: he still loves them, because he never changed his mind about the privileges/blessings he gave to them and about his choosing them to be his people.
target_text: te ladhe ama lamatua hia le mèdha èci, na nare heka. aa ladhe na paroa nare le dhèu, peka na, mai madhutu ja'a! mai asa d'ara ho j'aj'i dhèu ja'a! na babège eele heka si.

source_text: you non-jews once disobeyed god, but now he has acted mercifully towards you because the jews disobeyed him.
target_text: uru èèna, miu dhèu yahudi boe, mo'o boe nanene lamatua. te ngaa limuri ne, miu sèmi mere rasa kasia nèti lamatua, lula dhèu yahudi ro'o boe nanene ne.

source_text: now the jews have disobeyed god. the result is that by the very same way in which he acted mercifully towards you, he will act mercifully towards them again.
target_text: de rèngu se'e ka dhu limuri ne ro'o boe tao madhutu dad'èi lamatua. nèti èèna ka, lamatua neo pad'elo rasa kasia na mi miu era. aa bèli-camèd'a nèngu neo pad'elo rasa kasia na mi dedha rèngu kahèi.

source_text: god has declared and proved that all people, both jews and non-jews met, disobey ◄him/his laws►. he has declared that because he wants to act mercifully towards us all.
target_text: limuri ne, lamatua tao ai-hèb'a mi dedha dhèu yahudi, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu yahudi boe. te aa'i-aa'i ra tao boe madhutu dad'èi na, nuka sèmi rèngu ètu d'ara babèdho, aa re'a boe j'ara kalua. lamatua soro tèke si sèmi èèna, sèna ka na bisa pad'elo rasa kasia na mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: i marvel how vast and great are the wise things that god has done and what he has always known dou! we are completely unable to understand the things that he has decided and the ways in which he acts toward us dou!
target_text: ama lamatua d'èlu-mèu titu kèna! aa na pake mamèu na, sèna ka tao j'ara hua iia. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu tadhe mèu ne. abhu boe dhèu èci sa dhu ne'a mèu j'ara-j'ara dhu lamatua pama'ète lii langu. abhu boe ca dhèu sa kahèi dhu ne'a mèu, nga tao ka lamatua ad'u-ue j'ara èci.

source_text: i remember the scriptures that say, ◄no one has known what the lord thinks. /who has known what the lord thinks? ► rhq ◄absolutely no one has given him advice about what he should do! /who has advised him about what he should do? ► rhq
target_text: abhu boe dhèu èci sa dhu ne'a mèu ngangee ama èdhi. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa holo ne.

source_text: and, ◄no one has given anything to god that he did not previously receive from god! /has anyone given anything to god that he did not previously receive from god? ► rhq so god ◄is not obligated to/does not have to► pay back anything to anyone!
target_text: abhu boe dhèu dhu bisa hia iia lamatua mèdha èci. abhu boe dhèu èci sa dhu bisa laka-seti lamatua sèna ka na b'ala hari!

source_text: god is the one who created all things. he is also the one who sustains all things. the reason that he created them was that everything he created might praise him. may all people honor him forever! ◄may it be so! /amen! ►
target_text: te aa'i-aa'i kapua ra nèti ama lamatua! aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i, lula nèngu ka! aa'i-aa'i dhu èdhi tao, èdhi sab'a hia ne. èdhi koa-kio ne, taa-taa toke d'ai mia-mia! lèke tare'a-re'a!

source_text: my fellow believers, since god has acted mercifully toward you in so many ways, i appeal to all of you that you present yourselves syn to him by making yourselves like holy sacrifices met. make yourselves sacrifices that he is pleased with, sacrifices that are living/alive, not ones that are dead/killed. since god has done so much for you/us, this is the only appropriate way to serve him.
target_text: a'ari dhu pasue! ama lamatua pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na mi èdhi. nèti èèna ka, ja'a manèngi sèna ka saraka mamuri miu kateme mi lamatua, sama sèmi korban dhu mamuri. j'ara sèmi ne'e ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara lamatua. pa'èra ngi'u miu ho madhutu dad'èi na, aa mamuri mola, te j'ara sèmi èèna ka dhu pad'elo sasue miu aa pakab'ua ne. mema lèke, ladhe miu pahaha iisi mi nèngu sèmi èèna.

source_text: do not let anything non-christian determine how you should act. instead, let god change your way of life by making your way of thinking new, in order that you may know what he wants you to do. that is, you will know what is good, and you will know what pleases god, and you will know how to be all that he wants you to be.
target_text: baku soro tèke ho dhèu rai-haha ne pua miu tao sèmi ne'e, do sèmi èèna, do mamuri sèmi ngaa sa, madhutu dad'èi d'ara ra. baku sad'i madhutu iia d'ara di, j'ara ngangee ra, j'ara mamuri ra, do ad'a tatao ra. te ngaa dhu be'a risi eele, ladhe miu soro tèke lamatua ub'a ngangee miu j'aj'i hiu, sèna ka miu laladhe aa'i-aa'i se, madhutu j'ara hiu. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu bisa me'a dad'èi lamatua mi dedha miu. te dad'èi lamatua èèna, be'a, pamèci, dènge pakarej'e d'ara na.

source_text: because god has kindly appointed me to be his apostle, which i did not deserve, i say this to every one of you: do not think about yourselves more highly than what is right for you to think! instead, think about yourselves in a sensible way that corresponds to the abilities that god has given you because you trust in christ.
target_text: lula lamatua pajuu le ja'a, aa pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a, nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka dènge miu sèmi ne'e ka: lee ngi'u miu dènge j'ara dhu lèke! baku padedha ngi'u risi nèti dhu lèke. baku pake j'ara dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua. dhèu èci-èci hud'i tenge j'ara ho ne'a mèu a'èra dènge karunya dhu lamatua hia le mi nèngu, lula na parcaya kristus.

source_text: although a person has one body, it consists of many parts. all of the parts are needed for the body, but they do not all function the same way.
target_text: tare pakasame dènge ngi'u dhèu. ètu ngi'u ne, abhu bagian-bagian, dhu dènge sasab'a-la'a baka-leo.

source_text: similarly we, although we are many, are united into one group because of our relationship with christ, and we belong to one another. so no one should act as though he is needed by god more than others are!
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, èdhi dhu pa'èki dènge kristus. èdhi se dhèu ae-ae, te ngaa pa'èki j'aj'i mi ngi'u èci. aa dhèu èci-èci ka dènge sasab'a-la'a na, nuka sèmi bagian nèti ngi'u ne. èci parluu èci. tare conto nèti kacui-aai dhu poro pama'ète nèti ngi'u ne, gaguna na aad'o heka, si?

source_text: instead, since each one of us can do various things that differ according to the abilities that god has given to us, we should do them diligently and cheerfully! those whom god has enabled to speak messages from him should speak what corresponds to what they believe god told them.
target_text: a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e: lamatua pangèd'u èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti koasa, sèna ka pakako rupa-rupa sasab'a-la'a na, lula na d'èi pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èdhi. nuka sèmi, ladhe lamatua hia èu koasa sèna ka èu peka lii moa na, èu hud'i peka aa'i lii moa deo na. te ngaa baku peka risi nèti lii moa èèna.

source_text: those whom god has enabled to serve others should do that. those whom god has enabled to teach his truth should do that.
target_text: ladhe lamatua hia èu a'èra dènge karunya, ho lalau-lalo'o dhèu leo, èu hud'i lalau-lalo'o pake koasa deo na. ladhe na pala hia èu a'èra dènge karunya ho aj'a-nori dhèu lula-nèti nèngu, na, èu hud'i aj'a-nori ku pake koasa deo na.

source_text: those whom god has enabled to encourage/exhort his people should do that. those who share their goods/money with others should do it sincerely/generously. those who lead the congregation should do it wholeheartedly. those who help the needy should do it cheerfully.
target_text: ladhe na pala hia èu a'èra dènge karunya, ho pa'èra d'ara dhèu, èu hud'i pa'èra si pake koasa deo na. ladhe na hia èu koasa ho soru-bara dhèu leo dènge mèdha-panyau dhu èu unu, hia la mèdha-panyau sèra mi dhèu sèna ka èu soru-bara si. ladhe na hia èu a'èra dènge karunya ho pad'elo j'ara mi dhèu leo, sèna ka ra pakako sasab'a lamatua dènge be'a, na, èu hud'i maj'èni ho pimpin si pake koasa deo na. ladhe na pala hia èu rasa kasia ho soru-bara dhèu dhu ètu d'ara sasusa, èu hud'i bara si dènge d'ara karej'e-karae.

source_text: love others sincerely! hate what is evil! continue to eagerly do what god considers to be good!
target_text: ladhe miu pad'elo sasue mi dhèu, na, tao dènge d'ara mola; baku peka leo tao leo. core eele bhelu-katub'a, aa kèpe pa'èra-èra j'ara dhu be'a.

source_text: love one another as members of the same family do; and, you should be ◄the first ones/eager► to honor each other!
target_text: miu dhèu sarani hud'i mamuri pasue ku èci dènge èci. pa'èra iisi ho pad'elo pakab'ua miu èci dènge èci.

source_text: do not be lazy. instead, be eager to serve the lord god!
target_text: ladhe miu sab'a, sab'a dènge d'ara kateme, baku dènge paloa-pad'ui. hud'i laa sèna ka d'ara miu karae, lod'o miu ètu d'ara sasab'a-la'a. aa miu hud'i sab'a hia kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: rejoice because you are confidently awaiting what god will do for you! when you suffer, be patient! keep praying and never give up!
target_text: d'ara miu hud'i karej'e mèda-mèu, te miu me'a le, bèli-camèd'a lamatua neo tao tasamia hia miu. pa'èra d'ara ladhe abhu sasusa. baku roca sabaj'a mèda-mèu.

source_text: if any of god's people lacks anything, share with them what you have! readily take care of travelers who need a place to stay!
target_text: pake mèdha-panyau miu, ho bara dhèu sarani dhu parluu miu bara si. ladhe abhu dhèu dhu mai nèti rae leo, hia ra'a-rinu, aa sèmi mere si sèna ka manubha ètu d'ara èmu mi. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu pad'elo le sasue miu mi dedha rèngu.

source_text: ask god to be kind to those who ◄persecute you/cause you to suffer► because you believe in jesus! ask him to be kind to them; do not ask him to cause bad things to happen to them.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu tino paj'èra miu, manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua hia si mèngi-nale. tare'a! baku dhoo si!

source_text: if someone is joyful, you should rejoice also! if someone is sad, you should also be sad!
target_text: ladhe abhu dhu d'ara karej'e, na, karej'e sama-sama dènge ra. aa ladhe abhu dhu tangi roma iisi, lula d'ara pèd'a, na, tangi sama-sama dènge ra.

source_text: desire for others what you desire for yourselves or, live harmoniously with each other! do not do things because you want to be famous! instead, be content to do tasks that others consider that only unimportant people do or, to associate with unimportant people. do not consider yourselves wise.
target_text: mamuri pasue dènge d'ara èci. baku padedha iisi. be'a risi miu pa'angalai dènge dhèu haha. baku padedha iisi ho pangee, na, dhoka èu di dhu me'a.

source_text: do not do something evil to anyone who has done something evil to you. act in a way that all people will recognize as good!
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tao bhelu mi dedha èu, na, èu baku b'ala dènge bhabhelu kahèi. te ngaa èu hud'i tenge j'ara dhu be'a, dhu dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa sèmi rare dènge d'ara karej'e.

source_text: live peacefully with other people whenever it is possible, to the extent that you can influence the situation.
target_text: ladhe bisa, na, tenge j'ara ho mamuri padame dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: my fellow believers whom i love, do not do something evil in return when people do something evil to you! instead, allow god to punish them mty, because it is {someone has} written in the scriptures that the lord said, ‘it is my responsibility to take revenge; i am the one who will punish people who do something something evil to you dou, ' says the lord.

source_text: instead of doing something evil to those who have done something evil to you, do as the scriptures teach: if your sg enemies are hungry, feed them! if they are thirsty, give them something to drink! by doing that, you sg will cause them to feel ashamed and perhaps they will change their attitude toward you idm.
target_text: dhu be'a risi ka, tao madhutu ngaa dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, peka na, ladhe musu èu manganga, na, hia ne na'a. ladhe musu èu koko-kamango, na, hia ne ninu. te ladhe tao ka sèmi èèna, nèngu makae unu na, aa na pakab'ua hari èu.

source_text: do not let evil things that others have done to you overcome you sg by making you do evil things to them! prs instead, overcome the evil things that they have done by doing good deeds to them!
target_text: baku soro tèke bhabhelu ator èu. be'a risi ladhe j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a ka dhu uli èu. dènge j'ara ne'e, èu bisa segi madha j'ara dhu bhelu sèra.

source_text: every believer must be subject to the authorities. remember that god is the only one who gives officials their authority. furthermore, those officials that exist are ones who have been appointed by god {god has appointed}.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i hud'i nanene ku atora nèti dhèu paredha. te rèngu dènge hak aa koasa ho paredha dhèu. te ngaa koasa èèna, mai nèti ama lamatua. lula lamatua ka dhu ded'e si, nèti èèna ka rèngu abhu koasa ho rèd'u paredha.

source_text: so whoever resists the officials is resisting what god has established. furthermore, those who resist officials will bring on themselves from the officials the punishment that god considers fitting.
target_text: de ladhe dhèu lab'a dhèu dhu rèd'u paredha, èci èèna ka rèngu lab'a dhu lamatua ded'e nare le. ladhe ra ad'u-ue j'ara sèmi èèna, bèli-camèd'a abhu huku nèti lamatua.

source_text: what rulers do is not to cause people who do good deeds to be afraid. instead, what they do is to cause people who do evil to be afraid. so, if any of you rhq wants to be unafraid of officials, do what is good! if yousg do good, they will commend you instead of punishing you!
target_text: ladhe miu tao j'ara dhu lèke, baku madha'u dènge dhèu dhu rèd'u paredha. te ngaa ladhe miu ad'u j'ara bhelu, be'a risi miu madha'u dènge ra! de j'aga ngi'u ho tao dhu lèke, sèna ka miu baku madha'u dènge ra. aa ladhe miu tao ka j'ara sèmi èèna, pe ra koa-kad'iri miu.

source_text: it is in order to serve god by doing their work that every official exists, in order that they may benefit each of you. if any of you does what is evil, you sg will rightfully have reason to be afraid, because the authority that they have to punish people mty is very real lit! the officials exist to serve god. that is, they act as god's agents as they punish those who do evil.
target_text: te dhèu dhu rèd'u paredha, rèngu sèra ka dhu lamatua hag'e nare si, ho ladhe-leru miu. te ngaa ladhe miu loe boe nèti tao sala, be'a risi miu madha'u! te rèngu dènge hak dhu iia d'ara boe ho huku miu. rèngu, nuka sèmi ana pua-paleha lamatua, sèna ka huku dhèu dhu ad'u-ue bhabhelu-katub'a. te lamatua sèmi nare boe bhabhelu dhu dhèu tao; na nasa dènge ra.

source_text: so, it is necessary for you pl to be subject to officials, not only because they will punish you mty if you disobey them, but also because you know that you should be subject to them
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i nanene ku, mi dhèu dhu rèd'u paredha. te miu dhu me'a mèu le, èèna ka dhu lèke mola-mola. aa miu me'a kahèi, na, lamatua nasa, ladhe èdhi tao boe dhu lèke.

source_text: it is for this reason that you also pay taxes, because the officials are ones who serve god as they continually do their work.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, miu hud'i b'ae bea dhu madhutu atora, lula dhèu dhu rèd'u paredha sèra, pakako sasab'a lamatua.

source_text: give to all the officials what you are supposed to give to them! pay taxes to those who require that you pay taxes. pay duties on goods to those who require that you pay those duties. respect those who ought to be respected. honor those who ought to be honored.
target_text: de miu hud'i b'ae aa'i-aa'i dhu lèke madhutu atora. b'ae hia dhèu roro bea sèra, bea aa'i-aa'i dhu miu hud'i b'ae ku. pakab'ua mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mema nia sèmi lii pakab'ua. aa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tao j'ara be'a taruu, ded'e padedha kolongara si, sèna ka dhèu re'a, na, rèngu tao j'ara dhu be'a.

source_text: pay all of your debts when you are supposed to pay them. the only thing that is like a debt that you should never stop paying is to love one another. whoever loves others has fulfilled all that god requires in his laws.
target_text: b'ae pama'ète kèlu èu aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka baku mamuri ètu d'ara kèlu-g'ètu. te èdhi pakèlu dhoka ètu ca madha j'ara di, nuka pasue. ladhe miu sue dhèu, miu tao le madhutu atora-atora nèti lamatua.

source_text: there are many things that god commanded in his laws, such as do not commit adultery, do not murder anyone, do not steal, and do not desire anything that belongs to someone else. but the command by which they are all summed up {that includes them all} is this: each of you must love the people with whom you come in contact, just like you sg love yourself.
target_text: te atora sèra peka na, baku tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali mu; baku pamadhe dhèu; baku mana'u; baku d'èi leli neo unu mèdha-panyau dhèu, aa dhu leo hari. ladhe neo madhutu aa'i atora se'e, hud'i tao madhutu ku atora èci ne'e, dhu peka na, èu hud'i sue ku dhèu leo, nuka sèmi èu sue ngi'u èu unu mu.

source_text: if you love people with whom you come in contact prs, you will not do any evil to them lit. so, whoever loves others fulfills all that god's laws require.
target_text: te ladhe èdhi pad'elo sasue mi dhèu leo, èdhi tao boe bhelu mi nèngu, si? de ladhe èdhi loe boe pad'elo sasue èdhi, èdhi bisa tao madhutu aa'i atora lamatua.

source_text: do what i have just told you, especially since you know the significance of the time in which we are living. you know that it is time for you to be fully alert and active met, like people who have awakened from sleeping met, because the time when christ will finally deliver us from this world's pain/sin and sorrow is near. that time ◄is closer than/was not so close► when we first believed in christ.
target_text: ama lamatua neo patabuli èdhi nèti bhabhelu-katub'a dhèu rai-haha. aa limuri ne, lod'o sèna ka dhèu abhu mamuri nèti lamatua dètu ae le, ladhe èdhi pasoro dènge lod'o dhu èdhi heka parcaya yesus kristus. nèti èèna ka, èdhi hud'i mamuri pasue, lula èdhi te'a le madha j'ara ne'e. nuka sèmi uru èèna, èdhi dhu bhèj'i era. te ngaa limuri ne d'ai le lod'o na, ho èdhi kèd'i ka nèti bhabhèj'i èdhi!

source_text: our time to live in this world mty is almost ended met, like a night that is nearly ended. the time when christ will return mty is near. so we must quit doing wicked deeds met such as people do in the darkness, and we must be doing the things that will help us resist satan/evil met, as soldiers who put on their armor in the daytime get ready to resist their enemies.
target_text: nèbhu boe, te mèda oe èle kèna, aa lod'o rea kèna. de be'a risi èdhi ae eele ka nèti bhabhelu-katub'a èdhi. j'ara ne, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara maroga, aa ad'u-ue madha j'ara bhabhelu, te rèngu pangee, na, abhu boe dhu ladhe rèdhi tatao rèngu sèra. te ngaa limuri ne, èdhi hud'i j'aj'i ku sama sèmi sordad'u dhu bori mema mèdha-papake pamusu, ho pa'èra ngi'u sèna ka tao j'ara dhu be'a, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara saraa.

source_text: we must behave properly, as though the time when christ will return mty were already here. we must not participate in drunken carousing hen. we must not commit any kind of sexual immorality mty, dou. we must not quarrel. we must not be jealous of other people.
target_text: èdhi hud'i mamuri mola ku, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa rèdhi, na, èdhi dhu tao j'ara be'a. be'a boe ladhe èdhi mamuri dhoka ètu d'ara tao pesta, dènge tinu mahu di. be'a boe ladhe èdhi tao j'ara makae. be'a boe ladhe bau lii langu g'ana-kariu. aa be'a boe ladhe èdhi tèka d'ara, lula èdhi d'èi boe dhèu risi èdhi.

source_text: on the contrary, you/we should be like the lord jesus christ so that others will see that we belong to him, just as people put on special clothes so that others will see what group they belong to met. you/we should stop thinking about doing the things that your/our self-directed nature desires.
target_text: te ngaa dhu be'a risi ka, miu ub'a d'ara miu, ho j'aj'i sama sèmi kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, dhu lamatua pua mai. aa ladhe èu neo ad'u-ue j'ara dhu lèke boe, na, taha d'ara mu! mage soro tèke ho madhutu dad'èi mu dhu lèke boe j'ara.

source_text: accept those who are not sure whether god will permit them to do certain things some people think are wrong. but when you accept them, do not argue with them about what they think/their opinions.
target_text: abhu dhu parcaya lamatua, te ngaa parcaya na èra mèka, aa j'ara ae ka dhu ne'a mèka. pakabhèle ai èu ho sèmi more ne dènge d'ara kateme. baku sisu ngaa dhu na peka-padhai. hud'i laa nèngu pa'angalai dènge miu.

source_text: some people believe that they may eat all kinds of food. others believe that god does not want them to eat certain things, so they believe that they may not eat meat.
target_text: abhu dhu parcaya lamatua, dhu pangee na, dhèu sarani bisa ra'a ngaa sa, nuka sèmi sisi, do ngaa èèna ka. te ngaa abhu dhèu sarani leo, dhu parcaya ra èra mèka, dhu ra'a dhoka sayur di. te ra luri sisi.

source_text: anyone who thinks that it is all right to eat all kinds of food must not despise those who think it is not all right to eat all kinds of food. anyone who thinks it is not all right to eat all kinds of food must not ◄condemn/say that god will punish► those who think that it is all right to eat all kinds of food, because god himself has accepted those people.
target_text: te ngaa nanene, ee! dhèu sarani dhu bisa ra'a ngaa èèna ka, baku pahahe dhèu dhu neo boe ra'a sisi. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu sarani dhu neo boe ra'a sisi, baku peka dènge dhèu dhu bisa ra'a sisi, na, weh! mu'a sisi, sala! lula ama lamatua sèmi nare le dua ra ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na!

source_text: god is the master of us all, so ◄he is the one who will decide whether those people have done wrong! /who are you to decide whether they have done wrong? ► rhq therefore, you have no right rhq to condemn those who eat everything, because they are also god's servants! and just like it is the servants' own master who accepts or condemns mty his servants, it is god who accepts or condemns us. and believers will be accepted by the lord {the lord will accept believers} regardless of whether they eat meat or not, because he is able to keep them trusting in him.
target_text: ladhe èu me'a dhoka karitik a'ari mu dhèu parcaya sèra, te èu ngee na, èu ne cee? èu dènge hak ngaa, ho pèci sasala mi dhèu leo? dhèu ne ènu èu boe, si! aa èu ne, lamatua boe nèngu, si. te dhodhoka lamatua nèngu di dhu unu hak, sèna ka peka paled'a, tatao na èèna lèke, do sala. te ngaa baku bhèlu, bèli-camèd'a lamatua na sèmi nare dhèu ne'e dènge be'a, lula lamatua na bisa pa'èra ne, sèna ka na bisa titu èra.

source_text: some people regard certain days as holy and think that the other days are not holy. other people regard all days as equally suitable for worshipping god. each person should be fully convinced about such matters, thinking and deciding for himself and not for others.
target_text: abhu dhèu cahag'e dhu pama'ète rare, peka na, lod'o èci be'a risi nèti lod'o leo. abhu kahèi cahag'e dhu peka na, lod'o aa'i-aa'i ra èci èèna ka, lod'o èci sa risi boe nèti lod'o leo. dhèu èci-èci ka pama'ète unu na j'ara ne'e.

source_text: as for those who believe that they should worship on a certain day of the week, it is to honor the lord that they worship on that day. and as for those who think that it is all right to eat all kinds of food, it is to honor the lord that they eat those foods, as is clear from their thanking god for the food that they eat. as for those who abstain from eating certain kinds of food, it is to honor the lord that they do not eat those foods, and they also thank god for the food that they do eat. so doing either of those things is not wrong in itself.
target_text: ladhe dhèu pangee, na, abhu lod'o dhu be'a risi nèti lod'o leo, nèngu tao sèmi èèna, sèna ka pakab'ua kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. dhèu dhu na'a sisi dènge nganga'a dhu leo, bisa na'a ho pakab'ua kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, lula na manèngi makasi mi lamatua. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu dhu na'a boe sisi. nèngu neo pakab'ua kahèi kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, aa nèngu manèngi makasi mi lamatua kahèi.

source_text: none of us should live merely to please ourselves, and none of us should choose when or how we will die, merely to please ourselves.

source_text: while we live, it is the lord whom we belong to and should be trying to please, and not just ourselves. and when we die, it is the lord whom we should be trying to please. so, while we live and also when we die, we should be trying to please the lord to whom we belong, not just ourselves,
target_text: te ladhe èdhi mamuri era, èdhi pa'èki dènge lamatua èdhi. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe èdhi madhe, èdhi pa'èki era dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. de masi ka èdhi mamuri, do madhe, èdhi j'aj'i dhèu unu na era.

source_text: because the very purpose for which christ died and became alive again is that he might be lord whom all people should try to please, both of those who have already died and of those who are still living.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, kristus madhe, hèia mamuri hari. na tao sèmi èèna, sèna ka na bisa j'aj'i kètu bagi mi dhèu dhu madhe le, dènge dhèu dhu mamuri era kahèi.

source_text: ◄it is disgraceful that you who practice certain religious regulations say that god will punish your fellow believers who do not practice those regulations! /why do you who practice certain religious regulations say god will punish your fellow believers who do not practice such regulations? ► rhq i say this because the time will come when all of us will stand before god in order that he will say whether or not he approves mty of what we have done. so you who do not practice such regulations, ◄should not despise your fellow believers who practice them! /why do you despise your fellow believers who practice them? ► rhq

source_text: we know this because it is written {a prophet/isaiah wrote} what god has said: everyone will bow down before me! that is as certain as the fact that i live idm! everyone syn will acknowledge that because i am god, i have the right to judge and punish people.
target_text: abhu dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua, dhu peka na, ama èdhi mesa na dhu peka, na, ‘dhèu aa'i-aa'i pe patitu kètu urutuu, ho pahaha iisi mi ja'a, dènge pakab'ua ja'a. bèli-camèd'a, nèti d'ara hèb'a dhèu èci-èci, ra mangaku, na, ja'a j'aj'i kètu rèngu, lula ja'a ne, ama lamatua. '

source_text: so it is clear that it is god who will decide whether or not he approves of what each of us has done.
target_text: de èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti, bèli-camèd'a hud'i dhaa ètu madha lamatua, ho peka na, èdhi tao tasamia, aa nga tao ka èdhi tao sèmi èèna.

source_text: since it is god who will judge everyone, we must stop saying that god should punish some of our fellow believers! instead, you/we should decide that you/we will not do anything that would be an example that might cause fellow believers to stop trusting in god dou.
target_text: uru èèna, miu ètu roma pèci sasala taruu mi a'ari miu dhèu sarani sèra. tao ia ka sèmi èèna! be'a risi èdhi pama'ète sèmi ne'e: èdhi baku tao sèna ka a'ari èdhi kadhunu. èdhi baku tenge j'ara ho sii pamanahu si, sèna ka ra tao sasala.

source_text: i am absolutely certain dou because of my close relationship with or, my belonging to the lord jesus that there is nothing that by itself is wrong to eat. but if people think it is wrong to eat something, then to them it is wrong to eat it. so you should not encourage them to eat it.
target_text: lula ja'a dhu pa'èki dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, ja'a ke'a mèu, sèmi ne'e: abhu boe ngaa èci sa dhu bisa pakaj'alu dhèu, toke na bisa boe sabaj'a mi lamatua. te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu èci dhu pangee, na, mèdha èci tao ne kaj'alu, toke nèngu ngee na, bisa heka dènge hak sèna ka sabaj'a, na, hud'i laa mèdha ne j'aj'i mèdha luri hia nèngu.

source_text: if you eat food met that anyone for whom christ died thinks that it is wrong to eat, that person might be encouraged {you might be encouraging that person} to do something that he believes is wrong. as a result, you might cause that fellow believer to stop trusting in god. in that way he would be ruined spiritually just because you have stopped behaving as one who loves others should behave!
target_text: conto sèmi èu mu'a sisi, aa papèd'a d'ara a'ari mu, na, èu pad'elo boe sasue èu mi nèngu, si? ladhe sèmi èèna, baku mu'a! baku pa'ele iie a'ari mu, lula èu neo mu'a nganga'a èci! te kristus madhe pala mi dhèu ne'e kahèi.

source_text: similarly, do not do something that you think is good if, as a result, your fellow believer would sin and then others would speak evil of you who say that you are christians.
target_text: be'a boe ladhe èu ad'u-ue j'ara èci dhu madhutu a'abhu èu, be'a, te ngaa dhèu leo padhai kakoli kolongara èu, lula ra pangee na, tatao èu deo na, karehe.

source_text: letting god rule our lives met does not mean that we must obey regulations about eating or drinking something! instead, it means we must live righteously, act peacefully towards others, and be joyful by the power of the holy spirit.
target_text: ngee paie-iie! te ama lamatua ka, dhèu aae èdhi. te ngaa èdhi j'aj'i boe dhèu unu nèti dhèu aae, lula èdhi ta'a-tinu madhutu dhoka atora di. aad'o! ladhe èdhi neo j'aj'i dhèu unu nèti dhèu aae, èdhi hud'i tao dhu lèke, d'ara mola-mèci, mamuri mola dènge mera-milu, aa d'ara dhu karej'e-karae. aa'i-aa'i se bisa j'aj'i, ladhe èdhi pa'èki taruu dènge roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci.

source_text: those who serve christ by acting in such ways please god, and others will also respect them.
target_text: dhèu dhu lalau-lalo'o hia kristus sèmi èèna, pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua. aa dhèu leo lee kahèi mamuri dhèu ne'e, hèia padedha kolongara dhèu ne'e, peka na, nèngu ne, be'a!

source_text: so we should always eagerly try to live in a way that will cause peace among fellow christians, and we should try to do what will help each other to mature spiritually.
target_text: de èdhi hud'i pa'èra ètu d'ara mamuri padame, aa maj'èni pa'èra èci dènge èci.

source_text: do not destroy what god has done in the life of any believer just because of your eating certain kinds of food met which that person considers wrong to eat! god permits us to eat every kind of food. but if, by your eating certain kinds of food, you encourage another person to sin by doing what he believes is wrong, you are doing wrong.
target_text: baku pa'ele iie sasab'a lamatua ètu d'ara mamuri dhèu leo, lula dhoka nèti j'ara ta'a-tinu di. lamatua dhu peka le, èdhi bisa ta'a ngaa èèna ka, te aa'i-aa'i dhu mola-mèci. te ngaa ladhe èu patao-palaha dènge a'ari mu lula j'ara nganga'a-nganginu di, èu sala le. baku sèmi èèna!

source_text: it is good neither to eat meat nor to drink wine, nor to do anything else at any time if it will cause one of your fellow believers to stop trusting in god.
target_text: hua iia taha iisi mu. mu'a ia ka sisi, do minu ia ka èi anggor, do baku mu'a-minu ngaa dhu leo, dhu tao a'ari mu kadhunu.

source_text: let god tell you what things are right for you to do, but do not try to force others to accept what you believe. god is pleased with those who do what they know is right and as a result do not feel guilty concerning what they have done, because they have done only those things that they believe are right.
target_text: madhutu a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: ladhe èu more lii èci dènge lamatua, hèia èu pama'ète, na, èu neo parcaya ne lula-nèti nganga'a-nganginu, na, èu oto aa dènge heka lii langu. pangee ia ka ngaa-ngaa dhu peka na, èu tao sala, do aad'o. te èu dhu pama'ète more le sèmi èèna.

source_text: but some believers are not certain that god will approve of their eating a certain kind of food. so if they eat it, they think that god will punish them. and they truly will be punished {god truly will punish them}, because they have done things that they believe are not right. those who do anything without being certain that god considers it to be right are sinning.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe d'ara èu kajari, ka mu'a mèdha èci dhu èu ngee na pakaj'alu èu, lamatua pasala èu, lula èu madhutu boe ngaa dhu èu parcaya lod'o dhu èu mu'a. te ladhe èu neo ad'u-ue ngaa sa èci, te ngaa èu parcaya, peka na, èèna lèke boe ètu madha lamatua, na, èèna èu sala le.

source_text: most of us are sure that god will not punish us for doing certain things that the laws and rituals god gave moses said the jews should not do. but we should be patient with those who are uncertain about such things, and we should not let them irritate us. we should not simply please ourselves.
target_text: èdhi dhu parcaya èra, hud'i dènge d'ara maho'o ho bara dhèu dhu parcaya èra mèka, sèna ka rèngu taha ètu d'ara sasusa. be'a boe, ladhe èdhi dhoka pakarej'e ngi'u èdhi mesa ti.

source_text: each of us should do the things that please the fellow believers with whom we come in contact, and things that will benefit them. we should do those things in order to help them mature spiritually.
target_text: madhutu a'abhu ja'a hud'i sèmi ne'e ku: èdhi èci-èci ka tenge j'ara, sèna ka tao dhu be'a hia a'ari èdhi dhèu sarani, ho parcaya ra asa tabha èra. dènge j'ara ne'e, rèngu bisa karej'e dènge èdhi.

source_text: we should please our fellow believers, since christ has set us an example. he did not do things to please himself. on the contrary, he tried to please god even when others insulted him. that was as it is written {as ◄someone/the psalmist► wrote} in scripture that the messiah said to god: when people insulted you sg, it was as though they were also insulting me.
target_text: te yesus kristus mesa na, pakako boe sasab'a na ho pakarej'e d'ara nèngu unu na, te ngaa na neo pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua kahèi. èèna nuka sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri lamatua lula-nèti ngaa dhu bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i mi dedha yesus, dhu peka na, lii pa-aape rèngu hia mi èu, noto mi dedha ja'a kahèi.

source_text: and you need to remember that what was written previously {what god's servants previously wrote} in the scriptures, was written {they wrote} to teach us in order that we would be patient and be encouraged by reading/believing what they wrote. if we do that, we can confidently expect god to do for us all he has promised.
target_text: aa'i-aa'i dhu uru èèna dhèu suri ètu d'ara sasuri lamatua, sèna ka nori èdhi. nèngu pad'elo j'ara sèna ka asa pa'èra èdhi, taha pa'èra-èra, aa lii holo-nori na pa'èra d'ara èdhi kahèi. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna ka, èdhi bisa taha ètu d'ara tatae neo tèdhi lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èdhi.

source_text: god is the one who enables us to be patient and encourages us. ◄ask/pray to► him that he would enable you all to live harmoniously with each other, doing as christ jesus did.
target_text: lamatua ka dhu hia dhèu a'èra, sèna ka ra bisa taha ètu d'ara j'aj'èra. aa nèngu ka dhu pa'èra d'ara èdhi kahèi. ja'a sabaj'a, manèngi lamatua pad'elo j'ara, ho miu mamuri d'ara èci madhutu dad'èi yesus kristus.

source_text: then, as you are united in what you think and say mty, you will praise god, who is the heavenly father met of our lord jesus christ.
target_text: te ladhe miu mamuri d'ara èci, miu bisa sama-sama koa-kio ama lamatua. nèngu èèna, ama nèti kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: so i say to all of you believers at rome, accept each other. if you do that, people will praise god as they see you behaving like christ. accept each other just like christ accepted you!
target_text: de miu isi-aanga mi hud'i sèmi mere èci dènge èci, sama sèmi kristus sèmi nare le miu. te ladhe miu mamuri sèmi èèna, pe dhèu ae j'oka padedha-dedha kolongara lamatua.

source_text: i want you to remember that christ helped us jews mty by what he did, in order to show that god ◄is faithful/does what he says he will do►. that is, his coming as our messiah fulfilled what god promised to our jewish ancestors.
target_text: ja'a peka sèmi ne'e: kristus tao iisi na nuka sèmi ana pua-paleha, sèna ka hia dhèu yahudi re'a mèu, peka na, ama lamatua padhai lii lèke mola-mola. aa kristus tao iisi na nuka sèmi ana pua-paleha kahèi, ho pamèci aa'i mèu ngaa-ngaa dhu lamatua padhadha neo tao, hia mi bèi-baki èdhi sèra.

source_text: and by acting mercifully to them, he also caused non-jews to praise him. what he has done for non-jews fulfills what is written in the scriptures that david said to god: so i will praise you sg when i am among the non-jews, and i will sing to you mty.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu yahudi boe aa'i-aa'i koa-kio ama lamatua. te rèngu re'a, na, nèngu dhu rasa kasia mi èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti. sèra nuka sèmi dhu daud suri uru èèna ètu sasuri mola-mèci, peka na, nèti èèna ka, ja'a neo ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara èu, mi suku dhu leo sèra. ja'a neo sod'a lii koa-kio kolongara èu ètu katanga madha udhu rasa dhu leo sèra.

source_text: david also wrote, you non-jews, rejoice with us who are god's people.
target_text: ètu era leo, d'ara sasuri mola-mèci suri kahèi, na, we! miu dhèu leo rai kara dhu nèti rai leo. tao d'ara miu karej'e kea rae-rae, palere-lere dènge dhèu unu lamatua sèra.

source_text: and moses wrote in the scriptures, praise the lord, all you non-jews, and may everyone praise him dou.
target_text: ètu era leo, d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, daud suri, peka na, miu dhu nèti suku leo sèra. lami peka palème mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i lula-nèti dadedha lamatua, sèna ka rèngu koa-kio kètu èdhi, yesus kristus kahèi.

source_text: and isaiah wrote in the scriptures, there will be a descendant met of king david who will begin to rule the non-jews. they will confidently expect him to fulfill what he has promised.
target_text: ètu era leo hari, d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, yesaya suri, peka na, nèti dhèu aae daud, ana isai, bèli-camèd'a cèu mai ana-èpu na ca dhèu. nèngu ka dhu nèd'u paredha mi suku leo sèra. rèngu dhu re'a le, naneo mamai nèngu èèna. hèia rèngu mate tatae ne, te rèngu re'a mèu, na, nèngu ne, cee.

source_text: god is the one who causes you to confidently expect him to do what he has promised. i pray/ask that he will cause you to be completely joyful and peaceful as you trust in him. as you do that, the holy spirit will enable you to more and more confidently expect to receive what god has promised you.
target_text: ama lamatua ka dhu j'aj'i mi kapua nèti aa'i-aa'i dhu èdhi sanao-maena. ladhe miu parcaya ne, nèngu ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara miu aa pamau d'ara miu. hud'i laa sèna ka koasa nèti roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci, tao miu asa me'a mèu lula-nèti ngaa dhu nèngu neo tao.

source_text: my fellow believers, i myself am completely sure that you yourselves have acted toward others in a completely good way. you have done that because you have known completely all that god wants you to know hyp, and because you are able to teach each other.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a ke'a tare'a, na, d'ara miu pènu dènge madha j'ara-madha j'ara dhu be'a, j'ara ae-ae dhu miu me'a mèu le, aa me'a holo èci dènge èci.

source_text: however, i have written to you quite frankly in this letter about some things in order to remind you about those things. i have written this letter because i have been appointed by god {god has appointed me}, which i did not deserve,
target_text: ja'a suri paled'a-led'a ètu d'ara sasuri ne'e, ho pasanèd'e miu catèka hari nèti rupa-rupa madha j'ara. ja'a suri sèmi ne'e, lula lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a,

source_text: in order that i would work for jesus christ among non-jews. god has appointed me to act like a priest as i proclaim his good message in order that he will accept the non-jews who believe in christ. they will be like an offering met to god as a result of their being dedicated to him by the holy spirit {the holy spirit dedicating them to god}.
target_text: ropa na ded'e ja'a j'aj'i mi dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus kristus, ho laku peka-padhai lii lolo be'a nèngu asa dhèu yahudi boe sèra. ja'a pakako sasab'a ja'a èèna, nuka sèmi ama agama èci dhu neo pa'èra dhèu ae-ae dhu j'aj'i mi persembahan èci dhu pamaho'o d'ara lamatua. te roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci ka dhu tao si j'aj'i mola-mèci, sèna ka ama lamatua sèmi nare si.

source_text: it follows that, because of my relationship with or, because i belong to christ jesus, i am happy about my work for god.
target_text: lula ja'a dhu pa'èki le dènge yesus kristus, nèti èèna ka ja'a bisa boti kètu ètu madha ama lamatua.

source_text: i will speak boldly only lit about the work that christ has enabled me to do. i do that work in order that non-jews might pay attention to the message about christ as a result of what i have said and done,
target_text: ja'a bani boe padhai lii j'ara leo. ja'a dhoka lole tatao dhu kristus ad'u-ue, aa dènge j'ara sèmi ngaa na pake ja'a. limuri ne, abhu dhèu yahudi boe dhu madhutu kristus, lula lamatua pake ja'a ho pad'elo j'ara pake lii padhai dènge tatao ja'a.

source_text: specifically, by my performing many powerful miracles dou. i have done those things as a result of god's spirit powerfully enabling me. as a result of doing those things, while traveling all the way around from jerusalem to illyricum province, i have completed my work of proclaiming the message about christ in those places.
target_text: kristus pangèd'u le mi ja'a koasa nèti roh lamatua, sèna ka bisa tao rupa-rupa tadha malaa. na pangèd'u koasa èèna mi ja'a, sèna ka neo pad'elo, peka na, kristus ne cee. dènge j'ara ne'e, ja'a peka-padhai le aa'i-aa'i lula-nèti lii lolo be'a kristus dènge dhèu ètu mia-mia. nèti èèna ka, ja'a lole nèti kota yerusalem, pale-lème toke d'ai rai ilirikum dètu dènge italia.

source_text: as i proclaim that message, i am always eagerly trying to proclaim it in places where people have not already heard about christ. i do that in order that as i work for god i might not be continuing the work for him that someone else already started met. i do not want to be like a man who builds a house on someone else's foundation.
target_text: karèi nèti uru ka, ja'a dhu pangee, na, ja'a d'èi titu kèna lole lula-nèti kristus mi dhèu-dhèu dhu tadèngi rèdhi mèka lii lolo be'a na! te ja'a d'èi boe aj'a-nori ètu era dhu dhèu leo aj'a le.

source_text: on the contrary, i teach non-jews, so that what happens may be like what was written {the prophet isaiah wrote} in the scriptures about the messiah: those who did not hear about him previously will know the truth about him. truly, those who have not heard about him will hear and understand his message dou.
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, dhu suri, peka na, suku dhu tadèngi rèdhi mèka lula lamatua, rèngu sèra ka dhu bèli-camèd'a ladhe rèdhi ne. dhèu dhu tadèngi rèdhi mèka ngaa-ngaa, rèngu sèra ka dhu pe re'a mèu lula nèngu.

source_text: because i have attempted to preach the message about christ in places where they have not heard about him, i have been hindered {things have hindered me} many times from being able to visit you.
target_text: lula sasab'a ja'a ae sèmi èèna, ka lake kore mèka dhiu pa'asu-pareo dènge miu.

source_text: but now there are no more places in these regions where people have not heard about christ. furthermore, for several years i have wanted to visit you.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, sasab'a ja'a ètu ne'e èla aa'i le. aa ja'a nelu nèbhu ae le pèri-pèri tèu kèna, dhiu paraga dènge miu.

source_text: so i hope to go/come to see you. i hope to do that as soon as i am on my way to the provinces in spain. i hope to see you as i journey through your area, and i hope that by whatever you give me eup you will help me on my journey to spain. but before i go there, i want to enjoy being with you for a little while, although i would like to stay with you longer.
target_text: de ladhe ja'a laku asa spanyol, ja'a neo dhuli miu. aa ladhe ja'a dhuli taha ètu era miu, miu bisa ogo ja'a kahèi laku asa spanyol.

source_text: but i cannot visit you now, because i am about to go to jerusalem in order to take money eup for god's people there.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne ja'a neo laku uru asa yerusalem, ho lalau-lalo'o dhèu parcaya lamatua ètu nèi.

source_text: the believers in macedonia and achaia provinces mty decided to contribute some money eup for those of god's people in jerusalem who are poor.
target_text: te a'ari èdhi ètu propensi makedonia dènge propensi akaya, hia le doi kolete, sèna ka soru-bara dhèu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa dhu parcaya lamatua ètu yerusalem.

source_text: they themselves decided to do this, but truly they owe something to god's people in jerusalem. the non-jewish believers benefited spiritually from jewish believers as a result of hearing the message about christ from them, so the non-jews should also help the jewish believers in jerusalem by giving them material things or, money eup.
target_text: rèngu neo tao sèmi ne'e, lula ra pangee, na, rèngu oe sèmi pakèlu sa, mi a'ari èdhi ètu yerusalem. te dhèu-dhèu nèti suku leo ètu mia-mia, rèngu abhu le j'ara hua iia kahèi dhu uru èèna roh lamatua hia le mi dhèu yahudi sèra. de lèke mola-mola ladhe dhèu sarani dhu dhèu yahudi boe, pake mèdha-panyau ra ho soru-bara a'ari ra dhèu yahudi sèra.

source_text: so when i have finished this task by safely delivering all this money met, eup that the believers in macedonia and achaia have given, i will leave jerusalem and visit you in rome while i am on my way to spain.
target_text: de ladhe ja'a pabagi kore ka doi se'e mi a'ari èdhi ètu yerusalem, ja'a neo dhuli pangad'o dènge miu, ropa laku asa spanyol.

source_text: and i know that when i visit you, christ will abundantly bless us or, enable me to bless you.
target_text: ladhe ja'a dhiu, kèti dènge mèngi-nale ae-ae nèti kristus.

source_text: because we belong to our lord jesus christ and because the spirit of god causes us to love each other, i urge you all that you help me by fervently/intensely praying to god for me.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! lula yesus kristus j'aj'i kètu miu, aa lula roh lamatua ka tao miu pasue èci dènge èci, nèti èèna ka ja'a manèngi ho miu sabaj'a patare'a-re'a, sèna ka lamatua soru-bara ja'a.

source_text: pray that i will be protected {that god will protect me} so that the jews in judea who do not believe the message about christ will not harm me. also pray that god's people in jerusalem will accept the money eup that i take to them.
target_text: manèngi sèna ka lamatua bhiri-sarobho ja'a ètu propensi yudea, ho dhèu dhu ro'o boe parcaya lamatua baku tao bhelu mi dedha ja'a. aa manèngi ho ladhe ja'a lalau-lalo'o dhèu sarani ètu yerusalem, rèngu sèmi rare ja'a dènge be'a.

source_text: pray these things in order that i may go/come to you if god wants me to go/come, and that i may go/come joyfully, and that then god will refresh my spirit as a result of my visiting/being with you.
target_text: èle èèna, ladhe madhutu dad'èi lamatua, ja'a bisa dhiu asa miu dènge d'ara karej'e, lula ja'a neo ae kore ciki dènge miu.

source_text: i pray that god, who causes us to have inner peace, will be with all of you and will help you. ◄may it be so! /amen! ►
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a sèna ka lamatua bera-bera dènge miu. te nèngu ka dhu bisa tao ho dhèu mamuri dame dènge mera-milu. lèke tare'a!

source_text: by means of this letter i am introducing and recommending to you our fellow believer phoebe, who will be taking this letter to you. she is a deacon in the congregation in cenchrea city.
target_text: dènge sasuri ne'e, ja'a neo patadha miu dènge ana hèni èdhi febe, aa manèngi ho miu sèmi mere ne. nèngu ka dhu ra ded'e ho ladhe-leru juma'at ètu kota kengkrea.

source_text: i request that you receive her because of her relationship with the lord. you should do that because those who are god's people ought to receive their fellow believers. i am also requesting that you help her by giving her eup whatever she needs, because she has helped many people, including me.
target_text: ja'a manèngi ho miu sèmi mere ne dènge be'a. tao dhu pantas mi nèngu, nuka sèmi hia dhèu sarani sèra, lula nèngu ne pa'èki dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ladhe na parluu ngaa, soru-bara ne. te nèngu biasa soru-bara le ja'a dènge dhèu ae-ae, karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: tell priscilla and her husband aquila that i ◄send greetings to/am thinking fondly of► them. they worked with me for christ jesus,
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi ana hèni èdhi, priskila dènge dhèu èmu na, akila. ji'i ka dhu sama-sama pakako sasab'a ae-ae nèti yesus kristus.

source_text: and they were even willing to die idm in order to save my life. it is not only i who thank them for helping me, but the people in all hyp the non-jewish congregations also thank them for saving my life.
target_text: dua ra oe madhe sad'i neo pamamuri ja'a. te ngaa mesa boe ja'a di dhu manèngi makasi mi dua ra. te dhèu yahudi boe dhu j'aj'i le dhèu sarani, nèti juma'at aa'i-aa'i buli mia-mia, manèngi makasi kahèi, lula tatao ra dhu be'a.

source_text: also tell the congregation that meets in their house that i ◄send my greetings to/am thinking fondly of► them. tell my dear friend epaenetus the same thing. he is the first man in asia province who believed in christ.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu pakaboko ho manèngi-mangaj'i ètu d'ara èmu priskila dènge akila. hia lii maho'o ja'a mi angalai ja'a, epenetus. nèngu ka, dhèu uru tèka parcaya kristus ètu propensi asia.

source_text: tell mary, who has worked hard for christ in order to help you, that i ◄send my greetings to/am thinking fondly of► her.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi ana hèni èdhi, maria. nèngu dhu sab'a ne'a boe j'èra ètu talora aae miu.

source_text: tell the same thing to andronicus and his wife junia or, and his sister junia who are my fellow jews and who were also previously in prison with me. they are well-known/respected or, respected by the apostles, and they became christians before i did.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi andronikus dènge ana hèni èdhi, yunia. dua ra dhèu yahudi, sama sèmi ja'a kahèi. dua ra parcaya uuru kristus nèti ja'a. uru èèna, rèngu sama-sama dènge ja'a ètu d'ara bèdho. dua ra j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua, aa dhèu ae tadhe si.

source_text: i also send my greetings to ampliatus, who is a dear friend because of his relationship with the lord.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi ampliatus. ja'a sue ne, lula nèngu dhu pa'èki dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: i also send my greetings to urbanus, who works for christ with us, and to my dear friend stachys.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi urbanus. nèngu kahèi pakako sasab'a kristus sama-sama dènge èdhi. hia lii maho'o ja'a mi stakis, dhu ja'a sue.

source_text: i also send my greetings to apelles, whom christ has approved because apelles successfully endured trials. tell the believers who live in the house of aristobulus that i send my greetings to them.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi apeles. masi ka nèngu lèke dadugu-rariu, te ngaa na segi ka nare li'u, lula lèka èra kristus. hia lii maho'o mi a'ari aa'i-aa'i nèti aristobulus.

source_text: also tell herodion, who is my fellow jew, that i send my greetings to him. tell the same thing to those who live in the house of narcissus who belong to the lord.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi a'a herodion. nèngu dhèu yahudi kahèi, sama sèmi ja'a. hia lii maho'o ja'a mi isi èmu narkisus dhu parcaya kristus.

source_text: tell the same thing to tryphaena and her sister tryphosa, who work hard for the lord. i also send my greetings to persis. we all love her and she has worked very hard for the lord.
target_text: hia lii maho'o mi ana hèni èdhi, trifena dènge trifosa. rèngu pakako kahèi sasab'a nèti kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. hia lii maho'o mi angalai ja'a, ana hèni èdhi, persis. te nèngu kahèi sab'a bia hia kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: tell rufus, who is an outstanding christian, that i send my greetings to him. tell the same thing to his mother, who has treated me as though i were her son met.
target_text: hia lii maho'o mi rufus. kètu èdhi, yesus kristus ka dhu hag'e nare ne. hia lii maho'o mi ina na kahèi. te nèngu ne, nuka sèmi ina d'èlu ja'a.

source_text: tell asyncritus and phlegon and hermes and patrobas and hermas and the fellow believers who meet with them that i am sending my greetings to them.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi asinkritus, flegon, hermes, patrobas, hermas dènge a'ari aa'i-aa'i dhu pea dènge rèngu.

source_text: i also send my greetings to philologus, to his wife julia or, his sister julia, to nereus and his sister, and to olympas, and to all god's people who meet with them.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi filologus, ana hèni èdhi, yulia, olimpas, nereus dènge ana hèni na, dènge dhèu-dhèu sarani aa'i dhu sama-sama dènge rèngu.

source_text: greet one another affectionately, but in a pure way, when you gather together. the believers in all the christian congregations hyp in this area ◄send their greetings to/say they are thinking fondly of► you.
target_text: ladhe miu pakaboko, na, mi pa'uu èci dènge èci, dhu pantas mi dhèu parcaya. juma'at kristus aa'i-aa'i ètu se'e, hia lii maho'o mi miu kahèi.

source_text: my fellow believers, i exhort you that you beware of those people who are causing divisions among you and who cause people to turn away from god mty because they teach things that are contrary to the message about christ that you have learned or, that others taught you. keep away from such people!
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a manèngi sèna ka miu mage-mage! j'aga paie-iie, te abhu dhèu dhu tao miu mae-manyèla, aa dhu neo sii pabèbhe miu. ngaa dhu rèngu peka dènge miu sèra, palab'a dènge ngaa dhu ji'i aj'a-nori le miu. de baku pa'angalai dènge dhèu sèmi sèra!

source_text: they do not serve our lord christ! on the contrary, they only want to satisfy their own desires mty! also, by all the eloquent things that they say dou they deceive those people who do not realize that their teaching is false.

target_text: lod'o ja'a bera-bera dènge miu, ja'a pangee sèmi ne'e ka: ja'a pad'elo dhoka ca j'ara di, nuka yesus kristus. nèngu ne, dhèu dhu ama lamatua pajaji mema karèi nèti uru ka, ho hia mai. te ngaa ropa yesus mai, dhèu paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. dhoka j'ara ne'e di, dhu ja'a ke'a mèu.

source_text: furthermore, when i was with you, i felt that i was not adequate to do what christ wanted me to do. i was afraid that i would not be able to do it, and because of that i was trembling very much.
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o ja'a bera-bera dènge miu, ja'a rasa mamèu ja'a d'ai boe, aa ja'a madha'u ka isi karèbha.

source_text: when i taught you and preached to you, i did not speak words that unbelievers would consider iro wise in order to convince them that my message was true. instead, god's spirit showed that it was true by enabling me to powerfully perform miracles.
target_text: j'ara lii padhai ja'a, aa ngaa dhu ja'a lole, mud'a di. te ja'a ko'o boe pake lii dhu karisi sèna ka pamako miu. aad'o! te ngaa ropa ja'a peka-padhai, na, lii padhai ja'a j'aj'i led'a, lula roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci ka dhu ator ja'a, aa koasa na sab'a ètu ja'a kahèi.

source_text: i taught and preached that way in order that you might believe my message, not because you heard words that people considered to be iro wise, but because you recognized god's power.
target_text: te ja'a pangee, na, be'a boe ladhe miu parcaya ama lamatua, lula miu nanene lii padhai dhèu d'èlu-mèu di. dhu be'a risi, ladhe miu parcaya lamatua, lula na pad'elo koasa na mi dedha miu.

source_text: i do teach a message that people who are spiritually mature consider to be wise. but i do not teach a message that unbelievers consider to be wise. i also do not teach a message that unbelieving rulers in the world consider to be wise. what they think about it does not matter, because some day ◄they will lose their power/not be ruling any more►.
target_text: aa te ngaa, ladhe ji'i padhai lii dènge dhèu dhu parcaya èra le, ji'i aj'a rèngu pake lii padhai dhu dhèu bisa re'a mèu. te ngaa dhu re'a mèu èèna, madhutu boe ngangee dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, do, madhutu ngaa dhu dhèu paredha sèra aj'a limuri ne. te sèra sa, bèli-camèd'a ele iie aa'i si.

source_text: instead, i teach about what god planned wisely long ago. it is something that people did not know about previously because god did not reveal it previously. but god determined before he created the world that he would greatly benefit us by his wise plan.
target_text: te ngaa ji'i aj'a dhoka j'ara mamèu dhu mai nèti ama lamatua. lula uru-uru sèra, lod'o rai-haha j'aj'i mèka, lamatua pahuni j'ara sèra. te ngaa limuri ne, nèngu pama'ète le, sèna ka neo bhoke patalele lii pahuni èèna hia èdhi, ho èdhi kahèi abhu pala ètu d'ara kolongara na dhu kapai risi eele.

source_text: none of those who rule this world knew that wise plan. if they had known it, they would not have nailed our wonderful lord to the cross.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu paredha limuri ne, re'a mèu iia boe mamèu lamatua. te ladhe re'a tare'a, tatu ra paku pamadhe boe kètu èdhi dhu dedha risi èèna, ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: but we believers need to remember these words that a prophet wrote in the scriptures: things that no one has ever seen, things that no one ever heard, things that no one ever thought could happen, those are the things that god has prepared for those who love him.
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua dhu suri lula-nèti rahasia lamatua dhu uru èèna pahuni tèke, peka na, abhu j'ara dhu dhèu rai-haha dhae rèdhi mèka dènge musi madha ra, aa abhu j'ara dhu dhèu rai-haha dhae tadèngi rèdhi mèka dènge ro'a dhilu ra, dhu dhèu rai-haha bisa ngee rèdhi boe. aa te ngaa, madhutu iia-iia na lamatua sadia tèke le j'ara sèra aa'i-aa'i, bagi mi dhèu dhu sue nèngu.

source_text: god has caused his spirit to reveal those things to us inc believers. his spirit can do that because he knows thoroughly the meaning of all things. he even knows the things about god that are very difficult to understand.
target_text: uru èèna, mema dhèu re'a boe j'ara sèra, te ngaa limuri ne ama lamatua pake roh na ho bhoke paled'a hia èdhi. roh lamatua èèna ne'a aa'i mèu-mèu. te nèngu parisa toke lutu d'ara iiki lamatua kahèi.

source_text: only a person himself or, a person's spirit knows what he is thinking. similarly, only god's spirit knows what god is thinking.
target_text: èdhi èci-èci ka dènge roh ètu d'ara èdhi. nèti èèna ka, èdhi dhèu rai-haha, èci-èci ka dènge ngangee aa tatao na. aa abhu boe dhèu leo èci sa dhu ne'a mèu d'ara iiki èdhi, dhoka roh èdhi unu ti dhu ne'a. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge ama lamatua. abhu boe ca dhèu sa kahèi dhu ne'a d'ara iiki lamatua. dhoka roh nèngu mesa na ka dhu ne'a mèu.

source_text: it was not the ideas that unbelievers teach that we accepted. instead, it was the spirit who came from god that we received, in order that we might know the things that god has freely done for us.
target_text: èdhi dhu sèmi tare le roh lamatua, ka nèngu ka dhu ator èdhi. nèti èèna ka, èdhi madhutu boe ngangee dhèu ètu rai-haha ne. lula roh lamatua ètu d'ara èdhi, nèti èèna ka èdhi tadhe aa'i j'ara dhu be'a, dhu nèngu tao le hia èdhi.

source_text: those are the things that i tell you about. as i do that, i do not tell you things that someone whom others thought was iro wise taught me. instead, i tell you truths that god's spirit taught me, and i explain those spiritual truths to people whose thinking is guided by god's spirit or, i teach spiritual truths to spiritual people.
target_text: j'ara sèra ka dhu èdhi tema padhue-padhai. te ji'i lole j'ara-j'ara dhu roh lamatua aj'a-nori ji'i. ka ji'i se aj'a boe pake lii dhu nèti mamèu madhutu a'abhu dhèu rai-haha. te ngaa ji'i aj'a-nori pake lii dhu mai nèti roh lamatua mi dhèu dhu tadhe nèngu.

source_text: those who are unbelievers reject the truths that god's spirit teaches us inc, because they consider those truths to be foolish. they cannot understand them, because it is god's spirit who enables us to evaluate those truths correctly, and those people do not have god's spirit.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tadhe boe roh lamatua, ropa na nanene lii padhai ji'i, nèngu d'èi boe sèmi. lula nèngu ngee, na, ngaa kèna? maso boe d'ara kahadhu! aa te ngaa, masi ka tasamia èèna ka, dhèu ne bisa boe ne'a j'ara sèra, te nèngu dhu mamuri pa'èki boe dènge roh lamatua.

source_text: we who have god's spirit can judge correctly the value of all truths that the spirit reveals, but unbelievers cannot evaluate us correctly.
target_text: dhèu dhu mamuri pa'èki dènge roh lamatua, heka re'a j'ara sèra aa'i-aa'i, aa bisa re'a mia ka dhu lèke. te ngaa dhèu leo pajiko rare boe ngangee dhèu sèmi sèra.

source_text: as one of our prophets wrote: no human rhq has known what the lord is thinking. no human rhq is able to instruct him. but we believers are able to think about things mty in the way that christ thinks about them.
target_text: bisa tasamia? te abhu dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, peka na: cee ka dhu bisa re'a ngangee ama lamatua? do, cee ka dhu bisa ator lamatua, ho ama lamatua tao madhutu lii holo-nori dhèu èèna? abhu boe ca dhèu sa! madhutu iia-iia na, èdhi te'a j'ara se'e, lula kristus ka dhu soru-bara sèna ka èdhi bisa pangee madhutu ngangee nèngu.

source_text: my fellow believers, when i was with you previously, i was not able to teach you as i would teach people who are controlled by the holy spirit {whom the holy spirit controls}. instead, i had to teach you as i would teach people whom their self-directed nature controls. i taught very simple concepts to you who had recently believed in christ, as a parent would speak very simple words to a baby.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! lod'o ja'a ètu èèna era, miu nuka sèmi dhèu dhu dhae pa'èki èra mèka dènge roh lamatua. lula miu madhutu dhodhoka dad'èi d'ara miu dhoo-dhoo di, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu rai-haha dhu leo sèra. nèti èèna ka, ja'a bisa boe padhai lii dènge miu, nuka sèmi padhai lii dènge dhèu ee'a, te miu nuka sèmi ana iiki sa.

source_text: i did not teach you things that were difficult for you to understand, just like a woman does not give her baby solid food that the baby cannot chew and digest. and just like a woman ◄gives her baby milk/breast-feeds her baby►, i taught you simple spiritual concepts, because at that time you were not able to understand difficult things. and you are still not able to understand difficult concepts,
target_text: ja'a hud'i aj'a miu j'ara-j'ara dhu carui boe, lula miu bisa mèka sèmi mere j'ara dhu carui, nuka sèmi ana iiki dhu bisa mèka ra'a sisi. miu hud'i kadhii ku, sama sèmi dhèu ee'a dhu tema ra'a sisi. te ngaa limuri ne, miu nuka sèmi ana rara iisi hiu era, dhu me'a dhoka minu susu di.

source_text: because you are still controlled by your self-directed nature. some of you are jealous and quarreling. ◄that shows that your self-directed nature is controlling you! /does not that prove your self-directed nature is controlling you? ► rhq it shows that you are acting like unbelievers act.
target_text: lula ngangee miu cakaraa dhèu dhu neo dhoka madhutu dad'èi d'ara di. ladhe abhu dhèu dhu risi nèti miu, miu tèka d'ara aa patao-palaha leli! nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka na, miu me'a dhoka madhutu dad'èi miu dhoo-dhoo. de sèmi èèna na, miu sama sèmi dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: by some of you saying, i am loyal to paul, and others saying, i am loyal to apollos, ◄you show that you are acting like unbelievers. /does not it show that you are acting like unbelievers? ► rhq
target_text: lula miu cahag'e peka na, ja'a ne, re paulus! aa cahag'e dhu peka na, ja'a ne, re apolos! lod'o-lod'o miu padhai lii sèmi èèna, miu pad'elo, na, miu èci èèna ka dènge dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: so what you really ought to think about apollos and me rhq is that wedl are merely men who serve god. as a result of our telling you the message about christ, you trusted in him. both of us dl are merely doing the work that the lord appointed us to do.
target_text: madhutu iia-iia na, apolos èèna, cee? aa ja'a, paulus ne, cee? te ji'i dua mi se, dhoka ana pua-paleha di. ji'i dhoka pad'elo j'ara ho miu bisa parcaya kristus. apolos pakako sasab'a madhutu paredha kètu èdhi. aa ja'a sèmi èèna kahèi!

source_text: i was the first one who preached god's message to you. i was like met someone who plants seeds. later, apollos taught you more of god's message. that was like met someone who waters plants after they start to grow. but it is god who enables people to grow spiritually, just like he is the one who causes plants to grow.
target_text: ja'a ka dhu uru tèka lole dènge miu lula-nèti kristus. èèna nuka sèmi ja'a ka dhu sèle hini. hèia apolos mai aj'a-nori miu. èèna nuka sèmi nèngu ka dhu bui-tatee hini dhu ja'a sèle kore sèra. te ngaa ama lamatua ka dhu tao hini sèra muri j'aj'i kapai aae.

source_text: so the person who first preaches god's message to people is not important, and the person who later teaches people more of god's message is not important, just like met it is not the person who plants the seeds or the person who waters the plants who is important. instead, it is god, who causes plants to grow and who causes people to grow spiritually, who is important.
target_text: de dhèu dhu sèle hini sèra dènge boe kab'ua. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu dhu bui. dhodhoka èci di dhu dènge kab'ua, nuka ama lamatua. lula nèngu ka tao hini sèra muri, ka sub'u dènge sega.

source_text: the person who first preaches god's message to people and the one who later teaches them more of god's message met both ◄are trying to reach the same goal/have the same purpose►. and god will reward each of them according to how they served him.
target_text: dhèu dhu sèle, aa dhèu dhu bui-tatee, sab'a sama-sama, te sasab'a rèngu èci èèna ka. aa dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu pakako sasab'a lamatua, bèli-camèd'a na b'ae rui-j'aj'èra ra.

source_text: remember that apollos and i are both working together for god. you do not belong to us. just like a field belongs to its owner, not to those who work in it, you belong to god, not to us who work for him. also, a house belongs to its owner. it does not belong to the man who built it. similarly, god is the one to whom you belong.
target_text: te ji'i sama-sama dhèu sab'a nèti lamatua. aa miu nuka sèmi oka lamatua, dhu nèngu neo uri. sèmi èèna kahèi, miu nuka sèmi èmu dhu ama lamatua patitu.

source_text: just like a skilled person puts a foundation in the ground before he builds a house, as a result of god kindly helping me met, i was the first one who declared the message about christ to you. and, just like others build a house on its foundation, there were others who later taught you more about christ. but just like each person who builds a house must be careful about what materials he uses to build it met, each person who teaches god's truth must be careful about what he teaches.
target_text: de lamatua pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a. nèti èèna ka ja'a sama sèmi dholu. ka lamatua soru-bara ja'a ho ke'a mèu j'ara-j'ara nèti kapua, sèna ka ja'a tao era padhèdi dhu èra ètu d'ara mamuri miu. hèia dhèu leo aj'a-nori miu kahèi, ho rèngu patitu mi era padhèdi dhu ja'a tao kore èèna. te ngaa tuka èci-èci hud'i sab'a ku dènge d'ara kateme, ho rèngu patitu èmu dhu èra.

source_text: just like people can put in only one foundation for a house met, there is only one message that we can give to people. that message is about jesus christ.
target_text: era padhèdi dhu èra èèna, abhu le. nuka yesus kristus. nèti èèna ka, dhèu leo bisa boe tao era padhèdi leo ètu d'ara miu, te lamatua dhu tao tèke le era padhèdi dhu lèke.

source_text: furthermore, people can build a house on its foundation with materials that are valuable and do not burn easily, such as gold, silver, and expensive jewels. or they could build a house with materials that are not valuable and that burn easily, such as wood, hay, and straw.
target_text: tatu abhu dhèu dhu neo patitu kahèi ètu era padhèdi èèna pake rupa-rupa nèu. abhu dhu neo pake nèu dhu kab'ua, sèmi hualaa, doi pudhi do hadhu kale'e. abhu dhu pake nèu biasa, nuka sèmi aj'u, j'u'u do rèu hidhu.

source_text: later it will become clear/evident what kind of material they used to build the house. similarly, when people teach others god's truth, it will later become clear what kind of things they taught. god will make that clear/evident at the time when he judges us mty.
target_text: te ngaa sasab'a tuka èci-èci ka bisa te'a, aa dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra bisa re'a sasab'a rèngu èèna, be'a do aad'o. te lod'o èle rai-haha, lamatua neo sèku ne, sama sèmi na pake ai ho pad'elo, na, sasab'a dhèu sèra, bisa taha do aad'o.

source_text: when a fire starts burning a house, it becomes clear whether the builders used materials in their work that will burn, or materials that will not burn. similarly met, when god judges us, it will be clear whether we taught others things that were long-lasting and valuable or not. if the materials that are used to build a house are materials that do not burn, the builder will receive a reward met. similarly, if we have taught others things that are valuable and long-lasting, god will give us a reward.
target_text: ladhe uji nare sasab'a nèti ca dhèu pake ai, aa nèu dhu na pake bisa taha, bèli-camèd'a lamatua b'ae rui-j'aj'èra na ètu sorga.

source_text: if the things that we have taught are not valuable and long-lasting met, we will not get a reward. we will be saved {god will save us} from hell, but that is all that we will get. we will be like a man who escapes from a fire without saving any of his possessions.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe uji nare sasab'a dhèu pake ai, aa ai na'e aa'i nèu dhu nèngu pake patitu ètu era padhèdi èèna, na, lamatua hia boe dhèu ne ngaa-ngaa. te ngaa tuka ne abhu mamuri era, masi ka sèmi dhèu dhu rai kalua nèti d'ara èmu ai na'e.

source_text: you need to remember that god is present among you pl as he was present in the temple in jerusalem. rhq god's spirit lives within you.
target_text: miu hud'i me'a ku, dhu peka na, miu sama sèmi èmu sabaj'a lamatua, aa roh na dhu pea ètu d'ara.
