source_text: so, just like god will destroy anyone who tries to destroy his temple, he will destroy anyone who destroys the unity of a congregation. he will do that because he has set you, his people, apart for himself, just like he set his temple apart for himself.
target_text: aa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu pa'ele iie èmu sabaj'a lamatua, nuka era pea na, na mage-mage! bèli-camèd'a lamatua pa'ele iie ne kahèi! te èmu sabaj'a lamatua èèna mola-mèci. de miu hud'i mola-mèci ku kahèi.

source_text: some among you think that you are wise because unbelievers thought you were wise previously. stop deceiving yourselves. if you really want to be wise, by accepting what god considers to be wise you should be willing to let unbelievers consider that you are foolish iro.
target_text: miu baku tipu ngi'u miu unu mi! ladhe abhu ca dhèu dhu pangee, na, nèngu d'èlu-mèu aa ne'a aa'i madhutu mamèu dhèu ètu rai-haha lod'o limuri ne, èèna peka na, nèngu ne'a boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa. ladhe èu mase'a le, peka na, èu me'a boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa, heka èu mulai me'a kèna.

source_text: you should do that because things that unbelievers consider to be iro wise, god considers to be foolish. we can learn from the scriptures what god says about that: those who think that they are iro wise, he messes up their plans by the mistakes they make!
target_text: ngangee dhèu ètu rai-haha taa limuri ne, ama lamatua peka na, goa. te ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci dhu suri tèke, peka na: abhu dhèu dhu pangee, na, nèngu d'èlu-mèu, te ngaa èèna na lamatua pake hari ngangee na dhu karehe sèra, j'aj'i mi sasii, ho sii pa'ele iie hari nèngu!

source_text: and we can learn from these words of scripture, the lord considers as useless the thoughts of humans who think that they are iro wise.
target_text: ètu era leo dhu suri kahèi, peka na, lamatua èdhi dhu ne'a le ngaa dhu dhèu d'èlu-mèu sèra pangee, aa dhèu dhu hud'i re'a ku neo tao ne tasa mere mia, nèngu dhu ne'a nare le, na, rèngu dhoka ngee iia d'ara di.

source_text: so, stop boasting about how good one christian leader is or how good another christian leader is. all of usexc exist as leaders only to help you! specifically, do not boast about me, or about apollos, or about peter! everything in the world exists to benefit you believers. whether you live or whether you die, the things that are happening now or the things that will happen in the future, they are all to benefit you.
target_text: de miu baku padedha dhèu èci sa, dhu peka na, nèngu èèna lènge aa'i dhèu. te lamatua ka dhu ded'e dhèu, ho ator miu. aa'i-aa'i sèra j'aj'i le unu miu. de dhèu dhu ator miu sèra, sama sèmi: ja'a, apolos, dènge petrus, ji'i se j'aj'i unu miu. aa aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne unu miu kahèi, masi ka miu mamuri do miu madhe, masi ka deo ne'e do lod'o dhu mai, aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i unu miu kateme aae.

source_text: you should boast about christ, not about your leaders, because you belong to christ, and christ belongs to god.
target_text: aa miu j'aj'i dhèu unu kristus. aa kristus unu ama lamatua!

source_text: so, people ought to consider us apostles or, apollos and me to be merely servants of christ. god has given to us exc the work of telling others the message that god has now revealed to us.
target_text: de miu baku koa-kad'iri ji'i, te ji'i dhoka ana pua-paleha kristus di. aa ama lamatua lèka ji'i, sèna ka j'aga paie-iie j'ara-j'ara dhu uru èèna pahuni tèke.

source_text: with respect to doing that, those who are given work are required {give others some work to do require them} to do that work faithfully.
target_text: dhèu dhu madhenga mèdha-panyau lamatua na, nèngu hud'i j'aj'i ku dhèu dhu tao madhutu ngaa dhu lèke.

source_text: i am not concerned whether you or the judges in some court decide whether i have done my work faithfully or not. i do not even judge myself about that.
target_text: tasamia dènge ja'a? ja'a sab'e madhutu ngaa dhu lèke, do aad'o? ja'a ko'o boe ke'a, miu nile ja'a tasa mera mia. aa ja'a pusi-pahae boe kahèi dhèu leo nile ja'a sèmi ngaa sa. ja'a ke'a boe nile ngi'u ja'a unu ku kahèi.

source_text: i do not think that i have done anything wrong, but that does not prove that i have done nothing wrong. the lord is the one who judges me.
target_text: te masi ka d'ara iiki ja'a peka na, ja'a be'a le, tatu boe sasoa na, ja'a be'a. dhu mèci ka, lamatua ka dhu nile ja'a tasa mera mia.

source_text: so, stop evaluating any of us exc before the time when god judges everyone mty! do not judge us before the lord comes. he is the one who will reveal the sinful things that people have done secretly. he will even reveal what people have thought. at that time god will praise each person as each one of them deserves.
target_text: de miu baku tao ngi'u sèmi dhèu pama'ète lii langu ho nile dhèu leo sèra. mate mamai hari lamatua, te nèngu ka dhu èèna na bhoke patalele aa'i mèu-mèu. nèngu ka pasabhoka aa'i bhabhelu-katub'a dhu dhèu tao pahuni ètu d'ara maroga. nèngu neo bhoke paled'a j'ara-j'ara dhu dhèu ngee ètu d'ara ra. hèia ama lamatua neo peka aa'i j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a, dhu dhèu tao le.

source_text: my fellow believers, i have told you all these things as illustrations of myself and apollos. i have done this for your sake, in order that you may learn to live according to the saying, do not act contrary to what is {what they have} written in the scriptures. if you follow that rule, you will not be proud of one spiritual leader and despise another.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a dhu padhai lii lula-nèti ja'a dènge apolos, nuka sèmi ja'a j'aj'i mi conto ho miu bisa aj'a nèti ji'i, nuka: tao madhutu j'ara-j'ara dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua. baku tao dhu leo. ladhe miu madhutu ka j'ara se'e, miu baku bia re èci sa, aa padedha iisi lula madhutu ca dhèu, aa pahahe dhèu leo.

source_text: ◄no one has made any of you superior to others! /why do any of you think that you are superior to others? ► rhq all the abilities that you have, you received from god. rhq so if you received them all from god, ◄you should not boast thinking, i got these abilities from myself, not from god! /why do you boast thinking, i got these abilities from myself, not from god? ► rhq
target_text: de tasamia? miu pangee, na, miu risi nèti dhèu leo, do? baku! te aa'i-aa'i dhu miu unu, miu abhu nèti ama lamatua. de ladhe sèmi èèna, nga tao ka miu nged'e ej'a ai, nuka sèmi miu ad'u-ue unu mi?

source_text: it is disgusting that you act as though iro you have already received everything that you need spiritually. you act as though iro you were spiritually rich or, you had received all the spiritual gifts you need. you act as though iro you had already begun to rule as kings with christ. well, i wish that you really were ruling with him, in order that we apostles might also rule with you!
target_text: nuka sèmi aa'i-aa'i dhu miu parluu, miu abhu le. nuka sèmi miu kaja le! miu tao ngi'u mi, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu kapai sama sèmi dhèu aae sa, aa ji'i soru-bara boe ciki sa. madhutu iia-iia na, lamatua ka dhu hia aa'i-aa'i dhu miu parluu. te ngaa ladhe miu tare'a-re'a j'aj'i dhèu aae, ele boe ji'i ngèd'u paredha sama-sama dènge miu, si?

source_text: but it seems as though god has put us apostles on display, like prisoners at the end of the victor's parade. we exc are like men who have been condemned to die, who have been put in the arena where everyone can see the wild animals killing them. and not only people, but even angels all over the world are watching us, as people watch those who are performing a play in a theater.
target_text: ama lamatua ka dhu pua-paleha ji'i, ho la'a asa mia-mia ètu rai-haha ne, sèna ka lole dènge dhèu j'ara-j'ara kristus. te ngaa ca tèka-ca tèka sa ja'a pangee, na, lamatua pua ji'i titu re limuri tèka, sama sèmi ana bèdho dhu tatae abhu huku madhe. hèia na hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, aa dènge ana-ana pajuu na ètu sorga mai laladhe ji'i.

source_text: many people consider us to be iro fools because we preach about christ, but you proudly think iro that you are wise because ◄of your close relationship with/you belong to► christ. many people consider us iro to be unimpressive, but you proudly think that you impress others. people respect you, but they do not respect us.
target_text: miu kapai titu kèna, nga! te abhu dhèu dhu pangee, na, miu d'èlu-mèu, lula pa'èki dènge kristus. te ngaa rèngu pangee, na, ji'i goa titu kèna, lula ji'i j'aj'i dhèu unu kristus. ele boe rèngu ngee, na, miu èra risi, aa ji'i se roe aala-aala. ele boe ra ded'e miu padedha-dedha, te ngaa ro'o boe pusi-pahae ji'i ciki sa hèi. seli-kolane, nga!

source_text: up to this present time we have often been hungry. we have often been thirsty. we have ragged clothes. often we have been beaten {others have beaten us}. we have traveled so much that we have no regular homes to live in.
target_text: toke d'ai deo ne'e, ji'i manganga dènge koko-kamango. mèdha-papake ji'i kaha'i-kaheru. dhèu loe boe game ji'i. ji'i nuka sèmi dhèu dhu dènge boe era pea.

source_text: we work very hard to earn a living. when we are cursed by people {when people curse us}, we ask god to bless them. when we are persecuted {when people cause us to suffer}, we endure it.
target_text: ji'i sab'a dènge kacui-aai ji'i unu mi toke d'ai èi kabhèsu hae. ladhe dhèu padhai-kakoli ji'i, ji'i dhoka b'ala, peka na, ji'i manèngi, sèna ka ama lamatua tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a hia miu. ladhe dhèu paj'èra ji'i, na, ji'i b'ala boe, dhoka mau-mau di.

source_text: when we are slandered by people {when people slander us}, we reply kindly to them. up to now, unbelievers consider us to be worthless met, as though we were just garbage.
target_text: ladhe dhèu padhai pa'ele iie kolongara ji'i, ji'i dhoka dhaa dènge rèhu mare di. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa abhu dhèu dhu pangee, na, ji'i se nuka sèmi kaj'alu do mamumu dhu core eele.

source_text: i am writing this to you, not to make you feel ashamed, but instead to warn you as though you were my own dear children.
target_text: ja'a suri j'ara se'e, neo boe pamakae miu. te ngaa ja'a neo pasanèd'e miu, lula ja'a sue miu nuka sèmi ana matana ja'a sa. nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka dènge miu, ho lèpa asa j'ara dhu mola.

source_text: i say that because as an apostle of christ jesus i was the first one who proclaimed the good message to you. as a result, i was the one who enabled you to have eternal life. so even if there were thousands of christians who instruct you met, i am the only one who became like a father to you.
target_text: masi ka dhèu riho-riho dhu bisa pad'elo j'ara hia miu lula-nèti kristus, te ngaa dhoka ja'a mesa ku dhu j'aj'i ama miu. te ja'a ka dhèu uru j'ara dhu peka-padhai dènge miu lii lolo be'a nèti yesus kristus. nèti èèna ka, miu parcaya ne. ja'a tao j'ara èèna, lula ja'a dhu pa'èki mèno dènge ne.

source_text: so i urge you to live for christ the way i do.
target_text: de ja'a manèngi, sèna ka miu madhutu j'ara mamuri ja'a ne.

source_text: in order to help you do that, i have sent/will be sending timothy to you. i love him as though he were my son. he serves the lord faithfully. he will remind you of the way i conduct my life as one who ◄has a close relationship with/belongs to► the lord. the way i conduct my life is the same as how i teach others to live in all the congregations to whom i have spoken.
target_text: nèti èèna ka ja'a pua timotius dhiu soru-bara miu. ja'a sue ne, sama sèmi ana matana ja'a. ja'a lèka ne, te nèngu kahèi mamuri pa'èki dènge lamatua èdhi. èèna na nèngu soru-bara miu ho pasanèd'e miu nèti mamuri ja'a. j'ara mamuri ja'a sèmi èèna, lula ja'a pa'èki dènge yesus kristus, dhu ama lamatua hia mai. èèna ka dhu ja'a aj'a-nori dènge dhèu sarani dhu pakaboko ètu mia-mia.

source_text: some of you have become proud, thinking that i will not come there to rebuke your congregation about what they are doing.
target_text: abhu nèti miu dhu pangee, na, ja'a lake kore boe dhiu dènge miu. nèti èèna ka rèngu nged'e titu kèna.

source_text: but if the lord wants me to come, i will come to you soon. then i will not pay any attention to what those proud people say. instead, i will find out whether they have god's power.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe lamatua èdhi d'èi, nèbhu boe ja'a d'ai kota korintus. ho èèna na ja'a ke'a mèu, na, dhèu sèra padhai lii padedha iisi, do, rèngu tare'a dènge koasa!

source_text: remember that god judges whether or not we are letting him rule our lives, not by listening to how we talk, but by seeing whether his power is present ◄among us/in our lives►.
target_text: te ama lamatua èèna dhèu aae dhu unu koasa. ka dhèu nèngu hèb'a mènyi boe, ho pa'èra dhèu ètu d'ara lalèka ra, te ngaa rèngu pake koasa dhu lèke.

source_text: so which do you prefer? do you want me to come to you and punish you because you have not changed your ways, or shall i come to you and act lovingly and gently toward you because you have done what i told you to do?
target_text: de dad'èi miu tasamia? ladhe ja'a dhiu, na, ja'a tao lii sakaa aa huku miu? do, ja'a dhiu pad'elo sasue dènge d'ara be'a?

source_text: now i want to discuss another matter. it has been {people have} reported to me, and i believe that it is true, that some people among you have been acting in a sexually immoral way, in a way that is so bad that not even ◄pagans/people who do not know about god► act that way. people tell me that a man is living with his stepmother or, his father's other wife.
target_text: ja'a tadèngi, na, ca dhèu nèti juma'at miu dhu ad'u j'ara karehe dènge dhèu bhèni. ngaa dhu nèngu ad'u-ue ne bhelu risi nèti dhèu dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua. lula nèngu j'unu pa'èci dènge ina bhala na!

source_text: you should be sad about what that man is doing! he should have been expelled {you should have expelled him} from your congregation! but you have not done that, so ◄how can you be proud, thinking that you are spiritually mature? /it is disgusting that you are proud, thinking that you are spiritually mature! ► rhq
target_text: te ngaa miu pamone-pabhèni, sèmi juma'at miu mola-mèci le! te ngaa madhutu iia-iia na, miu hud'i makae ku, aa d'ara pèd'a. dhèu sèmi èèna, babège eele ne pakaj'èu!

source_text: as for me, i have already decided how you should punish that man. and even though i am away from you, my spirit is with you, and you should do as i would do if i were there with you.
target_text: masi ka èdhi pakaj'èu èci dènge èci, te ngaa d'ara ja'a dhoka ètu miu di. de ja'a pama'ète kore le lii langu dhèu dhu tao j'ara makae èèna, nuka sèmi ja'a dhu ètu èèna le.

source_text: what i have decided is that when you have gathered together with the authority mty of our lord jesus, and my spirit is with you, and the power of our lord jesus is with you,
target_text: ja'a dènge hak ho pama'ète sèmi èèna, lula yesus j'aj'i kètu èdhi, aa ja'a dhèu pajuu-paleha na. de miu hud'i madhèdi pa'èci ku ho pama'ète lii langu èèna pake kolongara kètu èdhi. aa d'ara ja'a sama-sama dènge miu kahèi.

source_text: you should hand that man over to satan. then satan can injure/punish his body, in order that he will turn away from his sinful behavior and his spirit will be saved on the day when the lord returns mty.
target_text: hèia miu hud'i saraka dhèu ne asa dhèu aae nidhu, sèna ka nèbhu-nèbhu na core eele j'ara bhelu-katub'a nèti d'ara na. sèna ka ladhe kètu èdhi mai hari, na, nèngu patabuli dhèu ne'e nèti koasa sasala-sasigo na.

source_text: it is not good that, while you are letting that immoral man continue to be in your congregation, you are boasting about being spiritually mature. ◄you know that a small amount of yeast affects all the bread dough met into which it is put {a woman puts it}. /do you not know that a small amount of yeast affects all the bread dough met into which it is put? ► rhq similarly, one person who continues to sin will have a bad effect on all the congregation.
target_text: be'a boe ladhe miu nged'e! baku bhèlu, na, èdhi pakihu bibit roti ciki di ho bisa pakapai adonan aa'i-aa'i. bibit roti, nuka sèmi bhabhelu dhèu. de ladhe soro tèke dhèu ad'u-ue bhabhelu ètu talora aae miu, bèli-camèd'a dhèu sarani leo sèra madhutu tao bhelu kahèi!

source_text: so, just like we jews expel the old yeast from our houses during the passover celebration in order that we may have a fresh batch of dough without yeast in it met, you must expel such evil people from your congregation. do that so that you can truly be holy people, as i know that you really are. remember that christ was sacrificed {sacrificed himself} so that god could spare us from being punished for our sins, just like the jews sacrificed lambs during the first passover celebration so that god would spare their firstborn sons from being killed.
target_text: babège eele dhèu bhelu èèna nèti juma'at miu, sèmi uru èèna dhèu yahudi sèra core eele ragi aa'i-aa'i nèti èmu rèngu sèra ho neo ra'a kalela paska. dènge j'ara ne, miu bisa j'aj'i hari nuka sèmi dhèu dhu d'ara na abhu heka bhelu-katub'a. miu hud'i j'aj'i ku sèmi èèna. uru èèna, dhèu roro ana kahib'i-kalèbho sèna ka tao badha korban kalela paska. d'ai limuri ku, rèngu pamadhe dhèu mola-mèci ama lamatua, sèna ka j'aj'i korban dhu pamèu d'ara èdhi.

source_text: so let us celebrate the fact that god has freed us from being punished us for our sins met, just like the jews in later years celebrated passover to celebrate god freeing them from being slaves in egypt. they made sure that there was no old yeast in the dough. they ate bread that had no yeast in it. similarly, we should make sure that there are no people in our congregations met who act maliciously toward others or act wickedly. instead, make sure met that all those in our congregations are ones who act sincerely and speak truthfully.
target_text: uru èèna, dhèu yahudi ra'a gee-j'ara nèti roti dhu pake boe ragi ètu d'ara lod'o kalela paska. limuri ne, èdhi nuka sèmi roti dhu pake boe ragi èèna. nèti èèna ka, èdhi hud'i j'aga paie mamuri èdhi sèna ka baku tao ia ka j'ara-j'ara dhu bhelu, aa baku papèd'a d'ara dhèu leo. èdhi hud'i padhai lii dhu lèke taruu. hèia ropa dhèu ladhe rèdhi mamuri èdhi, ra peka na, tatao èdhi madhutu d'ara mola.

source_text: in the previous letter that i wrote to you, i said that you should not associate with sexually immoral people.
target_text: ca hari ni, ja'a suri kèdhi le sasuri dhu peka na, baku pa'èci dènge dhèu dhu tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu nèngu boe.

source_text: i did not mean that you should not associate with unbelievers who are immoral, or who desire things that belong to others, or who ◄forcefully seize things that belong to others/are swindlers►, or who worship idols. you would have to leave this world to avoid all people like that.
target_text: a'abhu ja'a ne peka boe, na, miu baku pa'èci dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, dhu pusi-pahae boe ama lamatua, do dhèu manga'a, do dhèu kapod'e-kabèli dhu mana'u rare mèdha-panyau dhèu, do dènge dhèu sogo-tagu nidhu. te ladhe sèmi èèna, miu hud'i tao iisi mi pakaj'èu nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: but now i am stating clearly that when i wrote, i meant that you should not associate with those who say that they are fellow believers, if they are sexually immoral or if they desire and forcefully seize things that belong to others, or worship idols, or slander others, or become drunk. you should not associate with people like that, and you should not even eat with them!
target_text: te ngaa dhu ja'a peka ne nuka: miu baku pa'èci dènge dhèu dhu peka na, nèngu dhèu sarani, aa te ngaa nèngu tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu nèngu boe, do dhu manga'a, do dhu sogo-tagu nidhu, do dhu pahahe kolongara dhèu, do dhu mahu, do dhu kapod'e mèdha-panyau dhèu. èdhi baku pa'èci dènge dhèu sèmi sèra. aa loe eele ka madhèdi mi'a-minu pa'èci dènge dhèu sèmi sèra!

source_text: it is certainly not rhq my business to judge people who are not believers and who do not belong to christian congregations. but it certainly is rhq your business to judge those who are in your congregation!
target_text: miu dènge hak ho lee mamuri dhèu sarani. te ngaa ja'a dènge boe hak, sèna ka pama'ète lii langu dhèu dhu parcaya boe ama lamatua.

source_text: god is the one who will judge those who are not believers. do as the scriptures command: expel the wicked person from your midst!
target_text: te ama lamatua mesa na ka bèli-camèd'a pama'ète hia dhèu dhu parcaya boe ne. de miu baku bhèlu, ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua dhu suri, peka na, dhèu dhu peka na, nèngu dhèu unu lamatua, te ngaa loe boe tao bhabhelu, na, babège eele ne!

source_text: now another matter: when any of you believers accuses another believer about some matter, he takes that matter to judges who are not believers, for them to decide the case, instead of asking god's people to decide it. ◄that is disgusting! /why do you do that? ► rhq
target_text: ladhe ca dhèu sarani pagalaa dènge a'ari na dhèu sarani, nga tao ka lami asa pengadilan ètu madha hakim dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua? tasamia ka j'aj'i sèmi èèna? be'a risi lami asa madha dhèu-dhèu parcaya, sèna ka rèngu uri lii langu miu!

source_text: i want you to know that we who are god's people will some day judge those who are unbelievers. rhq so, since you will be judging unbelievers, you certainly are capable of judging between believers who disagree on small matters! rhq
target_text: nuka sèmi dhu dhae me'a mèka, peka na, dhèu-dhèu parcaya, bèli-camèd'a rèngu ka dhu pama'ète lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. de tasamia ka miu mesa mi bisa boe uri lii langu dhu ana iiki-iiki?

source_text: ◄you should keep in mind that we will even judge angels! /do you not know that we will even judge angels? ► rhq so we certainly should be able to judge about matters that relate to how we conduct our lives here on earth!
target_text: dhu mola-mola ka, ladhe bèli-camèd'a èdhi ka dhu uri lii langu ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga. de tatu hud'i miu ku dhu uri lii langu dhu bèli-bèli j'aj'i ètu talora aae miu.

source_text: therefore, when you believers have a dispute, you should certainly not choose as judges to decide your case people whom the congregation cannot respect because those judges are not believers! rhq
target_text: risi-risi hari, ladhe miu dhèu parcaya pagalaa lula-nèti j'ara dhu ana iiki-iiki sèra, nga tao ka miu pake dhèu pama'ète lii dhu dhèu-dhèu sarani pakab'ua boe si?

source_text: i am saying this to make you ashamed. surely there is someone among you who is wise enough to judge disputes between believers! rhq
target_text: de ja'a neo peka ca j'ara dhu pamakae miu. sèmi ngaa? nuka sèmi ètu talora aae miu abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu d'èlu-mèu uri lii langu dhu ana iiki-iiki sèra, sèmi lii langu dhu cèu nèti a'ari èdhi.

source_text: but instead, some believers among you accuse other believers in a legal court. and what is worse, you let the cases be judged by unbelievers {unbelievers judge the cases}!
target_text: te ngaa nèti talora miu abhu dhèu parcaya dhu ère nèti a'ari na dhèu parcaya asa madha dhèu pama'ète lii langu! aa te ngaa dhèu pama'ète lii langu ne dhu parcaya boe lamatua!

source_text: the fact that you have any lawsuits among you shows that you have completely failed as christians or, allowed satan to defeat you. you should allow other believers to wrong you without taking them to court! rhq you should not accuse them when they cheat you! rhq
target_text: lèke boe, sina ma? miu dhu segi boe le èèna, ladhe miu èci dènge èci lami pagalaa asa era pama'ète lii langu. be'a risi, a'ari èu èèna soro tèke ne, ladhe na tao sala mi dedha èu. aa ladhe a'ari èu dhèu parcaya mana'u nare mèdha-panyau èu, be'a risi hud'i laa nare!

source_text: but what is happening is that some of you are cheating others and doing wrong to them. that is bad. but you are doing that to fellow believers, and that is worse!
target_text: te ngaa miu dhèu parcaya èci tao sala mi a'ari miu. aa èci mana'u èci. aa te ngaa miu sama-sama dhèu parcaya!

source_text: ◄you should keep in mind that wicked people will not become members of the group over whom god will rule. /do you not know that wicked people will not become members of the group over whom god will rule? ► rhq do not be deceived {do not deceive yourselves} by thinking wrongly about these matters. people who are sexually immoral, or who worship idols, or who ◄commit adultery/have sex with someone to whom they are not married►, or who happily allow others to commit homosexual acts with them, or who take the initiative in committing homosexual acts,
target_text: miu nuka sèmi me'a boe j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i! te dhèu dhu ro'o boe tao dhu lèke, tatu bisa boe j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua. mage soro tèke dhèu tipu miu, sèna ka miu ad'u-ue sasala! dhèu dhu tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu nèngu boe, dhu sogo-tagu nidhu, dhu bersina, mone dhèu dua dhu pa'èci nuka sèmi dhèu èmu-kamali,

source_text: or who are thieves, or who desire and forcefully seize things that belong to others, or who are drunkards, or who slander others, or who are swindlers, will not enter the place where god rules.
target_text: dhèu mana'u, dhèu manga'a, dhèu rinu mahu, dhu padhai lii pakarehe kolongara dhèu, dhu pakapod'e ho rare mèdha-panyau dhèu, te dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèmi se'e se, tatu bisa boe j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua!

source_text: some of you previously did things like that. but god has freed/cleansed you met from your sinful behavior. he has set you apart for himself. he has erased the record of your sins because you trusted mty in the lord jesus christ and because of what the spirit of our god has done for you.
target_text: mema, uru èèna miu cahag'e sèmi èèna kahèi! te ngaa ama lamatua saku eele sasala-sasigo miu, hèia pamèu miu. aa nèngu bhoke le j'ara kahèi, sèna ka miu bisa pabe'a hari dènge ne. na tao j'ara se'e, lula miu pa'èki dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, aa lula miu pa'èki dènge roh lamatua kahèi.

source_text: some of you may say, god allows us to do anything that he does not forbid. but i would reply, that is true, but not everything that god permits us to do helps us. yes, as some of you say, god permits us to do anything that he does not forbid. but as for me, i will not let anything make me its slave; that is, i will not do anything that will gain control over me in such a way that i will not be able to stop doing it.
target_text: ja'a dènge hak sèna ka tao aa'i mèu-mèu. te ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a neo tao sèra, tatu boe be'a hia ja'a. de masi ka ja'a dènge hak sèna ka tao aa'i mèu-mèu, te ngaa ja'a ko'o boe j'ara dhu karehe koasa nare ja'a.

source_text: some of you may also say, food is just for us to put in the stomach, and the stomach is just for us to put food in. and since god will do away with food and stomachs when he gives us our new bodies, what we do with our bodies sexually does not affect us any more than eating food does. but what you have concluded is wrong, because the lord does not want us to use our bodies to do sexually immoral things. instead, the lord wants us to use our bodies in ways that please him. also, the lord wants us to do what is good for our bodies.
target_text: conto sèmi, dhèu peka na, nganga'a parluu kabake, aa kabake parluu nganga'a. te ngaa sanèd'e, te bèli-camèd'a lamatua palaho aa'i dua-dua ra. conto dhu leo hari, èdhi bisa boe soro ngi'u èdhi sèna ka bisa tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu-kamali èdhi boe. èdhi unu ngi'u ne, sèna ka sab'a hia lamatua èdhi. aa lamatua èdhi ladhe-leru ngi'u èdhi.

source_text: god, by his power, caused the lord jesus to live again after he died, and he will cause us to live again after we die, which shows that he is very concerned about our bodies.
target_text: ropa kètu èdhi, yesus kristus madhe, ama lamatua ka pamamuri hari ne. de ladhe èdhi madhe, nèngu dènge koasa kahèi ho pamamuri hari èdhi.

source_text: you should keep in mind that your bodies belong to christ. rhq so, should i or any other believer rhq take our body, which belongs to christ, and join it sexually to a prostitute? no, certainly not!
target_text: ngi'u miu j'aj'i mi unu kristus, nuka sèmi miu bagian nèti ngi'u kristus. tatu j'ara ne, miu me'a le! de ladhe ja'a pake bagian nèti ngi'u kristus, ho laku pa'èci dènge ngi'u nèti bhèni kajeo, na tasamia? baku sèmi èèna! te èèna na lèke boe!

source_text: when a man has sexual relations eup with a prostitute, it is as though their two bodies become one body. ◄you should never forget that! /do you not know that? ► rhq what moses wrote about people who join together sexually is, the two of them will become as though they are one body.
target_text: tatu miu me'a le, ladhe dhèu tao j'ara makae ho j'unu pa'èci dènge bhèni kajeo, na, dua-dua pakihu kee j'aj'i mi èci. te dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, peka na, rèngu dua ra pa'èki le j'aj'i mi èci.

source_text: but anyone who is united {who joins himself} to the lord becomes one with him spiritually.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu mamuri d'ara èci dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, j'aj'i le èci dènge nèngu, sama sèmi dua ra dhu pa'èki ètu d'ara roh èci.

source_text: always ◄run away from/avoid► committing sexually immoral acts. other sins that people commit do not affect their bodies, but those who commit sexually immoral acts sin against their own bodies.
target_text: ladhe èu abhu tebho tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu èu boe, na, rai pakaj'èu! dhèu ad'u-ue sasala rupa-rupa dhu pa'ele iie rèngu unu ra, aa pa'ele iie dhèu leo kahèi. te dhèu dhu karihu kaj'alu pa'ele iie ngi'u nèngu unu na.

source_text: ◄keep in mind that your bodies are like met temples of the holy spirit. /do you not know that your bodies are like met temples of the holy spirit? ► rhq the spirit, whom god gave you, lives within you. you do not belong to yourselves. you belong to god,
target_text: ngi'u èu èèna, nuka sèmi èmu sabaj'a roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci. roh nèngu èèna ka, dhu pea ètu d'ara miu, te ama lamatua mesa na ka hia roh na mi dedha miu. nèti èèna ka, miu dènge boe hak ciki sa hèi, ho j'aj'i lamatua dhu ator ngi'u miu unu mi. te ngaa, nga tao ka miu mamuri sèmi pame'a boe sa dènge j'ara se'e?

source_text: because when his son died for you it was as though met god paid a price for you. so honor god by how you use your bodies!
target_text: kristus sui nare le miu dènge kab'ua titu kèna. de miu hud'i mamuri ku dènge pakab'ua ngi'u miu unu mi, ho pad'elo, na, miu pakab'ua ama lamatua kahèi.

source_text: now i will reply to the things that you wrote to me about. it is good for people not to get married.
target_text: ja'a neo suri j'ara-j'ara dhu miu pakarèi ètu d'ara sasuri miu èèna, dhu peka na, tasamia? dhu be'a ka, dhèu mone baku leo-èmu, do?

source_text: but because many people are committing sexual immorality, which god detests, every man should have his own wife with whom he can have sexual relations, and every woman should have her own husband with whom she can have sexual relations.
target_text: sèmi ne'e: lula abhu lod'o taleo ae, dhu dhèu bisa manahu asa d'ara tatao dhu sala ètu d'ara pa'èci mone dènge bhèni, nèti èèna ka be'a risi dhèu mone èci hud'i dènge ku dhèu èmu nèngu mesa na. sèmi èèna kahèi, dhèu bhèni hud'i pa'èci ku dènge dhèu èmu nèngu mesa na.

source_text: every man must continue having sexual relations eup with his wife, and every woman must continue having sexual relations with her husband.
target_text: mone dhu dènge le dhèu èmu! mage mo'o boe j'unu pa'èci dènge dhèu èmu èu. aa dhèu bhèni dhu dènge le dhèu èmu! mage mo'o boe j'unu pa'èci dènge dhèu èmu èu.

source_text: a man's wife does not have the right over her own body to be the only one to decide about having sexual relations with her husband. instead, her husband also has a right to decide about that. similarly, a woman's husband does not have the right over his own body to be the only one to decide about having sexual relations with his wife. instead, his wife also has a right to decide about that.
target_text: te bhèni dhu leo le èmu, hia le ngi'u na sèna ka j'aj'i unu dhèu èmu na. aa mone dhu leo le èmu, hia le ngi'u na ho j'aj'i unu dhèu èmu na.

source_text: you may refuse to have sexual relations with each other eup only if you both first agree to do that for a short time, in order that you may both have more time to pray. then after that, begin having sexual relations again eup in order that satan will not be able to persuade you to have sex with someone else because you are unable to control your sexual desires.
target_text: de miu baku patula-pajuku, lula dua-dua mi dhu dènge hak hua! te ngaa ladhe miu neo sabaj'a di, ho mo'o boe ngee j'ara dhu leo-leo, na, j'unu pa'èci boe d'ara ciki oo'e èèna ka, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. sad'i dua mi mere lii èci ku. aa ladhe sabaj'a mere, na, be'a risi pakaboko hari dènge ka. te ladhe aad'o, na, bisa j'aj'i be'a boe! te dhèu aae nidhu bisa dadugu-rariu dhèu dhu taha rare boe d'ara.

source_text: i am telling you these things to say that god allows you to get married, but he does not say that you must get married.
target_text: j'ara ne mai nèti a'abhu ja'a di, nèti boe atora lamatua.

source_text: i myself wish that all people would stay unmarried/single, as i am. but god has enabled each person to live in ways that seem right for them. he has enabled some people to live without getting married, and he has enabled other people to get married.
target_text: madhutu ngangee ja'a, be'a risi dhèu baku leo-èmu, nuka sèmi ja'a dhu dènge boe dhèu èmu. te ngaa ama lamatua hia dhèu karunya pamèci dènge nèngu. nèti èèna ka, abhu dhèu dhu ama lamatua hia si leo-èmu, aa abhu cahag'e dhu na hia si leo boe èmu.

source_text: now i want to say this to you unmarried people and to you whose spouses have died: it would be good for you to remain unmarried as i am.
target_text: ja'a neo peka dènge dhèu mone do dhèu bhèni dhu leo mèka èmu, aa dènge bhèni balu, na, be'a risi miu baku leo-èmu, nuka sèmi ja'a ne.

source_text: but if you cannot control your sexual desires eup, you should get married. it is better to be married so that you can satisfy your sexual desires with your spouse than to constantly have a strong desire eup for sexual relations.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe taha mere boe, hua iia leo èmu ka. dhu hua iia risi ladhe dhèu leo-èmu, te aad'o na, dad'èi d'ara na pa'ele iie ngi'u nèngu unu na.

source_text: and now i will give a command for believers who are married. this is not a command from me alone; it also comes from the lord jesus. you married women must not ◄separate from/divorce► your husbands!
target_text: ne'e ne mai boe nèti ngangee ja'a mesa ku. te ja'a neo peka ngaa dhu lamatua èdhi paredha le mi dhèu dhu leo le èmu, na, bhèni bisa boe pa'ia-pa'ela dènge dhèu èmu-kamali na.

source_text: but if any of you do that, you must remain unmarried, or else you should be reconciled with your husband and live with him again. similarly, men must not ◄separate from/divorce► their wives.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe nèngu tèke eele dhèu èmu na, be'a risi leo ia ka èmu. hua iia nèngu la'e padame dènge mone dhu j'aj'i dhèu èmu na. sèmi èèna kahèi mone, bisa boe pa'ia-pa'ela dènge dhèu èmu-kamali na.

source_text: now i say this to the rest of you, to those who became believers after they were married. this is what i am saying, not what the lord has commanded. if someone has a wife who is not a believer, if she is willing to keep living with him, he must not divorce her.
target_text: ne'e ne madhutu ngangee ja'a, mai boe nèti lamatua èdhi. aa mi dhèu leo, ja'a neo padhai lii sèmi ne'e: ladhe abhu mone dhèu sarani dhu dhèu èmu na parcaya boe kristus, na, baku ia eele ne, ladhe dhèu èmu na neo mamuri taruu dènge nèngu.

source_text: similarly, if a woman has a husband who is not a believer, if he is willing to keep living with her, she must not divorce him.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, dènge bhèni dhu dhèu èmu na parcaya boe kristus, na, baku ia eele ne, ladhe mone ne d'èi era sèna ka dua ra mamuri pa'èci taruu.

source_text: i say that because god has set apart every woman's unbelieving husband for himself because of his wife being a believer, and god has set apart every man's unbelieving wife for himself because of her husband being a believer. if that were not true, god would consider their children unacceptable. but, the fact is that god does consider them acceptable to him.
target_text: te mone dhu parcaya boe kristus, bisa mola-mèci, lula nèngu dhu pa'èki le dènge bhèni dhu j'aj'i dhèu èmu na. aa bhèni dhu parcaya boe kristus, bisa j'aj'i mola-mèci kahèi, lula nèngu dhu pa'èki dènge mone dhu j'aj'i dhèu èmu na. te ladhe aad'o, na, ana-ana rèngu bisa boe mola-mèci. te ngaa dènge j'ara ne, rèngu bisa mola-mèci ètu madha ama lamatua.

source_text: however, if a woman's husband who is not a believer or a man's wife who is not a believer wants to leave, let him or her do so. the husband or wife who is a believer should not force the other one to stay. god has chosen us in order that we may live peacefully.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe dhèu bhèni do dhèu mone dhu parcaya boe kristus, dhu la'e tèke eele dhèu èmu-kamali na dhu parcaya, na hud'i nèngu sène. ka dhèu èmu dhu parcaya, pa'èki heka dènge ne. te ama lamatua paroa miu sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu unu na, ho miu mamuri padame èci dènge èci.

source_text: you women believers should allow your unbelieving spouses to leave you if they want to, because there is no way that you can be sure that god will save your husband if you stay together rhq or, perhaps god will save your husband if you stay together. similarly, you men who are believers, there is no way that you can be sure that god will save your wives if you stay together rhq or, perhaps god will save your wives if you stay together.
target_text: dhèu bhèni dhu parcaya, dhu leo le èmu aa'i-aa'i! ele boe miu bisa hia mamuri mi dhèu èmu miu. aa bisa aad'o kahèi. sèmi èèna kahèi dhèu mone dhu parcaya dhu leo le èmu sèra! ele boe miu bisa hia mamuri mi dhèu èmu miu. aa bisa aad'o kahèi. miu me'a iia mèka.

source_text: however, each person should continue in the status that the lord gave him, the status that he had when the lord called him to belong to him. that is the rule that i tell people in all the congregations where i speak.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa mamuri dhèu èci-èci tasa mera mia lod'o ama lamatua paroa nare miu j'aj'i dhèu unu na, mamuri taruu sèmi èèna. baku ub'a hari, te ama lamatua dhu ator nare le sèmi èèna. ja'a aj'a-nori atora ne ètu juma'at aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: if a man had already been circumcised rhq when he became a christian, he should not try to pretend that he is not circumcised. if a man had not been circumcised rhq before he became a christian, he should not become circumcised.
target_text: conto, ladhe miu suna le sèna ka pad'elo, na, miu dhèu yahudi, hèia lod'o limuri miu tadèngi ama lamatua paroa nare miu, na, baku pasili, peka na, miu suna le. aa dhèu dhu dhae suna mèka ropa tadèngi ama lamatua paroa si, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu unu na, na, suna ia ka. lula rèngu dhu j'aj'i le dhèu unu lamatua.

source_text: you should not try to change your status that way, because it means nothing to god whether someone is circumcised or not. what is important is that we obey what god has commanded.
target_text: ladhe dhu suna le, èèna j'aj'i boe mi ngaa èci sa. aa suna mèka èèna ka, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. dhu dènge kab'ua ka, nuka èdhi madhutu lii paredha ama lamatua.

source_text: generally, each person should remain in the status that he had when he became a christian.
target_text: lod'o ama lamatua hag'e nare miu j'aj'i dhèu unu na, lamatua pua boe miu suna, do baku suna. de hud'i ka laa sèmi èèna. baku ub'a ia ka.

source_text: if one of you was a slave when you sg became a christian rhq, do not be concerned about it. however, if you get an opportunity to be free, do what you need to do to become free.
target_text: ja'a hia hari conto èci. ladhe èu j'aj'i ènu lod'o ama lamatua paroa èu, na, hud'i laa sèmi èèna, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. te ngaa ladhe sèmi èu dhu ènu boe, na, hud'i laa! ladhe bisa boe j'aj'i dhèu bebas, ngaa-ngaa tao boe kahèi.

source_text: do not worry about your previously being a slave, because those who were slaves before they became christians, the lord has freed them from satan's control. similarly, those who were not slaves before they became christians, it is as though met they are christ's slaves because they must do what he tells them to do met.
target_text: te ropa lamatua paroa ca dhèu ènu j'aj'i dhèu unu na, ènu ne j'aj'i le sèmi ca dhèu dhu bebas, dhu sab'a hia lamatua na ètu sorga. aa lod'o ama lamatua paroa ca dhèu bebas j'aj'i dhèu unu na, dhèu ne j'aj'i ana pua-paleha kristus.

source_text: christ paid a price to buy you when he died for you. so do not act as if you are evil people's slaves by doing the evil things that they tell you to do.
target_text: kristus tihe pama'ète nare le miu dènge kab'ua titu kèna! de miu baku j'aj'i ènu hia dhèu leo.

source_text: my fellow believers, i repeat that in general each believer, being in fellowship with god, should continue in the status that he had before he became a christian.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! lod'o ama lamatua paroa nare miu j'aj'i dhèu unu na, mamuri miu tasamia èèna ka, hud'i laa sèmi èèna. baku ub'a ia ka. hud'i laa sèmi èèna ka, hia mi lamatua.

source_text: now i will answer your question about women who have never married. there is nothing that the lord has commanded me to write about them, but i am writing this to tell you what i think is best, because the lord jesus has mercifully enabled me to say what is reliable.
target_text: miu karèi ja'a lula-nèti dhèu kalora iisi dhu j'unu pa'èci rèdhi mèka dènge dhèu èci sa. ama lamatua peka boe ngaa-ngaa dènge ja'a nèti j'ara èèna. te ngaa miu bisa sèmi ngaa dhu ja'a peka-padhai, lula ama lamatua pad'elo rasa kasia mi ja'a. madhutu a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e ka:

source_text: there are a lot of distressing events happening now or, that will soon happen, so i think that it is better for people to remain in the marital status that they now have.
target_text: limuri ne èdhi abhu j'aj'èra rupa-rupa. de mamuri dhèu tasa mera mia èèna ka, hud'i laa sèmi èèna. dad'èi ja'a sèmi ne'e ka:

source_text: if any of you men are married rhq, do not try to divorce your wife. if any of you are unmarried rhq, do not seek a wife.
target_text: ladhe èu pa'èki dènge dhèu èmu èu, na, baku ia eele ne. ladhe èu dhu pa'èki heka dènge dhèu èmu èu, na, tenge ia ka bhèni leo, sèna ka leo ia ka èmu.

source_text: but if any of you men get married, you have not committed a sin by doing that. likewise, if an unmarried woman gets married, she has not committed a sin by doing that. however, those who get married will have many troubles, so i am urging you to remain unmarried in order that you may not experience such troubles.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe èu leo hari èmu, na, èu sala boe ngaa-ngaa. aa ladhe bhèni dhu pa'èci rèdhi mèka dènge dhèu mone leo-èmu, nèngu ad'u-ue boe sasala ngaa-ngaa. te ngaa sanèd'e, dhèu dhu paleo èmu, bèli-camèd'a paraga dènge j'aj'èra rupa-rupa ètu rai-haha ne. dad'èi ja'a sèna ka miu baku susa sèmi èèna.

source_text: my fellow believers, this is what i mean: there is not much time left before christ returns. so, from now on those men who are married should devote themselves to serving the lord as much as they would if they were not married.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! madhutu ngangee ja'a, nuka: lod'o oe èle rai-haha ne dètu ae le. de mone dhu dènge dhèu èmu, mage ladhe dhoka dhèu èmu nèngu di, te ngaa laladhe kahèi asa lamatua.

source_text: those who are sad should devote themselves to serving the lord as much as they would if they were not sad. those who are rejoicing should devote themselves to serving the lord as much as they would if they were not joyful.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe abhu dhu tangi, be'a risi pa'èra d'ara ho baku tangi, sèna ka laladhe asa ama lamatua. ladhe abhu dhu karej'e-karae, be'a risi baku karej'e seli, te ngaa laladhe asa ama lamatua. ladhe abhu dhu hèli ngaa-ngaa, be'a risi tao mamuri na nuka sèmi dhèu dhu dènge boe unu, sèna ka laladhe asa ama lamatua.

source_text: those who are buying things should devote themselves to serving the lord as much as they would if they did not possess those things. because this world as it exists now will soon be gone, those who are actively involved in the affairs of this life should not devote all their time to be involved in those things.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhu pake mèdha-panyau nèti rai-haha ne, be'a risi tao ngi'u na, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu mamuri na dhu maena boe mi mèdha-panyau rai-haha ne, sèna ka na laladhe dhoka asa ama lamatua di. lula j'ara mamuri rai-haha ne bèli-camèd'a ele.

source_text: another reason why i encourage you to remain unmarried is that i desire that none of you be anxious about the everyday affairs of this life. unmarried men are able to be primarily concerned about serving the lord jesus and trying to please him.
target_text: ja'a d'èi sèna ka miu baku pangee ae-ae. te dhèu dhu leo boe èmu, lod'o nèngu ae ho na tao madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. sèna ka nèngu bisa tenge j'ara ho sab'a pakarej'e d'ara lamatua.

source_text: but married men are often greatly concerned about the affairs of this life. specifically, they are concerned about pleasing their wives. so their thinking is divided. unmarried women are able to be concerned about serving the lord. they want to set apart their minds and their bodies for serving the lord. but married women are often concerned about the affairs of this life. specifically, they are concerned about how to please their husbands.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu leo le èmu, hud'i taru kira dad'èi rai-haha ne. nèngu kahèi hud'i taru kira ku mi dad'èi ama lamatua, te ngaa nèngu hud'i tenge j'ara ho pakarej'e d'ara dhèu èmu na kahèi. j'ara se'e se ka tao ngangee na j'aj'i mi kajari. sèmi èèna kahèi, bhèni dhu dènge heka dhèu èmu, aa bhèni kalora iisi. rèngu taru kira dad'èi ama lamatua, sèna ka bisa mamuri mola-mèci ètu d'ara dènge ngi'u aae. te ngaa bhèni dhu leo le èmu, d'ara na kajari. nèngu taru kira ka mi dad'èi lamatua, te ngaa na tenge j'ara ho pakarej'e d'ara dhèu èmu na kahèi.

source_text: i am telling you this for your own good. i am not saying it in order to restrict you. instead, i am saying it in order that you may do what is proper and be able to serve the lord without being distracted {things distracting you}.
target_text: ja'a lole j'ara se'e, sèna ka nèti babe'a hia miu. ja'a ko'o boe ho miu lèke sasii. dad'èi ja'a ka, miu tao dhu lèke, aa tangare asa dad'èi ama lamatua, sèna ka ngangee miu baku kajari.

source_text: some of you men have asked about your unmarried daughters. i suggest that if any man thinks that he may be treating his daughter unfairly by keeping her from marrying, and if it is already past the right time for her to get married, and if he thinks that she ought to be married, he should do what he wants to do. he should let her get married. he will not be sinning by doing that.
target_text: ladhe dhèu mone dhu lii d'ai le bhèni dhu d'ai umur paleo èmu, na, hud'i laa ra paleo, ladhe mone ne d'èi heka pamata. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, rèngu tao boe j'ara sala. te ladhe ra mate panèbhu, mage dhoka mone èèna taha nare boe d'ara, hèia nèngu tao j'ara dhu lèke boe.

source_text: but if a man feels absolutely sure that it is better that his daughter not get married, and if nothing is forcing her to get married, and if he is free to do what he decides to do on the matter, if he decides that his daughter should not get married, he is doing what is right in keeping her from marrying.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe mone ne bisa taha nare d'ara, nèngu baku laka-seti ho kab'i lai-lai. te ne'a ngaa dhu nèngu neo tao. masi ka nare nèbhu, dènge boe ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: so any man who decides that his daughter should get married is doing what is good, but if he decides that she should not get married, he is doing something even better. or, some of you men have asked about the women to whom you are engaged to marry. if any man thinks that he may be treating that woman unfairly by not marrying her, and if it is already past the right time for her to get married, and if he wants to marry her very much, he should do what he wants to do. he should marry her. he will not be sinning by doing that. but if a man feels absolutely sure that it is better for him not to get married, and if nothing is forcing them to get married, if he is free to make his own decision on the matter, if he decides not to get married, he is doing what is right. so any man who decides that he should get married to the woman he is engaged to is doing what is good, but if he decides that he should not get married, he is doing something even better.
target_text: de dhèu mone dhu leo dènge bhèni na, èèna be'a. aa dhu leo boe èmu èèna, be'a risi hari.

source_text: women must remain married to their husbands while their husbands are still alive. but if a woman's husband dies, she is free to marry any unmarried man whom she wants to marry, but he must belong to the lord.
target_text: bhèni dhu leo le èmu, pa'èki toke madhe dènge dhèu èmu na. te ngaa ladhe dhèu èmu na madhe, nèngu bisa leo hari dènge dhèu mone leo, sad'i mone ne dhèu dhu parcaya kristus kahèi.

source_text: however, i think that she will be happier if she does not marry again. and i believe that the spirit of god is directing me as i say that.
target_text: madhutu a'abhu ja'a, be'a risi bhèni balu ne, leo ia ka èmu. ja'a pangee, na, lii holo ne cèu nèti roh lamatua dhu ètu d'ara ja'a kahèi.

source_text: now i will answer what you asked about us believers eating meat that has been sacrificed to idols. we know what some of you say, that god has enabled all of us to know the truth about things such as idols. but often we become proud because we say that we know all those things. but instead of being proud about what we know, we should show that we love our fellow believers by helping them to become spiritually mature.
target_text: ja'a neo lole lula-nèti sisi dhu dhèu pake sogo-tagu nidhu. èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti dhu te'a ae le j'ara se'e. dhu j'aj'i mi lii langu, ka ladhe dhèu ne'a ae, na, nèngu bisa nged'e, te na pangee, na, nèngu d'èlu-mèu risi nèti dhèu leo sèra. de be'a risi, èdhi mamuri dènge pasue di. te j'ara pasue ne'e ka tao dhèu aa'i-aa'i asa tabha èra ètu d'ara parcaya ra.

source_text: those who think that they thoroughly know something do not yet know it as they should.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu pangee, na, ne'a mèu, èèna peka na, mamèu nèngu dhae d'ai mèka.

source_text: but as for those who love god, they know that they belong to him.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu sue ama lamatua, tatu lamatua tadhe ne. ne'e ka dhu lèke mola-mola.

source_text: so i will tell you about eating meat that people have sacrificed to idols. we know that it is true, as you say, that idols are not really alive. we also know that there is only one real god.
target_text: de ladhe dhèu na'a sisi dhu sogo-tagu le mi nidhu, èdhi aa'i-aa'i te'a, na, nèngu dhoka pahaha iisi mi mèdha sogo-tagu ètu rai-haha di, te ngaa pahaha boe iisi mi lamatua dhu lèke. te èdhi te'a, na, abhu dhoka ama lamatua èci di dhu lèke aa, mèdha sogo-tagu aa'i-aa'i dhu dhèu sogo-tagu, dènge boe kab'ua.

source_text: it is true that there are gods whom people think live in the heavens or whom they think live on earth. truly, there are many beings that people call gods, and whom they call lords.
target_text: abhu mèdha ae-ae ètu dedha-liru dènge rai-haha ne, dhu dhèu peka, na, ‘lamatua rèngu' do aad'o na, ‘kètu rèngu'.

source_text: but for us believers there is only one real god. he is our heavenly father who created everything. he is the one whom we worship and serve. also, for us believers jesus christ is the one and only lord. he is the one whom god caused to create everything. it is because of what he has done for us on the cross that we have spiritual life.
target_text: te ngaa bagi èdhi, ama lamatua dhoka èci di. nèngu èèna, ama èdhi. aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i nèti nèngu. aa'i-aa'i dhu èdhi tao hia mi nèngu. aa kètu èdhi dhoka èci di, nuka yesus kristus. ama lamatua pake yesus, lod'o na paj'aj'i aa'i-aa'i. aa èdhi mamuri, lula yesus ka dhu hia èdhi.

source_text: nevertheless, some people do not understand that idols are not really alive. in the past, some among you who are believers now were accustomed to believing that idols were really alive. as a result, when they eat such meat now, they still think that it was sacrificed to an idol that is alive. they are not sure that god allows believers to eat meat that has been offered to idols. so, when they eat such meat, they think that they have sinned.
target_text: te ngaa abhu dhèu dhu re'a boe j'ara se'e. rèngu loe boe pangee mèdha sogo-tagu sèra, hèia ngangee rèngu èci èèna ka dènge ngangee rèngu uru sèra. nèti èèna ka, ropa ra'a sisi dhu sogo-tagu nidhu, rèngu pangee, na, nganga'a ne j'aj'i le korban ho pake sogo-tagu nidhu! ladhe ja'a ku'a mèdha ne'e, na, ja'a pa'èki era dènge j'ara-j'ara dhu bhelu! de ne'e ne ka dhu pa'ele iie ngangee rèngu, toke rèngu bisa heka unu ngangee madhera, lula d'ara rèngu èra boe.

source_text: but god will not think more highly about us if we eat certain foods, or if we do not eat certain foods. that is, we are not more acceptable to god if we do not eat certain foods, nor are we more acceptable to him if we eat those foods.
target_text: nga tao ka sèmi èèna? nganga'a bisa boe nèti èdhi asa madha ama lamatua, si? ladhe ta'a boe, èdhi asa boe bhelu, sina ma? aa ladhe ta'a, tao boe èdhi j'aj'i dhèu be'a, si?

source_text: however, be sure that you do not do anything that god allows you to do, if by doing that you would encourage any of your fellow believers to do something that they are not sure god allows them to do. as a result, you would be causing them to sin.
target_text: te ngaa mage-mage! masi ka èu dènge hak sèna ka ad'u-ue madha j'ara èci, tatu boe j'ara ne nèti babe'a hia èu. ladhe sèmi abhu a'ari ca dhèu dhu parcaya èra boe, ladhe nèdhi èu tao j'ara èèna, hèia na manahu, na, èèna be'a boe!

source_text: for example, you know that idols are not really alive. suppose that in a temple where they worship idols you eat food that has been sacrificed to idols. suppose that someone who is not sure whether god allows us to eat that food sees you eating it. you would be encouraging him to eat it, too. rhq
target_text: èu dhu me'a le, j'ara ne j'aj'i boe mi ngaa èci sa. te ngaa ladhe a'ari dhèu parcaya dhu d'ara na èra boe, ladhe nèdhi èu mu'a ètu d'ara èmu sogo-tagu, na pangee sèmi ngaa? tatu na pangee, na, ladhe ja'a ku'a nganga'a sogo-tagu èèna, ngaa-ngaa tao boe, masi ka nganga'a èèna ra pae'a le nidhu.

source_text: as a result, you who know that idols are not really alive, might cause that fellow believer, one for whom christ died, ◄to be ruined spiritually/to stop believing in christ►.
target_text: èu me'a le j'ara ae-ae. te ngaa ladhe èu tao sèmi èèna, èu asa paroe d'ara dhèu dhu èra mèka. aa te ngaa dhèu èèna, a'ari èu dhèu parcaya. kristus madhe hia nèngu kahèi!

source_text: by sinning against your fellow believer by causing him to do something that he thinks god does not allow us to do, it is as though you are sinning against christ himself!
target_text: hua iia pangee sèmi ne'e: ladhe a'ari èu dhu d'ara èra mèka ad'u-ue j'ara èci dhu madhutu ngangee rèngu sala lula tatao èu, na, èu tao le sasala hia rèngu. aa èu tao sasala mi kristus kahèi.

source_text: so if i, paul, think that by eating a certain food i might cause a fellow believer to be ruined spiritually, i will never eat such food again. i do not want to cause any fellow believer ◄to be ruined spiritually/to stop believing in christ►. and you should ◄do as i do/imitate my example►.
target_text: de ladhe ja'a ku'a nganga'a dhu tao a'ari ja'a dhèu parcaya manahu asa d'ara sasala, be'a risi ja'a baku ku'a sisi sèmi sèra, toke d'ai ja'a madhe. te ja'a ko'o boe rèngu manahu asa d'ara sasala.

source_text: i am certainly free to do all the things that god allows me to do. rhq i am an apostle. rhq you certainly know that i have seen jesus our lord. rhq it is a result of my work that you have believed in the lord jesus. rhq
target_text: baku pangee, na, ja'a dènge boe hak ho suri sèmi ne'e hia miu. te ama lamatua pua ja'a laku lole dènge dhèu lula-nèti nèngu. ja'a dhu kèdhi le kètu èdhi, yesus èèna. ja'a dhu pa'èki mèno dènge ne. hèia miu aa'i-aa'i parcaya nèngu kahèi, lula sasab'a-la'a ja'a ne.

source_text: and even though other people may think that i am not an apostle, you certainly should know that i am an apostle. remember that your having become christians met as a result of my telling you about the lord ◄confirms/shows that it is true► that i am an apostle.
target_text: masi ka dhèu leo ro'o boe sèmi rare ja'a j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua, te ngaa tatu miu me'a, na, lamatua ka dhu pua ja'a dhiu peka-padhai lii moa na asa miu. ladhe miu neo me'a mèu, na, lee mamuri miu di. te miu dhu pa'èki era dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus!

source_text: in order to defend myself, this is what i say to those who criticize me by claiming that i do not act like an apostle.
target_text: ja'a neo dhaa mi dhèu dhu pèci sasala mi dedha ja'a, sèmi ne'e:

source_text: as for barnabas and me, we certainly have the right as apostles to receive from you and other congregations food and drink for our work. rhq
target_text: miu ngee, na, ja'a dènge barnabas dènge boe hak ho abhu nganga'a-nganginu nèti dhèu dhu ji'i aj'a-nori si, do?

source_text: we have the same right that the other apostles and the lord jesus' younger brothers and especially peter have. they all take along a wife who is a believer when they travel various places in order to tell people about christ. and they have a right that the people whom they work among will support their wives, too. so barnabas and i certainly have those same rights. rhq
target_text: miu pangee, na, ji'i dènge boe hak ho leo dènge dhèu bhèni kristen, dhu la'a sama-sama pakako sasab'a lamatua ètu era leo, do? madhutu iia-iia na, dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua dhu leo sèra, rèti kahèi dènge dhèu èmu ra. ari lamatua yesus sèra tao sèmi èèna. petrus mesa na sèmi èèna kahèi!

source_text: it would be ridiculous to think that barnabas and i are the only apostles who must work to earn money to pay our expenses while we are doing god's work! rhq
target_text: do, miu ngee na, dhoka ja'a dènge barnabas di dhu hud'i sab'a tenge doi-dhari, sèna ka bisa mamuri ho aj'a-nori dhèu?

source_text: soldiers certainly do not pay their own wages. rhq those who plant a vineyard would certainly eat some of the grapes when they become ripe. rhq those who care for sheep would certainly drink the milk from those sheep. rhq similarly, those who tell others about christ certainly have a right to receive ◄financial help/food► from the people to whom they preach.
target_text: ngangee miu sèmi èèna, mai nèti mia? ladhe sèku sordad'u sèra. rèngu pusi boe hèli nganga'a-nganginu dènge mèdha-papake. ladhe sèku dhèu sab'a ètu oka anggor. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu kai, peka na, èu baku mu'a hua anggor sèra! aa ladhe sèku dhèu madhenga badha. dhèu ne dènge hak ho nare susu nèti kahib'i-kalèbho dhu nèngu j'aga.

source_text: i am saying that, not only because people think that it is right. rhq no, i am rhq saying it because it is what god said in the laws that he gave to moses.
target_text: ja'a padhai lii ne madhutu boe ngangee ja'a dhèu rai-haha ne. te atora sèra nèti ama lamatua dhu peka sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: moses wrote in one of those laws, while an ox is threshing grain, you must not tie its mouth shut so that it cannot eat the grain. ◄god was not only concerned about oxen when he gave that law. /was god only concerned about oxen when he gave that law? ► rhq
target_text: ètu atora musa, dhu suri peka na, ropa sapi j'èli are ho hag'e eele lamusi nèti huri na, baku kape hèb'a na, sèna ka bisa na'a. miu pangee, na, lamatua soro tèke sèna ka dhoka sapi di dhu bisa na'a, do?

source_text: no, he was rhq concerned about us, also! yes, god caused moses to write those words because he is concerned about us! those who plow the ground confidently expect to eat some of the crop that grows. those who thresh grain confidently expect to eat some of the grain that they thresh. similarly, we who proclaim the message about christ have the right to confidently expect to receive financial help for our work. and because we have proclaimed god's message to you, we certainly have the right to receive from you the things that we need for our bodies met! met, rhq
target_text: aad'o! lamatua peka na, nèngu taru kira èdhi kahèi. te dhu suri tèke, peka na, dhèu dhu kabèli rai, aa dhèu dhu hag'e eele lamusi nèti huri na, ropa ra sab'a, rèngu re'a kahèi, èèna na abhu pala ra. sèmi èèna kahèi, be'a risi dhèu pajuu-paleha dhèu kristen sèra, bisa abhu pala nèti rui-j'aj'èra ra. te lod'o ji'i aj'a-nori miu j'ara-j'ara nèti roh lamatua èèna, ji'i nuka sèmi ca dhèu sab'a oka-tedhe dhu sèle hini. de lod'o ji'i aj'a ngare, ladhe ji'i abhu nganga'a-nganginu do ngaa hari nèti miu, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. te j'ara na sèmi èèna ka!

source_text: since other people who preached to you had that right, certainly barnabas and i have the same right. rhq however, neither of us insisted that you give us the things that we have a right to receive from you. instead, we were willing to endure anything in order that we not hinder anyone from believing the message about christ.
target_text: dhèu leo dhu aj'a-nori miu, dènge hak sèna ka abhu dhua-èi dènge mèdha-panyau nèti miu, si? aa ji'i tasamia? ji'i dènge hak risi eele nèti rèngu! te ngaa miu me'a le. ji'i se pake ngèdhi boe hak ho laka-seti miu. ji'i pa'èra ètu rupa-rupa j'ara, sèna ka baku magee miu. te, dènge j'ara ne'e, miu d'èi nanene lii lolo be'a yesus kristus dhu ji'i peka-padhai dènge miu.

source_text: you should keep in mind that the priests and servants in the temple eat some of the food that people bring to the temple. rhq specifically, the priests who work at the altar eat some of the food that the people bring to sacrifice on the altar.
target_text: pangee ku laa! ama-ama agama dhu sab'a ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi, mamuri nèti persembahan dhu dhèu rèti. aa dhèu dhu sab'a ètu mei korban, ra'a sisi nèti badha dhu dhèu rèti.

source_text: so the lord has commanded that those who proclaim the good message about him should receive from those who hear that message what they need to live on.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, lamatua dhu moa, na, dhèu dhu sasab'a ra peka-padhai lii lolo be'a kristus, rèngu bisa mamuri nèti rui-j'aj'èra nèti sasab'a-la'a ra. dhu lèke kèna.

source_text: however, i have not requested that you give me those things that i have a right to receive from you. furthermore, i am writing this to you, not in order to request you to begin giving me financial help now. i would rather die than to receive help from you. i do not want anyone to prevent me from boasting about my proclaiming god's message to you without receiving financial help from you.
target_text: masi ka ja'a dènge hak ho mamuri sèmi èèna, te ngaa ja'a d'èi boe tao sèmi èèna. ja'a suri boe sasuri ne sèna ka miu hia ja'a ngaa-ngaa. nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ja'a pakako sasab'a lamatua hia miu, te ngaa manèngi boe ngaa-ngaa nèti miu. de hua iia risi ja'a madhe, ladhe dhèu pangee, na, ja'a manèngi ngaa-ngaa nèti miu.

source_text: when i proclaim the message about christ, i cannot boast about doing it, because christ has commanded me to do it. i would be very miserable or, i am afraid that god would punish me if i did not proclaim that message.
target_text: masi ka ja'a lole taruu dènge dhèu lula-nèti lii lolo be'a lamatua, te ngaa èèna j'aj'i boe mi ngaa sa èci, dhu ja'a bisa padedha iisi. ja'a hud'i lole ku dènge dhèu lula-nèti lamatua, te lamatua ka dhu pua ja'a sèmi èèna. ladhe ja'a sab'a boe madhutu sasab'a ja'a, na dui kore j'aj'èra! te tatu pasae kore hahuku.

source_text: if i had decided by myself to proclaim it, god would reward me. but i did not decide by myself to do that. i am simply doing the work that god entrusted to me.
target_text: ladhe ja'a sab'a sasab'a ne lula madhutu dhoka dad'èi ja'a mesa ku, na, ngaa dhu ja'a abhu sèra, nuka sèmi gaji dhu dhèu sab'a sèra abhu. te ngaa ladhe ja'a sab'a sasab'a ne, lula lamatua pua ja'a, èèna leo. te lamatua lèka ja'a ho j'aga mèdha-panyau na dhu kab'ua.

source_text: so perhaps you wonder what my reward is. rhq i will tell you. when i proclaim the good message about christ, i do not ask people for financial help. it makes me very happy not to ask for help, and being happy is the reward i get. i do not want to use the rights that i have when i proclaim the gospel.
target_text: de ladhe sèmi èèna, upa ja'a ngaa? ja'a parluu boe gaji. ja'a padhue-padhai lii lolo be'a lamatua, dhu manèngi boe ngaa-ngaa. ne'e ka dhu tao ja'a karae, nuka sèmi ja'a abhu le upa. de masi ka ja'a unu rupa-rupa hak, nuka sèmi dhèu leo dhu sasab'a ra padhue-padhai lii lolo be'a èèna, te ngaa ja'a pake aa'i boe hak sèra.

source_text: i am not obligated to do what anyone else thinks that i should do. nevertheless, when i have been with any group of people, i have made myself do what they believed that i should do, just like a slave does what his master wants him to do. i have done that in order that i might convince more people to trust in christ.
target_text: ja'a ne, dhèu bebas dhu sab'a madhutu dad'èi d'ara ja'a. dhèu dènge boe hak ho pua ja'a tao ne'e, do, tao èèna. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ja'a tao ngi'u nuka sèmi ènu, ho dhèu aa'i-aa'i abhu hak ho paleha ja'a. dènge j'ara ne, ja'a bisa soru-bara dhèu ae, sèna ka ra madhutu ama lamatua taruu.

source_text: specifically, when i was with fellow jews, i did the things that jews think that people should do. i did that in order that i might convince some of them to trust in christ. although i am now not obligated to obey the jewish laws and rituals, when i was with those who believe that they are obligated to obey those laws, i did the things that they think that people should do. i did that in order to convince some of them to trust in christ.
target_text: de ladhe ja'a pa'èci dènge dhèu yahudi, na, ja'a tao iisi sèmi dhèu yahudi, sèna ka soru-bara dhèu yahudi ho ra tadhe lamatua. ladhe ja'a pa'èci ka dènge dhèu dhu kèpe pa'èra atora lamatua, ja'a tao madhutu atora lamatua, ho ja'a bisa soru-bara si, sèna ka ra tadhe mèu lamatua, masi ka ja'a ke'a, na, tao madhutu atora èèna, bisa boe pabe'a ja'a dènge lamatua.

source_text: when i was with ◄non-jews/those who do not know those laws►, i did the things that non-jews think that people should do, in order that i might convince some of them to trust in christ. i do not mean that i disobey god's laws. no, i obey the things that christ commanded us to do.
target_text: ladhe ja'a pakaboko dènge dhèu dhu re'a boe atora lamatua, ja'a j'aj'i sèmi rèngu ho lere kèti si asa lamatua. ja'a patabuli boe atora lamatua dhu na hia mai re musa, te ngaa ja'a mamuri pake atora kristus

source_text: when i was with those who doubt whether god will permit them to do certain things that others ◄disapprove of/think it is not right to do►, i avoided doing those things, in order that i might convince some of them to trust in christ. in summary, i have done all the things that the people i have been with think that others should do, in order that by every possible means i might convince some of them to trust in christ.
target_text: dènge dhèu dhu d'ara èra boe, na, ja'a tao iisi sèmi dhèu dhu d'ara èra boe kahèi, ho ja'a bisa pamako si sèna ka mai asa ama lamatua. dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, ja'a tao iisi sèmi rèngu, sèna ka, ladhe bisa, kèti cahag'e asa madha lamatua.

source_text: i do all these things in order that more people will believe the message about christ, and in order that i, along with other believers, may receive the good things that god promises to give us.
target_text: ja'a tao j'ara aa'i-aa'i se, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa lèka lii lolo be'a lamatua. dènge j'ara ne'e, èdhi bisa abhu pala dhu be'a nèti madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i, dhu lamatua hia èdhi.

source_text: when people run in a race, they all run, but only one of them wins the race and as a result gets a prize. you certainly know that rhq. so, just like runners exert themselves fully to win a race met, you should exert yourselves fully to do the things that god wants you to do, in order that you may receive the reward that god wants to give you.
target_text: ja'a pakasame dènge pa'uji rai. dhèu ae-ae madhutu pa'uji rai, te ngaa dhu abhu juara dhoka dhèu èci di. de miu èci-èci mi hud'i rai pa'èra-èra ku ho j'aj'i juara hia lamatua.

source_text: all athletes exercise their bodies strenuously in many ways. they do that in order to receive a wreath as a reward to wear on their heads. those wreaths fade, but we will receive a reward that will last forever lit.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhutu pa'uji, hud'i madhutu ku paredha nèti dhèu dhu aj'a rèngu, si? dhèu se sab'a bia sèmi èèna, lula neo abhu solo juara dhu bèli-camèd'a ele iie. te ngaa èdhi sab'a sèna ka abhu upa dhu taha toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: for that reason, i try hard to please god met, like a runner who runs toward the goal lit. i try hard to accomplish what god wants me to accomplish, like a boxer tries hard to hit his opponent, not to miss hitting him.
target_text: de ja'a rai leli boe. te ngaa ja'a tenge j'ara ho rai pa'èra-èra toke d'ai lane. ladhe pasoro ja'a sèmi dhèu tuka paj'ubhu, na, ja'a j'ubhu leli boe, te ngaa hud'i j'ubhu palèke ku.

source_text: i beat my body to make it do what i want it to do met, as slaves obey their masters, in order that, after i have proclaimed god's message to others, he will not say that i do not deserve to receive a reward.
target_text: ja'a pa'èra d'ara, aa aj'a ngi'u sèna ka bisa taha taruu. te be'a boe ladhe ja'a peka dènge dhèu leo lula-nèti ama lamatua, aa te ngaa ja'a mesa ku sisu atora, hèia lamatua kalua eele ja'a nèti d'ara pa'uji rai èèna.

source_text: my fellow believers, i want to remind you about ourexc jewish ancestors. they were all under the cloud by which god miraculously led them and protected them when they left egypt with moses. all those ancestors crossed the red sea after god miraculously made the water separate so that they could walk through it.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! mage miu bhèlu eele lii lolo dhu uru èèna, lod'o bèi-baki èdhi ètu era dhu dhèu pea boe. ama lamatua paj'uj'u j'ara hia rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, pake ra'i-liru dhu kako uuru nèti rèngu. aa ama lamatua hag'e eele èi dhasi, hèia ra kako d'ai cabèka dhasi dènge sod'a.

source_text: god caused all of them to begin to live under the authority of mty moses when they walked under that cloud and walked through the red sea.
target_text: dhasi dènge ra'i-liru se, nuka sèmi lii pakasame sa. te bèi-baki èdhi sèra lèka musa nuka sèmi ama ho lere si, ka ra madhutu ra'i-liru, aa maso asa d'ara dhasi palere-lere dènge ne. èèna sama sèmi èdhi dhu parcaya kristus hèia abhu sarani, dhu peka na, èdhi j'aj'i dhèu unu na, aa ti nanene ne.

source_text: all those ancestors of ours ate the same food that god miraculously provided.
target_text: bèi-baki èdhi aa'i-aa'i ra, ra'a nganga'a dhu roh lamatua sadia tèke hia ra.

source_text: they all drank water that god miraculously provided. that is, they all drank water that god miraculously made come out of the rock. that rock was a symbol of met christ, who went with them. so we conclude that god helped all of those people in many ways.
target_text: aa rinu nèti èi dhu roh lamatua sadia hia ra kahèi. èi dhu rinu èèna kalua nèti hadhu aae dhu roh lamatua paj'uj'u tèke. rèngu lasi asa mia-mia èèna ka, hadhu èèna dhu ètu èèna le. madhutu iia-iia na, hadhu èèna, nuka kristus.

source_text: however, we also conclude that god was angry lit with most of those people because they sinned against him. he caused almost all of them to die, and as a result their bodies were scattered in the desert.
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua d'èi boe dènge tatao dhèu ae sèra. ka ropa ra kako palème era mamoo dhu taleo èèna, dhèu ae madhe. ka ra padhane si palème era.

source_text: those things that happened long ago became examples to teach us the following things: we should not desire to do evil things as those people desired to do.
target_text: j'ara aa'i-aa'i se ho j'aj'i mi conto, sèna ka èdhi baku d'èi tao j'ara bhelu sama sèmi rèngu.

source_text: we should not worship idols as many of those people did. remember that moses wrote, the people sat down. they ate and drank to honor the golden calf that they had just made. then they got up to dance immorally.
target_text: baku pae'a nidhu sèmi rèngu cahag'e. ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, dhu suri, peka na, dhèu isra'el madhèdi ra'a-rinu pesta ètu madha patung sapi iiki ci'u. ka ra sogo-tagu ne.

source_text: we should not have sexual relations with someone to whom we are not married, as many of them did. as a result, god punished them by causing 23, 000 people to die in only one day.
target_text: èdhi baku tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu-kamali boe èdhi. te uru-uru sèra, rèngu tao j'ara makae sèmi sèra ka, hèia dua nguru tèlu riho dhèu madhe ètu d'ara ca lod'o doko èèna ka.

source_text: we should not try to see how much we can sin without the lord punishing us. some of them did that, and as a result they died because poisonous snakes bit them.
target_text: èdhi baku ad'u-ue bhabhelu rupa-rupa, ho neo te'a, kristus huku èdhi, do aad'o. te dhèu isra'el cahag'e neo sèku ama lamatua sèmi èèna ka, ka na hia mege ae-ae dhu dènge raco sèna ka kadhi pamadhe si.

source_text: we should not complain about what god does. some of them did that, and as a result an angel destroyed them. so god will certainly punish us if we sin like they did.
target_text: èdhi baku ka'uu-kamuki kahèi. te dhèu isra'el cahag'e re'a dhoka ka'uu-kamuki di, ka ama lamatua pua ana pajuu na èci nèti sorga mai pamadhe si.

source_text: all those things that happened to our ancestors long ago are examples for us. moses wrote those things to warn us who are living at this time which is near the end. we are the people for whom god has done the things that he decided to do in the previous periods of time.
target_text: j'ara ne lèke mi dhèu isra'el, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha hia mi èdhi. ra suri se'e se, ho èdhi bisa te'a, sèna ka baku tao madhutu sasala rèngu. te lod'o èle rai-haha ne dètu ae le.

source_text: so i say this to all those who confidently think that they will always steadfastly continue to believe what god said and will never disobey what he commanded: be careful that you sg do not sin when you are tempted.
target_text: sanèd'e paie! limuri ne èu ngee, na, èu èra le. te ngaa baku pamud'e, sèna ka baku manahu.

source_text: remember that your desires to sin are the same desires that other people have. but when you are tempted to sin, you can trust god to help you. he will not permit you to be tempted {anything to tempt you} more than you are able to resist. instead, when you are tempted {things tempt you}, he will also provide a way for you to endure it without sinning.
target_text: lod'o-lod'o ngee mèdhi neo tao bhabhelu, te ngaa sanèd'e, te dhèu leo dhu paraga rèdhi le kahèi, dadugu-rariu sèmi sèra. te ngaa èu bisa parcaya ama lamatua, sèna ka na tao madhutu ngaa dhu nèngu peka. te lamatua soro tèke boe èu ho abhu dadugu-rariu risi nèti a'èra èu. ropa èu paraga dènge dadugu-rariu, nèngu pad'elo j'ara kalua hia èu. nèngu neo pa'èra èu, ho baku manahu.

source_text: so, i say to you people whom i love, avoid worshipping idols just like you would run away from anything that is dangerous.
target_text: de a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! ladhe dhèu neo laka-seti miu sèna ka sogo-tagu nidhu, na, pakeso nèti era èèna! baku pamata!

source_text: it is to people who think that they are wise that i write. so, you, as wise people, judge whether what i am writing is true.
target_text: ja'a padhai lii dènge miu dhu me'a ngee madhera. hud'i laa miu mesa mi dadoo unu mi, ngaa dhu ja'a neo peka-padhai èèna, lèke tare'a.

source_text: during the lord's supper, after we ask god to bless ◄the wine/the juice► in the cup, we give thanks for it and drink it. by doing that, we certainly are rhq sharing in what christ did for us when his blood flowed from his body when he died. during the lord's supper, when we break the bread and eat it, we are certainly sharing in mty what christ did for us when his body suffered for us on the cross. rhq
target_text: pangee sèku j'ara ne: ladhe èdhi pakaboko sèna ka ta'a-tinu ètu mei ama lamatua, hèia tare galaa ho manèngi makasi mi lamatua, ka tinu nèti galaa èèna, sasoa na, èdhi dhu pa'èki dènge kristus. ropa na pasuti raa na ka na madhe, èèna sama sèmi èdhi madhutu madhe kahèi. ladhe èdhi pamae roti èèna, hèia ta'e, sasoa na, èdhi dhu pa'èki dènge kristus. de ropa kristus madhe, èèna sama sèmi èdhi kahèi madhe sama-sama dènge ne.

source_text: because it is one loaf of bread that we break and eat during the lord's supper, it symbolizes that we who are many are one group, because we all eat from the one loaf.
target_text: èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti ta'e nèti roti cue. de aa'i-aa'i dhu rare pala nèti roti cue ne, nuka sèmi èdhi dhu pa'èki j'aj'i mi ngi'u èci, masi ka èdhi dhèu ae-ae.

source_text: consider what happens when the israeli people eat the food that the priests sacrifice on the altar outside the temple. they participate in what the priests do at mty the altar. rhq similarly, if you eat food that non-believers have offered to an idol in a temple, you are participating in their worship of the idol there.
target_text: pangee sèku dhèu isra'el uru sèra. ropa rèngu roro badha ètu dedha mei korban sèna ka pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua, ama agama dhu roro ne ka dhu bisa na'e sisi èèna. sasoa na, rèngu pa'èki dènge lamatua, aa pa'èki kahèi dènge dhèu dhu rèti badha ho j'aj'i mi korban.

source_text: by saying that, i do not mean that offering food to an idol makes it anything more than just ordinary food rhq. i do not mean that an idol is anything more than just an idol. no! instead, i mean that what people sacrifice to idols, they are sacrificing to demons, not to god. so, if you eat food that has been sacrificed to idols, you are participating in worshipping the demons that the idols represent. and i do not want you to participate in worshipping demons!
target_text: madhutu a'abhu ja'a, tasamia? lod'o dhèu dhu tadhe boe lamatua neo hia mèdha-panyau rèngu j'aj'i mi mèdha sogo-tagu ra, èèna dènge boe kab'ua, do? te mèdha sogo-tagu sèra, dhoka patung dhu madhe di! aad'o! a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: lod'o dhèu roro badha ho j'aj'i badha sogo-tagu, rèngu sogo-tagu nidhu bhelu. te ngaa rèngu pahaha boe iisi mi ama lamatua dhu lèke. de ja'a ko'o boe ho miu pa'èki dènge nidhu bhelu sèmi sèra.

source_text: when you drink the grape juice/wine in mty the cup at the lord's supper, you cannot participate in the blessings that the lord jesus brought to us and at the same time drink the wine in the mty cup that people offer to demons! when you eat at the lord's table, you cannot participate in the blessings the lord provided mty when he died for us and at the same time participate in the things that represent demons by eating food that has been sacrificed to idols
target_text: ladhe miu pa'èki dènge lamatua, ka minu nèti galaa ètu mei lamatua, na, miu bisa boe pa'èci dènge nidhu bhelu sèra, aa baku minu nèti galaa dhu ra pake pae'a nidhu. te ladhe miu minu sèmi èèna, sasoa na, miu pa'èki dènge nidhu bhelu. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe mi'a ètu mei lamatua, miu bisa boe mi'a ètu mei nidhu. goa, ee! te sasoa na, miu pa'èki dènge nidhu bhelu sèra!
