source_text: if you participate in honoring demons in that way, you will certainly make the lord very angry rhq! ◄remember that you are certainly not stronger than he is. /do you think that you are stronger than he is? ► rhq certainly not, so you will not escape his punishing you if you honor demons in that way!
target_text: madhutu a'abhu miu sèmi ngaa? neo papèd'a d'ara lamatua èdhi, do? èèna bahaya! ele boe miu ngee, na, miu èra risi lamatua, do?

source_text: some people say, god permits believers to do anything. but i say that not everything that people do benefits those who do it! yes, some people say, god permits believers to do all things. but not everything that people do helps them to become spiritually mature.
target_text: ele boe miu pangee, na, ja'a neo tao ngaa èèna ka, bisa. te èèna hak ja'a. tare'a. te ngaa sanèd'e, tatu boe j'ara aa'i-aa'i sèra nèti babe'a hia èu. aa tatu boe j'ara aa'i-aa'i sèra, bisa soru-bara èu ho pa'èra d'ara mu.

source_text: no one should try to benefit only himself. instead, each person should try to benefit other people spiritually.
target_text: baku tenge dhoka leto pala ngi'u èu di. be'a risi tenge oto hia dhèu leo kahèi.

source_text: this is what you should do: eat any food that is sold {that people sell} in the market. do not ask questions to find out if that food has been offered {someone offered that food} to idols, just because you think it would be wrong to eat such food.
target_text: de ja'a manèngi sèmi ne'e: ladhe hèli sisi ètu d'ara pasa, na, mu'a laa. baku pakarèi ia ka, peka na, sisi pae'a nidhu, do? do pangee, na, ja'a bisa ku'a sisi ne, do aad'o?

source_text: remember that the psalmist wrote, everything on the earth belongs to the lord god because he created it! so, food that has been offered to idols belongs to the lord, not to the idols, and you may eat it.
target_text: lula ètu d'ara sasuri lamatua dhu suri tèke, peka na, rai-haha dènge isi na aa'i-aa'i, unu lamatua èdhi.

source_text: if a non-believer invites you to a meal, go if you want to, and eat any food that is set {that he sets} before you. do not ask whether it was offered to idols, just because you think that it would be wrong to eat such food.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu parcaya mèka kristus nèru miu, peka na, mai lati ta'a asa èmu ja'a! ladhe miu lami, na, mi'a ngaa dhu na hia miu. baku pakarèi ia ka, na, ja'a bisa ku'a nganga'a ne'e, do aad'o?

source_text: but if someone says to you, this is food that was sacrificed to an idol, do not eat it, for the sake of the person who told that to you, and also because someone there may think that it is wrong to eat such food.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe abhu dhu mai paka'uu, peka na, baku mu'a ne'e ne, te sisi ne sisi sogo-tagu nidhu, be'a risi èu baku mu'a. èu hud'i taru kira ku mi dhèu dhu mai peka lii deo na, ho baku pabia ne.

source_text: i do not mean that you should be concerned about whether it is all right to eat such food. what i mean is that you should be concerned about others who may think that it is wrong to eat such food. since i know that i ◄am free/have the right► to eat such food without god punishing me, no one should rhq say that what i am doing is wrong just because he himself thinks that it is wrong.
target_text: a'abhu ja'a, na, pangee paie-iie, madhutu ngangee dhèu deo na, bisa ku'e do aad'o. baku ngee dhoka dhu be'a madhutu ngangee èu mesa mu. aa te ngaa, ja'a bisa tao madhutu d'èi d'ara ja'a. te ngaa ladhe dhèu leo pangee, na, be'a boe ladhe nèngu ad'u-ue ca madha j'ara, nga tao ka ja'a bebas boe sa hèi tao madhutu dad'èi d'ara ja'a, lula be'a boe bagi mi dhèu leo?

source_text: if i thank god for the food when i eat food that has been offered to an idol, no one should criticize me for eating food for which i have thanked god rhq!
target_text: ladhe ja'a manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, hèia ja'a ku'a, na, nga tao ka dhèu padhai pamanahu ja'a?

source_text: so i say to you in conclusion, when you eat food, or drink something, or do anything else, do everything in order that people will praise god.
target_text: de miu neo mi'a do, minu do, tao ngaa èèna ka, na, tao aa'i-aa'i sèna ka pakapai kolongara ama lamatua.

source_text: do not do anything that would hinder jews or greeks from becoming believers, and do not do things that would encourage members of god's congregations to sin.
target_text: baku pasusa dhèu yahudi, do dhèu yahudi boe, do dhèu unu lamatua dhu parcaya sèra.

source_text: do as i do. i try to please everyone in every way. i do this by not seeking to benefit myself. instead, i try to benefit many others, in order that they may be saved {that god may save them} from the guilt of their sins.
target_text: tao nuka sèmi ja'a tao. te ja'a neo cob'a pakarej'e si ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra. ja'a mesa boe tao dhu be'a hia ja'a di, te ngaa neo tao dhu be'a bagi rèngu aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka rèngu abhu sod'a kahèi.

source_text: follow my example, just like i try to follow christ's example.
target_text: miu ladhe mi ja'a, aa tao madhutu j'ara mamuri ja'a. te ja'a ladhe mi kristus, aa tao madhutu tatao nèngu.

source_text: i praise you because you remember all the things that i taught you and because you follow the instructions that i gave you. you have done just like i told you to do.
target_text: ja'a koa-kad'iri miu, lula tasamia èèna ka miu sanèd'e taruu ja'a. aa j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a aj'a-nori le miu, miu tao madhutu era. be'a titu kèna!

source_text: now, i want you to know that the one who has authority over mty every man is christ, and the ones who have authority over women are men or, their husbands, and the one who has authority over christ is god.
target_text: te ngaa ca j'ara dhu ja'a neo pasanèd'e miu nuka: baku bhèlu j'aj'aj'i miu nèti mia. dhèu mone dhu parcaya sèra, kèni na nèti kristus, dhu j'aj'i kètu ra. dhèu bhèni j'aj'i nèti dhèu mone. aa kristus mai nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: so if any man wears a covering over his head when he prays or speaks a message god gave him, he disgraces himself syn.
target_text: dhèu mone baku pahutu kètu na lod'o nèngu manèngi-mangaj'i, do, ropa na peka-padhai lii moa lamatua. te èèna sama sèmi nèngu pamakae kristus, lula ne'a boe pakab'ua madhutu ad'a èdhi.

source_text: also, if any woman does not wear a covering over her head when she prays or speaks a message that god gave her, she disgraces herself or, she dishonors her husband. that would be acting like sim women who are ashamed because their heads have been shaved.
target_text: te ngaa bhèni hud'i pahutu kètu na lod'o sabaj'a, do ropa nèngu lole lii moa lamatua. te ladhe aad'o na, èèna sama sèmi nèngu pamakae dhèu èmu na, lula ne'a boe pakab'ua madhutu ad'a èdhi. aa nèngu pamakae ngi'u nèngu unu na, nuka sèmi dhèu bhèni dhu lusu pakahoni kètu na.

source_text: so, if women do not wear coverings over their heads when they pray or speak messages that god gave them, they should let someone shave their heads so that they will be ashamed. but since women are ashamed if someone cuts their hair short or shaves off their hair, they should wear coverings over their heads when they pray or speak messages that god gave them.
target_text: te ladhe abhu dhèu bhèni dhu d'èi boe pahutu kètu na, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha nèngu pakab'ua dhèu èmu na, be'a risi nèngu g'ute pabab'a rèu kètu na. te ngaa ladhe nèngu rasa kètu na kahoni pamakae nèngu, hua iia nèngu pahutu kètu na.

source_text: men should not wear coverings over their heads when they pray or speak messages that god gave them, because they represent what god is like met and they show how great god is. but women show how great men or, their husbands are.
target_text: ngee sèku sèmi ne'e: dhèu mone parluu boe hutu kètu na, te ama lamatua paj'aj'i dhèu mone madhutu raropa na. nèti èèna ka, dhèu mone j'aj'i mi hua-hela dhu pad'elo dadedha ama lamatua. aa dhèu bhèni kahèi j'aj'i mi hua-hela dhu pad'elo dadedha dhèu mone.

source_text: remember that god intends that men have authority over women. we know that because god did not make the first man, adam, from the first woman, eve. instead, he made that woman from a bone that he took from the man.
target_text: te lod'o ama lamatua paj'aj'i rai-haha ne, na tao boe dhèu mone nèti dhèu bhèni. te ngaa paj'aj'i dhèu bhèni nèti dhèu mone.

source_text: also, god did not create the first man to help the woman. instead, he created the woman to help the man.
target_text: aa lamatua tao boe dhèu mone hia mi dhèu bhèni. te ngaa na pangèd'u dhèu bhèni mi dhèu mone.

source_text: for that reason, women should wear something to cover their heads as a symbol of their being under their husbands' mty authority. they should also cover their heads so that the angels will see that and rejoice.
target_text: de hua iia risi dhèu bhèni pahutu kètu ho dhèu re'a, na, nèngu pake hak na ho sabaj'a aa lole lii moa lamatua, madhutu j'ara dhu lèke. ana pajuu nèti sorga re'a sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: however, remember that even though god created the first woman from the first man, all other men have been born from women. so men cannot be independent of women, nor can women be independent of men. but all things, including men and women, come from god.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe rèngu pa'èki dènge lamatua, bhèni dènge mone bisa boe èci-èci ka tao unu na. ama lamatua paj'aj'i uuru ku dhèu mone. hèia na paj'aj'i dhèu bhèni nèti dhèu mone. te ngaa èle èèna ka, dhèu bhèni ka dhu nara iisi dhèu mone. aa ama lamatua ka dhu tao aa'i-aa'i, j'aj'i.

source_text: consider this for yourselves: is it proper for rhq women to pray to god while they do not have coverings over their heads?
target_text: miu pangee sèku! ladhe dhèu bhèni pahutu boe kètu ho sabaj'a mi ama lamatua, madhutu a'abhu miu, na, be'a, do aad'o?

source_text: ◄everyone senses that it is disgraceful for men to have long hair. /doesn't everyone sense that it is disgraceful for men to have long hair? ► rhq
target_text: madhutu ad'a miu ètu kota korintus, ladhe dhèu mone rèu kètu madhera, èèna pamakae nèngu, do?

source_text: but it is very delightful if women have long hair, because god gave them long hair to be like a beautiful covering for their heads.
target_text: te ngaa bhèni dhu rèu kètu na madhera, be'a titu kèna, si? lamatua hia ne rèu kètu madhera ho pa'abhe kab'a kètu na. èèna ka dhu lèke mola-mola.

source_text: but whoever wants to argue with me about my saying that women should have a covering over their heads when they pray or speak a message from god should consider the fact that we apostles do not permit any other custom, and the other congregations of god do not have any other custom.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe abhu dhu loe boe pakarèi nèti j'ara ne'e, sanèd'e, te nèti ji'i dhu j'aj'i kètu juma'at, aa nèti juma'at-juma'at, ne'e ne dhu tema le j'aj'i ètu talora èdhi.

source_text: now i want to tell you about some other things. i do not praise you about them, because whenever you believers meet together, good things do not happen. instead, bad things happen.
target_text: limuri ne, ja'a neo padhai lii ca j'ara. te ngaa lii ne koa-kad'iri boe miu. te ropa miu pakaboko, miu tao boe j'ara dhu lèke, te ngaa miu asa tao maruru.

source_text: first of all, people have told me that when you gather together as a group to worship god, you divide into groups that are hostile to each other. to some extent i believe that is true.
target_text: partama, dhu ja'a tadèngi, na, lod'o miu pakaboko tao kasasi, miu dhu mae-manyèla. nèti lii dhu ja'a tadèngi sèra, tatu abhu cahag'e dhu lèke tare'a.

source_text: it seems that you must divide into groups that despise each other in order that it might be clear/evident which people among you god approves of!
target_text: mema, lula mamae-manyèla miu èèna ka, bisa te'a cee ka dhu tare'a-re'a nanene lamatua èdhi, aa mia dhu nanene boe.

source_text: when you gather together, you iro eat the meal that you say is to remember the death of the lord jesus for us.
target_text: te lod'o miu dhèu sarani pakaboko ho mi'a ètu mei lamatua, miu hud'i sanèd'e ku mi lamatua yesus. èèna ka dhu lèke. te ngaa miu tao boe sèmi èèna.

source_text: but what happens when you eat is that each person eats his own meal before he thinks about sharing his food with anyone else. as a result, when the meal is over, some people are still hungry and others are drunk! so it is not a meal that honors the lord.

target_text: lod'o-lod'o miu tao j'ara sèmi ne'e, ho mi'a roti dènge minu nèti galaa sèmi ne'e, toke kristus lèpa hari mai, èèna nuka sèmi miu palolo hari mamadhe na.

target_text: nèti èèna ka, lod'o dhèu ra'a roti dènge rinu nèti galaa èèna, sèna ka sanèd'e kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu d'ara na mola boe dènge dhèu leo, èèna na ama lamatua huku ne. lula, èèna ngi'u dènge raa nèti lamatua yesus. de ladhe d'ara dhu mola mèka, na, nèngu nia boe na'a dènge ninu, lula j'ara èèna pahahe lamatua yesus.

source_text: before any believer eats that bread and drinks that wine mty, he should think carefully about what he is doing,
target_text: be'a risi ca dhèu-dhèu ka parisa uuru ku d'ara na. ladhe d'ara na dhu mola le, heka bisa na'a roti aa ninu èi anggor kèna.

source_text: because if anyone eats the bread that represents christ's body and drinks the wine that represents his blood without recognizing that all god's people should be united, god will punish him for doing that.

source_text: many people in your group are weak and sick, and several have died eup because of the way they acted when they ate that bread and drank that wine.

source_text: if we would think carefully about what we are doing, god would not judge and punish us like that.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe èdhi parisa paie-iie d'ara èdhi, èdhi abhu boe huku sèmi sèra.

source_text: but when the lord judges and punishes us for acting wrongly, he disciplines us to correct us, in order that he will not need to punish us when he punishes the people who do not trust in christ mty.
target_text: ladhe lamatua èdhi huku èdhi, na tao sèmi èèna sèna ka aj'a-nori èdhi ho èdhi madhutu j'ara dhu lèke. te nèngu d'èi boe ladhe èdhi lèke huku sama sèmi dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: so, my fellow believers, when you gather together to eat food to remember the lord's dying for you, wait until everyone has arrived so that you can find out who does not have enough food.
target_text: de a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! ladhe miu pakaboko ho mi'a-minu ètu mei lamatua, èci hud'i mate ku èci.

source_text: those who are so hungry that they cannot wait to eat until everyone else has arrived should eat in their own homes first, in order that when you gather together god will not judge and punish them for ◄being inconsiderate of/not being concerned about► others. and when i come to corinth i will give you instructions about other matters concerning the lord's supper.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhu taha boe manganga, be'a risi mi'a uuru ku ètu èmu, sèna ka ropa miu pakaboko pa'èci, baku abhu dhu lèke huku. j'ara leo dhu miu karèi sèra, pe ja'a dhiu ku, heka ator si kèna.

source_text: now, my fellow believers, i will answer your questions about the things god's spirit enables believers to do. i want you to know clearly lit about these things.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! dad'èi ja'a ka ladhe miu me'a mèu nèti koasa dènge karunya dhu roh lamatua pangèd'u mi èdhi, sèna ka èdhi pake.

source_text: you know that before you became christians, various things led you to worship idols, which are unable to tell you any of god's message.
target_text: miu dhu me'a, na, lod'o miu dhae j'aj'i mèka dhèu unu lamatua, miu sogo-tagu mèdha dhu lii aad'o sèra. miu madhutu rèngu iia-iia d'ara.

source_text: so the first thing that i will tell you now is that it is not the spirit of god who would cause anyone to say, jesus deserved to die, and that the holy spirit is the only one who can enable anyone to say, jesus is truly the lord.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a neo ho miu me'a, na, tatu boe abhu dhèu dhu pa'èki dènge roh mola-mèci ama lamatua, peka na, dhoo-saseo yesus èèna! aa tatu dhèu dhu pa'èki boe dènge roh mola-mèci ama lamatua peka na, yesus èèna, lamatua ja'a!

source_text: there are various things that god's spirit enables various believers to do, but it is that same spirit who enables us to do them.

source_text: there are many different ways to serve the lord, but it is the same lord whom we all are serving.
target_text: dhèu abhu karunya rupa-rupa ho lalau-lalo'o dhèu leo, te ngaa rèngu nanene dhoka lamatua èci di.

source_text: we believers have the power to do various tasks, but it is the same god who gives all of us the power to do these things.
target_text: dhèu unu rupa-rupa sasab'a sèna ka pakako sasab'a lamatua, èèna j'aj'i lula ama lamatua di dhu soru-bara rèngu ho ra pakako sasab'a-la'a sèra aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: god's spirit gives his power to each believer in order to benefit all the other believers.
target_text: ama lamatua pad'elo roh na mi mamuri dhèu dènge j'ara dhu baka-leo hua, te ngaa dad'èi na sèna ka aa'i-aa'i ra sama-sama abhu babe'a.

source_text: to some, the spirit gives the ability to speak very wise messages. to others, the same spirit gives the ability to know things that he reveals to them.
target_text: lamatua pangèd'u koasa roh na mi dhèu unu na. ka cahag'e abhu koasa, sèna ka ngangee madhera ho nori dhu lèke. cahag'e abhu koasa ho peka paled'a ngaa dhu rèngu re'a dènge be'a.

source_text: to others, the same spirit gives the ability to believe that god will work miracles. to others, the spirit gives the ability to heal sick people.
target_text: cahag'e hari abhu koasa sèna ka parcaya pa'èra mi ama lamatua, lula rèngu dhu pa'èki pa'èra dènge roh na. cahag'e hari abhu koasa ho puri-pa'èle dhèu pèd'a.

source_text: to others, he gives the power to perform miracles. to others, he gives the ability to speak messages that come directly from god. to others, he gives the ability to tell if a message is really from god or not. to others he gives the ability to speak messages in languages mty that they have not learned. to others, he gives the ability to tell the meaning of those messages mty.
target_text: cahag'e hari abhu koasa sèna ka tao tadha-tadha malaa dhu pad'elo dadedha ama lamatua. cahag'e hari lole lii moa lamatua mi dhèu unu na. cahag'e abhu koasa sèna ka re'a, roh mia ka mai nèti ama lamatua, aa mia ka dhu aad'o. cahag'e hari, abhu koasa ho bisa padhai lii pake lii leo. aa cahag'e hari, bisa peka sasoa nèti lii sèra.

source_text: it is the same spirit who gives all these abilities. he gives whatever abilities he wants to give, to whatever person he wants to give them.
target_text: te ngaa dhodhoka roh èci di dhu bisa tao rèngu, sèna ka bisa pakako sasab'a-la'a ra. nèngu ne'e ka dhu pangèd'u mi dhèu èci-èci, ka rèngu bisa sab'a madhutu dad'èi roh lamatua èèna.

source_text: although a person's body has many parts, all the parts form just one body dou. it is like that with those who belong to christ.
target_text: ja'a neo pasoro karunya sèra dènge ngi'u dhèu. ngi'u èci, te ngaa bagian na ae-ae. te ngaa bagian se, pa'èki j'aj'i ngi'u èci di. ne'e nuka sèmi dhèu unu kristus sèra.

source_text: when we were baptized {when people baptized us}, the one holy spirit caused us to become one group of believers. it does not matter whether we are jews or non-jews. it does not matter whether we are slaves or not slaves. when we believed in christ, the one spirit came to live met within all of us.
target_text: èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti pa'èki dènge roh èci di. nèti èèna ka, lod'o èdhi abhu sarani, èdhi nuka sèmi ca suku. masi ka èdhi dhèu yahudi, do dhèu yahudi boe, ènu do dhèu bebas, ama lamatua pala hia èdhi roh èci di. èèna nuka sèmi tinu èi dhu hia mamuri nèti madha èi èci di.

source_text: our bodies do not have only one part. they have many parts with various functions.
target_text: tare'a, ngi'u ne nèti boe ca bagian di. te na j'aj'i nèti bagian ae-ae.

source_text: but the truth is that god has put all the parts of our bodies together exactly as he wanted to put them.

target_text: ladhe ngi'u ne dhoka ca bagian di, ngara na ‘ngi'u' boe, sina ma?

source_text: and the parts that we do not think highly of are the parts that we clothe carefully. and we protect carefully those parts that we do not show to people.

target_text: èci èèna ka dènge miu. te miu sama sèmi ngi'u kristus dhu kateme. dhèu parcaya èci-èci nuka sèmi ca bagian nèti ngi'u kristus.

source_text: god has placed apostles in our congregations. apostles are first in rank. next in rank are those who speak messages which come directly from god. next in rank are those who teach spiritual truth. then there are those who have the power to work miracles, those who have the ability to heal sick people, those who have the ability to help others, those who have the ability to govern the affairs of the congregation, and those who have the ability to speak messages in languages mty that they have not learned.
target_text: te ètu talora miu dhèu parcaya, ama lamatua hia koasa sèna ka pakako rupa-rupa sasab'a, nuka: partama, lamatua pua-paleha dhèu cahag'e ho lasi lole lii moa na. ka dua, na pake dhèu cahag'e, j'aj'i dhèu rèti lii padhai nèngu. ka tèlu, na hia dhèu cahag'e d'èlu-mèu ho aj'a-nori dhèu leo lula-nèti nèngu. aa na hia koasa mi dhèu cahag'e, sèna ka bisa tao tadha-tadha malaa ho pad'elo dadedha na. cahag'e hari abhu koasa ho puri-pa'èle dhèu pèd'a. cahag'e hari abhu karunya ho soru-bara dhèu. cahag'e hari abhu karunya sèna ka uri dhèu ho sab'a sama-sama dènge be'a. aa lamatua pangèd'u koasa mi dhèu cahag'e hari, ho bisa padhai pake rupa-rupa lii.

source_text: certainly not all believers are apostles. rhq they all do not have the ability to speak messages that come directly from god. rhq they do not all have the ability to teach spiritual truth. rhq they do not all have the power to work miracles. rhq

source_text: they do not all have the ability to heal people. rhq they do not all have the ability to speak messages in languages mty they have not learned. rhq they do not all have the ability to tell others the meaning of those messages. rhq certainly not!

source_text: but you should eagerly desire to have the abilities that will help other believers the most or, the abilities that god considers to be the most important. but now i will tell you the best way to use the abilities that god's spirit has given you.

source_text: supposing we could speak all the various languages mty that people in the world speak and even speak the language that angels speak. if we did not love others, speaking those languages would be as useless as beating a brass gong or clanging cymbals together.
target_text: ladhe sèmi ja'a bisa padhai lii pake lii aa'i-aa'i, nèti dhèu rai-haha do, lii nèti ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga, te ngaa dènge boe sasue ciki sa ètu d'ara ja'a, kolo-karisi na ngaa? lii padhai ja'a sèra mola mèu lao, sama sèmi babha dhu lii cère-cère, do nuka sèmi dere dhu lii dhèru-dhèru di.

source_text: supposing we had the ability to speak messages that come directly from god, and we could understand the plans that he has not yet revealed to others, and we could know everything about everything, and we believed in god so strongly that we could do impossible things like causing mountains to move. if we did not love others, god would consider all that to be worthless.
target_text: ladhe sèmi ja'a dènge karunya ho lole peka lii moa lamatua mi dhèu unu na, aa dhu ke'a aa'i rahasia, dènge ke'a aa'i j'ara-j'ara dhu dhèu d'èlu-mèu se re'a, aa ladhe lalèka ja'a èra mi lamatua toke ja'a bisa pahari eele ledhe nèti era na, te ngaa ja'a dènge boe sasue ciki sa, na, gaguna na ngaa? rui-j'aj'èra ja'a guna boe mi ngaa èci sa.

source_text: and supposing we would give everything that we own to poor people, and would let others kill us in order that we could boast about sacrificing our own bodies. if we did not love others, we would not get any reward from god.
target_text: ladhe ja'a pahie eele aa'i mèdha-panyau ja'a, ho sèna ka kab'ua ra panga'a dhèu unu aad'o, do, soro ngi'u ja'a sèna ka j'aj'i mi korban, te ngaa ladhe ja'a dènge boe sasue ciki sa, gaguna na ngaa? ja'a dènge boe j'ara dhu tao ja'a nged'e. te sèra sa parcuma! guna boe ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: those who prs truly love others act patiently and kindly toward them. those who prs truly love others are not jealous of them, they do not boast about what they themselves have done, and are not proud.
target_text: te sasue èèna, d'ara taleo. sasue èèna, lii mako. sasue èèna, d'ara kura boe. sasue èèna, padedha boe iisi. sasue èèna, pamone-pabhèni boe.

source_text: those who prs truly love others do not act in disgraceful/disrespectful ways towards them. they do not ◄act selfishly/think only of themselves and what they want►. they do not quickly become angry. they do not keep remembering the bad things that others have done to them.
target_text: sasue èèna, lii sakaa boe. sasue èèna, neo boe pasegi ngi'u unu na. sasue èèna, nasa malai boe. sasue èèna, tèka boe d'ara.

source_text: those who prs truly love others do not rejoice when people do evil things, but they do rejoice when people act righteously.
target_text: sasue èèna, karej'e dènge ngaa dhu lèke, aa d'èi boe bia ca bèka.

source_text: those who truly love others patiently put up withthe faults of others. they do not quickly assume that others have done something bad. they confidently expect that others will act righteously. they patiently endure all their own troubles.
target_text: sasue èèna, taha taruu ètu d'ara madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i. sasue èèna, parcaya taruu. sasue èèna, sanao-maena taruu. sasue èèna, ma'ète boe.

source_text: we should never prs let anything stop us from continuing to love others. as for the ability to speak messages that come directly from god, some day that will come to an end. as for the ability to speak languages mty that we have not learned, that will also come to an end some day. and as for the ability to know things that god reveals to us, that will come to an end some day because it will not be necessary any more.
target_text: sasue dènge boe too-lane. te, ngaa dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua peka le, nèbhu-nèbhu parluu heka. aa dhu dhèu padhai pake lii rupa-rupa, bèli-camèd'a parluu heka kahèi. aa ladhe ngaa dhu dhèu d'èlu-mèu sèra re'a, nèbhu-nèbhu guna heka kahèi.

source_text: god does not reveal everything to us, and we cannot know everything that he knows.
target_text: limuri ne dhu te'a dhoka ciki oo'e di. aa ladhe èdhi j'aj'i dhèu tèti lii padhai lamatua, èdhi peka dhoka j'ara dhu dhae tesa mèka.

source_text: but when everything is perfect after christ returns, things which are not perfect now, such as the abilities which god's spirit gives us, will ◄disappear/come to an end►.
target_text: te ngaa ropa d'ai ka lod'o na, aa'i-aa'i sèra tesa dhe'i-dhe'i. lod'o èèna j'ara-j'ara dhu tesa mèka, guna heka mi ngaa èci sa.

source_text: when we were children, we talked like children talk, we thought like children think, we reasoned like children reason. but when we grew up, we got rid of our childish ways met. similarly, you need to get rid of your childish thinking about the abilities that the spirit has given you.
target_text: conto sèmi: lod'o ja'a ana iiki era, ja'a padhai lii sama sèmi ana iiki. ngangee ja'a sama sèmi mia dhu ana iiki pangee. te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a dhèu ee'a le. nèti èèna ka, tatao ja'a sèmi heka ana iiki.

source_text: in this life we do not understand everything fully. it is like met looking at something indirectly by seeing it in a mirror. but when we get to heaven mty, we will understand everything clearly. it will be like talking to someone face-to-face. now we know only part of everything that god wants us to know. then we will know everything completely, just like god knows us completely.
target_text: conto leo: limuri ne, èdhi tèdhi rango-rango era, dhae mèu iia mèka, nuka sèmi èdhi ladhe asa d'ara tèru dhu ahu. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu pe aa'i-aa'i se mèu aadha-aadha, nuka sèmi èdhi ladhe padètu iiki-iiki ètu madha èdhi. ne'e ne, ja'a ke'a dhoka ciki di. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu bisa ke'a aa'i, nuka sèmi ama lamatua ladhe madhore d'ai adhe-usu ja'a.

source_text: so now there are three things that we must continue to do: to trust in god, to confidently expect to receive what he will give us, and to love others. but the greatest of those three things is loving others.
target_text: de limuri ne, abhu tèlu j'ara dhu èdhi hud'i tao, dhu taha taruu. nuka: èdhi hud'i parcaya taruu lamatua; èdhi sanao-maena taruu, na, pe lamatua ator aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i be'a; aa èdhi hud'i pasue taruu. nèti tèlu j'ara se, dhu dedha risi ka, sasue. lula sasue ka dhu hua risi nèti aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: you must want to love others more than you want anything else. but you should also eagerly desire the abilities that god's spirit gives to believers. and you should desire most of all to have the ability to speak messages that come directly from god mty.
target_text: tenge j'ara sèna ka pasue ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra. te abhu heka j'ara leo dhu dedha risi. aa tenge j'ara kahèi, sèna ka roh lamatua hia miu koasa dènge karunya, ho bisa tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a. aa dhu be'a, nuka, ladhe miu abhu karunya sèna ka lole lii moa lamatua.

source_text: i say that because those who speak messages that come directly from god are speaking in languages that they and the other believers in the congregation know, and so they are able to strengthen them spiritually and to encourage and comfort them. but those who speak in languages mty that they have not learned are not speaking to people. instead, they are only speaking to god. no one understands them. by the power/guidance of god's spirit or, from within their own spirit they speak things that others do not know.
target_text: te ladhe dhèu dhu abhu karunya ho padhai lii pake lii leo, roh lamatua hia ne koasa sèna ka peka paled'a j'ara dhu mèu iia mèka. te ngaa nèngu padhai lii boe dènge dhèu leo, te padhai lii dhoka dènge lamatua di. dhèu dhu pa'èci dènge ne ètu sèra, abhu boe èci sa dhu re'a lii padhai nèngu. te ngaa ladhe dhèu abhu karunya ho lole lii moa lamatua, na, nèngu peka lii moa ne mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu sèra. nèngu pa'èra ku parcaya dhèu mi lamatua, pa'èra d'ara dhèu, aa pakarej'e d'ara dhèu susa.

source_text: those who speak in languages that they have not learned are receiving a blessing for themselves, but those who speak messages that come directly from god are giving a blessing to all the believers in the congregation because they are speaking in a language that the congregation knows.
target_text: dhèu dhu padhai lii pake lii leo, nèngu pa'èra dhoka ngi'u nèngu mesa na di. te ngaa dhèu dhu padhue-padhai lii moa lamatua èèna, nèngu pa'èra dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu pakaboko dènge ne, sèna ka juma'at kateme asa tabha èra.

source_text: i would like you all to have the ability to speak in languages mty you have not learned. but i would like even more for you to have the ability to speak messages that come directly from god. people can speak messages in a language that they have not learned, but if there is no one there who can explain the meaning, that situation is not as helpful to the congregation as speaking messages that come directly from god in the language that the congregation knows.
target_text: dad'èi ja'a, ladhe dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa padhai lii pake lii leo. te ngaa ja'a d'èi risi, ladhe miu bisa lole lii moa lamatua. te dhèu dhu peka lii moa lamatua èèna, guna risi nèti dhèu dhu dhoka padhai pake lii leo di. ladhe padhai pake lii leo, èèna be'a, sad'i abhu dhèu dhu bisa peka paled'a sasoa na. dènge sèmi èèna, lii moa sèra bisa asa pa'èra dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu juma'at, sèna ka re'a mèu.

source_text: my fellow believers, suppose i came and spoke to you in a language that none of you knows and i did not explain the meaning of what i told you. even if i told you something that god had revealed to me, or told you some message that had come directly from him, or taught you something that you needed to know, ◄that certainly would not help you! /how would that help you? ► rhq
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! pangee sèku j'ara ne. ladhe sèmi ja'a dhiu ngad'o miu ho padhai pake lii dhu miu me'a boe sasoa na, miu abhu oto na ngaa? aad'o, si? te ngaa ladhe ja'a padhai lii dènge miu, be'a risi ja'a peka dènge miu dad'èi lamatua. be'a risi ja'a bhoke paled'a j'ara-j'ara dhu uru èèna mèu iia mèka. be'a risi ja'a aj'a-nori miu ho me'a mèu risi hari j'ara sèra. be'a risi ja'a pasanèd'e miu lii holo-nori lamatua. be'a risi aj'a-nori miu. dènge j'ara sèmi sèra, heka miu abhu oto kèna, si?

source_text: it is like lifeless musical instruments, like flutes and harps for example. when they are played, if the notes are not played {if those playing those instruments do not play the notes} clearly, no one will know what tune is being played {what tune they are playing}. rhq
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge alat musiik. se'e se mèdha madhe, te ngaa lii ra rupa-rupa. pake sakino do, sasadhu do, gitar do, ladhe pangèci boe lii na, tatu dhèu re'a boe lii sod'a sèmi ngaa, si?

source_text: if someone playing the trumpet wants to signal that the soldiers should prepare to fight a battle, the soldiers certainly will not get ready if the call to battle is not played {he does not play the call to battle} clearly. rhq
target_text: ladhe lii tèbhe mèu iia boe, na, tasa mera mia sordad'u bisa re'a, na, rèngu hud'i tao ngaa mi musu ra? bisa boe, si?

source_text: it is the same with you! if you do not speak words that other people can understand, ◄no one will know what you are saying. /how will anyone know what you are saying? ► rhq it will be as though you are just speaking to the air!
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge miu. ladhe miu padhai lii, pake lii dhu dhèu bisa boe re'a mèu, èèna nuka sèmi miu padhai lii dènge lai ngèlu. parcuma, te dhèu bisa boe dhane rare lii padhai èu!

source_text: there are many different languages in the world, and all of them convey meaning lit to the people who know those languages.
target_text: ètu rai-haha ne abhu lii ae titu kèna. lii se, èci-èci ka dènge sasoa na.

source_text: but if we do not understand the language that others are speaking, it will be as though they are foreigners to us, and we will be foreigners to them.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe ja'a ke'a boe lii dhèu leo, bagi ja'a lii ne dènge boe kab'ua. ja'a ke'a boe lii rèngu, aa rèngu re'a boe lii ja'a kahèi. ji'i baga taa, aa j'aj'i sèmi dhèu leo rai kara sa.

source_text: so i say this to you: because you are eager to have the abilities that god's spirit gives, earnestly desire those abilities that will do the most to help all the believers in the congregation.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge miu. miu neo abhu karunya dènge koasa nèti lamatua. èèna be'a. te ngaa be'a risi ladhe miu tenge j'ara ho abhu koasa dènge karunya dhu miu bisa pake sèna ka pa'èra dhèu parcaya sèra!

source_text: so, those who have the ability to speak in languages mty that they have not learned should pray that god will give them the ability to explain the meaning of what they say.
target_text: de dhèu dhu padhai pake lii leo, be'a risi nèngu sabaj'a manèngi sèna ka lamatua hia ne karunya kahèi, ho peka sasoa nèti lii leo èèna.

source_text: if they pray in a language mty that they have not learned, their spirits are praying, but they are not using their minds.
target_text: ladhe ja'a manèngi-mangaj'i pake lii leo, ja'a sabaj'a pake d'ara ja'a, te ngaa ja'a ke'a boe ngaa dhu ja'a padhai lii èèna.

source_text: so i will tell you rhq what we should do. at times we may pray, using only our spirits, in languages we have not learned. and at other times we should pray using our minds, thinking about the words that we are praying. similarly, at times we may sing using only our spirits, using languages that we have not learned, and at other times we should sing using our minds, thinking about the words that we are singing.
target_text: de babe'a na, ja'a tao tasamia? ja'a pake dua-dua, te ngaa èci-èci ka dènge lod'o na. ja'a neo manèngi-mangaj'i pake d'ara ja'a, aa ja'a neo manèngi-mangaj'i pake lii dhu ke'a mèu kahèi. ja'a neo sod'a pake lii sod'a koa-kio mi lamatua nèti d'ara ja'a. aa ja'a bisa sod'a kahèi, pake lii dhu ja'a ke'a mèu.

source_text: suppose that any one of you praises god or, thanks god for what he has done, using only your sg spirit and not using your mind. maybe some people will be present who do not know about the abilities that god's spirit gives to believers. because they do not know what you are saying, after you thank god, they will not rhq know when to say amen! /i agree!
target_text: te ladhe èu pake lii leo ho koa-kio ama lamatua nèti d'ara èu, te ngaa abhu dhèu ètu sèra dhu re'a boe lii deo na, tasamia nèngu bisa d'ara èci dènge èu? lod'o èu manèngi makasi mi lamatua pake lii leo, tasamia dhèu èèna bisa nare lii èci dènge èu, ka na peka na, lèke kèna! bisa boe, si? te nèngu ne'a boe lii padhai èu deo na.

source_text: you may be thanking god very well, but you are not helping them.
target_text: èu bisa manèngi makasi sèmi èèna kahèi mi lamatua. te ngaa èèna pa'èra boe d'ara dhèu leo.

source_text: i thank god that i speak in languages mty that i have not learned more than any of you do.
target_text: ele boe miu me'a boe, te ngaa ja'a padhai lii pake lii leo risi nèti miu. aa ja'a manèngi makasi mi lamatua, lula nèngu hia ja'a bisa padhai lii sèmi èèna.

source_text: but during a worship service, in order that others will understand what i am saying, i would prefer to speak five words using my mind, in order that i may teach others, rather than to speak 10, 000 words in a language mty that is not understood by the congregation.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe dhèu parcaya pakaboko, na, be'a risi ja'a padhai lii dhoka lèmi hèb'a dhu bab'a te ngaa re'a mèu, sèna ka aj'a-nori si. te ladhe ja'a padhai lii pamadhera-dhera pake lii leo, dènge pake lii riho-riho hèb'a dhu re'a boe, na, gaguna na aad'o.

source_text: my fellow believers, stop being like little children in the way that you think about these abilities that god's spirit gives. instead, think about them in a mature way. if you really want to be like little children, do as few wicked things as babies do!
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! ladhe miu neo me'a mèu j'ara-j'ara, na, miu hud'i pangee nuka sèmi dhèu ee'a. mage pangee sèmi ana iiki! te ngaa re j'ara bhelu-katub'a, miu hud'i nuka sèmi ana iiki dhu re'a boe tao bhabhelu, lula d'ara ra dhu mèu aadha-aadha.

source_text: when the jews long ago refused to obey god, he warned them about what would happen when he allowed their enemies to punish them. in the scriptures it is written {the prophet isaiah wrote} what the lord god said about that, they didn't listen to prophets speaking their own language, so i will send people from foreign lands to attack my people. those foreigners will speak languages that my people do not know dou. in that way, i will warn my people, but they will still not pay attention to what i say.
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, dhu suri peka na, lamatua èdhi peka, aku nèngu na, ‘ja'a neo pake dhèu dhu padhai lii pake lii leo sèra, ho padhai lii dènge dhèu isra'el. masi ka ja'a peka tasamia èèna ka, te ngaa ro'o boe nanene ja'a. '

source_text: if we speak in languages mty that we have not learned, unbelievers who are there will realize that the spirit of god is truly among us. that will warn them that they need to fear god. but believers do not need such a warning.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ladhe miu paraga dènge dhèu dhu padhai lii pake lii leo, èèna j'aj'i mi tadha hia dhèu dhu parcaya mèka lamatua, sèna ka bisa rèdhi koasa lamatua. j'ara ne'e soru-bara boe dhèu dhu parcaya le kristus. te ngaa ladhe dhèu lole lii moa lamatua, na, ne'e ne ka soru-bara rèngu dhu parcaya le kristus. te ngaa soru-bara boe dhèu dhu parcaya mèka kristus.

source_text: suppose during the worship service everyone started to speak in languages mty that they have not learned. if unbelievers or people who do not know about the abilities that god's spirit gives to believers come in and hear that, they will surely think that you are crazy. rhq
target_text: ladhe sèmi miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu pakaboko, ka miu padhai lii pake lii baka-leo, hèia dhèu dhu parcaya boe, do, dhu ne'a boe j'ara se'e, maso dhiu asa talora aae miu, dhèu se ngee sèmi ngaa sa? tatu ra peka na, dhèu ètu se'e se, huj'u aa'i mèu-mèu!

source_text: but if an unbeliever or someone who does not know about those abilities comes in while all of you believers are one by one speaking messages that come directly from god, everything that you say will show that person that he is a sinner and that god will punish him if he does not turn from his sinful behavior.
target_text: aa ladhe sèmi miu aa'i-aa'i dhu padhue-padhai ho peka paled'a lii moa lamatua, hèia dhèu dhu parcaya boe, do, dhu ne'a mèu mèka j'ara-j'ara se, maso dhiu asa talora miu. tatu dhèu ne, neo nanene lii padhai miu. de, ngaa dhu miu peka-padhai sèra, pad'elo sasala na, toke neo parisa mamuri na d'ai lutu.

source_text: he will realize that god knows the evil things that he has done that, things that other people do not know. then he will kneel down and worship god and say, god is truly among you!
target_text: ka bhabhelu dhu nèngu pahuni ètu d'ara na, èèna na bhoka patalele, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a. ka na patitu kètu urutuu na, ho pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua, peka na, ira ii! tare'a-re'a ama lamatua ètu talora aae miu di!

source_text: so, my fellow believers, i will tell you rhq what i think that you should be doing. when you come together to worship god, some of you may have a hymn to sing. others may have something to teach the congregation. others may have something to say that god has revealed to them. others may give messages in languages that they have not learned. others will explain the meaning of those messages. make sure that all of these things that you do will make the congregation become more mature spiritually.
target_text: de a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! ladhe miu pakaboko, èci-èci ka dènge karunya na. abhu dhu sod'a koa-kio ama lamatua. abhu dhu aj'a-nori dhèu lula-nèti lamatua. abhu dhu peka paled'a j'ara-j'ara lamatua dhu uru èèna pahuni era. abhu dhu padhai pake lii leo. aa abhu dhu bisa peka sasoa nèti lii leo sèra. j'ara aa'i-aa'i se, rèngu hud'i tao ku ho pa'èra parcaya dhèu leo sèra.

source_text: it is all right if two people, or at the most three people, speak in languages mty that they have not learned. but they must speak one at a time, and someone must explain the meaning of what the others have said.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhu d'èi padhai lii pake lii leo, èèna be'a. sad'i dua do tèlu dhèu di, baku pa'ae-ae. dhèu èci padhai lii uuru, èle ku heka dhèu leo kèna. aa hud'i abhu ku dhèu dhu peka sasoa na.

source_text: if those who want to speak in a language that they have not learned realize that there is no one there who will be able to explain the meaning of what they will say, they should not speak in that language during the meeting. instead, they should speak to god by themselves, somewhere else.
target_text: ladhe sèmi abhu boe dhu bisa peka sasoa nèti lii leo èèna, na, baku padhai lii pake lii leo ètu katanga madha dhèu ae-ae. hud'i laa rèngu padhai lii ètu d'ara ra. rèngu bisa padhai lii dènge lamatua sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: during a meeting, two or three people should speak messages that come directly from god, and others who are there should think carefully about what those people have said.
target_text: ladhe miu pakaboko, na, dua do tèlu dhèu di dhu padhai lii, lole lii moa lamatua. dhèu leo hud'i dadoo ku lii padhai nèti dhèu dhu padhai sèra.

source_text: if someone receives a new message directly from god while someone else is speaking, the one who is speaking should stop speaking and let the other person tell what god has revealed to him.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe lamatua bhoke ca j'ara dhu uru èèna mèu iia mèka mi ca dhèu dhu madhèdi nanene ètu èèna, na, nèngu hud'i peka paled'a lii moa ne mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhèdi ètu èèna. aa dhèu dhu padhai lii ètu madha, hud'i ae eele nèti lii padhai na, sèna ka hia dhèu dhu heka tadèngi lii moa lamatua, ho na padhai lii.

source_text: you can all, one by one, speak messages that have come directly from god, in order that you can teach others and all be encouraged {encourage everyone}.
target_text: dhu lèke ka, miu aa'i-aa'i mi bisa lole lii moa lamatua. te ngaa ladhe padhai lii, na, èci uru, ladhe èle heka dhèu leo kèna. dènge j'ara ne, dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa nanene, bisa re'a j'ara, aa bisa pa'èra d'ara ra.

source_text: those who speak messages that come directly from god are in control of their own spirits, so they can wait for their turn to speak.
target_text: sanèd'e, te dhèu dhu lole lii moa lamatua, hud'i ne'a ator ngi'u na. ka èci pamata dènge èci, aa dhèu leo taha uru.

source_text: remember that god does not desire that things be done in a disorderly way during your worship services. instead, he desires that everything be done in an orderly way. just like it happens in all the other congregations of believers,
target_text: te abhu boe maruru ètu ama lamatua, te ngaa mera dènge milu di. ètu mia-mia, ladhe dhèu parcaya pakaboko, hud'i sèmi ne'e ku:

source_text: the women should not be permitted {do not permit the women} to interrupt the meeting by asking questions. they must keep quiet. they must be subject to their husbands. what moses wrote prs about how god created the first two people suggests that the women should do that.
target_text: dhèu bhèni madhèdi mau-mau, bisa boe padhai lii pa'ae. rèngu hud'i nanene kètu juma'at sèra. te atora ama lamatua peka sèmi èèna kahèi, si?

source_text: if they want to know more about something that a speaker said, they should ask their husbands when they get home, for it is disgraceful for women to interrupt a service by asking such questions.
target_text: ladhe abhu bhèni dhu neo karèi j'ara èci, pe d'ai èmu ku heka karèi dhèu èmu na kèna. te ladhe bhèni maruru ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a, sèra sa pamakae iisi ra!

source_text: if you do not agree with these things that i have been telling you, remember that rhq the message from god did not first come from you people in corinth. also, you are not rhq the only ones who have heard it! many others have heard it and accepted it, so you should not act as though you are the only believers who have heard the message from god.
target_text: madhutu a'abhu miu, tasamia? te lii holo-nori ama lamatua mai boe nèti miu. aa lii holo-nori na hia boe miu mesa mi ètu kota korintus di! de pangee paie ku!

source_text: those of you who think that you have the ability to speak messages that come directly from god, or think that you have some other ability that god's spirit gives, should realize that the things that i have written about in this letter are things that the lord has commanded.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu pangee, na, nèngu bisa lole lii moa lamatua, do pangee na, nèngu abhu koasa nèti roh lamatua, na, nèngu ne'a j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a suri hia miu sèra, atora dhu ja'a tao boe, te ngaa paredha nèti kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: but if they are not willing to accept my authority, god will not accept them or, they will not be accepted by the congregation.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu ro'o boe sèmi rare j'ara se, na, miu baku sèmi mere dhèu ne.

source_text: so, my fellow believers, be eager to speak messages that come directly from god, and do not prevent anyone from speaking in a language that he has not learned.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! tenge j'ara sèna ka miu abhu koasa ho bisa peka paled'a lii moa lamatua. aa mage kai dhèu, sèna ka rèngu baku padhai pake lii leo.

source_text: but make sure that everything that you do during the worship services is done in a proper and orderly way.
target_text: de ladhe miu pakaboko, na, pakako aa'i-aa'i madhutu mola-mola. tao uuru ku èci, heka dhu leo kèna. pakako aa'i-aa'i dènge be'a, madhutu madha j'ara na. baku dènge maruru.

source_text: now, my fellow believers, i want to remind you about the message about christ that i preached to you. it is the message that you received and that you have continued to trust firmly.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! ja'a neo sèna ka miu sanèd'e lii lolo be'a lamatua dhu uru èèna ja'a peka-padhai le dènge miu. miu sèmi mere, hèia tao taruu madhutu lii lolo be'a èèna.

source_text: if you keep on firmly believing this message that i preached to you, you will be saved {god will save you}. if you do not continue to believe it, your believing in christ was ◄all for nothing/useless►!
target_text: te lii lolo be'a èèna ka dhu bisa hia miu mamuri, sad'i miu kèpe pa'èra-èra. te ngaa ladhe miu parcaya taruu boe ama lamatua, na, parcaya miu èèna ele iie d'ara.

source_text: the most important part of the message that i received from the lord jesus, and that i told you, was this: christ died to take away the guilt of our sins, as the scriptures said that he would do.
target_text: ja'a aj'a le miu j'ara-j'ara dhu kapai risi eele, dhu uru èèna dhèu aj'a-nori ja'a. nuka: kristus, dhu ama lamatua pua mai èèna, madhe le sèna ka patabuli èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi. j'ara ne'e j'aj'i madhutu sasuri mola-mèci lamatua dhu suri tèke karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: his dead body was buried {they buried his body}. on the third day after that, god caused him to become alive again, as the scriptures said would happen.
target_text: ra padhane ne. ka d'ai camèd'a èèna, lamatua pamamuri hari ne, lèke mola-mola sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu sasuri mola-mèci lamatua.

source_text: after that, christ was seen by {appeared to} peter. then he appeared to eleven of the original twelve apostles.
target_text: èle èèna ka, kristus pad'elo iisi na mi petrus. nèngu pad'elo iisi na mi ana madhutu na dhèu canguru dua sèra kahèi.

source_text: later he was seen by {appeared to} more than 500 of our fellow believers. most of those are still living, but some of them have died eup.
target_text: aa ca tèka, na pad'elo iisi na mi lèmi ngasu risi dhèu parcaya. dhèu aa'i-aa'i se ladhe rèdhi ne dènge musi madha rèngu. nèti rèngu se, ae dhu mamuri era, aa ciki di dhu madhe le.

source_text: then he was seen by {appeared to} his younger brother james, who became the leader of the congregation in jerusalem. then he appeared to all of the apostles.
target_text: ka na pad'elo iisi mi yakobis. hèia nèngu pad'elo iisi kahèi, mi dhèu pajuu-paleha na aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: finally, he was seen by {appeared to} me, but i became an apostle in a way that was very unusual met.
target_text: ja'a dhèu limuri tèka dhu ladhe kèdhi ne. te ja'a ne nuka sèmi ana dhu rara iisi limuri tèka.

source_text: the fact is, i consider that i am the least important of the apostles. i do not deserve to be an apostle, because i ◄persecuted god's groups of believers/caused god's groups of believers to suffer► everywhere i went.
target_text: dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua dhu leo sèra kapai risi nèti ja'a ne. madhutu mola-mola, na, ja'a nia boe j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha na. te uru èèna, ja'a ka dhu paj'èra dhèu unu lamatua ètu mia-mia.

source_text: but it is because god acted kindly toward me in ways that i did not deserve that i became what i am now. and his acting kindly toward me produced a great result lit, which is that i worked harder for christ than all the other apostles. but it was not that i was working with my own ability. instead, god was helping me in a way i did not deserve.
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a. hèia na tao ja'a j'aj'i sèmi ne'e ne. ropa nèngu tao j'ara be'a hia ja'a, na core eele boe lod'o iia d'ara. nèti èèna ka, ne'e ne ja'a sab'a bia risi nèti rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra! ja'a mesa ku boe dhu sab'a, te ngaa d'ara hua iia lamatua ka dhu sab'a ètu mamuri ja'a.

source_text: so it does not matter whether it was i who was preaching or whether it was the other apostles who were preaching. we all preached the same message, and that message is what you believed.
target_text: de ladhe ja'a, do, dhèu pajuu-paleha dhu leo dhu aj'a-nori èèna ka, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. te a'aj'a ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi èèna dhoka ca j'ara di. ji'i peka-padhai taruu lii lolo be'a lamatua mi dhèu. nèti èèna ka, miu j'aj'i parcaya lii lolo be'a dhu sama èèna.

source_text: so now let me ask you this: since we have all preached to you that christ was raised again {that god caused christ to become alive} after he died, ◄no one among you should be saying that god will not cause believers to become alive again after they die! /why do some of you say that god will not cause believers to become alive again after they die? ► rhq
target_text: ji'i tema aj'a-nori, peka na, kristus dhu ama lamatua pua mai èèna, mamuri hari le nèti mamadhe na. de, nga tao ka miu cahag'e peka na, dhèu madhe sèra, mamuri hari boe? ngangee èèna mai nèti mia?

source_text: if it is true that god will not cause anyone to become alive again, that situation would mean that christ was not raised from the dead {he did not cause christ to become alive again}!
target_text: te ladhe dhèu madhe mamuri hari boe, sasoa na, kristus mamuri hari boe kahèi!

source_text: and if christ was not raised from the dead {if god did not cause christ to become alive again}, then what we preached to you was useless, and your believing in christ is useless.
target_text: aa ladhe kristus mamuri hari boe, na, aa'i-aa'i dhu ji'i peka-padhai dènge dhèu, gaguna aad'o. aa lalèka miu mi kristus, parcuma kahèi!

source_text: if it is true that no one will be raised from the dead {that god will not cause anyone to become alive again after he dies}, we exc have been guilty of lying to you about god, because we told you that god caused christ to become alive again. but if it were really true that no one who has died will be raised {that god will not cause anyone who has died to become alive} again, then christ was not raised {he did not cause christ to become alive} again either!
target_text: aa ladhe tare'a dhèu madhe mamuri hari boe, ji'i j'aj'i sakasii kapod'e-kabèli mi ama lamatua. te ji'i tema aj'a-nori, peka na, ama lamatua ka dhu pamamuri hari kristus! mema tare'a dhu ji'i lole sèmi èèna ka. te ngaa ladhe sèmi dhèu madhe mamuri hari boe, sasoa na, ama lamatua pamamuri hari boe kristus kahèi.

source_text: if it were true that christ was not raised {that god did not cause christ to become alive} again after he died, you have believed in christ for nothing, because god will still punish you for mty your sins.
target_text: pangee sèku j'ara ne: ladhe kristus mamuri hari boe, lalèka miu mi ama lamatua parcuma! aa miu pasae taruu sasala-sasigo miu!

source_text: and those people who died eup while they were trusting in christ will go to hell.
target_text: mesa boe èèna di, te dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu uru èèna pa'èki dènge kristus, dhu madhe le, ladhe kristus kèd'i boe nèti mamadhe na, rèngu madhe pacèri nèti ama lamatua kahèi.

source_text: in this life many of us have suffered much for christ because we confidently expect that he will reward us in heaven. if we have confidently expected this in vain, people should pity us more than they pity anyone else!
target_text: kristus j'aj'i era sarai èdhi, lula te'a, na, nèngu neo tao j'ara hua iia hia èdhi. te ngaa ladhe èdhi sanao-maena ho nèngu neo tao sèmi èèna dhoka ètu rai-haha di, na parcuma! aa èdhi j'aj'i dhèu kasia risi eele nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra!

source_text: but the truth is that christ has been raised from the dead {that god has caused christ to live again after he had died}, and ◄that guarantees/because of that, it is certain► met that he will also cause those believers who have died eup to become alive again.
target_text: aa te ngaa aad'o sèmi èèna, si? te dhu lèke mola-mola ka: kristus dhu ama lamatua pua mai èèna, mamuri le nèti mamadhe na! aa mesa boe nèngu di, te èèna na dhèu-dhèu parcaya dhu madhe sèra, bèli-camèd'a mamuri hari kahèi. kristus ne, nuka sèmi hua uru dhu pad'elo, na, rèngu dhu madhe sèra, bèli-camèd'a mamuri hari madhutu nèngu.

source_text: what one man, adam, did affects us all. we all die. similarly, what one man-christ-did affects usinc all: god will cause all believers to become alive again.
target_text: uru-uru èèna, dhoka dhèu èci di, nuka adam dhu sisu paredha ama lamatua. de hahuku na, nuka mamadhe. hahuku ne noto mi èdhi dhèu rai-haha kahèi. te ngaa limuri ne, abhu ca dhèu hari, nuka kristus, dhu mamuri madhutu paredha ama lamatua. de, lula babe'a nèngu ka dhèu madhe bisa mamuri hari!

source_text: because of what adam did, all of us who are descended from him die. similarly, because of what christ did, all of us who have a close relationship with him will be brought back to life {god will make alive all of us who have a close relationship with christ}.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu sisu paredha lamatua, lèke huku madhe sama sèmi adam kahèi. te ngaa dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu pa'èki dènge kristus, èèna na ama lamatua pamamuri hari si.

source_text: but we must all take our turn. god raised christ first met. and when christ returns, god will cause those who belong to christ to become alive again.
target_text: te ngaa èci-èci ka dènge lod'o na. kristus dhèu partama dhu mamuri hari, nuka sèmi hua uru deo na. aa pe na lèpa hari mai asa rai-haha ne, dhèu unu na sèra heka mamuri hari kèna.

source_text: then, after christ has destroyed all dou the evil powers that oppose god, the world will end. then christ will give to god, his father, his kingdom to completely rule over it.
target_text: èle ku, heka rai-haha ne èle kèna. lod'o èèna, kristus j'aj'i dhèu aae dhu pa'ele iie koasa aa'i-aa'i, paredha aa'i-aa'i, aa mamèu aa'i-aa'i dhu pamusu dènge lamatua. nèngu j'aj'i kahèi dhèu aae dhu pangèd'u hari hak paredha na mi ama na, nuka ama lamatua.

source_text: you must realize that christ must rule here on earth until he has completely defeated mty all his enemies.
target_text: te ama lamatua hud'i nèd'u paredha taruu, toke na segi aa'i dhu lab'a kristus, sèna ka ra pahaha iisi mi nèngu.

source_text: the last thing that he will get rid of is death. but he certainly will get rid of death, which is like an enemy to us.
target_text: abhu ca j'ara dhu pamusu dènge èdhi era, nuka mamadhe. te ngaa d'ai limuri, ka lamatua segi kahèi koasa mamadhe. de lèpa lod'o limuri, dhèu madhe heka.

source_text: in the scriptures the psalmist wrote that god will cause everything to be under christ's authority mty. but it is clear that the word ‘everything' here does not include god, because god is the one who will cause everything to be under christ's authority mty.
target_text: ètu sasuri mola-mèci lamatua suri, peka na, lamatua tao dhu na segi aa'i-aa'i sèra, sèna ka ra pahaha iisi mi dhèu dhu lamatua pua mai èèna. de dhu suri, peka na, dhu na segi aa'i-aa'i sèra, sèna ka ra pahaha iisi mi dhèu nèngu, de lèke, ladhe peka na, ama lamatua pahaha boe iisi mi dhèu unu nèngu èèna. lula ama lamatua ka dhu ded'e ne, sèna ka j'aj'i kètu mi ngaa aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: after everything is put under the authority of god's son, then christ will put himself completely under the authority of god, the one who gave him that authority. then god will be completely in control of everything idm, everywhere.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a ladhe aa'i-aa'i nanene tare'a-re'a ana ama lamatua, èèna na ana ne pangèd'u aa'i-aa'i hari mi ama na, dhu ded'e ne j'aj'i kètu nèti aa'i-aa'i sèra. èle èèna, ama lamatua paredha taruu ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i, bagi mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: now think about this: some among you are being baptized or, are baptizing people on behalf of those who died before someone baptized them or, who died before they became believers. if, as some people say, believers will not be raised from the dead {god will not cause believers to become alive again}, ◄what is the value in those people doing that? /there is no value in those people doing that! ► rhq if god will not cause any believers to become alive again, it is senseless to be baptized {baptize anyone} on behalf of someone who has died. rhq
target_text: abhu dhèu dhu neo sarani ho gati dhèu dhu madhe le dhu dhae sarani mèka. te ngaa ladhe dhèu madhe mamuri hari boe, nga tao ka rèngu neo sarani hia dhèu madhe?

source_text: furthermore, if god will not cause us believers to become alive again, it is rhq very foolish for me and the other apostles to be constantly putting ourselves in danger because we tell people the gospel.
target_text: aa nga tao ka ji'i oe madhe pahari-pahari ètu d'ara sasab'a ji'i, ladhe dhèu madhe mamuri hari boe?

source_text: my fellow believers, every day i am in danger of being killed {people killing me}! that is as true as it is that i am pleased with you because of your close relationship with christ jesus our lord.
target_text: te bèli-bèli ja'a oe madhe! te ngaa a'ari pasue! ja'a subha, te ja'a pangee, na, ngaa-ngaa tao boe ladhe ja'a madhe. te ja'a bisa boti kètu, lula miu pa'èki taruu dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, dhu ama lamatua pua le mai.

source_text: if god will not cause us believers to become alive again after we die, ◄i will receive no benefit at all from having opposed those who attacked me so strongly in ephesus city. /what will i gain from having opposed those who attacked me so strongly in ephesus city? ► rhq they were fighting me like wild beasts! if we believers will not be raised from the dead {if god will not cause us believers to live again}, we might as well say as people often say: tomorrow we are going to die, so we might as well enjoy now everything that we can. we might as well feast and get drunk!
target_text: ca hari ni, lod'o ja'a ètu kota epesus era, ja'a patao-palaha dènge dhèu sèra nuka sèmi badha hui dhu bhelu. te ngaa ladhe ja'a dhoka patao-palaha, ho bisa segi mesa ku, aa hia boe lamatua, èèna parcuma. guna boe ngaa-ngaa! te ladhe tare'a dhèu madhe mamuri hari boe, hua iia èdhi madhutu dhu dhèu peka, na, mai èdhi pesta rame-rame, aa ta'a-tinu be'a-be'a, te bèli èdhi madhe kèna!

source_text: do not let yourselves be deceived by those who say that god will not cause believers to live again {do not let people who say that god will not cause believers to live again deceive you}. if you associate with evil people who say such things, they will ◄influence you to do evil things/destroy your good moral way of living►.
target_text: miu baku lèke tipu, ho pangee sèmi èèna! te abhu dhu peka na, ladhe èu pa'èci dènge dhèu bhelu, èèna pakaj'èu èu nèti mamuri dhu mola.

source_text: start thinking correctly again about these matters, as you should, and stop your sinful behavior which has resulted from your wrong thinking. i say that because it seems that some among you do not know god, and as a result they are thinking wrongly. i say that to make you ashamed.
target_text: ad'u-ue ia ka bhabhelu-katub'a! rèno ka! ator ngi'u mu! tao dhu lèke di! dhu lèke ka, miu hud'i me'a ku makae, te ètu talora aae miu, abhu era dhèu dhu tadhe mèka ama lamatua.

source_text: but some of you are asking, how will dead people be raised {how will god cause dead people to become alive} again? what kind of bodies will they have?
target_text: abhu dhu pakarèi, na, ladhe dhèu madhe mamuri hari, j'ara na tasamia? aa ngi'u aae j'aj'i sèmi ngaa sa?

source_text: anyone who asks such questions is foolish. you know that a seed that is planted in the ground must completely change its form met before it sprouts.
target_text: goa, ee! te ladhe sèle hini, hini ne hud'i roe ètu d'ara rai uuru ku, heka na bisa muri kèna.

source_text: a seed, such as a wheat seed, is very different from the plant that sprouts from it.
target_text: aa hini dhu èdhi sèle, rupa na leko-leo nèti dhu muri, èli, heka cèu rèu kèna. te nèngu èèna hini dhu mango-meto, nuka sèmi gandum, do are, do hini dhu leo.

source_text: god gives everything that lives the form that he desires. he gives each seed its own form.
target_text: èci-èci ka madhutu raropa ra, madhutu dad'èi lamatua. lula nèngu ka dhu ator raropa nèti ana aaj'u sèra.

source_text: similarly, people, animals, birds, and fish all have flesh, but each one has a different kind of flesh.
target_text: badha dènge dhèu rai-haha sèmi èèna kahèi. èci-èci ka dènge raropa ra, madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. hèia ngi'u dhèu rai-haha madhutu raropa dhèu rai-haha. ngi'u badha èci-èci ka dènge raropa ra. manu-bhui dènge raropa ra. i'a dènge raropa ra. dhu leo sèra dènge raropa ra.

source_text: also, there are angelic beings in heaven or, stars and planets in the sky, and there are people with bodies on the earth. the angelic beings or, stars and planets are beautiful in one way, and people on earth are beautiful in a different way.
target_text: abhu mèdha ètu dedha-liru, aa abhu ètu rai-haha. ètu dedha-liru dènge kolo-karisi na. te ngaa kolo-karisi ne, leko-leo nèti dhu ètu rai-haha. dhu ètu rai-haha abhu kolo-karisi kahèi. te ngaa kolo-karisi se, leko-leo nèti dhu abhu ètu dedha-liru.

source_text: the sun is bright in one way, and the moon is bright in a different way, and the stars are bright in a different way. and even the various stars are different from each other in how bright they are.
target_text: ètu dedha-liru kolo-karisi madha lod'o leko-leo; kolo-karisi hèru leko-leo; aa kolo-karisi hua-hètu leko-leo kahèi. èci-èci ka dènge kolo-karisi ra. de aa'i-aa'i ra dènge kolo-karisi, si?

source_text: and it is the same way with our bodies. the bodies that we will have when god causes us to live again after we die will not be the same as the bodies that we have now met. the bodies that we have now will die and decay. the new bodies that we will have will never die.
target_text: ladhe dhèu madhe mamuri hari, èèna nuka sèmi hini deo na. te ladhe padhane ka dhèu madhe, ngi'u aae na ele iie, si? te ngaa ladhe mamuri hari, ngi'u na sèmi heka uru èèna. te ladhe mamuri hari, bisa heka madhe.

source_text: we despise the bodies that we have now, before we die. but our new bodies will be glorious. the bodies that we have before we die are weak. but our new bodies will be strong.
target_text: ropa èdhi padhane dhèu madhe, èdhi mad'enge ngi'u aae ne. te ngaa ladhe dhèu èèna mamuri hari, na saraga titu kèna! te nèngu j'aj'i mola-mèci! dhèu dhu madhe le bisa heka tao ngaa-ngaa lod'o dhèu padhane ne. te ngaa ropa na mamuri hari, nèngu èra titu kèna!

source_text: the bodies that we have before we die are natural bodies. but our new bodies will be ones that god's spirit ◄controls/gives us►. just like there are natural bodies, there are bodies that god's spirit completely controls or, makes alive.
target_text: ladhe dhèu mamuri era, ne'a dhoka ngee dènge rasa di, si? te ngaa ropa na madhe, ho mamuri hari, na, roh lamatua hia ne mamuri dhu lèke. ka dhèu ne sèmi heka uru èèna.

source_text: in the scriptures it is written {we read} that when the first man, adam, was created, he became a living human being. christ later also became a human being. but he is different from adam, because he became a person who gives us spiritual life.
target_text: dhèu rai-haha dhu uru-uru j'ara, dhu sama sèmi èdhi, nuka adam. madhutu sasuri mola-mèci lamatua dhu suri tèke, peka na, nèngu j'aj'i dhèu rai-haha dhu mamuri, dhu ne'a ngee dènge rasa. te ngaa dhèu rai-haha dhu raropa na sama sèmi adam, dhu dedha risi eele, nuka kristus. roh na ka dhu bisa hia dhèu mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: but our bodies that god's spirit ◄will completely control/will give us► are not the first bodies that we have. we have our natural bodies first.
target_text: raropa dhèu dhu uru-uru j'ara, nuka dhèu dhu ne'a dhoka ngee dènge rasa di, ka bisa madhe. te ngaa dhu mamuri hari, nuka dhèu dhu abhu mamuri dhu lèke nèti roh lamatua.

source_text: the first man, adam, was created {god created the first man, adam} from the dust of the earth. but christ, the one who came later, came from heaven.
target_text: raropa dhèu dhu uru-uru j'ara ètu rai-haha ne, dhu tao nèti ahu rai. te ngaa raropa ka dua, nuka kristus dhu mai nèti sorga.

source_text: everyone on earth has a body like the first man on the earth had. and in heaven, everyone will have a body like christ, the man who came from heaven, has.
target_text: èdhi dhu mamuri ètu rai-haha ne ca ropa dènge dhèu partama dhu lamatua paj'aj'i nèti ahu rai. te ngaa dhèu dhu pa'èki dènge ama lamatua ètu sorga, ca ropa dènge kristus dhu mai nèti sorga.

source_text: and just like god gave us bodies like the first man on earth had, so we believers will have bodies like christ has, who is now in heaven.
target_text: èdhi dhèu limuri ne, ca ropa dènge adam dhu ama lamatua paj'aj'i nèti ahu rai. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, gati dènge raropa hiu, sama sèmi kristus dhu mai nèti sorga.

source_text: my fellow believers, i want you to know that we inc syn cannot go to heaven, where god rules over everything, with our physical bodies, because our bodies cannot last forever. they will die and decay.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! dhu ja'a neo peka dènge miu, sèmi ne'e: èdhi dhu ca ropa dènge dhèu partama, ngi'u èdhi j'aj'i nèti sisi dènge raa. dènge j'ara ne'e, èdhi bisa boe abhu pusaka ho j'aj'i ana-ana ama lamatua ètu sorga. bisa boe! te raropa dhèu sèmi èèna, bèli-camèd'a ngi'u ra ele iie, ka bisa boe sèmi rare ngaa dhu taha nare nèbhu.

source_text: but i will tell you something that god has not revealed before: some of us believers will not die eup. however, all of us will be changed {god will change all of us}.
target_text: de nanene paie-iie! te ja'a neo bhoke paled'a rahasia èci. èèna na abhu dhèu parcaya cahag'e dhu madhe boe. te ngaa èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti, èèna na gati raropa hiu.

source_text: it will happen suddenly, as fast as someone can blink his eye met, when we hear the sound of god's trumpet for the last time. when we hear that trumpet, all the believers who have died will come back to life and will have bodies that are changed {that god has changed}, bodies that will never decay.

source_text: also, my opponents boast about work that others have done as if it were their own work. it is improper for them to do that, but i do not do as they do. i confidently expect that as you trust more and more in the gospel that i preach, you will more and more agree that god has given me the right to work as christ's representative among you.
