target_text: ja'a nuka sèmi ama miu, aa miu nuka sèmi ana bhèni ja'a dhu dhèu lii d'ai le. dhèu dhu lii d'ai miu èèna, nuka kristus. ka ja'a ate sale boe miu, sèna ka ladhe d'ai lod'o miu kab'i, miu kalora iisi era. hèia ja'a j'aga miu, sèna ka dhèu leo baku gagai miu, ho pa'ele iie parcaya miu.

source_text: however, just like satan, when he cunningly appeared as a snake, deceived eve and caused her to disobey the lord god, i am concerned that those teachers will cause you to think wrongly so that you will no longer be faithful to christ alone.
target_text: ne'e ne miu madhutu j'ara mamuri kristus dènge d'ara mola. te ngaa ja'a madha'u, mage dhoka dhèu tipu rare, miu sèna ka miu piku eele nèti j'ara mola èèna, nuka sèmi uru èèna mege tipu nare hawa. mege ne bisa tipu sèmi èèna, lula nèngu baki nèti kapod'e-kabèli!

source_text: i say that because some people have come among you who are teaching their own thoughts about jesus. they are saying about him things that are entirely different from what i taught you. they are urging you to receive a powerful spirit who would come to live in you, but it is not the same spirit that you received from god when you believed in christ. they preach what they call a good message, and you accept their message, even though it is not the same as the good message about christ that you heard from me. and you have gladly accepted them and their message!
target_text: ladhe lod'o-lod'o miu paraga dènge dhèu sèmi sèra sa, ho ra aj'a-nori miu lula-nèti yesus ropa leo dhu sama boe dènge yesus dhu ji'i aj'a-nori miu, na, tasamia ka miu lèka lii padhai ra? uru èèna, miu bhoke le d'ara miu ho sèmi mere roh mola-mèci lamatua, sèna ka na ator miu. te ngaa tasamia ka limuri ne, miu neo hari sèmi mere roh ropa leo èci? uru èèna, miu lèka lii lolo be'a kristus dhu ji'i aj'a miu. te ngaa tasamia ka limuri ne miu parcaya hari a'aj'a ropa leo?

source_text: i consider that lit none of those men, even though they think of themselves as being iro extra-special apostles, are in any way greater than i am.
target_text: dhèu se padedha iisi ra, peka na, rèngu ka dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua dhu kapai risi. madhutu ngangee miu, hak rèngu se risi nèti hak ja'a, do? aad'o! ja'a pake boe ngangee sèmi sèra.

source_text: i admit that i am not an eloquent speaker, but i do know god's message. i have made that clear to you by everything that i have done among you and by everything that i have taught you.
target_text: masi ka ja'a d'èlu-mèu boe ètu d'ara lii padhai pake lii dedha, te ngaa ke'a mèu sasoa nèti ngaa dhu ja'a padhue-padhai. miu dhu me'a le j'ara se'e, lula ja'a peka pahari-pahari le dènge miu.

source_text: i refused to accept money from you as pay for teaching you god's message about christ. ◄it is ridiculous for you to think that what i did was wrong! /was that wrong? ► rhq i know that by teaching you without pay, i made myself seem iro unimportant to you. but i did it to honor you.
target_text: lod'o ja'a aj'a miu lii holo-nori ama lamatua, ja'a manèngi boe miu ogo-oru hia ja'a. ja'a tao iisi nuka sèmi ana iiki sa, sèna ka bisa ded'e padedha miu. teko-teko nèti j'ara ne'e ka miu neo pasala ja'a, do?

source_text: some people might say that it was as though iro i was robbing other congregations because i accepted money from them in order that i might work among you.
target_text: te dhèu parcaya nèti juma'at era leo sèra ka dhu tago ja'a, sèna ka ja'a bisa ladhe-leru miu. ne'e èci èèna ka dènge ja'a kore nèti rèngu ho soru-bara miu.

source_text: furthermore, when i was there with you and had no money to buy the things that i needed, i did not cause any of you ◄to have difficulties by my depending on you/by asking you for money/support►, because our inc fellow believers who came from here in macedonia province brought enough money for me to buy everything that i needed. so i have not caused you any difficulty at all by asking you for money, and i never will ask you for money eup.
target_text: lod'o ja'a bera-bera dènge miu, ladhe ja'a parluu ngaa-ngaa, na, ja'a manèngi boe miu, aa pabia boe miu. a'ari èdhi dhu mai nèti propensi makedonia ka dhu soru-bara ja'a. te ngaa ja'a pabia kèdhi mèka miu, aa bèli-camèd'a ja'a pabia boe miu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: and as sure as you know that everything that christ says is true, you can be sure that what i say to you now is true. wherever i go there in achaia province, i do not let you believers pay me for doing god's work among you. and no one will be able to prevent me from boasting about that.
target_text: lii holo-nori kristus ne lèke tare'a-re'a. ja'a lèka mèu, na, lii padhai ja'a lèke kahèi, lula ja'a pa'èki dènge kristus. abhu boe ca dhèu sa ètu propensi akaya dhu bisa kutu hèb'a ja'a, aa kai ja'a sèna ka baku padhai lii padedha, peka na, ja'a pabia boe miu sèmi èèna.

source_text: no one should wrongly rhq think that it is because i do not love you that i do not take pay from you. god knows that you truly/really are very dear to me.
target_text: nga tao ka ja'a peka sèmi ne'e? ele boe, lula ja'a sue boe miu, do? masi ka miu pangee sèmi èèna, te ngaa ama lamatua ne'a, na, ja'a sue miu.

source_text: there are some men there among you who would like to be able to say boastfully that they work among you just as i do. so, in order to make it impossible idm for them to say that, i have refused to accept pay from you, and i will continue doing that.
target_text: j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a tao kèdhi le, ja'a tao taruu. dènge sèmi èèna, dhèu dhu tema padedha iisi, peka na, tatao rèngu sèra èci èèna ka dènge tatao ji'i, na, padhai lii rèngu dènge boe kolo-kapua.

source_text: those men are lying when they say that they are apostles. they work deceitfully. even though they say that they work for god, they are working only for themselves. they try to make people think that christ sent them as his apostles, but they do not truly represent him.
target_text: rèngu peka, na, lamatua ka dhu pajuu-paleha rèngu. rèngu se, dhèu sab'a dhu d'èi leko-monya dhèu! dhèu se tao iisi ra nuka sèmi dhèu pajuu-paleha dhu lèke nèti kristus. aa te ngaa rèngu se dhoka padhai lii hèb'a-hua!

source_text: i am not surprised that they act like that, because satan himself causes people to think that he has come as a shining messenger from god.
target_text: miu baku cag'ag'a! te dhèu aae nidhu kahèi tao iisi na sama sèmi ana-ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga dhu nèti saraa aa d'ara be'a.

source_text: so it should not surprise you if these men, who really serve satan, do good things in order to make you think they serve god. some day god will punish them according to what they deserve because of the evil things that they do.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu baku malaa ladhe dhèu sab'a na neo tao iisi ra nuka sèmi dhèu dhu sab'a dènge d'ara mola. sanèd'e, te èèna na ama lamatua b'ala bhabhelu-katub'a rèngu.

source_text: i say again: i do not want any of you to think that my boasting about myself is like foolish people boast. but even if anyone thinks that i am boasting about myself like a foolish person boasts, listen to what i have to say anyway, just like you listen to those false apostles. they really speak foolishly! listen to me while i also boast a little.
target_text: ladhe mo'o, na, ja'a padhai lii hari ciki sama sèmi dhèu goa. te ja'a neo padhai lii padedha iisi ciki.

source_text: about the things that i am going to tell you, boasting confidently about myself, surely you know that they are not the kind of things that the lord jesus would say. instead, i will speak as a foolish person would speak.
target_text: dhu ja'a suri padedha iisi ne, dhoka neo padhai lii sama sèmi dhèu goa sa. te lii padhai ja'a ne kapua na nèti boe lamatua èdhi.

source_text: because many among you are boasting about their own work, as unbelievers do, i will also boast about myself and my work mty, iro.
target_text: abhu dhèu ae dhu d'èi ded'e padedha ngi'u ra madhutu tatao dhèu rai-haha ne. de ja'a neo padhai lii padedha iisi kahèi sama sèmi rèngu.

source_text: i am sure that you, who think that you are so wise, will accept what i say because you gladly accept the false teachers and the foolish things that they say.
target_text: te miu dhu pangee, na, ngangee miu mola ladhe paraga dènge ca dhèu dhu kahadhu bia, na, miu soro tèke ne, si?

source_text: when people treat you as if they were your bosses, you gladly submit to them. you think that it is all right when others force you to provide for their needs. you think that it is all right when people take control over you, when they boast about themselves, or when they insult you by slapping you in the face.
target_text: ladhe dhèu leo tao miu madhutu dad'èi rèngu, na, miu soro tèke si. nuka sèmi: ladhe dhèu tao miu sèmi ènu sa, miu soro tèke ne, do? ladhe abhu dhu mana'u mèdha miu, miu soro tèke ne, do? ladhe abhu dhèu tipu miu, miu soro tèke ne, do? ladhe dhèu tao iisi nuka sèmi dhèu kapai, aa pahahe miu nuka sèmi ana iiki sa, na, miu soro tèke ne, do? sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tèb'e miu, na, miu soro tèke ne sène.

source_text: i agree that i was not bold enough to treat you in such ways. ha! do you think that iro i should feel ashamed because i did not do that? so now, talking like a person who does not have any sense, i will boldly tell you some things about myself, just like those false apostles tell you things about themselves.
target_text: te ngaa baku nasa! te ja'a makae, lula ji'i roe aala-aala. te ji'i lake ngare boe tao sèmi èèna, sama sèmi dhèu sèra tao mi dedha miu. te ngaa ladhe rèngu neo padedha iisi lula ngaa sa, ja'a bani padedha iisi sèmi èèna kahèi. te ngaa baku bhèlu, te ja'a padhai lii sèmi dhèu goa na!

source_text: do they tell you that they are hebrews and can speak the hebrew language? well, i can say the same thing about myself. do they tell you that they belong to god's people, the nation of israel? well, i can say the same thing about myself. do they tell you that they are descendants of our great ancestor abraham? well, he is my ancestor, too.
target_text: rèngu se dhèu ibrani tare'a-re'a, do? oo! ja'a kahèi dhèu ibrani. rèngu dhèu isra'el, do? oo! ja'a kahèi. rèngu sèra ana-èpu abraham, do? oo! ja'a kahèi.

source_text: do they tell you how much work they have done for christ? now i am talking like a crazy person talks eup. well, i work for christ much more than they do. i have been in prison many more times than they have. many times i have been beaten {people have beaten me} very severely because i believe in and obey christ. many times i almost died because of serving christ.
target_text: rèngu sèra dhèu sab'a hia kristus, do? oo! ja'a kahèi sèmi èèna. baku bhèlu, te ja'a padhai lii paleko ne! mema, ja'a peka na, ja'a sama sèmi rèngu. aa te ngaa ja'a risi nèti rèngu. te ja'a sab'a bia risi. ra bèdho ja'a ae risi. ra game ja'a ae risi. ja'a kahèi oe madhe pahari-pahari ae risi nèti rèngu.

source_text: on five occasions jewish religious leaders beat me 39 times with a whip.
target_text: ètu d'ara adhe-aai dhèu ja'a, dhèu yahudi, ra hake paparu ja'a lèmi hari. lod'o-lod'o ra hake paparu ja'a, na, ra hake tèlu nguru ceo hari pake gui.

source_text: on three occasions i was beaten {roman officials beat me} with wooden sticks. on one occasion a large crowd of people threw stones at me to kill me. on three occasions the ship that i was traveling on was wrecked and sank. on one of those occasions i was floating in the water a night and a day before i was rescued.
target_text: tèlu hari, dhèu hake ja'a pake aj'u. ca tèka dhèu pèci neo pamadhe ja'a. ja'a molo dènge kapa tèlu hari. d'ara ca mèu ca mèda, ja'a leb'o-leb'o ètu d'ara dhasi.

source_text: as i have often traveled to other places, i have often risked losing my life. for example, sometimes i have been in danger crossing rivers. i have been in danger traveling in places where there were bandits. at times i have been in danger among people of my own nation, the jews, and at other times i been in danger among those who are not jews. i have been in danger in cities, and i have been in dangerous situations in barren areas. i have been in dangerous situations when i was traveling in ships. i have been in danger among people who falsely claim to be fellow believers.
target_text: ja'a laku kaj'èu asa mia-mia pahari-pahari. ètu d'ara kakako ne, ja'a paraga dènge j'aj'èra rupa-rupa, dhu tao ja'a oe madhe. nuka sèmi: nèti èi aae lala ètu d'ara loko aae, nèti parapo, nèti dhèu ja'a dhèu yahudi, nèti dhèu yahudi boe, aa nèti dhèu dhu tao ngi'u ra sama sèmi a'ari dhèu parcaya, aa te ngaa rèngu leko-monya. ja'a oe madhe kahèi ètu talora lèu, ètu d'ara kota, dènge era dhèu pea boe.

source_text: i have worked very hard dou to earn ◄a living/what i need►, and often i did not sleep. at times i was hungry and thirsty, and at times i did not have enough time to eat. sometimes i was cold because i did not have enough clothes to wear.
target_text: ja'a sab'a bia, aa paraga dènge sasusa ae-ae. lod'o ae ka dhu ja'a bisa boe bhèj'i. ja'a manganga dènge koko-kamango kahèi. pahari-pahari ku'a boe ngaa-ngaa. abhu kahèi lod'o dhu ja'a unu boe mèdha-papake, ka maringi oe madhe.

source_text: in addition to all that, i am constantly and deeply concerned about all the congregations that i have helped to begin.

source_text: every time that i hear about fellow believers rhq who are not strong spiritually, i sympathize with them and try to help them. every time that i learn about a fellow believer rhq who causes another believer to do something wrong, that makes me very angry.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu rasa roe-bhilu dhu bisa boe sab'a ngaa-ngaa, na, sanèd'e ja'a. te ja'a sèmi èèna kahèi. ladhe abhu dhèu dhu dadugu dhèu-dhèu parcaya sèna ka tao j'ara karehe sama-sama dènge rèngu, na, ja'a makae, aa nasa.

source_text: because it seems that it is necessary for me to continue boasting about myself, i will boast about things that caused some people to think of me as being weak.
target_text: ladhe ja'a neo padedha iisi, na, be'a risi ja'a padedha iisi lula-nèti j'ara-j'ara dhu pad'elo raroe ja'a. tare'a!

source_text: god, who is the father of our inc lord jesus, and who is the one whom we should praise forever, knows that i am not lying about this.

source_text: it seems that i must go on boasting about myself. although i do not think that my telling you about this will help you to accept me as christ's representative to you, i will say this anyway. i will tell you about visions that the lord gave a certain man and about things that he supernaturally revealed to that man. i will tell you this because some of the people among you boast that it was in visions that they received the things that they teach.
target_text: ladhe miu mo'o, na, ja'a padedha iisi hari ciki, masi ka gaguna aad'o. te ngaa ja'a neo peka dènge miu j'ara-j'ara dhu lamatua èdhi pad'elo le dènge ja'a ètu d'ara tanila.

source_text: the man that i will tell you about is one who believes in christ. fourteen years ago he was taken {christ took him} up into the third heaven, the highest heaven, the place where god is. i do not know whether he went there in his physical body or whether he was outside of his body at that time and only his spirit went. only god really knows. but he was suddenly taken {christ suddenly took him} up to a place called paradise, that wonderful place where god lives. i repeat that i do not know whether his body went there or only his spirit. only god knows that. while he was there, god told him some things that he does not allow human beings to tell others about.
target_text: ja'a tadhe ca dhèu unu kristus. canguru èpa tèu dhu la'e, abhu dhu ded'e ne asa dedha-liru dhu dedha aae. te ngaa ja'a ke'a boe, na ca'e dènge ngi'u aae, do dhoka roh nèngu di. dhodhoka lamatua di ne'a. ja'a ke'a kahèi, na, ropa ded'e ne asa era hua iia lamatua èèna, nèngu tadèngi lii padhai dhu be'a titu kèna, dhu dhèu rai-haha bisa boe peka-padhai.

source_text: i will proudly talk about that man. however, i will not be boasting as i say that i am the one who saw and heard those wonderful things. i will talk only about the things that cause others to think of me as a weak human being like everyone else.
target_text: de mi dhèu sèmi èèna, ja'a neo padhai lii padedha. te ngaa ja'a ko'o boe padedha iisi lula-nèti ngi'u ja'a unu ku. ja'a ded'e dhoka raroe-bhilu ja'a, aa j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a bisa boe tao kore.

source_text: but even if i should choose to boast to you about such wonderful things that happened to me, i would not be speaking like a fool, because i would be telling you the truth. but i will not talk proudly about such things, because i do not want any of you to think highly of me because of the things that have happened to me. instead, i want you to decide what kind of person i am by the way you see me acting and by what you hear me teach.
target_text: ladhe ja'a neo padedha iisi, na, ja'a parluu boe monya, te ja'a dhu dènge j'ara ae dhu lèke, dhu ja'a bisa peka-padhai. te ngaa ja'a mau-mau, sèna ka dhèu baku pangee, na, ja'a dènge kolo-karisi nèti ngaa dhu rèngu tadèngi aa ladhe rèdhi nèti ja'a.

source_text: in order that i might not become proud because of those many wonderful things that christ revealed to me, god permitted satan to send a messenger to humble me or, to make me sick. what that messenger did to me was painful, like met a thorn pricking my body.
target_text: risi-risi hari, lamatua dhu pad'elo le dènge ja'a j'ara-j'ara dhu kapai titu kèna. te ngaa ja'a abhu susa kahèi, sèna ka ja'a baku pamone. te dhèu aae nidhu pua ana pajuu na èci, ho mai kakèj'i taruu ja'a, nuka sèmi dhudhu dhu pakèj'i ètu d'ara isi ja'a ne. waa! ja'a j'èra titu kèna!

source_text: three times i prayed to the lord about it, begging him to take this away from me.
target_text: tèlu hari kèna, ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua pakaj'èu eele j'aj'èra ne nèti ja'a.

source_text: but he said to me, no, i will not take this away from you. instead, i will kindly help you, and that will be all that you need, because it is when you are weak that i can best work powerfully to help you. so, because of what the lord said to me, i will very gladly boast about the things that make me seem weak, so that people may realize that it is christ who gives me power to serve him.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua peka na, ja'a pad'elo le d'ara hua iia ja'a mi èu, de èèna d'ai le, sèna ka èu me'a, na, nèti d'ara raroe ka koasa ja'a asa tabha. nèti èèna ka ja'a d'èi padedha iisi ètu d'ara raroe ja'a, sèna ka ja'a ke'a, na, koasa kristus ètu d'ara mamuri ja'a.

source_text: for that reason, whenever i am weak, or when people insult me, or when i have to endure hardships, or when i am persecuted {people cause me to suffer}, or when i am in situations that distress me, i am content because i am serving christ. i can say that because at any time when i myself am weak, that is the very time when christ powerfully helps me.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ladhe a'èra ja'a mesa ku bisa boe sab'a ngaa èci sa, na, d'ara ja'a mau-mau sène. de ropa dhèu pahahe ja'a, do pasusa ja'a, do paj'èra ja'a, do game ja'a, lula ja'a j'aj'i dhèu unu kristus, na, d'ara ja'a mau-mau sène. te ladhe ja'a mesa ku bisa boe, na, ja'a abhu koasa nèti kristus, ho bisa èra tao j'ara sèra.

source_text: it has been foolish for me to talk about myself like this, but it is you who forced me to do it. truly if the lord would not help me, i would be worthless, as my opponents say that i am. but none of the men whom you wrongfully think iro are great apostles are greater in any way than i am. so it would have been right/proper for you to say good things about me.

source_text: you should have done that, because when i was with you i repeatedly did the things that showed you that i am truly an apostle, such as performing many dou miracles.

source_text: i ◄feel anxious/am concerned► about you. i worry that when i visit you again, god, the one whom i serve, will make me feel ashamed of you when i see that you still are not conducting your lives as believers should. then i will feel very sad about some of you who were sinning previously and have not stopped your sinful behavior. some of you may still have impure thoughts. some of you may be having sexual intercourse with those to whom you are not married. and some of you may be doing other shameful things.

source_text: when i visited you the second time, i warned you that i was going to punish all the wrongdoers among you. and now i am warning you again while i am still away from you. when i visit you this third time, i will punish those who were sinning at the time when i visited you before and who are still sinning, and i will punish the others who have been sinning since then, if they have not stopped their sinful behavior.
target_text: lod'o dhu ja'a dhiu kali ka dua asa miu uru èèna, ja'a pasanèd'e le dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara bhabhelu-katub'a sèra. limuri ne, ja'a pasanèd'e hari rèngu sama-sama dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri ètu d'ara bhelu-katub'a sèra. nuka sèmi uru èèna, dhu ja'a peka kore le, na, ladhe ja'a j'aj'i mai hari, ja'a soro tèke boe rèngu sèra.

source_text: because you have demanded that i prove to you that christ is speaking to you when i speak to you, i will show you that i speak to you as his apostle. christ does not approve of your sinful behavior. on the contrary, he will powerfully discipline you.

source_text: it is true that christ seemed to be weak when he was crucified {when people killed him by nailing him to the cross}. but it is also true that he now lives because god worked powerfully to bring him back to life. similarly, as i serve god, i also am a weak human being as christ was. but i also have a close relationship with christ who is now alive again. and with his authority i will use god's power to discipline you.
target_text: lod'o dhèu pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, mema na roe aala-aala, lula na patalale eele koasa na. te ngaa ama lamatua pangèd'u le kristus koasa, hèia na mamuri hari le. ka masi ka ji'i j'aj'i dhèu unu na, dhu rasa na, ji'i ètu d'ara raroe era, te ngaa ama lamatua hia le ji'i mamuri hiu. nèti èèna ka, ji'i bisa ladhe-leru miu pake koasa nèngu.

source_text: each of you should ask yourself: do i believe god's message about christ? each of you should examine yourselves to make sure that you truly do believe in christ and so truly belong to him, and that his spirit lives in you pl. when you examine yourselves in that way, i am sure that you will rhq say to me, yes, of course we belong to christ.

source_text: but because i do not want to have to punish you, i am praying to god that he will help you not to do anything evil that would cause me to have to punish you. i pray this, not in order that when people who say that i am not your apostle realize that my ministry among you has been very successful, they will have to agree that i do have authority from christ. instead, i pray this because i want you to do what is right, even though that might mean that my opponents would think that i do not have authority from christ, since i would not have an opportunity to show my authority to discipline you.

source_text: finally, my fellow believers, i say to you, be joyful. completely change how you conduct your lives, and do what i have urged you to do. be united in what you think about the matters about which i have written to you. live peacefully with each other. if you do those things, god, who enables you to love each other and be peaceful, will bless mty you.

source_text: i, paul, write this letter to you. i remind you that i am an apostle. that is not because a group of people appointed me, nor because a human being sent me to be an apostle. instead, jesus christ and god our heavenly father, who caused jesus to become alive again after he died, have appointed and sent me to be an apostle. all the fellow believers who are here with me approve of this message that i am writing. i am sending this letter to the congregations that are in galatia province.

source_text: because when i experience troubles, i know that some day god will say that he approves of what i have done or, that the roman authorities will set me free. this will happen as a result of your praying for me, and as a result of god's spirit, whom jesus christ gave me, helping me.
target_text: lula ja'a ke'a, na, miu sabaj'a hia ja'a, aa roh yesus kristus dhu soru-bara ja'a. nèti èèna ka, ja'a ke'a, na, lèpa lod'o limuri, aa'i-aa'i se èle dènge sod'a-mole!

source_text: i know that this will happen because i very confidently expect dou that i will faithfully honor christ. i expect that like i always have done, christ will be greatly honored {i will continue now also to very boldly honor christ} by means of all that i do syn, mty, whether by the way i live or by the way i die.
target_text: masi ka ja'a muri do, madhe do, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. sad'i ama lamatua pake ja'a, sèna ka ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara yesus kristus, aa aj'a mola-mola lula-nèti nèngu, toke abhu boe ngaa èci sa dhu pamakae ja'a. se'e se ka dhu ja'a sanao karèi nèti uru, toke doe ne'e ne.

source_text: as for me, i live in order to honor christ. but if i die, it will be better for me than if i continue to live, because then i will be with him. on the other hand, if i continue to live, that will enable me to continue to serve christ effectively. as a result, i do not know which to choose. that is, i am not sure which of those two i prefer. i long to leave this world and go to be with christ, because that will be very much better for me.
target_text: te ja'a pangee sèmi ne'e ka: ladhe ja'a mamuri, na, hud'i laa pa'èki dènge kristus, aa pakako taruu sasab'a-la'a na. èèna ka dhu be'a. te ngaa ladhe ja'a madhe, ja'a oto risi hari, lula ja'a tèke eele rai-haha ne, aa mamuri hari ho pea pa'èci dènge kristus ètu sorga. nèti èèna ka, d'ara ja'a kajari, aa ke'a boe mia ka dhu be'a risi eele!

source_text: nevertheless, it is more important that i remain alive than that i go to be with christ because you still need me to help you.
target_text: de sèmi ne'e ka laa! lula miu parluu ja'a era ètu ne'e, be'a risi ja'a pea pa'èci dènge miu ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: since i am convinced of this, i know that i will remain alive and that i will go/come to be with you all. as a result, you will believe in christ more firmly, and as a result of that, you will rejoice.
target_text: ja'a ke'a, na, mamuri ja'a madhera era, sèna ka paraga hari dènge miu. te lamatua neo ho ja'a pa'èra d'ara miu, hèia miu asa lèka ne dènge d'ara karej'e.

source_text: that is, you will be able to rejoice very greatly because of christ jesus bringing me to be with you again.
target_text: de bèli-camèd'a miu ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara yesus kristus, lula na bhoke le j'ara sèna ka ja'a lèpa pa'asu-pareo hari dènge miu.

source_text: most importantly, as fellow believers in christ, conduct yourselves just like you learned you should do when you heard the message about christ. do that in order that whether i come and see you, or whether i am away from you and people tell me about you, what i hear or see will make me happy. they will tell me that you are unitedly and cooperatively resisting those who oppose the message about christ or, oppose you. i will know that you are not allowing others to influence you to believe a message that is different from the gospel about christ. and i will know that you are not at all frightened by {afraid of} the people who oppose you. this will show/prove to those people that god will destroy them, but this will show/prove to you that god will save you eternally. it is god who is doing all this.
target_text: masi ka tasa mera mia, mamuri miu hud'i lèke ku, te miu dhèu unu lamatua. de miu hud'i mamuri dhu mèci ku, aa tao madhutu lii lolo be'a yesus kristus dhu peka le dènge miu. aa ladhe bèli-camèd'a ja'a lèpa hari dhiu pangad'o dènge miu, do tadèngi dhoka lii nèti dhèu di, peka na, miu mamuri mola, na, d'ara ja'a karej'e. te ja'a bisa ke'a, na, miu dhu mamuri d'ara èci, lula pa'èki dènge roh èci di. aa bisa ke'a, na, miu pa'èra ho pakako sama-sama lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus, sèna ka dhèu leo parcaya kahèi. aa miu me'a boe madha'u kahèi, masi ka abhu dhèu dhu lab'a miu. ne'e ne j'aj'i mi tadha hia musu, na, ama lamatua neo lalèta eele si. te ngaa ama lamatua hia miu mamuri, ho bèli-camèd'a miu mamuri taruu dènge nèngu.

source_text: remember that he has not only kindly enabled you to believe in christ, he has also kindly allowed you to suffer for the sake of christ.
target_text: te, lula ama lamatua d'ara hua iia risi, nèti èèna ka na bhoke le j'ara, sèna ka miu bisa parcaya kristus, aa j'aj'i dhèu unu na. mesa boe parcaya di, te ngaa lamatua soro tèke miu abhu sasusa kahèi, lula miu madhutu nèngu.

source_text: as a result, you are having to resist those who oppose the good message, just like you saw that i had to resist such people there in philippi, and just like you hear that i still have to resist such people here now.
target_text: te dhu ja'a tadèngi, abhu dhèu ètu sèra dhu lab'a miu, lula miu pakako lii lolo be'a kristus. sanèd'e, te ca hari ni rèngu lab'a le ja'a kahèi, toke d'ai doe ne'e ne.

source_text: since christ encourages us, since he loves us and comforts us, since god's spirit fellowships with us, and since christ is very merciful dou to us,
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i, unu yesus kristus! na pangèd'u le miu j'ara be'a ae-ae. de miu bisa pa'èra d'ara èci dènge èci. miu bisa holo dhu mai nèti sasue miu. miu bisa mamuri pabe'a èci dènge èci, lula roh lamatua dhu sab'a ètu talora aae miu. aa miu bisa pad'elo rasa kasia miu dènge d'ara be'a èci dènge èci.

source_text: make me completely happy by doing the following things: agree with one another, love one another, be closely united with one another, and live harmoniously with one another dou.
target_text: ladhe miu tao sèmi èèna, na, d'ara ja'a karej'e kea rae-rae. risi-risi hari, ladhe miu pasue dènge d'ara èci, mamuri ètu ca j'ara, aa mere lii èci ètu d'ara sasab'a-la'a.

source_text: never try to selfishly make yourselves more important than others nor boast about what you are doing. instead, be humble, and in particular, honor one another more than you honor yourselves.
target_text: baku tao ngaa-ngaa dhu tenge dhoka pa'oto ngi'u èu risi nèti dhèu leo. aa baku pangee, na, èu risi nèti dhèu leo. te pamone do pabhèni èu èèna, dènge boe kolo-kapua. te ngaa èdhi hud'i pahaha iisi ku, sèna ka te'a, na, dhèu leo risi nèti èdhi.

source_text: each one of you should not only be concerned about your own affairs. instead, each of you should also be concerned ◄that you help/about the needs of► one another.
target_text: aa baku dhoka uri mamuri miu mesa-mesa mi. te ngaa èdhi hud'i ladhe kahèi, ngaa dhu dhèu leo parluu.

source_text: you should think/act just like christ jesus thought/acted.
target_text: te d'ara èdhi hud'i sama ku sèmi d'ara yesus kristus.

source_text: although he has the same nature as god has, he did not insist on keeping all the privileges of being equal with god.
target_text: masi ka nèngu ca ropa dènge ama lamatua, aa nèngu kètu èdhi kahèi, èci èèna ka dènge ama lamatua, te ngaa na tèke eele hak na, aa pake boe dadedha dènge kapai na.

source_text: instead, he willingly gave up divine privileges. specifically, he became a human being and took the attitude of a servant. when he had become a human being,
target_text: hèia na puru mai asa rai-haha ne, ca ropa dènge dhèu rai-haha. na tèke eele hak na aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka tao iisi na j'aj'i nuka sèmi ènu sa.

source_text: he humbled himself even more. specifically, he obeyed god even to the extent of being willing to die. he was even willing to be nailed to a cross, to die as though he were a criminal.
target_text: mesa boe j'aj'i dhèu haha d'ai seli di, te ngaa na tao ngi'u na j'aj'i dhèu dhu laku-laku boe kahèi, sèna ka tao madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. masi ka ra pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, na sèmi nare kahèi, aa madhe, nuka sèmi dhèu bhelu.

source_text: as a result, god promoted him to a rank that is above every other rank.
target_text: lula nèngu pahaha iisi sèmi èèna, nèti èèna ka ama lamatua ded'e ne padedha-dedha. aa pangèd'u ne ngara dhu kapai aae. te abhu boe ngara èci sa dhu kapai aae risi nèti nèngu.

source_text: god did that in order that every being syn in heaven and on earth and under the earth should worship mty jesus,
target_text: ama lamatua ded'e padedha-dedha ngara na èèna, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i pakab'ua ne. nuka: dhèu ètu dedha-liru, dènge dhèu ètu rai-haha ne. dhèu mamuri dènge dhèu madhe. bèli-camèd'a dhèu aa'i-aa'i patitu kètu urutuu, ho pahaha iisi mi nèngu.

source_text: and in order that every person syn should declare that jesus christ is lord. as a result of everyone doing that, they will honor god, his father.
target_text: aa bèli-camèd'a dhèu aa'i-aa'i peka na, yesus kristus èèna, tare'a-re'a lamatua! dènge sèmi èèna, rèngu koa-kio ama lamatua kahèi.

source_text: my dear friends, as you consider this, since you have always obeyed god, each of you should very reverentially dou try to do those things that are proper for people whom god has saved. you should do those things not only when i am with you. instead, you should try even more to do them now when i am not with you.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! nanene paie-iie! uru èèna, lod'o ja'a pea ètu kota pilipi era, miu nanene lii padhai ja'a, ka miu madhutu j'ara mola ama lamatua. limuri ne, èdhi pahag'a, te ngaa ja'a manèngi ho miu titu èra ètu d'ara mamuri mola. sanèd'e, te ladhe miu nanene boe nèngu, bèli-camèd'a pe mèdhi unu mi! lula nèngu ka dhu patalale miu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo mi. hèia miu mamuri dhu mèci, te miu j'aj'i le dhèu unu na.

source_text: you are able to do these things, since god himself causes you to desire to do what he wants you to do, and he also enables you to do what he wants you to do.
target_text: te ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu sab'a ètu d'ara miu. nèngu ka dhu bhoke j'ara, sèna ka miu neo nanene ne. aa nèngu ka dhu hia koasa kahèi, ho miu d'èi sab'a pakarej'e d'ara na.

source_text: do everything god or your leaders ask you to do. never complain about what they want you to do, or argue with them.
target_text: de ladhe sad'i miu tao ngaa èèna ka, na, baku ka'uu-kamuki, aa baku pasibha d'ara lii.

source_text: behave like that in order that you may be completely faultless dou and may be perfect children of god dou while you live in the midst of people who are wicked and do very wicked things dou. as you live among them, show them clearly met the way they ought to behave, just like the sun, moon, and stars show the road clearly to us sim.
target_text: tao sèmi èèna, sèna ka miu j'aj'i dhèu dhu d'ara mola-mèci, aa dhèu dhu dènge boe sasala. miu mamuri ètu d'ara talora aae dhèu bhelu dènge dhèu kapod'e-kabèli. te ngaa baku madhutu si! te mamuri miu hud'i mola-mèci ku, lula miu ana-ana lamatua. hèia mamuri miu hud'i heo ku, ho pad'elo j'ara hia rèngu, nuka sèmi hua-hètu dhu pasaraa ètu d'ara maroga.

source_text: tell them how to have eternal life. i ask that you do that in order that on the day christ returns i may be able to rejoice mty, that i did not labor dou so hard among you in vain.
target_text: hèia miu mamuri mola dènge pakako lii holo-nori lamatua. dènge sèmi èèna, bèli-camèd'a miu tao d'ara ja'a kea rae-rae, lod'o yesus kristus lèpa hari mai. aa rui-j'aj'èra ja'a core eele boe iia d'ara, te ngaa dènge kab'ua.

source_text: perhaps the roman authorities will execute me, and my blood will pour out met as the wine pours out when the priest offers it to god met. for your part, you believe in christ firmly. as a result, you have given yourselves completely to god in order that you might do what he wills met, just like a priest offers a sacrifice completely to god met. because i dedicate myself wholly to god together with you, even if they are about to execute me, i will greatly rejoice dou, because i am giving myself wholly to god, and because you all are giving yourselves wholly to god. similarly, you too should rejoice because you are giving yourselves wholly to god, and you should rejoice because i am giving myself wholly to god.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe sèmi ja'a dutu pa'èle aa'i mèu-mèu mamuri ja'a, ho j'aj'i nuka sèmi korban èi anggor, sèna ka miu bisa parcaya asa èra, aa pakako sasab'a lamatua, ja'a sèmi kore mamadhe dènge karej'e. èèna nuka sèmi ama agama tiko èi anggor ètu mei korban, ho pahaha iisi mi lamatua. dènge j'ara ne, èdhi bisa sama-sama karej'e, lula korban ne, iia d'ara boe.

source_text: my relationship with the lord jesus leads me to confidently expect that he will enable me to send timothy to you soon, in order that his telling you the news about me will encourage you. but i also expect that his returning to me and telling me the news about you will encourage me.
target_text: ja'a sanao, nèbhu heka, lamatua yesus bhoke j'ara, ho ja'a pua timotius dhiu, sèna ka na pa'èra d'ara miu. èle èèna, na lèpa hari mai sa ne'e, ho na lolo dènge ja'a kakako miu, aa pakarej'e d'ara ja'a.

source_text: keep in mind that i have no one else like him who genuinely cares for you.
target_text: ja'a pua boe dhèu leo, dhoka timotius di, lula nèngu ne d'ara èci dènge ja'a. aa na sue tare'a-re'a miu.

source_text: all the others whom i have considered that i might send to you are concerned only about their own matters. they are not concerned about what jesus christ considers important.
target_text: nèngu ne, sama boe dènge a'ari dhu leo sèra. te rèngu sèra pangee dhoka ngi'u rèngu unu ra, te ngaa uri boe ngaa-ngaa dhu pamèci hia yesus kristus.

source_text: but you know that timothy has proved that he serves the lord and others faithfully. you know that he has served the lord closely together with me in proclaiming to people the message about christ as though he were sim my son and i were his own father.
target_text: te ngaa miu me'a le, na, timotius sab'a d'ai madhe, pakako sasab'a ama lamatua. na sab'a dènge ja'a nuka sèmi ana dhu sab'a hia ama na. ji'i dua mi la'a peka-padhai lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus ètu mia-mia.

source_text: so then he is the one i confidently expect to send to you as soon as i know what will happen to me.
target_text: ladhe rèngu pama'ète rare ku lii langu ja'a, ja'a heka pua timotius dhiu asa miu kèna.

source_text: and i am confident that i will soon be released {the authorities will soon release me} so that the lord will enable me also to come/go to you soon.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, lamatua pa'èra d'ara ja'a, na, nèbhu heka ja'a bisa dhiu paraga dènge miu.

source_text: i have concluded that it is really necessary that i send epaphroditus back to you. he is a fellow believer and my fellow worker, and he endures difficulties together with me met, just like soldiers endure difficulties together. you sent him to me in order that he might help me when i was needy eup.
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o ja'a ètu d'ara j'aj'èra era, miu pua a'ari èdhi epaproditus mai ladhe-leru ja'a. na pakako sasab'a lamatua sama-sama dènge ja'a, nuka sèmi ca dhèu sordad'u dhu maj'èni madhutu paredha komedhaa na. te ngaa ne'e ne, ja'a neo pua na lèpa hari asa miu.

source_text: but i have concluded that i must send him back to you because he has been longing to see you all. furthermore, he has been very distressed because he knows that you heard that he had become sick.
target_text: te d'ara na neo ae le nèdhi miu. aa na ngee miu, lula ne'a, na, miu tadèngi le nèngu dhu pèd'a.

source_text: indeed, he was so sick that he almost died. however, he did not die. instead, god pitied him and he also pitied me, and as a result he healed him. god pitied me because he did not want me to be even more sorrowful than i already was.
target_text: mema lèke tare'a. ca hari ni, na pèd'a aae oe madhe. te ngaa ama lamatua sue ne, aa lamatua sue ja'a kahèi, ka na puri-pa'èle epaproditus, sèna ka ja'a baku asa susa.

source_text: so, i am sending him back to you as quickly as possible, in order that you may rejoice when you see him again and in order that i may be less sorrowful than i was.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a neo pua hari na lèpa, ho bisa paraga hari dènge miu dènge d'ara karej'e-karae. ladhe sèmi èèna, d'ara ja'a heka mau kèna.

source_text: welcome him very joyfully just like believers in our lord jesus should welcome one another. while he was working for christ, he was helping me in place of you because you were far away. he knew that he might die as a result of helping me, and truly he nearly did die. so honor him, and honor all those who are like him.
target_text: de miu hud'i sèmi mere ne dènge be'a, te nèngu ne dhèu unu lamatua. aa miu hud'i pakab'ua ku dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra dhu ca ropa dènge ne. te nèngu pakako sasab'a kristus, toke oe madhe. aa nèngu hari boe kabodho ciki sa, lula na neo soru-bara ja'a, gati miu. de sèmi mere hari ne dènge d'ara karej'e.

source_text: now there are other things that i want to write about. my fellow believers, continue to rejoice because you belong to the lord. though i will now write to you about those same matters that i mentioned to you before, this is not tiresome for me, and it will protect you from those who would harm you spiritually.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! nanene paie-iie! d'ara miu hud'i karej'e ku, lula miu pa'èki dènge kristus. masi ka ja'a suri pahari-pahari, te ngaa ja'a roca boe pasanèd'e miu sèna ka baku lèke tipu!

source_text: beware of those people who are dangerous met like wild dogs. they are dangerous evildoers dou. beware of them since they are like people who cut other people's bodies met. they will harm you spiritually by insisting that you must let someone circumcise you in order for you to become god's people mty, met.
target_text: baku pamud'e dènge dhèu kapod'e-kabèli, dhu laka-seti dhèu, peka na, miu hud'i suna ku, ho j'aj'i tadha, na, miu se dhèu unu lamatua. madhutu iia-iia na, lamatua paredha boe sèmi èèna! rèngu sala le èèna! te ngaa masi ka sèmi èèna, ra bata-magèla dhèu nuka sèmi busa pakadhi sa.

source_text: those people think that they are god's people because someone has circumcised them. but we, not they, are truly god's people met, whether or not someone has circumcised us. god's spirit enables us to mty worship god; we praise christ jesus because he has enabled us to become the people of god. we do not believe that god will consider/make us his people as a result of what someone has done to our bodies mty, syn.
target_text: te rèngu peka, na, lamatua sèmi nare dhèu lula rèngu suna. te ngaa èèna sala! èdhi te'a le, na, lamatua sèmi nare dhèu lula ra parcaya yesus. ka dhèu dhu tare'a-re'a unu lamatua, nuka èdhi dhu parcaya yesus! èdhi dhu pahaha iisi mi nèngu, madhutu roh na dhu mola-mèci. èdhi ka dhu ded'e padedha-dedha yesus kristus, lula na bhoke nare le j'ara, ho èdhi bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua. te èdhi bisa boe abhu mamuri, lula madhutu tatao dhèu rai-haha di.

source_text: we do not trust in those rituals to make us acceptable to god, although i could very well do that if it would be useful for me. in fact, if i could benefit from it for my salvation, i could rely upon what i have done and who i am mty, syn more than anyone else could! i will tell you why.
target_text: uru èèna, ja'a pangee dhu èci èèna ka dènge rèngu kahèi, peka na, dhèu bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua, sad'i ra suna. madhutu iia-iia na, sèra sa sasab'a dhèu rai-haha di! ladhe neo padhue sasab'a dhèu rai-haha, na, ja'a bisa padhai lii padedha iisi risi nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i, lula uru èèna sasab'a ja'a lèke mola-mola dènge atora agama dhèu yahudi aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: i was circumcised {someone circumcised me} when i was one week old. i am from the people of israel. i am from the tribe of benjamin. i am completely hebrew in every way. while i was a member of the pharisee sect, i strictly obeyed the laws that god gave moses. i was so zealous to make people obey those laws that i caused the people who believe in christ to suffer because i thought they were trying to abolish those laws. indeed, as far as my obeying those laws is concerned, no one could have accused me by saying that i had disobeyed any of those laws.
target_text: madhutu atora agama, ina-ama ja'a suna ja'a, ropa ja'a d'ai aru lod'o. ja'a ne dhèu yahudi tare'a-re'a, lula j'aj'aj'i ja'a nèti suku benyamin, ana-èpu nèti baki isra'el. ja'a maj'èni titu kèna, madhutu mola-mola atora aa'i-aa'i nèti partei agama parisi, toke abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa pasala ja'a. risi-risi hari, ja'a d'èi titu kèna, paj'èra dhèu-dhèu dhu madhutu kristus, lula madhutu a'abhu ja'a, na, dhèu se rai eele le atora agama èdhi.

source_text: nevertheless, all such things as those, which i used to consider to be useful to me, those very things i now consider worthless, because i want to know christ or, in order that i may know christ. more than that, i consider all things to be worthless, compared to how great it is to know christ jesus my lord. because i want to know him better or, in order that i may know him better, i have rejected all things as worthless. i consider them as useless as met rubbish, in order that i may have a close relationship with christ met,
target_text: te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, ka ngangee ja'a kabèli, ropa ja'a madhutu kristus. de limuri ne, ja'a padedha heka iisi dènge j'ara mamuri dhu uru sèra, lula dènge heka sasoa ngaa-ngaa hia mi mamuri ja'a. madhutu a'abhu ja'a, na, dhu dedha risi nuka: ja'a tadhe kristus, kètu ja'a èèna. j'ara leo aa'i-aa'i ra, nuka sèmi mamumu di.

source_text: and in order that i may completely belong to him. it was not as a result of my obeying the laws he gave moses that god erased the record of my sins. instead, it is because i have trusted in christ that god has declared that i am no longer guilty for my sins, and he enables me to act righteously. it is god himself who has erased the record of my sins, and he enables me to act righteously, only because i have trusted in christ.

source_text: all those things are intended to cease to exist when we use them. and do not obey such regulations/rules, because they are what mere human teachers command and teach.
target_text: te ngaa atora sèra, dhoka pa'ue-ai nèti dhèu rai-haha, ho ra aj'a mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i. madhutu iia-iia na, atora sèra dhodhoka uri j'ara-j'ara dhu èèna na ele iia d'ara di!

source_text: do not obey such regulations/rules; they only cause people to do what their self-directed nature wants to do. those regulations seem to be wise because they urge people to worship as mere human teachers have decided. they urge that people should humiliate themselves, and that people should treat their bodies harshly. but those regulations/rules do not help people at all to not do the sinful things that their self-directed nature wants to do.
target_text: ladhe sèmi dhèu bisa tao madhutu atora sèra, ra pangee, na, bèli-camèd'a dhèu pakab'ua si, aa peka na, rèngu se d'èlu-mèu titu kèna; dhèu dhu tao iisi ra sèmi dhèu kèpe pa'èra atora agama; dhèu dhu d'ara mako; dhèu dhu paj'èra ngi'u unu ra, dènge dhèu dhu maj'èni sogo-tagu. madhutu iia-iia na, aad'o! atora sèra bisa boe pamèu ngangee dhèu rai-haha, dènge d'ara dhu d'èi ad'u-ue bhabhelu!

source_text: you now are alive spiritually, and it is as though you were given new life {god caused you to become alive} when he caused christ to become alive again. so be constantly wanting what is associated with heaven mty, where christ is. there god has given him supreme authority and the highest honor.
target_text: ama lamatua hia le miu mamuri hiu, nuka sèmi nèngu pamamuri hari miu sama-sama dènge kristus. limuri ne, kristus madhèdi le ètu era dhu kab'ua risi ètu baboa g'ana ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i pangee dhoka j'ara-j'ara dhu pakarej'e d'ara lamatua.

source_text: be constantly wanting the blessings that god has prepared for you in heaven mty. do not be constantly wanting to do the evil deeds that people on earth do mty,
target_text: pangee dhoka j'ara-j'ara dhu lamatua d'èi. baku pusi-pahae dènge j'ara dhu dhodhoka pakarej'e d'ara dhèu rai-haha di.

source_text: because you have ceased to behave as you formerly did. you are like people who have died. you now live spiritually together with christ in the presence of god; and people cannot see that you have a new life.
target_text: te miu madhe kahèi, ropa kristus madhe. hèia mamuri hiu miu èèna kalau boe, lula miu pa'èki le dènge kristus, dhu bera-bera dènge ama lamatua ètu sorga.

source_text: when christ, who causes you to live spiritually, is publicly revealed, then god will also reveal you publicly together with christ, and you together with christ will be glorious.
target_text: kristus mamuri ètu d'ara miu, aa na pabe'a mamuri miu. bèli-camèd'a, ropa na lèpa hari mai, miu cèu palere-lere dènge ne kahèi ètu d'ara dadedha dènge kapai na!

source_text: get rid of your evil practices/deeds met, mty as though they were enemies whom you were killing or, stop doing evil things met, mty, just as dead people do not do what is evil. specifically, do not practice sexual immorality. do not commit unnatural sexual acts. do not desire to act like that, and do not desire to do anything that is evil. do not desire to have more things than you need, because, if you do that, you are ◄worshipping material things instead of worshipping god/making material things to become your god►.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i pèci eele ku dad'èi d'ara dhu neo tao bhabhelu-katub'a. nuka sèmi: d'ara d'èi tao j'ara karehe dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali èu; d'ara d'èi tao j'ara-j'ara kaj'alu; d'ara d'èi dhu neo tao madhutu dad'èi d'ara di; d'ara d'èi tao bhabhelu rupa-rupa, aa manga'a dhu d'èi dhoka aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i unu èu di madhutu iia-iia na, sèra sa nuka sèmi èu sogo-tagu, lula èu ded'e padedha-dedha j'ara leo dhu seti eele lamatua.

source_text: do not behave like that since god will punish mty those who disobey him, because of their sins.
target_text: j'ara se'e se ka dhu tao ama lamatua nasa titu kèna, toke na neo huku dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ro'o boe nanene ne.

source_text: you also formerly did those things when you were disobeying god.
target_text: uru èèna, miu mamuri sèmi èèna ka, lula d'ara miu pa'èki dènge j'ara bhelu sèra.

source_text: now, however, as for you, do not do any of these evil deeds: do not get angry in any way dou. do not act maliciously. do not ◄slander/talk evil about► people. do not talk abusively to people.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, miu hud'i pèci eele ku dad'èi d'ara dhu neo ad'u-ue bhabhelu aa'i-aa'i. nuka sèmi: d'èi nasa; d'ara pana-mag'oro; tèka d'ara dènge dhèu; padhai lii pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu; dènge padhai lii kaj'alu.

source_text: do not lie to one another. do not do those things, because you have ◄disposed of/stopped obeying► your former evil nature and stopped doing what you did when you had that former evil nature, and because you have received a new nature. god is causing your new nature to become more and more like his own nature. he created your new nature in order that you might get to know god truly.
target_text: aa miu èci dènge èci baku kapod'e-kabèli. lula miu core eele le dad'èi d'ara dhu neo tao bhelu, aa tèke eele j'ara mamuri dhui sèra. aa limuri ne, miu gati dènge d'ara dhu hiu. èèna nuka sèmi dhèu core eele le mèdha-papake dhui dhu kaj'alu, sèna ka silu mèdha hiu dhu mèu. ama lamatua ka dhu paj'aj'i miu. aa limuri ne, na tao miu asa tadhe pabe'a-be'a nèngu, aa tao miu j'aj'i ca ropa dènge ne.

source_text: as a result of that, it is not important whether anyone is a non-jew or a jew, or whether anyone is circumcised or not, or whether anyone is a foreigner, or even uncivilized, or whether anyone is a slave or not a slave. but what is important is christ, who is supremely important in every way.
target_text: ètu d'ara mamuri hiu ne, èdhi hag'e boe, na, rèngu sèra dhèu yahudi, do dhèu yahudi boe; dhèu dhu madhutu suna, do dhèu dhu suna boe; dhèu leo rai kara, do dhèu dhu ad'a aad'o; dhèu ènu, do ènu boe. se'e se kolo-karisi na, aad'o! te ngaa dhu lèke ka, ladhe rèngu pa'èki dènge kristus, aa nèngu mamuri ètu d'ara ra.

source_text: because god has chosen you to be his people; and because he loves you, be compassionate to one another. be kind to one another. be humble. be meek or, be considerate toward one another, be patient with one another,
target_text: ama lamatua hag'e nare le miu, lula na sue miu. dad'èi na sèna ka miu j'aj'i dhèu mola-mèci na dhu leko-leo nèti dhèu rai-haha leo sèra. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i j'aj'i ku dhèu d'ara hua iia, d'ara be'a, pahaha iisi, lii mako, dènge taha mere d'ara.

source_text: and tolerate one another's flaws. forgive one another, if one of you has a grudge/complaint against another. just like the lord jesus freely/willingly forgave you, you too must freely/willingly forgive one another.
target_text: miu hud'i taha mere d'ara, aa èci tadhe mèu èci. ladhe nèti miu, abhu dhu tenge lii langu dènge angalai na, na, baku tèka d'ara dènge ne. te ngaa miu hud'i pabhèlu eele sasala na, aa abho ne, nuka sèmi lamatua dhu pabhèlu eele le sasala miu.

source_text: and what is more important than all of these is that you love one another, because by doing that you will be perfectly united together.
target_text: sanèd'e, ee. te sasue èèna risi aa'i nèti ngaa-ngaa. de miu hud'i pake sasue ne ètu d'ara miu, nuka sèmi mèdha-papake ètu ua. te sasue èèna, nuka sèmi loa hèngu dhu èdhi manènu, sèna ka j'aj'i sig'i dhu saraga titu kèna. ne'e ne ka dhu pa'èki èdhi j'aj'i mi èci.

source_text: because god chose you to live peacefully with one another in your local congregations, let that peace which christ gives control your ◄inner beings/hearts►, and be constantly thanking god.
target_text: èdhi bisa padame dènge ama lamatua, lula kristus. de miu hud'i soro tèke kahèi dadame kristus ne, uri d'ara miu. te lamatua d'èi ka, miu aa'i-aa'i mi mamuri mera-milu èci dènge èci, lula miu pa'èki j'aj'i ngi'u èci. aa d'ara miu hud'i me'a manèngi makasi, lula lamatua unu na ka hag'e nare miu.

source_text: and continue to let the message about christ govern/direct all you think and do, as you very wisely teach and warn one another with psalms and hymns and spiritual songs or, songs that god's spirit gives you, while you sincerely and thankfully sing to god.
target_text: hud'i laa lii holo-nori kristus uri d'ara miu dènge mamuri miu kahèi. lii holo-nori se'e, nuka sèmi mèdha-panyau dhu kab'ua, dhu na pangèd'u mi miu. lii se'e pad'elo j'ara ho miu bisa me'a madha j'ara ae-ae, madhutu ngangee lamatua. ka miu bisa pake lii se'e, sèna ka aj'a-nori, aa pasanèd'e miu èci dènge èci. ladhe nori dhèu-dhèu miu, mage dènge sakaa, te ngaa pake lii dènge d'ara dhu taleo moro-moro dhu pènu dènge rasa makasi. pake lii sod'a koa-kio, lii sod'a dhu miu abhu nèti roh mola-mèci lamatua, aa lii sod'a dhu miu mesa mi suri ho koa-kio ama lamatua.

source_text: whatever you say, and whatever you do, do all of this in the manner that those who are representatives mty of the lord jesus should do, while you constantly thank god, our father, as you ask the lord jesus to take your prayers to god.
target_text: miu j'aj'i le ai g'ana nèti yesus kristus. de sanèd'e, te aa'i-aa'i dhu miu padhue-padhai sèra, mèti kolongara lamatua. aa aa'i-aa'i dhu miu tao sèra mèti kolongara lamatua kahèi. de baku bhèlu tao aa'i-aa'i dènge kolongara kètu miu, yesus kristus. aa manèngi makasi taruu mi ama na, ama lamatua.

source_text: you women, be subject to your husbands, since that is what you should do because you have a close relationship with the lord jesus.
target_text: bhèni dhu dènge dhèu èmu! miu hud'i mamuri nanene ku dhèu èmu miu, lula èèna ka dhu lèke mi dhèu-dhèu dhu madhutu yesus kristus.

source_text: you men, love your wives; and, do not be harsh with them.
target_text: mone dhu dènge dhèu èmu! miu hud'i sue ku dhèu èmu miu, aa baku sakaa dènge ne, ka papèd'a d'ara na.

source_text: you children, obey your parents in every circumstance, because the lord god is pleased when you do that.
target_text: ana-ana aa'i-aa'i! miu hud'i nanene ina-ama miu, ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra, te èèna ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua.

source_text: you parents or, you fathers, do not correct your children more than you need to, in order that they do not become discouraged.
target_text: ina-ama aa'i-aa'i! miu baku ènyi aa lii taka leli mi ana-ana miu, te aad'o na, ra nasa ka ra parui. mage-mage d'ara ra ta'u'a dènge miu.

source_text: you slaves, obey your earthly masters in every circumstance. do not obey your masters only when they are watching mty you, like those who merely want to impress their masters favorably. instead, obey your masters sincerely. do this because you reverence the lord jesus or, god.
target_text: dhèu sab'a sèra! ètu rai-haha ne miu hud'i tao ku madhutu dad'èi lamatua miu ètu d'ara sasab'a aa'i-aa'i ra. mage dhoka mere d'ara di, lod'o dhu lamatua miu ètu madha miu. te ngaa tenge la j'ara, ho pakarej'e taruu d'ara ra. sab'a dènge be'a, lula miu dhu me'a, na, ama lamatua dhu ladhe patae miu.

source_text: whatever work you do, work wholeheartedly. work wholeheartedly, like those who are working for the lord jesus. do not work like those who are working merely for their masters, because you know that it is the lord who will properly/justly repay you. that is, you will receive what god has promised. remember that it is christ who is the real master whom you are serving.
target_text: miu sad'i sab'a ngaa èèna ka, na, sab'a la mola-mola. miu hud'i sab'a sasab'a miu dènge d'ara kateme hia lamatua miu ètu rai-haha ne, nuka sèmi miu sab'a hia kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. de miu lalau-lalo'o ne, te nèngu ka dhu b'ala rui-j'aj'èra miu, dènge hia miu pusaka.

source_text: but god will judge everyone impartially. he will punish you according to what you have done that is wrong.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu sab'a lèke boe j'ara, bèli-camèd'a na huku miu. lula nèngu èèna dhu bia boe cabèka, aa ladhe boe rèhu dhèu.

source_text: you masters, treat your slaves justly and fairly, because you know that you have a master who is in heaven who will say whether he approves of what you have done.
target_text: miu lamatua sèra! miu hud'i uri ku dhèu dhu sab'a hia miu sèra dènge mola, aa bia boe cabèka. sanèd'e ee, te miu dènge lamatua ètu sorga dhu uri miu kahèi.

source_text: pray to god persistently, and as you pray, be alert and be thanking god.
target_text: miu hud'i maj'èni sabaj'a. aa miu hud'i mase'a ku dènge j'ara-j'ara dhu miu padhai dènge ama lamatua, aa manèngi-mangaj'i dhu pènu dènge d'ara makasi.

source_text: since i am in prison mty because i declared the message about christ that god has now revealed, pray also for me that god will give me opportunities mty to speak, in order that i might declare it.
target_text: baku bhèlu sabaj'a hia ji'i, aa manèngi ho ama lamatua bhoke j'ara, sèna ka ji'i bisa lole dènge dhèu, j'ara-j'ara dhu uru èèna pahuni lula-nèti kristus. sanèd'e, te ja'a ètu d'ara bui ne, lula ja'a padhue-padhai kristus mi dhèu.

source_text: that is, pray for me that god will enable me to make his message known publicly. i need to do this because i know that i should declare it.
target_text: sabaj'a sèna ka ja'a bisa lole paled'a lii lolo be'a ne, sèna ka dhèu bisa re'a mèu.

source_text: act wisely towards those who do not believe in the lord jesus mty; use every opportunity to do that.
target_text: mamuri dènge mola ètu talora aae dhèu dhu parcaya mèka kristus. pake paie-iie lod'o dhu taleo dhu ama lamatua hia miu.

source_text: in particular, always speak graciously and in a pleasant way to those who do not believe in the lord jesus. as a result, you will come to know in what manner you should answer each one of them.
target_text: ladhe miu padhai lii, padhai dènge lii mako, dhu palèke dènge d'ara dhèu. mage padhai dhu paroca dhèu. pake lii-lii dhu lèke, sèna ka miu bisa dhaa hari dènge be'a, ladhe abhu dhèu pakarèi dènge miu.

source_text: tychicus will tell you all that has been happening to me. he is a fellow believer whom i/we exc love and who helps me faithfully and who serves the lord jesus together with me.
target_text: pe tikikus dhiu lole dènge miu, j'ara mamuri ja'a. nèngu ne a'ari pasue èdhi dhu ladhe-leru dhèu-dhèu unu lamatua dhu ne'a boe roca. uru èèna, nèngu pakako sasab'a lamatua sama-sama dènge ja'a kahèi.

source_text: the reason that i am sending tychicus to you with this letter is that he might know how you are and in order that he might strengthen you spiritually. or, in order that you might know about us exc and in order that he might comfort you.
target_text: ja'a pua na dhiu, sèna ka pa'èra d'ara miu, aa lole dènge miu j'ara mamuri ji'i ètu ne'e.

source_text: i am sending him to you with onesimus, who is a faithful fellow believer whom i/we inc love and who is your fellow townsman. they will tell you all about what has been happening here.
target_text: ja'a pua onesimus kahèi lèpa palere dènge ne. onesimus ne a'ari pasue dhu sab'a ne'a boe roca kahèi. nèngu ne, dhèu miu. dua ra, pe lole dènge miu j'ara-j'ara dhu j'aj'i le ètu ne'e.

source_text: aristarchus, who is in prison with me, and mark, who is barnabas' cousin, ◄say that they are thinking fondly about you/send you their greetings►. i have instructed you about mark, so if he comes to you, welcome him.
target_text: aristarkus hia lii maho'o kahèi hia miu. ra taha ne ètu d'ara bui sama-sama dènge ja'a. markus, a'ari nèti barnabas, hia lii maho'o kahèi. uru èèna, ja'a moa mema le dènge miu, na, ladhe markus dhiu pangad'o dènge miu, na, sèmi mere ne dènge be'a.

source_text: jesus, who is also called justus, also ◄says that he is thinking fondly about you/greets you/sends you his greetings►. these three men are the only jewish believers who are working with me in order that people would submit to god as their king, and they have all comforted me.
target_text: yesus, dhu èdhi pangare ne, yustus hia lii maho'o kahèi mi miu. nèti angalai aa'i-aa'i dhu sama-sama pakako sasab'a ama lamatua, dhoka rèngu tèlu ra se'e ka dhu j'aj'i dhèu sarani nèti suku yahudi. aa rèngu se'e ka dhu pa'èra d'ara ja'a.

source_text: epaphras, who is your fellow townsman and who serves christ jesus, ◄says that he is thinking fondly about you/greets you/sends you his greetings►. epaphras prays earnestly for you very often, that you might be spiritually mature and that you might know fully all that god wills for you.
target_text: angalai miu epapras ètu ne'e, aa na hia miu lii maho'o kahèi. nèngu ne dhèu sab'a hia yesus kristus. nèngu ne ka dhu loe boe sabaj'a hia miu dènge a'èra na, aa na manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua pa'èra dènge tao pamèci miu, aa tao miu j'aj'i me'a mèu dad'èi na.

source_text: i can assure you that he prays this because he is deeply concerned for you, for those who live in laodicea city, and for those who live in hierapolis city.
target_text: ja'a pasanèd'e mema miu, na, epapras ne, dhu sab'a bia hia miu dènge dhèu-dhèu kristen ètu kota laodikia dènge kota herapolis.

source_text: luke, the doctor, whom i/we exc love, and demas ◄say that they are thinking fondly about you/send you their greetings►.
target_text: abhu lii maho'o kahèi nèti demas dènge dote lukas dhu èdhi sue.

source_text: tell the fellow believers who live in laodicea city and nympha and the congregation that meets in her house that we ◄are thinking fondly about them/send them our greetings►.
target_text: ja'a hia lii maho'o mi a'ari dhèu parcaya ètu kota laodikia. baku bhèlu hia lii maho'o ja'a mi mama nimfa dènge dhèu-dhèu parcaya dhu tema pakaboko ètu d'ara èmu na.

source_text: after someone reads this letter publicly to you, cause someone to also read it to the congregation that is in laodicea city. and as for the letter that i wrote to the congregation that is in laodicea city, make sure that it is also read among you {you should also read that letter} publicly.
target_text: pe, ladhe miu aa'i-aa'i mi ètu kota kolose baca mere sasuri ne, na, mi pa'adhu hia dhèu-dhèu parcaya ètu kota laodikia, sèna ka rèngu baca kahèi. aa miu hud'i baca kahèi sasuri dhu ja'a pa'adhu kèdhi hia rèngu uru sèra.

source_text: say to archippus, make sure that you complete the task that god appointed you to do, because you have a close relationship with the lord jesus.
target_text: pasanèd'e arkipus, peka na, èu baku bhèlu pakako toke pa'èle, sasab'a dhu èu sèmi more nèti lamatua.

source_text: i, paul, ◄am thinking fondly about you/send you my greetings►. having taken the pen from my scribe, i am now writing this myself in order that you may know that i have truly sent this letter. remember to pray about the fact that i am in prison mty. i pray that our lord jesus christ would continue to act graciously towards you all.
target_text: baku bhèlu, peka na, ra taha ja'a ètu d'ara bui ne era. ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha miu. sasuri ne, ja'a ènyi ai pake kacui-aai ja'a unu ku. salam nèti ja'a, paulus

source_text: i, paul, am writing this letter. silas and timothy are with me. weexc are sending this letter to you who are the congregation of believers in thessalonica city. we inc all worship or, trust in god our father met and our lord jesus christ. we three desire/pray that god, our father, and jesus christ, our lord, will continue to act kindly toward you and will continue to cause you to have inner peace.
target_text: lii maho'o nèti ja'a paulus, dènge angalai ja'a silas dènge timotius. sasuri ne, ji'i pa'adhu hia miu dhèu sarani aa'i-aa'i mi ètu kota tesalonika. miu ka dhu pama'ète mere le, ho madhutu ama lamatua èdhi, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ji'i manèngi, sèna ka ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na hia miu, ho miu mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: we always thank god for you all when we mention you while we pray or, when we pray for you.
target_text: ji'i loe boe manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, lula parcaya miu. mèu-mèda ji'i sabaj'a hia miu aa'i-aa'i mi.

source_text: we thank god because we continually remember that you work for god because you trust in him and you earnestly/energetically help people because you love them. you also endure it when people cause you to suffer. you endure it because you confidently expect that our lord jesus christ will soon return from heaven to rescue you!
target_text: ji'i sanèd'e sasab'a dhu miu sab'a, lula miu parcaya ama lamatua, aa sue ne. miu loe boe nèti j'ara èèna, lula era sarai miu ka lamatua yesus. ji'i loe boe kahèi ngèti j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i asa katanga madha ama lamatua.

source_text: my fellow believers whom god loves, we also thank him because we know that he chose you to become his people.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ji'i nge'a ama lamatua sue miu. nèti èèna ka, na hag'e nare miu j'aj'i dhèu nèngu.

source_text: we know that he chose you because when we told that message to you, we did not speak only words. the holy spirit helped us to speak powerfully/effectively, and he strongly assured us that he was powerfully working in you by means of the message about christ that we told to you. you yourselves know that, because you know how we spoke and how we conducted ourselves when we were with you, in order that we might help you.
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o ji'i dhiu asa tesalonika, ji'i peka-padhai dènge miu lii lolo be'a ama lamatua. lod'o èèna, miu pasa dhilu paie-iie ho nanene lii padhai lii ji'i. miu mesa boe dhoka nanene lii ji'i di, te ngaa miu mèdhi unu mi kahèi koasa ama lamatua nèti roh na dhu mola-mèci èèna. j'ara èèna ka dhu tao miu tare'a-re'a sèmi mere lii lolo be'a èèna. lod'o èèna, miu mèdhi unu mi j'ara mamuri ji'i dhu tasa mera mia, sèna ka me'a tare'a-re'a, j'ara-j'ara lamatua.

source_text: our fellow believers, whom our lord jesus loves, we thank god very frequently for you. it is appropriate/right for us to do that, because god chose you ◄from the beginning mty of creation/before the world existed► in order that he might save you as a result of your believing the true message and as a result of god's spirit setting you apart for god.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ji'i loe boe manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, lula na sue miu. te lod'o na paj'aj'i mèka rai-haha ne, nèngu pama'ète nare le, sèna ka hia miu mamuri. ka na hia roh na ho pamèu miu, lula miu parcaya ngaa dhu tare'a.

target_text: lod'o ji'i lole lii lolo be'a dènge miu, ama lamatua pake lii lolo be'a na ho ère miu, sèna ka miu me'a dadedha dènge kapai nèti lamatua yesus kristus.

source_text: so, our fellow believers, continue to be firm concerning what you believe; that is, continue believing the true teaching that we gave to you by our speaking to you and by our writing a letter to you.

source_text: our lord jesus christ himself and god, our father, loves us and encourages us and causes us to confidently expect to receive the eternal things that he has promised to give to us as a result of christ acting kindly toward us in a way we did not deserve. we strongly pray that god and jesus together will encourage you! and we pray that they will cause you to continue doing and saying things that god considers to be good.
target_text: ji'i manèngi-mangaj'i taruu mi ama lamatua èdhi, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ji'i manèngi sèna ka rèngu pa'èra d'ara miu, ho miu bisa tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a. ji'i manèngi sèmi èèna, lula ji'i nge'a ama lamatua sue titu kèna mi èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti. lula d'ara na hua iia, nèti èèna ka nèngu loe boe pa'èra d'ara èdhi. dènge j'ara ne'e, èdhi bisa sanao-maena taruu mi nèngu.

source_text: as for the other matters, our fellow believers, pray for us that more and more people will hear prs our message about our lord jesus. pray that they will believe this message, as you have done.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! baku bhèlu sabaj'a hia ji'i. sabaj'a sèna ka lii lolo be'a lamatua, pale-palème asa mia-mia dènge malai, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa pakab'ua lii lolo be'a èèna, sèmi dhu lod'o miu abhu lii lolo be'a ca hari ni.

source_text: remember that our lord jesus is trustworthy! so we are sure that he will cause you to continue to be steadfast. we are also sure that he will protect you from satan, the evil one or, from evil.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua kèpe pa'ère lii padhai na. nèngu tao pa'èra miu, aa na bhiri miu nèti dhu bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: because of your close relationship with our lord jesus, we are confident that you are obeying what we have commanded you, and we are confident that you will obey what we are commanding you in this letter.
target_text: aa ji'i nge'a tare'a kahèi, na, lamatua yesus hia miu madhutu ngaa dhu ji'i lole le dènge miu. ka tatu miu tao madhutu le sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: we pray that our lord jesus would enable you to continue knowing that god loves you. we pray also that christ will cause you to continue being steadfast or, being steadfast as he was steadfast.
target_text: ji'i sanao ho lamatua yesus sanoro miu, sèna ka asa me'a, na, ama lamatua sue miu, ka miu èra ètu d'ara j'aj'èra, nuka sèmi kristus uru èèna taha ètu d'ara j'aj'èra na.

source_text: our fellow believers, we command you, with the authority mty that our lord jesus christ has given to us, that you stop associating with every fellow believer who is lazy and refuses to work. that is, you must stay away from those who are not conducting their lives in the manner that we taught you.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a peka mema miu dènge ale ngara lamatua yesus kristus! baku lami pa'èci dènge dhèu dhu bai-eed'a dhu re'a dhoka rodha di. te rèngu sèra madhutu boe èdhi dhu maj'èni sab'a bia.

source_text: we tell you this because you yourselves know that you should behave like we behaved. we ◄did not just sit around without working/were never lazy► while we were living among you.
target_text: miu aa'i-aa'i mi me'a, na, miu hud'i laladhe ku j'ara mamuri ji'i, lod'o ji'i pea ètu talora aae miu. miu mèdhi unu mi. ji'i ngo'o boe core eele lod'o iia d'ara.

source_text: specifically, we did not eat anyone's food if we did not pay that person for it. instead, we worked very hard ◄to support ourselves/to earn the money to buy what we needed►. we worked hard dou during the day and during the night, in order that we would not have to depend on any of you to supply what we needed.
target_text: ji'i sab'a bia mèu-mèda, sèna ka ji'i baku pabia miu. ji'i sèmi boe iia d'ara, nganga'a-nganginu nèti dhèu.

source_text: we have always had the right to depend on you for money, but instead we worked hard in order to make ourselves examples for you, in order that you should behave like we behave.
target_text: ji'i se dhèu sab'a nèti lamatua. de ji'i dènge hak kahèi manèngi ngaa-ngaa nèti miu. te ngaa ji'i ngo'o boe tao sèmi èèna. ji'i neo pad'elo j'ara dhu be'a sèna ka miu madhutu.

source_text: remember that when we were there with you, we kept commanding you that if any fellow believer refuses to work, you should not give him food to eat.
target_text: uru èèna, ji'i hia le kahèi atora dhu peka na, dhèu cee dhu ro'o boe sab'a, baku hia ra'a-rinu.

source_text: we are commanding the same thing again now, because someone has told us that some of you are lazy and not working at all, just interfering with what other people are doing!
target_text: ji'i tadèngi lii, peka na, nèti talora aae miu abhu dhèu dhu bai-eed'a, ro'o boe sab'a. rèngu sèra re'a dhoka bhute dènge soro iisi ra asa d'ara lii langu dhèu leo.

source_text: we command those fellow believers who are not working, and urge them by the authority mty of our lord jesus christ, that they settle down and ◄support themselves by working/work to earn money to buy what they need►.
target_text: ji'i pasanèd'e dhèu sèmi sèra, dènge kolongara lamatua yesus kristus, sèna ka rèngu ele-ho'a. be'a risi rèngu sab'a tenge nganga'a-nganginu dènge èi kabhèsu unu ra.

source_text: fellow believers! do not ever get tired of doing what is right!
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! miu baku roca tao j'ara dhu be'a!

source_text: if any fellow believer refuses to work and does not obey what i have written in this letter, ◄publicly identify that person/tell the congregation what that person is doing►. then do not associate with him, in order that he may become ashamed.
target_text: miu patadhe paie-iie dhèu-dhèu dhu ro'o boe madhutu ngaa dhu ji'i suri ètu d'ara sasuri ne. hud'i rèngu sène, sèna ka ra'e makae.

source_text: do not think of him as though he was your enemy; instead, warn him as you would warn your other fellow believers.
target_text: sad'i miu baku tao si nuka sèmi musu miu. te ngaa kai si dènge be'a, sèmi miu kai a'ari miu mesa mi.

source_text: i pray that our lord jesus himself, who gives inner peace to his people, will give inner peace to you always ◄and in every situation/whatever happens►. i pray that our lord jesus will continue to help you all.
target_text: lamatua èèna, dhèu aae mera-milu. ja'a manèngi ho na hia miu mera-milu ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra. ja'a maena, sèna ka lamatua bera-bera dènge miu.

source_text: now, having taken the pen from my scribe, i, paul, am sending this greeting to you as i write this myself syn. i do this in all my letters in order that you may know that it is truly i who have sent this letter. this is how i always end my letters.
target_text: ja'a pa'èle sasuri ne dènge kacui-aai ja'a unu ku, sèna ka miu me'a, na, sasuri ne tare'a-re'a nèti ja'a. lii limuri tèka, oe pa'èle sasuri leo aa'i-aa'i sèra, ja'a ka dhu suri kahèi.

source_text: i pray that our lord jesus christ will continue to act kindly to you all.

source_text: i, paul, am writing this letter. you know that i am an apostle. i represent christ jesus because god and christ jesus commanded me to do it. god is the one who saved us, and jesus is the one for whom we are confidently waiting to return. you, timothy, are like met a true son to me because you trusted in christ after i told you about him. i pray/desire that god, who is our father, and christ jesus, who is our lord, will continue to act kindly and mercifully to you, and that they will give you inner peace.
target_text: timotius dhu be'a. lii maho'o nèti ja'a, paulus. ama lamatua ded'e le ja'a j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus kristus. aa lamatua yesus, era sanao-maena dhu hia èdhi mamuri taa-taa dènge nèngu, lula ama lamatua pakaj'èu èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo. timotius! èu ne, nuka sèmi ana matana ja'a, lula ja'a ka dhu pad'elo j'ara ka èu parcaya kristus. ja'a sabaj'a sèna ka ama lamatua èdhi, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, pad'elo d'ara hua iia rèngu, aa hia èu mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: i urge you now, just like i urged you when i was going to macedonia province, that you remain there in ephesus city. stay there so that you may command certain persons who teach other believers that they not teach false doctrines.

source_text: and tell people to not continually give their attention to stories that tell about our ancestors, stories in which there are ◄genealogies/lists of our ancestors' names► that seem to be endless. you must command your congregation not to think that these stories are valuable, because whenever people think that, they just start arguing about things uselessly, instead of teaching god's plan, which is concerned with what we believe or, which we know because we trust in christ.
target_text: aa dhèu sèra core eele lod'o iia d'ara kahèi lasi palolo nanuku, pab'ala lii dènge kapod'e-kabèli nèti bèi-baki toke lai ana lai èpu. j'ara sèmi sèra, dhoka hia dhèu patao-palaha, aa hia boe ra mamuri dènge parcaya mi ama lamatua.

source_text: teach them to have pure desires mty and so to know that god approves of what they do, and to sincerely believe the true teaching. by doing that, they will love god well.

source_text: there are some people who have turned away from these true teachings. as a result, they just discuss what is useless.

source_text: we must remember that god did not give moses those laws in order to condemn righteous people. by those laws he condemns people who act as though there were no laws and who refuse to obey anyone. he condemns those who do not revere god and those who sin habitually. by them he condemns those who refuse to perform rituals that are pleasing to god and who show no respect for religion. he condemns those who murder their fathers and who murder their mothers and who murder other people.

source_text: he condemns those who are sexually immoral and those who are homosexuals. he condemns those who kidnap/steal people in order to make them slaves. he condemns those who lie and those who promise something strongly but do not do what they promised. he condemns every other action that is contrary to our true teaching.

target_text: masi ka uru èèna, ja'a d'èi padhai pa'ele iie kolongara yesus, aa paj'èra dhèu-dhèu dhu madhutu j'ara mamuri na. ja'a d'èi ènyi raruri si. bhabhelu ja'a sèmi èèna, lula uru èèna, ja'a ke'a boe ngaa dhu ja'a tao, aa parcaya mèka yesus kristus. te ngaa ama lamatua core eele boe ja'a. ka na pad'elo sasue na mi ja'a. mia hari kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, loe boe pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a! nèngu hia mèngi-nale dhu ae hia ja'a, sèna ka ja'a bisa parcaya ne, aa ja'a bisa sue dhèu leo kahèi nuka sèmi nèngu sue ja'a.

source_text: something that all we believers say is certainly true and is worthy for us to fully accept is that christ jesus came into the world in order to save sinful people so that god would not punish them for their sins. as for me, i consider that i have sinned more than all others.
