source_text: yet christ jesus acted mercifully to me in order that he might demonstrate to people that he is perfectly patient with them. he did that by his being patient with me, one who has sinned worse than everyone else. he wanted what he did for me ◄to be an example/to demonstrate his patience► to people who would later believe in him, and as a result would live forever.
target_text: masi ka ja'a bhelu sèmi èèna, te ngaa ama lamatua huku boe ja'a. te nare ja'a j'aj'i mi tadha sena ka pad'elo sasue yesus kristus mi dhèu dhu bhelu risi eele, nuka sèmi ja'a ne'e ne. dènge j'ara ne'e ka, dhèu leo dhu tao sala sèra bisa parcaya ne kahèi, ka ra abhu mamuri taa-taa dènge ne.

source_text: i desire that people will honor and praise the only true god forever! even though no one can see him, he is the king who rules for all time, who will never die! ◄amen! /that is true! ►

source_text: timothy, you are like met a son to me. so, ◄based on/in accordance with► what someone previously ◄prophesied/told what god revealed to them► about you, i am instructing you to strongly oppose those who teach false doctrines. you should oppose them like met a soldier ◄fights strongly against/opposes► those who attack his countrymen.
target_text: ana timotius dhu be'a! ja'a neo peka dènge èu ngaa dhu hud'i èu tao ku ètu d'ara sasab'a-la'a èu. aa'i-aa'i se, madhutu ngaa dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua peka tèke le lula-nèti èu ne. ladhe èu madhutu lii se'e dènge mola-mola, èu sèmi ca dhèu sordad'u dhu bisa pamusu dènge be'a, ho lab'a bhabhelu-katub'a.

source_text: continue to believe the true teaching and do only what you know to be right! remember that some people have ◄pushed aside/rejected► the true teaching. as a result, they no longer believe met what is true.

source_text: specifically, they should pray for rulers and for all other people who ◄are in important government positions/have authority►, in order that god will help them to rule. as god enables the rulers to rule well, we can live very peaceably as we conduct ours lives doing all that god and others consider to be right and proper.
target_text: sabaj'a sèmi èèna kahèi hia dhèu aae-dhèu aae, dènge dhèu dhu rèd'u paredha. dènge j'ara ne'e èdhi bisa mamuri mera-milu, dènge dame, madhutu dad'èi lamatua, mamuri pamèci dènge dhèu dhu pahaha iisi mi lamatua.

source_text: it is good to pray like that, and it pleases god, who saves us, when we pray like that.

source_text: he is the only one true god! and there is only one person who talks to god on behalf of people. that person is christ jesus, who himself is a man!

source_text: he gave ◄his life/himself► as a sacrifice in order to ransom/redeem all people, which showed at the proper time that god desires that all people be saved {to save all people}.

source_text: i would like that the clothing that women wear be ◄modest and sensible/proper and appropriate► dou. i want them to not fix their hair in fancy/elaborate ways, nor wear gold jewelry, nor pearls, nor expensive clothing in order that they may make themselves attractive. instead, they should be doing things that women who ◄claim to/say that they► worship god should do; that is, they should be doing good deeds.
target_text: dad'èi ja'a kahèi ladhe dhèu-dhèu bhèni re'a lalau iisi ra pake mèdha-papake dhu pantas. dhu tao bhèni j'aj'i bhèni iia, lula boe nèti pasaraga rèu kètu, do pake mèdha-papake dhu kab'ua aae dhu nèti makae, do pake risi eele mèdha hualaa, doi pudhi dènge mutiara. te dhu tao bhèni sèra j'aj'i bhèni iia, nuka d'ara dhu hua iia, aa rèngu tao dhoka j'ara dhu be'a. èèna ka pamèci dènge dhèu bhèni dhu pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua.

source_text: keep in mind that god made adam first, and afterwards he made eve,

source_text: but even though she did that, now women will be saved {god will accept women} as they bear children if they continue to trust god and if they continue to love others, and if they continue to live in a way that is more and more ◄acceptable to god/like god wants them to►, and if they continue to be modest.

source_text: since that is a task that others should respect, an overseer must live in such a way that no one can truly ◄say that he has done anything that is wrong/find fault with him►. specifically, he must be faithful to his wife. he must think clearly about what he does. he must be able to control his behavior. he must be sensible. he must be dignified/respectable. he must welcome and care for guests. he must be able to teach god's truth well.

source_text: he must not be a drunkard. he must not be ready/quick to fight those who make him angry. on the contrary, he must be gentle and he must not be quarrelsome. he must not be greedy for a lot of money.

source_text: he must lead and care for his own household/family well. for example, he must be a man whom his children obey and completely respect,

target_text: be'a risi, pili dhèu dhu mamuri palèke dènge dad'èi kristus. de baku ded'e kètu juma'at nèti dhèu dhu parcaya nèbhu mèka mi yesus. te èèna na, rèngu sèra bisa padedha iisi malai. mage dhoka lamatua huku si, sama sèmi lamatua huku dhèu aae nidhu.

source_text: moreover, an elder must live in such a way that non-christians speak well of him, because if he conducts himself like that, people will not say evil things about him, and the devil will not capture/trap him met like people capture animals in a trap.

target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu èmu ra. rèngu sèra hud'i bhèni dhu mamuri madhutu madha j'ara dènge tatao dhu be'a. mage dhèu dhu tema padhai-kakoli pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu leo. rèngu hud'i dhèu dhu re'a taha rare d'ara, aa dhèu lèka si kahèi.

source_text: deacons must be faithful to their wives, and they must lead well and care well for their children and other people in their houses.

source_text: because if deacons serve well, people will respect them, and they will be able to speak very boldly/confidently about what they believe concerning christ jesus.

source_text: although i hope that i will come and visit you soon, i am writing these things to you now in order that if i ◄am delayed/things prevent me from visiting to you soon►, you will know how believers should conduct their lives and you will be able to teach that to them. i am talking about all those who are members of god's family, all the congregations that belong to the all-powerful god, all those who uphold/support met the true message.

source_text: it is certainly true that the message that god has now revealed is very wonderful! from it, we learn this spiritual truth that we say/sing about christ or, we affirm this teaching to be true and very important. it is what shows us how to live ◄in a godly manner/in a manner that pleases god►. it is what god has now revealed, even though it was not known before. we ◄affirm/say that it is true► concerning jesus christ that, he is the one who appeared on the earth in a human body. god's spirit showed/demonstrated that he is/was truly the messiah or, that he always acted righteously; angels saw him; people preached about him in many nations; people in many parts of the world believed the message about him. god took him up into heaven.

source_text: for example, they forbid believers to marry because they say that it makes us unacceptable to god. they also command that people abstain from eating certain foods. but god created such foods in order that we can eat them! we who believe in christ know the true teaching, and we thank god for the food that he gives us. that is why we can eat it.

source_text: when you teach these things to your fellow believers, you will be showing that you, whom christ jesus appointed, serve them well. you will have become strong spiritually ◄by holding fast/by obeying► the true message that we all believe.

source_text: you must completely reject godless, silly/foolish stories from your ancestors that old people tell. keep training yourself so that you have more ◄godly behavior/behavior that pleases god►.

source_text: some people say, it helps us in some ways if we exercise our bodies. but i say that people benefit very much if they live ◄in a godly way/in a way that pleases god►, because if people live in a godly way, that will benefit them both while they live now and when they live in the future life in heaven.
target_text: olaraga pa'èra ngi'u na, be'a. masi ka babe'a na ciki oo'e di. te ngaa pa'èra ngi'u dènge d'ara ho mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua ètu j'ara aa'i-aa'i sèra, babe'a na ae seli eele. babe'a na mesa boe mamuri ètu rai-haha deo ne'e di, te ngaa mamuri lèpa limuri kahèi.

target_text: èdhi tao era maena mi ama lamatua dhu mamuri. nèngu na ka dhu hia mamuri mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i, risi-risi mi èdhi dhu parcaya na. nèti èèna ka, èdhi sab'a dènge d'ara kateme.

source_text: timothy, by the way you conduct your life, show the believers in your congregation how they should conduct their lives. specifically, speak good things, conduct yourself well, love people, trust god, and be pure in every way. if you do all that, no one will have any reason ◄to belittle/to treat you disrespectfully► because of your being young.
target_text: baku soro tèka dhèu sèra pahae boe èu, lula èu ana ngèru era. èu hud'i j'aj'i conto hia dhèu parcaya sèra, nèti lii padhai èu, nèti kakako èu, nèti d'ara sasue èu mi dedha dhèu, nèti parcaya èu mi yesus kristus, dènge mamuri èu dhu mola-mèci.

source_text: until i come, be sure that you read the scriptures to the congregation and that you exhort/urge them to obey the scriptures, and teach them.

source_text: do not forget to use the abilities that god gave to you as a result of people/us ◄prophesying/telling what god revealed to them► about you, and as a result of the elders putting their hands on you to commission/appoint you to do god's work.

source_text: do these things that i have told you to do! ◄concentrate on them/do them sincerely and wholeheartedly► in order that everyone may see that you are improving in how you do them.

source_text: make sure that the congregation takes care of widows who have no one to care for them. if a widow has children or grandchildren, these children or grandchildren should learn that they are to take care of their own family first. by doing that they can repay their parents and grandparents for all that they did for them when they were young, because doing that pleases god. the widows who are really alone and have no one to help them confidently expect that god will help them. so night and day they pray, earnestly asking dou god that he will help them and others.

source_text: but widows who just want to have a lot of pleasure are spiritually met dead, although they are physically alive.

source_text: if anyone does not take care of those who live in his own house, and especially if he does not take care of his own family, he has ◄denied/quit believing► what we believe and we should consider that he is worse than a person who does not believe in christ.
target_text: aa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu ro'o boe ladhe-leru a'ari na, risi-risi hari isi èmu na, èèna sama sèmi nèngu pèci eele lalèka nèngu mi lamatua. nèngu bhelu risi nèti dhèu dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua.

source_text: so never be ashamed/reluctant to tell others the message about our lord. and do not be ashamed of me, even though i am a prisoner because i preach about him. instead, be willing to suffer as i do as you proclaim the message about christ. endure what you will suffer by letting god empower you to endure it.

source_text: god saved us and chose us to conduct our lives in a pure way. it was not our doing good deeds/actions that caused him to do this for us-something that we did not deserve. instead, before ◄time began/he created the world► he purposed/planned to be kind to us as a result of what christ jesus would do for us. now, as a result of our savior christ jesus having come, it has been revealed {he has shown} that he acts kindly toward us. specifically, christ jesus has declared that we will not remain dead after we die! he has also revealed that, as a result of our hearing and accepting the message about christ, we will live forever in bodies that will not decay!
target_text: lula lamatua ka dhu patabuli èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi. aa na hag'e nare èdhi ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na dhu mola-mèci. na pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èdhi, lula na sue èdhi, masi ka èdhi tao boe ngaa-ngaa ho nia sèmi babe'a na. lod'o lamatua paj'aj'i mèka rai-haha ne, te ngaa pama'ète nare le ho hia yesus kristus mai, sèna ka na pad'elo d'ara hua iia na, aa pala mamuri hia èdhi. ka yesus kristus mai le, aa bhoke paled'a ngaa dhu uru èèna ama lamatua nelu tao, aa pad'elo d'ara hua iia nèngu mi èdhi. na palaho le koasa mamadhe! ne'e ka dhu j'aj'i lii lolo be'a! de cee dhu parcaya lamatua yesus, madhe heka taa-taa, te ngaa mamuri manèro toke d'ai mia-mia dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: i was chosen {christ chose me} to go as an apostle to many places and proclaim that message to people.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua ded'e nare ja'a j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus kristus, sèna ka ja'a lole lii lolo be'a na, aa aj'a-nori dhèu ètu mia-mia.

source_text: so, even though i suffer here in this prison, i am not ashamed of being here or, i am very confident, because i know christ jesus, the one whom i have trusted, and i am convinced/sure that he is able to keep safe the good message that he has entrusted to me or, the things that i have entrusted to him, and that he will reward me at the time mty when he comes again.
target_text: sèra sa ka dhu paj'èra ja'a ètu d'ara èmu bèdho ne. te ngaa ja'a makae boe! lula ja'a ke'a le cee ka dhu ja'a parcaya, nuka lamatua yesus. aa ja'a ke'a kahèi, peka na, nèngu ka dhu pangèd'u sasab'a ne'e mi adhe-aai ja'a, nèngu ka dhu bisa j'aga sasab'a ne'e, aa nèngu ka dhu pa'èra ja'a sèna ka pakako sasab'a ne'e, toke nèngu mai hari.

source_text: be sure that you tell others the same correct message that you heard from me. and as you tell it, keep trusting in christ jesus and keep loving others as christ jesus enables you to do.
target_text: de madhutu ka, j'ara mamuri nèti a'aj'a dhu lèke dhu ja'a pad'elo le dènge èu. ladhe èu parcaya taruu, aa sue dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèmi èèna, ne'e peka na, èu j'aj'i le èci dènge yesus kristus.

source_text: do not let anyone persuade you to change the good message that god has entrusted/given to you. allow the holy spirit who lives in us to direct what you say.
target_text: ama lamatua pangèd'u le ètu d'ara adhe-aai èu kakaja èci dhu kab'ua, nuka a'aj'a dhu lèke. de ladhe-leru pabe'a kakaja èèna! pake roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci dhu ètu d'ara èdhi, sèna ka hud'i laa na pa'èra èu ho ladhe-leru kakaja èèna paie-iie.

source_text: you know that almost all the believers in asia province have ◄turned away from/abandoned► me, including phygelus and hermogenes.
target_text: ele boe èu tadèngi le, na, figelus, hermogenes dènge dhèu leo nèti propensi asia sèra, pusi-pahae heka ja'a.

source_text: but i pray that the lord will be kind to the family of onesiphorus for the following reasons: often he cheered me up and, even though i was a prisoner mty, he was not ashamed ◄of me/to admit he was my friend►. on the contrary, when he came here to rome, he diligently searched for me until he found me. i pray that the lord will be kind to him on that day mty when he, the lord, will judge people. and how much onesiphorus served me in ephesus city, you know very well.
target_text: te ngaa onesiforus leko-leo nèti rèngu. na pakaj'èu boe nèti ja'a. èu mesa mu me'a, lod'o ja'a ètu kota epesus era, nèngu ka dhu ladhe-leru ja'a. limuri ne, na pea ètu kota roma ne'e. ropa na d'ai ne'e, na patangi-tenge ja'a ètu mia-mia. ka na abhu ja'a ètu d'ara èmu bèdho ne. te ngaa na makae boe. na mai taruu ngad'o ja'a ho pa'èra d'ara ja'a. de ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi onesiforus dènge a'ari na aa'i-aa'i ra. ladhe lod'o èle rai-haha ne, ho lamatua pama'ète lii langu dhèu rai-haha, ja'a sanao ho lamatua pama'ète dhu be'a hia mi onesiforus si.

source_text: you are like a son to me. so i urge also that you let god empower you spiritually as a result of christ jesus acting kindly toward you.
target_text: ana timotius dhu ja'a sue! yesus kristus d'ara hua iia titu kèna. limuri ne, èu èci le dènge nèngu. na pa'èra èu. de èu me'a dhoka sèmi more di!

source_text: as you do that, remembering that the message that you heard from me is the same message that other people have affirmed/declared to you, you must entrust/give that message to people whom you can trust, people who will be competent/able/qualified to teach others.
target_text: uru èèna, ja'a aj'a le èu ètu madha dhèu ae lula-nèti j'ara mamuri lamatua dhu mola. de limuri ne ja'a manèngi èu, ho aa'i-aa'i dhu èu tadèngi nèti ja'a, lamu aj'a hari hia dhèu dhu èu bisa lèka si. dhèu sèra hud'i bisa lasi aj'a hari sèmi èèna kahèi mi dhèu leo.

source_text: endure as i do what we suffer for christ jesus, like a good soldier endures what he suffers.
target_text: èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti, nuka sèmi sordad'u yesus kristus. de èdhi pasae j'aj'èra sèmi nèngu kahèi. lula èu ne sordad'u dhu be'a, èu hud'i pasae more ku pala unu mu.

source_text: you know that soldiers, in order to please their captain, do not ◄become involved in civilian affairs/spend time doing other kinds of work► met. so, like soldiers, do not let other matters ◄distract you as you serve/hinder you from serving► christ jesus!
target_text: sordad'u dhu pakako sasab'a bisa boe sab'a pab'ali dènge sasab'a dhu leo. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, nèngu ne'a pakarej'e d'ara komedhaa na.

source_text: similarly, you know that athletes who do not obey the rules of the contest will not be given {not win} the prize met. so, like athletes, do all that christ jesus has commanded so that god will reward you!
target_text: tare conto leo sèmi olaraga. ladhe madhutu lomba, hud'i madhutu ku atora na. te ladhe aad'o, na, kalua! bisa boe abhu juara. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe neo pakako sasab'a lamatua, madhutu ku atora na.

source_text: you also know that a hard-working farmer should be the first to receive some of the harvest met. so, like farmers, work hard for christ jesus and expect that god will reward you!
target_text: ladhe kahèi dhèu sab'a oka-tedhe. na sab'a dènge tèku rui na ètu d'ara oka na. de nèngu ka dhu uru tèka abhu hua-hela.

source_text: think about what i have just written, because, if you do, the lord will enable you to understand everything that you need to understand.
target_text: pangee paie-iie conto sèra. pe ama lamatua hia me'a mèu j'ara sèra aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: endure everything by remembering how jesus christ endured it when he suffered. remember that he came back to life {god raised him from the dead} and god affirmed/declared him to be king as his ancestor king david was. those are things that i tell to people when i tell them the message about christ.
target_text: pangee pabe'a-be'a mi yesus kristus. nèngu èèna ana-èpu dhèu aae daud. na madhe, te ngaa ama lamatua pamamuri ne. èèna ka j'aj'i lii lolo be'a dhu ja'a laku peka-padhai ètu mia-mia.

source_text: i am suffering here in prison because some people oppose the good message that i tell. they have even put me in chains as if i were a criminal. nevertheless, the message from god is not chained {nothing is preventing met others from proclaiming the message from god}.
target_text: lula ja'a lole lii lolo be'a, èèna ka ja'a j'èra sèmi ne'e ne. risi-risi hari ra èki-karadhe ja'a dènge rate, tao ja'a sèmi dhèu bhelu-katub'a sa. te ngaa rèngu taha rare boe lii lolo be'a ama lamatua.

source_text: therefore i willingly endure all that i am suffering for the sake of those whom god has chosen. i do this in order that christ jesus will save them, too, and that they will be forever with him in the glorious place where he is.
target_text: de ja'a sadia pasae rupa-rupa j'aj'èra. sad'i dhèu unu lamatua dhu na hag'e nare sèra abhu mamuri. pe ama lamatua ded'e si padedha-dedha, lula rèngu j'aj'i dhèu unu yesus kristus.

source_text: endure everything as you remember that these words that we all say/sing or, that we teach people are trustworthy: since we have stopped behaving as we did in the past, as though we died when he died, we shall also live with him.
target_text: aa lii se'e mema lèke tare'a: ladhe èdhi mangaku, na, kristus madhe ho gati èdhi, èci èèna ka èdhi madhe tèke eele mamuri dhui, hèia èdhi kahèi mamuri bera-bera dènge ne.

source_text: since we are also patiently enduring what we suffer, we shall also rule with him. but if we say that we do not know him, he also will say that he does not know us.
target_text: ladhe èdhi taha ètu d'ara j'aj'èra, èdhi tèd'u paredha sama-sama dènge nèngu kahèi. te ngaa ladhe èdhi pasili ne, nèngu pasili èdhi kahèi.

source_text: if we ◄are unfaithful/stop doing what he tells us to do►, he will treat us just like he promised to do, because he ◄can never be untrue to himself/always does what he says that he will do►.
target_text: masi ka d'ara èdhi satia boe, te ngaa nèngu satia taa-taa, lula nèngu bisa boe leko-monya. ngaa dhu na peka, èèna ka dhu na tao.

source_text: those whom you appointed to teach others god's truth, keep reminding them about these things that i have told you. tell them strongly that, since god knows what they are doing or, that god will judge them for everything that is wrong that they do, and therefore they must not quarrel ◄about words/about matters that are not important►, because, when teachers quarrel, it helps no one, and because, when they quarrel, they spiritually destroy those who hear them or, they cause those who hear them to quit ◄being committed to christ/believing in christ►.
target_text: pasanèd'e dhèu parcaya, sèna ka rèngu baku bhèlu j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i ra. kai si dènge kolongara ama lamatua, ho ra loe eele ka nèti pa'uji lii padhai lii. te aa'i-aa'i sèra guna boe ngaa-ngaa. dhodhoka pa'ele iie ngangee nèti dhèu dhu nanene.

source_text: ◄do your best/try hard► to be the kind of person that god will approve of. be like a good worker as you teach the true message accurately. if a worker works well, he will not need to be ashamed of or, will be pleased about what he does.
target_text: tenge j'ara dhu be'a, sèna ka tao iisi èu nuka sèmi dhèu sab'a dhu nia abhu koa nèti ama lamatua. dhèu sèmi èèna parluu boe makae, lula nèngu èèna sab'a sasab'a na dènge be'a. èu hud'i j'aj'i dhèu dhu aj'a dènge mola lii holo-nori lamatua mi dhèu, aa baku dènge koe-kapengo. lula lii holo-nori na, mola!

source_text: ◄stay away from/do not talk with► those who talk foolishly and ◄godlessly/say things that displease god►, because those who talk foolishly will become even more ◄ungodly/displeasing to god►,
target_text: pakaj'èu nèti lii padhue dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua, aa nèti lii padhai dhu pakab'ua boe lamatua. te sèra sa dhoka tao dhèu asa bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: and because their message will harm people sim like gangrene/cancer does. you know hymenaeus and philetus. they are two such people who talk in this manner.
target_text: lii padhai dhu bhelu-katub'a sèra paj'ala sèmi èi papèd'a kangker. lii padhai himeneus dènge filetus sèmi sèra ka!

source_text: specifically, they teach a wrong message; that is, they say wrongly that god will not cause dead people to live again because he has already given us spiritual life. they claim that our spiritual life is the only new life that we will receive. by saying that, they cause some people
target_text: dua ra aj'a sala, peka na, dhèu madhe mamuri aa'i hari le. te ngaa èèna lèke boe! dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, rèngu se piku eele nèti ngaa dhu lèke. ngaa dhu rèngu aj'a se'e, pa'ele iie parcaya nèti dhèu cahag'e.

source_text: not to continue to believe in christ. however, the congregations of god are strong met. they are like a strong foundation on which is written: the lord knows the people who really belong to him, and every person who calls jesus mty ‘lord' must stop doing wicked things.
target_text: te ngaa kapua dhu ama lamatua padhèdi nare èèna, kalau-karèto boe. ètu kapua èèna, dhu suri peka na, lamatua tadhe mèu dhèu unu na, aa, dhèu cee dhu pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua, hud'i pakaj'èu ku nèti bhelu-katub'a. kapua èèna, dhèu unu lamatua.

source_text: in a wealthy person's house there are not only utensils made of gold and of silver, but also utensils made of wood and of clay. the gold and silver utensils are used at special occasions/events, and the others are used at ordinary occasions. similarly, in a congregation there are those who ◄are ready/desire► to do great things for the lord jesus, and there are those like the teachers of false doctrines/teachings who are not. therefore, those who rid themselves of what is evil in their lives will be able to work well for the lord. they will be like utensils met used at special occasions, set apart for and especially useful to the owner of the big house. they will be like fine utensils that have been prepared {are ready} to do any kind of good work.
target_text: ètu d'ara èmu dhèu kaja, abhu rupa-rupa mèdha-panyau. abhu dhu tao nèti hualaa iia dènge hualaa pudhi. te ngaa abhu kahèi dhu tao nèti aj'u dènge rai kalili. mèdha dhu kab'ua, lamatua èmu na d'èi pake ètu d'ara iia-aala. te ngaa mèdha dhu biasa sèra, lamatua èmu makae pake ètu madha dhèu. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu rai-haha. ladhe abhu dhu pakaj'èu iisi ra nèti bhelu-katub'a, nèngu èci èèna ka dènge mèdha-panyau dhu kab'ua sèra. lamatua èmu d'èi pake ne, lula nèngu dènge gaguna sèna ka tao rupa-rupa sasab'a dhu be'a.

source_text: because of that, you sg must avoid doing the wrong actions that many young people desire to do. instead, you must earnestly do right actions, believe the true teaching, love god and others, and you must continually be at peace with those who ask the lord to help them and who are pure in every way or, who serve jesus faithfully.
target_text: ana ngèru sèra manahu malai lula madhutu dad'èi ra. te ngaa èu, timotius, hud'i j'aga ngi'u mu paie-iie, ho baku madhutu dad'èi d'ara sèmi èèna. tenge j'ara ho tao dhu be'a taruu. parcaya taruu lamatua. mamuri pasue aa padame dènge dhèu leo. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya lamatua, dhu mamuri dènge d'ara mola-mèci, rèngu d'èi dhoka tao j'ara dhu be'a. de èu, timotius, hud'i mamuri ku sama sèmi rèngu sèra!

source_text: do not talk with anyone who foolishly wants to argue about matters that are not important. do not talk with them, because you know that when people talk about foolish things, they begin to quarrel.
target_text: ja'a pasanèd'e hari èu ca tèka! baku lamu soro iisi asa d'ara lii langu dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua. te sèra sa dhodhoka tao dhèu ho patao-palaha di.

source_text: but those who serve the lord must not quarrel. instead, they should be kind to all people, they should be able to teach god's truth well, and they should be patient with people.

source_text: you need to realize that during the last days mty before christ returns, evil people will make it difficult for believers to behave as they should.

source_text: this is because such evil people will be habitually loving themselves and loving money. they will habitually boast about themselves, they will be proud, and will often say bad things about others. they will disobey their parents. they will not be thankful, nor will they respect anything that is good.
target_text: dhèu dhoka sue ngi'u ra, aa manga'a doi-dhari. rèngu padedha iisi, aa d'èi pahaha dhèu leo, d'èi pakarehe kolongara lamatua, d'èi boe nanene ina-ama ra, re'a boe manèngi makasi, kètu hadhu, d'èi boe madha j'ara lamatua,

source_text: and, although they will pretend that they worship god, they will not let god's spirit work powerfully in their lives. do not associate with such people or, do not let such people join your congregation,

source_text: because some such people, even now, subtly/deceivingly persuade foolish women to let them come into their houses, and then they deceive those women so that they control what those women think. these women have been burdened with sins {have sinned very much} and they have been led to do {they do} the many evil things that they strongly desire to do.
target_text: rèngu maso asa d'ara èmu dhèu dènge rèhu mare, ho lasi kakèj'i d'ara dhèu bhèni dhu èra boe, aa mud'a lèke god'a. dhèu bhèni sèmi sèra sa, mamuri ètu d'ara sasala-sasigo dhu udhu sobhu-sobhu, aa madhutu dhoka rupa-rupa dad'èi d'ara ra.

source_text: even though they are always wanting to learn new things, they are never able to recognize what is true.

source_text: just like jannes and jambres long ago very much opposed moses, so also some people now oppose the true message. those people think only what is evil. god rejects them because they do not believe what is true.

source_text: but as for yourself, you have fully known what i have taught. you have known and imitated the way in which i conducted my life, and what i have been trying to do. you have trusted god as i have. you have been patient as i have been. you have loved people as i have, and you have endured as you suffered like i have suffered.

target_text: mema dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya yesus kristus, aa neo mamuri mola-mèci madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua, tatu dhèu paj'èra rèngu.

source_text: evil people or, and those who deceive other people will ◄get worse/teach things that are more and more wrong►. specifically, they will deceive other people, and those who hear them will deceive others.
target_text: ngaa hari, dhèu bhelu dènge dhèu kapod'e-kabèli sèra, asa tabha bhelu. rèngu kapod'e-kabhèli ho pamanahu dhèu leo, te ngaa rèngu sèra lèke kapod'e kahèi.

source_text: but you, in contrast, must continue to believe what you have learned and ◄been assured of/firmly believe►. i know that you are confident/sure that it is true because you know that you have learned it from all of us who taught you ◄god's truth/what is right►.
target_text: te ngaa èu hud'i kèpe pa'èra-èra lii holo-nori dhu èu abhu le. aa ngaa dhu èu parcaya èèna, madhutu taruu. te èèna ka dhu lèke! èu me'a mèu cee ka dhu aj'a aa'i-aa'i sèra mi èu! èu bisa lèka si!

source_text: from the time when you were a child you have known the holy writings/scriptures. you now know that they enabled you to become wise so that god saved you because of your believing in christ jesus.
target_text: karèi nèti èu ana iiki era, èu abhu a'aj'a le isi nèti sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua. nèti sasuri se'e, èu me'a rahasia mamuri dhu lèke, dhu tao èu me'a mèu j'ara mamuri. nèti èèna ka, èu parcaya yesus kristus.

source_text: god ◄inspired/put into men's minds► everything that is written in the scriptures {they wrote in the holy writings}, and those writings are all useful to teach us what is true, to cause us to know when we are wrong and then ◄to correct us/to show us what we have done that is wrong►, and to train/teach us to do what is right.
target_text: aa'i-aa'i dhu ra suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, mema ama lamatua ka dhu uri ho dhèu suri sèra. gaguna sasuri èèna, nuka: aj'a dhèu ngaa dhu lèke, pad'elo sasala dhèu, ère hari dhèu asa j'ara dhu mola, aa nori dhèu ho bèli-bèli mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: what is written {they wrote} is useful to help us who serve god to be ready/prepared to do all that we should do. by means of it, we are equipped {god gives us what we need} in order to do every kind of good deeds.
target_text: dènge sèmi èèna, sasuri mola-mèci èèna bisa tao pamèci dhèu unu lamatua sèra, sèna ka rèngu re'a sasab'a dhu be'a aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: christ jesus is going to come back and judge those who are living when he comes and those who will have died. he will judge them concerning what rewards they deserve, and he will rule everyone. so, knowing that he and god are watching everything that we do, i solemnly/earnestly command you that you proclaim the true message to people. always be ready/prepared to proclaim it, whether people want to hear it or not. some people are saying things that are not correct; ◄refute their teaching/show why their teaching is wrong►. rebuke them when they are doing wrong. tell them what they ought to do. be very patient while you teach them.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a yesus kristus mai hari asa rai-haha ne, ho nèd'u paredha nuka sèmi dhèu aae. masi ka dhèu dhu mamuri era, do dhèu dhu madhe le, aa'i-aa'i ra lasi asa katanga madha na, sèna ka na pama'ète lii langu ra èci-èci. nèti èèna ka, ètu madha ama lamatua dènge yesus kristus, ja'a manèngi mi èu ho lamu peka-padhai dènge dhèu-dhèu, lii holo-nori ama lamatua. èu pa'èra taruu! baku pangee, na, lod'o dhu be'a, do aad'o. pad'elo sasala dhèu, te ngaa kai si pabe'a-be'a dènge lii mako. pa'èra d'ara dhèu pake lii holo-nori dhu lèke.

source_text: do these things because there will be a time when people will not listen to good teaching. instead, they will bring in many teachers for themselves who will tell them just what they want to hear idm. the reason that they will bring in such teachers is that they want to do the evil things that they desire.
target_text: te bèli-camèd'a, dhèu ro'o heka nanene lii holo-nori dhu lèke. pe ra kaboko rare mese-mese dhu d'èlu-mèu padhue-padhai madhutu dad'èi ra, sèna ka pabe'a ro'a dhilu ra.

source_text: that is, they will not listen to mty what is true, but will listen instead to strange stories from our ancestors.
target_text: ra hutu dhilu ra ho tule eele lii holo-nori dhu lèke. te ngaa pasa dhilu ra, ho nanene lii lolo nanuku dhu leko-monya sèra!

source_text: furthermore, i command that you always control what you think and do. be willing to endure hardships/suffering. your work should be telling people the message about christ jesus. as you serve the lord, do everything that god has told you to do.
target_text: masi ka tasamia èèna ka, èu hud'i taha d'ara. pa'èra ètu d'ara j'aj'èra. lamu lole lii lolo be'a, sèna ka dhèu sèmi rare yesus kristus. soru-bara dhèu dènge d'ara kateme, toke pa'èle sasab'a. baku dènge d'ara cabèka.

source_text: timothy, i say these things to you because as for me, it is as though met they are now about to kill me. it is as though my blood will be poured out {they will kill me} as a sacrifice on the altar; that is, i know that it is the time for me to die eup.
target_text: baku pusi dènge ngi'u ja'a ne, te lod'o mamadhe ja'a dètu le. èci èèna ka dènge galaa dhu isi na oe èle kèna.

source_text: and as to telling people the good message and defending it, i have ◄exerted myself thoroughly/done it with all my energy► met, like a boxer does. as to doing the work that god gave me to do, i have completed it, like a runner who finishes met the race. as to what we believe, i ◄have been loyal to it/continue to believe it►.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a segi le ètu d'ara pa'uji èèna dènge be'a. ja'a rai d'ai le lane. ja'a madhutu taruu le yesus kristus dènge be'a.

source_text: so, like people award a prize met to the winner of a race, the lord, who judges rightly, will give me a reward because i have lived righteously. he will give me that reward when mty he judges people. and not only will he reward me, but he will also reward all those who very much want him to come back.
target_text: de ne'e ne, di èci ka dhu ja'a tatae. nuka piala juara dhu lamatua tao tèke le hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri mola. lamatua èdhi èèna, nuka dhèu pama'ète lii langu dhu mola. dhu ne'a boe bia cabèka. ladhe d'ai ka lod'o na, na pangèd'u mi ja'a piala juara èèna. te ngaa mesa boe ja'a di. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu sue ne, aa dhu mate mamai na, rèngu sèra abhu piala sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: ◄do your best/try hard► to come to me soon.
target_text: timotius! mai ka lai-lai ngad'o ja'a!

source_text: i say that because demas has left me. he wanted very much the good things that he might enjoy mty in this world right now, and so he went to thessalonica city. crescens went to serve the lord in galatia province, and titus went to dalmatia district.
target_text: te limuri ne ja'a kaliu bia. krekes la'e le asa propensi galati. aa titus la'e le asa rai dalmatia. aa demas sue risi j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke boe ètu rai-haha ne, la'e le sa kota tesalonika.

source_text: luke is the only one who is still with me of those who were helping me. and when you come, bring mark with you, because he is useful to help me in my work.
target_text: dhodhoka lukas di dhu pea dènge ja'a ètu ne'e. tenge more markus sèna ka dua mi mai palere-lere. te nèngu èèna bisa ladhe-leru ja'a ètu ne'e.

source_text: tychicus cannot help me because i sent him to ephesus city.
target_text: ja'a hia le tikikus la'e asa kota epesus.

source_text: and when you come, bring the coat that i left with carpus in troas city. also, bring the books, but ◄most of all/especially► i want ◄the parchments/the animal skins► on which important things are written.
target_text: ladhe èu mai, baku bhèlu mèti kodho pana ja'a dhu tèke eele ètu èmu karpus ètu kota troas. aa baku bhèlu mèti dènge sasuri ja'a sèra, risi-risi dhu ja'a suri ètu ka'uri badha.

source_text: alexander, the man who makes things from metal, did many evil/harmful things to me. the lord will punish him for what he did.
target_text: aleksander, tuka tabaga èèna, tao bhelu dhu ciki boe mi dedha ja'a. hud'i nèngu sène, te bèli-camèd'a, lamatua ka dhu b'ala ne, sèmi dhu nèngu tao mi dedha ja'a.

source_text: so you, too, must beware of him. he will try to destroy your work if he can, because he very much opposes the message that we proclaim.
target_text: èu hud'i mage-mage ku dènge dhèu èèna, lula nèngu na d'èi palab'a lii-lii dhu èdhi aj'a-nori.

source_text: when i first defended myself in court here, no one came along to help defend me. instead, they all left me. i pray that it will not be counted against {god will forgive} them lit for leaving me.
target_text: lod'o hiu-hiu ja'a titu ètu madha hakim ho siri iisi ja'a, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu re ja'a. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra kako tèke eele ja'a mesa ku. te ngaa hud'i rèngu sène! pe lamatua pabhèlu eele sasala ra.

source_text: nevertheless, the lord was with me and strengthened me. he enabled me to fully preach the message, and all the non-jewish people in the court or, people from many nations heard it. and i was rescued by the lord {the lord rescued me} from great danger, as if i were taken met out of a lion's or, wild animal's mouth.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ama lamatua tèke eele boe ja'a. na pa'èra ja'a, sèna ka ja'a bisa peka-padhai lii lolo be'a na dhu pakura boe ciki sa. ja'a lolo sèmi èèna ka mi dhèu yahudi boe, ho ra nanene lii lolo be'a. aa pakaj'èu le nèti mamadhe-mamopo.

source_text: therefore, i am sure that the lord will rescue me from everything that is truly evil and will bring me safely to heaven, where he rules. praise him forever! ◄amen! /may it be so! ►
target_text: aa èèna na ama lamatua pakaj'èu ja'a nèti bhabhelu-katub'a aa'i-aa'i ra. aa lere nèti ja'a dènge sod'a-mole laku asa sorga. ètu era nèi, nèngu ka dhu nèd'u paredha. lamatua èèna, kapai seli eele! ja'a koa-kio ded'e padedha-dedha ne, dhu ma'ète boe! tare'a sèmi èèna.

source_text: greet for me priscilla and her husband aquila and the family of onesiphorus.
target_text: baku bhelu mèti lii maho'o ja'a mi ina priskila dènge dhèu èmu na akila. sèmi èèna kahèi, mi a'ari onesiforus.

source_text: erastus stayed in corinth city. trophimus, i left in miletus city because he was sick.
target_text: erastus pea ètu kota korintus. ca hari ni, ja'a tèke eele trofimus ètu kota miletus, lula na pèd'a aae.

source_text: ◄do your best/try hard► to come to me before ◄the stormy season/winter►. eubulus, pudens, linus, claudia, and many other fellow believers in this city ◄send their greetings to/say that they are thinking affectionately about► you.
target_text: tenge j'ara sèna ka lod'o d'ai mèka hèru pacuhi, èu dhu d'ai le ne'e. angalai ètu se'e se, nuka: ebolus, pudes, linus dènge ina klaudia pa'adhu lii maho'o hia miu. sèmi èèna kahèi, dènge a'ari dhèu kristen dhu leo sèra.

source_text: i pray that the lord will help you in your spirit, timothy, and that he will act kindly toward all of you believers who are there.
target_text: ja'a sanao sèna ka ama lamatua sama-sama dènge èu taruu. sèna ka lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi miu aa'i-aa'i mi. d'ai sange ne'e ka, paulus

source_text: i, paul, am writing this letter to you, titus. god appointed me to be his servant and to be an apostle who represents jesus christ. god appointed me in order that i might teach those whom god has chosen to be his people to correctly believe in him. he wants me to teach them the true teachings about god, in order that they will learn to behave ◄in a godly manner/in a manner that pleases god►. as a result of my doing these things, his people confidently expect that god will cause them to live forever. god, who never lies, promised before he created the world that his people would live forever. then at the time that he chose, he revealed to us his message. specifically, god our savior gave this message to me, and he trusted me to proclaim it to people. titus, i am writing this letter to you because you are like a true son met to me because i led/helped you to believe the same teachings about christ that i do. ◄i pray that/may► god our father and christ jesus our savior will continue to act kindly toward you and cause you to have inner peace.
target_text: ana titus dhu be'a! sasuri ne'e nèti ja'a, paulus, ana pua-paleha ama lamatua, aa dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus kristus. na pua ja'a sèna ka pa'èra parcaya dhèu dhu na hag'e nare sèra. na pua ja'a ho pad'elo j'ara mola kahèi, sèna ka ra mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua. dènge sèmi èèna, dhèu unu ama lamatua re'a, na, bèli-camèd'a rèngu mamuri taa-taa dènge ne. lod'o ama lamatua paj'aj'i mèka rai-haha ne, te ngaa na moa mema, bèli-camèd'a dhèu unu na mamuri taa-taa dènge ne. nèngu ne'a boe leko-monya. d'ai lod'o na, ka ama lamatua peka paled'a, na, nèngu saku eele sasala-sigo dhèu, sèna ka ra mamuri taa-taa dènge ne. aa na paredha ja'a ho laku peka lii lolo be'a hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu mia-mia. titus! èu ne nuka sèmi ana d'èlu ja'a sa, lula èu dènge ja'a ne sama-sama parcaya kristus. de ja'a sabaj'a mi ama lamatua dènge yesus kristus dhu hia mamuri mi èdhi, sèna ka ra pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra mi èu, ho èu mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: when i asked you to stay on crete island, i wanted you to do these things: teach the believers what they need to know so that they can understand correctly the spiritual matters about which some are teaching wrongly. appoint elders in the congregation in each town in the manner in which i told you to do.
target_text: ca hari ni, ja'a pama'ète kore le, ho èu pea ètu pulu kreta, sèna ka uri pèri-pèri j'ara dhu èdhi parluu era ètu èèna. aa hud'i laa èu ded'e dhèu dhu re'a lalau-lalo'o juma'at ètu d'ara rae-rae. baku bhèlu atora dhu ja'a peka le dènge èu, lula-nèti dhèu dhu j'aj'i kètu juma'at. peka na:

source_text: when you appoint men as elders, you must choose men whom no one can justly accuse of habitually doing what is wrong or, whom everyone speaks well of. specifically, appoint men who have been faithful to their wives. appoint men whose children faithfully obey them. do not appoint men whose children habitually do all the things that their bodies urge them to do, or who refuse to obey their parents.
target_text: ladhe neo ded'e dhèu ho j'aj'i kètu juma'at, nèngu hud'i mamuri ku dènge boe sasala. nèngu hud'i satia dènge dhèu èmu na ca dhèu di. ana-ana na parcaya kahèi yesus kristus. mage dhoka dhèu peka, na, rèngu sèra ana-ana dhu tenge patao-palaha di, aa palab'a dènge dhèu.

source_text: leaders of the congregation must be men who, as everyone knows, habitually do what is good or, whom no one can justly accuse of doing what is wrong, because it is on god's behalf that they will direct/serve the congregation. specifically, they must not be arrogant/proud. they must not easily become angry. they must not be men who drink much alcohol. they must not be men who ◄act violently/fight► when they are angry. they must not be men who are ◄greedy for/strongly desire to get► money.
target_text: lula kètu juma'at sèra pakako sasab'a lamatua, de rèngu hud'i mamuri dènge mola, aa dènge kolongara hua iia. baku ded'e dhèu dhu d'èi padedha iisi; dhu nasa malai, d'èi mahu, dhu d'èi pagama, aa dhu manga'a doi-dhari.

source_text: instead, they must be ones who welcome and take care of guests. they must ◄be devoted to/like to do► what is good. they must do what god considers to be right. they must be ◄holy/completely dedicated to god►. they must be men who do what their minds tell them is right to do and not what their emotions/desires urge them to do.
target_text: dhèu dhu j'aj'i kètu juma'at sèra hud'i d'èi sèmi rare dhèu asa d'ara èmu ra. dhu d'èi j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a, dhu taha rare d'ara, dhu bia boe cabèka, dhu d'ara mola-mèci, aa dhu re'a taha rare ngi'u.

source_text: they must firmly believe in the message about jesus christ exactly as i/weinc taught it, in order that they might be able to teach the believers what is correct and to urge them to follow it well. if they firmly accept our message, they will be able to convince those who oppose what is correct that they are wrong.
target_text: rèngu hud'i kèpe pa'èra-èra ku lii holo-nori ama lamatua, dhu uru èèna èdhi nori si. dènge sèmi èèna, rèngu pad'elo j'ara lamatua dhu mola hia dhèu leo, aa bisa pamola lii lolo dhu lèke boe j'ara sèra.

source_text: i say this because there are many people who oppose the correct teachings. they refuse to obey people who have authority over them, they talk ◄on and on/without stopping►, saying what helps no one, and they deceive people. the jewish believers mty who insist we must obey all the jewish rituals are especially doing this.
target_text: te abhu dhèu ae dhu d'èi palab'a a'aj'a dhu lèke. abhu dhu peka-padhai dènge boe kolo-kapua. aa abhu kahèi dhu d'èi kapod'e-kabèli. risi-risi dhèu yahudi dhu peka, na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu neo abhu mamuri hud'i suna ku.

source_text: you and the leaders whom you appoint should prevent such people from teaching the believers. they are causing whole families to stop believing in the correct teachings met by means of their teaching people wrong ideas/teachings. they are teaching people only in order that people will give them money, which is very shameful for them to do.
target_text: ra pake a'aj'a rèngu dhu sala ho nuni rèti a'ari èdhi pakaj'èu nèti lii holo-nori lamatua dhu lèke. rèngu sèra d'èi dhoka tenge doi-dhari dènge j'ara kapod'e-kabèli di! kai dhèu sèmi sèra sa, sèna ka ra loe nèti aj'a j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke boe.

source_text: a man from crete island whom they consider a prophet said, my fellow cretan people are always lying to one another! they are like dangerous wild animals met! they are lazy and always eat too much food syn!
target_text: ca tèka, dhèu èci nèti pulu kreta, dhu tema padhai pake lii hini, lole dhèu nèngu unu na, aku nèngu na, dhèu pulu kreta d'èi dhoka padhai lii hèb'a hua di, dhu manga'a, nuka sèmi badha hui dhu re'a boe atora, aa bai-eed'a mèje adhe!

source_text: the words that this man said about the cretan people are still true, especially about their being liars. so, rigorously convince/show those cretan believers that those false teachings are wrong. tell them to firmly believe in the correct teachings.
target_text: mamuri dhèu sèra mema sèmi èèna ka! de èu hud'i lamu ère more hari dhèu dhu lèke kapod'e-kabèli sèra, ho pa'èra hari parcaya ra mi lamatua.

source_text: teach them that they should no longer listen to the stories that the jews ◄made up/invented►. especially they should refuse to obey those who reject our true teachings, because those people are teaching things that only come from human beings, not from god.
target_text: èle èèna, ra nanene ia ka nanuku nèti dhèu yahudi sèra, aa rèngu hud'i ae eele ku nèti lii paredha dhèu-dhèu dhu tule eele lii holo-nori dhu lèke.

source_text: believers should reject what they teach about food, because no food that we eat can make us unacceptable to god if we are pure in our ◄inner beings/hearts►. but if people are evil and they do not trust in christ jesus, there is no ritual that can make them acceptable to god. such people's way of thinking has been ruined {such people have ruined their way of thinking}, and they do not even feel guilty when they do what is evil.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! bagi dhèu dhu d'ara mola-mèci, aa'i-aa'i mola-mèci. te ngaa bagi dhu d'ara kaj'alu aa dhu parcaya boe lamatua, abhu boe ngaa èci sa dhu mola-mèci. lula d'ara dènge ngangee rèngu dhu kaj'alu mema le.

source_text: even though they claim/say that they know god, by what they do they show that they do not know ◄god/his true teaching►. they do not obey god, and they are unable to do anything that he considers to be good. so god considers them to be absolutely disgusting!
target_text: rèngu mangaku tadhe ama lamatua. te ngaa mamuri ra nuka sèmi dhèu dhu tadhe boe ne. rèngu padhai lii leo, tao leo. rèngu mema tare'a-re'a dhèu karehe di! rèngu ro'o boe madhutu dad'èi lamatua. baku maena dhèu sèmi sèra re'a tao dhu be'a!

source_text: but as for you sg, teach the believers what agrees with the correct teachings.
target_text: te ngaa èu ne, titus, baku j'aj'i sèmi rèngu kahèi! èu hud'i pa'èra d'ara dhèu, sèna ka ra mamuri madhutu lii holo-nori lamatua dhu lèke.

source_text: specifically, tell the older men that they should control themselves ◄in all situations/whatever happens►, that they should behave in such a manner that all people will respect them, and that they should control what they say and do. and tell them that they should firmly believe in the correct teachings, that they should sincerely love others, and that they should always be steadfast.
target_text: peka dènge ama-ama dhèu heka sèra ho mamuri madhutu atora, j'aga paie kolongara, aa taha rare d'ara. rèngu hud'i kèpe pa'èra aa taha taruu madhutu lii holo-nori ama lamatua dhu lèke. aa rèngu hud'i sue dhèu leo kahèi.

source_text: similarly, tell the older women that they should behave ◄in a reverent manner that shows that they are devoted to god/in a manner that honors god►; specifically, they should not ◄slander others/talk evil about others►, and they should not ◄be drinking much/habitually drinking► alcohol. tell them that they should teach the younger women what is good,
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge ina-ina dhu heka sèra. peka dènge ra j'aga paie kakako dènge lii padhai ra, aa mamuri taruu madhutu dad'èi lamatua. baku padhai-kakoli kolongara dhèu. baku j'aj'i ènu dhua ara-dhua pèd'u. te ngaa rèngu hud'i aj'a dhèu, sèna ka ra mamuri dènge mola.

source_text: in order that they may love their husbands and their children.
target_text: dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, rèngu j'aj'i dhèu pad'elo j'ara mi ina-ina dhu ngèru era, sèna ka ra sue dhèu èmu-kamali dènge ana-ana ra.

source_text: older women should teach younger women to control what they say and do and to be pure in every way, to be good workers at home and submissive to their own husbands. the younger women should behave like this in order that no one will speak against the message about god.
target_text: rèngu hud'i aj'a kahèi dhèu ho ra mamuri dènge taha rare d'ara, mola-mèci, re'a lalau d'ara èmu, re'a pahae dhèu èmu ra, aa d'èi nanene lii dhèu èmu ra. ladhe mamuri rèngu sèmi èèna, dhèu bisa heka padhai lii pahaha lii holo-nori ama lamatua.

source_text: as for the younger men, similarly, urge them to control themselves in all that they say and do.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, holo mone ngèru sèra, sèna ka ra mamuri dènge taha rare d'ara.

source_text: you yourself must continually do what is good in order that others will see how they should behave. teach the believers sincerely and seriously;
target_text: titus! èu ne hud'i mamuri dènge be'a ku, ho bisa j'aj'i dhèu pad'elo j'ara mi dhèu leo. sad'i èu tao ngaa èci sa, sab'a dènge be'a, sama sèmi dhu èu aj'a dhèu sèra. ladhe èu aj'a ngaa sa èci, na, tao madhutu ngaa dhu èu aj'a sèra. mage pamud'e dènge sasab'a èu.

source_text: teach what is correct and what no one can justly criticize. do this in order that when the believers conduct their lives in a proper manner, anyone who opposes ◄us/our message► will be disappointed because there will be nothing bad that they can justly say about us.
target_text: ladhe èu nori dhèu, pake lii holo-nori dhu lèke, sèna ka dhèu abhu boe j'ara ho pamanahu èu. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, dhèu-dhèu dhu lab'a èdhi ra'e makae, lula rèngu abhu boe j'ara ho segi èdhi.

source_text: as for slaves, specifically, urge them to be submissive to their masters in everything. they should please their masters; specifically, they should not ◄contradict/refuse to obey► their masters.
target_text: aj'a ènu sèra ho ra nanene lamatua rèngu ètu j'ara ngaa èèna ka, aa pakarej'e d'ara lamatua ra. baku ra pab'ala lii padhai dènge lamatua ra.

source_text: they should not steal things that belong to their masters. instead, they should always be completely honest/reliable and thus show their masters that their masters can completely trust them. they should behave like this in order that as a result of all the slaves conducting themselves well, people will realize that the teachings about god our savior are very desirable.
target_text: rèngu baku mana'u mèdha-panyau lamatua ra. rèngu hud'i pad'elo ku dhu peka, na, lamatua ra bisa parcaya rèngu tare'a-re'a. rèngu sèra hud'i j'aj'i dhèu dhu be'a aa satia. ladhe dhèu leo neo pakasame mamuri ènu rèngu dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu èdhi aj'a, tatu ra dhaa, peka na, lii a'aj'a èdhi be'a titu kèna. te a'aj'a èdhi se'e, madhutu j'ara-j'ara ama lamatua dhu hia le mamuri mi èdhi.

source_text: the believers should behave in a good manner, since god did for us what we did not deserve, sending jesus christ to earth in order that he might save all people prs.
target_text: te ama lamatua pad'elo le babe'a d'ara na mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, aa bhoke j'ara ho patabuli dhèu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra.

source_text: god teaches/tells us prs how to stop doing what he dislikes, and to stop desiring the things that ◄ungodly people/people who habitually do things that do not please god► desire mty. he wants us to control our behavior and to do what is right and to do what pleases him while we live in this present age/time.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, mamuri dhu pamèci boe, aa dad'èi dhu karehe, ti core eele si. èdhi mamuri ètu rai-haha ne, hud'i te'a taha tare d'ara, mamuri dènge mola-mèci, aa satia dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: do not forget that we are waiting expectantly for that which will make us very happy indeed mty! we are expectantly waiting for our great god and savior, jesus christ, to come gloriously!
target_text: limuri ne èdhi sanao-maena mamai hari yesus kristus dhu kapai risi eele! èèna j'aj'i mèngi-nale mi èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti. nèngu èèna, lamatua èdhi dhu kapai risi dhu pala-bagi le mamuri mi èdhi.

source_text: he is the one who willingly gave himself ◄to die/as a sacrifice► on our behalf to set us free from all sinful behavior! he wants ◄us to get rid of all our evil behavior/to make our lives pure► met. he wants us, who are his very own people, to be people who are eager to do what is good.
target_text: nèngu hia le ngi'u aae na j'aj'i mi korban, sèna ka patabuli eele èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti, sèna ka tao èdhi j'aj'i dhèu unu na dhu mamuri mola-mèci, dhu d'èi dhoka tao j'ara hua iia di.

source_text: teach the believers these things! urge them to do them! correct those who do not obey them! as you do this, you have my full authority; so do not allow anyone to disregard you!
target_text: de titus, aj'a aa'i-aa'i se mi dhèu sarani sèra. pa'èra d'ara si, sèna ka madhutu a'aj'a sèra. dhèu cee dhu tao sala, na, pad'elo j'ara be'a hia ne. dhèu bisa boe pahaha èu, lula èu dènge hak ho tao paie rèngu.

source_text: remind the believers that they should submit to all those who rule them or have authority over them, and that they should obey them. they should be ready to do anything that is helpful.
target_text: pasanèd'e dhèu sarani sèra, ho nanene dhèu paredha aa dhèu-dhèu dhu rèd'u koasa. rèngu hud'i madhutu ku atora sèra. aa rèngu hud'i pa'èra tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a.

source_text: they should never say bad things about anyone, they should not quarrel with people, they should be patient when others ◄irritate them/do things that they do not like►, and they should always treat all people as important.
target_text: baku lasi padhai pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu. baku d'èi pasibha d'ara lii. be'a risi, mamuri mola, dènge d'ara hua iia mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: remind your congregations about these things because formerly we believers ourselves were also foolish, just like all people who do not believe in christ are now. we did not obey ◄god/god's message►. we let others deceive us. we ◄spent all our time doing/continually did► what is evil and could not stop ourselves from doing all the things that our bodies liked dou. we were ◄envying others/desiring to have what others have►. we were causing people to hate us and we were hating one another.
target_text: te uru èèna, lod'o èdhi tadhe mèka lamatua yesus, èdhi te'a boe ngaa-ngaa, aa dènge mud'a lèke tipu. èdhi to'o boe nanene dhèu leo. èdhi dhoka mamuri madhutu d'ara bhelu di, ka èki ngi'u èdhi dènge rupa-rupa dad'èi d'ara ti. èdhi d'ara karehe dènge dhèu leo. èdhi mamuri dhoka dènge jeluus. èdhi d'èi tèka d'ara mi dhèu leo, hèia ra kab'èli tèka d'ara dènge èdhi.

source_text: even though we were behaving sinfully like this, god our savior acted kindly and lovingly to us prs, and saved us! he did this, not because we did things that are right, but just because he wanted to be merciful to us! he washed us inwardly and gave us a new way of living as a result of the holy spirit changing us inwardly.
target_text: masi ka mamuri èdhi ne ele iie le, te ngaa ama lamatua dhu hia mamuri mi èdhi, pad'elo le sasue dènge d'ara hua iia na mi dedha èdhi. na hia èdhi mamuri lula boe nèti tatao èdhi dhu be'a, te ngaa lula sasue na mi èdhi. nèngu rase pamèu-mèu sasala èdhi sèra pake roh na dhu mola-mèci, sèna ka pahiu mamuri èdhi, nuka sèmi rara iisi hari èdhi.

source_text: because we trusted in jesus christ our savior, god put the holy spirit within us in order to wonderfully change us.
target_text: lula yesus kristus madhe le ho pakaj'èu èdhi nèti koasa sasala sèra, nèti èèna ka ama lamatua hia dènge boe too-lane roh na dhu mola-mèci mi èdhi.

source_text: he wanted to erase the record of our sins even though we did not deserve that, and he wanted us to receive all that god desires to give us. these are the things that we confidently expect to receive when we live with him eternally.
target_text: lula d'ara hua iia yesus, ka na pabe'a pa'èci èdhi dènge ama lamatua, nuka sèmi ana na. hèia èdhi te'a, na, bèli-camèd'a èdhi mamuri taa-taa dènge ne. se'e se j'aj'i mi pusaka èdhi!

source_text: these words that i have written are trustworthy. so, i want you to confidently teach the things that i have written about in this letter to those who have trusted in god, in order that they will be constantly devoted/attempting to do deeds that are good and helpful for others. these teachings are beneficial and profitable for all people,
target_text: dhu ja'a peka ne, lèke tare'a. ngaa dhu ja'a aj'a ne, dènge kab'ua hia mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i. nèti èèna ka, èu hud'i pasanèd'e dhèu ho madhutu lii aj'a dhu mola. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya lamatua, loe boe tenge j'ara sèna ka tao j'ara dhu be'a.

source_text: but there are people who foolishly dispute/argue with you, wanting you to believe senseless ◄myths/stories that came from your ancestors►, stories in which there are ◄genealogies/lists of your ancestors' names►. they argue and quarrel with you, ◄insisting/telling you► that you must obey the jewish laws. ◄stay completely away from/do not talk with► them, because arguing about such things is not profitable for anyone. it is completely worthless!
target_text: baku soro iisi asa d'ara lii langu dhu leko-monya, nuka sèmi: pasibha d'ara lii langu dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua, patao iia d'ara dènge dhèu leo, patula-pajuku nèti j'aj'aj'i mia dhu dedha risi, aa patao nèti atora ad'a yahudi. tao ngaa? sèra sa aa'i-aa'i, èci sa gaguna na aad'o. pèci eele lod'o iia d'ara!

source_text: those people, by teaching things that are false, are causing others ◄to turn away from/to quit believing► the true teachings. you must warn them that god will judge them if they continue doing that. if they do not stop, warn them one more time. if they still do not stop, then no longer have anything o do with them.
target_text: lamu holo dhèu dhu tema pamae juma'at sèra. ladhe nèngu tao taruu, kai ne. aa ladhe na loe boe, soro tèke ne sène.

source_text: you will know clearly that such persons have deliberately ◄turned away from/quit believing and obeying► the true teachings. they know that they are doing what is sinful, but they deliberately keep on doing it.
target_text: dhèu sèmi èèna, ngangee na mola heka. nèti tatao unu na ka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra re'a mèu sasala na.

source_text: i expect to send either artemas or tychicus to you. as soon as one of them arrives, ◄make every effort/try hard► to come to me quickly at nicopolis city, because it is there that i have decided to go and stay during the stormy/winter season.
target_text: ja'a neo hia artemas do tikikus, dhiu paraga dènge èu asa pulu kreta. ladhe na d'ai, èu tenge j'ara sèna ka mai lai-lai paraga dènge ja'a ètu kota nikopolis. te ja'a neo pea ètu nèi d'ara hèru pacuhi ne.

source_text: as for zenas ◄the lawyer/the expert in the law► and apollos, when they are ready to leave crete island, help them as much as you can in order that they may have everything lit that they need as they travel.
target_text: èu tadhe le dhèu dhu d'èlu-mèu hukum, ngara na senas, aa angalai na apolos, do? ra neo lasi asa era kaj'èu. de mu bara si, sèna ka ra baku kura ngaa-ngaa ètu talora j'ara.

source_text: moreover, our fellow believers also should learn ◄to devote themselves to doing/to constantly do► good deeds for people who need help in order that they, our fellow believers, will live very useful lit lives.
target_text: te dhèu dhu madhutu lamatua yesus baku madhèdi iia d'ara di. rèngu hud'i maj'èni tao dhu be'a, aa bara dhèu dhu tare'a-re'a parluu. dènge sèmi èèna, mamuri ra dènge kab'ua.

source_text: as i finish this letter, everyone who is with me ◄says that they are thinking affectionately about you/wants me to send greetings to you►. tell those who are there who love us and believe as we do that we ◄are thinking affectionately about/greet► them. i pray/desire that our lord jesus christ will continue to act kindly toward all of you.
target_text: titus. ji'i aa'i-aa'i ètu ne'e pa'adhu lii maho'o hia èu. aa hia kahèi mi angalai ji'i dhu sama-sama parcaya lamatua yesus. ja'a sabaj'a manèngi sèna ka lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha miu aa'i-aa'i mi. d'ai sange ne'e ka, paulus

source_text: i, paul, am a prisoner who serves christ jesus. i am here with timothy, our fellow believer. i am writing this letter to you, philemon, our dear friend and fellow worker.
target_text: sasuri ne nèti ja'a, paulus. angalai ja'a, timotius, hia lii maho'o kahèi. sèna ka èu me'a, ra taha ja'a ètu d'ara èmu bèdho ne, lula ja'a peka-padhai dènge dhèu lula-nèti yesus kristus. ja'a suri sasuri ne hia èu, pilmon, dhu ji'i sue, aa dhu j'aj'i angalai ètu d'ara sasab'a;

source_text: i am also writing to your wife, apphia, and to archippus, who is like met our fellow soldier because he serves christ steadfastly together with us. i am also writing this to the congregation that meets/gathers in your sg house.
target_text: hia ina apfia, dhu ji'i tadhe nuka sèmi ana hèni ji'i; hia arkipus, dhu sab'a sama-sama dènge ji'i ètu d'ara sasab'a ne'e; dènge hia juma'at dhu tema sabaj'a sama-sama ètu d'ara èmu èu.

source_text: i pray that god our father and our lord jesus christ will continue to act kindly toward you all and will continue to cause you to have inner peace.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra mi dedha miu, sèna ka miu bisa mamuri padame èci dènge èci.

source_text: i always thank my god when i pray for you sg, because i hear people say that you love all god's people chi
target_text: pilmon! lod'o-lod'o dhu ja'a sabaj'a hia èu, ja'a manèngi makasi mi lamatua, lula mamuri èu.

source_text: and that you continue to trust in the lord jesus.
target_text: te ja'a tadèngi ae le nèti parcaya èu mi lamatua yesus, dènge sasue èu mi dhèu-dhèu parcaya.

source_text: i pray that as a result of your knowing all the good things that god/christ has done for us, you may ◄be effective/influence many others► as you tell others what you believe, in order that they may honor christ.
target_text: lula lalèka èu, èu bisa mamuri d'ara èci dènge dhèu parcaya dhu leo sèra. ja'a manèngi-mangaj'i ho ladhe miu pad'elo d'ara be'a miu èci dènge èci, miu bisa me'a mèu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu be'a, dhu èdhi bisa tao hia lamatua yesus.

source_text: i have rejoiced greatly and have been greatly encouraged because you, my dear friend, have acted lovingly toward god's people by encouraging them syn.
target_text: sasue èu èèna ka pakarej'e d'ara ja'a, aa pa'èra d'ara ja'a kahèi. aa sasue èu èèna ka, pa'èra kahèi d'ara dhèu parcaya sèra.

source_text: so i have a request/favor to ask of you. i am completely confident that i have authority to command you to do what you ought to do, because i am an apostle of christ. but because i know that you love god's people, i request this instead of commanding you to do it. it is i, paul, an old man and now also a prisoner because i serve christ jesus, who am requesting it.
target_text: a'a, ee! ja'a parluu ciki, sèmi ne'e: ja'a j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha kristus. nèti èèna ka, ja'a dènge hak kahèi ho paredha èu, sèna ka tao j'ara ne'e. te ngaa ja'a ko'o boe tao paredha di, dhoka neo manèngi èu bantu di, nuka sèmi dhèu heka dhu to'a mi dedha èu. ja'a j'aj'i ana bèdho lula madhutu yesus kristus. nèti èèna ka ja'a bani manèngi èu soru-bara ja'a, lula ja'a ke'a sasue èu mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: i request that you do something for someone who has become like my own son because i told him about christ met while i have been a prisoner mty here. his name is onesimus.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka èu pad'elo sasue èu mi ana ja'a, onesimus. nèngu èèna, nuka sèmi ana d'èlu ja'a, te nèngu parcaya yesus nèti sasab'a ja'a, ropa ja'a ètu d'ara bui ne.

source_text: although his name, as you know, means ‘useful', formerly he was useless to you. but now he is useful both to you and to me!
target_text: ja'a ke'a, onesimus ne, ènu èu dhu rai nèti èu. ja'a ke'a, na, uru èèna nèngu dhu laku boe ètu katanga madha èu. te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a parcaya nèngu nèti gaguna ae-ae hia èdhi dua ti.

source_text: although ◄he is as dear to me as/i love him as much as i love► met my own self mty, i am sending him back to you.
target_text: ja'a sue ne titu kèna. te ngaa hud'i laa, ja'a pua na lèpa hari asa èu.

source_text: i would like to have kept him with me, in order that he might serve me on your behalf, while i am a prisoner mty because of my preaching the message about christ.
target_text: madhutu ngangee ja'a, na, ja'a taha onesimus sèna ka gati èu, ho nèngu ladhe-leru ja'a ètu ne'e. te ja'a bisa boe tao ngaa-ngaa ètu d'ara bèdho ne. ja'a j'aj'i ana bèdho, lula peka-padhai dènge dhèu lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus.

source_text: nevertheless, because i had not yet asked you and you had not yet permitted me to keep him here with me, i decided not to keep him here. i decided that i should not do anything without your permitting it. i decided that you should help me only if you really want to help me.
target_text: ja'a ko'o boe sèna ka èu sad'i madhutu di, ladhe èu rasa dhèu laka-seti èu. dad'èi ja'a, na, èu tao dhu be'a madhutu dad'èi èu unu mu. de ladhe èu mo'o mèka sèmi dènge be'a lii manèngi ja'a, na, ja'a ko'o boe tao ngaa ciki sa mi onesimus ne, lula dhu hak dhoka èu di.

source_text: perhaps the reason that god permitted onesimus to be separated from {to leave} you for a little while was that he would believe in christ, and as a result you would have him ◄back/with you► forever!
target_text: ele boe èu pangee sèmi ne'e: lamatua soro tèke onesimus ele nèti èu d'ara ciki oo'e ne, sèna ka na mai hari ho pea taruu dènge èu.

source_text: you will no longer have him only as a slave. instead, you will have him as someone who is more than a slave. you will have him as a fellow believer! he is especially dear to me, but he certainly will be more dear to you than he is to me or, i love him very much, but you will certainly love him more than i do, because now he not only belongs to you but he also belongs to the lord.
target_text: lod'o na rai èèna, nèngu dhoka j'aj'i dhèu ènu èu di. te ngaa ladhe nèngu lèpa hari dhiu, nèngu j'aj'i mi ari pasue èu. ja'a sue ne titu kèna kahèi. de ne'e ne, gaguna na hia mi èu asa tabha. te nèngu ne mesa boe j'aj'i ènu èu di, te ngaa nèngu j'aj'i kahèi ari dhu sama-sama parcaya kristus.

source_text: so, if you consider me to be your partner in god's work, receive him as you would receive me.
target_text: de sèmi ne'e ka. ladhe èu tadhe ja'a ne angalai èu ètu d'ara sasab'a èci, na, ja'a manèngi ho èu sèmi more nèngu, nuka sèmi ja'a ka dhu dhiu èèna.

source_text: if he has wronged you in any manner or if he owes you anything, ◄charge that to me/tell me so that i can pay you►.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe onesimus tao nèdhi sala mi dedha èu, do, na pakèlu era, hud'i laa pe ja'a ka tago kore.

source_text: i, paul, am now writing this in my own handwriting: i will repay you what he owes you, although i might mention to you that you owe me even more than onesimus may owe you, because it was the result of my telling you about christ that god saved you.
target_text: ladhe laa! sasuri pakèlu ne, ja'a suri unu ku. ja'a, paulus, èèna na b'ae pama'ète kèlu onesimus mi pilmon. d'ai le, sina ma? de ja'a parluu heka pasanèd'e, na, èu pakèlu ja'a ae risi. te èu j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua, lula ja'a.

source_text: ◄yes/i say it again►, my dear friend, because you and i both have a relationship with the lord, i want you to do this for me. encourage me syn by receiving onesimus kindly, just like you encourage others who believe in christ.
target_text: lèke kèna! hud'i laa sèna ka èu bantu ja'a ètu j'ara ne'e, lula èdhi pa'a'ari ètu d'ara lamatua. pakarej'e d'ara ja'a sèmi èèna, lula èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti sama-sama dhèu unu kristus.

source_text: i have written this letter to you, confident that you will do what i am requesting you to do. in fact, i know that you will do even more than what i am requesting you to do.
target_text: pilmon! ja'a suri sasuri ne hia èu, lula ja'a parcaya èu bisa taru kira mi ja'a dènge be'a. ja'a rasa, èèna na èu tao risi nèti ngaa dhu ja'a sanao.

source_text: also, keep a guest room ready for me to stay in, because i confidently expect that as a result of your prayers for me, i will be released from prison and will come to you all.
target_text: j'ara èci era. sadia ku kama èci hia ja'a. te ja'a parcaya lamatua tadèngi lii sabaj'a miu, aa pe na bhoke j'ara ho kalua eele ja'a nèti d'ara bui, sèna ka dhiu hari pa'asu-pareo dènge miu ètu nèi.

source_text: epaphras, who is suffering with me in prison because of his serving christ jesus, ◄sends his greetings to you/wants you to know that he is thinking fondly about you►.
target_text: epapras ètu ne'e. nèngu j'aj'i dhèu bui kahèi, lula nèngu lole j'ara-j'ara lula-nèti yesus kristus sèmi ja'a kahèi. na pa'adhu lii maho'o kahèi hia èu.

source_text: mark, aristarchus, demas, and luke, who are my other fellow workers, also ◄send their greetings to you/want you to know that they are thinking fondly about you►.
target_text: markus, aristarkus, demas, dènge lukas ètu ne'e kahèi. sasab'a rèngu èci èèna ka dènge ja'a. rèngu hia lii maho'o kahèi.

source_text: i pray that the lord jesus christ will ◄continue to work kindly in all your lives/kindly keep accomplishing what he desires within you►.
target_text: ja'a manèngi kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, sèna ka pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi miu aa'i-aa'i mi. d'ai sange ne'e ka! saloom, paulus

source_text: long ago god communicated frequently to our ancestors in various ways by what the prophets said and wrote.
target_text: uru èèna, ama lamatua pake dhèu rèti lii padhai na, ho padhai lii dènge bèi-baki èdhi dhèu ibrani. nèngu pake rupa-rupa j'ara, sèna ka peka pahari-pahari dènge rèngu.
