target_text: isak parcaya ama lamatua kahèi. nèti èèna ka, na manèngi ho lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi ana na, yakob dènge esau.

source_text: it was because jacob trusted god that, as he was dying, he prayed that god would bless each of the sons of his own son joseph. he worshipped god as he leaned upon his walking stick before he died.
target_text: yakob parcaya ama lamatua kahèi. nèti èèna ka, lod'o nèngu oe madhe, pakaseti kèd'i titu dènge kabodho kabhuku dènge kèpe tatea na, pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua. hèia manèngi ho lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi èpu na, ana nèti yusuf.

source_text: it was because joseph trusted god that, when he was about to die in egypt, he anticipated the time when the israelis would leave egypt; and he instructed that his people should carry his bones with them when they ◄left egypt/returned to canaan►.
target_text: yusuf parcaya ama lamatua kahèi. lod'o na oe madhe, nèngu parcaya, na, ama lamatua pe lere nèti dhèu na, dhèu isra'el sèra, kalua nèti rai masir. nèti èèna ka, na moa tèke mi rèngu, ho rèti rui na ropa rèngu tèke eele rai masir.

source_text: it was because moses' father and mother trusted god that they hid their son for three months shortly after he was born, because they saw that he was so beautiful. they were not afraid of disobeying what the king of egypt had commanded, namely, that all the jewish male babies must be killed.
target_text: ina-ama musa parcaya ama lamatua kahèi. lod'o ina na nara iisi ne, ra pahuni ne toke d'ai tèlu hèru kateme, lula ra ladhe na mone iia. aa ra madha'u boe dhèu aae masir, masi ka paredha le dhèu, peka na, pamadhe aa'i ana-ana mone ibrani dhu rara iisi hiu!

source_text: the daughter of the king, whom they called pharaoh, raised moses, but when he had grown up, it was because he trusted god that he refused to accept the privileges that would have been his if people considered that he was ◄the son of the king's daughter/the king's own grandson►.
target_text: ropa musa kapai mai, na parcaya ama lamatua kahèi. te uru èèna, ana bhèni dhèu aae masir, dhu ded'e nare le nèngu sèna ka j'aj'i mi ana na. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa musa d'èi boe ladhe dhèu pangee, na, nèngu ne a'ari nèti dhèu aae masir.

source_text: he decided that it was better for others to mistreat him for a time along with the israeli people, than to temporarily enjoy living sinfully in the king's palace.
target_text: te na pangee, na, be'a risi nèngu mamuri j'èra sama-sama dènge dhèu unu lamatua sèra. sad'i nèngu baku mamuri karej'e dènge j'ara bhelu-katub'a, dhu dhoka ètu d'ara ciki oo'e di.

source_text: this is because he decided that if he suffered for the messiah, it would be worth far more in god's sight than his owning all the treasures of egypt that he would receive as pharaoh's heir. he decided that because he looked forward to the time when god would give him an eternal reward.
target_text: nèngu soro tèke dhèu pahahe ne, lula nèngu sanao-maena taruu mi kristus, nuka dhèu dhu ama lamatua pajaji le neo hia na mai. nèngu taha sèmi èèna, lula ne'a, na, bèli-camèd'a lamatua bagi hia ne hadia dhu be'a risi nèti mèdha aa'i-aa'i ètu rai masir.

source_text: it was because he trusted god that he left egypt. he was not afraid that the king would be angry because of his doing that. he ◄kept going/did not turn back► because it was as though he kept seeing god, whom no one can see.
target_text: musa parcaya ama lamatua kahèi, lod'o na manèngi isin nèti dhèu aae masir, ho lere nèti bèi-baki èdhi kalua nèti rai masir. masi ka dhèu aae nasa titu kèna, te ngaa musa madha'u boe dènge ne. musa lèka taruu ama lamatua, masi ka tèdhi boe senu-salao na, te ngaa nuka sèmi musa dhu nèdhi.

source_text: it was because moses believed that god would save his own people that he instituted the festival called passover. he did that by commanding that the people should kill lambs and sprinkle their blood on their doorposts. they did that in order that the angel who causes people to die would not kill eup the oldest male israelites when he killed the oldest sons in each egyptian family.
target_text: musa parcaya lamatua kahèi, ropa rèngu pa'èra neo kalua nèti rai masir. te nèngu madhutu mèno paredha lamatua, aa pua bèi-baki èdhi tao paska hiu-hiu, dènge roro kahib'i-kalèbho, sèna ka tao badha korban. hèia rare raa kahib'i-kalèbho sèra, sèna ka tao tadha mi babèdho èmu ra. mèda èèna, ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga puru mai pamadhe ana uuru aa'i-aa'i ètu rai masir. te ngaa na pamadhe boe ana uuru ètu èmu dhèu isra'el, lula ladhe nèdhi raa dhu ra pici ètu babèdho èmu.

source_text: it was because they trusted god that when the israelite people walked through where the red sea had been, it was as though they walked on dry land! but, when the army of egypt also attempted to cross that same water, they drowned, because the sea came back and flooded them!
target_text: lod'o bèi-baki èdhi kalua nèti rai masir, rèngu parcaya ama lamatua kahèi. lula lalèka ra, ka lamatua cèri eele èi dhasi mi dua ètu dhasi mea, sèna ka rèngu kako asa cabèka dènge be'a, ètu dedha rai mango. te ngaa sordad'u masir dhu bata si sèra, madhe aa'i ètu d'ara dhasi, ropa neo pège asa cabèka.

source_text: it was because the israeli people trusted god that the walls around jericho city collapsed, after the israelis marched around the walls for seven days.
target_text: lod'o bèi-baki èdhi maso asa rai kana'an, rèngu parcaya ama lamatua kahèi. te rèngu madhutu paredha na, dènge kako rai-reo re li'u tembok ètu kota jeriko, toke pidhu lod'o kateme. ka tembok ne guri laho mae-mae.

source_text: rahab had been a prostitute, but because she trusted god, she did not perish with those inside jericho who disobeyed god. joshua sent some spies into the city in order to find ways to destroy it, but god saved her because she welcomed those spies peaceably.
target_text: lod'o èèna, rahab ètu kota èèna kahèi. uru èèna, nèngu j'aj'i bhèni kajeo. lula na parcaya ama lamatua, nèti èèna ka na sèmi nare mata-mata dhèu isra'el, aa palu'u si ètu d'ara èmu na. hèia lamatua pamadhe aa'i dhèu jeriko, lula ro'o boe nanene nèngu. te ngaa lamatua hia mamuri mi rahab, lula na lèka ne.

source_text: i do not know what more i should say rhq about others who trusted in god. it would take too much time to tell about gideon, barak, samson, jephthah, david, samuel, and the other prophets.
target_text: ja'a bisa padhai lii madhera hari era, j'ara-j'ara dhèu leo dhu parcaya ama lamatua. te ngaa ja'a abhu boe lod'o taleo, ho lole toke lutu, lula-nèti gideon, barak, simson, yefta, daud, samuel, dènge dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu leo sèra.

source_text: it was because they trusted god that some of them did great things for him. some conquered lands ruled by powerful men. some ruled israel and justly punished those men and nations who rebelled against god. some obtained from god the things that he promised to give them mty.
target_text: rèngu se aa'i-aa'i ra parcaya ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, abhu dhu segi dhèu aae-dhèu aae. abhu dhu pakako paredha dènge d'ara mola, ho sarii dhèu dhu sala boe, aa huku dhèu dhu sala. abhu dhu sèmi rare ngaa dhu lamatua jaji le. aa abhu kahèi segi badha singa.

source_text: some forced lions to keep their mouths shut. some escaped from being destroyed by fire. some of those people escaped from being killed with a sword mty. some of those people who trusted god were made strong {became mighty} again after they had once been weak. some became powerful when they fought wars. some caused armies that came from foreign lands to run away from them.
target_text: abhu dhu pamadhe ai dhu heo robhe-robhe. abhu dhu ama lamatua ère nare si nèti dhèu dhu neo pamadhe si pake samala. abhu dhu roe, te ngaa ama lamatua pa'èra si. abhu dhu lamatua tao si ho èra aae ètu d'ara pamusu, toke musu rai.

source_text: some women who trusted god received their relatives back again when god ◄made them live again after they had died/raised them from the dead►. but others who trusted god were tortured until they died. they were tortured because they refused to agree when their captors said, we will release you if you deny that you believe in god. they refused to do that, because they wanted to live with god forever, which is better than continuing to live on earth after having almost died.
target_text: abhu kahèi ina-ina dhu paraga hari dènge dhèu rèngu dhu ama lamatua pamamuri hari si nèti mamadhe ra. te ngaa abhu dhèu dhu lèke j'aj'èra, lula parcaya ama lamatua. rèngu d'èi risi madhe, sèna ka baku tèke eele parcaya rèngu mi ama lamatua. te rèngu pa'èci taruu dènge ne. de rèngu dhu sanao-maena, na, bèli-camèd'a lamatua neo ded'e ra, sèna ka abhu mamuri dhu be'a risi hari ètu sorga.

source_text: other people who trusted god were mocked; some had their backs cut open by being struck with leaded whips. some were chained and put in prison.
target_text: abhu dhu pa-aape si, aa abhu dhu lèke gama. abhu dhu leo dhu lèke ngapi haga ra dènge ngangapi ètu d'ara bui.

source_text: some of those believers were stoned to death {people killed some of those believers by throwing stones at them}. others were cut completely in two. others were killed with swords. others of these people who trusted god wandered around the land wearing garments made only of skins from sheep and goats. they did not have any money. they were continually oppressed and tormented {people continuously oppressed them and tormented them}.
target_text: abhu dhu madhe, lula lèke pèci dènge hadhu. abhu dhu roro pamadhe si, pake raroro. abhu dhu dhèu pare pamadhe si pake samala. abhu dhu mamuri dènge boe unu, toke ra pake ka'uri badha, lula abhu dhèu dhu paj'èra dènge pasusa si, toke babèga eele si,

source_text: the people on earth who caused those who trusted in god to suffer were so bad that they did not deserve to live with people who trusted god. some who trusted god wandered in deserts and on mountains. some lived in caves and in other large holes in the ground.
target_text: ka rai lasi asa pad'a sod'a, ledhe-ledhe, d'ara loe, dènge asa d'ara ro'a rai. ra tao dhèu se'e dhu laku-laku boe, aa babège-lalèta si asa era dhu karehe. aa te ngaa lalèka ra èra titu kèna, toke dhèu ètu rai-haha ne nia boe pa'èci dènge dhèu sèmi se'e se.

source_text: although all these people were commended by god {god commended all these people} because they trusted him, god did not give them all that he promised them while they were alive.
target_text: lamatua koa dhèu sèmi se'e se, lula ra parcaya ne. te ngaa toke ra madhe, rèngu abhu mèka ngaa dhu lamatua padhadha tèka.

source_text: god knew ahead of time that what he would give us and them later would be better than giving them immediately what he promised. what god intends is that only when they and we are together will we have all that god intends us to have.
target_text: lamatua neo tao madhutu lii padhadha na dènge j'ara dhu be'a risi. lula na d'èi, sèna ka èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti bisa mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia dènge ne: nuka èdhi tadhe mèu le kristus, dènge rèngu dhu madhe uuru sèra.

source_text: we know about many people like that who showed they trusted in god. they are like a crowd of spectators who are cheering for us inside a stadium met. knowing that, we must put away all the things that hinder us, as a runner puts aside everything that would hinder him because they are heavy met. especially we must put away sinful actions that hinder us, as a runner sets aside clothes he does not need, clothes that would entangle him met. let us wholeheartedly strive to achieve what god has planned for us, as someone in a race wholeheartedly runs the course that is before him met.
target_text: de tasamia dènge èdhi dhu mamuri lod'o limuri ne? èdhi cakaraa dhèu dhu madhutu pa'uji rai. bèi-baki èdhi dhu parcaya ama lamatua, rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra nuka sèmi dhèu dhu titu lingu rare èdhi, ho pa'èra d'ara èdhi. te ngaa èdhi dhu pa'èki dènge sasala era, sèra sa ka dhu pabia haga èdhi ka rai tara boe. nèti èèna ka, èdhi hud'i core eele ku sasala sèra aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka èdhi bisa rai èra. te ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu pili èdhi, ho madhutu pa'uji rai ne, de èdhi hud'i taha ku, sèna ka rai taruu toke d'ai lane.

source_text: and let us keep our minds on jesus, as a runner keeps his eyes on the goal met. jesus is the one we should imitate in the way he perfectly trusted god. when he died on the cross he endured it as he suffered greatly mty, instead of thinking about the things he would rejoice about later. he disregarded being disgraced by dying that way. he is now sitting at the place of highest honor mty at the throne where god rules.
target_text: aa èdhi hud'i rai, mage piku g'ana-kariu, te ngaa ladhe dhoka asa yesus di. te nèngu ka dhu bhoke j'ara, ho èdhi bisa parcaya ama lamatua. aa èèna na nèngu soru-bara èdhi, sèna ka èdhi parcaya taruu toke èle. sanèd'e, do aad'o? lod'o yesus dui j'aj'èra ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, dhèu pahahe ne, te ngaa na taha taruu, lii boe-ugu boe. te ne'a, na, j'aj'èra na èle kèna, ka d'ara na j'aj'i karae. èèna ka dhu lèke. te na madhe, hèia ama lamatua pamamuri hari ne, èle ka na nedhe pamadhèdi kristus ètu baboa g'ana na, ho paredha sama-sama dènge ne.

source_text: jesus patiently endured it when sinful people acted so hostilely against him. try to act the way he did, so that you do not give up trusting god or become discouraged.
target_text: masi ka dhèu paj'èra bia ne, te ngaa na taha taruu. de miu baku bhèlu dènge j'aj'èra yesus, sèna ka miu bisa taha mere, aa baku roe.

source_text: while you have struggled against being tempted to sin, you have not yet bled and died because of resisting evil, as jesus did.
target_text: miu lab'a le j'ara bhabhelu-katub'a, te ngaa lalab'a miu èra mèka, toke raa miu suti. tare'a si!

source_text: do not forget rhq these words that solomon spoke to his son, that are the same as god would exhort you as his children: my child, pay attention lit when the lord is disciplining you, and do not be discouraged when the lord punishes you dou,
target_text: ele boe miu bhèlu lii holo-nori ama lamatua dhu na peka le dènge miu, nuka sèmi ca dhèu ama padhai lii dènge ana na, peka na, ana, ee! ladhe ama èdhi dhu huku ho aj'a èu, sèna ka èu mamuri madhutu j'ara dhu lèke, na, èu baku pamud'e! aa ladhe na kai ho aj'a èu, na, èu baku paroe d'ara.

source_text: because it is everyone whom he loves whom the lord disciplines, and he punishes everyone whom he accepts as his child.
target_text: te ama èdhi kai ho aj'a dhèu dhu na sue. mema dhèu-dhèu dhu na sèmi nare j'aj'i ana na, nèngu kai ho aj'a si.

source_text: it is in order that god may discipline you that he requires you to endure the disagreeable things that happen to you. when god disciplines you he is treating you as a father treats his children. all fathers rhq discipline their children lit.
target_text: de ladhe ama lamatua kai ho aj'a miu sèna ka mamuri madhutu j'ara dhu lèke, na, taha taruu aa sèmi mere. na tao sèmi èèna, lula miu j'aj'i le ana na. te ama aa'i-aa'i hud'i kai ho aj'a ana na, toke ana na bisa mamuri madhutu j'ara dhu lèke.

source_text: so, if you have not experienced god disciplining you just like he disciplines all his other children, you are not true children of god met. you are like illegitimate children; no father disciplines them.
target_text: te ladhe ama lamatua kai boe ho aj'a miu sama sèmi ana na dhu leo sèra, sasoa na, miu se ana nèngu boe.

source_text: furthermore, our natural fathers disciplined us when we were young, and we respected them for doing that. so we should certainly more readily accept god our spiritual father disciplining us, with the result that we live eternally rhq!
target_text: èdhi tema pakab'ua ama matana èdhi ètu rai-haha ne, lula na kai ho aj'a-nori ti, lod'o èdhi dhu ana iiki era. dhu lèke na kèna. te ngaa dhu be'a risi hari, èdhi hud'i nanene ku ama lamatua dènge be'a, lula nèngu ne, ama èdhi ètu sorga, aa na kai ho aj'a-nori èdhi, sèna ka èdhi mamuri madhutu j'ara na dhu lèke.

source_text: our natural fathers disciplined us for a short time in a way that they considered right, but it wasn't always right, but god always disciplines us in a right way, to help us. he does it so that we may be holy as he is.
target_text: ama matana èdhi kai ho aj'a èdhi, dhoka d'ara ciki oo'e di, madhutu ngaa dhu na ngee na be'a. te ngaa ama lamatua dhu ne'a risi, ngaa dhu èdhi parluu te'a. nèti èèna ka, na kai ho aj'a èdhi, sèna ka mamuri mola-mèci sama sèmi nèngu.

source_text: during the time that god is disciplining us, that does not seem to be something about which we should rejoice. instead, it is something that pains us. but later it causes those who have learned from it to be peaceful and to live righteously.
target_text: mema èdhi d'èi boe ladhe abhu lii kai. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, d'ara èdhi j'aj'i mau, lula te'a tare le mamuri madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: so, instead of acting as though you were spiritually exhausted, renew yourselves met spiritually. go straight forward in your christian life met, in order that believers who are uncertain about their faith will imitate you and not ◄leave god's way/become useless to god► met. instead, they will be spiritually restored met as an injured and useless limb is restored.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! pa'èra kacui-aai miu dhu roe, aa pasamaa haga miu dhu bia. baku rai piku g'ana-kariu, te ngaa rai mola taruu, sèna ka pa'èra d'ara rèngu dhu roe-bhilu ho bisa rai taruu. miu hud'i pa'èra d'ara miu, sèna ka taha taruu ètu d'ara parcaya mi kristus.

source_text: try to live peacefully with all people. seek to be holy, since no one will see the lord if he is not holy.
target_text: a'ari dhu parcaya kristus! miu hud'i pa'èra ngi'u mi, sèna ka mamuri padame èci dènge èci. aa baku loe tenge j'ara ho mamuri mola-mèci. te dhèu dhu mola-mèci boe, bisa boe rèdhi ama lamatua.

source_text: beware that none of you stops trusting in god, who has done kind things for us that we did not deserve or, beware that you have never experienced god kindly saving you. be on guard lest any of you act in an evil way towards others, because your doing that will grow like met a root grows into a big plant, and the result of your doing that will be that many believers will sin and become unacceptable to god.
target_text: pa'èra d'ara èci dènge èci, sèna ka mage dhoka abhu nèti miu dhu rai, toke rasa heka d'ara hua iia ama lamatua. aa j'aga paie ho baku soro tèke ladhe abhu dhu papèd'a d'ara ètu talora aae miu. te èèna nuka sèmi raco dhu pa'ele iie dhèu ae.

source_text: do not let anyone be immoral, or be irreligious as esau was. he exchanged the rights he had as a firstborn son for only one meal.
target_text: mage-mage aa j'aga ho baku abhu dhèu nèti miu dhu tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali nèngu. aa mage-mage aa j'aga ho baku abhu dhèu nèti miu dhu pusi-pahae boe ama lamatua, nuka sèmi esau. esau ne, ana uuru isak. ca lod'o, esau lèpa dènge kabake manganga. na manèngi nganga'a ca pega nèti ari na yakob, ho b'ae pake hak ana uuru.

source_text: you know that after he did that, he wanted to receive what his father would promise to give him if he blessed him. but his father was unable to change what he had already done. and esau found no way to change things, even though he sought tearfully to do that.
target_text: te ngaa èdhi te'a, nèbhu boe ka, esau manyasa. te ropa isak neo manèngi lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi ana uuru na esau, te ngaa bisa heka, lula esau dhu hia iia d'ara le hak ana uuru na. nèti èèna ka, masi ka na tangi roma iisi, tasamia èèna ka, nèngu bisa heka abhu ngaa dhu uru èèna nèngu core eele.

source_text: in coming to god you have not experienced things like what the israeli people experienced at sinai mountain. they approached a mountain that god told them they should not touch. they approached a blazing fire, and it was gloomy and dark dou, and there was a hurricane/cyclone.
target_text: sèmi ne'e a'ari! èdhi bisa lati le asa madha ama lamatua, madhutu j'ara hiu dhu na bhoke nare le hia èdhi. te ngaa uru-uru sèra, bèi-baki èdhi bisa mèka sèmi èèna. te lod'o ama lamatua pa'èki lii pajaji dènge rèngu, rèngu padètu dènge ledhe sinai. ètu dedha ledhe ne, abhu ai dhu heo. abhu ngèlu aae kahèi. aa maroga saguru nare ledhe ne, ka dhèu se madha'u titu kèna.

source_text: they heard a trumpet sounding and they heard god speak. the result was that those who heard it pleaded for god not to speak to them like that again.
target_text: rèngu tadèngi lii tiu tèbhe kahèi, hèia lii dhu mèdhu aae nèti lamatua kalua nèti ledhe ne. ropa tadèngi lii lamatua, hèia asa ra madha'u, toke ra manèngi musa, peka na, ira ii! ji'i bisa heka taha dènge lii nèi!

source_text: when god commanded them saying, if a person or even an animal touches this mountain, you must kill him/it by throwing stones at him/it, they were terrified.
target_text: rèngu mema bisa boe taha, lula ngaa dhu lamatua paredha èèna, bia titu kèna. te na peka, na, ca dhèu sa bisa boe j'èli ledhe ne! masi ka dhèu, do badha! te dhèu cee dhu j'èli ledhe ne, hud'i lèke pèci toke madhe.

source_text: truly, because moses was terrified after seeing what happened on the mountain, he said, i am trembling because i am very afraid!
target_text: ngaa dhu rèngu ladhe rèdhi ètu ledhe ne, mema pamadha'u tare'a, toke musa karèbha kahèi.

source_text: instead, it is as though you have come to the presence of god in heaven met. that is like what your ancestors did when they came to worship god on zion hill, in jerusalem, in the city of god who is all-powerful. you have come or, you are coming to where there are countless angels, who are rejoicing as they have gathered together.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, j'ara asa lamatua bhoke tèke le, aa èdhi bisa patoo madha padhai lii dènge ne. limuri ne, èdhi lati asa ledhe cue, ngara na sion. ètu era ne'e, abhu kota yerusalem. kota yerusalem ne, ètu boe rai-haha ne, te ngaa kota yerusalem hiu ètu sorga, era pea ama lamatua. ètu nèi, abhu ana pajuu ama lamatua ae-ae, toke riho-riho, dhu loe boe tao pesta.

source_text: you have joined all the believers who have privileges like firstborn sons, whose names god has written down in heaven. you have come to god, who will judge everyone. you have come to where the spirits of god's people are, people who lived righteously before they died, and who now have been made perfect in heaven.

source_text: the message that you heard when you first mty believed in christ is that we should love each other.
target_text: karèi nèti uru ka, miu tadèngi le lii moa dhu peka na, pasue èci dènge èci!

source_text: we should not hate others as did adam's son, cain, who belonged to satan, the evil one. because cain hated his younger brother, he murdered him. ◄i will tell you about why he murdered his brother. /do you know why he murdered his brother rhq? ► it was because cain habitually conducted his life in an evil way, and he hated his younger brother because his younger brother conducted his life righteously.
target_text: miu sanèd'e era lii lolo kaen dènge habel, si? baku tao madhutu kaen, te nèngu ne dhèu bhelu-katub'a, ka nèngu pamadhe ari na, habel. nga tao ka nèngu tao sèmi èèna? lula kaen tao j'ara-j'ara dhu bhelu, te ngaa ari na tao j'ara-j'ara dhu mola.

source_text: you should not be amazed/surprised, my fellow believers, when unbelievers mty hate you.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! baku malaa ladhe dhèu dhu madhutu dad'èi rai-haha d'èi boe miu.

source_text: we know that we have been changed from being spiritually dead met to being spiritually alive. we know this because we love our fellow believers. those who do not love their fellow believers are still spiritually met dead.
target_text: èdhi te'a le dhu peka na, dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara sasala, ladhe madhe, nèngu cèri eele nèti ama lamatua. te ngaa, lula èdhi pasue dènge a'ari èdhi, èèna j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, ropa èdhi madhe, èdhi mamuri taruu dènge lamatua. te, ladhe dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri dènge boe sasue, bèli-camèd'a madhe, na, rèngu pakaj'èu nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: those who hate any of their fellow believers, god considers met them to be murderers. and you know that no murderer has eternal life.
target_text: te dhèu dhu sue boe a'ari na, nèngu cakaraa dènge dhèu dhu pamadhe dhèu. de me'a le, na, dhèu dhu sèmi sèra sa, abhu boe mamuri taruu dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: the way that we now know how to truly love our fellow believers is by remembering that christ ◄voluntarily died/gave his life► for us. so, when our fellow believers need something, we should be willing to help them. we should even be willing to die for them.
target_text: èdhi bisa te'a conto sasue dhu lèke nèti kristus. te nèngu sue èdhi, ka soro ngi'u na, sèna ka madhe gati èdhi. nèti èèna ka, èdhi hud'i soro ngi'u èdhi kahèi bagi a'ari èdhi.

source_text: many of us have the things that are necessary for us to live in this world. if we become aware that any of our fellow believers do not have what they need and if we refuse to ◄provide for them/give to them what they need►, it is clear that we do not love god as we claim/say that we do.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu unu d'ai, nèdhi a'ari na ca dhèu dhu mamuri susa, te ngaa na tao boe madha-dhilu mi dhèu susa ne, na, tasamia ka nèngu peka na, ja'a sue ama lamatua! lèke boe!

source_text: i say to all of you whom i love dearly, let us not merely say mty that we love our fellow believers! let us genuinely/really love them by doing things to help them!
target_text: ana-ana pasue! baku dhoka sue ètu hèb'a di, te ngaa tao j'ara dhu be'a, ho pad'elo sasue dhu lèke.

source_text: when we truly love our fellow believers, we can be sure that we are conducting our lives according to the true message. as a result, we will not feel guilty/ashamed when we talk mty to god.
target_text: te, ladhe èdhi pad'elo sasue dènge ad'u-ue j'ara dhu be'a sèmi èèna, èdhi te'a, na, èdhi abhu mamuri dhu lèke. dènge sèmi èèna, èdhi madha'u heka, aa èdhi bisa doa kètu ropa èdhi ara lati asa madha ama lamatua.

source_text: we can pray confidently, because although we might feel guilty/ashamed about our sins, god is ◄greater/more worthy to be trusted► than what we feel. he knows everything about us.
target_text: masi ka d'ara iiki èdhi galaa èdhi lula-nèti j'ara dhu lèke boe dhu èdhi ad'u-ue uru èèna, èdhi madha'u ia ka. te rasa kasia ama lamatua kapai risi nèti rasa kasia èdhi. aa nèngu dhu ne'a aa'i mèu-mèu kahèi.

source_text: dear friends, when we do not feel guilty because of our sins, we can pray to god confidently.
target_text: ana-ana pasue! ladhe d'ara iiki èdhi galaa boe èdhi, na, èdhi bisa bani aa makae boe, ropa èdhi ara lati asa madha ama lamatua.

source_text: and, when we confidently pray to him and request something from him, we receive it because we do what he commands us to do, and because we do what pleases him.
target_text: lula èdhi tao madhutu paredha lamatua, aa pakarej'e d'ara na, nèti èèna ka èdhi bisa abhu ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu èdhi manèngi nèti nèngu.

source_text: i will tell you what he commands us to do: we must believe that jesus christ is ◄his son/the one who is also god►. we must also love each other, just like he commanded us to do.
target_text: lii paredha na sèmi ne'e ka: parcaya taruu ana na yesus kristus, dhu nèngu pua mai. aa baku loe pasue èci dènge èci, sama sèmi lii paredha yesus.

source_text: those who do what god commands are ones who have a close relationship with god, and god has a close relationship with them. i will tell you how we can be sure that god has a close relationship with us: it is because we have his spirit, whom he gave to us, that we can be sure that god has a close relationship with us.
target_text: dhèu dhu tao madhutu lii paredha ama lamatua sèra, mamuri na pa'èki dènge ne, aa ama lamatua pa'èki dènge ne kahèi. èdhi te'a, na, ama lamatua ètu d'ara èdhi, lula roh na mamuri ètu d'ara èdhi.

source_text: dear friends, many people who have a false message are teaching it to people mty. so do not trust every message that someone claims/says that god's spirit mty gave to him. instead, ◄test/think carefully about► the teachings that you hear in order to know whether they are from god or not.
target_text: ana-ana pasue! baku lèka leli lii padhai ladhe dhèu mai, peka na, nèngu nèti lii moa ama lamatua. te ngaa miu hud'i dadoo ne paie-iie, ho me'a mèu lii padhai na tare'a-re'a nèti lamatua, do aad'o. te limuri ne, ae le dhèu kapod'e-kabèli dhu kako pale-lème rai-haha ne. dhèu se tipu dhèu, peka na, rèngu sèra dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua.

source_text: i will tell you how to recognize teachings that come from the spirit of god: those who affirm/say that jesus christ came from god to become a human like us are teaching a message that is from god.
target_text: èdhi bisa te'a mèu lii moa dhu tare'a-re'a mai nèti roh lamatua, dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e: ama lamatua padhadha tèke le karèi nèti uru ka, sèna ka neo hia ana na mai asa rai-haha ne. ladhe dhèu dhu nèti lii moa èèna mangaku, peka na, yesus kristus èèna tare'a-re'a ana ama lamatua, dhu j'aj'i dhèu rai-haha sama sèmi èdhi, na, lii moa èèna mema nèti lamatua.

source_text: but those who do not affirm/say that about jesus are not teaching a message from god. they are teachers who oppose christ. you have heard that people like that are coming to be among us. even now they are already here!
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu mangaku boe yesus sèmi èèna, nèngu mai boe nèti ama lamatua. te èèna mai nèti dhu lab'a kristus. miu tadèngi le dhu peka na, dhu lab'a kristus èèna, bèli-camèd'a cèu mai. madhutu mola-mola na, dhu sèmi èèna abhu le ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: as for you who are very dear to me, you belong to god, and you have refused the false messages that those people teach, because god, who enables you to do what he wants, is ◄greater/more powerful► than ◄satan/the devil►, who enables ◄godless people/people who conduct their lives in a way that displeases god► mty.
target_text: ana-ana pasue! miu se, mema mai nèti ama lamatua, aa koasa na ètu d'ara miu. nèti èèna ka, miu segi le dhèu dhu lab'a lamatua. te roh na dhu pea ètu d'ara miu, èra risi nèti koasa dhu ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: as for those who are teaching what is false, they are ◄godless people/people whose lives are displeasing to god► mty. because of that, they teach what ◄godless people/people whose lives are displeasing to god► mty want to hear. that is why the ◄godless people/people whose lives displease god► mty listen to them.
target_text: dhèu dhu lab'a lamatua sèra, j'aj'aj'i ra nèti rai-haha. nèti èèna ka, lii padhai lii ra pa'èki mèno madhutu dad'èi rai-haha. hèia dhèu rai-haha ne d'èi nanene si.

source_text: as for us exc, because we belong to god, whoever ◄knows/has a close relationship with► god listens to us. but those who do not belong to god do not listen to us. that is how we can know whether the things that people are teaching mty are true or whether they are false, and deceiving people.
target_text: te ngaa j'aj'aj'i èdhi nèti ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, dhèu dhu tadhe lamatua d'èi nanene lii padhai èdhi. te ngaa dhèu dhu mai boe nèti lamatua, ro'o boe nanene lii padhai èdhi. dènge j'ara ne'e, ladhe dhèu peka na, nèngu nèti lii moa lamatua, bisa te'a mia ka dhu lèke dhu mai nèti roh lamatua, aa mia ka dhu kapod'e-kabèli.

source_text: dear friends, we must love each other, because god enables us to love each other, and because those who love their fellow believers have become god's children and ◄know/have a close relationship with► him.
target_text: ana-ana pasue! èdhi hud'i pasue ku èci dènge èci, lula kapua sasue nèti ama lamatua. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri pasue mai nèti ama lamatua kahèi, aa ra tadhe mèu ne.

source_text: god's nature is to love all people. so those who do not love their fellow believers do not ◄know/have a relationship with► god.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu dènge boe sasue tadhe boe lamatua. lula lamatua èèna, nuka sasue.

source_text: i will tell you how god has shown us that he loves us: he sent ◄his only son/the only one who was also god► to live on the earth to enable us to live eternally as a result of our trusting in what he accomplished for us by dying for us.
target_text: lamatua pad'elo sasue na mi èdhi sèmi ne'e: na pua ana na dhu dhodhoka ca dhèu èèna ka, mai asa rai-haha ne sèna ka bhoke j'ara hia èdhi. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, èdhi bisa mamuri taruu dènge lamatua.

source_text: and god has shown us what it means to love another person: it does not mean that we loved god, but it means that god loved us and sent ◄his son/the one who was also god► to sacrifice his life in order that our sins might be forgiven {he might forgive our sins}.
target_text: ladhe neo me'a sasue dhu lèke tare'a, baku pasoro sasue èdhi dènge sasue lamatua. te ngaa ladhe sasue lamatua mi dedha èdhi, lula ama lamatua pua ana na mai, ho j'aj'i korban sèna ka gati èdhi. dènge j'ara ne'e, lamatua saku eele sasala-sasigo èdhi, sèna ka èdhi bisa pabe'a hari dènge nèngu.

source_text: dear friends, since god loves us like that, we certainly ought to love each other!
target_text: ana-ana pasue! lula ama lamatua sue èdhi seli eele, na, èdhi hud'i pasue ku èci dènge èci kahèi.

source_text: no one has ever seen god. nevertheless, if we love each other, it is evident that god lives within us and that we love others just like he intends/wants us to do.
target_text: abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu ladhe nèdhi mèu ama lamatua. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ladhe èdhi pasue èci dènge èci, sasoa na, ama lamatua bera-bera dènge èdhi. aa sasue na asa tabha ètu d'ara mamuri èdhi, toke j'aj'i sasue dhu kateme.

source_text: i will tell you how we can be sure that we have a close relationship with god and that god is within us: he has put his spirit within us.
target_text: ama lamatua pangèd'u le roh na ètu d'ara èdhi. nèti èèna ka, te'a, na, èdhi mamuri d'ara èci dènge ne, aa nèngu mamuri d'ara èci dènge èdhi kahèi.

source_text: we apostles have seen ◄god's son/the one who is also god►, and we tell people that the father sent him to save the people in the world mty from being punished for their sins.
target_text: ja'a dènge angalai ja'a ngèdhi le ana ama lamatua dènge musi madha ji'i. ka ji'i peka palème dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i, na, ama lamatua hia le ana na mai, sèna ka patabuli dhèu ètu rai-haha ne nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra.

source_text: so those who affirm/say that jesus is the ◄son of/one who is also► god, god is within them, and they have a close relationship with god.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mangaku, peka na, yesus, ana ama lamatua, nèngu mamuri pabe'a dènge ama lamatua, aa ama lamatua pabe'a dènge nèngu kahèi.

source_text: we have experienced how god loves us and we believe that he loves us. as a result, we love others. because god's nature is to love people, those who continue to love others have a close relationship with god, and god has a close relationship with them.
target_text: èdhi te'a kahèi, peka na, lamatua sue èdhi titu kèna. nèti èèna ka, èdhi parcaya, nèngu sue èdhi taruu. lamatua sue dhèu rai-haha ne titu kèna. de dhèu dhu mamuri pasue, nèngu mamuri d'ara èci dènge ama lamatua, aa lamatua mamuri d'ara èci dènge nèngu kahèi.

source_text: we should love others completely. and if we do that, when the time comes for him to judge us, we will be confident that he will not condemn us or, that we have a close relationship with him. we will be confident of that because of our conducting our lives in this world as christ did.
target_text: aa ladhe èdhi d'ara èci dènge lamatua, sasue èdhi j'aj'i kateme. hèia, ropa d'ai lod'o èle ka rai-haha ne, lamatua parisa mamuri dhèu aa'i-aa'i, na, èdhi madha'u boe ara lati asa madha na, lula èdhi dhu j'aj'i le sèmi kristus, lod'o dhu na mamuri ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: we will not be afraid of god if we truly love him, because those who love god completely cannot possibly be afraid of him. we would be afraid only if we thought that he would punish us. so those who are afraid of god certainly are not loving god completely.
target_text: ladhe èdhi mamuri pasue, na, èdhi dènge heka d'ara madha'u ciki sa. te ladhe èdhi pasue dènge mola, èèna nuka sèmi èdhi pakaj'èu eele aa'i le madha'u nèti d'ara èdhi. ladhe dhèu madha'u, d'ara na susa, lula nèngu madha'u lèke huku. dhèu ne, nuka sèmi ana iiki dhu ne'a mèka sue dhèu dènge mola.

source_text: we love god and our fellow believers because god loved us first.
target_text: èdhi pasue, lula ama lamatua dhu sue uuru le èdhi.

source_text: so those who say i love god but hate a fellow believer are lying. those who do not love one of their fellow believers, whom they have seen, certainly cannot be loving god, whom they have not seen.
target_text: ladhe dhèu padhai lii, peka na, ja'a sue ama lamatua, te ngaa nèngu tèka d'ara dènge a'ari na, nèngu monya di. te ladhe dhèu sue boe a'ari na dhu ètu katanga madha nèngu, tasamia hari nèngu sue ama lamatua dhu nèdhi mèka? bisa boe, sina ma?

source_text: keep in mind that this is what god has commanded us: if we love him, we must also love our fellow believers.
target_text: te ama lamatua unu na ka dhu papuru paredha, peka na, èdhi baku sue dhodhoka nèngu di, te ngaa sue ku a'ari èdhi dhèu parcaya sèra.

source_text: all those who believe that jesus is the ◄messiah/person god sent to rescue us► are ones who have truly become children of god. and everyone who loves a man who is someone's father will be expected to love that man's children as well. similarly, those who love god, who has caused them to become his children met, should love their fellow believers, whom god has also caused to become his children.
target_text: dhèu parcaya aa'i-aa'i dhu peka na, yesus, tare'a-re'a kristus dhu ama lamatua pua mai, dhèu sèra j'aj'i le ana-ana ama lamatua. te dhèu dhu sue ca dhèu ama, tatu sue ana na kahèi.

source_text: the way we can be sure that we truly love god's children is this: we are loving them when we love god and do what he commands us to do.
target_text: ladhe èdhi sue lamatua, aa sab'a madhutu paredha na, èèna peka na, èdhi sue ana-ana lamatua kahèi.

source_text: i say this because our obeying what god commands us to do is the same as loving him. and it is not burdensome/difficult for us to do what god commands us to do.
target_text: de ladhe èdhi sue nèngu, èdhi hud'i tao madhutu ku paredha na sèra. aa paredha na bia boe.

source_text: all of us whom god has caused to become his children have been able to successfully resist ◄doing what/conducting our lives like► the people mty who oppose god do. it is only by our trusting in christ that we are able to ◄resist doing what/conducting our lives like► people in the world who are opposed to god mty do.
target_text: èdhi dhu j'aj'i le ana-ana lamatua, bisa segi dad'èi rai-haha ne, lula èdhi parcaya ne.

source_text: ◄i will tell you who are the ones who are able to resist doing what the people who are opposed to god do. /do you know who are the ones who are able to resist conducting their lives like the people who are opposed to god mty do? rhq► it is those who believe that jesus is ◄god's son/the man who is also god►.
target_text: te dhèu dhu segi dad'èi rai-haha, nuka dhèu dhu parcaya, peka na, yesus, ana ama lamatua.

source_text: think about jesus christ. he is the one who came to earth from god. god showed that he had truly sent jesus when jesus was baptized in water mty and when jesus' blood flowed from his body when he died. god showed this not only when jesus was baptized mty, but also when jesus' blood flowed from his body when he died. and god's spirit declares truthfully that jesus christ came from god. the spirit always speaks what is true.
target_text: sad'i miu me'a, na, yesus, dhèu rai-haha kahèi, aa nèngu ne, kristus kahèi dhu ama lamatua hia mai asa rai-haha ne. lod'o nèngu neo pakako sasab'a-la'a na, yohanis sarani ne pake èi. èle èèna ka, nèngu madhe aa pasuti raa na kahèi. de dhu lèke ka, mesa boe èi di dhu yohanis pake sarani nèngu, te ngaa raa na dhu suti eele èèna dhu kab'ua risi. te roh ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu peka sèmi èèna, aa dhu ne'a boe leko-monya.

source_text: there are three ways by which we know that christ came from god.
target_text: te abhu tèlu j'ara dhu j'aj'i sakasii:

source_text: those three ways are: what god's spirit tells us, what god said when jesus was baptized mty in/with water, and jesus' blood that flowed from his body when he died on the cross. these three things all tell us the same thing, that jesus came from god.
target_text: nuka roh lamatua, èi dhu yohanis pake sarani yesus, aa raa yesus unu na. tèlu j'ara se'e ka, pad'elo ca j'ara dhu sama lula-nèti yesus.

source_text: we usually believe what other people say. but what god says is more reliable/trustworthy than what people say. so we must believe what god has said is true about ◄his son/the one who is also god►.
target_text: ladhe dhèu rai-haha ka j'aj'i sakasii, na, èdhi bisa parcaya ne. risi-risi hari ladhe ama lamatua unu na ka dhu j'aj'i sakasii lula-nèti ana nèngu unu na. aa te ngaa tèlu j'ara se'e dhu ama lamatua pake, ho j'aj'i mi tadha dhu peka na, yesus mesa boe dhèu rai-haha biasa di, te ngaa nèngu ne kristus kahèi.

source_text: those who trust in the son of god know within their ◄inner beings/hearts► that what god says about his son is true. but those who refuse to believe that what god says is true are saying that god is a liar, because they refuse to believe what god has said about ◄his son/the one who is also god►.
target_text: dhèu dhu parcaya ana ama lamatua, sasoa na, dhèu ne sèmi nare le lii holo-nori lamatua, lula-nèti ana na. te ngaa dhèu dhu lèka boe lamatua, nèngu nuka sèmi dhèu dhu padhai lii, peka na, ama lamatua leko-monya! dènge j'ara ne'e, nèngu sèmi boe lii holo-nori lamatua lula-nèti ana na.

source_text: this is what god says to us: i have given you eternal life! we will live forever if we have a close relationship with his son.
target_text: isi nèti lii holo-nori lamatua nuka sèmi ne'e: lamatua hia le èdhi mamuri dhu lèke, toke d'ai mia-mia. aa èdhi abhu mamuri ne, lula èdhi parcaya ana na.

source_text: those who have a close relationship with god's son or, who have accepted what god's son has done for them have already begun to live forever. but those who do not have a relationship with ◄god's son/the one who is also god► or, who have not accepted what god's son has done for them have not begun to live forever.
target_text: de dhèu dhu pa'èki dènge ana ama lamatua abhu mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia dènge ne. te ngaa dhèu dhu pa'èki boe dènge ana ama lamatua, abhu boe mamuri sèmi èèna.

source_text: i have written this letter to you who believe that jesus is mty ◄god's son/the one who is also god► in order that you may know that you have eternal life.
target_text: ja'a suri madha j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i hia miu dhèu parcaya ana ama lamatua, sèna ka me'a mèu, na, miu unu mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: because we have a close relationship with him, we are very confident that he hears us when we ask him to do anything that is in accordance with ◄his will/what he desires►.
target_text: ladhe èdhi sabaj'a mi ama lamatua, sad'i èdhi manèngi ngaa èèna ka madhutu dad'èi na, èdhi bisa te'a tare'a-re'a, na, nèngu tadèngi lii manèngi èdhi sèra.

source_text: and since we know that he hears whenever we ask him for something, we also know that it is as though he has already done what we requested him to do.
target_text: aa ladhe èdhi parcaya tare'a-re'a sèmi èèna, èdhi te'a kahèi, na, èdhi abhu ngaa-ngaa dhu èdhi manèngi nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: those who see one of their fellow believers sinning in a way that does not result in being eternally separated from god should ask god to help that fellow believer; and as a result god will help that fellow believer and enable him or her to live eternally. but some people sin in a manner that causes them to be separated from god eternally. i am not saying that you should ask god to help people who sin like that.

source_text: the angel who was speaking to me carried a golden measuring rod, in order to measure the city, its gates, and its wall.

source_text: the city was square in shape; it was as long as it was wide. after the angel measured the city with his rod, he reported that it was ◄1, 500 miles/2, 400 kilometers► long, and that its height was the same as its length and width.
target_text: na uku uru tedhe kota. madhera, bhabhèla dènge katitu na, èci èèna ka. nuka, aa'i-aa'i ra, 2. dua riho dua ngasu dua nguru kilometer.

source_text: he measured its wall and reported that it was ◄216 ft. /70 meters► thick or, high. the angel used the measure that people normally use.
target_text: hèia na uku ma'aa tedhe, madhutu a'uku dhèu rai-haha. ma'aa na, èna nguru lèmi meter.

source_text: the city wall was made of something like the green stone that we call jasper. the city itself was made of something like pure gold that looked like clear glass.
target_text: tedhe ne, tao nèti hadhu kale'e, ngara na yaspis. aa aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara kota ne, tao nèti poe dènge pai, dhu mèu aadha-aadha nuka sèmi tèru.

source_text: the foundations of the wall of the city were beautifully made with wonderful stones that are like precious stones on earth. the first foundation stone was a crystalline stone like jasper, the second foundation stone was a blue stone like sapphire, the third foundation stone was a green stone like agate, the fourth foundation stone was a green stone like emerald,
target_text: canguru dua hadhu fanderen sèra, tao nèti rupa-rupa hadhu kale'e dhu kab'ua. fanderen ka èci, tao nèti hadhu yaspis, dhu mangèru kale'e. ka dua, nèti hadhu nilam dhu kale'e mangèru bhidhu-bhidhu. ka tèlu, tao nèti hadhu mirah dhu mea kale'e. ka èpa, tao nèti hadhu samrud, dhu mangèru kale'e.

source_text: the fifth foundation stone was a brown and white layered stone like sardonyx, the sixth foundation stone was a red stone like carnelian, the seventh foundation stone was a yellow stone like chrysolite, the eighth foundation stone was a green stone like beryl, the ninth foundation stone was a yellow stone like topaz, the tenth foundation stone was a green stone like chrysoprase, the eleventh foundation stone was a blue stone like hyacinth, and the twelfth foundation stone was a purple stone like amethyst.
target_text: ka lèmi, tao nèti hadhu unam dhu pakatanga dènge karara mea sanama pudhi. ka èna, dhu tao nèti hadhu sardius, dhu mea kale'e. ka pidhu, tao nèti ratna cempaka dhu karara hualaa. ka aru, dhu tao nèti hadhu beril, dhu kale'e mangèru aae. ka ceo, tao nèti hadhu krisolit, dhu karara moce-moce. ka canguru, tao nèti hadhu krisopras dhu mangèru mud'a. ka canguru èci, tao nèti hadhu lasuardi, dhu mangèru dhasi. aa ka canguru dua, tao nèti hadhu kecubung, dhu kale'e mea sanama mangèru.

source_text: the twelve gates of the city were something like huge pearls. each gate was like it was a single pearl. the ground of the main plaza of the city or, the streets of the city appeared to be pure gold that looked like clear glass.
target_text: aa babèdho kapai canguru dua bua sèra, tao nèti canguru bua mutiara. babèdho èci tao nèti mutiara cue. j'ara oka-hoo ètu d'ara kota ne, tao nèti poe-pai dhu kale'e sèmi tèru.

source_text: there was no temple in the city. the lord god almighty himself, and the one who is like a lamb, are there, so there was no need for met a temple.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a kèdhi boe èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ètu d'ara kota ne. lula ama lamatua dhu koasa kapai risi dènge ana kalèbho pea taa-taa ètu d'ara kota ne. nèti èèna ka, dhèu pahaha iisi mema mi rèngu.

source_text: the city will not need the sun or the moon to light the city, because the glory of god will illuminate the city, and jesus, the one who is like a lamb, will also be its light.
target_text: kota èèna, parluu boe madha lod'o dènge hèru ho pasaraa ne, lula saraa ama lamatua ka dhu pasaraa ne. aa ana kalèbho ne j'aj'i nuka sèmi labhu dhu heo.

source_text: the people of mty the nations will live with the light of the city shining upon them. and the kings of the earth will bring their wealth into the city to honor god and the one who is like a lamb.
target_text: dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha, èèna na kako lasi mai ètu d'ara saraa èèna. dhèu aae-dhèu aae nèti rai-haha, rèti kakaja-sasu'i ra asa nèi kahèi.

source_text: the gates of the city will not be shut {no one will shut the gates of the city} at the end of each day as they usually are shut, because there will be no night there.
target_text: ètu era nèi, abhu boe mèda. nèti èèna ka, parluu boe bèdho hèb'a tedhe.

source_text: the people of the world will also bring their wealth into the city to honor god and the one who is like a lamb.
target_text: pe asa d'ara kota ne, dhèu rèti aa'i-aa'i dhu be'a kahèi, dènge hormat aa'i-aa'i nèti rai-rai ètu rai-haha.

source_text: no one who is morally impure, no one who does things that god considers detestable, and no one who tells lies, will ever enter that city. only those people whose names are written in the book of the one who is like a lamb {whose names the one who is like a lamb has written in his book}, the names of people who have eternal life, will be there.
target_text: te ngaa dhu bisa boe maso asa nèi, nuka aa'i-aa'i dhu karehe, nuka sèmi: dhèu sogo-tagu nidhu, dhèu dhu tao j'ara makae, dènge dhèu kapod'e-kabèli. dhu bisa maso, nuka rèngu dhu ngara ra abhu ètu d'ara sasuri ana kalèbho. rèngu se'e ka dhu mamuri taa-taa dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: the angel showed me the river of water that causes people who drink from it to live forever. the water was sparkling and clear like crystal. the river was flowing out from the throne where god and the one who is like a lamb were sitting.
target_text: èle ka ana pajuu nèti sorga pad'elo dènge ja'a loko èci, dhu èi ne nèti mamuri. èi ne mèu aadha-aadha nuka sèmi tèru. na hae mai nèti kadera paredha ama lamatua dènge ana kalèbho.

source_text: it flowed down through the middle of the main street of the city. on each side of the river were trees bearing fruit that causes people who eat it to live forever. the trees bear twelve crops or, twelve kinds of fruit; they produce one crop each month. the people of the nations mty use the leaves of these trees as medicine in order that they may feel stronger
target_text: hèia hae la'e asa talora aae j'ara oka-hoo ètu d'ara kota ne. nèti sebhe-sebhe loko ne, abhu aj'u dhu hua na nèti mamuri. aj'u ne d'ara ca tèu, hua canguru dua hari; ca hèru, ca tèka. rèu na bisa j'aj'i èi na'i ho puri-pa'èle suku-suku ètu rai-haha nèti papèd'a ra.

source_text: there will never be anyone or anything there that god will be under god's curse. the throne of god and the one who is like a lamb will be in the city. and god's servants will worship him there.
target_text: te ngaa rèngu dhu ama lamatua tule eele aa dhoo si, abhu boe ètu d'ara kota ne. dhu ètu ne'e, nuka ama lamatua dènge ana kalèbho dhu madhèdi ètu dedha kadera paredha, aa dènge ana pua-paleha ra dhu pahaha iisi mi rèngu.

source_text: they will see him face-to-face, and his name will be written {he will write his name} on their foreheads.
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i bisa ladhe rèdhi rèhu ama lamatua. ètu katangarèi dhèu se'e, dhu suri ngara lamatua.

source_text: there will never again be night. god's servants will not need the light of a lamp or the light of the sun, because the lord god will shine his light upon them. and they will rule forever.
target_text: mèda abhu boe ètu kota ne'e. de dhèu unu lamatua parluu boe madha lod'o, do labhu, lula ama lamatua ka dhu pasaraa kota ne. bèli-camèd'a rèngu sama-sama rèd'u paredha toke d'ai mia-mia la'e.

source_text: the angel said to me: these words that god has revealed to you are true, and he will certainly do what he has promised to do. the lord god who ◄inspires the prophets/tells the prophets what to say► sent his angel to show the people who serve him the events that must happen soon.
target_text: ka ana pajuu ne peka dènge ja'a, na, aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a peka kore dènge èu se'e, lèke tare'a-re'a. dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa parcaya lii ja'a se. uru èèna, ama lamatua pake roh na ho peka-padhai lii holo-nori na mi dhèu rèti lii padhai na. te ngaa limuri ne, na pake ana pajuu na nèti sorga ho lole mi dhèu unu na, lula-nèti j'ara aa'i-aa'i se dhu nèbhu heka hud'i j'aj'i ku.

source_text: jesus says to all his people, listen to this! i am coming soon; god will abundantly bless everyone who obeys what has been commanded in this book.
target_text: hèia yesus padhai lii, peka na, sanèd'e paie-iie! nèbhu heka, te ja'a neo mai. ètu d'ara sasuri ne, dhu suri aa'i mèu-mèu le, ngaa dhu bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhutu isi sasuri ne, pe rèngu abhu a'oto.

source_text: i, john, am the one who heard and saw in a vision these things that i have written down. when i had heard and seen them, i immediately knelt down at the feet of the angel who was showing them to me, in order to worship him.
target_text: dhu suri sasuri ne, nuka ja'a, yohanis. aa'i-aa'i se ja'a nanene dènge ro'a dhilu ja'a, aa kèdhi dènge musi madha ja'a. ropa tadèngi kore, hèia ja'a patitu kètu urutuu ho pahaha iisi ètu madha ana pajuu nèti sorga ne, dhu pad'elo le aa'i-aa'i se mi ja'a.

source_text: but he said to me, do not worship me i am just your fellow servant! i am also the fellow servant of your fellow believers who are ◄the prophets/the ones who tell messages that come directly from god►, and i am a fellow servant of those who obey what has been commanded in this book. instead, worship god!
target_text: te ngaa na kai ja'a, peka na, ee! èu baku tao sèmi èèna! èu dhodhoka pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua di! baku mi ja'a ne. te ja'a ne ènu lamatua kahèi, èci èèna ka dènge èu dènge a'ari èu dhu j'aj'i dhèu rèti lii padhai na, aa dènge dhèu leo aa'i-aa'i ra dhu tao madhutu ngaa dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri ne'e.

source_text: he also said to me, do not keep secret the message about what god has foretold in this book, because it is almost time mty for him to what he has promised to do in this message.
target_text: èu baku pahuni isi sasuri ne dènge dhèu leo. te nèbhu heka, aa'i-aa'i dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri ne, hud'i j'aj'i ku.

source_text: since that time is near, if those who act in an evil manner want to continue to act that way iro, that is up to them. god will soon ◄pay them back/punish them► for that. if those who are vile want to continue to be vile iro, that is up to them. god will soon ◄pay them back/punish them► for that. those who are acting righteously should continue to act righteously. and those who are holy should continue to be holy.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ad'u-ue bhabhelu, na, hud'i rèngu sène ra tao kaj'alu taruu. te ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri mola-mèci, hud'i laa ra mamuri mola taruu. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tao karehe, hud'i rèngu sène ra tao bhelu taruu. te ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu tao be'a, hud'i laa ra tao taruu dhu be'a.

source_text: jesus says this to everyone: listen! i am coming soon! and i will pay back everyone according to what each one has done, by punishing or rewarding them.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus lii hari, aku nèngu na, sanèd'e paie! te nèbhu heka, ja'a dhiu. pe ja'a b'ala hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i, madhutu ngaa dhu ra ad'u-ue.

source_text: i am the one who began all things met and the one who will cause all things to end met. i existed before all things existed and i will exist at the end of all things dou.
target_text: ja'a ne, alpa toke omega. ja'a ne, a toke z. aa'i-aa'i j'aj'aj'i ra nèti ja'a, karèi nèti uru, toke d'ai èle.

source_text: god is very pleased with the people who wash their robes, making themselves spiritually clean met, because they will be able to eat the fruit of mty the tree that enables people to live forever, and because they will be able to enter the gates into the holy city.
target_text: dhèu dhu rase pamèu le mèdha-papake ra, rèngu ka dhu oto. te rèngu ka abhu hak ho maso re babèdho kapai dhu la'e asa d'ara kota ne. dhèu dhu mamuri mola, rèngu ka dhu oto. te bèli-camèd'a rèngu abhu ijin ho ra'a hua dhu hia dhèu mamuri taa-taa.

source_text: people who are unholy will not be allowed to enter the city. they include people who practice sorcery, people who sin sexually, murderers, idol worshipers, and everyone who enjoys telling lies and are continual liars. they can never enter that city.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu leo bisa boe maso asa era èèna. dhèu dhu unu boe lamatua, bisa boe pea ètu era èèna. nuka rèngu dhu parcaya boe lamatua, dhèu dhu tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali ra, tuka sogo-tagu, tuka pamadhe dhèu, tuka suagi, dènge rèngu dhu leko-monya. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra bisa boe ara asa d'ara. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra pea dhoka mi li'u di.

source_text: i, jesus, sent my angel in order that he might tell you who are in the congregations that all these things that have been said are true. i am the descendant of king david whom the prophets promised would come met. i am the one who is like the bright morning star met, the one that moses promised would come.
target_text: ja'a ne, yesus. ja'a ka dhu paleha ana pajuu ja'a nèti sorga, ho bhoke j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i ra, sèna ka pe miu lami lole peka lii pajaji ja'a se'e mi pidhu juma'at sèra. ja'a ne, ana-èpu dhèu aae daud. ja'a ne, dhèu aae dhu kèd'u paredha. saraa nèti ja'a heo lo'a-lo'a, nuka sèmi hua-hètu oe mèu. saraa nèti ja'a madèka titu kèna, nuka sèmi hua-hètu èèna.

source_text: god's spirit and his people, who are like met the bride of christ, say to each one who desires to believe, come! whoever hears this should also say to each one who desires to believe, come! spiritually thirsty people should come met! everyone who desires the water that enables people to live forever should take it as a free gift!
target_text: roh ama lamatua mai paroa, peka na, mai asa ne'e! bhèni dhu neo kab'i paroa kahèi, peka na, mai ka! aa'i-aa'i dhu tadèngi peka kahèi, mai ka! dhèu cee dhu koko-kamango, mai ho minu! dhèu cee dhu neo ninu èi dhu nèti mamuri, mai mere ka! dhèu bisa rare èi ne dhu iia-iia d'ara. dhèu bisa rinu èi ne dhu b'ae boe.

source_text: i, jesus, solemnly warn everyone who hears what i have foretold in this book: if anyone adds anything to this message, god will cause him to experience the plagues that are {that i have} described in this book.
target_text: ja'a, yohanis, pasanèd'e dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu èèna na tadèngi ngaa dhu ama lamatua bhoke mema hia ja'a ètu d'ara sasuri ne: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu patabha hari ngaa-ngaa ètu d'ara sasuri ne, èèna na ama lamatua pabie hari hahuku na mi nèngu dènge pidhu calaka sèra dhu na dutu mai asa rai-haha.

source_text: if anyone omits any of the message about what i have foretold in this book, god will take away that person's right to eat fruit from mty the tree that enables people to live forever. he will also take away that person's right to enter god's city. both these things are described {i have described both these things} in this book.
target_text: aa ladhe abhu dhu pakura hari isi sasuri ne, pe ama lamatua tao eele hak nèngu, sèna ka bisa boe maso asa d'ara kota dhu mola-mèci, aa bisa boe na'a hua aj'u dhu hia dhèu mamuri taa-taa.

source_text: jesus, who says that all the things written here are true, says, certainly i am coming soon! i, john, reply, ◄may it be so! /amen! ► lord jesus, come!
target_text: yesus mesa na ka dhu bhoke j'ara aa'i-aa'i sèra. na moa le, peka na, tare'a-re'a sèmi èèna! nèbhu heka, ja'a neo dhiu. de mai ka, lamatua yesus!

source_text: i pray that our lord jesus will continue to act kindly to all of you who are god's people. ◄amen! /may it be so! ►
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka lamatua yesus pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dhèu unu na aa'i-aa'i. lèke tare'a sèmi èèna! amin! nèti ja'a, yohanis
